_about:
The in-game Quest Guide (owner 2026-10-07): the Allakhazam walkthrough of every classic quest on the server, shown by
the Quest Journal's QUEST GUIDE button (/task) and /questguide.

albion|abolishment of sacrifice.Name: Abolishment of Sacrifice
albion|abolishment of sacrifice.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-11-23 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Received from Paladin trainer at level 15. You must complete the Traveler's Way and List of Denial quests first.

Step 1: You must go to the council in Humberton (out of north gate of camelot, not to far) to a keep on the hill there and speak with the council. Apparently, someone named Harish (a filidh) has cursed the church and is drawing the sons and daughters of Humberton into his own cult.
Step 2: The council sends you to the twin towers, just across big white up and down bridge. You just have to ask the guards about Harish and they will tell you he is north of the tower.

Step 3: Head due north up a big hill and you will see a group of filidhs, mostly green and grey to me at level 15. Off to the left and behind this camp is another group of filidhs where Harish is hiding out.

Step 4: Kill Harish and he will say something to the effect of "Now see the my true power as I continue to battle after death" He will then die and become "Shade of Harish" a 8 foot ghostly version of himself. Original Harish was grey to me and the shade version was green at level 15. When you kill the Shade of Harish the filidhs joined in the fight die as well.
Step 5: Return to the council and they will thank you and give you a "Humberton Tithe" to take back to Camelot as their thanks for the churchs aid.

Step 6: When you talk to the trainer in Camelot she asks if you defeated the evil and then you hand her the tithe. I received no money or exp but a NICE set of leggings. It's been mentioned that thee are a few more steps beyond this one...
Notes and locs by Shadowar:
1) Talk to your trainer in Camelot City inside the church at loc 31000, 19000.
2) Exit Camelot by the North gate and go talk to Belef at loc 20360, 40475 in Black mtns South. He is inside Castle Humberton on the 2nd floor.
3) Speak to any guard near the 2 towers, North of the double bridge at loc 36400, 18000 in Black mtns South.
4) Kill Sacrificer Harish at loc 42350, 385 in Black mtns South. Was grey to me et lvl 17, when he dies his spirit attacks you (was green).
5) Go back to Belef in castle Humberton.
6) Return to your trainer in Camelot.
Rewards:
Redoubled Leggings
Faithbound Shield

albion|animare il morti.Name: Animare il morti
albion|animare il morti.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-08-23 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This is a continuation of the Sorceror Epic Quest. At level 25 go see Master Vismer in the Academy at Camelot. He will tell you of the continued pursuit to control the raising of the undead.

He will give you some spell components and ask you to go kill a Roman Guard in Cornwall name Favius. Favius is at the roman undead camp near the villa. To find him go south down the road from Cornwall Station at your first left in the road head down it. You will see roman guards up and down the path.. you should follow the path from a distance away from the road to avoid all the aggro Mobs in the area.
When you come to the end of the path you will see the villa and Favius walk around the villa with a bunch of other undead romans. He walks alone however and cons blue at lvl 25.

After you kill him, you need to go back to the circle of summoning in the lost tower that is SW from the villa. Make sure the summoning spell components are in your inventory. speak the words of power again. The phrase is "abeo decido animus exspecto terra." Appears to work only at night.
Once done, a roman burning knight appears, and you are told to go back to Vismer.
Lot of horse riding, but real easy quest.
Good Luck.
In the SI expansion the tower is not broken
Rewards:
Thought Threaded Cloak -- Sorceror
Fire Threaded Cloak -- Wizard
Chain Shirt of Comfort -- Mistrel
Rewards:
Thought Threaded Cloak
Fire Threaded Cloak
Chain Shirt of Comfort

albion|feast of the decadent.Name: Feast of the Decadent
albion|feast of the decadent.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Once again, your help is needed to gather information to help defend the Realm of Albion (sorta makes me feel like an infiltrator) This quest was relatively simple in execution with a decent reward (for my class). It involves much travel time and the mobs you end up getting information from conned orange at level 43.

Once you are at level 43, visit your main class trainer and they will send you off on yet another adventurous romp up and down the length of Albion. You are given The Feast of the Decadent quest and your first stop is to visit Arly Camden in Sauvage Castle.
Arly tells you a story about BWCAs attacking outposts and he requests that you gather information and take what you find to Caelin Finian who is also in Sauvage Castle.

Killing a regular BWCA, grey to a level 43, does not satisfy the quest. Angry BWCAs spawn in a couple of camps in Snowdownia and possibly in other zones. The one that I went to was located in Snowdownia at 8k, 30k (New Frontiers loc=Pennine Mountains 40k, 50k). Find an Angry BWCA, orange and red con then kill it. Once you do, you will find a Blood Marked BWCA Hide in your inventory and a text message that tells you that you sense you have learned all you can from the BWCAs. Head back to Caelin in Sauvage Castle.

Give the hide to Caelin and he will examine it. After doing so, he will give it back and ask you to take it to Elvinia Dareal in Caer Witrin. Down to Avalon Marsh you go to visit Elvinia. Giving her the hide did not trigger a response from her. Say Caelin and she will tell you that she needs you to find the Rangers of the Tylwyth Teg and get from them some Tylwyth Teg brew to assist her visions.

Tylwyth Teg Rangers are orange con and spawn along the northern zone wall of Snowdownia (location 5k,28k is in Pennine Mountains, near the pass Pennine-Snowdonia, New Frontiers Pennine Mountains 48k, 3349). I had difficulty finding a single ranger here and later found singles in Forest Sauvage. Kill one and you will find a bottle of elven brew in your inventory. Take this back to Elvinia. The
location is 53K,39K in Pennine Mountain. The location is not far from the
Forrest Sauvage/Pennine Mountain border so shouldnt be any problems finding
it.

Give Elvinia the elven brew and she tells you that it will take a while for the spell to work. She gives you a reward and asks you to return at a later time. At 43 I got over 985,000,000 exp, about 1 bubble
Rewards:
Ring of Shielding Power -- Theurg
Ring of the Stalwart Arm -- Armsman
Ring of Vigilant Defense -- Scout
Ring of Prayers -- Friar

albion|deserter amano.Name: Deserter Amano
albion|deserter amano.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: When you hit 20 speak to your trainer in Camelot, she will tell you to seek out Lord Adribard in Avalon Marsh and assist him.
Deserter Amano has deserted his teachings and the church etc helping goblins attack people locate him to the north.
Amano is out side of Tepok's near the ruined house on hill. Be warned, hit

him with any ranged attack and he mezzes you and lets the goblin warrior take you on who is blue at 20. There is a shaman who is gray who anti buffs you also. Amano is grey as well, if in trouble use the area near entrance if it starts to go pearshaped leg it into Tepok's, heal etc., then go back for more. Then this quest says to inform Lord Adribard about Amano's death.
Lord Adribard is in Adribards retreat. Journey to him tell him hello, thank you, and he tells you to go see Magus Crystolos in Lethantis Association.
Tell him Amano is dead and you will get xp and your reward.
Rewards:
Vest of the Valiant
Vambraces of the Defender

albion|entry into tomorrow.Name: Entry Into Tomorrow
albion|entry into tomorrow.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Your Trainer asks you to talk to Captain Dillon in the guard tower close to Ludlow to start the quest. Captain Dillon asks you to look for two runaway guards, Frund and Agisthil in the North Black Mountains. This information is wrong, in fact, the two guards are still in South Black Mountain. They are located to the east of South Black Mountain after the bridge they can be found at 53899, 17267. After acquiring the stones, you will have to take them to Omis at a keep on the road before you get to Snowdania Fortress. After polishing the stone, you will be asked to rid of Brodic at East of South Black Mountain, 44k, 13k. As soon as I entered this little forest across the bridge I got the message: "The pouch holding the Crediac glows with warmth and light". It means that Brodic is somewhere around. I found him at loc 42165, 9417 Go back to Captain Dillon for your reward.
In my case, Crediac started to shine at 38000,6000 and I found Brodic (yellow 11) at Loc (378,78)(406,93)... he may wander away from here, but this is his return location.

Amulet of Feline Graces -- Infiltrator
Bookworm's Ring -- Cabalist
Might (bracer) -- Mercenary
Gem of Black Death -- Reaver
Arawn's Beads and Flayed Skin Necklace-- Necromancer

albion|arc of ages.Name: Arc of Ages
albion|arc of ages.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-11-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This is the level 40 Academy Epic Quest.

It starts off at your trainer, who tells you that Master Vismer is in need of you again. When you go to talk to Master Vismer he gives you a scroll and asks you to find a tower in Camp Forest. The tower is that of the Lethanis Association and when you step onto the East Platform (North Platform has been mentioned as well.), you are teleported to Snowdonia, a few paces from where Lady Nimue spawns.

Give the scroll you received from Vismer and Lady Nimue tells you that your next step is to retrieve the Staff of Enlightenment from Cornwall where is resides in the hands of a long lost emperor. Travel to Cornwall and the Catacombs and work your way down to the Forgotten Emperor. When you kill him you receive the Staff of Enlightenment.

In order to proceed you must wield the Staff, whereupon it tells you to go to Lethanis to find out what comes next. When you get to Lethanis, stand on the North Platform and the Staff tells you to travel to the Teleport Platform in Forest Sauvage. Traveling there gets the Staff to tell you that the Arc of Ages you are looking for is in Hadrians Wall guarded by undead Roman Centurions. Or you stand on the north platform with the scroll and the east with the staff. We have gotten reports of both ways. Could be different for each class.

Travel to Hadrians Wall and along the road is the fallen aqueduct (NEW FRONTIERS loc=32k,13k). One of the fallen pieces looks like a perfect Arc. Around it will be 5 undead Centurions. There is no need to fight them. If you can survive for 5 seconds, standing underneath the Arc will kill the Cents. After they are dead the Staff will be replaced by a Tome of Summoning. Take the Tome to Master Vismer and he rewards you with a Weapon of your choosing.
For Minstrels, we had a choice between a Thrusting or a Slashing weapon. The Slashing weapon is known as Deathtale.

Deathtale

albion|barbaric tales.Name: Barbaric Tales
albion|barbaric tales.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per live patch first week in Oct and Nov:
Legend of the Lake and Barbaric Tales: Players couldn't turn in the second goblin tome - this has been fixed, they can turn it in now.
Sir Verin is outside the gates to Swanton Keep in North Black Mountaints.
He asks you to get 2 halves of a book of knowledge from the named goblins, Ulfwag and Grilk.
Ulfwag can be found in a goblin fort south of Swanton Keep and north west of Snowdonia Station location 18086 28069

Grilk can be found in an abandoned house. To get there, go to the lone guard tower along the path to Snowdonia Fortress. This is north of the twin guard towers past the bridge that connects South Black Mountains to North Black Mountains. From the lone guard tower, head west by southwest and you shall climb a tall mountain, with roaming goblins. Look around for an abandoned house. Loc 4.4k, 5.5k. (For all who know where Tepok's Mine is, it is southwest of it). After you give both halves to Sir Verin, you have to return to Lady Nimue.
When your return to Lady Nimue, she will award you experience and and an item. These are rewards for completion of Legend of the Lake, but listed for your convenience.
Armsman -- Sleeves of the Stoic
Friar -- Traveler's Leggings
Scout -- Gauntlets of Archery
Theurgist -- Necklace of Elemental Influence
Rewards:
Necklace of Elemental Influence
Sleeves of the Stoic
Gauntlets of Archery

albion|defender's orders.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)

2. She tells you to go speak with Gavon Montgomery in Caifelle (get ticket

albion|forged excellence.Name: Forged Excellence
albion|forged excellence.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: At Lady Nimue when she asks you to choose one of the sub quests, choose
[shard of Sequence] and you will be given the Forged Excellence quest.
Lady Nimue sends you off to speak to Erstal Furlan, the smith at Outland Wharf about the shards of Sequence.
At Outland Wharf, ask Erstal about the [shards of Sequence]. He will tell you the story of Arthur's sword named Sequence and how it was broken by Lancelot while completing an epic quest.

At the end of the story he tells you to go get the shard from inside a mud golem named Dooben. Dooben has moved, he is now southwest of Caer Witrin (16k, 46k) with some of his other mud golem buddies. Go kill Dooben at his new home (blue to me at level 15) and receive a Shard of Sequence (level 50 item with no properties).

Return to Erstal with the jewel and give it to him. He tells you it can be combined with another item, gives it back to you and sends you off to slay the wood ogre seer, Vagdush. Vagdush is on the western border with Cornwall, just a bit north of the road, and up on a wooded hill (4k, 36k also seen at 3k, 44k)(also has been found on the opposite side of the road NE of that location at 3940, 35580 amongst a group of wood ogre seers.)
When you slay Vagdush (yellow to me at level 15), you receive Vagdush's Seer Amulet (level 40 item with no properties).

A check of your journal tells you that you need to combine these jewels at the forge at Cornwall Station. Run on over to the forge and right-click on it to combine the items. You receive a Sequence Ring from the Forge.
You have finished the Forged Excellence quest!
Reward:
Sequence Ring

albion|fortune of few.Name: Fortune of Few
albion|fortune of few.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per Patch 1.37:

Quest: Fortune of Few. Armsmen were receiving a Embossed Crossbow reward for this level 11 quest. For those Armsmen who wish to receive a usable item for their level, please return to Master Graent. You can hand him the Embossed Crossbow and you will receive a Belt of Battle in exchange.
Per patch 1.71:
- Fortune of Few - Master Graent will once again accept crafted war mattocks in addition to the store bought ones.

You speak to your trainer and he states that Master Graent is planning on running some training classes, but unfortunately his shipment of weapons that he needed for this did not arrive and he is desparate for weapons to train his students with. If you agree to help him with this, he gives you slightly more than 11 silver to go buy 5 bronze war mauls and take the Master Graent. The amount he gives you equals the cost of the war mauls. Click the item picture, not the name. These are considered Large Weapons, and Ethan Farley in Camelot sells them (hut in the middle of hut # 55 ( map in Official Strategy Guide) with the blue and white striped roof ( right in front of you as you pass by the Old folks named Pritchard ( they used to OR still give free /level armor) Purchase these and take to Master Graent

After you do this, he states that you are trustworthy and, since he is now not going to have to cancel his classes today, he needs your help again. He needs you to run to the bridge by Salisbury Plains (southeast of Prydwen Keep) and take a food shipment to Sergeant Grum, because he has not received his shipment. He can be found south of the bridge patrolling the area, and doesn't stop long to be disturbed. You give him the food shipment and he thanks you and tells you to return to Master Graent.
When you return to your trainer he again praises your trustworthiness
and, as a token of gratitude, gives you a reward.
Official hint (from Camelot Herald):

Players getting the message "Item number not listed" when trying to buy bronze war mattocks need to pick up the mattock icon so its on the cursor and then click buy instead of just highlighting the item and clicking buy.
Rewards:
Ring of Clarity -- Friar
Embossed Crossbow -- Armsman
Bracer of Deftness -- Scout
Minor Elemental Insight -- Theurgist
Belt of Battle
Rewards:
Ring of Clarity
Embossed Crossbow

albion|hands of fate.Name: Hands Of Fate
albion|hands of fate.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per Patch 1.60:
- Hands of Fate: The Shade of Ambrosius should be working correctly again.

If you still have the Scroll of Fate and the Tome of the Dead, AND the Ebony collar of the dead you pulled from that Kobold thats just beyond the HUGE bridge north of Ludlow. You give these items to the Loremaster found in the Academy in Camelot. He tells you to come back when you are level 30 (Chaplain for a friar). When you see the Loremaster when you are level 30 (this is where hands of fate begins), he decifers the meaning of all 3 items and what you must do. He says something about finding the one true sword (Excalibur obviously), and finding those whose sleep is restless in the Salisbury plains, he also mentions something about merging the items to become immortal.

After a bit of searching around, I figured out that the spectre I was looking for was at the entrance to Stonehenge Barrows (Make sure you are wearing the Collar of the Dead when you approach Stonehenge). His name is "Shade of Ambrosius Aurelianus". He will be up for anyone with the quest in their journal regardless of time of day. So I found him, some talking (looks like a guard) spectre, I handed him both the scroll and the book. Morgana promptly appears and they guard and Morgana do battle (Morgana was purple to me at level 30, though non-agro). She lights this dude up like a Christmas tree and he dies. Then she takes the book and the scroll, and warns me to never interfere with his affairs again. She disappears and I found a nice shiny new staff called Haze (yellow) which deals 11dps and spd 3.0. I don't think this quest is finished....only because I can't beleive I was supposed to let Morgana live and let evil prevail, but her fireball killed the spectre (who was purple to me) so attacking her would have been pointless. Oh I almost forgot I received a full bubble of exp after morgana disappeared.
Rewards:
Haze -- Friar
Staff of the Tempest Wind -- Theurgist
Mantle of the Bowmaster -- Scout
Gauntlets of Battle -- Armsman
The next quest is Craft of Retribution
Rewards:
Haze
Staff of the Tempest Wind
Mantle of the Bowmaster
Glowing Gauntlets of Battle

albion|haunted messages.Name: Haunted Messages
albion|haunted messages.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-09-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This is the equivalent of the level 11 epic for Paladins and Clerics from SI.
1) Talk to your trainer in Caer Gothwaite
2) Speak to Tage about the [souls from paradise].
3) Talk to Brother Obster about the [lost souls].
4) Kill three ghosts. (There is a group of them almost straight North from Caer Gothwaite, around loc 52k, 28k - the opposite side of the lake from Caifelle)
5) Bring the "letter to a loved one", "brooch", and "holy book" back to Brother Obster to receive your reward.
At level 11, I received 3 silver per turn-in and 15,928xp and 5 silver at the end, along with my item.
Rewards:
Paladin -- Holy Pendant
Cleric -- Jewel of Righteous Smite
Rewards:
Holy Pendant
Jewel of Righteous Smite

albion|hidden insurrection.Name: Hidden Insurrection
albion|hidden insurrection.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-08-23 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Performed under version 1.52
I arrived at the Guild of Shadows in Camelot where Master Eadig (for Mercs it wll be Master Arenis) greeted me with a task in which I was, of course, [interested]. Eadig continued to
explain that there was again trouble in Snowdonia. Routine sounding but
Eadig had his [doubts]. Eadig declined further comment and sent me off to Snowdonia.
HIDDEN INSURRECTION
[Step #1] Seek out Captain Rhodri at the Snowdonia Border keep.
Rhodri and I quickly got [down to business]. We spoke of the [Arawnites] and border at Sauvage. Rhodri gave me a Note and told me to [speak with Lieutenant Kuebler] in Castle Sauvage.
[Step #2] Deliver Rhodri's letter to Lieutenant Kuebler. He can be found at
Castle Sauvage on second floor from Rhodri.
Kuebler called me a lackey and told me to return to Snowdonia. How long
must I suffer this?
[Step #3] Return to Captain Rhodri at the Snowdonia border keep.
Rhodri grumbled and gave me a Chest for [Twr ap Alsig] of Barfog. Loc 35k, 30k. Apparently he mistook me for a minstrel.
[Step #4] Speak to Twr ap Alsig of Barfog about the [goblin] uprising. Deliver to him Sir Bor's chest filled with riches.

Handing the chest to Twr ap Alsig netted me 52,428,800 experience points. When I mentioned a [goblin] uprising, Alsig said their new order was the result of an [outside influence]. Alsig suspected a tunnel in Tepok's Mine provided a [link to the borderlands] that allowed dwarves to spread their foul word to the goblin hordes. Alsig suggested that I find a Savant goblin. Of course, I knew what I was to do. Loc for Tepok's 5k, 3k

[Step #5] Locate the mine controlled by goblins within the Black Mountains. Seek out a Savant within the mine and learn what you can of the passageways. You may be forced to slay the goblin and search his belongings.
As I glided past the oblivious fisher hatchlings, I felt a warm breeze blow
past and I was awarded 53,428,800 exp. Finally, some appreciation. At
every intersection, I took a right turn until I came upon Goblin Monitors, Cleaners, and Directors. There the Savant wandered, accompanied by his pet.

As I perforated the Savant's arteries, he shrieked "My pets shall put you in your place!" The Savant fell quickly and I was able to scoop up a dwarven dispatch from the Savant's belongings before I was overwhelmed by blue cons.
[Step #6] The dispatch speaks of an attack to be carried out upon the locals within Barfog! Carry this dispatch to Twr ap Alsig within Barfog to warn him of this impending danger.
Binding close to Barfog is advisable. When I handed the dispatch to Twr ap
Alsig, he quickly composed a document for Sir Bors and send me off with
another 52,428,800 experience. I was able to hitch a ride off a very kind
minstrel who sped me to Snowdonia.
[Step #7] Return to Captain Rhodri at the Snowdonia border keep.
Rhodri greeted me: "This is a great day Adashar! I shall travel to meet with
Twr ap Alsig and his people. Perhaps between us we can once and forever be
united as one realm. Well, we can at least hope. You have done well and Sir
Bors would see that you are rewarded. What reward do you desire? [Death's
Touch], a thrusting weapon? [Death Dancer] a slashing weapon? [Spark of Midnight], a left-handed slashing weapon? [Crackling Impaler], a left-handed
thrusting weapon?"
I received another 52,428,800 exp and I took the Death's Touch. Cons orange at level 40
Being a fan of slightly faster weapons, I handed it right back to Rhodri,
getting the same options as before. This time I chose the Crackling
Impaler, also cons orange at level 40
Rhodri would not take the Crackling Impaler; I surmise the trade is a one
time thing.
For this quest I got 76,098,236 per section. I received that on exiting
the dungeons with a message "You feel like your being watched" So in total I received 380,491,180 of XP and a staff.

albion|la morti parla.Name: La Morti Parla
albion|la morti parla.Source: Allakhazam quest page (current copy; notes about later patches removed)
Lines: Upon completing the Scura tragedia quest and reaching level 20, talk to
Master Vismer to receive La Morti Parla.
Step one: Kill a skeletal legionnaire such as those found in Cornwall down

the path guarded by several sets of skeletal centurions. At the end of this path there is an undead camp, where Legionnaires can be found. Or you can just go to the broken bridge in Salibury Plains and kill a legionaire at the broken bridge.
Step two: Pick up the 'roman skeleton dust' and return to Vismer in Camelot;
give him the dust.

Step three: Travel due northwest from west downs to a druid ring. Vismer tells you you must retrieve a druid's eye from the druid ring (loc 27000, 54000)directly southeast of West Downs in Salisbury. Kill any Filidh (loc Filidhs at 35000, 16000)(or druid) there to get an eye, keeping in mind they come out only at day time, kill one and receive 'a druid eye'
Step four: Return to Vismer in Camelot and give him 'a druid eye'
Step five: Run to Cotswold and speak to Master Ferowl who can be found upstairs in the bar, the building farthest northwest, it is the first tavern on your left as you leave Camelot.
Step six: Return to Vismer in camelot to receive your reward.
This completes the La Morti Parla quest, awards .5 blue of xp, and advances the Scura Tragedia quest to step 8.
Rewards:
Leggings of Comfort
Invoker's Robes
Robes of Scintillation

albion|legend of the lake.Name: Legend of the Lake
albion|legend of the lake.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-08-28 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This is Part I of an epic quest, and it includes nesting quests: (The nested quests included in this one are Wizard Lost and Barbaric Tales.)
Per Patch 1.53:

Legend of the Lake: We have made some changes to the 15th level portion of this quest in an attempt to bring it up to the level of other quests within the realm. The main change is the addition of two sub-quests to complement the existing "Barbaric Tales" and "Wizard Lost". Players who encounter this step of the quest will be given the option to perform two of the possible four sub-quests. Please note that these changes will not affect players that have already performed this section of the quest. One of these new quests is Lisreen's Plight.
1. Talk to your trainer. He will tell you that they need to find Excaliber.
2.The first step is to locate the Lady of the Lake. Your journal notes will tell you she can be found at night, either in Snowdonia, Camp. Forest, or the Avalon Marsh.

Through a little research you will find out her name is Lady Nimue. I found her in the lake southeast of Caer Witrin. To get there from Caer Witrin, follow the path leading towards Adribard's Retreat (To the east) and you shall come to a dark grey stone bridge. Do not cross the bridge, instead, turn right along the shoreline and follow it. You shall see a large playground-looking fort, which is actually full of bogmen. She is in between two islands, one with the playground, the other with a bridge connected to the playground island. Swim towards the point where the bridge meets the right-hand island. loc=27631,45026 You will see Lady Nimue standing in the water after you have swam out a little way, she cannot be seen from the shore. She pops from 7pm-5am. (Lady Nimue can be found in Campa Forest during the day at 8380, 47321, and Avalon Marsh during night at 27631, 45026.)
She will then give you a quest called Wizard Lost, something about the wizard Merlin and the Wisdom of Legends, complete it then continue with Legend of the Lake.
3. She will tell you something about the Tome of Legends, and Sir Verin. This is the beginning of a mini-quest called Barbaric Tales.
You can ONLY DO TWO of the four sub-quests, be careful which ones you choose. But it has been said that you actually can do all 4 subquests. You only have to do 2 of them through Nimue.
4. After you complete the two subquests, go visit the mobs that give out the other two quests and you'll be able to do them.
Rewards:
Soft Leather Travelers Leggings -- Friar
Sleeves of the Stoic -- Armsman
Necklace of Elemental Influence -- Theurgist
Gauntlets of Archery -- Scout
Rewards:
Sleeves of the Stoic
Gauntlets of Archery
Soft Leather Travelers Leggings
Necklace of Elemental Influence

albion|legione perso.Name: Legione Perso
albion|legione perso.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Master Vismer says, "The hour is upon us. We have chosen our [final target] for your spell. It is our hope that in its undoing shall come the knowledge we have sought for so long. We shall soon know who raises the dead within our realm and what must be done to stop the evil necromancy."

Master Vismer says, "There exists one know as Lunaris Primus Pilus. On his last command he lead a force against Barfog and perished on the battlefield. Entombed in a monastery, the commander has lain peacefully for over a hundred years. With the rise of the dead, the roman commander's sleep was broken and he now haunts the crumbled monastery. You must [put to rest] Lunaris primus pilus, but must do so within the walls of the monastery. Should he fall outside its walls, he will rise once again."

Master Vismer says, "Use your spell as instructed. This is no different from the last. Here are your components, hopefully they are strong enough for the deed that lay before you. Good luck! Do not hesitate to join forces with others to accomplish this task."
Master Vismer gives you the components here and they appear in your inventory.
You must go to Llyn Barfog to get the Lunaris Primus Pilus (level 30). Once you enter Llyn Barfog head towards the guard tower then north to the monastery.

Now's the tricky part, you can try to kill Lunaris Primus Pilus and all his minions but you can just initiate the log with him and when he aggros after you Morgana will appear. Don't try to attack her she will kill you!
Stand back and Morgana will kill Lunaris Primus Pilus and then...

Morgana says, "FOOL! You have meddled in my affairs for too long! Even now, as I take your only source of information, those idiots within your order learn of their failure. They watch even now! Let them now realize that trust should not have been put into one so weak. Prepare yourself, thy end is at hand."
Morgana says, "Flee while you still have breath! My children await on your voyage home!"
RUN back to Master Vismer for your reward.
Rewards:
Glowing Adamantium Staff of the Fire Tempest
Staff of Compliance
Shield of Swirling Notes

albion|lisreen's plight.Name: Lisreen's Plight
albion|lisreen's plight.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This is one of the new Sub-Quests added to the Level 15 Legend of the Lake Quest.
You need to help Lady Nimue locate her lost dagger, Lisreen.
First you need to go to Camp Station and Talk to Archibald Oakheart, be
sure to mention you are looking for "Lisreen". He will tell you, that
you are crazy, but if you are persistent he will tell you that they
Slavers have it at their camp in Salisbury Plains, but it is hidden with
100's of other similar looking daggers. To find the right one you will
need the heart of an ebony fellwood tree. These are found near the Camp
forest / Salisbury Plains zone line. It was trivial to kill with my
16th Season Armsman.
Once you get the heart, you need to clear out the slaver camp in the
Salisbury Plains. I had a high level guild member help me clear out the
camp. Once the camp is clear walk up right next to the 2 crates in the
camp, and if you have the ebony Fellwood heart, you should be given the
Dagger Lisreen.
Go back and talk to Archibald OakHeart, and he will ask you for the
Ebony Fellwood heart, and tells you to go back to Lady Nimue.
Once you got back to Lady Nimue, she awards you experience, and also
gave me a Circlet of the Lake.
Reward:
Circlet of the Lake

albion|list of denial.Name: List of Denial
albion|list of denial.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: You must complete the Traveler's Way quest first.

Speak to Lady Winchell in cleric guild. She speaks of 2 guards who have stolen Camelot's battle plans and are planning on escaping thru the Castle Sauvage portal when the next bunch of warriors go thru. You are instructed to find these 2 guards and kill them --bringing plans back to her. You get to keep whatever magical item that drops.

I found the 2 guards to the left of castle sauvage if you are facing it--they were some distance apart when i first saw them and both were blue to me at 11--they do aid each other--if one is about to die it calls for help and the other one joins in. They may also have a priest there to help them.
Returned to Camelot and give the plans to Lady Winchell and she instructs you to seek out Scribe Veral in the palace. (he can be found near to where the name
registar is in camelot) Reward was exp and some coin (about 8 silver and some copper) for the quest--and allowed to keep the other item that dropped.
Helm Of the Observant -- Cleric
Bracer of the Stoic Defender -- Paladin
Rewards:
Helm of the Observant
Bracer of the Stoic Defender

albion|lord of deceit.Name: Lord of Deceit
albion|lord of deceit.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to Magus Agyfen in Camelot.
Magus Agyfen says, "Hail! I trust you are well? I have a mission for you should you be [interested]."

Magus Agyfen says, "Many in our order have begun to speak at length if your missions for Sir Bors. It seems you have succeeded where many of them have failed. I would watch my back when around the likes of them. It is because of this that I hesitate to deliver this message from Captain Rhodri. I do not know that it contains, but I was informed it would be very profitable! May whatever god you worship watch over you. I shall only wish thee luck! Safe travels!"
Travel to Snowdonia Fortress and talk to Captain Rhodri.
[Step 1] Seek out Captain Rhodri at the Snowdonia Border Keep in Snowdonia
Fortress.
Captain Rhodri says, "I had not expected you to arrive so soon. Give me a moment to gather my thoughts."

Captain Rhodri says, "It is good to see you in excellent health. Sir Bors will be most pleased it is you who answered his call for help. We are in need of your skill and the insight you have into the locals of Barfog. As I indicated in your message, you will be rewarded well for your efforts. Are you still willing to [assist us]?"

Captain Rhodri says, "This is good! I am relieved this matter will be resolved quickly in your hands. I shall not waste any more of your time than is necessary. As you are aware, the Twp ap Alsig believe it is the dwarves who have been assisting Tepok with funds and supplies. I truly doubt that dwarves would stomach working with such creatures. Yet, we cannot turn a blind eye to our newest of allies and the mine has proven a burden for too long. Therefore Sir Bors has decided that you must descend into Tepok mines, locate and slay Tepok himself. I am sure this deed should pose no problems for one of your skill. It is said Tepok carries with him a sack containing all this precious items. Return this to us as it may contain clues to location these dwarves. Best of luck to thee."
Rhodri sends you to kill the Overseer Tepok goblin (Yellow at 43,
bring a partner to assist) deep in Tepok's Mine to retrieve the bag and return them to him.
Captain Rhodri says, "Ah! Were you able to retrieve Tepok's precious bag?
Give him the bag.

Captain Rhodri says, "This is what we have been looking for! [Twr ap Alsig] has been deceived. I knew the dwarves have nothing to do with this plot. This dispatch proves as much! The person who write this speaks of supplies. Supplies that originated within Pennine and from a group that makes their home there. While I do not fully rule out the dwarves, we would be wise to turn our attention north and into the mountains."
Deliver dispatch to Twr ap Alsig.
Return to Captain Rhodri.
Captain Rhodri says, "Were you able to deliver the dispatch to Twr ap Alsig?"
Tell him that your "work is done".

Captain Rhodri says, "Very well then! We can now move forward with our plans. While you were away Sir Bors instructed his scouts to scour the borderlands. What they found was quite alarming. It seems the goblins had tunnelled under the pass wall and were using this passage as a means to receive supplies from the north. Before we were able to follow the goblins to the source of their supplies our [scouts were spotted] and the tunnel destroyed."

Captain Rhodri says, "Aye! We are unsure if there are other such passages but if there are, we shall find them. We still need to search Pennine and locate the source of these supplies! Unfortunately we cannot afford to use any of our own scouts. I have been asked to task you with this delicate mission. We can no longer limit our source of information to observation alone. Someone must [venture into the camps] of each race within the Pennine and return solid reports."

Captain Rhodri says, "Not to worry Cabalist! We will not send you into these camps blindly. We have been observing the inhabitants of Pennine for quite some time. Are you still [willing to assist] us in this matter?"

Captain Rhodri says, "Then let us begin! Your first task will be to infiltrate a camp of Tylwyth Teg elves. There is one among them named Delfina. She carries the reports of their people to and from the Tylwyth Teg homelands. Our time is short Cabalist. Do not toy with the targets! Simply locate this Delfina, slay her, and return her reports. I await your return. May your blade be swift and quite!"

Rhodri sends you into Pennine Mountains to hunt the named Twylyth Teg Delfina to retrieve information and return this to him; this named mob is SW of Berkstead just past the Elyll Guard camp, in a gully at about 10000, 60000 in Pennine Mountains(New Frontiers loc= 46943, 5291) (also has been found at loc=7.5k 58k and loc=7263,58467)(New Frontiers : found Delfina at loc 47269, 5402 and 48k, 35k, in Pennine mtn. left of Cear Boldiam). She was a red con protected by two red/oranges at level 43. You will more than likely need help. Once the job is done, return to Captain Rhodri
Rhodri will then send you to Twr ap Alsig in the Llyn Barfog outpost to
translate the document gathered from Delfina and then return to him with the
translation.
Captain Rhodri says, "Once again your swiftness is most impressive! Do you have Delfina's reports?"
Hand him the report.

Captain Rhodri says, "This done not bode well. I didn't review the documents in depth, but I don't see any mention of goblins here. Our scribes will have to go over them more closely. You have done well Cabalist! We will require your assistance once we have had more time to review Delfina's reports. Return to me later and perhaps I will have news. Good day to you!"
He awards 953,000,000 experience and a Ring.
A lvl 49 Necro who completed this quest reports gaining 1,958,000,000 Exp.
lvl 43 Necro received 1,083,932,608 exp.
lvl 44 Cabalist received 1,245,111,645 exp.
lvl 49 received 1,970,786,560
Rewards:
Ring of Shades (stealth or envenom)-- Infiltrator
Ring of Shadowy Embers -- Mercenary
Construct Ring -- Cabalist
Ring of Forbidden Rites -- Necromancer
Jewelled Skull Ring -- Reaver
Rewards:
Ring of Shadowy Embers
Construct Ring
Ring of Shades
Ring of Forbidden Rites
Jewelled Skull Ring

albion|passage to eternity.Name: Passage to Eternity
albion|passage to eternity.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Get this quest form your trainer.
[Step #1] Speak to Sister Deane at Vetusta Abbey of the [new evil] that plagues Albion.
Go out from camelot north gate, then turn left, the church will in front of you.

[Step #2] Seek out those Templars that reside near the Hibernian portal keep within Hadrin's Wall, you can also attain these in the Barrows. Do what you must to learn what evil is strong enough to to lead them astray! (Approx. location of Templars is 21k,10k in Hadrian's Wall.)

They are neutral. Talk to one of the templar(right click), then they will attack you. Kill one of them, and you will get a "Templar focus gem". Templars are level 50+. (NEW FRONTIERS loc=28.6K 48.8K Hadrians Wall near a broken tower.)
[Step #3] Meet with Bertie Dracon at Swanton Keep. Hand to him the Tempar focus gem.
[Step #4] Speak with Bertie Dracon at Swanton Keep. Ask him of the [path of purity].

[Step #5] Travel with haste to the Stonehenge barrows. Locate the Templars that seek to defile the tomb of Uther and slay them all! So long as you carry the Templar focus gem, you will know when they are near.
That Templar near Vigilant Souls. Kill him, and there will 2 more add.
[Step #6] Return to your trainer in Camelot.
You will get a lot of XP(0.8 at lvl 47) and a level 45 ring.
A lvl 49.5 Cleric received 1.9 billion xp = approx 0.6 bubble
Rewards:
Ring of Defiant Soul -- Cleric
Ring of the Iron Will -- Paladin
Rewards:
Ring of Defiant Soul
Ring of the Iron Will

albion|path of the renegade.Name: Path of the Renegade
albion|path of the renegade.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This is continued from the level 15 Rebellion Accepted quest.
[Step #4] Return to Captain Rhodri at level 20 in Snowdonia Fortress.

Captain Rhodri Says, "We cannot actively move on the Renegades without a reason. So we have decided to send you to their tower under the Cover of Darkness. There you will subdue one of the Renegade guards and learn all you can. Do not spend much time in the Vicinity. The moment you learn of something, return to us. Farewell Infiltrator."
[Step #5] Learn of the Renegades in Llyn Barfog, and the Treason they are guilty of.
You have been Given The Path of the Renegade Quest.
[Step #1] Slay a Renegade Guard in Llyn Barfog (Yellow @ 20)

The Renegade Tower will be just to your left as you come from North Black Mountains. (Llyn Barfog, loc: 60,000/25,000). There are guards that roam in pairs, many of the single guards are linked to guards inside the tower. Dont get too close or Sir Dillus will come with a few guards.
[Step #2] Return to Captain Rhodri with the Diary you have obtained.
[Step #3] You must move quickly and locate the Arawnite Messenger in the Pass that leads to Llyn Barfog.

The Arawnite Messenger is found in the North Black Mountains. He spawns at loc: 4,691/38,927 exactly, in the trees (also found at S E of the Tower at Loc 4521/39005.) He is an Archer, when using his arrows he hits for 35-40 damage per hit. He does 60+ Damage per hit when meleeing. He was yellow and orange to me at 20.
[Step #4] Return to Captain Rhodri with the orders you have taken from the Arawnite messenger.
Captain Rhodri cannot read the orders, so
[Step #5] A vendor by the name of Omis may be able to decipher the Arawnite orders. He can be found in the Keep just south of Snowdonia (Swanton Keep).
Give the Orders to Omis and he reads the letter and puts some notes on the paper for the Captain to read.
[Step 6#] Return to Captain Rhodri at the Snowdonia Border Keep. Give him the Arawnite Orders.
Receive your Reward.
You have finished the Path of the Renegade quest.
[Step 6#] Return to Captain Rhodri at the Snowdonia Border Keep when you have obtained level 25.
Rewards:
Soft Doeskin Boots -- Infiltrator
Heavy Pull Short Bow -- Mercenary
Boneshaper's Spine -- Cabalist
Staff of Tainted Rage -- Necromancer
Boots of the Fallen -- Reaver
Rewards:
Soft Doeskin Boots
Heavy Pull Short Bow
Boneshaper's Spine
Staff of Tainted Rage
Boots of the Fallen

albion|point of reason.Name: Point of Reason
albion|point of reason.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-08-23 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Lady Triss, the paladin trainer in Camelot, tells you they have learned much while you were away. You are asked to help find some elusive assistant, and are sent to speak to Sir Benitt
at Castle Sauvage, the keep at the forest Sauvage border. (This is the Paladin version and is also available for Clerics from their trainer)

Sir Benitt tells you of a dying scout who returned with a report of this assistant, Aricoer, one who practices pagan magic and denounces the church. He also gave him a rough map of Cornwall, and a note which mentioned a broken tower. He asks you to return this scout's map to the church.

After looking at the map, your trainer send you to Sir Gwyn at the Snowdonia Fortress to have him identify where this broken tower lies (perhaps he was once stationed near Cornwall at the opposite end of the realm).
Sir Gwyn tells you the tower is in Cornwall, past the Cornwall station and just off the road He sends you back to your trainer in Camelot.
I hope you're not getting saddle-sore, because there is more riding ahead. Your trainer next sends you to see Sir Aldar at Cornwall Station.

Sar Aldar tells you to head west along the road. The broken tower will be on your right, just north of the road. It is close to the road, and easy to find. He cautions you to only go in the daytime. (NOTE: Aricoer only spawns at night) There are a number of undead near the tower, and even though they will assist Aricoer, at least until you
kill him. Aricoer drops a chest, which apparently is a wizard's box. Do not try to open it, as it is sealed with his evil magic.
Return the box to your trainer in Camelot, and you shall receive an award from the church to thank you for your hard work.
Rewards:
Blade Stopper -- Paladins
Hammer of Wrath -- Clerics
Rewards:
Blade-Stopper
Hammer of Wrath

albion|rebellion accepted.Name: Rebellion Accepted
albion|rebellion accepted.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This is the level 15 Guild of Shadows Epic.
After speaking with your class trainer in Camelot:
[Step #1] Seek out Captain Rhodri at the Snowdonia Border Keep in Snowdonia Fortress.
[Step #2] Seek out Elrigh. It is said he Travels from inn to inn within the Black Mountains. Mention to him your interest of the [locals] within Barfog.
I found Elrigh in North Black Mountains inside Snowdonia Station, upstairs. /Say locals to him and he will start to talk.
[Step #3] Locate Andri inside of Camelot. He frequents the Bars there. Speak to him of [Barfog] and the [Renegade] guards.

I bought a ticket to East Camelot for the stable guy at Snowdonia Station to speed things up. I found him in the bar near the Defenders of Albion Guild. Go in the East Camelot Gate. Go forward past the guildhouse and the bar is on the left at the 90 degree turn. Andri is in the tavern called The Stone in Camelot (loc= 23600,20000). Andri is upstairs on the second floor. You need to /say renegade to him to get him to begin talking.
[Step #4]Return to Captain Rhodri at Snowdonia Border keep in Snowdonia Fortress. Inform him of the [Renegade] and of [Sir Dillus].

I bought a ticket from the stable guy at the East side of Camelot to take me back to Snowdonia Station, and ran the rest of the way. Once at the Fortress I told Captain Rhodri of the renengade and of Sir Dillus when prompted by the Captain.
Return to him yet again once you reach lvl 20 and achieve the title of Spy and he will tell you what to do next.
Rewards:
Cabalist -- Boneshaper's Ring
Mercenary -- Fury (bracer)
Infiltrator -- Gem of Shadowy Intentions
Reaver -- Sleeves of Despair
Necromancer -- Choker of Dark Deeds
Rewards:
Boneshaper's Ring
Fury
Gem of Shadowy Intentions
Sleeves of Despair
Choker of Dark Deeds

albion|regal nobility.Name: Regal Nobility
albion|regal nobility.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Once you hit 20 you head to the Snowdonia Border Keep to speak with Captain Rhodri

Captain Rhodri says, "_________, it is good to see you are still alive and have come in good health. I have been asked by Sir Bors to ensure this [matter] with the renegades is finished once and for all."

Captain Rhodri says, "Sir Bors would have the support of the locals within Barfog and this situation would be the best way to win their trust. Therefore your mission is to return the to renegade post and [dispatch] the outcasts."

Captain Rhodri says, "You must ensure that justice is delivered to both Dillus and his supporting officers. When this is complete, visit the local outpost there and talk to one named Twr ap Alsig. We have it on good authority that if you win his support the locals will follow. Take with you the Arawnite orders as proof of Sir Dillus' betrayal."
You have been given the Regal Nobility quest.
You receive Arawnite orders from Captain Rhodri!
[Step#1] Slay Sir Dillus and his renegade officers!
After killing Sir Dillus your journal moves on to step #2
[Step#2] Speak to Twr ap Alsig at the local outpost in Lyn Barfog. Mention Sir Bor's wish to lend them [support]. Also mention [Sir Dillus]' betryal!
Twr ap Alsig says, "Yes Inconnu? What do you want?"
Twr ap Alsig says, "Support you say? Why should we? Your kind has forever forgotten its way. The light of that Camelot has blinded you."
Twr ap Alsig says, "We know you have killed him! You have not won us with that! Do you have proof of anything that may keep us from killing you on the spot?"
(Hand Twr ap Alsig the scroll from Captain Rhodri)
Twr ap Alsig says, "Heavens! How can this be? I scarcely believe my eyes! I truly wish I could take your word on just this, yet I must be [certain] where your loyalties lay."

Twr ap Alsig says, "There roams about this land the undead cythraul. Should you destroy one of these and bring back its skull as proof, I will lend the support you seek." (Also has been known to send someone to go kill a Bwgan Hunter.)
[Step#3] Slay a cyhraul within Llyn Barfog!
[Step#4] Speak to Twr ap Alsig at the local outpost in Llyn Barfog.
Twr ap Alsig says, "I still seek proof of your deeds. Do you have something for me?"
(Hand Twr ap Alsig the Cythraul skull.)
You receive a Pain Threaded Cloak from Twr ap Alsig!
Twr ap Alsig says, "You have done well Inconnu! We shall support your cause and welcome you always. Please take this as a token of trust between our people."
You have finished the Regal Nobility quest.
Rewards:
Light Chain Tunic -- Mercenary
Spirit Threaded Cloak -- Cabalist
Vest of the Infamous Blade -- Infiltrator
Pain Threaded Cloak -- Necromancer
Tunic of Dark Suffering -- Reaver
Rewards:
Light Chain Tunic
Spirit Threaded Cloak
Vest of the Infamous Blade
Tunic of Dark Suffering
Pain Threaded Cloak

albion|scura tragedia.Name: Scura Tragedia
albion|scura tragedia.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Must do the Wisdom quest first.
Master Vismer gives you a signet ring and ask that you talk with the scribe Eril, a vassal of Lord Adribard. You will be talking to Eril regarding the lost knowledge of Necromancy.
Eril is found in Adribard's retreat. He stands on top of the tower gazing over the swamp. Target him and ask regarding the undead. He tells you of the list of wizards who have studied necromancy.

Scribe Veral is in Camelot. He informs us that we must find the one who knows the location and incantations for the ritus a potential. We must find Brother Darren in the Vetusta Abbey. Scribe Veral can be found west of the main castle in Camelot.

For the abbey leave Camelot through the north gate and head west. Not to far distant is the compound. Ask Brother Darren of the ritual, but first give him Vismer's ring. This will influence him to tell you of what he knows. He indicates that you must summon a spirit from a circle of stones. This spirit will ask a single question that must be answered. Darren does not know the question or the answer. However, he doesn't know which stone ring must be used. He directs you to Olorustos at the Lethantis Association.

Olorustos indicates to look in a lost tower. Undead speak of necromancers in their mist. There is a summoning circle within a lost tower. This tower is in Cornwall not very far from the Catacombs. From Cornwall Station head west along the road till you come to a spur turning south. Follow this a short ways then turn west and travel across country. Tower is a short brick tower golden or yellow in color. There is no evidence of a summoning circle anymore. During the night speak "proximare spiritus nonorare". Then ask the spirit of her "list". She will ask a riddle of you before she continues.

The Spirit of the unspoken says, "You seek the unspoken list! We have seen your venture into the darkness, and kow that which keeps my brethren from peace. I shall read the list only should you speak unto me the answer to a [riddle]."
The Spirit of the unspoken says, "The shadow of life passes us, as does the passage of time. When day turns to darkness, time fades into eternity. What then becomes of life?"
The answer to the riddle is "life becomes death."

The Spirit of the unspoken says, "Vislun, Bernor, Ignuixs, Ablivmu, Arnor, Blaise, Merlin, Ganieda, Viviane, Nimue, Morgana, Elaine, Garlon, Annowre, Byanne"

Once you answer the riddle you must return to Camelot and speak with Master Vismer. He asks for this ring and list to be given back to him. However, he does not require the actual list of wizards given to you by the spirit.

albion|symbol of the broken.Name: Symbol of the Broken
albion|symbol of the broken.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Master Ferowl says, "I have requested The Academy send someone who would be able to help. I am far to weak to travel and fear my powers would fail in battle. You don't need to assist this old man, but if you will [take up the cause] to defend this realm from Morgana's evil ways then your help would be welcome."
Dialog box:
You have been given the Symbol of the Broken quest.

Master Ferowl says, "Your choice is a wise one! I will not waste anymore time with banter. There is a rumor of an Arawnite shaman by the name of Saelonna who has seen into the future. The rumors say the shaman has been driven insane by her visions. It is my hope that Saelonna has seen Morgana's evil and perhaps inscribed it in her [Book of Arawn]."

Master Ferowl says, "Seek out this Saelonna within the borders of Snowdonia and retrieve this book at whatever the cost. Return to me when you have completed this task. May your travel be swift and uneventful!"
[Step #2] Seek out the Arawnite shaman known as Saelonna. Do what you must to retrieve her Book of Arawn.
Kill Saelonna, she is at the Arawnite camp past Snowdonia, 58k, 19k. She can be located at any of the following 4 locs:
(NEW FRONTIERS loc=55k 40k, Dathmul 8k 32k )
You receive a Book of Arawn from Saelonna!
[Step #3] Return the Book of Arawn to Master Ferowl at the Inn in Cottswold.

Master Ferowl says, "Oh my! The shaman writes of an undead beast that walks within the Pennine Mountains. This undead beast was not the creation of Morgana, but a beast spawned by the Grimwoods. It seems the wood used in the creation of some acient tower was drawn from the Grimwoods themselves. Some of the necromancers, who harvested this wood, fell prey to the Grimwoods' spells and were turned into eternal slaves. Over the years it seems many of these undead slaves were destroyed. Yet, one of the original necromancers still roams through the mountains. It appears that Morgana has used her own powers to reveal all this beast knew, including its name, Treefall. If this [Treefall] has told Morgana the location of this ancient tower, then it is imperative we locate the beast as well."

Master Ferowl says, "There have been sightings of this beast in the southern portions of the Pennine Mountains. You would be wise to start your search there. Should you encounter this Treefall, slay it and return its remains to Caelin Finan of Castle Sauvage. I believe with the right combination of spells he may be able to delve the location of this tower. Now be on your way! Time is short!"
[Step #4] Find Treefall and retrieve his remains.
Kill Treefall, a named Grimwood, location near 40k, 60k, be warned, he is not alone. (NEW FRONTIERS loc=Treefall 4k 57k)
[Step #5] Deliver the dead Grimwood bark to Caelin Finan at Castle Sauvage. Tell Caelin the bark was taken from a beast named [Treefall].
You say, "The bark was from a beast named Treefall."
Caelin Finan says, "Interesting, I have never heard of that name. I will attempt to determine what use this wood may have. One moment please!"
Caelin Finan examines the Grimwood bark.

Caelin Finan says, "Quite interesting indeed! This wood has only been used for one purpose, to build a necromantic altar! This is very bad. If this altar exists, it could be used to summon up demons from places best not spoken about. I assume The Academy has sent you on this mission? It may be wise to inform them of this evil wood and the power it commands!"
[Step #6] The Academy must be told of the news! Return to your trainer in Camelot and inform them of Morgana's interests in [raising up demons].
You say, "Morgana's interest is raising up demons!"

Master Berwick says, "Oh my! This is indeed troubling. I will ask Master Ferowl to consult with us immediately. We must determine if this is truly Morgana's goal. If her chosen path is to summon these demons then we must act at once. Locating and destroying this altar before she has a chance to use it is our only hope. Take this ring as a reward for your trouble. Return to me later and I will inform you of our decision."
Rewards:
Bernor's Tarnished Ring
Ring of Coruscating Harmony

albion|the craft of retribution.Name: The Craft of Retribution
albion|the craft of retribution.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This is Part VI in a series of quests:
Part V is Hands of Fate
The Craft of Retribution
All throughout the quest, there is a lot of talk about how we need to stop
Morgana and that she might be making undead from other realms.
...and get ready to get saddle sore.
1) Talk with your (insert class) trainer. He will ask you to seek out
Lieutenant Kuebler in Castle Sauvage.
2) Go to Castle Sauvage and talk with Lieutenant Kuebler. He will ask you to
see Captain Leri in Snowdonia Fortress.
3) Go to Snowdonia Fortress and speak with Captain Leri. She wants you to
secure the Arawnite shaman knowledge on death through force.
4) From the fortress go out into the frontier and find an Arawnite shamaness
near the fortress to the north. Kill her and she will provide you a tome.
The shamaness was yellow at level 40, but there are many shamanesses around
some also con blue. Just killed the first one I found. Return the tome to
Captain Leri.
5) After reading the tome Captain Leri discovers the Arawnites are
interested in an undead minion that Morgana focuses her power through. In
order to find the undead you must retrieve an amulet from the Catacombs and return it to her. Read what she says... she does tell you exactly what to do in the next step.
6) Travel to the catacombs and proceed straight from the entrance until it
enters a round room that has 4 named undead romans. Kill all four. They
all conned blue. Each will drop an item: 1 amulet, 1 bracelet, 1 ring, and
1 belt. Once you have all 4 items, wear them and stand in the center of the
room for a few seconds. You will see a brief message and in your inventory
you will have the Amulet of Fasius Previlus. Once you have the amulet return to Snowdonia.
7) Captain Leri will ask for proof. Hand her the amulet and she hands it
back. She then says to that you show the amulet to Cynwik the Wizard who is
also in the fortress.
8) Cynwik the Wizard will ask what you want. Hand him the amulet. He
babbles a bit but finally tells you that the amulet longs to be with it's
owner who roams the ruins of a roman temple near the northwest pass of
Hadrian's Wall (loc=10k , 42k). And he gives the Amulet back.

9) Travel from Snowdonia east to Pennine Mountains. Keep going NE towards Hadrian's Wall. The pass is at approx 40k,0 (This /loc will not be the same in New Frontiers). Once in HW follow the path, then make a left at the aqueduct ruins and follow path which will take you to the northwest. You will eventually come to some pillars (kind of in a circle or oval) this is where Fasius Previlus will be found (loc=10k 42k in Hadrians, In New Frontiers Fasius was located in Hadrian's Wall at 41540, 29860, spawned at midnight game time.) Wait a few moments. There is some text about the amulet glowing because near it's
owner. Then the amulet will break (NOTE: the item name of the amulet does
not change to 'broken amulet' or such. Name stays just as it was named
before). Wait a bit longer, until a series of lightning flashes occur. Then
Fasius will appear standing on top of a rock. Kill him. And your quest log
will tell you to return to Snowdonia. (NOTE: he spawned as orange con to
level 40. Was soloed by a level 40 friar who got REAL lucky with a string
of 3 consecutive evades... take a friend.)
10) Captain Leri will ask for proof. Hand her the amulet. She will then
ask for your choice of rewards.

albion|the lost stone.Name: The Lost Stone
albion|the lost stone.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Speak with Friar Trainer Sister Evangeline in Caer Gothwaite.

Sister Evangeline says, "Welcome back. I have been watching your training and you seem to be blessed with many skills. Those skills will come in handy in the near future. I have been sending reports of your progress to my superiors at the Defenders hall in Camelot and they have decided that it is time to [test your limits and skills]."

Sister Evangeline says, "Our superiors have sent word that a former member of the Defenders of Albion, Gavon Montgomery, is once again working with us. They did not tell more than he is working with the Defenders and that his task is very important. He has requested assistance with his work, and our superiors felt it was time for you to use some of the skills you have been gifted with. Apparently Gavon needs to recover something that has been lost, and our superiors all agree that you are ready to help him. Do [you agree with them]?"
Dialog box: Will you help Gavon Montgomery and the Defenders of Albion recover what has been lost?

Sister Evangeline says, "I believe you are correct. Go to Gavon Montgomery now and he will tell you more of his assignment with the Defenders. You shall find him at Caifelle on the road north of Gothwaite Harbor. I shall pray for your safety while you are out in this dangerous world."
[Step #1] Seek out Gavon Montgomery at Caifelle, onthe road north from Gothwaite Harbor. When he asks, tell him your name.
Gavon Montgomery says, "Greetings Friar. I see that your trainer received the message fromt he Defenders. What is your name?"
/Say your name

Gavon Montgomery says, "We have quite a task ahead of us. I was once a Scout for the Defenders of Albion before I hurt my leg. Since I can no longer do my duty, the Defenders have helped set me up s as merchant. It's not what I had planned to be doing , but it puts food on my table. Even though I am not an active member of the Defenders, I still do what I can to help. Lately that has meant [tracking down lost objects]."

Gavon Montgomery says, "As you may know, the Defenders of Albion are always searching for better ways to defend the realm from enemies. Our duty is hard, for these days we face not onlythe enemies that nip at our borders but also the ones that exist amongst us. Anything that can be done or used to make our fight a little easier is always well supported among the Defenders. That is [why I was sent] here."

Gavon Montgomery says, "One of the Inconnu that has been helping us to defend the realm against the Drakoran located and recovered a stone that seems to weaken the Drakoran. Our Theurgists back in Camelot wish to examine and study this stone so that it can possibly be duplicated and used to aid us in this fight. If we [only had it now]!"

Gavon Montgomery says, "This Inconnu was coming back from getting the stone when he was attacked and overpowered by a pack of urchin rabblerousers. They stole the stone and ran off into the wilds when the Inconnu mandaged to crawl back here. So far no one has been able to capture the little rabblerouser that has it. Go now and seek out the urchin rabblerouser that has it. They are tricky and throw it around, so keep trying until you find it. We are counting on you."
[Step #2] Get the missing stone fromt he urchin rabblerouser south of Caifelle.
Follow the road south and the mob can be found on the left side of the road. Loc 49k, 31k.
The urchin rabblerouser says, " Ho ho! You thought I had the gray stone you seek, but I didn't! Try again!"
The urchin rabblerouser says, "You want the stone so bad, take two of them! Ho ho!"
Killed two gray at level 7. I received a small flat gray stone and a carved bejeweled gray stone.
[Step #3] Return to Gavon Montgomery at Caifelle.
Gavon Montgomery says, "Were you able to find the stone? The Defenders in Albion are waiting for it so they can begin trying to duplicate it. I must send it to them soon."
Hand him a stone, I handed him the bejewelled one.

Gavon Montgomery says, "This isn't the stone I seek! I was told it was plain, flat, gray stone. It may have special properties, but the Defenders will have to investigate it. Did you find another stone?"
I have him the normal stone.

Gavon Montgomery says, "This stone doesn't look like it will do much, but we hope that it will. I shall get this over to Camelot right away. The Defenders of Albion sent this over for the person who was able to recover the lost stone. Here take it, and know that you have helped to defend the realm!"
You receive a Belt of the Faithful from Gavon Montgomery!
You are rewarded 7 silver and some copper!
You have finished The Lost Stone quest.

albion|wisdom.Name: Wisdom
albion|wisdom.Source: Allakhazam quest page (current copy; notes about later patches removed)
Lines: You must have completed the Traveler's Way quest, Stones of Power, before getting this one.
Given by the trainers upon reaching lvl 11.
Wizard trainer -- Master Grundelth
Sorceror trainer-- Magus Cormac
Minstrel trainer -- Master Dubri

The trainer gives you an ancient book and tells you to go to guard tower near Prydwen Keep in Camelot Hills east of Camelot City and give to sage in the tower. Then Sage Nelson inside then instructs you to go to south black mountains to the guard tower south of Ludlow and give ancient book to the sage there. Sage Lissa instructs you to take it to 1 of the 2 towers at the bridge north of Ludlow and give it to the sage in it. Then Sage Crystal gives you a riddle to complete (there seems to be 3 riddles different ones, of which he will only ask you one, they are not class specific).
Answers for riddles:
*books
*stars
*shoe
After you've gone to the 3 sages, the last one tells you to return to trainer for a reward.
Sorceror Walkthrough:
1). Speak to Magus Cormac in the Academy in Camelot.
Magus Cormac says "Well met. You look like things are a bit slow and you are in need of some extra coin. How would you like [something to do] ?
Magus Cormac says, "I require the use of your brain more than the use of your brawn today. A few days ago, an ancient book was uncovered near Stonehenge. Whoever wrote this book must have been wise."

Magus Cormac says, "It seems to be written in three anguages and I can not seem to untangle the words within. I do know of three women that can. [Three sages] were dispatched to study the weather at three towers."
Magus Cormac says, "Each of them is also a master of three different, [ancient languages]. I know enough to figure out what the language is, but understanding it is a different matter."

Magus Cormac says. "You must first find the tower in Camelot Hills that Sage Nelson has been assigned to. She has studied the Lemnian tongue, spoken on the island of Lemnos. She will tell you the location of the [other two]."
Magus Cormac says, "The other two sages are at different towers. Just take the book to them and let them have a look at it. I still know not what puzzled them about the [weather] there."

Magus Cormac says, "The academy has decided to watch the weather in hopes of someday, being able to see into the future and know if it will rain in a few days. What a daft notion. [About that book]..."
Magus Cormac hands you a book...

2)...Ok, run through Camelot and take a right at the end of the street through Cotswold Village. Keep running a short while until you see a guard tower. Talk to Sage Nelson. Follow the prompts until she asks to see the book. Give her the book. She mumbles on a little then gives you the book back.
3). Run to the guard tower just south of Ludlow and speak to Sage Lissa and again follow the prompts, hand the book over and receive it back.

4). Run to the bridge north of Ludlow, cross it and go to the guard tower on your right at the other side and do the same once agin with the sage there. Sage Crystal will then ask you to solve a simple riddle.
5). Now return to Camelot (shortest way is south over the bridge and follow the path to your right, passing by Humberton).
6). Go back to the Academy and again speak to Magus Cormac.

Lines: - Wizard Lost - The Green Witch may now be found at night in Salisbury Plain.
This is the subquest in the Legend of the Lake series.

You are asked to learn all you can about Merlin. She first sends you to talk to Olorustos at the Lethantis Association. The Lethantis Association is behind Camp. Station in the Camp. Forest. When you talk to him, you will have to mention Merlin to him, he will not lead you on. He will send you to talk to Scribe Eril in Adribard's Retreat.
Eril will send you to talk to the mage Cynwik at the Snowdonia border keep. After talking to Cynwik the Wizard, he sent me back to Lethantis Association to talk to Olorustos once again.
Then after talking to Olorustos, he sent me to Camelot to talk to Magess Islia in Merlin's Tower. First I asked her about
[Merlin] and then asked her about Merlin being on another [plane] of existence. After talking to Magess Islia, she will ask you to kill the Green Witch and return a Wizard Locked box to her.

The Green Witch can be found at night in Salisbury Plains (loc=21736, 45480, 2808 Salisbury Plains (it has been mention the loc is actually 45480, 2808 only, please submit your findings to clarify this information, thanks!).
When your return to Lady Nimue, she will award you experience and and an item. These are rewards for completion pf Legend of the Lake, but listed for your convenience.
Sent me straight to Eril to start with, not to Olorustus.
Armsman -- Sleeves of the Stoic
Friar -- Traveler's Leggings
Scout -- Gauntlets of Archery
Theurgist -- Necklace of Elemental Influence

albion|chains of death.Name: Chains of Death
albion|chains of death.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-08-23 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: When you return to your trainer in Camelot upon reaching level 30 you are told that the wizards succeeded in breaking the spells holding Aricoer's box, and they found a wealth of gold and silver, which has been donated to the church. Also inside was a small figurine wrapped in a scroll. The scroll states that if the owner requires assistance they should seek out the one who wears the honored sacrifical dagger.

Once again your assistance is needed, and you are directed to speak to Loremaster Alain to see what information he may have on the figurine. He can be found on the second floor of The Academy in Camelot. Alain has seen this type of object before. He explains that it is used to identify the holder as the key to some unholy sacrifice. He says the one who made the figurine must have great skill in carving bone.

Upon returning to your trainer you are informed that The Church has sent couriers to all their trainers throughout the Realm. You as asked to search them out to see what additional information they may be able to add. You are also given a second figurine to give as a gift, as expected when one delivers the first figurine. This gift has been endowed with the holiest of prayers.

As it turned out Lord Adribard and Lady Lynn, the Paladin and Cleric trainers in Adribard's Retreat, did have some information about a woman the roams among the undead somewhere in Cornwall. Since Aricoer was found in Cornwall at the broken tower, this
seems like it could be the one your seek.

Even at this point in your career, Cornwall is a very dangerous place. There are no guards west of Cornwall Station, and the land has many dangerous creatures that roam around. There are three places in Corwall that I know to have undead. You have already been to the broken tower in western Cornwall, and you may have been to the ruins just northwest of Cornwall Station to seen Brother Jarrell's ghost. There is one other site, a ruined Roman villa, that has a number of undead Romans wandering within and without its walls. To get there head west along the road until you see a small path headed east.

Follow the path untill you come to the villa. Be extremely careful to avoid the dangerous pigs (rooters), walking trees, and bog men (bogeys). They will likely kill you if you are by yourself. At the villa the undead will mostly leave you alone, but some of the higher level centurions might attack you. However, your goal is not the villa itself, but a spot a little behind it on the hill to the south. There you will see a few giant skeletons, and a woman nearby named Erich, who is the one you seek. It is probably best if you eliminate the giant skeletons one by one before attempting to talk to Erich (Location of Erich is actually East in driection but southwest facing the woods from the back of the Villa).
When you talk with Erich, she mistakenly believes you are actually in disguise, and asks for the bone figurine. She then asks for a small gift. Then she takes it from you she
realizes her mistake too late, and the prayers upon it destroy her. Any remaining giant skeletons will then attack you. You are awarded some silver and some experience, and she
also dropped a Netherwordly Cloak, a very nice Sorcerer and Cabalist cloak.
Upon returning to you trainer, you are awarded a nice item for your diligent work. For Paladins, this is a nice pair of plate gloves called Blessed Vindicators. They appear purple when you wear them.
Rewards:
Blessed Vindicators -- Paladins
Symbol of Faith -- Cleric
Rewards:
Blessed Vindicators
Glowing Symbol of Faith

albion|heart of albion.Name: Heart of Albion
albion|heart of albion.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: "Heart of Albion" is from the Herald's quest contest of 2002. The winning story by Alan Fork can be found on the Camelot Herald.
She gives you a poem to read and you must decipher who to speak to at Adribards Retreat based from the poem.

You must speak to Summer Gram. She will tell you to kill the Undead Knight Fiedel. He will give you the first shard (knowledge) of the heart. You must return it to Summer. (Undead Knight Fiedel is at the ruined church in Avalon Marsh. Go south from Adribard's Retreat and the Ruined Church will be on the right. You must "prove" yourself by killing the Bishop and then killing Fiedel.)

She will give you a second poem to find the shard of freedom. You must travel to West Downs. Speak to the Instrument merchant, Marlin Thuler, (in barn) and he will instruct you to kill Slave master Cotrell (Approx loc is 58, 18).
Bring Marlin Thuler the broken sword of Cotrell, and he will give you the shard of freedom. He gives you another poem and says you must speak to Lady Nimue again.
Give her the shard of freedom and she gives you a list of ingrediants to bind
the shards together. One is the mud from a mud golem.
The next is the mist from the mist monster NW of Cear Witrin (loc=9742,28612). Give the mud and mist to Lady Nimue. She will ask you a question. The answer is hope.
She will give you a pendant of hope..lvl 17 item crush 3% slash 4% and thrust 4%. I got this quest at lvl 17 with my friar and lvl 20 with my necromancer. They both recieved the same item.
My friar was on the lvl 15 quest to find Arthur's sword when this quest was given to her.
Reward:
Pendant of Hope

albion|traveler's way -- stones of power.Name: Traveler's Way -- Stones of Power
albion|traveler's way -- stones of power.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-11-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to your guild master

They give you instructions to head to Cotswald and chat with Lundeg Tranyth at loc 10845, 30585 in Camelot hills (Another option is being sent to Humberton, one vendor someone had to speak to was Bline).
The vendor will ask to you get a hidden Eye, which is found from giant spiders in the South black mountains in a specific area.

In order for a spider to drop an eye, it must be one of the ones which are found underneath the boar markings on the side of the hill. This area can be found by heading across the dual bridge near Ludlow and turning right after you pass the bridge. loc 54k, 21.5K in Black mtns south

I got my stone on the first try at a different location. I continued on past the double bridge and turned left off the road at the very next tower. It worked in the journal and when I returned it to Cotswold.
Return the eye to the vendor in Cotswald, for a nice set of Green hued leather leggings.
This quest is a prerequisite for the level 11 Quest.
Rewards:
Svelte Hide Leggings -- Minstrel
Hidden Eye -- Wizard and Sorceror
Rewards:
Hidden Eye
Svelte Armor Leggings

albion|immediate resolution.Name: Immediate Resolution
albion|immediate resolution.Source: No Allakhazam walkthrough was found; these are the quest's journal steps
Lines: Step 1: Speak to Olorustos. He will instruct you further.
Step 2: Locate Guardian Aron, who defends a point just southwest of the Lethantis Association, and deliver the wax-sealed note. Do not tarry!

albion|cellar infestation.Name: Cellar Infestation
albion|cellar infestation.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-11-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Mistress Laws, the fighter trainer in Caer Gothwaite, sends you to help Ylaine Barrett with her swamp goo problem.

Mistress Laws says, "You have barely begun training; yet already there is a need for you to lend your strength for the protection of this town. I know some of the locals are suspicious of the Inconnu, well, that is not to be helped. They are a mysterious people, and their sudden appearance one stormy night, well, that causes a large amount of [suspicion], as you can imagine, They are here to help us, I do believe that, and so must you. But some of the locals, they are not so sure."

Mistress Laws says, "They have seen the Drakoran ruin their lands, they have witnessed Morgana's terrible magic first hand, so they cannot be expected to trust these new, powerful allies. I expect you to treat the Inconnu as allies, and to try and avoid the idle gossip of the local townsfolk. Saying that, I must send you to one of the loudest of the rabble. Ylaine Barrett. The food cellar has been swarming with swamp goo, and she wants someone to go out and clear the immediate area of swamp goo. Don't worry, I don't expect you to kill them all, just do what you can."
Dialog box: Will you aid Ylaine Barrett in her attempt to rid the cellars of swamp goo?
