You have been given the Cellar Infestation quest.
Mistress Laws says, "Right, I expected you would do so. Now, go talk to Ylaine Barrett."
[Step #1] Speak to Ylaine Barrett about the swamp goo in the cellar. Be sure to let her know your name when she asks. She's in Gothwaite Harbor.
Ylaine Barrett says, "Ah. G'day. And who might you be?"
Tell Ylaine Barrett your name.

Ylaine Barrett says, "I see, you're a fighter. Has Mistress Laws, Master Reginald, or Delore sent you here to help me out? Why don't they just send you out after the goo? That's all I really want. You know, I don't remember that there were that many of these strange creatures crawling around the village [before]."

Ylaine Barrett says, "Yes, well, before, well, before they came. Don't you remember? That night? All day long, everything's fine. Set itself uop for a fine next day, as well! The night, it was clear. Not a sign of a storm in sight! Why, no one prepared for it! Then, in the darkest part, suddenly, the storm starts! We were woken from the noise of it! It was awful, but we didn't dare go outside! Some of the men, they did, but they came back pale as a corpse! Were shaken to their core! And some of these being the fightin' men! Best of the town! Aye, but the [swamp goo]."

Ylaine Barrett says, "They've gotten into the food cellar! The slimy things were creeping all over that place! I've gotten rid of most of the swamp goo, but I know there's more just outside town working their way to my food stores. I think you could do a small favor for us all and get rid of some. Oh and while you are at it, the skin of the swamp goo, I've some uses for it. I'll pay you for a swamp goo skin. Just go and get me one of their skins, and I'll be satisfied with ya."
[Step #2] Hunt the swamp goo, and return a skin to Ylaine.
Swamp goo are located in the water just down the hill from Caer Gothwaite.
You receive a slimy swamp goo skin from the swamp goo!
[Step #3] Return the skin to Ylaine Barrett.
Ylaine Barrett says, "Oh, you're back! Did you see how many there were? They are a nuisance, aren't they! Well, have you got me the skin?"
Give Ylaine Barrett the slimy swamp goo skin.

Ylaine Barrett says, "Ah, a good and slimy one! It's odd, these creatures, they've got some strangeness about them, but they've got their uses, as well. Thank you, then. Here, I promised I'd pay ya, and I will!"
You are awarded 3 silver and some copper!
You are awarded 11 experience!
You have finished the Cellar Infestation quest.

albion|inconnu poison.Name: Inconnu Poison
albion|inconnu poison.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Narah says, "I'm here to train you, to prepare you as best I can, for the day when you will choose your future path, as a necromancer or reaver, to do Arawn;s bidding, and [defeat Morgana]."

Narah says, "Morgana has raised many of Arawn's souls, and she has also summoned to her side the Drakoran armies! These Drakoran are as much an enemy to Arawn as Morgana, for those that serve Morgana work against Arawn. The Drakoran invaded Avalon, and all that is here, in the Isle of Glass, that is all that is left of the people of Avalon. The others are dead. The cannot [fight the battle] alone."

Narah says, "But while they can no longer fight the battle against the Drakoran without our aid, many still mistrust us. Trynt Madoc has decided the best way to earn the trust and loyalty of the people of the Isle of Glass is to prove our value and dedication to the battle against Morgana. It is not required of you, but helping Trynt may be an opportunutiy to practice your skills."
Dailog box: Will you help Trynt Madoc and his group?
You have been given the Inconnu Poison quest
Narah says, "Go speak to Trynt Madoc. He'll tell you what needs to be done."
[Step #1] Speak with Trynt Madoc in Gothwaite Harbor. Tell him your name when he asks.
Trynt Madoc is in the gazebo just down the hill from Caer Gothwaite in the Harbor.
Trynt Madoc says, "Greetings young Disciple. What be thy name?"
Tell him your name.

Trynt Madoc says, "Well, (your name), I see that Magess Gwenllian has been doing her part to help improve the relations around her. You may not have noticed, but many people around here do not like Inconnu. I am not one of those people, but there is a man, a poison merchant just came to this land, Burton MacDougal, who believes that every last Inconnu us out to steal his soul. I have told him that I can [prove differently]."

Trynt Madoc says, "I told Burton that the Inconnu brought a poison with them that is very effective against Drakoran. He said he would believe that there Inconnu are here to help if he could get a sample of the poison and the list of components to make it himself. Lirele, an Inconnu who is working with us, has agreed to help but she needs [a certain component] to finish the poison."
Trynt Madoc says, "Lirele told me she needed the fin (of) a sea pup to complete the poison. They live in the waters around Gothwaite Harbor. Get one and take it to Lirele.
[Step #2] Get the fin of a sea pup from the waters outside Gothwaite Harbor.
Sea pups are located just to the end of town near the water's edge. Get a fin and take it to Lirele.
You receive a sea pup fin from the sea pup!
[Step #3] Go to Lirele in Gothwaite Harbor
Lirele is located diagonally from Trynt Madoc outside a building next to some steps.
Lirele says, Tryne said you would be coming to see me. Do you have the sea pup fin? Please give it to me now."
[Step #4] Give Lirele the sea pup fin.
Lirele says, "Thank you. This should only take a minute. Here, take the poison and this scroll to Burton MacDougal. Tell him it is from Lirele the Inconnu."
You receive a vial of poison from Lirele!
You receive Lirele's scroll from Lirele!
[Step #5] Go to Burton MacDougal in Gothwaite Harbor. Tell him [Lirele sent] you.
Burton MacDougal, the poison merchant, is located just inside the building that Lirele stands in front of.
Burton MacDougal eyes you suspiciously.
Burton MacDougal says, "What do you want? I don't like your kind, so state your business quickly and get gone!"
You say, "Lirele sent me."

Burton MacDougal says, "Oh, you're from Lirele, eh? That doesn't change anything. That nasty Trynt told me the pale witch would be getting me some poison, but I haven't seen it yet. Did she send you over here with it? Let me have it."
[Step #6] Give Burton MacDougal the pos\ison prepared by Lirele.
Give the vial of poison to Burton MacDougal.
Burton MacDougal takes the poison and examines it.

Burton MacDougal says, "Hrmph, haven't seen something like this before. but this won't last me very long. Trynt said she'd tell me how to make it. I see the wench hasn't lived up to that promise. You just can't trust you Inconnu!"
Give Lirele's scroll to Burton MacDougal.

Burton MacDougal says, "Oh, hrmph, well, um, this is how to make it. Um, well, I guess that wench, er, Lirele, wasn't lying to me after all. Maybe she's not so bad after all, or you either, but I still don't trust the rest of 'em! Well, here, since you did some work, you can have this. But t his doesn't mean that I like you! Now, buy some poison or get out of here!"
You are awarded 11 experience!
You are awarded 2 silver and some copper!
You have finished the Inconnu Poison quest.

albion|commencement.Name: Commencement
albion|commencement.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: You must have completed Immediate Resolution first.
Master Torr says, "You have learned much. It would behoove you to venture further than you already have. Yet the roads are dangerous these days and to survive you will require [companions]."
Dialog box: You are tasked to seek out the local crier and gain insight into grouping.
You have been given the Commencement quest.
Master Torr says, "Seek out our local crier and he shall instruct your further.
Barnarn the crier says, "Hail! I am told you require instruction. Tis and easy [task] to learn."
Barnarn the crier says, "Seek out a fellow member of this realm. Fashion between you a group and return to me. I will instruct you further then."

albion|flint weapons.Name: Flint Weapons
albion|flint weapons.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: You can do this quest in several zones and it is an easy low level weapon upgrade. There is more than one NPC who gives it. Cherts drop from multiple low level mobs. Bring one back and he will make you a weapon:
Thin Chert = flint dirk
Flat Chert = flint knife
Round chert = flinthead club
Stonemason Harwin says, "Greetings, I'm the master of stonemason hereabouts. You look in need of a decent [weapon]. Perhaps I can help you in that regard, though it may put you in a bit of danger."

Stonemason Harwin says, "Aye, though you may scoff at the idea, stone weapons, if made correctly can be quite effective. I can make a [knife], a [club], or a [dirk] depending on the shape of the [chert] I start with."
Stonemason Harwin says, "Ahh, a slasher are ye? Well, in order to make a knife I'll first need a flat [chert]. If you bring me one I should be able to make a knife for ye."
Stonemason Harwin says, "A crushing weapon?" Squeamish at the site of a little blood, eh? I suppose I can make you a club if you bring me a round [chert]."
Stonemason Harwin says, "Ok, I should be able to manage a dirk for you. I'll need a thin [chert] though to get the best thrusting action. If you bring me one I'll make you a dirk."
You receive a flinthead club from Stonemason Glover!
This quest does NOT show in your journal and is repeatable.
Rewards:
Flinthead Club
Flint Dirk
Flint Knife

albion|lost potion.Name: Lost Potion
albion|lost potion.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Narah says, "Trynt Madoc has said you did well. Now, he'd like you to help out again. It seems Sister Genette Ashlan has some problems with the Inconnu in general. It makes sense, as she is of the Church of Albion. We have always been rivals with the one god of that church. They are not known for their tolerance. But, Trynt Madoc believes it is important to have her stop [speaking out] against us in the town."

Narah says, "Yes, she believes it would be better to die at the hands of Morgana and her Drakoran minions than to consort with those of the realm of the dead. I do not believe many in the town share the same sentiment, but it would be nice to not hear her cackling tongue for a change."
Dialog box: Will you help Trynt Madoc change the mind of Sister Genette Ashlan?
You have been given the The Lost Potion quest
Narah says, "Right then. Speak to Genette. Tell her Tryby sent you."
[Step #1] Speak with Sister Genette Ashlan in Caer Gothwaite. Tell her [Trynt sent] you.
Sister Genette Ashlan, the healer, is located in the first tent inside the gates of Caer Gothwaite. This would be to your right facing the gates from your Disciple trainer.
Sister Genette Ashlan says, "What do you want? I make no secret that I dislike your kind. If you have some business with me, speak up, otherwise go away!"
You say, "Trynt sent me."
Sister Genette Ashlan says, "Trynt, eh? He's a troublemaker, trying to make people think you Inconnu are worth having around. He wasn't here when [the storm hit]!"

Sister Genette Ashlan says, "Aye, the storm that brought the likes of you to these shores. It has been a beautiful day that day. The evening started out beautiful too, clear and calm. A group of soldiers had left as the sun was just dipping below the horizon to go on patrol. With not a cloud in the sky, the group didn't take torches but relied upon the light of the stars to guide them. Out in the middle of nowhere, a group of those nasty Drakorans ambushed a group of soldiers. There was a violent fight with many dead on both sides. A few of the soldiers survived and managed to crawl back towards Caer Gothwaite. When they were spotted, the watchers [sent for me]."

Sister Genette Ashlan says, "I gathered my things and hurried outside to meet those poor men and women. They were seriously hurt, but I thought I could save them. I began to treat using a magical healing potion given to me but another healer. It cleans the wound and makes it heal much faster and also counteracts the evil poison of the Drakorans. As I moved along treating each wound, a breeze began to blow gently. It took a few hours for me to treat each of them. As I reached the last one, the wind began to blow harder. One of my assistants suddenly gasped as dark clouds rolled in, blocking out the light of the stars. As the rain began to fall, [we gathered up] the wounded and hurried into the shelter of the Caer. Before we had even crossed the courtyard the lightning was blinding and the thunder deafening, and we wondered if we would be drown by the rain."

Sister Genette Ashlan says, "In the chaos of the storm and protecting the soldiers, I dropped my healing potion. No one was brave enough to go back out and look for it. I tried to search for it, but the storm was too violent and I could not even make it out the door. I did my best to treat the last soldier, but [without the potion] I could not cure him of the poison and he died. All because of the likes of you! You caused the storm and make that soldier die! That is why I don't like your kind!"

Sister Genette Ashlan says, "Trynt said that Inconnu witch Lirele would replace my potion if I told her. The potion requires two bones from damp skeletons. Get them and take them to Lirele if you want to prove the Inconnu are not the evil creatures I believe they are!"
[Step #2] Seek out the damp skeletons that roam north-northeast of Caer Gothwaite. Get two bones to give to Lirele.
You receive a damp skeleton bone from the damp skeleton!
You get 2 experience points!
The damp skeleton drops a copper coin.
[Step #3] You have one damp skeleton bone. You must get a second one.
You receive a damp skeleton bone from the damp skeleton!
You get 2 experience points!
The damp skeleton drops some copper coins.
[Step #4] Go to Lirele the Inconnu in Gothwaite Harbor.
Lirele says, "I see you have returned, (your name). Trynt Madoc said you would. Genette Ashlan needs her potion replaced. Please give me the first damp skeleton bone so I may begin the potion."
[Step #5] Give Lirele one of the damp skeleton bones.
Give Lirele the first damp skeleton bone.

Lirele says, "I have been sent by the great Arawn to help the people of Avalon. I am to assist Trynt Madoc and any others who will help us. I am to retrieve sould and aid in the fight against the Drakoran. All are to help defeat the Drakoran!"
Lirele says, "Thank you, (your name). Now please give me the second one."
[Step #6] Give Lirele the other damp skeleton bone.
Give Lirele the second damp skeleton bone.

Lirele says, "Well done. Now the potion is complete. Please take it to Genette Ashlan and give her our most humble apologies for causing the loss of the first potion. I shall speak with her later about the soul of the soldier that died."
You receive a potion of healing from Lirele!
[Step #7] Return to Sister Genette Ashlan in Caer Gothwaite.
Sister Genette Ashlan says, "Oh, so your're back. Did she make my potion? I'm guessing she didn't!"
[Step #8] Give Sister Genette Ashlan the potion prepared by Lirele.
Give the potion to Sister Genette Ashlan.
Sister Genette Ashlan says, "Hhmm, this looks like my potion, but I'm going to have to test it out. I cut myself earlier. I shall try it on that cut."

Sister Genette Ashlan says, "Well, apparently that Lirele knows her stuff. This is the same as my potion. When this runs out maybe I'll ask her to make me some more. Egad, did I jsut say that? Ask an Inconnu for something? Well, maybe the Inconnu aren't so bad if they can keep making my potion. Ack, what is wrong with me, saying things like that? Anyway, take this and go away before I say something good about the Inconnu!"
You are awarded 22 experience!
You are awareded 2 silver and some copper!
You have finished the The Lost Potion quest.

albion|disturbing illness.Name: Disturbing Illness
albion|disturbing illness.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-11-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to your trainer who will send you to talk to the healer, Sister Genette Ashlan in Caer Gothwaite. She is next to the bind stone, which is directly across from the entrance. She will send you on a random task.

Master Reginald says, "Ylaine tells me she hasn't spotted any swamp goo in the cellars since you and some other young adventurers took a part in clearing them out. This is really good to hear. Of course, now we've new [troubles]."
Master Reginald says, "Aye, the never go away. I'd like you to lend a hand. I'll understand if you don't, but I thikn you could benefit a little from it."
Dialog box: Will you aid the healer to find a cure?
You have been given the Disturbing Illness quest.

Master Reginald says, "Aye, speak to the healer, Genette, she is treating new illness that seems to be affecting only the Inconnu. She's worked with Dalvay, Arawn's priest, and together they've come up with some sort of cure."
[Step #1] Talk to Sister Genette Ashlan, the healer, about this strange Inconnu sickness.

Sister Genette Ashlan says, "Rogue, are you the one that's here to help me? Aye, I've got to treat this illness afflicting the Inconnu. I've not seen anything like it. I've had to talk to that [strange priest]."

Sister Genette Ashlan says, "Aye, I'll not understand the workings of your folk, Rogue, truly I shan't. But he is a strange fellow. Came to me at the oddest times to tell me your folk were getting sick, and needed tending, and about threatened me with Arawn's wrath when I said then Arawn should have thought of tending the Inconnu's illness' himslef before he threw that temple in the middle of our town. Aye, but I'm a healer, and heal I will, but you're a strange folk, and need a different sort of tending. I've got everything I need, but one thing. I need one more [ingredient] to this concoction I'm cooking up."

Sister Genette Ashlan says, "Off the coast, near the water, you can usually see the sea pups out there. The skin of the sea pup has an oily feel to it. I need to scrape off the oils from the skin and boil it. Aye, it's my problem how, I'll manage that. You just go get me the skin."
[Step #2] Bring Sister Genette the skin of a sea pup.
Go and kill a sea pup, they are located West of Caer Gothwaite and Gothwaite Harbor and are near the water. Other version calls for a Large Dragonfly Sac.
You receive a sea pup skin from the sea pup!
[Step #3] Return to Sister Genette with the ingredient you obtained.
Sister Genette Ashlan says, "Ah, you've come back. Have you the item? Now then, give it here, and I will begin the prepartations."
You give the sea pup skin to Sister Genette Ashlan.

Sister Genette Ashlan says, "Great! Alright, now you need to speak to Tage. Dalvay's acolyte. Tell him I'm ready for the next portion of the remedy. Here, take this coin. I don't think he's any concept of payment for work rendered."
(You will find Tage standing in the center of the three stones, where the disciple, necromancer and raver trainers are standing inside the keep where all starts. )
You are awarded 6 silver and some copper!
[Step #4] Tell Tage Sister Genette is ready for the next portion of the remedy.
You say, "Sister Genette is ready for the next portion."
Tage says, "I did not expect her to be ready so soon. You will have to [collect] the next ingredient she will need. I've too many sick to tend."
Tage says, "Bring me a swamp goo. Dead, preferably. The roam just outside of town."
[Step #5] Bring Tage a swamp goo.
Swamp goo are located south, just down the hill from Caer Gothwaite, near the water.
You receive a dead swamp goo from the swamp goo!
[Step #6] Return the second component to Tage.
Tage says, "Have you the second component I need, Rogue?"
Tage says, "This will do. You have done well. Wait a moment, while I prepare the pulpy mixture the healer woman will need."
Tage says, "There. It is done, and has been blessed by Arawn. Tell the healer woman to add her potion to this pulp."
You receive a pulpy mixture from Tage!
[Step #7] Take the pulpy mixture to Sister Genette.

Sister Genette Ashlan says, "Ah, you're back. Did that acolyte creep you out, as well? I still shiver just thinking about him and that priest! Well, did he have anything for me? I was told that only a mixture blessed by Arawn would work! The nerve!"
You give the pulpy mixture to Sister Genette Ashlan.

Sister Genette Ashlan says, "Thank you, Rogue. I'm sure I'll be able to heal your people, though you know, the blessings of our church should be more than enough. Really, Arawn's blessing is not needed in all things."
You are awarded 22 experience!
You have finished the Disturbing Illness quest
Alternate tasks:
1. kill a fly and bring its poison sack to the healer.
2. the award is not 22 exp, but is 44 exp.
Another alternate task is to kill an Urchin Quib, and retrieve its quills. I recieved 22exp for completing the quest

albion|association.Name: Association
albion|association.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This is only one version...
[Step #1]Locate and speak to Hunter Ceron. He can be found on a ridge just north of Ludlow.
His loc is 56060, 36230. If you go directly NE
Hunter Ceron reads a note.
The Hunter Ceron says, "Deliver this note to the town crier in Ludlow. He will instruct you further."
You receive a note from the Hunter Ceron!
[Step #2] Deliver a note to the crier in Ludlow.
Varrin the crier is located in front of the tavern.
Varrin the crier says, "Do you have a note for me?"
You hand Varrin the crier the note from Hunter Ceron.
Varrin the crier says, "Thank you!"
Varrin the crier read a note.

Varrin the crier says, "Aye! The bandits in the north are causing problems once again. Seek out Commander Buin at the tower just east of here and deliver this message to him. Then, return to your trainer for your reward."
[Step #3] Deliver a note to Commander Buin at the tower just east of Ludlow.
It is actually E/SE but you can see it from Ludlow.
Commander Buin says, "Do you have a note for me?"
You hand Commander Buin a note from Varrin the crier.

Commander Buin says, "You have done well in delivering this message to me. Times are dark and darkening still! Yet, do not fear! So long as the shining light of Camelot continues, we shall never fall!"

Commander Buin says, "You have done well in delivering this message to me. Times are dark and darkening still! Yet, do not fear! So long as the shining light of Camelot continues, we shall never fall! Now be on your way. You have learned much, yet more training do you require before you can be of greater service to the realm of Albion!"
(yes that is what he said, I copied it word for word and he repeated himself!)
At step three instead of being sent to Commander Buin, I was sent,with a note, to Cemmeth in Cotswold.
[Step #4] Return to your trainer!
Master Torr says, "Your service to Albion is notable! I am sure the guilds have taken notice of your actions this day!"
You are awarded XXX experience!
You are awarded 3 silver and some copper!
You have finished the Association quest.

albion|nain hunting.Name: Nain Hunting
albion|nain hunting.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-11-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Sir Ambiz needs your help in hunting Nain Dwarves. Kill them and bring back proof for a minor reward. Just go straight S from the castle, towards the Abbey. There will be individuals scattered across the hill that con blue to a level 4. If you are higher level than that, turn and head west at the top of that hill. The valley you hit has two dwarven camps. Problem is that they group, and will call for help, so be careful.

albion|rock imps.Name: Rock Imps
albion|rock imps.Source: Allakhazam quest page (current copy; notes about later patches removed)
Lines: Crep Pew in Ludlow will tell you about the Imps on the hill which are raining rocks down upon the village. Head up the hill and kill them and he will reward you with some money and experience for their body parts.
Crew Pew says, "Help! [Imps] on the hill behind me are trying to force us out of town!"
Crew Pew says, "They want us out so the can loot the [town]."
Crew Pew says, "They are pushing boulders down the hill that are damaging our buildings and injuring [people]."
Crew Pew says, "My [shop] has been damaged and my [daughter] injured."
Crew Pew says, "Please help us by killing the imps and their leader."
Crew Pew says, "We are desperate for [assistance]."
Crew Pew says, "Will you brave warriors please [assist] us?"
Crew Pew says, "If you bring me the evidence that you have killed them, you will be handsomely rewarded."
Kill rock imps and for every "part" you get a gem (Rock Imps can be found "On the top of the ridge, due north of Ludlow (west of the road to the bridge).")
You receive a yellow quartz from Crep Pew!
Crep Pew gives you 160 copper for the yellow quartz.

albion|soul hunt.Name: Soul Hunt
albion|soul hunt.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-11-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Master Reginald says, "Remember the swamp goo in the cellar? And the sickness that affected the Inconnu only? It seems that there is an undead that has been hiding from Arawn for years, Now, with the Inconnu walking the land, he's feeling [threatened]."

Master Reginald says, "Aye. It seems he's instigated the whole swamp goo cellar infestation and began the sickness with the Inconnu. As long as the Inconnu are here, he will be a threat. I think we should aid Tage."
Dialog box: Will you help end the threat to Caer Gothwaite?
You have been given the Soul Hunt quest.
Master Reginald says, "Aye. Speak to Tage, he'll fill you in on the what Arawn has told him."
[Step #1] Speak to Tage.

Tage says, "Rogue, one of our sould has disguised himself as a damp skeleton amongst the dead Morgana has raised. He thinks to distract us by infesting the town with the swamp goo, and creating an illness for the Inconnu. He must be returned to Arawn, before he does more harm. Everry night that he lives as one of the undead, he gains in power. If he is not returned soon, he will grow strong, and become a great threat to this fortress town. He must be returned. He roams with the rest of the undead. Go, return his essence to me."
[Step #2] Seek out Jocias, and retrieve his soul.

Jocias only spawns after a great number of damp skeletons have been offed. If you get lucky he will have already spawned. He will spawn near 46k, 49k, or 49k, 49k, or 49k, 51k or there abouts. He did immediately respawn when I killed him with the rogue.
Jocias dies!
You get 26 experience points.
Jocias drops a bag of coins.
Jocias says, "Ha! My soul is still free! Amongst the damp skeletons Morgana has raised! You'll never find me!"
[Step #3] Jocias fled into a damp skeleton. Find and retrieve Jocias' soul from the damp skeleton it fled to.
I tried this several times, and it seems that the soul will jump into a gray con skele. And usually off all by itself. Kill as many as needed until you get the soul.
The damp skeleton says, "Noo! Don't return me to Arawn! He will torment me!"
You receive Jocias' soul from the damp skeleton!
[Step #5] Return the soul to Tage.
Tage says, "Have you Jocias' soul, Rogue?"
You give Tage Jocias' soul.
Tage says, "Ah. He shall be returned to Arawn. His place is the underworld. He must make retribution to Arawn. I thank you, Rogue. You have done well."
You are awarded 5 silver and some copper!
You are awarded 44 experience!
You have finished the Soul Hunt quest.

albion|souls of the dead.Name: Souls of the Dead
albion|souls of the dead.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Narah says, "There's some group that is trying to have those of the Temple of Awarn leave. They feel as Sister Genette Ashlan did, that the town is better off [falling to the Drakoran] than working with us."
Narah says, "Well, that is the alternative to accepting our aid, since they obviously can't defeat Morgana without our help. Trynt recognizes this, and would like your help again."
Dialog box: Will you aid Trynt Madoc again with the residents of Caer Gothwaite?
You have been given the Souls of the Dead quest.
Narah says, "Speak to Trynt Madoc about the group of people speaking out against the Inconnu."
[Step #1] Speak with Trynt Madoc in Gothwaite Harbor about the group of people against the Inconnu.

Trynt Madoc says, "Greetings again. I am so glad you've been able to help improve the relations between some of the people here in Caer Gothwaite and the Inconnu. Sadly, there are still some who speak badly of the Inconnu. They have been going around telling everyone that the Inconnu are the [servants of Morgana]!"

Trynt Madoc says, "Yes, I cannot believe it either, for I have seen the Inconnu out on the field of battle, sacrificing themselves in the fight against the Drakoran and Morgana's undead. They won't stop fighting until the last breath has passed through their lips. Yet still people do not believe they are here to help but will [be our downfall]."

Trynt Madoc says, "Now, not everyone believes this, but there is a core group that does. The group's second in command is a woman named Tessa Ohrman. She is always saying the Inconnu are here to stir up the undead, not gather up the souls ripped from their peaceful slumber by Morgana. We need you to prove to Tessa that she is wrong about the Inconnu. If we win Tessa to our side, she will convince the leader, Calder to change his mind. Go to Tessa now, and speak with her. I told her you would be coming to speak with her."
[Step #2] Go speak with Tessa Ohrman in Gothwaite Harbor. Tell her your name when she asks.
Tessa Ohrman says, "So, you're the one Trynt said he'd send to me. What's your name?"
Tell Tessa Ohrman your name.

Tessa Ohrman says, "Well, I'll be honest with you. I don't like Incommu and I only agreed to speak with you because Trynt wouldn't go away until I did. If you want to know what the cause of all the problems around here is, look no farther than the Inconnu! The got all these undead riled up, [causing trouble] with the people around here."

Tessa Ohrman says, "The undead have been attacking people, especially the headless dead. They are the remains of people who have had terrible accidents upon the shores of this land. They never bothered us until the Inconnu came! Everyone said it was Morgana's doing, but I know the truth! If you think you can prove that the Inconnu are not here to cause trouble, [retrieve the souls] of three headless dead."

Tessa Ohrman says, "When you have them, take them to that Inconnu Lirele over there. She claims she can send them away, but I don't believe her. You get them, take them to her, and I'll watch to see if she does it or if she turns them loosee on us here in Caer Gothwaite! Now go!"
[Step #3] Get the souls of three headless dead that roam east of Gothwaite Harbor.
Go kill some dead!
The headless dead says, "Thank you for freeing me..."
[Step #3] Get the souls from two more headless dead that roam east of Gothwaite Harbor.
The headless dead says, "Thank you for freeing me..."
[Step #3] Get the souls of one more headless dead that roam east of Gothwaite Harbor.
The headless dead says, "Thank you for freeing me..."
[Step #4] Go to Lirele in Gothwaite Harbor.

Lirele says" It is good to see you again. I overheard your conversation with Tessa. She fears us, and together you and I shall show her she has no reason to fear the Inconnu. Please give me the first soul."
[Step #5] Turn in a soul to Lirele.
Lirele says, "Good, now the second."
[Step #5] Turn in a soul to Lirele.
Lirele says, "Thank you. Now the third please."
[Step #5] Turn in a soul to Lirele.
Lirele begins to chant in an unknown language.
Lirele casts a spell!
[Step #6] Return to Tessa in Gothwaite Harbor.

Tessa Ohrman says, "I saw you over there with that Inconnu Lirele. I saw what she did with those spirits. She didn't make them come attack me! I thought she would, but she didn't. I'd have to see her do it more, but maybe I was wrong. Yes, even I [can admit] I am wrong!"

Tessa Ohrman says, "It's not easy, and I don't trust the Inconnu, but I will stop saying that they are here to cause trouble, and I will work on changing Calder's mind too. I don't know if he will listen, but I will try. To show I am not such a bad person as some think, please [sic]take this."
(When I did this quest, it had typo's and the last log cut off before she was finished, but I still ended the quest. If you have the ending log, please let us know)
You are awarded 88 experience!
You are awarded 2 silver and some copper!
You have finished the Souls of the Dead quest.

albion|guild introduction.Name: Guild Introduction
albion|guild introduction.Source: Allakhazam quest page (current copy; notes about later patches removed)
Lines: Narah says, "While others have a choice in their future, you are destined for service as a necromancer in the Temple of Arawn, and you would be wise to [speak] to a trainer, to show intiative."
Narah says, "It is time for you to move forward in your training. Talk to Carys, the necromancer trainer. You have learned all you can from me."
Narah says, "You should talk to a necromancer trainer, to learn about life as a necromancer."
Dialog box: Will you go and meet the trainers who are interested in your skills?
You have been given the Guild Introduction quest.
Narah says, "Good. Speak to Carys to learn about the role of Necromancers."
[Step #2] Speak to Carys, the Necromancer.

Carys says, "If you are strong enough to handle the power, Lord Arawn will give you control over the dead. You will be able to manipulate the spirits of the dead. This will scare many who do not understand our power, and they will fear and shun you. But you will h ave the power of Lord Arawn at your command. As a disciple, this is your only choice. You are designed by Arawn to be a necromancer."
You are awarded 3 silver and some copper!
You are awarded 176 experience!
You have finished the Guild Introduction quest.

albion|guild preparation.Name: Guild Preparation
albion|guild preparation.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Master Torr says, "It is time for you to make yourself known to the [guilds] in this realm."
Dialog box: Your task is to learn about Albion's guilds. Then seek out and make contact with at least one future guild.
You have been given the Guild Prepartation quest.
Master Torr says, "Your service to them will dictate your fate. Are you [prepared] to [pursue] understanding at this time?"
You have been given the Guild Preparation quest.
Master Torr says, "Then let us begin our lesson! There are but four guild in Albion. They are the [Church of Albion], the [Defender of Albion], the [Guild of Shadows], and the [Academy]."
Master Torr says, "Our glorious church stands eternal in the light of Camelot! Their faith strives to bring order to chaos, faith to the faithless, light where there is darkness!"
Master Torr says, "Should you wish to follow its teachings, you will server as a [Paladin]."

Master Torr says, "You wish to be a defender of the faith I take it? Many a Paladin has led our fighters into battle with victory not far behind. Their never-ending sacrifices proves that the Church of Albion will remain for many centuries! To give your life of service to the Church of Albion, seek out Lord Prydwen of Lady Triss within the city of Camelot!"

Master Torr says, "To defend the borders of this realm is no small deed! Our great army still follows the way of Arthur! In the Shadows of Camelot, all will stand equal so long as the Defenders exist!"
Master Torr says, "Should you hear the calling, you shall serve as an [Armsman]!"
Master Torr says, "The Academy is Albion's tome of knowledge! From withing it's walls ushers forth untold power!"
[Step #1]Seek out at least one future guild trainer.
Then seek another then return to your original trainer. Do not join a guild at this time or you will fail this quest!

albion|zombie problem.Name: Zombie Problem
albion|zombie problem.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-11-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Gronyr wanders the roads outside Prydwen Keep and stops at the stone in the road that says Camelot. He also stands near the entrance of Prydwen Keep and some times near the farm house where the zombies spawn. If you hail him, he will warn you about the zombies that have taken over his farm. The farm is near the road and if you wait until night time, the farmer will spawn along with a pile of other zombies. Killing the farmer gets you some nice gloves. Killing the zombie sows will sometimes get you a rotting hog tail. Give the tails back to Gronyr and he will give you a cloudy green stone (worth about 50 copper) for each one.
Gronyr wanders, sometimes he is in Prydwen Keep to the left of the entrance, sometimes on the road by the Camelot stone, and third place is next to the rock next to the stables at the farm.

Gronyr Gloyw says, "Help! Evil is walking the land and it has despoiled my farm. An army of [zombie swine] has invaded my land, they are led by the walking corpse of the farmer who owned the land before me."

Gronyr Gloyw says, "Aye, foul and corrupted undead swine rise from the ground at [night] and dance around their unholy master, a zombie farmer. If you bring me rotting hig tails as proof that you have killed them, I will reward you."
Gronyr Gloyw says, "Only at night do the beasts rise from the grave to ravage my fields. Even if you do not agree to help me, beware walking the road near m farm at night, for evil walks the land."
After killing a zombie sow, give the hog tail to Gronyr Gloyw.
Gronyr Gloyw says, "Thank heavens, one less monster to ruin my land. Here is a small payment for your troubles."
You receive a cloudy green stone from Gronyr Gloyw!
Reward:
Cloudy Green Stone

albion|bandit ears.Name: Bandit Ears
albion|bandit ears.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Hunter Derwyn is located at the tower next to the bandit camps usually referred to as the bandit tower. He is offering a reward for the ears of any bandits you kill. When you bring him an ear, he gives you a document to take to Sir Dorian in the otwer outside Cotswald which results in a minor reward, a medal (worth about 55 cp).

albion|cleric mulgrut.Name: Cleric Mulgrut
albion|cleric mulgrut.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-11-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to Hugh Gallen at Prydwen Keep.

Hugh tells you the sad tale of a cleric who went mad after the death of his son. The only recourse is to put the poor guy out of his misery. He's not only insane, but undead. Head west and look for Mulgrut Maggot and kill him. Besides knowing you did right, you get a nice belt of animation.
Hugh Gallen says, "So you want to buy something eh? Well here is what I have."
Hugh Gallen says, "I have a [bit of information] you might be interested in should you wish to hear it."

Hugh Gallen says, "Listen close! Lord Prydwen once had a faithful cleric, known as Mulgrut. His service to our realm was unparallel. Yet, during Arthur's siege on Lancelot, his son, Durren, [was slain]."
Hugh Gallen says, "Yes! Mulgrut [never recovered] from that. He turned his eyes from God and never looked back."
Hugh Gallen says, "Aye! Even in death his soul never rests. If you are interested, I can tell you how to [make a profit] from this!"
Dialog box: Do you accept the Cleric Mulgrut quest?
You have been given the Cleric Mulgrut quest.
Hugh Gallen says, "It is said that upon his death, he carried into the after life an item of great worth. Some say he still walks the cemetery not far from here!"
[Step #1]Locate and slay Mulgrut for his magical item.
He and 3 of his minions, 2 decayed zombies and a putrid zombie, walk from between the cemetery and the hill with the tall stone and the large skeletons.
(or wait to kill Mulgruth in the cemetery at loc 18k, 45.5K in Camelot Hills.)
The putrid zombie says, "Brains! I want brains!"
Mulgrut Maggot says, "Die you demon of Arthur! My son shall be avenged!"
You receive a Belt of Animation from Mulgrut Maggot!
Your standing with the undead has decreased.
You are awarded experience!
You have finished the Cleric Mulgrut quest.
Reward:
Belt of Animation

albion|ripper.Name: Ripper
albion|ripper.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Barnarn the crier says, "Rumor has it that a giant wolf has attacked a patrol at a remote post in the southern black mountains."
Talk to the named guard at the tower west of Vetusta Abbey (in the same valley where you can find the dwarfs for a quest in Humberton). He tells you about Throatripper.
Lieutenant Jursen says, "Hail! Ever heard of [throatripper]?" (South Black Mountains - 5963,59063,1024)
Lieutenant Jursen says, "Yeah, an [angry wolf] who has taken up living in these woods."
Lieutennat Jursen says, "Well it attacked one of our patrols and was wounded. Ever since then the damn beast just howls all night and [attacks anything] that comes near it."
Lieutenant Jursen says, "I would have taked care of it myself, but I cannot leave my post. Will you [kill it]? I will reward you!"
Dialog box: Do you accept the Ripper quest?
You have been given the Ripper quest.
Lieutenant Jursen says, "Thank you! I might actually get some sleep tonight."
[Step #1]Find and slay Throatripper. (South Black Mountains - 9014,56520,0788)

If you kill the wolf that spawns near the edge of the forest between the cutpurse and dwarf camps right at the base of the hill, Throatripper will spawn at loc=6558, 52669 and come running at you, but will run off when you turn around and you will have to chase him down and kill him. He is yellow to level 5. He drops a Ripper pelt.
[Step #2]Return to Lieutenant Jursen for your reward.
Lieutenant Jursen says, "Wow! You did it! As promised, here is your reward. You should take that pelt into Ludlow and talk to [Marie]. It might be more valuable than you think!"
Lieutenant Jursen says, "She is a Seamstress in Ludlow."
[Step #3]Travel to Ludlow and show Seamstress Marie the ripper pelt. (South Black Mountains - 46305,44524,2217)
Seamstress Marie says, "Hello, you appear to need my [services]."
Seamstress Marie says, "Well I can do most any leatherwork you may require. Do you have a [pelt] that you wish me to examine?"
Seamstress Marie says, "I assume you required my leatherworking skills do you not? Let me see it!"
You give Seamstress Marie the Ripper pelt.

Seamstress Marie says, "Ah! A fine pelt indeed! I will fashion this a jerkin but you will need to obtain another item so that I can sew it properly. Seek out a large skeleon and from it bring me a piece of polished bone."
You can find large skeletons at various places near Costwold and Prydwen Keep. (Camelot Hills - 45106,49934,2677) Kill them until you get the polished bone, then return to Ludlow.
4. Give Marie the polished bone, and she will reward you with the Ripper Jerkin (LEATHER)
Reward:
Ripper Jerkin

albion|simple request.Name: Simple Request
albion|simple request.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Pompin the crier says, "Lieutenant Brude in the Snowdonia mountain fortress needs someone to perform a simple errand. Report to him directly if you're interested in the job."

Lieutenant Brude at Snowdonia Fortress asked me to take a sealed note to Lieutenant Kuebler at Castle Sauvage. It's a basic courier job as you take notes back and forth. You get some coin and a little experience. Some do not get coin.

albion|camdene's components.Name: Camdene's Components
albion|camdene's components.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: In Adribard's Retreat, which is in Avalon Marsh, talk to Dyemaster Camdene. He tells you that he needs 3 components to make some special dyes and that he will reward you if you would collect these 3 special components for him. First he needs a rat tongue from a Swamp Rat. Second he needs a worm rot from a Rot Worm. Third he needs a bog mud that comes from a Bogman Grappler. All three of these monsters can be found within the Avalon Marsh. When you have acquired all 3 items, return to Dyemaster Camdene but don't try to give him the items right away...he will say that he doesn't want them. First right click on him to speak to him and he will say it appears that you have the items he asked for. He will then ask you to give him the items one at a time in order. I did this quest at level 6 and received almost a full blue bubble of experience in addition to some money and a bottle of light green cloth dye. At level 6 the swamp rats where green and the rot worms and bogman grapplers were blues. Only problem I had was that the bogman grapplers frequently like to travel in pairs. All 3 monsters can be found easy enough if you head straight out from the entrance of Adribard's Retreat into the Avalon Marsh.

albion|goblin incursion.Name: Goblin Incursion
albion|goblin incursion.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: If you have trouble getting this quest, you can always try the Crier in Ludlow to possibly activate it.

I got at lvl 12 as a paladin, I heard about it from a barkeep in camelot. Although I think you can get it at a lower lvl. It starts with that you seek up Guard Reed in Humberton which will talk about a goblin problem they are having and they are awaiting news from a scout which have been sent out to investigate. He tells you to run to Commander Jusen past the 2nd marker past the brigde towards Snowdonia Station. Loc: 21166,1276.

He gives you a note which you hand back to Guard Reed which confirms the problem, and you are now asked to go to the goblin camp north of Humberton and kill the leaders there, Grilo and Fusnup, which were green and grey at lvl 12 and quite easily dispatched. They are either inside the house or walking along the shore I think, I found them in the house and undeads roam the shore at night, which can be dangerous i suppose if you are lower lvl, were grey at 12.

After you kill Grilo and Fusnup, Guard Reed says that the goblins are gonna attack Ludlow and you need to deliver a message to his son in Ludlow, Guy Reed and warn them. When you deliver the report to reed he says that you should talk to Maggie McClellan, which also is in the tavern which is a gossiper to get her to spread it around and here the quest ends.
As reward for the quest you get to choose between 4 kinds of bracelet which increases either strength, intelligence, piety or dexterity. And 5 silver and some copper.
Rewards:
Bracelet of Denied Bloodshed
Bracelet of Mercifulness
Bracelet of Wound Knitting
Bracelet of Preservation

albion|heart of sephucoth.Name: Heart of Sephucoth
albion|heart of sephucoth.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Eowyln in Cotswold says she can craft a pendant if you bring her the heart of the river sprite Sephucoth.
Eowyln Astos says, "Hail traveler! I may have a bit of [profitable information] for you!"
Eowyln Astos says, "I have learned how to [fashion a pendant] of immense value."
Eowyln Astos says, "I can do so, but I would require the heart from a [terrible beast]."
Dialog box: Do you accept the Heart of Sephucoth quest?
You have been given the Heart of Sephucoth quest.
Eowyln Astos says, "Aye, the locals have given it the name Sephucoth. Return its heart to me and I will instruct you further."
[Step #1] Slay the river sprite Sepucoth and return to Eowyln Astos with his heart.

Sephucoth is located up river, surrounded by his cronies, near an oveturned boat. The easiest way to find him is, go to the north end of the bridge from cotswold to camelot, then follow the river west until you see a little sunken boat along the north shore. There will be a bunch of river sprites, spritelings, and drake hatchlings hanging around.

Kill them till Sepucoth spawns and then take him out. I recommend bringing a friend if you are below level 7 or so, as they WILL gang up on you. Sepucoth always has a couple of sprite buddies hanging around. My Paladin had a tough time with them until Level 7, when I was able to solo them.

You might have to kill some sprites to get him to appear. Bring back his heart and she will send you off to get a polished bone from a large skeleton. Bring this back and you will receive your pendant.
If you are going to kill Sepucoth, you might as well also get the Sunken Cargo quest as well.
Reward:
Fiery Crystal Pendant

albion|hunt for slith.Name: Hunt for Slith
albion|hunt for slith.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Commander Burcrif (loc=33945, 61515 in Black mountains south) says, "Hail! I hear tell of a rumor. Would you perhaps like to [hear it]?"
Commander Burcrif says, "Some talk of a red snake that will only come should he become [displeased]."
Commander Burcrif says, "I know now what might truly displease a snake, but I do know where he may be found. Are you [interested]?"
Dialog box: Do you accept the Hunt for Slith quest?
You have been given the Hunt for Slith quest.
Commander Burcrif says, "Good! This rare snake was last seen to the east. Not far from the walls of Camelot. Best of luck in your endeavor!"
[Step #1] Locate and kill Slith

Just past the tent merchants are ants, pups and snakes. Northeast of the gates, declining slowly, away from Camelot, look for the broodlings and start killing them, Slith will appear (loc=41500, 55500 in Black mountains south). Best to wait a level until you are stronger unless you bring a friend. The broodlings will gang up on you while you are fighting Slith, up to 7 broodlings can be nipping at you. Slith drops his tail, which is a dex ring.
You receive Slith's Tail from Slith!
You have finished the Hunt for Slith quest.
Reward:
Slith's Tail

albion|search for sil.Name: Search for Sil
albion|search for sil.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Nob (Loc: 24100, 21300) is worried about Sil and wants you to find him for him. Head out to the tower nearby and ask Sir Dorian if he has seen Sil.
Sir Dorian will then tell you that he saw him headed towards the statute on the nearby hill which has a statue of a head poking out of the top of it.

Alas, Sil met his maker at the hands of a Spriggarn named Ygwrch Gyrg. If you kill things on the hill, eventually Ygwrch will spawn and you can get revenge for poor Sil and a nifty cloak as well (Gyrg's Cloak, plus to quickness). Now return to Nob and tell him the bad news for some extra experience.
Ygwrch is a level 7 Monster, so this quest is most easily done either grouped at level 7 or at level 8. When I killed him, he was linked to two Spriggarns.
Reward:
Gyrg's Cloak

albion|sunken cargo.Name: Sunken Cargo
albion|sunken cargo.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Cullen's ship was sunk by a band of river sprites and he really wants his precious cargo of apple brandy.
Cullen Smyth says, "What am I to do? My boat has sunk in the river and the [cargo] lost. Oh what am I to do?"
Cullen Smyth says, "My cargo of fine apple brandy that I was delivering to the King's table. Did you know that Hakon is a master wood craftsman as well as a hunter?"

From the river that crosses through Cotswold Village, follow the Camelot-side south for quite a ways. It is a little past halfway to Prydwen Keep, so it may take a minute or two. You will see a ship surrounded by sprites along the shoreline. Kill some and one named Sephucoth will spawn. He drops the brandy. Bring it back to Cullen and he will give you a gold nugget to sell to a merchant.

*Note: you don't have to talk to Cullen first, just kill Sephucoth and then deliver the brandy. Brandy is a common drop from Sepucoth. If you are going to kill Sephucoth, you might as well also perform the Heart of Sephucoth quest as well.

albion|father hugrath.Name: Father Hugrath
albion|father hugrath.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Frip can be found standing next to the bridge near Prydwen Keep, which connects Salisbury Plains to Camelot Hills. Talk to him and he will tell you about how he lost his dad in a ruin nearby and fears he may be dead. Well, he's almost right. Frip's dad, Hugrath, is undead and surrounded by friends. He spawns in a building in the ruins just upriver from Frip and drops a Quicksilver Bracer when killed. More specifically, the tower Frip's Dad is in is the broken tower (smaller one), southeast of the Demon Tower. It is along the river east of the bridge where Frip is located. Pocket the bracer and let Frip know about his dad for some extra experience.
Reward:
Quicksilver Bracer

albion|lady leana.Name: Lady Leana
albion|lady leana.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Sir Quait, in Prydwen tells you to go talk to Nob the (inside) Stableboy about a problem he is having with fairies. Nob tells you that Lady Leana and her fairies have been terrorizing his animals. Leana is at the pond located in the nearby weeping willow grove. If she is not, DON'T kill the fairies -- you will fail the quest. But if you do, just go back and get quest again. Talk to her about it and she will complain that Nob's animals have been drinking at her pond. There does not seem to be a peaceful solution to this, so just kill her (bring a friend to handle the other fairies that join in) and she will drop a Silver Chain.
Reward:
Silver Chain

albion|protecting anniogel.Name: Protecting Anniogel
albion|protecting anniogel.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Kaere says, "Paladin, I am Kaere and I was sent here by Lady Eilwen and Davay to help Lady Treva Evasca defend this town. The task has not been easy for the Drakoran are a formidable enemy. Every day Lady Treva and her guardians live with the knowledge that the Drakoran may not be satisfied with over running the forts to the north and will attack the town. I have been [gifted with the knowledge] that may yet save this town from the Drakoran."

Kaere says, "Lord Arawn deemed me worthy to be skilled in potion making. Together with Enchanter Slone, we have developed a potion that will shield and protect the town for a while. There isn't a potion that will grant the town permanent protection - it is only through the destruction of the Drakoran that the town will be safe again. Until then I shall do everything in my power [to aid Lady Treva] in protecting her town."

Kaere says, "Lady Trevahas asked me to make this potion, as well as perform my daily tasks for her. I do not have the time to gather the necessary components for this potion and Enchanter Slone must remain here to serve those seeking enchantments. If I was to tell you what we needed, could you [get it for me]?
[Will you gather the components for Keare's spell to protect Anniogel?]

Kaere says, "Enchanter Slone has called upon his knowledge of the magic of this land and combined it with my knowledge of the dead. Together the two make a powerful protection potion. All the components for the potion [can be found] on creatures that roam this land."

Kaere says, "For Enchanter Slone's part of the potion we will need a draft of water from a lesser water elemental. It shall be the base of the potion. I shall give you a container to capture the water in when we are finished speaking. You will also need to get the tail of a giant dragon fly and then some dirt from an urchin rabblerouser. Both items will aid in forming the invisible wall to repel the Drakoran from this town. There is one more thing you will need for the potion. and that is [my ingredient].

Kaere says, "I require the glowing spirit ston of the ghosts that roam the land. By placing the spirit stone of one of Morgana's servants into the potion it shall aid to break the power she has over this land. You may aquire these four components in any order you wish, but you must bring me all four to brew the potion. Do you [need directions] to the creatures you must hunt or do you [know already] where they are?"

Kaere says, " I am pleased that you are so familiar with the creatures of this land. Here is the vial to capture the water from the lesser water elemental. If you should forget the locations of any of the creatures, come back and speak with me. Remember, you may obtain the components in any order. If you lose this vial, return to me and I shall give you another one, but do your best not to lose it! Good luck, Paladin."

Kaere says, "You have survived, Paladin. You must have courage and bravery that will serve you well. Now, I must add the items to the potion in a specific order, so listen closely to what I ask for. First I need the vial of water from the lesser water elemental."
Kaere says, "Now I must have the tail of the giant dragonfly."
Kaere says, "Please give me the dirt from the urchin rabblerouser."
Kaere says, "And now give me the flowing spirit stone."

Kaere says, "Kaere drops the stone into the potion and there is a bright flash of firey light Enchanter Slone flinches at the bright light and then nods one last time at Kaere as the potion turns clear."

Kaere says, "Paladin, you have worked so hard to help us make that potion that we shall grant you the honor of protecting the toen. Take this potion and go out into the middle of the town. The potion will glow when you reach the correct spot. Then simply use the potion and it will protect the town. If you need help [using an item] I can aid you. Return to me once you have used the potion."

Kaere says, "To use and item, drag the icon of the potion ove to your quickbar. Then type the letter of the Use item key (check your keyboard mapping to see what it is set as), then type or click the number of the hotkey where you will put the potion. This will allow you to use the item. Good luck, Paladin!"

Kaere says, "I felt the magic of the potion flowing through the town, Paladin. The potion worked perfectly and the town is protected for a while. When the potion begins to wear off I shall seek out another to help me, for you have done your duty to Anniogel and there are other people that shall need your help. But you do not walk away from here empty handed, Paladin. Enchanter Slone and I have [a gift] for you."

Kaere says, "Some of the finest craftspeople in the land worked hard to create this, Paladin, and now we present it to you. We cannot thank you enough for your service to Anniogel, Paladin. Lord Arawan and Lady Lile shall look upon you with favor for your help. Fare thee well, Paladin."
You are awarded 21,720 experience!
You are awarded 10 silver and some copper!
You have finished the Protecting Anniogel quest.
lvl 9 received 8.4k exp
Rewards:
Armsmen -- Fighter's Call Hauberk
Friar and Cleric (Shaman on Co-op Server) -- Blessed One's Leggings
Paladin, Reaver and Mercenary -- Battle-worn Vest
Wizard -- Earth's Call Staff
Scout -- Arrow's Flight Long Bow
Sorceress -- Staff of Substance
Hunter -- Agile Rogue's Jerkin -- Co-op Server
Minstrel -- Gilded Songster's Vest
Staff of the Dying -- Necromancer
Rewards:
Fighter's Call Hauberk
Blessed One's Leggings
Battle-worn Vest
Earth's Call Staff
Arrow's Flight Long Bow
Staff of Substance
Agile Rogue's Jerkin
Gilded Songster's Vest
Staff of the Dying

albion|dunan's bear tooth.Name: Dunan's Bear Tooth
albion|dunan's bear tooth.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Apprentice Dunan in Ludlow needs help in recovering his stolen beartooth. It was stolen by a bandit named Gundron McCory. Gundron is located up in the hills in the midst of a poacher camp. Found him at loc 52K,32K Gundron is up on the mountain next to the river north of Ludlow. You can see the boar painting on the hillside across the river from the top of the mountain. When you get there, Gundron may be in the camp with a couple of other npcs that will be orange or perhaps red to you at level 9. Just be patient if that's the case though; Gundron eventually makes a patrol of the bandit camp perimeter (accompanied by 1 or 2 bandits that will most likely be gray or low green to a level 9). He does not fight alone, so bring a friend. Kill him and bring back the tooth and you will be rewarded.
Rewards:
Beartooth Charm
Bear Tooth

albion|price of courage.Name: Price of Courage
albion|price of courage.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Prerequisite for this quest is the Goblin Incursion quest.

Talk to Maggie at the tavern in Ludlow. She will tell you of the troubles of young Trini Piper, whose parents were killed by Goblins at an early age. (She was raised by Jezzy Piper.) Talk to Trini, then Jezzy, and the latter will ask you to kill the three goblin servants of Grilk: a ratmaker, a footscratcher, and a bonescraper. (They con to about lvl 10, while Grilk himself is a 13.)

They can all be found just south of Tepok's Mine. It is a goblin convention there (up to a dozen conning up to lvl 13), so bring help. As you slay each of the three servants, a Goblin Head will appear in your knapsack.

Take the three heads to Commander Jusen in the tower due east of the mine. He will give you a King's Token. Take the token to Trini, who accepts it as a legacy from her parents. Talk to Jezzy Piper, who will thank you and give you 15k experience. Then talk to Maggie, who will give you your choice of one of four magic bracers.
Rewards:
Heart of the Determined
Heart of the Intellect
Heart of the Sly
Heart of the Zealot

albion|thinking cap.Name: Thinking Cap
albion|thinking cap.Source: Allakhazam quest page (current copy; notes about later patches removed)
Lines: Cranly in Snowdonia Station (actually outside near bindstone, Avalonian in plate) says that her cousin named Bouditha, is abusing a family cap and that you need to get it back from her and return it to Cranly! She can be found atop a hill across from Ludlow at Loc=50064,32175.
Reward:
Thinking Cap

albion|departed hero.Name: Departed Hero
albion|departed hero.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: You must complete the Simple Request quest first.

Lieutenant Brude has more work for you. Morgana has risen the knight Sir Gerenth back from the dead to do evil for her. She has left Sir Gerenth in the hands of druids which can be found in a cemetary in the North Black Mountains. To be more precise, to the SE of the goblin camp found near Snowdonia station.
Your task is to put Sir Gerenth to rest and bring a bone dagger back from his corpse to show that you have done as you were asked. He's at 12078 39710
When you return the bone dagger you receive Lieutenant Brude's thanks, some silver, and exp.

albion|dragon ant charm.Name: Dragon Ant Charm
albion|dragon ant charm.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Ember, in Snowdonia Station, claims she can make a new charm for you. Ember can be found at the Snowdonia Station at the back of the inn (not outside).

The catch is that she needs a dragon ant larvae to do it. Fortunately, a dragon ant queeen spawns up the hill from the path outside the station. But unfortunately, it is a rather long wait for the Queen to spawn.

From the station, the hill is to the northwest, before the goblin fort (loc=40000, 15000). Head up there and start killing ants until the queen appears and then kill her and extract the larvae. It's not the Dragon ant larva that you have to turn into Ember. Regular ant workers, soldiers, and drones drop the dragon ant larva.

The queen however will drop a spotted larva. There is a spawn of the Dragon Ant Queen in Camelot Hills as well, in the 'bandit fields', not far from the guard tower outside Fortress Sauvage. Queen cons yellow to level 10, and has a blue and or a green that fights with
her, so bring a friend. They are Northwest at loc 33k,27k. (Got her at 31000,26000 11pm (yellow 11) Which is very close to the previous given location).

There is about 3 ants that spawn at a time, the queen spawned after about 20 minutes and was even to me lvl 11 armsman. The enraged cockatrices, forest poachers and ghost miners in the area provide decent hunting grounds for groups around 10-11. The ants (even the queen) can be solo'd however, at lvl 11.
It's the spotted larva that you must turn into Ember. Bring it back to Ember and she will make you a Dragon Ant Charm.
Did not receive:
09 Armsman
09 Paladin
10 Paladin
11 Cleric
Reward:
Dragon Ant Charm

albion|intervention.Name: Intervention
albion|intervention.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to Sir Defi in Snowdonia. He will ask you to take a document to Brother Don at the Abby in the Southern Black Mountains. Brother Don will give you a small amount of experience and money along with a wax-sealed note to take back to Sir Defi. Upon receiving this note, Sir Defi will give you approximately 12 silver and decent experience.

albion|tale of druids.Name: Tale of Druids
albion|tale of druids.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: The following quest must be done before the "Stolen Spells" can be obtained. It starts with Vadri Pade, who can be found in a back
room in the Magic Shoppe in Camelot. She wants you to learn about druids in Albion.
Vadri Pade says, "Good day to you. I don't really have time to tell [the tale] again. Perhaps you could return later?"
Vadri Pade says, "You do not know of the [druid tale]?"
Vadri Pade says, "Ah well I suppose to could be persuaded to speak it one last time. Have a seat and let us begin."

Vadri Pade says, "Our story begins many generations ago. Our land was inhabited by a barbaric people and little if any order existed within Albion. Then fromt he northern shores came a strange mix calling themselves Celts. They spread through our land and suppressed the barbarians, absorbing the culture into their own. The priests of this new race were named [Druids] and they dominated in both religion and all daily deeds."

Vadri Pade says, "Yes! These priests are the very same that walk our lands once again. During the time of Arillius and Uther the push to rid our land of the Celts almost succeeded. Yet tolerance became the motive of Uther during his later years and was adopted by ARthur as well. This tolerance has unfortunately led to our current [predicament]."

Vadri Pade says, "Have you not seen the druids that are encroaching into our area? One need not walk more than half-day to encounter them. These are our lands regardless of their attachment to the [standing stones]!"

Vadri Pade says, "The druids have long practiced their pagan arts in and about these stones. I know not where the stones originated, but the druid fascination over them increases with each generation. I can only assume they believe the stones to contain some holy power. It must be this false belief that ties them to our lands. You seem [quite enthralled] by these druids. If you wish I could direct you to someone who would speak in more depth of this subject?"
Dialog box: Do you wish to learn more of the druids within Albion?
You have been given the Tale of Druids quest.

Vadri Pade says, "There is a wizard who may be able to assist you. Master Kless has studied the druids at much length and often leads students in instruction. If you travel into Cotswold you can find his within the dye shop. I must get back to my cleaning now. We sometimes have problems with pixies and they get into everything. Best of luck to you."
[Step #1] Speak to Master Kless at Cotswold. Ask him of the [druids].

See Master Kless in Cotswold and ask him of [druids]. He can be found in the last house on the right, as you leave Camelot and follow the road East through COTS. The garishly dressed Crier Pompin is standing outside, so you can't miss it.
Master Kless says, "Good day to you! A question appears to hang about your lips. What can I instruct you in?"
You say, "What of druids?"
Master Kless says, "Ah! The druids of [new and old] hold quite a bit of history my friend. I would be glad to detail a bit of it for you if you wish?"

Master Kless says, "Yes! While both still practice the basic paths taught them generations ago, it is the newest of druids that seek to reclaim that which they lost so long ago. Their hold on Salisbury and parts of the Campacorentin Forest are proof of this. Some have actually pressed into the Black Mountains seeking to claim land closer and closer to Camelot. There are many within our realm that now fight to ensure this spread will not continue. I know three thta keeps tabs upon the very movement of these druids and research their history in depth. Though I fear this will do [little to assist] us now, I am certain it will allow us to take greater action in the future."

Master Kless says, "Already we are having difficulty in stopping the druids to our north. They gain greater courage the closer they come to Camelot. Unlike the [druids of old] that held land for a generation or so before moving on, these fruids move with blazing speed. Their thirst to reclaim all that was taken from them seems never to be filled."

Master Kless says, "From what I've learned, once their priest had taken Keltoi as their primary place of learning the druidic spread all but stopped. They turned their attention to developing a culture within our lands and building places of worship. Now it seems these druids press into our realm as if on act of vengeance. Their only goal is to secure all land that was once their own regardless of the [bloodshed]."

Master Kless says, "You should witness this for yourself. To be told the deeds of these people is nothing compared to actually experiencing their wrath first hand. If you would be willing to travel into the black mountains and [slay a sacrificer] I will reward you."
Master Kless says, "That's correct! Bring me the sacrificer's dagger as well. I believe the hill they occupy is just north of the double bridge. Best of luck to thee."
[Step #2] Travel into the black mountains and slay a filidh sacrificer. Return its dagger to Master Kless at Cotswold.

2. Kless will instruct you to go to North Black Mts to slay a Filidh Sacrificer and bring back his dagger. Head overland NNE from the Twin Towers at the North end of the double bridge in So Blk Mts. The druid circle you seek is on the border between the North and South Black Mts zones. (It's the same druid circle where Harish can be found.)
3. Return to COTS and deliver the filidh's dagger to Kless. Then...
4. Speak with Sir Tilian (upstairs) in Castle Sauvage. Ask him of [druids].
5. Speak with Ornis in Swanton Keep (inside, 1st floor). (Cough up the 5 silver for a horse; it's a long run.)
6. Return to Camelot and seek out Librarian Pelan in the Academy (upstairs, on the left). Ask him of [standing stones]. He will give you a book to deliver.
7. Take the book to Master Kless in COTS and collect your reward.
Rewards:
Power Repository Ring -- Cabalist, Sorcerer, Theurgist, and Necromancer
Ring of the Sound Diminished -- Scout,Infiltrator and Minstrel
Ring of Damage Consumption -- Armsman, Paladin, and Reaver
Ring of the Holy Harvest -- Friar
Rewards:
Power Repository Ring
Ring of the Sound Diminished
Ring of Damage Consumption
Ring of the Holy Harvest

albion|cloak of shades.Name: Cloak of Shades
albion|cloak of shades.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-09-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Part 1 and 2
Steps:
1. Talk to the minstrel in Cotswold Village - her name is Laridia the Minstrel (sometimes you can start at step 2)

2. Talk to seamstress in Prydwen Keep - her name is Meran the Weaver and she is located along the back wall. She tells you she needs components for the Cloak of Shades. The components are found on a red adder,and a will o wisp; or a wild boar and a brownie nomad, both found in the plains. Also may ask to kill a black dog.

a. Kill a red adder (glowing snake skin) which are commonly found in Salisbury Plains. My best advice is to hunt for a red adder near West Downs because you will have to take a horse ride to the next step.
b. Kill a will o wisp which is located in Campocertin Forest. A good place to find these mobs is just east of Caer Ulfwych.
c. Wild Boar (Pristine Boars Hide) -- Plains; Brownie Nomad (Sinew) -- Camp Forest or Plains; and Black Dog -- West Downs.

5. After acquiring the components return them to Meran the Weaver in Prydwen Keep - a horse ride is the quickest way. She will send you to see Dyemaster Thrurin. Thrurin wanders the woods along the road that connects Camelot to Ludlow. He can be hard to find sometimes and you need to check both sides of the road. Talk to Thrurin. He also needs components - a container and some dye. The container is found on a Dryad.

6. Kill a Dryad which can be found in the North Black Mountains or Campacorentin Forest. Dryads in the North Black Mountains can be found in the woods surrounding Snowdonia Station. Return the container to Thrurin and he will tell you how he lost the dye to a thief.

6. Kill the red dwarf chief and recover the horn of drinking. He can be found in the valley below the bull carved into the hill. From Ludlow, cross the double bridge and immediately turn east (right). As long as you stay right of the hills and left of the water, you can't miss the dwarves. I avoided everyone and picked off the chief and a matron (yellow and blue to me at 11). Return the horn to Thrurin and he will tell you how he lost the dye to a thief. You may be asked to kill a Gray Warg. Gray Wargs can be found in the north black mountains directly west of snow station at loc 19637, 33996

7. Kill Aldous Wynedd, which is a named bandit found in the South Black Mountains. He is located on top of the hill to the east of Ludlow. The hill seems to be too high to climb but it is not. Aldous hangs out with several other named thief-types and attacking him will draw some attention from the others so be careful or have a group.
8. Return the dye to Thrurin and he will send you after some black rocks from a boulderling.
9. Go kill a boulderling or a Grumoz Demon in Camelot Hills and return to Thrurin.
(another variation someone was given: step 9 kill a black dog in sailsbury plains for patch of fur.)
10. Talk to Meran, give her the components and you will receive the Cloak of Shades.

(There are actually 13 steps to this damn quest. It took me forever and I'm a minstrel! If you want the item as a scout or infiltrator, take a minstrel or theurgist with you for the run buff. The quest will take at least an hour.)
Reward:
Cloak of Shades

albion|niea's missing brother.Name: Niea's Missing Brother
albion|niea's missing brother.Source: Allakhazam quest page (current copy; notes about later patches removed)
Lines: This is part I in a series of quests:

Niea, in Humberton Castle, will send you to find Gwulin, who she doesn't trust. She claims he had information about her brother's disappearance and might need coercion. She'll hand you a pack of money and bid you find Gwulin.

He looks like a bandit and roams near the road that runs from the Camelot Hills bridge to the Salisbury Plains. When you talk to him, he'll ask for money, basically. Hand him the money pouch that Niea gave you and he'll immediately attack. Found Gwulin just south of the bridge, little less then 1/2 the distance to west downs, (just so you know others in your group that run the quest with you can give the pouch to Gwulin while he is attacking the first person to do so).

After you slay him, you'll get Roan's Broken Flute. Roan is Niea's brother. Take this flute to West Downs and talk to the Stableboy, Andryn. He'll give you some experience and let you know he figured that Roan was dead. He'll then offer you another quest that will complete the quest Roan was undertaking. Turned in the flute to the stable boy and got about 14k exp being a lvl 11 armsman, I don't remember getting any $$ for it though.
The next quest is called Sir Gleran's Lost Necklace.
Notes and Locs by Shadowar:
1) To start the quest, talk to Niea at loc 20730, 40745 in Black mtns South (she is inside Castle Humberton). She will give you a pouch of money.
2) Then, you must find Gwulin who is roaming on the road between Humberton and Salisbury plains. I found him at 3 different locs:
36000, 55800 in Camelot Hills (near the stone bridge);
42800, 3500 in Salisbury plains;
39500, 125 in Salisbury plains;
Each time he was either on the road, or walking near it. Talk to him, give him the pouch of money. Gwulin will then attack you. Kill him and you will receive a flute.
3) Go talk to stable boy Andryn at loc 29070, 7900 in Salisbury plains (at West Downs). Give him the flute.
You will receive xp and another quest (if you accept). The quest is: Sir Gleran's Necklace quest.

albion|sals' jar.Name: Sals' Jar
albion|sals' jar.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-09-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to Sals Pew in Ludlow. Aldous Wynedd has stolen the jar that Sals was going to use to enter the Potters Guild. He wants it back. Aldous can be found on top of the hill North of Ludlow. Kill him and return the jar to Sals for some silver and xp.

albion|sir gleran's lost necklace.Name: Sir Gleran's Lost Necklace
albion|sir gleran's lost necklace.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-09-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: You must complete Nieas Missing Brother first.

Andryn and Niea would like you to complete the quest that Roan had undertaken. You must retrieve the necklace that Roan was to deliver, if only to clear Roans name. The necklace can be retrieved from the filidhs that inhabit a smal valley directly behind West Downs. Keep killing the filidhs until their leader shows up. The person to look for is Kedalinde Teanidd. Once you kill her and get the necklace, return it to Sir Gleran in Humberton Castle for your reward.
Notes by Shadowar:
You must do the Niea's missing brother quest before doing this one.
1) To start the quest, talk to stable boy Andryn at loc 29070, 7900 in Salisbury plains (in West Downs).
2) Go kill the Filidh's leader named Kedalinde Teanidd at loc 28200, 1860 in Salisbury plains.

Be careful, if you pull or attack Kedalinde first, there can be as much as 6 other filidhs that will attack as well. Better clean them before attaking Kedalinde. When she dies, you receive a golden necklace.
3) Give the necklace to Sir Gleran at loc 20040, 40650 in Black mtns South (he is inside Castle Humberton).
You will receive the Garnet Belt: +2 pow, +1 int. And also a quest if you accept (the Barnett's shield quest).
Reward:
Garnet Belt

albion|staff of life.Name: Staff of Life
albion|staff of life.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to Llewelyn Camber, the guy along the water south of Prydwen keep, in Camelot hills at lvl 11. He tells you to go kill a named filidh to the south. Her name is Aithne Con. She is considerably dangerous, and you should bring along a friend, she will call for hers.

To get to her, cross the river directly opposite of the quest NPC, and run south, away from the river, for about 5 seconds. Turn due east and run until you see an obscure stone ring on a hillside. She spawns there, remember, she is very close to the river, so roaming around Salisbury Plains is not necessary. Kill her for quest item (her head) and take it back to guy along the water for Staff of Life.
Reward:
Staff of Life

albion|tainted magic.Name: Tainted Magic
albion|tainted magic.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
