Lines: Talk to Maggie McClellan at the tavern in Ludlow. She will tell you of
the troubles Yasminea Darden has been having casting magic on her pet Pebbles.
However, before you can talk with her you must get Bouncer Corwin out of the

way. (Get three ales from the bartender, and he'll start crooning a love song to Yasminea.) Eventually, she will direct you to get the pouch of a Goblin Shaman from the camp near Tepok's Mine. (There are a metric buttload of goblins up there, so bring friends or be high enough level that the lookouts con black and cause less trouble.)

When you kill a Goblin Shaman, you get a Shaman's Pouch in your pack. Bring the pouch back to Ludlow Tavern, and give it to Keenar Woedin. He can't use it, but he'll find a ticket to the performance of The Great Gobzini just north of the Mine. Seems he may roam a bit: Gobzini is on the hill a little south of the mine but he was by him self and conned even to me a lvl 11 armsman.

Killing him is a bit harder to do (he should con yellow to a Lvl 13) but getting to him is much easier, as there are less goblins in the north to worry about. When he dies, you get a Magical Bag in your pack. Bring it back to Yasminea and you get 41k exp. Then talk to Corwin, and he'll sheepishly offer you one of three items: [Gloves], [Sleeves], or [Boots].

After finishing the 'Tainted Magic quest', don't forget to let Maggie know what Corwin tells you. It's a little quest that netted me a free 16,000XP on the side for nothing! ;) (/whisper Elope to Maggie and received 31,856 exp at lvl 13)
Rewards:
Boots of Legermain
Magician's Secret Gloves
Magician's Mysterious Boots
Sleeves of Prestidigation
Magician's Secret Sleeves
Magician's Secret Boots
Sleeves of Legerdemain

albion|bandit camp.Name: Bandit Camp
albion|bandit camp.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-11-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to Barkeep Dwerrav in the pub near the Guild of Shadows in Camelot. He tells you that Sir Kenley in one of the guard towers is having trouble with bandits. The guard tower happens to be right next to the pub, and Sir Kenley can be found upstairs. Sir Kenley will tell a story of a feud between Cleddyf and Cilydd Difwych, named bandits in camps east of the road to Forest Sauvage in Camelot Hills. His scouts say that a messenger is constantly running between the two camps, and you must find a way to take the messenger's place and intercept the messages.
1) Find the messenger near one of the bandits camps (there are a few) and

kill him (green at 14). Behind the tower where you turn in the bandit ears to the hunter there is a dirt hill. The Messenger wanders on that hill (right before the Dragon Ant Soldiers). Receive a "bandit tunic" and a "note to Cleddyf" Don the bandit tunic disguise and all bandits become neutral to you.
2) Deliver note to Cleddyf. He reads it and then gives you a "sealed note for Cilydd".

3) Deliver the sealed note to Sir Kenley (receive some xp). NOTE: remember to remove the bandit tunic or the guards will kill you. Sir Kenley tells you that you must take the opportunity to get rid of one of the brothers and kill Cleddyf at the meeting point.

4) Return to the camp area and wait for midnight. Cleddyf (blue at 14) will begin to move from his camp at around 11:30 or so. He will be accompanied by a Bandit Lieutenant (green at 14). There were also a couple of bandits (gray at 14) wandering around that came to help. Kill Cleddyf and receive "Cleddyf's head".
5) Deliver Cleddyf's head to Sir Kenley in Camelot. Receive xp and a reward.
Reward:
Barker

albion|guarding the stone.Name: Guarding the Stone
albion|guarding the stone.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Upon turning 12, I was told by the crier in Prydwen Keep that Sir Jerem (Also in the keep, in the bldg with the healer) needed help looking for a squire. I talked to Jerem and was given the quest to find his squire, Squire Graid.

The squire is guarding a rock in the Salisbury plains. You can follow the road from Camelot Hills to the Camp. Forest, and turn right onto the grass just before the guard tower. Or, you could simply head to the guard tower on the road by west downs and then head due south along the zone border. Either way, you eventually come to a large rock.

The loc for the rock is 5k,31k. The squire and a horse named Abagu are standing there. After a brief conversation (the squire has an annoying tendency to walk away on his patrol during the conversation, so it may take a while), he asks you to help him deal with a Ghostwalker's Apprentice and the undead that accompany him.

Usually he's wandering the plains, but if you wait long enough, he'll come to the stone bringing an undead druid and a filidh. The ghostwalker apprentice appears walking from due east towards the stone. The Apprentice was green to level 15. It appeared about midnight and once i killed the trio, they appeared again about 2 minutes later!

It's way easier waiting for him to come to the stone because Graid and Abagu can hold of the undead druid and filidh as you sprint to the back where the apprentice is casting his spells and take him out.

After you kill him, you get an apprentice pack which you give to Squire Graid. Give the pack to the squire and he'll ask you to bring it to Sir Jerem in the keep. Give the item to Sir Jerem for an item and exp.
Reward:
Apprentice Cloak

albion|information / trickery.Name: Information / Trickery
albion|information / trickery.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: General Wystan speaks about Drakoran Border Watchers. 3 of them have information and each is carrying a scroll that contains information that he wants. You must kill 3 to get each part of the message. He then says you
must kill a corpse candle to get the essence for one of the Ladies in the room with him.
~ Subpart to this quest. After speaking with General Wysten, the NPC named
Dory, at the entrance to the room, calls you over too him. He will "waves
a pouch of money" in front of you to sway you to his side. You have a choice
at this part, to take the bribe or decline. 1) To decline, you will
continue on as if nothing happened and Dory tells you to not mention his bribe to the others. 2) To accept this bribe, you being the subquest Trickery.
Trickery ~ Dory wants you to give him the scrolls, rather than to give them
to General Wysten. He will then give you another set of scrolls to give to
the General in their place.

Drakoran Border Watchers ~ Get on horse to Wearyall Village, jump at the first fort you come too (Anniogel will be on your left at the top of the hill). Head SW to the farthest fort, as you face the gate go left and continue on up towards a small batch of trees. You will see Drakoran Border watchers and other low Drakorans around them.(aprox loc=12124, 39452) Kill 3, journal updates. Head back to Anniogel to kill the Corpse Candle, directly south of Anniogel in the trees.
Information Quest Ending: Return to General Wysten in Caer Gothwaite. In

the dialogue he speaks on how you 'look nervous' and 'is there something more you want to tell me' At this point journal is updated to ask if you want to tell him that Dory tried to bribe you, or if you want to say [nothing else].
Personally, I played the good guy and ratted him out. Saw no difference in
the ending than the person that chose to say nothing else.
Trickery Quest Ending: Gave scrolls to Dory, Dory handed over fake scrolls. Give fake to General Wysten. Same thing, rat out Dory or let him slide.
Both endings receive Coin, XP, and a Token to take to Armorer Gamila

This is just to add that I did this Trickery quest and chose to be nasty and give the scrolls to Dory instead. He gave me 8 silver and I gained 15,9238 xp. When I gave the fake scrolls to the general he gave me 14 silver and I gained 63,712 xp. I'm a level 13 sorcerer. And I feel so evil =)
sodden corpse was found at location 42.7K,7.5K north of Anniogel at the base
of a hill near the shoreline.
Rewards:
Friar -- Faithful Defender Boots
Scout -- Realm Defender Boots
Armsman, Paladin, Reaver, and Mercenary-- Defender's Army Boots
Infiltrator -- Recondite Defenders Boots
Cabalist Wizard, and Sorcerer -- Avalon Defender's Boots
Necromancer -- Dark Defender's Boots
Pious Defender Boots -- Cleric
Rewards:
Faithful Defender Boots
Realm's Defender Boots
Defender's Army Boots
Recondite Defenders Boots
Avalon's Defender Boots
Dark Defender's Boots
Pious Defender Boots

albion|barnett's shield.Name: Barnett's Shield
albion|barnett's shield.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-09-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per patch 1.70:
- Barnett's Shield - The maximum level of this quest has been raised to level 25 so that players working on Bedelia's Grief can continue working on their quest.
Prerequistite quest is Sir Gleran's Lost Necklace.

Sir Glerans (Humberton) best man, Barnett, was ambushed and killed while trying to defend Sir Glerans Ladys honor. Your task is to locate both halves of Barnetts shield, as well as bringing Gleran the head of Mootang, whom is responsible for the mans death. You must get the shield halves from two boulderlings, which can be found on the mountain side near Swanton Keep. Once that is completed, you can find Mootang at the goblin camp that is also near Swanton Keep and wait for Mootang to spawn in the back left corner of the camp. Once slain, return the two shield halves and Mootangs head to Sir Gleran in the order he requests them and you will receive your reward.
*Additional information for those completing the nested quest Bedelia's Grief.

I traveled to N. Black Mountains and, aware that there were large rock trolls just south of Swanton Keep, made that my first stop. They were green to me and quickly died, yielding Barnett's shield in two pieces. Then I needed to find Mootang. I know of two goblin hangouts in N. Black Mountains. I checked the one straight east of Snowdonia Station first. There are some rocks in the back that have rolled down the mountain and allow easy access to the wall of the town in back. The goblins are apparently too lazy to keep up their wall very well. Sure enough!

Mootang was in there, and a couple of my ice creatures were enough to end his miserable life! He had the nerve to tell me that I was braver than that poor Barnett! Mootang is inside the hut nearest the back wall, and since his door faces the camp entrance, is near impossible to target.

However, I've found that if you approach the camp from the west, occasionally a goblin warrior will patrol outside the west wall. Attack him, and the nearest two goblins will come to his defense (even though they are behind the wall), one of whom is Mootang. At level 13, that means you only need fight 2 goblin warriors (green) and Mootang (blue), easy enough to solo.

I returned the shield pieces and Mootang's head to Sir Geran, who gave me a bag to return to Bedelia and rewarded me with a jagged axe... which was of no use to a Theurgist! However, good-naturedly I agreed to take the bag to Bedelia anyway. Thus ended Barnett's Shield Quest.
Notes from Shadowar:
1) Talk to Sir Gleran at loc 20040, 40650 in Black mtns South (he is inside Castle Humberton).

2) Go kill Large Boulderlings at loc 37400, 19000 in Black mtns North (it is near Snowdonia station). It has to be day, because at night the Large boulderlings change to Rock Elementals wich wont do. Kill boulderlings until you get the 2 halves of Barnett's shield.

3) Go kill Mootang inside the goblin camp at loc 18500, 26700 (another loc mentioned is Loc 19100 27700)in Black mtns North (again, near Snowdonia station). Go from behind the camp, climb on the camp's stone wall (using the boulders near it), pull Mootang or one of the goblin warriors near him, jump down from the wall and run up the slope for a bit. Wait for Mootang there.
4) Give both halves of the shield as well as Mootang's head to Sir Gleran in Castle Humberton.
Reward:
Jagged Axe

albion|growler's necklace.Name: Growler's Necklace
albion|growler's necklace.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-09-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Growling Ghost is the main quest, this is a subquest.
1. Find Cyfwich Diwych in Camelot Hills and get Growler's Neclace (far NE

corner of Camelot Hills) He's a bandit found on the road to Castle Savauge. A few bandit camps are located to the right of the road enroute there (basically past Mithra). There are three camps there, each camp has a "Diwych" at it cause they're brothers, but only one camp has the right one that you need to kill. Just make sure the name matches, his exact location is: 50043, 12549.
2. Return Neclace to Growler
3. Free his bones (slay him)
Return to Sargeant Alain to finish The Growling Ghost quest.

albion|lady judith's circlet.Name: Lady Judith's Circlet
albion|lady judith's circlet.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: You can recieve from Gaevin Sebryn or Aonghas Prirerd. Your tasks and steps may vary.
One variation:
Gaevin Sebryn tells you a story about Lady Judiths Circlet (gold with pearl) that has been stolen, but she recognized the robber. Get it back.

1. Kill bandit Cyfer Difwych in Camelot Hills. He is the one in the central camp due east of E. Camelot Gates. Blue mob at 14 and his support were greys. Obtain opal but no circlet. Loc 53k, 22k. He drops an opal.
2. Return opal to Gaevin, who tells you he has discovered who bought the gold circlet.
3. Travel to Camp. Forest to "persuade" Aonghas Prirerd to give it back. He can be found in the southeast ~loc 46800, 55500, west of Keltoi. Again blue mob at 14 with grey support mobs.
Possible alternates -------

I was told that the thief "traded" the circlet for some gems to Shale, a different colored boulderling(and he can be found on the hill to the left of the PK bridge, spawns fast too), and that I had to kill it to get the circlet back.

After I returned the Opal, I was informed to seek out: 'a demon named Fielath in the undead ruins in Camelot Hills' he is inside the broken tower next to the river (across the river from shale) and right next to where you go to kill Frip's dad!

One place he tells you to go is over by the spiders and the other place is where the manes deamons are. I got Ciraron Webweaver. When looking for Ciraron Webweaver, make sure you are at the right spider spawn location as there are 2. There is one just west of the keltoi dungeon next to the druid ring where the "Green Witch" is. There is a stone pillar where they are, and these are large bloated spiders - this is NOT where Ciraron Webweaver is. She is at the other spider spawn. It is still east of Caer Ulfwych, but farther north than the other one, and indeed is in the trees on a small hill. You will know you are at the right location, as the spiders there are just bloated spiders (not large). You may have to killed a number of these to get her to spawn, but she did after about 10 minutes for me.
4. Return to Gaevin for your reward. Cutter, a 1h thrusting weapon.
Reward:
Cutter

albion|slythcur cloak.Name: Slythcur Cloak
albion|slythcur cloak.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to Anga Weaver in Adribard's Retreat she will tell ask you to collect a pile of drake scales, and a brown drake eys from carrion drakes in salisbury plains which where green to me at 14. Next you will have to kill Slythcur a named drake which was blue to me at 14 to get Slythcur's Hide. Once you've collected all this (which has to be collected in order) return to Anga talk to her. She will ask you for
the parts in order.
Reward:
Slythcur Cloak

albion|the captured courier.Name: The Captured Courier
albion|the captured courier.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-09-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Sister Rhigwyn is on the second floor of the Church in Camelot. Shell send you out to find Dustan and help him deliver a box. Dustan was ambushed in Camelot Hills. At a Bandit Camp near the Tomb of Mithra, find Cilydd Difwych and kill him. Get the box and head to Campacorentin Forest. Here you need to run to Caer Ulfywch and location the druid grove find a named female druid who holds Dustan hostage. This is approximately the southeast corner of the forest. Kill her and talk with Dustan; Give him the key and box. Head to Aribard's Retreat and give Brother Onoloth the pendant Dustan gave you to receive your reward.
Reward:
Splitter

albion|the growling ghost.Name: The Growling Ghost
albion|the growling ghost.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Speak to the Crier of Prydwen who tells you to speak to Sgt Alain. Sgt Alain stands guard on the south side of the Camelot Hills bridge. The Sergeant is the one who starts the quest.
1. Speak with Growler (can be found a little ways up the trail as you enter
the forest on the right at night) (Note: Growler has been found on either the left or the right side of the road, at locations
2. Kill Growler or do what he asks -- "Growler's Neclace" Quest
3. Return proof of Growler being removed (his skull)
Reward:
The Growler

albion|drakoran watchers.Name: Drakoran Watchers
albion|drakoran watchers.Source: Allakhazam quest page (current copy; notes about later patches removed)
Lines: Frederik Rolby in Gothwaite Harbor says that a Drakoran scout has been spotted a little to close to Gothwaite.
He sends you to speak to Ely in Caifelle.
Ely tells you that you can find the scout East of Anniogel and Northwest of Caifelle.
The Wandering Drakoran Scout can be found around 47324, 21517. Kill him and he drops a sealed letter. Read the sealed letter (Put it in your quickbar and use it.)

The sealed letter talks about a Drakoran leader, Ariach, that has plans to attack Gothwaite. Your journal will update telling you to decide what to do next. Take the sealed letter back to Ely in Caifelle. Ely now offers you a choice. You can either let the defenders of Gothwaite handle the threat, or you can kill Ariach yourself.

Ariach can be found around 4k, 30k (Note: mentioned to be a night spawn only). Kill him and he will drop the attack plans. Take those back to Frederik Rolby in Gothwaite Harbor. I received 463,400 experience and 7 silver and some copper for completing the quest.
Rewards:
Ariach's Gloves -- Infiltrator, Minstrel and Scout
Messenger's Staff -- Thuergist
Stolen Robes of Arawn -- Necromancer
Pilfered Robes of Arawn -- Heretic
Rewards:
Ariach's Greaves
Stolen Robes of Arawn
Messenger's Staff
Ariach's Mace
Ariach's Gloves
Ariach's Purged Staff
Pilfered Robes of Arawn

albion|reaching beyond.Name: Reaching Beyond
albion|reaching beyond.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Speak to [Edith Waring] in [Avalon Marsh] and accept her quest, she gives you a ticket to [West Downs] and 50 silver.
Speak to [Larson O'Riley], located just west of [West Downs]. He sends you after two items, a feather and some roots.
The feather is off a named Basklisk, [Tuka]. He wanders the ridge across the road from [West Downs] and is around lvl 11-13.

Next go to the bridge just north of there and swim in the water at the base of the bridge until you get spammed with the text ' searches the base of the bridge'. Took me two tries before he pulled out the root.
Return to [Larson O'Riley] and give him the feather and the root, then watch him do his thing. He gives you a potion and a ticket back to the [Avalon Marsh].
Return to [Edith Waring] and give her the potion and watch her as a Inconnu appears to her and gives her a necklace. She gives it to you.
It's a lvl 14 necklace that gives +18
Hits. Exp from quest is 231,700 exp
I loved this quest to partially introduce the Shrouded Isles expansion.
-- Stephansean
The bridge you go to is Prydwen Keep/Salisbury bridge, not "just north of
where you killed Tuka" as that could be anywhere along the ridge, that runs
a long, long ways. And I didn't get anywhere near close to 200k exp, I got
45,056xp as a level 14 Friar.
Reward:
Blessed Symbol of the Spirits

albion|siom's staff.Name: Siom's Staff
albion|siom's staff.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-09-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: *Your steps and tasks may vary. Please note this is only one version.

The merchant Siom in Humberton sent me to retrieve a sack of red dust from a "Kedalinde Teanidd" and told me she was "somewhere in Salisbury Plain." Kedalinde Teanidd turned out the be the leader of the group of filidhs that spawn just behind West Downs. Once I returned the dust to Siom in Humberton, I was sent to retrieve the backbone of "Mystic Ulfwag." Mystic Ulfwag is the leader of the goblin fort northwest of Snowdonia Station in Black Mountains North. Upon returning the backbone to Siom, she made a staff for me and gave me 4 silver and some copper.
Reward:
Charred Bone Staff

albion|bedelia's grief.Name: Bedelia's Grief
albion|bedelia's grief.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Barnett's Shield is a prerequistite for this quest, please verify by posting below.

Go to Barkeeps Dwerrav or Broec in Camelot who say that Bedelia was worried about her missing son. Here you find Bedelia greiving for the loss of her son Barnett. After talking to Bedelia, you get Bedelia's Grief quest. Her son was sent on a mission and killed. She hoped to get some of his personal belongings back. She will send you to talk to Sir Gleran in Humberton Keep and she gives you a portrait to give to Sir Gleran to prove you were sent by her.

When you give the protrait to Sir Gleran, he explains that he has not had a man to spare to return the shield. He asks you to return the shield along with Barnett's sword. He told me that he wanted to return the kid's stuff, but he hadn't retrieved the shield yet. He believed it to be on some large rock trolls in N. Black Mountains. He also told me that as long as I was going that way, he would like me to kill Mootang, who was responsible for the boy's death, and return his head.
*This step is the Barnett's Shield quest. After you do that then return for the completion here. Barnett's Shield does not require Bedelia's Grief quest.
When you return the shield and sword, Bedelia explains the sword was a family heirloom. With both her husband and son gone, she will give you the sword if

you avenge her son by bringing justice to the one that ordered Mootang to goad Barnett into a fight; King Smugluk. You can find Smugluk at the goblin camp you found Mootang. So back I traveled to N. Black Mountains and the goblin camp. Another pair of my ice creatures were equal to the task and again I traveled to Camelot (by this time getting a bit saddle sore). I gave the king Smugluk's head to Bedelia and she rewarded me, alas, with Barnett's sword, a Bloody Short Sword.
Reward:
Bloody Short Sword

albion|willing sacrifice.Name: Willing Sacrifice
albion|willing sacrifice.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per live patch first week in Nov:
Willing Sacrifice - The quest reward tells the player they're going to get a belt. The rewarded object is now correctly set to a belt.
Per Patch 1.60:
- Willing Sacrifice: Players should once again be able to summon High Priest Andania with a willing sacrifice.

Hi DAoCers I finished the new Albion Quest from the Sep/2002 Patch its called Willing Sacrifice. This quest is slightly different from the normal quests in that it almost requires a cleric and a stealther of some sort. I am a Cleric (lvl 20 when I got the quest) so I just needed to get the stealther luckily a 17th lvl Infiltrator was doing the quest at the same time. (Thanks again Kely.) I have no Idea What lvl the quest is but it yeilded some mighty fine items (The
infiltrator gave it a 5/5)I personally chose the belt (needed a new one) it was a lvl 19 magic item.

Step (1) Talk to Brother Codeth. He is in the guard tower north of Prydwen Keep Bridge. He asks if you go to services regularly. If you say yes he seems pleased, and tells you about the Cult of Mithra. He also asks if you are willing to help mentioning that
someone must be willing to sacrifice them selves. He also tells you about a password the cult has and that must be discovered using stealth. He finally gives you his journal on the subject.

[Step #1] Check Brother Codeth's Journal to see what to do now. To use: After you've dragged Brother Codeth's Journal to your hotbar, press your Use Item Key and click on the journal icon in your hotbar.
Step (2) You must read his journal by putting it in a hot key and using it (default key for use is e).
Step (3) The journal tells you the first test that many cultist must undergo is given by Anilius. You
must kill him. He is in mithras West behind the room with Favonius Facilis and Virulis.
Step (3) Read the journal again and it tells you to kill Favonius Facilis and Virulis.
Step (4) Read the journal it mentions a being that might tell of the password a forgotten Being.
Step (5) You must kill Forgotten Promise. After you kill it, Promise say that he has not forgotten the the
room where the password might be located is west, then north, then west, then north.
Step (6) For this step you need to use stealth to get the password it is Heliodromus. you will be attacked
kill them and you can proceed to the next step.
Step (7) For this step you need a cleric with you to rez you. Read the journal it tell you that Acolyte

Naseita must compleat the ritual so that you may follow the slave to High Priest Andania. To complete the ceremony someone in the party must die, don't fight him just let him kill you let your cleric rez you. Then wait for the slave to spawn and then follow
it.
Step (8) The Slave leads you to the room where High Priest Andcnia Spawns. Wait for that to happen then kill him.

Lines: 0: Leutenant Kuebler (Sauvage Fortress, upstairs, north) asks you to talk
to Sir Tillian (Sauvage Fortress, upstairs, north west). I was level 19

3: Sir Tillian puts it in a box and sends you to Aiellana in Adribard's
retreat.
4: Aiellana sends you to find two standing stones of power in Forest Sauvage.

albion|lord aryon's box.Name: Lord Aryon's Box
albion|lord aryon's box.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-11-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: [Step #1] Find Halena Edulan in the tomb raider camp in Salisbury Plains.

Sister Elaydith at the Church in Camleot tells you the story of a battle between Lord Aryon or Avalaon Marsh and Morgana's evil armies. During a pitched battle, Lord Aryon was stabbed by a page with a poisoned dagger. The poison was designed not to kill Lord Aryon, but to leave him in a state of undead.

It was actually Bishop Burhoff that betrayed Lord Aryon. He had charmed the page and then he opened the gates to Morgana's armies. With his last breath, Lord Aryon cursed Bishop Burhoff to suffer the same fate as he. One of Lord Aryon's knights bravely fought his way to Bishop Burhoff and sacrificed his own life to slay Bishop Burhoff. The ghost of Bishop Burhoff still haunts the ruins of the castle in Avalon Marsh, known as Dark Bishop Burhoff.

One of the items that has been recovered from these ruins is a box that belonged to Lord Aryon that contains some important papers that were written by Lord Aryon and some even by King Arthur himself. Unfortunately the key to unlock the box was apparently stolen from Lord Aryon's grave by tomb robbers.

The key is now believed to be in the possession of a tomb robber name Halena Edulan, who can be found in the tomb robber camp in the eastern part of Salisbury Plains. Before the key can be used to unlock the box you will also have to journey to the ruins of the old castle in Avalon Marsh and get a scroll to remove the wards from the box. The scroll you get from the undead remains of Lord Aryon, now know to the locals as Dread Lord Aryon, loc: 41k, 49k.
-Halena Edulan-

Once you zone into Salisbury Plains from Camelot Hills, there will be a river on your left. Follow the river away from the road, and after the broken bridge, veer to the right (west) until you come up on the tomb raider camp. There are a few camps along the shoreline, but they are a lot easier to avoid than the random wandering Salisbury Giants and Boars, and this way you don't have to circle around the entire plains just to get to where you want to be.
-Dread Lord Aryon-

Go into Avalon Marsh from Salisbury Plains, and continue on the road past Adribard's Retreat like you were going to Caer Wintrin. When the road forks the first time in Avalaon Marsh, veer left. A little ways down the road you'll see the broken church (looks similar to the manes demons area by the Prydwen bridge), and Dread Lord Aryon will be standing inside the ruins. This is the same castle you will have to go back to for the second quest to kill Bishop Burhoff, as well.
Return both the key and scroll to the church. As a reward you are given a polearm weapon called Lifetaker.
The next quest in this series is:
Bishop Burhoff's Curse
Reward:
Lifetaker

Landon is located next to the the tower at the southwest corner of Salisbury Plains. His son is ill, and will die unless he receives his medicine. Unfortunately, a druid seer has attacked them and stolen the medicine needed.

albion|bishop burhoff's curse.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-11-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: [Note: Some may be able to obtain this quest without doing the Lord Aryon's Box quest.]
Lord Aryon's Box is the prerequisite quest and must be completed before you can get this one. Your steps and tasks may vary.
You get the quest from Brother Lensar in Camelot church and are sent to Avalon Marsh to locate Dark Bishop Burhoff (loc is 40157 47328 1732) in a church ruins with ghostly knights.

Follow the road past the avalon retreat keep going no left or right turns and you will see on the right ghost knights and a lot of them just go to the ruins at the back of the church and you will find him kill him.

You return to Camelot church and speak to Bishop Burhoff's ghost in the graveyard wait till night fall in the grave yard wait till 10pm he should pop and he will tell you that he needs you to locate a Mist Monster in Avalon Marsh (loc is 13245 16400 3073). albion|escaped bandits.Name: Escaped Bandits
albion|escaped bandits.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Speak to Guard Cynon in West Downs and he will ask you to help Guard Dafydd at the guard tower just outside Camp Forest. Dafydd tells you about several bandit prisoners who escaped from custody. He asks you to find the bandits and slay them, returning with proof.
The bandits are almost due east of the guard tower, over the first hill. The bandit leader will have a cloak which you return to Dafydd at the tower.

For anybody who may be having difficulty finding them, the escaped bandits are just south of the first druid ring you run into if you head due east from the tower where Guard Dafydd stands. Look around at loc 26000, 57000 and you should see them walking up and down the hillside south of that druid ring.
Guard Dafydd is the "merchant guard" that many of us sell our loot to when hunting in the southern portions of the plains.

By the way, these bandits drop a lot of loot -- gems, some armor, and other things of decent value as well. They respawn very quickly, and a small group or skillful soloer could do fairly well hunting them.
The reward was experience and almost 24 silver.

albion|outcast ormgarth.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Grin the crier says, "The circle of mages has complained of many murders in the dead of night. Their leader, Olorustos might have more information to tell."

Olorustos is looking for an adventurer to track down a dangerous outlaw nearby. Agree to take the quest and head to the north of town and look for Ormgarth. He is surrounded by snakes. Killing him will result in a snake charm.
Olorustos says, "Ah! Perhaps you [can help] us!"
Olorustos says, "Yes, there is an outcast member of our association known as Ormgarth who has been [causing problems]."
Oloruostos says, "He has been slipping deadly snakes into the beds of our members for weeks now. Will you help us and [stop him]?"
Dialog box: Do you accept the Outcast Ormgarth quest?
You have been given the Outcast Ormgarth quest.
Olorustos says, "Oh thank you! He was last seen not far from here. Northeast, into the woods!"
[Step #1] Find and kill Ormgarth. He has been seen Northeast from the circle of stones.

Ormgarth is located exactly NE of the stones. The stones are called Ring of Sentasil. Loc or Ormgarth: 22515, 3221 When you attack him, he and a dozen snakes will attack you. But if you kill Ormgarth before the snakes kill you, you get the charm!
Ormgarth says, "You shall not stop me from killing those who have caused me such pain!"

The first thing he asks for are a sliver of Ashen wood and eyes from Brodecia. Ashen wood can be found in Camp. Forest or in Forest Sauvage. Brodecia is found in Forest Sauvage, in the Ettin camp (NEW FRONTIERS loc=49238, 24923. This is northeast of Castle Sauvage, on the south bank of the river at the eastern edge of a grove of trees.) The Ettin camp is NE of the gates, just follow the left side of the river and you'll come right to them.

After getting those items go back to Dugan. He'll tell you he was jumped while gathering the rest of the items and a goblin named Urfgrat the Green has his carving kit. Urfgrat can be found around the goblin camp NW of Caer Ulfwych, near the ogre camp. Urfgrat was blue at 19th lvl, and had 4 or so helpers that where all grey. In Campocoretin Forest, the coordinates are:
Goblin Camp: 34,45
Ogre Camp: 24,43
Urfgrat and his two or three cronies walk through the middle of the Ogre camp every eight minutes real time, or at least that was my experience. I tracked him...
Started at 18,35. Moved E-SE
Then to 24,38
Then to 30, 40. Turned SE
Then to 35, 45. Turned E
Then to 38,45.

When I went back to turn in the carving kit, I right clicked on Dugan and he went through the whole conversation and gave me the totem without me turning in the carving kit. I tried turning in the carving kit afterwards and was told he didn't want the item.

Skull-shaped Totem

albion|uncle thulin.Name: Uncle Thulin
albion|uncle thulin.Source: Allakhazam quest page (current copy; notes about later patches removed)
Lines: Achae Smith says, "Greetings to you this fine day friend. I am Achae Smith. Over there is my daughter Aelbfeld Smith. My husband is the hard working man, but I sometimes regret coming [out here]."
Achae Smith says, "Oh, I know he meant well, thinking we could have a better life and all, that it would be less crowded than Camelot, which mind you, it is, but still..."

Achae Smith says, "I guess I'm just sad is all. You see, my uncle, Thulin, went missing just a few days ago. I think one of Cabalist Meical's automotons got him, but I have no proof. Do you not know of [Cabalist Meical]?."

Achae Smith says, "I don't know the whole story, but I can share with you what I know. Not so long ago, a great cabalist by the name of Meical came here to Devwy. No one knows his reasons for coming, but some say it was to [shun] society."

Achae Smith says, "In order to survive here, he built automated constructs of varying types and sizes. The more he was away from civilization, the more mad he went. Eventually, he lost his mind completely. That is when his creations [turned] on him."

Achae Smith says, "Oh yes. They killed him and then left their prison to roam around the hills and valleys of Devwy. They will harm anyone in their path. That is why I am [concerned] for my uncle's safety."

Achae Smith says, "My uncle left a few days ago to make a trip to Wearyall Hill to trade for some supplies we desperately needed. The caravan has not returned yet, and our guards found some pieces of [shredded clothing] in the woods a days travel from here."
Achae Smith says, "I went out exploring fir a little bit yesterday where the guards had found the shredded bits and discovered [this] as well."
Achae Smith says, "It's a chunk of metal from what I believe is a [forged servant]."

Achae Smith says, "A forged servant is a very aggressive construct of Meical's, forged from the very same metal used to make anvils. If a forged servant did take my uncle, there's no telling what they might have [done] to him!"
Achae Smith says, "Please froend, will you help me out and [search] for my uncle?"
Will you help Achae find her uncle?
You have been given the Uncle Thulin quest.
Achae Smith says, "Oh! You will! Excellent! Thank you so much! I am very worried for my Thulin's safety, and I would hope you find him alive, but if you don't, please bring his [remains] back to me."

Achae Smith says, "We can give him a proper burial through the Church of Albion if we had his remains. Oh, but I do so hope for the best. Gracien Adamson is our local scholar around here. You should speak with him about Meical's creatures."
[Step #1] Speak with Gracien Adamson about the [forged servant]. He is located in Fort Gwyntell.
Gracien Adamson says, "Yes? What can I do for you? Or are you here to waste my time?"

Gracien Adamson says, "Oh yes... I am quite familiar with that creature, well, with most of the cabalist's former servants, I must say. But what interest do you have in the forged servant? You haven't, by chance, been talking to [Achae Smith], have you?"

Gracien Adamson says, "Yes... I heard about her uncle's strange disappearance. And then her finding of that metal. It's hardly what I'd call evidence, as you can find pieces of forged servants just about everywhere. Still, if she wants me to talk with you, I see [no harm]."

Gracien Adamson says, "The forged servants are constructs made out of a dense steel, the same you'd find in an anvil. You'll sometimes hear them referred to as [anvil monsters], but I don't know how common that name is."

Gracien Adamson says, "I'm sure you know that they were made by Meical in order to serve him. Make no mistake, friend. These creatures are pure evil, a menace to us and any who come upon them. I'll tell you [what], though."

Gracien Adamson says, "I know and alchemist who could determine if a forged servant really did make off with Achae's uncle. All you need is to get that piece of metal her and then come back to me. Don't worry, I'm sure she'll give it to you."
[Step #2] Return to Achae in Fort Gwyntell and get the [metal bit] from her.
Achae Smith says, "Oh, you're back. Did you talk with Gracien? What did he have to say?"

Achae Smith says, "You need the metal bit I found? Well, alright. Gracien does know best I suppose. Here you are. I hope it helps to find my uncle! Please hurry froend! I want him home, safe and sound."
(You receive a metal bits from Achae Smith!)
[Step #3] Show the metal bit to Gracien.
Gracien Adamson says, "Yes, those do look like pieces from a forged servant, but without scribibg, it's nearly impossible to tell. Alright then, here is what you're going to do]."

Gracien Adamson says, "Take the metal bits with you to Wearyall Hill. There you will find a woman named Elyn Badam. She is a friend of mine, the alchemist I spoke of earlier. Give her this note. She should help you out after that. Good luck friend."
(You receive a Wax sealed not from Gracien Adamson!)
[Step #4] Take the note and metal bits with you to Wearyall Village. When you get there, seek out Elyn Badam and hand her the note.
Elyn Badam says, "And what might I be able to do for you today?"

Elyn Badam says, "Ah, my dear friend Gracien... I do wish he'd come here for a... visit. But, that's really not what you're here to discuss, is it? It says in this note that you have some metal bits for me to look at? Well, hand them to me."
You are awarded 520,160 experience!

Elyn Badam says, "Yes, I can discover if it was indeed the creature that took the woman's uncle. But I need for you to fetch me some ingredients in exchange for the information. Here is the [list] of what I will need."

Elyn Badam says, "First, I need a piece of bark from Brother Josef's tree. It's the large one on the hill over yonder, you can't miss it. Secondly, I need a Golden Orb from a Drakoran Mage. Lastly, I need a [pair of wings] from an apple fly."
Elyn Badam says, "I suggest you get the items sooner rather than later. The longer we wait, the harder it will be for me to garnish whatever information I can from this metal bit."
[Step #5] Search around the Wearyall Tree for a piece of its bark
( loc=17098,48616,4592 dir=266, click on the base of the tree and you will receive a Wearyall Hill Tree Bark form Wearyall Tree)
[Step #6] Find a Drakoran Mage and retrieve its Golden Orb
( Traveled to Isle of Glass, loc=4308,11317,3120 dir=95, and killed a Drakoran Mage, there a lot of them roaming near the tents there.)
[Step #7] Get a pair of apply fly wings from the apple flies near Wearyall Hill.
[Step #8] Return to Elyn in Wearyall Village when you have retrieved all the items.
Elyn Badam says, "Welcome back friend. I take it you were successful in retrieving the items I sent you after. If you were, please hand the Wearyall Tree Bark to me first."
You are awarded 520,160 experience!
Elyn Badam says, "Now, for the Drakoran Golden Orb please. This is an absolute must for my ritual."
You are awarded 520,160 experience!
Elyn Badam says, "Yes. Quite nice. And in excellent condition too. Now, for the apply fly wings. I hope they weren't too diffucult for you to obtain."
You are awarded 520,160 experience!
Elyn Badam says, "Most excellent. You have done well my friend, and I am please with what you have brought me. Now, if you will please wait, I will begin."
[Step #9] Return to Devwy and tell Achae that her uncle is [deceased].
Achae Smith says, "Welcome back ______. Were you able to find out any information?"
Achae Smith says, "Well, I suppose I should have expected that, even though I held out hope that he was alright. Could I please ask [another favor] of you?"
Achae Smith says, "Will you please find Thulin's remains for me? I would like to have a proper burial for him. It would mean so much to me if you [would fo this] for me."
Achae Smith says, "Oh thank you friend. I am indebted to you. Please return to me when you find the remains."
[Step #10] Search for Thulin's remains amongst the forged creatures. They can be found north of the border of the Dales of Devwy and Avalon Isle.

(There is really no need to travel that far, there a quite a few Forged Servants right near the road leading into Fort Gwyntell, loc=55164,40520,5068 dir=287. When you kill the Forged Servants Thulin's remains will appear in your backpack.)
[Step #11] Return Thulin's Remains to Achae Smith in Devwy.
Achae Smith says, "Oh find, did you find Thulin's remains?"

Achae Smith says, "Well, I want to thank you friend, for helping my family out in this difficult time. Atleast now I can give him a proper burial. I have little to offer you in the way of rewards, but I may have something that will benifit you better than me."

Achae Smith says, "This was Thulin's most prized possession. He gave it to me before he left on his fatal trip, telling me it was time to pass it on to another. I know I can not put it to use, perhaps you can. Here is al littler coin as well. I know it isn't much, but perhaps it will aid you in your battles. Thank you again friend. Even though these are sad times, I am strenghtened by your courage and kind heartedness. Thank you."
You are awarded 1,040,320 experience!
You receive Thulin's Worn Ring from Achae Smith!
You are awarded 5 gold and some copper!
You have finished the Uncle Thulin quest.
Reward:
Thulin's Worn Ring

albion|failing magic.Name: Failing Magic
albion|failing magic.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Lady Eilwen says, "Another spelled failed. That has been happening more
and more lately. I do not feel that my power has faded, nor do I detect it

fading in Lurlei, yet together we only successfully cast half our spells, if even that many. And when we do cast protection spells around the armies, the Drakoran magic cuts right through them! Its like we have no resistance to their magic anymore! Lurlei and I fear that someone is [increasing their power] or weakening ours."
Lady Eilwen sighs sadly.

Lady Eilwen says, "It would not surprise me if either were the case, but who is behind it? Lurlei and I have been struggling with our spells since the arrival of the Inconnu. Oh I have heard the rumors that the Inconnu are not only here to steal our souls but our magic too. I have never heard anything more ridiculous in my life! The Inconnu are here to help us defeat with Drakoran. Why would they help us face our enemies if they only wished
to destroy us? No, I believe there is [another force] at work."

Lady Eilwen says, "Morgana, Friar. Plain and simple. She has found some way to boost the Drakoran's magical skills. Unless we can find a way to counter their magic and boost our own I fear that the spells that Lurlei and I cast to aid the armies in their fight will be no better than a child's first attempt at spell casting. But I believe there is [hope for us yet]."
Lady Eilwen says, "I have been working with that Infiltrator, Dory. I know

General Wystan thinks poorly of him, but Lady Lile has taken a liking to him. Of course, that may be just to annoy General Wystan, but who knows? Anyway, Dory learned of our magical problems and came to me to discuss the problem. He's been hunting for possible solutions and now it appears that [he has found one]."
Lady Eilwen says, "He has sent a note requesting that I come speak to him
immediately, but I cannot answer his summons. Lurlei and I have a meeting

with General Wystan and Mistress Etheldreda to discuss the progress of our fight. Dory only attends these meetings sporadically, so if he is not there he will not be missed. I, on the other hand, will most definitely be missed, but the note said to come immediately. I am in a bit of a dilemma for the information is too important for me to miss. If only I had someone to [go meet with Dory]."
Dialog box:
You have been given the Failing Magic quest.

Lady Eilwen says, "Thank you, Nesie! I shall not forget this. When you meet with Dory, tell him I sent you. In the meantime I will arrange for you to be properly rewarded for helping me out this way. I am counting on you to act in my name, Nesie. Make Avalon proud of you!"
(Dory is at 43,000 X 58,000 in Caer Gothwaite.)

Dory says, "You've got some nerve, Nesie? Speaking to me after what you did? Don't try to look innocent! You got me in trouble with General Wystan and if wasn't for the intervention of Eilwen and Lurlei he'd have shipped me back to Camelot by now. You had better have a bloody good reason for bothering me."

Dory says, "Oh, so she did? She must not have realized that you were the one who got me in trouble with Wystan because I doubt she would have sent you otherwise. Let's see if you can keep your mouth shut this time if you're asked to. Now, since Eilwen sent you, I'm sure you know about [her little problem]."

Dory says, "I've been working on solving that problem for her. See, I can do good things, contrary to what Wystan believes! In my, um, profession, I have quite a few contacts. When I heard the rumors that the Inconnu were responsible for Eilwen's failing spells, I asked around and got an answer from a fine Cabalist. She assured me that the Inconnu were not responsible for Eilwen's problems. I bet you think I'm lying, but I'm not! Brishene is an Inconnu and I think she knows what she's talking about. Brishene is not one to lie, even if she is a member of the Guild of Shadows! She identified the cause as Morgana and has begun to [search for a solution]."
(remember the Information Quest? Well Dory remembers your choice, I chose to
rat him out to General Wysten again, I still see no change in the quest)

Dory says, "Since Eilwen is not here, I guess I'll have to tell you of what Brishene has found so far to help with the solution. She spent good gold getting this information, so keep your mouth closed and your ears open! Long ago, before the coming of the Drakoran, a cabalist named Meical became fed up with the war raging between the three lands. He had seen too many friends and enemies die and it pushed him over the edge of sanity. He became obsessed with creating life, not destroying it. Meical fled the mainland for the Dales of Devwy and built a hall to lock himself away [from the world]."
Dory says, "Yes, Meical did not want to have any dealings with the people of this world. Instead he set about fulfilling his obsession. Using his
magical skills, he began to create new creatures out of rope and wood and
metal. But Meical's insanity warped his magic and over time the creatures

developed the same insanity that possessed Meical. The creatures rose up and killed Meical, then spread into the surrounding area where they still roam today. But [Brishene discovered] something about those creatures."

Dory says, "The magic that animates them seems to be undimished, unlike the magic of the Avalonians. Brishene doesn't know why, but she's trying her best to find out what's going on. Since you ratted me out to Wystan before, you're going to make up for it now! Brishene thinks there's a sphere of
metal [in the creatures] that contains a bit of their magic and she wants to study it."
Dory says, "Brishene asked me to get the spheres from the forged servants
that roam around outside Meical's Hall. She wants two so she can conduct her
experiments on them. I need you to go out and get the spheres for Brishene.
Wystan is watching me closely so I can't leave the Caer to go do it myself. When you have the spheres, go to Brishene at Wearyall Village. She will be waiting for you there."
Kill 2 Forged Servants (loc 54,53), take them to Brishene in Wearyall. The servants were

just inside the Dales of Devvy (horse to Fort Gwyntell) on the right side of the road in woods slightly. As a theurgist I was told to kill 2 crafted apple gatherers to obtain 2 metal spheres. I found them just S of Fort Gwyntell.
You receive a metal sphere from the forged servant!
Go up to Fort Gwyntell, take horse back toward Wearyall Village.
Brishene says, "Greetings, Nesie. Dory sent word to me that you would be coming to see me and be bringing me the spheres that I need. Please give the
first sphere."
Brishene says, "Good, now the second one?"
Brishene says, "Thank you, Nesie. I will begin my experiments but I wish I
had [my pendant]."
Brishene says, "It is a pendant that allows me to focus my magic so that I
may use it better. Dory wanted to borrow it to show it to Eilwen but some
petty thief stole it from him before he could return it to me. I have [tracked its location] but I must begin working right away or I would go
retrieve it myself. Every minute I delay hurts Eilwen and the Avalonian
armies."
Brishene says, "Apparently the thief either traded it or lost it to the

hands of a Drakoran because I've tracked it to one of their camps. There is a Drakoran there named Barak. My sources tell me that you will find Barak in the camp that lies east from the great tree of Wearyall Hill. I must have that pendant if I am to do my research correctly. I can start without it, but it will be better with it. Return to me when you have my pendant."
Ok the journal was very precise as to where to find this mob at. Have your
resists up to par, he chain casts.
Barak says, "Dory...will...pay...for...this...give...me...back...the...pendant...."
You receive Brishene's pendant from Barak!
Barak dies!
Brishene says, "That did not take as long as I expected, Nesie. Were you
able to obtain my pendant?"

Brishene says, "I am in your debt. This will allow me to continue working with the second mechanism that you brought me. I have been able to discover that Meical imbued the spheres of each creature with magic from a source
other than what the Avalonians draw upon. It is a powerful source that
Eilwen may be able to use if we can discover a way to tap into it. I shall
continue my research and hopefully have good news for Eilwen soon. Until then, take this report to Dory so that he may know what is going on."
You receive Brishene's report from Brishene!
Now, journal updates to return to Dory
Dory says, "You took your time getting back here, Nesie. I still wonder if I
can trust you. Hopefully you weren't off reporting my every move to Wystan
again. I see you carry a scroll with you. Is that my death order or
something else?"
Dory says, "Hrmph. It appears that you did a decent job for Brishene. She
says she's learning quite a bit about those creatures of Meical's. I have
another meeting with Eilwen soon and I shall share this information with
her. I still don't like you, but Eilwen seems to. She sent over weapons that
were saved when Avalon was destroyed. You are to [choose one] that suits your needs. I hope I can trust you to continue to help Eilwen with this problem, Nesie."
Dory says, "Now listen closely, for you can only choose one and once you make your choice you can't change your mind. You may choose from one handed
[slashing], two handed [crushing], or a [thrusting] polearm a slashing [flexible] weapon, a [long bow], a [quarterstaff], or a [caster staff]?"
Dory says, "Here is your Gem Flecked Quarterstaff. Use it well, Nesie."
You are awarded 75 silver and some copper!
You are awarded 13,211,232 experience!
You have finished the Failing Magic quest.
lvl 26 received 5,767,168 exp.
Rewards:
Gem Flecked Quarterstaff
Onyx-tipped Cat o' Nine Tails
Opalescent Longsword
Lapis-Inlaid Spiked Mace
Crystal-Topped Staff
Ruby-Topped Staff
Bloodstone-topped Staff
Jade-tipped Longbow
Sapphire-topped Staff

albion|tyngyr's daughter.Name: Tyngyr's Daughter
albion|tyngyr's daughter.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This quest starts in Adribard's retreat. Talk with the Crier in the keep and he tells you to talk with Tyngyr Blade. Tyngyr is a weapons merchant in the second. He directs you south towards a ruined keep. Seems is daughter is now safely at Caer Witrin, however has lost some very sentimental items.
Run past the bridge that leads to Caer Witrin, and watch for a ruined keep on the west (right) side of the road. The ruins are in a peninsula on the SE corner of Lake Witrin.
The first item to be recovered for the daughter is being held by a Ghostly Knight. They are common here in the ruins of the keep. Knights were all green to a level 13 wizard.

The target for the bracelet differed for me and my friend. I the wizard, needed a Water Leaper to get bracelet. While my friend the Theurgist (level 11) needed a Bloody Bones. The Water Leaper was a frog that was found in the small pond across the road. The Bloody Bones are fairly common in the area.

The two items are then taken to Caer Witrin. Tyna Blade is standing between the guards and the stable NW corner of the keep. She gives you a letter to take to her father. But for some reason stays at the Caer.

The quest is completed with the returning of the letter to Tyngyr. He gives a silver and some copper for the quest. No item reward. Exp reward but not enough to move the exp bar of a level 11 character.

albion|amulet of the planes.Name: Amulet of the Planes
albion|amulet of the planes.Source: Allakhazam quest page (current copy; notes about later patches removed)
Lines: Your steps and tasks MAY vary. Below is one example.

After directed by a Crier to see Mairi Ralilden at the Lethanis Association, I rode my horse southward to see what she needed. She promised me a very powerful amulet, so I heeded her instructions, and headed off to find the Tomb Raider Lonry Aetheoc (Ring South of the Northwest Guard Tower in Salsbury Plains). His death bestows the Jet Black Chain.

Return to Mairi, but don't give the chain. She'll send you to Caer Ulfwych to see Fianya Walelden. Fianya wants an Opaque Glass Disc from Ciraron Webweaver. This is the Patience part. Webweaver can be found with Arachnaedia and the bloated spiders, she's on a very slow spawn. (I noticed that after killing bloated spiders whilst Arachnaedia was there, Webweaver finally spawned). Be careful - even if you spot her, she's seems to blend into the woods and is hard to find again - so once you have her targeted, don't click on anything else. Loc 50k, 28.5k.(Note: some have been sent to get opaque glass disk from a cliff spider in Cornwall for this step.)

Return with the disc to Fianya, she'll take the disc and then the chain and fashion an amulet for you. Return to Mairi. Mairi will take the amulet and send you out to obtain the spell scroll from Borwyr the Cursed. He can be found in Camelot Hills, northeast of the bridge where the Grumoz demons lair. Loc 49678, 52870. When he dies, you'll obtain the spell scroll. Take this back to Mairi and she'll make you pledge to her that you don't end up like Borwyr. After that, she gives you the Amulet of the Planes.

When I did the quest step 2 was completely different, instead of being told to to get the opaque glass disc from a webweaver, I was send to the Avalon Marsh to get it from a mud golem. I found one at 16k, 49k near the lake.
When returning to Fianya I received 81.920 xp (at lvl 18).
Step 3 - I got the Spellscroll of Borwyr the Cursed, he spawns in western Avalon Marsh . When returning to Mairi I again receive 81.920 xp and the necklace which is blue for lvl 18.
Reward:
Amulet of the Planes

albion|weakened bonds.Name: Weakened Bonds
albion|weakened bonds.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per Patch 1.60:
- Weakened Bonds: Players should now find that Archdruid Glasan is once again spawning.
Per Patch 1.70:
- Necromancers may use the ley crystals while in shadeform.
At the academy, Librarian Pelan gives this quest, it ends up when you kill the ArchDruid Gasan in Salisbury plains.
You may have to /whisper Gem Staff to get this quest. Also see below under helpful hints.

This is what I had to do: Pelan (2nd floor on building just north of the patio at the academy) Sends you to speak with Scout Dherin (atop the watch tower just south of Castle Sauvage)(New Frontiers he can be found inside the entrance of the tower located east of Gronyr's Farm. Approx. 39k,32k, Camelot Hills.) who in turn sends you to speak with Gral Bermorn (atop the tower in C. Ulfwych) who sends you in several errands that culminate in the final fight with Archdruid Gasan.
You visit the major circles in a clockwise manner around sals plains. The first one is the one where the large skeletons spawn at night, as you travel along the river to the broken bridge.
The minor circle I used was the one just south of west downs.

From the first major circle go west to the next one, west to the next one again, west to the next one again. north to the next one, north-eastish to the next one and then finaly southish to the next. They are very easy to spot.
Then go to stonehenge for the last step and use the darkenstone. Archdruid Glasan will spawn at a smaller circle of stones, just north of the centre of stonehenge.
There are the 7 circles listed in order that you must visit and activate the well using the ley crystal along with their respective locs.
1. Beartaine: 55k,44k
2. Midsummer: 46k,46k
3. Lughnasadu: 22k,45k
4. Mabon: 12k,45k
5. Yule: 12k,28k
6. Imblog: 54k,12k
7. Ostara: 54k,28k
To use the Darkenstone, equip it in the hot bar, then press E (or your use button) and then click on the stone. Ley stones are used in the same manner.
I received 8,322,552 xp and 60 silver and some copper besides Ley Infused Belt of ......
Useful hints:

After reading some of the posts on this site, I thought I'd try out the quest. I saw that Pelan would not give the quest to another Friar (Lv 28 Friar myself), but thought to try it anyway. I found him but he would not give me the time of day, let alone the quest. :(
However, I ended up moving closer to him and in the corner by the bookcases I got a message saying I had "Entered the Library"...on a whim I asked again and it worked!
So...if he does not give you the quest, try moving around in the area you find him in until you get the "enter library" message and hope for the best! Good luck!
Dialog from quest- submitted by: bethany

Gral Bermorn says, "Within Salisbury there exist eleven druid circles, eight major, three minor, and the axis circle where you obtained the darkenstone. Of the three minor circles, one lay in the south and two in the north. All others can be considered major including Stonehenge itself. If a darkenstone is taken into any of these circles, the holder will be made aware if it is major or minor. Each of the minor circles can be instructed to offer up a ley crystal by using the darkenstone. It will be the ley crystal that will allow you to [ switch ] the wells on."

Gral Bermorn says, "As the last rays of light fade from Salisbury, travel to each major druid ring and make use of your crystal. The crystal will be crushed in the process and will activate the ring's well. As Morgana's power has hold of the tombs below these rings, I am unsure what the mix of necromantic power and ley energy will have upon you and the circle itself. Be prepared for anything! If you find yourself without a ley crystal return to a minor circle and use the darkenstone to gain another. If you are foolish enough to lose your darkenstone, you may return to the [ axis circle ] and kill a skeleton to obtain another.

Gral Bermorn says, All seven of the wells can only be activated using darkness. If dawn arrives and you have not visited all seven you must wait till the next night to complete the ritual. When you have established the alignment of these ley lines, travel to the heart of Stonehenge and use your darkenstone for the final time. Upon the stone's destruction the bonds that tie the portal close should ignite and allow it to be [ opened from the other side ]."

Gral Bermorn says, "You must be ready for Glasan at this point. When the arch druid arrives, you will have little time to attack him, as his power will grow quickly. If you are successful in slaying him, the staff should shatter on its own. Any shards left from the battle must be returned to me! Here, take these instructions to aid you. Good luck to thee Theurgist."
Rewards:
Ley Infused Belt of Suppression
Ley Infused Belt of the Chaste
Ley Infused Belt of Vigor
Ley Infused Belt of Power

albion|supplies for lillian.Name: Supplies for Lillian
albion|supplies for lillian.Source: Allakhazam quest page (current copy; notes about later patches removed)
Lines: - Supplies for Lillian - This quest has been updated to reflect the recent monster changes in the Avalon Marsh and the minimum level has been changed to 28.
- Supplies for Lillian - The reward for this quest has been adjusted to be more appropriate to its level.

Speak to a crier (I believe it was Pimpin in Cotswold village, although I am not sure) and he told me that Beria in West Downs needed help. Licrin the crier in Prydwen Keep will also tell you of this quest.
Beria asks you to collect some supplies that her master, Lillian, needs.
First item was a lump of clay from marsh scrags in Avalon Marsh. You need to kill a named scrag, Scraek.
Next item was a brick of mud from the mud golems in Avalon Marsh.
To get to them I went followed the road around to the south . The golems are near Caer Witkin at loc 16212, 47177, 1830. The golems were yellow and blue to me at 15.
Last item was a bundle of ebony sticks from the ebony fellwoods in Campocorentin Forest.
They are just inside the forest as you leave the plains, to the left. They were yellow and blue to me at 15. Ebony fellwoods cannot be found " just inside the forest".
They are around 45k, 17k.
some were orange to me at lvl 16.
When I returned to Beria and gave her the items, she rewarded me with a Blackened Hammer (yellow to me at lvl 16). I also got some experience, but no money.
Rewards:
Blackened Hammer
Blackened Mantle

albion|the walelden's pendant.Name: The Walelden's Pendant
albion|the walelden's pendant.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-09-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This starts at huntress at Caer Ulfwych. She sends you to talk to the fletchers wife. She is making a jewelry for some noble and requires 3 items which have to be gathered in order.
- First item, Crystallized Leaper eye. Can be found in Avalon Marsh near the
bridge, blue to 18 - 20.
- Second Item : Crystallized Basilisk Eye. Can be found in Salisbury Plains,
Figure its level 16 to 20,

- 3rd item : Crystallized Eye Of daddylonglegs : Granddaddy Longlegs can be found just north of Keltoi Dungeon, Spawns around 7am, Rare spawn, blue at 21. If you can find large bloated spiders, You should be able to find him. His loc is roughly 49k, 47k

Return the first 2 items to the fletchers wife, and the Spider eye To the Fletcher -- Eiddin Walelden, and he will give you 2 items to take to Kealan at Lethanis Association. (Basilisk Skin and Leaper Skin).
Reward:
Chitin Mail

albion|long lion fang.Name: Long Lion Fang
albion|long lion fang.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Starts at 30, any class, in Camelot, with Laurenna, who is located near the
north gate.

She says she will make you a weapon if you bring her the materials. She needs a bough from an Elder Beech (Cornwall)(another possible mob she may have you kill is Hornbeam Fellwood in Forest Sauvage), bear sinew from the cave bears in Tepok's mine and a lion fang from the black lioness who is found in Camp Forest where it borders Salisbury Plains (roams between 62k 24k and 60k 25k.)
Reward is exp and a Long Lion Fang
Reward:
Long Lion Fang

albion|undead infestation.Name: Undead Infestation
albion|undead infestation.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-11-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This new quest was added in 1.60. It starts with Eafa Thatcher, who is next to the smith, in Caifelle, a small outpost in the Isle of Glass, Shrouded Isles, Albion.

I didn't keep track of the quest Journal, so I can't give you a walkthrough, but I can provide you with 2 item rewards for completing the simple quest. It requires no fighting, only lots of horse riding.

These items were given to a 41 minstrel upon completing the quest, I don't know if a different class would recieve different items, but since these are both poor minstrel items (-15 charisma!?), I suspect not.
1) Talk to Kennard Jameson (the stable master) in Caer Gothwaite about [Reabus].
2) Talk to Hanna in the kitchen in Caer Gothwaite about [Reabus].
3) Tell Meb (on the battlements) in Caer Diogel that [Reabus is missing].
4) Go back to Hannah in Caer Gothwaite and wait for Meb to get there.
5) Give a note to Toby Keeler (the stable master) in Annogiel.
6) Return to Caer Gothwaite and give Meb the hair and parchment (in that order) that Toby gave to you.
Talk to Meb, and he hands you both the cloak & necklace. Random cash & xp given along the way as well.
Rewards:
Necklace of Inner Strength
Diseased Cloak of Winter

albion|under attack.Name: Under Attack
albion|under attack.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Note and word of warning - If you turn in the commander's head first, you cannot turn in the lieutenant's heads afterwards, because turning in the commander head ends the quest and removes it from your log.
Per Read File Patch Feb. 04, 2003:
Players on the Under Attack quest will now only be able to turn in one head each from Lt. Yalris, Lt. Slor'vid and Lt. Grrar.
Quest starts with Frederik Rolby or Kimmy Glaze.

Frederik Rolby in Gothwaite Harbor talks about Drakorans attacking the forts. He sends you to speak with Kimmy Glaze in Anniogel. You are to seek out the Drakoran Commander and his Lieutenants. Commander Slor'vids and Lieutenants Grrar, Yal'ris, and Zudd can be found in the centeral of the 3 camps in the NW corner of the Isle of Glass. LOC for the camp is approx. 9095,9553. They pop right around the campfire. They appear from Midnight to 3 A.M. game time, if they are not siegeing the forts. The lieutenants will show up awhile before the commander. I found that you have to attack the lieutenants in order for the commander to show up. Yal'ris is a damaging spellcaster, Zudd is an archer, and Zudd is a healer. You really only have to kill Commander Slor'vids for the quest, but if you get the Lieutenants heads, you get a bonus. Take the Lieutenants heads to Kimmy Glaze in Anniogel.

albion|wizard's demand.Name: Wizard's Demand
albion|wizard's demand.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-11-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Yorel Anbidian in Swanton Keep is in a bit of a bind. A wizard has ordered a magical pair of gloves, but Yorel is out of the special skin he makes them from, and his supplier is missing. Unfortunately, he doesn't even know what creature the skin is from, so he sends you to Mathien in Snowdonia Station with a small scrap of skin for him to identify.

Mathien identifies it as the skin from a frog named Worry Wart which can be found at the faerie frog pond just north of Snowdonia Fortress. The skin is delicate, and you need a complete skin, so you may need to kill him more than once.
When you return a complete skin to Yorel he is so grateful that he makes a pair of leather gloves for you as well.
Reward:
Frog Rider's Riding Gloves

albion|impossible mission.Name: Impossible Mission
albion|impossible mission.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Go to the Albion Runner in Camelot (he is located near the green bit near the church and the exit from the round table area toward the guild of shadows), speak to him he and will tell you that your assistance is needed and that the journey will be difficult and long. He will tell you that you will need to investigate the disappearance of the city of Lyonesse etc.... your journey will take you past CW, you will need to tell him "Caer Witrin" and he will tell you to seek a named guard in Cornwall station staying upstairs called Edmond.
After speaking to him he will tell you what your mission is in whole then

your steps will kick in. Go kill 2 undead farmers in Lyonesse. Get on the road follow it until in Lyonesse, be careful of Lesser Telemons near standing stones, you can't miss them in Lyonesse. The road will go into the water, go to the left of the shore line and be careful of monsters in the water. Get back on the road as soon as it comes out and watch out for Telemons red at lvl 38 (cleric). To get past them use a group to take one out or run dead centre of standing stones. Once on road your safe, follow the road until there is a small puddle on your right. Next to the large expanse of water try to use the same tactic to get passed the Telemons again, be careful of Moor Liches. There should be a house in the water and a house on the top of hill (this is the pygmy goblins). Follow the shore line passed the house you then will start to encounter Shepherds and Farmers these were yellow and orange to me at 35 yellow and blue at 37 kill your 2 farmers.

Then it will say find the ruined temple and locate the guards (names I can not remember). Then follow the shore until you see another expanse of water ahead of you, follow its shore line left. On your left at this point you will see some ruins, then some guards. Walk slow toward one until a message flashes in your box and your quest step changes. Do not try to take them h2h they are hard....
Head back to Edmond in Cornwall Station... you will receive 70+ sliver and some exp. (about 5%).

The next part of the quest kicks in about a monster ambushing his men on the road side he needs you to take care of a monster Moor Bogey called Yog. Yog is located near the hill that has the entrance to the Catacombs. Leave the station and head along the road where is splits of to the left head at 45% to this road toward the catacombs there is a tree line to the left just level with the tree line you should encounter him. His exact location was 44k, 40k (also found at loc=40738 36939, 11h 6m 30s game time). He was yellow at 37 and easy to solo as other Moor Bogies. They will only add if your within range after killing him. Look in your pack nice weapon: Yog's Iron Fist, a proc weapon yellow at 35. Head back to station for another 3/5% experience and 5 silver (not sure on the silver). Quest completed fairly easy once said monsters are located.
(this quest was done with a lvl 37 cleric on the Prydwen Euro server)
Reward:
Yog's Iron Fist

albion|reports.Name: Reports
albion|reports.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-11-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Mistress Eveleen, in Caer Gothwaite, wants you to find out about the 3 reports she has not had time to finish. Once you accept the quest, you receive 3 Reports and a Ticket to Wearyall Village.
1) Woman in Black Report, "Use Item to read it"

The Woman in Black report reads, "Mistress E. - Have repeatedly witnessed a woman in black heading into an abandoned village as I watched the Drakoran. Think I saw her hide something in stable once. Always runs away when she sees me so must stay hidden until she leaves. Must hide next time - perhaps behind boat near stable? Road into Avalon Isle, north fork, along water. - Scout Ewlyn."
The Woman in Black report reads, "Scout Ewlyn killed by Drakoran. Send someone to hide by the boat and watch for this woman. Bring back item she is hiding, if found. - Eveleen"
2) Undead Report, "Use Item to Read it"
Report of Undead: We've finished checking the orchards and are working on the villages. Villager reports were correct - Morgana controls a great deal
of the undead. Those under her control carry her symbol. General Wystan has
recalled this unit to help defend our position outside of Anniogel so we

will not get to check the village southeast of the city of Avalon. It still must be checked. If you send someone from Caer Gothwaite to check it, they will find it north of the road within sight of Avalon. there are undead during the day and spirits at night, so your person should not have trouble finding some. - Lt. Sylia"
The Undead report reads, "Send someone to check if Morgana controls the
undead of this village. Some think the spirits there at night are hers too.
You must kill one of the undead or spirits there to obtain proof. - Eveleen"
3) Calikana Report, "Use Item to Read it"

The Calikana report reads, "Observed an orc acolyte approach Wearyall Village a few times, but the sanctity of the place kept driving her off. Took it upon myself to approach her and surprisingly she spoke to me. She said her name is Calikana and she knew something about the Drakoran. Going
to meet with her again soon. In case I don't return, I will be meeting with
her at the three rocks along the coast in Aldland, southwest from Wearyall
Village. - Dysa"
The Calikana report reads, "One of Dory's Infiltrators. Have not received
another report from her since. I fear the worst but still sending someone
out to the spot to look for Dysa and meet with this Calikana if possible. -
Eveleen"
We chose to do the quests in this order: Calikana report, Undead Report, and Woman in Black report, due to traveling/time etc.
Calikana Report ~ From Wearyall Village go SW. You will see rocks on the
beach in the distance. Roam around the rocks til you get the trigger that
you are close to Calikana. STOP. The large orc will fight, kill her to
update journal. Go back to Wearyall.
Undead Report ~ From Wearyall Village go North toward Avalon, go right (NE)
to a ghoest town. You must kill a spirit (night) or undead ganger
(daytime). You Receive an Apple Etched Token.
Woman in Black Report ~ From Wearyall Village take horse towards Caer

Gothwaite. JUMP OFF as soon as you enter Isle of Glass. Go north along road to the town in the distance. Search all the boats. You will see a signal ingame that you found the spot. Woman in Black & Man in Black come out and meet in stable. "You search the stable for the hidden object.You have found a bundle of papers in the chest! You receive a bundle of papers from inside the chest!

Return to Mistress Eveleen in Caer Gothwaite. Reward @ lvl 48 was 115mil xp, 2gold and Token to give to Armorer Gamilia. Token = choice of weapon, class dependant. Options for weapons are slash pole, 1h crush, 2h thrust, long bow, crush flexible weapon, quarterstaff and caster staff. No options for 1h slash or 1h thrust.
Level 34 Pally rec'vd
Changes to quest:
Calikana Report
Calikana & Drakoran Looter attack you at group of Rocks.
Cal - yellow to 35, and looter blue
A Message from Calikana - "The plan worked, attack!"
Killing them does NOT update journal.
Once all three dasks are completed, then journal is
Updated.
Received 64 Million xp, 2g and choice of weapon. Still
No 1H slash...;-(
At 33 the reward is 39.96 mil XP and 2 gp.

albion|evening the odds.Name: Evening the Odds
albion|evening the odds.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: (From Badgers on the Vault boards .)
Get the quest from Veena on the southeast corner of Inishail Islend, at the top of a hill just above the beach. (49807,49039)
1) Kill sea slimes until you get 3 vials, return those to Veena. These are all up and down the beach.
2) Kill inishail flies until you get a vial of venom, return it. There's a camp of these right next to Veena.
3) Kill a tidal mongrel for a vial of saliva, return it. Tidal mongrels are in the water about halfway between Gwyd and Inishail, loc=60k 34k Inishail Island.
