albion|fall of an emperor.Name: Fall of an Emperor
albion|fall of an emperor.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to the shield merchant, Grindan Halig, in Caer Ulfwych and he send you to talk to a guy in Cornwall Station. He is to the left when you enter the station in corner.

He sends you to Catacombs of Carvoda, where when you enter the new area (that got added awhile back), you go down the spiral stairs and talk to the Emperor that spawns for quest. He tells you to do such and such and basically kill a bunch of undead.

From there, first kill, you go back up stairs and head towards ramp, turn left before ramp and head down the passage. You will go though 2 chambers and find first kill, then head back to where you talked to Emperor. There you equip the item in your hot bar and holding down the e key and hitting the hot bar number at same time you use the item (like using a charge item) then you stay in that area and do 3 other kills and do same thing and use item in same spot then you kill the named guy at the very end of hall. Then you enter the chamber with the snakes and kill the giant undead, then to exit you leave the snake chamber and go right and you pop right out side :)
Then go to back to Cornwall Station see the one guy then to CU and pick your cape.
Text of quest...
Grindin Halig says, "Hail (your class)! Do you [have a moment]?
Grindin Halig says, "I have long sought to uncover the mystery that surrounds the resting place of a once [roman emperor]."

Grindan Halig says, "Aye! The catacombs have stood for hundreds of years, weathering those who crawl about within and the attempts to steal what riches still remain. Vagabonds I tell you! The tomb is a place of the dead and should not be disturbed by those whose hearts still beat! While I too yearn to know what lay deep within its [hidden depths], I will not desecrate the emperor's tomb."

Grindan Halig says, "I am unsure if you know of Iohannes Aldar? He is a respectable arrow merchant up at the Cornwall station. Iohannes is known for his love of adventure. Unfortunately a [grievous injury] forced him to settle and take up fletching."

Grindan Halig says, "Very serious indeed! Though killed, the greater boogey Iohannes was fighthing took his left foot. Since this time, he has asked to hear the tales of any who pass through Cornwall station. Iohannes has not only become quite the arrow merchant, but also a wealth of knowledge to anyone who would listen to [his story]."

Grindan Halig says, "I recently visited Iohannes and heard a tale that has whet my appetite ever since. It seems some adventurer stumbled upon a new room within the Catacombs of Cardova. The undead that now inhabit the tomb were different than what she had encountered before. These new legions of the emperor [could speak]!"

Grindan Halig says, "After hearing this, I researched a bit on my own within Camelot. Just two days ago I came to the realization that it may be possible to learn the true identity of the emperor that was buried within the catacombs! Alas, I do not know what effect this may have upon the tomb as a whole, as putting name to the forgotten emperor could lead to greater tomb raiding. Yet, if I could find someone who would be [willing to bear the weight] of this task and do so quietly then perhaps the tomb will remain unchanged."
Are you willing to assist Grindan and descend into the depths to learn the name of the forgotten emperor? ACCEPT

Grindan Halig says, "Ah! Very good (class name)! I think you will do nicely. I do not know how best to proceed I suggest that you speak with Iohannes Aldar at Cornwall station. Perhaps if you listen to his story and study the tomb well, you will find the key to learning the name of the emperor. Best of luck (your name)!"
[Step #1] Travel to Cornwall station and locate Iohannes Aldar. Speak to him of the [catacombs].

Iohannes Aldar says, "Ah! You must speak of the Catacombs of Cordova! What a wonderful place of adventure this is. Lately the catacombs have become of greater interest to the adventures you see about you. It seems one foolhardy wizard was casting a spell within the depths of the catacombs and destroyed a wall. This wall appears to have been built to seal up the [lower levels] of the tomb."

Iohannes Aldar says, "Not many have returned from this new area, but those who have carry with them fabulous stories. Thier stories speak of a long hall, a hall with a light at the end. Within that light exists a great and powerful undead roman general. I can only imagine what else may lay within this [new found chamber]!"

Iohannes Aldar says, "Yes! I almost forgot to mention the voices! Some spirit that inhabits the passageways about the main chamber speaks continually. This is quite odd as from what I have heard, most spirits and undead are unwilling to speak openly. I would be willing to [pay generously] to have on hand the words that are spoken of this spirit."

Iohannes Aldar says, "Oh! You are offering your services then? This is great (class name)! You must depart immediately then. Travel into the deepest parts of the Catacombs of Cardova. Travel into these newly found chambers and locate the talkative spirit. I will await you here when you have found the words it speaks. Good luck (class name)!"
[Step #2] Locate the talkative spirit within the chamber of cleansing.
The Spirit of the Emperor says, "Welcome traveler! I have been [waiting many generations] for you to finally come to this place."

The Spirit of the Emperor says, "Long ago I ruled all that you see both here and above! The people worshiped me and even Emperor Nero accepted my counsel from time to time. The fools within Rome knew nothing of the land here. If not for thier meddling, my name might be spoken by all even to this day! Now it seems some fool witch has begun to raise my fellow generals and soldiers from thier graves. I have no interest in the events that now transpire above and seek only to [end the torment] she has placed upon me."

The Spirit of the Emperor says, "Yes! To exist as an undead is to know pain, a pain so horrible it can only be silenced through a second death. Do you not realize that this is the sole reason why my men continually attack all who trespass within this tomb? Thier only hope is for a swift end to thier awakened state and a return to the [sweet darkness]."

The Spirit of the Emperor says, "This is why you have come to me (your name)! I seek to once more join my brethren in the after-life. Unfortunately the curse that keeps me in this state is intertwined with my generals. Each one must be silenced in turn and thier [focus item] offered up to me within the chamber of cleansing."

The Spirit of the Emperor says, "From Olivarius will come a scepter, from Taras a sword, from Crotus a seal, and from Amminus an amulet. Each of these focus items with the exception of the last must first be used at this spot before the next one can be obtained. When you have acquired Amminus' amulet, proceed into the crypt of the displaced soul. If the amulet is used at this location my body will be summoned from beneath the crypt. This will be your chance to bestow your gift of silence upon me. Perhaps in my death, the [curse will be broken] and all who still walk within this tomb will be put to rest."
[Step #3,4,5] Kill Olivarius, Taras, and Crotus and offer thier focus items one at a time in the chamber of cleansing.
[Step #6] Kill Amminus and offer his amulet up in the crypt of the displaced soul.
[Step #7] Kill Emperor Seleucus (text is misspelled in quest).
[Step #8] Return to Iohannes Aldar and give him the Seleucus' book of deeds.
Iohannes Aldar says, "I welcome your return (class name). How goes the search for that spirit?"
Hand in book.

Iohannes Aldar says, "Oh my! This is most remarkable! I can barely believe what it is I hold here! I do hope it wasn't too much trouble to obtain this. I have little to repay you with save my thanks and the promise that I shall tell your entire story. I think I will close my shop early today. I have much to read now. Thank you once again (your name)!"
Award at lvl 37: 60,878,593 experience.
[Step #9] Return to Grindin Halig and tell him the name of the Emperor (misspelled).
Get your reward.
Rewards:
Cloak of the Latent
Cloak of Renitency
Cloak of the Vital
Cloak of the Resolute

albion|spirits of the orchard.Name: Spirits of the Orchard
albion|spirits of the orchard.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Madilen Anglesey, who is located in the first builing as you enter the town from the East in Wearyall Village. She will send you to speak with Karayan.
Mention to Karayan that Madilen sent you and you will be given a potion for your next task.
Go to Afal Dyffryn, which is north of Wearyall, loc of 10k, 17k. Locate and kill Nalsor, FYI he is baf.
Upon Nalsor's death, Tomos spawns and you need to give him the potion that you received in the previous step.
He wants to know what to do with the potion you gave him, tell him to pour it over the seeds. After he does this, he will return to you four sets of seeds which you need for the next step.
Each seed set belongs to a particular spirit and you need to locate and return the seeds to the correct orchard.

When you happen upon the correct orchard, the seeds will begin to glow with a ghostly green light for so and so spirit. When this happens, drop the seeds on the ground and continue to the next until you have done all four sets. Undead Apple Harvesters are in this area and will attack, so be ready.
After the seed task is fulfilled, you receive Tomos' Pouch of Apple Seeds.
Must give the bag of apples back to Karayan, he will then send you back
to Madilen for reward and more xp.
The reward I got from this quest was automatically chosen for my Level 36 Reaver. I also got about 99 million XP for the completion of the quest.
I completed it on my own as a level 44 Paladin on
UK Excalibur v1.57 with no problems. Most creatures con green or blue,
many add but are no problem. Also grays were aggressive!
For a reward I got:
207,540,645 experience (0.2 bubs)
2 gold + some silver
Arwrweision Arms (plate)

albion|black plague.Name: Black Plague
albion|black plague.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-11-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Quest begins with Sister Elaydith in Camelot, the dialog below picks up right before the acceptance of the quest:

Sister Elaydith says, "About sever days ago, one of the city guards became suddenly ill during the night and I was called to her bedside. The guard was crying and in severe pain. She said that her back felt like it was on fire. I rolled her on her side to look at her back and the smell of [rotthing flesh] filled the air."

Sister Elaydith says, "Her back was covered with black small oozing sores. I applied a salve to her back and hoped that would be the end of it. I could not have been more wrong. Two days later, she died. Since her death, eight more people have grown ill and two have died. If this plague continues, everyone in the city will be sick and dying in a matter of weeks. We have to stop it before it's too late. Will you help me ______?"
You have been given the Black plague quest.

Sister Elaydith says, "Good. I will need all the help I can get. I would like you to go meet with Berenger Brenner. He is the guardian of one of the latest people to show signs of the disease. I would like you to try and discover anything you can about the strange illness. I will try to make another potion to cure it while you are gone. May the light of Camelot shine upon you, ______."
Berenger Brennan says, "Greetings, noble one. You must have been sent by [Sister Elaydith]."
Berenger Brennan says, "Very well. I am watching over [Gaevin] ensuring sure he is well enough to tend to his duties."

Berenger Brennan says, "Aye. He has been feeling ill lately, yet he refuses to rest. I keep telling him that he needs to drink water and sleep. He is as stubborn as a mule and has never listened a day in his life. Every time I tell him to go rest, he just says I should mind my own business. He is in a lot of [pain] and I think he wants to see his brother, Keener, for something."

Berenger Brennan says, "Well I know you didn't come all this way just to chat with me. You should go speak with Gaevin now, while he is in a good mood. He normally doesn't chat much with strangers, especially ones with questions prying about his health."
Gaevin Sebryn says, "What are ye looking at?"
Gaevin Sebryn says, "Didn't your sire ever teach you not to stare?"

Gaevin Sebryn says, "Anyway, it's not important. I told the clerics everything I know about how I became sick. I went to bed one night feeling fine and I awoke the next morning with my back feeling like I had slept on a bed of hot coals. I haven't left the city in the past few weeks and I haven't been around sick people, at least none that looked [sick]."

Gaevin Sebryn says, "I have heard rumors spreading around the city about people falling ill, but the guards are keeping a tight lip if you ask them what is happening. I think the king is trying to keep this sickness a secret so people don't panic. Can I tell you my own [secret]?"

Gaevin Sebryn says, "I am really scared, ______. I am putting a brave face on so that the city guard, Berenger, doesn't lock me up. I don't think I will live to see the next full moon. Can you do me a [favor], ______?'

Gaevin Sebryn says, "I need a message delivered to my hometown so they know what is going on. If I die, I don't want them to think I left home because of them. I just needed to get out and see the world, [understand]?"

Gaevin Sebryn says, "I am sure you do. You seem the adventurous sort yourself. Now take this sealed letter to my brother, Keener, in Ludlow. He will make sure my parents get it. Tell him not to worry about me. He will know something is wrong when he gets my letter because I haven't tried to wrote to my parents in years. [Hopefully], the cleric will find a cure before you return."
Gaevin Sebryn says, "If not, I may not be hear to learn of any news you bring back. Now get out of here! I am tired of looking at your ugly mug."
(You receive a Sealed Letter for Keener from Gaevin Sebryn.)
Keener Woedin says, "This is a letter from Gaevin! I haven't heard from him in years. I hope nothing is wrong."
Keener Woedin reads the letter and lets out a shocked gasp.
Keener Woedin says, "Oh my! I can't believe this. Gaevin has come down with some sort of plague or something. He can't die! I must tell my parents immediately."
Keener Woedin scribbles down a note on a piece of paper.
Keener Woedin says, "Please do me this one [favor], ______."

Keener Woedin says, "Go back to Camelot and give this note to Gaevin. I realize that it must be quite the journey for you and you are not a messenger, but I must insist that you help me get that [message] to my brother."
You receive a Note for Gaevin from Keener Woedin!.

Keener Woedin says, "Gaevin may die before he finds out my parents don't hate him for leaving Ludlow. That is why it is so important to me to have him get my message. I have a few gold coins if you need them. Do you [need them] or [not]?"
You are awarded 13,836,044 experience!
Keener Woedin says, "Thank you, ______. I will put the coin to good use. It will help pay for my parents to travel to [Camelot City]."
Keener Woedin says, "Aye, you must get going. Thank you so much, ______. You shall be blessed for your deeds this day."
Gaevin Sebryn says, "Thank you for bringing me this note. I am glad my parents know I am sick, but I am not sure I remember your name, (Class). I haven't been [feeling] well lately at all."
You are awarded 6,918,022 experience!
Gaevin Sebryn says, "I can't lie down to sleep anymore. It causes so much pain if I touch the sores. I am getting sicker and I am so scared. A [strange man] came to visit me while you were gone."
Gaevin Sebryn says, "He was dressed in long robes and said he was Marquis Sabonach. That man did not look like a noble at all. He whispered some strange words in my ear and said I would be [ok]."

Gaevin Sebryn says, "He lied. I even feel worse than yesterday. My body hurts too much for me to try lying down again. I don't know what I am going to do. I hope the Healer has a cure for me soon. Could you ask Berenger if he has heard anything yet? I know Berenger thiks I have lost my mind but I am fooling him. Tehe haha."

Berenger Brennan says, "Welcome back, ______. It was truly good of you to bring that letter for poor Gaevin. I fear his sickness is starting to overcome him. He has been talking about a strange man coming to see him and babbling stuff about [demons]."

Berenger Brennan says, "He tried to cut me in half with a sword until I pinned him against the wall. I felt so bad because I know the sores on his back hurt so much, but it was the only way to keep him from [killing me]."

Berenger Brennan says, "I have heard stories of other sick people killing Clerics because they were so sick they thought the Cleric was a demon. You need to go back to Sister Elaydith that Gaevin's time is near. I don't think he will live much longer without a cure."
Berenger Brennan says, "Hmm, my back itches. You should get going, _______."

Sister Elaydith says, "Praise the Church, you have returned! There have been more people coming down with the plague. Luckly, I have found a way to figure out who is [sick] and who isn't. This potion gives me the ability to see who is sick. I was just about to drink some more before you came in."
Sister Elaydith says, "Oh no! You have the early markings of the disease. We have to get you a potion to keep you healthy while we find a [cure]."

Sister Elaydith says, "There is only one thing that seems to do any good and I have run out of it. I need you to quickly go into Dartmoor and find a creature called a Dartmoor Pony. I need you to bring me the horse fungus that comes from that creature so I can use it to cast a special cure spell on you. Go quickly before you start showing signs of the illness."
Go to Dartmoor and kill a Dartmoor Pony for the horse fungus once you have accoplished this return to Sister Elaydith.
Sister Elaydith says, " You are very lucky, _______. I could see the sickness growing in your body while you were standing there."
Sister Elaydith says, "At least you are well for now. We need to do something about Gaevin. I forgot to ask. Did you find out anything [new] from him?"
Sister Elaydith says, "Ah, he mention the [Marquis Sabonach]?"
Sister Elaydith says, "This is not the first time I have heard that name. Others have whispered it to me. I have [learned] where it comes from."

Sister Elaydith says, "Sabonach is the name of a demon that lives in an underground fortress called Darkness Falls. Legends say that the Marquis lives in the darkest depths of that hellish place. The entrance can be found in our relic keeps, but the mythical gate only opens when our forces have conqured more lands than the other realms. Otherwise, the entrance remains closed. There are rumors of another gateway very close to Camelot City, which may be used in a suprise attack against us. That place is pure evil, ______, but I fear you will need to go there and find a [cure] for the disease."
Sister Elaydith says, "It seems many things have been amiss here in Camelot. An [ambassador] named Mannam has brought word of an evil plot to destroy all of [Albion]."

Sister Elaydith says, "He informed the king that Sir Bors is planning some sort of an assassination against the Crown. He also said that the demon named Marquis [Sabonach] was spreading the disease that is afflicting Camelot City"

Sister Elaydith says, "I did some research of my own and found the name of another creature in Darkness Falls that may hold the cure. There is a creature called Malroch. He is said to be the cook of Darkness Falls. He cooks up recipes made from the fruit of immortality. If you could bring me just one of his sealed wondrous potions, I am sure I could come up with a cure for the [disease]. You could keep any extra potions you find for yourself."

Sister Elaydith says, "He might be our only chance, ______, If not, I am sure that Camelot City will soon fall to this horrible disease and after that, all of Albion. You must find the way into Darkness Falls before it is too late."
Go into Darkness Falls and kill Malroch the Cook, once you have accoplished this return to Sister Elaydith.
Sister Elaydith says, "You have returned and not a moment too soon. Do you have the Stoppered Wondrous Potion?"
Sister Elaydith says, "Thank you, ______. You have saved all of Albion from this disease! Hopefully, you will never need to go into that [hellish] place ever again."

Sister Elaydith says, "This one potion should be more than enough. You can keep the other potion for yourself. It's a very powerful potion, so use it when in dire straights. I must begin to cure the other stricken people. You have earned a friend for life, ______. I shall remember your name if I am ever in need of help again."
You are awarded 13,836,044 experience!
You have finished the Black plague quest.
Reward:
Unstoppered Wondrous Potion (Alb)

albion|zombies, ghosts, and necromancers.Name: Zombies, Ghosts, and Necromancers
albion|zombies, ghosts, and necromancers.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-11-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per Patch 1.61b:
- Zombies, ghosts and necromancers, step 8. Berzerkers on Gaheris that couldn't turn in the rod can now do so.
Step 1) To begin the quest speak to either Bartholomew Swett OR Juliana Grym in Avalonian Apparition house on the right near Ft. Gwyntell
step 2) Next, talk to Avice Swett who's standing next to Eabae Dale
Step 3) Eabae then sends you to kill one of the Avalonian Apparations which surround the ghost house.
step 4) After killing the apparation, talk to the Priest of Arawn in Ft. Gwyntell You'll be awarded 40,164,891 exp (lvl 44)
step 5) The Priest of Arawn tells you to go talk to Avice Swett and tell her to [Take the rod]
step 6) Go back to the apparition houses and give Avice the rod. After you hand her the rod she tells you to go kill a drakoran necromancer's apprentice.
step 7) Kill the drakoran necromancer's apprentice (found across the wooden bridge from the Ft.) loc 27k, 26k (Dales of Devwy)
step 8) Bring the apprecentice's rod of necromancy to Avice
After handing Avice the rod I was awarded 542,226,039 exp and a cloak.
Note:
This quest also can be started in other house, but DONT start there,
I got very crappy items (af88 plate, +54 hit points). I did it afterwards
with my scout, and also got cloak with somewhat different stats (worse in my opinion)
Text from the quest:

Juliana Grym says, "Armswoman, is something wrong? I feel like something has been wrong for some time. I talk to the Swett's, and they say the same thing. Funny. I haven't talked to them in such a long time, and they are only next door. Do you [understand]?"

Juliana Grym says, "About the feeling I have, that our peace is disturbed. Sometimes, I feel like I shouldn't be here at all. But there is more. Sometimes I sense strange beings that I can't quite make out. I sense them in the house. They make me [angry]."

Juliana Grym says, "Yes. Unsettled, angry. I try to keep my calm, but they are a constant pressure. And things are already so confusing! For instance, why hasn't Lucia gone to market? She should have gone to [market], yet she hasn't gone in so long.
Juliana Grym says, "Well. She can't remember when she went. Neither can any of us. But it couldn't have been long ago. Things are [strange], Armswoman. Will you help us?'
You have been given the Zombies, ghosts and necromancers quest.
Juliana Grym says, "Oh! Thank you! I hope you can help us! Try talking to Everard. Lucia only mumbles about going to the market. I think she is more affected by this than the rest of us."
[Step #2] Speak to Everard Grym about the strange things going on.
Everard Grym says, "What? I'm a bit [bothered] right now."

Everard Grym says, "Anxious. Angry. Annoyed. What not. What do you want? Oh. Juliana sent you.Didn't she.Fine. You are here. Have you seen anything strange? Odd? Different? We all feel different. Have you seen strange [presences]?"

Everard Grym says, "Aye.Can you? Can't you? Well. Stick around. They come. They always do. I know not what they are. There was a holy man. Father Staverly. He stayed on the hill. He came to us often. Seek him out. Ask him what to do about the Grym family! Tell him the presences disturb us. I think he now stays at Fort Gwyntell, beyond the hill behind our homes."
[Step #3] Find Father Staverly, and speak to him. Thell him the [presences disturb the Gryms]. He is in Fort Gwyntell, over the hill behind the Grym house.

Father Staverly says, "Presences disturb them? In their house? Do they not realize they are dead? Aye, but in these times, that would not be such an odd thing, would it? There are only two [forces] that work with the dead."

Father Staverly says, "Those of Morgana, wicked sorceress and mistress of dragons; and those of Arawan, the dark lord of the underworld. Since Arawn's forces broke the boundries between the mortal and immortal to aid us against Morgana, I can only think it must be Morgana's doing, perhaps one of her minions. The only way to undo the workings of necromancers these days seem to be by accepting the aid of other [necromancers]."

Father Staverly says, "Seek out a drakoran mystic. They wear charms of some sort, we call them charms of the dead. Bring these charms to the priest of Arawan at Fort Gwyntell in exchange for a sword, a dark sword of Arawan. Give this to Warin. He was once a great Paladin."
[Step #4] Hunt a drakoran mystic. Bring the charms of the dead they wear to the Priest of Arawan at Fort Gwyntell.
(Killed a drakoran mystic loc aprox 45,58)
[Step #5] Trade the item found on the drakoran to the Priest of Arawan for dark sword enchanted againt Morgana's Magic.
Priest of Arawn says, " Armswoman, what brings you out here, to this remote land?"

Priest of Arawn says, " Ah! This is a charm used by the drakoran mystics! We've been trying to acquire them, to try and find weaknesses in their magic. They are trying to use dark magics they don't understand, but we do. We ar hoping we can use their ignorance against them. Here, for that, I shall give you this, it is a sword forged in the realm of the dead, in the forges of Arawan. I know a bit about the workings of this world, and even more of the other. I know that there is someone who needs this sword. Be sure it gets to him."
You are awarded 192,719,608 experience!
[Step #6] Give the sword to Warin, one a paladin of the church.

Warin Grym says, "Fare well, friend, now is not the time to visit us. Many strange things have been going on here, things I can not understand. I fear we are being attacked by forces of great evil, even in our death? Else why are we not at rest?"
(Handed Warin the dark sword of Arawan.)

Warin Grym says, "Armswoman, I know what this is. It's the dark sword of Arawan. Forged in the fires of the realm of the dead. Forged in dark magics by evil workers of the necromantic arts. To wield this sword is to cut loose the thread that separated us from this world, and brings us to the dark lands of Arawan. I fear though, if we do not do this, then a more dire fate awaits us as enslaved minions of Morgana and her drakoran followers. As such we would never be free to rest. I must believe that Arawan's realm at least would offer some sanction. I will wield this dark sword, and lose myself to Arawan. I may need your help, Armswoman."
[Step #7]Help Warin defeat the apprentice.
Warin Grym says, "Die, foul creature of Morgana's! I summon thee to thine death! Kill him when he appears Armswoman! I have summoned him for you! Speak to me when he is dead!"
[Step #8]Go back to Warin Grym for your reward.
You are awarded 542,226,039 experience!
You are awarded 40 silver and some copper!
You have finished the Zombies, Ghosts, and Necromancers quest.
You receive Warin Grym's Special Plate from Warin Grym!

Hooded Blades Cloak
Hooded Magic Cloak
Hooded Shadow Cloak
Hooded Pious Cloak
Warin Grym's Special Plate
Grym's Great Robes
Grym's Great Jerkin
Grym's Great Gored Vest

albion|secret orders.Name: Secret Orders
albion|secret orders.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: lvl 41 quest with an excellent story
starts in Swanton Keep (thats the keep south of Snowdonia) Your steps MAY vary.
Talk to Heather Barclay to start it she will start you with some story and ask you to go and speak to the Librarian Ophus in the Academy in Camelot.

The librarian will give you some information to take back to Heather. I think you do this trip once more at which time Heather then asks you to go take care of a necromancer in Salisbury Plains near the Barrows.

The necromancer, Celain Elrich, is located just on the outer stone rings of the barrows NE side he is a lvl 40 (yellow) and he has a Zombie Lieutenant (green), if left long enough he will raise more undead and they will add if you attack him near them.

I finally located CELAIN ELRICH by the SE Stone. Or if you come out of Barrows turn slightly to your RIGHT & there's a stone on the outers borders. The exact location of the stone is 37929-39336-2187 She conned Green to me at Lvl 46. So did the zombie.

After killing him it says to go back and see Heather. You have an item in your pack and a phrase to say, she then sends you to tell it to the Librarian Ophus. He then sends you to Ludlow to speak to a mage called Graham Mal'Toinia in the Inn. He thickens the plot and sends you to Heather with very interesting news.

Heather, being cunning, doubts his story and thinks the information is wrong and sends you back to Graham to question his story. He does not deny it so you start the annoying journey again back to Heather and she thanks you for your effort and gives you the first gift: a Ring of Secret Intentions.
Step 8 for a cleric

After I talked to Graham and went to see Heather, she sent me off find Tobias Warcry in Snowdonia (approx loc= 20k,44k...New Frontiers loc=53807, 41776) and get a journal from him. He is in the camp just straight out from Snowdonia Fortress that is label empty camp on some maps. There are cyclops in and near the camp, but I found him wandering outside the camp...bonus was I found Grunge there and completed that quest as well.

Then says that there is a hunter in Lynn Barfog who has need of our services. The hunter is located NE of the merchants building. The easy way to find her is follow the road until the merchant house is in sight and turn right as if heading to the church, she is in the tree line and likes to wonder toward the water.

Talk to Cab'ah Bint Tabat and she will ask you to kill a long dead creature that has risen from the dead, a ghost dragon. The Llyn Cythraul is located in the water se of the merchant building in-between the alfanc hatchlings and the keep. Its yellow to me at 42. 28K 38K
After killing it you need to go see Heather - more story and another gift: Medallion of Albion

She says that another necromancer, Melechan, has been sighted but in Odin's Gate. So off you go on this journey on the way past the Snowdona Station. Best bet is to bind there, it saves you a long journey. As soon as you port, as long as no mids/hibs try to kill you, its easy head up to the amg. Once through the gates turn left in the tree line walk that way till you come up to a bandit camp (the treeline disappears). New Frontiers loc=26204, 45159 Odin's Gate.

The necromancer is in the middle of the camp some of the bandits might agro all of whom are green and the odd blue the necro is yellow but he will keep casting until hes dead. He drops a Veiled Bracer of Eyes.
Head back to Heather in 2 ways: 1) the long way same way you came; or 2) go and have some RvR fun die and re-appear near Swanton Keep :)

Heather will then send you on one more journey (you will start to hate this woman). In the Pennine Mountains, there is some Arawn Commander that will be neutral to you. Located NE of Caer Sursbrook, on top of a hill. He will ask you a riddle KNOWLEDGE or POWER
(no answer is wrong unless you want the final item to be of lesser quality). Knowledge is the better answer!

Then go to Heather once more, this time there is light at end of the tunnel and as soon as you pass the final message on to her, she thanks you by giving you experience and some money (6.5 GP) and the final item which is class
specific.
Rewards:
Ring of Secret Intentions
Medallion of Albion
Veiled Bracer of Eyes

Splendid Boots of Glory -- Paladin and Armsmen
Splendid Boots of Honor -- Scout
Splendid Boots of Blessing -- Cleric and Mercenary, Minstrel, and Reaver
Splendid Boots of Pilgrimage -- Friar and Infiltrator

albion|voices of the dead.Name: Voices of the Dead
albion|voices of the dead.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per Read File Fix Jan 02, 2002:
Voices of the Dead - Players should no longer find themselves getting stuck when choosing a reward for this quest.
Per Patch 1.60:
- We have fixed a small issue where Kelsanor could be enticed to leave his area. Now, he will no longer leave his area.
AND
For Co-op:
- Valewalkers and Animists should now be able to complete the Albion quest, Voices of the Dead.
Marden, in Wearyall Village, speaks of the voices he hears and how he is too weak to stop them. He will ask you to help him. He then sends you to speak to Karayan.
Karayan has a gift for you from Arawn, but Arawn requires you to get him a
spirit. Karayan sends you to kill a Decayed Marshman (northish of city,
journal is very much correct and precise in directions for a change)
Kill Decaying Marshman, take the item back to Karayan. Karayan will tell you

your next task, which is to kill Kelsanor. In addition to telling you to kill Kelsanor, Karayan will also give you an item to aid your cause: Arawn's Gift, lvl 42, health regen: value 132, Duration: 30 secs, Cast time 3.0 Secs, power cost 44
Kelsanor is to the east, go past the lone tree on hill to the next set of
ruins. Most of the mobs in the old ruins con green to gray @ lvl 50, so
approach with caution. He is a caster, will disease, dot, nuke etc. At very
low life, he will warp whoever to another part of the hill away from him.
(be prepared for this, I missed the text the first time I did the quest,
actually caught it the second and was more prepared)

Kelansor is really hard to kill. You have to be close to hit to hit him with melee or a spell. At low health he will also port you way the heck away from him. I started it at 42, got my butt kicked by him and then came back with a 50 Reaver at 45 and killed him. Easy way to do it is make sure you get a DoT of some form on him when he gets to low health so that you can kill him if he ports you out.

Take the Essence back to Karayan in Wearyall. Reward was 2bil xp at lvl 48, 10 gold and choice of items. It is NOT class specific. Chose carefully, all types are covered, 2h weapons, Longbow, Shield, Staves, Crushing Weapons, etc. Some of the wording of this quest is off and I had to speak to a CSR to get the proper reward. It has been noted as being 'bugged'
Chosing Longbow: Carved Bone Pin, Longbow 6, Dex 6, Cold 2%, Hits 6, lvl 44
item.
For Friar~~~~ Chose Focus Staves ~~~~ Yes, I know, it sounds very weird and
up to this point only associated with pure casters. Hence why I appealed the
item I chose and wanted to know correct for our class. You will get a choice
of Rejuvenation or Enhancement.
Rejuvenation: Sanative Staff, dps 15.9, spd 4.7, Power 8, hits 15, body 2%,
Focus Bonus: Rejuvenation 44 lvls.
THIS REWARD IS BUGGED. The CSR tested the Focus on the staff, it DOES NOT
work. Casting heals with and without the staff in hand, there was NO
variation. CSR sent it up to the Quest area to be fixed, I asked if I would
receive word or a different item if it was altered, all he could say was
watch for patch notes.
Caster Focus staves are all:
44 levels of focus in your skill
15 hits
2% body
9 power
14.3 DPS
43 Minstril did not receive
Rewards:
Sanative Staff
Toe Bone Belt (Alb)
Staff of the Wrathful
Telluric Staff
Woven Bone Sash
Motriferous Staff
Bleached Bone Earring
Carved Bone Bracer
Somatic Staff
Carved Bone Bracelet

Corporeal Staff

albion|prelude to war.Name: Prelude to War
albion|prelude to war.Source: Allakhazam quest page (current copy; notes about later patches removed)
Lines: This is a high level quest that may require a person to be level 46 to get the "reward drop". It starts by talking to to Master Kless in Cotswold. He gives you a note to take to Lt. Kuebler in Castle Sauvage.

Lt. Kuebler is agitated but sends you to kill Boggarts to learn something from them. The directions are that the SW of Caer Erasleigh but I was able to find and kill one between Caer Berkstead and Caer Sursbrooke. Boggarts were orange and red to my lvl 46 friar but I was able to solo an orange one with a bit of work. When you have killed enough of them, only took one for me, you will get runed metal bars in you inventory.
As per Lt. Kuebler's instructions, you take the runed metal bars to Sage Lissa in the tower southeast of Ludlow. She gives you some information then sends you back to Lt. Kuebler at Castle Sauvage.
Lt. Kuebler gives you new orders to wipe out an Ellyll village in the Pennine Mountains, but you need to see a scout first. Albion Scout can be found on 19k,4k (19053, 4206) Pennine Mts.

The scout gives you instructions to destroy the Ellyll village just over the next hill(loc=53393,55535). This is a small village with 1-2 guards and maybe 4 villagers. If you are putting together a small party to help you out with this part, be sure to let them know that this isn't the main Ellyll camp that contains Ellyll Champions. That would take a much tougher party to accomplish.

Once you have wiped out the village, go back to the scout and he will tell you where Saffron the named cockatrice lives. The instructions are for a valley southeast of Caer Sursbrooke that has lots of cockatrices and Twylith Teg Rangers. Be careful of the rangers because they can have a high agro range. The approximate locations coordinates of Saffron is in the small clum of trees at 40K 39K she is very small. Upon killing Saffron, you will get a one time drop that is dependant on class. From my experience, friars will get the Frozen Leather Helm while Clerics get the Frozen Stone Helm (chain helm with +4 smite). A Paladin also got the Frozen Stone Helm so I'm not sure if any other classes will get the one time drop.
Return to Lt. Kuebler after killing Saffron and he will congratulate you and give you experience. If I remember correctly, the exp reward is about 186 million.
A different version:
First, I got the quest by talking to Lt. Kuebler, so it appears you can start it different ways.

I had to kill a cliff crawler to get the runed metal bars. I also got some exp here, I think it was the 168M.These spiders are East of Berkstead, on the way to Boldiam. They were yellow and orange to me, so they were a bit easier to solo than the boggarts.
The next 2 steps were the same.I killed 3 ellyl villagers, not the whole camp. They were yellow to me, and the 3 came as a group. I was in a group of 5 of us at the time.
And, then we got Saffron.
Saffron gave me a Frozen Quilted Cap and then Lt. Kuebler gave me 168,629,657 exp.

Lvl 48 Smiting Cleric. I handed in the rune Metal Bars I got approx. 225 mill. for EXP. Went to Ellyll camp & had to kill about 5-6 elves & then on bottom it said taht "Camp Was Wiped Out". Then went to kill SAFFRON, (She is in the small clum of trees at 40K 39K she is very small) very low orange to me at Lvl 48 Very easy kill. Eventually went back to Lt. Kuebler & got 244,758,976 EXP pts
lvl 50 received 293,601,280 experience.
champion experience gained 154.
Rewards:
Frozen Stone Helm
Frozen Leather Helm
Frozen Boned Helm
Frozen Quilted Cap
Frosted Plate Helm
Icebound Quilted Cap

albion|malignant creatures.Name: Malignant Creatures
albion|malignant creatures.Source: Allakhazam quest page (current copy; notes about later patches removed)
Lines: Per Patch 1.60:
- Malignant Creatures: All players should now be able to complete this quest.
AND
- The following Albion gems can now be recharged: Caster's Minding Thoughts, Strengthening Power, Quickening Power, Darkening Powers.
AND
For Co-op:
- Animists and Valewalkers should now be able to continue working on the Stoneheart Quest.

The Malignant Creatures quest starts in Little Haven in Caldey. Little Haven is around loc 46/19. The NPC that gives the quest is Mordwywr (the enchanter in town). Mordwywr is in the largest building in Little Haven. I received this quest at L48 and the reward includes a L48 gem - not sure if you can get the quest before that level.

You have to kill 7 undead creatures. I killed these: phantom magi, defiled skeleton, headless footman, grasping ghoul, ebon skeleton, corpse delver, and haunted rowan -- all yellow and easy kills to a level 48(found at loc=60k 56k).
Quest reward was 6 gold and some copper, 2,377,658,624xp (about 3/4 bub I think to L48), and a gem for jewel slot, most likely class specific. I am a wizzie and received Caster's Minding Thoughts.
I did this at 46, all mobs were yellow to me as well. I only received 1.8 billion exp, but it was still 3/4 of a bub for me -- I think therefore that it scales according to level.
My reward (as a friar) was Darkening Powers.
A 48 scout received 2.3 billion exp.

I tried to kill other undead, but only the ones on the list dropped items for me. The three that didn't were corpse mold, gangrenous mass, and a ghoul desecrator. The gem I got had 5 charges of a 15s self damage shield, with a delved rating of 5. Since someone else got a different gem, you might actually get a decent charge on one. 1.8 billion xp at level 46, roughly a bulb or a little more.
A lvl 43 friar with us couldn't get the quest yet.

3,137,339,392 experience (One bubble of exp at lvl 46.) 6 gold
Strengthening Power (Gem)
lvl 48 necro received:

lvl 46 received 1,801,928,334 exp.
lvl 47 received 2,069,872,107 exp.
lvl 49 received 2,731,212,567 exp.
lvl 50 received 4,706,009,088 exp.
Rewards:
Darkening Powers -- Cleric
Rewards:
Caster's Minding Thoughts
Darkening Powers

albion|free the rogue!.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per Patch 1.59:
Free the Rogue! - Animists and Valewalkers should now be able to complete this quest on Co-op
Per Patch 1.62:

- Free the Rogue - we have made some significant changes to this quest to make it easier for players to lure Mercal from his hiding place. Also, players no longer need to accompany Mercal on his return to town, he will meet you there.

Talk to Arden, the instrument merchant in Caer Diogel, and he will send you to rescue Mercal who is hiding near Krondon (Ogre Citadel). You must have good Ogre faction or bring some friends to help out. You can gain Ogre faction by killing Orcs. You no longer can gain Ogre faction to make them eutral/friendly by killing Orcs.
For Mercal to appear, the Ogre in the keep must be alive. If you kill the
ogres you will have to wait for them all to respawn or else Mercal will not
appear, since upon appearing they automatically die. So if you are having

problems with getting Mercal appear, just wait a bit. According to the CSR I spoke with, Mercal is scared of the ogres, and won't pop if there are ogres around his hiding place, so you may have to kill them before trying to get him to pop.
Once you have gotten there, there are three barrels, and if Mercal is not there, speak his name and he will spawn.
He will thank you and then take off towards Caer Diogel, follow him. Talk to Mercal and he will give you some documents to give to Arden who will then reward you.
lvl 48 received 2,272,761,920 exp and 8 gold.
Rewards:
Ogre Bracer
Shadow Cap
Ogre's Prayer Stone
Shadow Clasp
Ogre's Pious Belt
Ogre's Magical Belt

Lines: goal is to get a magical statue.
Ariette sends you to retrieve 3 items.
1 Archiator Hide from a Drakoran Archiator
1 blue slime (?) from a blue-green algae
1 appletreesap from Larionne
1) Drakoran Archiator
Drakoran Archiators can be found southwest of Ft. Gwyntell, just over the bridge.
Con yellow-ora to 49
2) Blue-green Algae
They can be found in Aldland. Just follow the road West out of Caer Diogel
up to the coast (~ loc 5k, 30k). Con yellow to 49
3) Larionne
She is a named Lammia in Clifton in Plain of Gwyddneau. After killing the Algae
just follow the road north (but watch out for aggro orcs) to Gwyddneau. In there
head west til you reach the river. If Lammias are neutral, you just can run up
north, if they are aggro better swim. Larrionne is at the northern end of Clifton
(~ loc 36,20). Cons orange to 49.
Remember you dont have to kill her! If Lammias are neutral, just talk to her and
she will hand out the item.
After collecting these items you have to put them together. First use (shift+e)
the slime, then the treesap. Journal will update and tell you to use the knive
with the Archiator Hide (shift+e the knive). Upon doing that an apple tree spirit
will appear. Talk to him, he will direct you further. Read quick what he tells you,
since he dissappears quite fast and you can only do that knive-trick 4 times.
The spirit tells you to free the soul of a young sorceress, Eralyne.
You can find Eralyn (who is actually a zombie) at the graveyard near Caer sidi
(~ loc 20k/20k in Caldey). Eralyn cons red to 49, so bring friends if you can't
solo reds. After killing her, she thanks you and you receive the statue.

reward. You can't choose the same Bracer 2 times.
You'll get the 2 Bracers, 10 Gold and bout 2.8 billion xp (lv 49).

albion|ogre's might.Name: Ogre's Might
albion|ogre's might.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-14 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per Patch 1.59:
Players on Ogre's Might who killed Scureol Hyrde and have the Channeler's Orb, but couldn't turn the item in to Master Xavier can now turn the item in and finish the quest.
Master Xavier is in the first building to your left as you enter Caer Diogel. He is located inside on your left.
Master Xavier says, "Good day, though any day you're alive these days is a good day, eh? How do you get on with those of the [Ogre Citadel]?"

Master Xavier says, "Yes, the ogres. Once, they were allies. Now, they are a sensitive bunch, blaming us for their essential exile into the mountains and their last stronghold. They fled before Morgana, pleading with us for aid, not realizing that we were already defeated, fleeing before the evil [Drakoran] hoardes."

Master Xavier says, "Aye. We weren't the sole occupants on this island you know. Once, not long ago, as we measure time, the ogres were our allies. We held this land together minding our own business, for the most part. We helped each other out occasionally. Occasionally we had some arguements that turned into some fighting, but nothing much. Then, Morgana came, and pushed us back, and the ogres back, [as well]."

Master Xavier says, "They wanted us to help them. They somehow expected us to do a better job of defending the island. Truthfully, I think they rallied themselves to late, and relied on us too heavily. They liked to keep to themselves, and when Morgana's Drakoran hoarde appeared and she summoned that dragon up, while we were struggling to hold our city, they [retreated] to their fortresses and citadels."

Master Xavier says, "They watched as our city became overrun. They watched the citizens of Avalon flee. But they assumed we'd handle it. The assumed they were not threatened. Then, the Drakorans [surprised] the ogres."

Master Xavier says, "Honestly, I don't see how they could have been surprised. It was clear to all of us what was happening. Morgana wanted the island, wanted it's magic. Ogres have access to the powerful places in the land. They have [magic] all their own."
Master Xavier says, "Oh yes, Powerful magic. Ogre magic. I know a bit about their [strange] magic."

Master Xavier says, "Oh yes. Here, we face the Drakorans and Morgana's evil. But what of when they are gone? Then, we are faced with the threat of that savage people from the Norse lands. If Albion does not defeat Midgard, then Midgard will defeat us. Now, if Albion got a hold of some of the magic of the ogres in their most powerful [stronghold], think what could be done!"

Master Xavier says, "Well now, before I go telling you about all that, I need to know, would you be willing to find some of their magic? You will need help, a lot of help. So before you agree, be sure you can convince many friends to come along. It's an orb I'm looking for, created by one called the Star Channeler; and it's locked deep inside the Ogre Citadel."
Dialog box: Will you find some of this Ogre magic?
You have been given the Ogre's Might quest.

Master Xavier says, "This item, now, it's in the Ogre Citadel, deep within, a chamber open to the stars. I don't know how to get in it, but I know the ogre there, his name is Scurceol Hydre, and he calls himself a star channeler! He is said to be channeling power from the heavens! Heresy, some say, but there is one who claims to have seen this powerful channeler! Speak to Arden in Caer Diogel about the star channeler. Tell him you're crazy enough to seek out the powerful talisman he's created."
[Step #2] Talk to Arden about the [star channeler].
Arden is the instrument merchant located next to the stairway on outside wall and can be seen directly from entering Caer Diogel.
Arden says, "Greetings friend. What brings you to old Arden?"
You say, "What about the star channeler?"
Arden says, "Ah. The star channeler. The ogre that calls himself that. Rory, my good, and often absent, friend, knows a bit about this ogre and his [power]."

Arden says, "Rory says the ogres don't have magic, and that this one Ogre, he was talking about natural powers that had more to do with a science of application rather than spells and incantations! How absurd, I say! Let the ogres believe what they will, but I know magic, and what this self-claimed star channeler does is not [science] but magic."

Arden says, "Science. Call it what you will. Here is what Rory says happens. There is a room inthe citadel under the stars. There are four golden rings. Rory said the star channeler, named Scurceol Hyrde, calls them nodes. The nodes are powerful. The seem to protect the star channeler. His name is Scurceol Hyrde. I don't pretend to konw how it all works. I can't even tell you how to defeat Scurceol Hyrde, but I know the room is very [dangerous]."

Arden says, "Rory only said the room meant death for anyone not meant to enter. The nodes, he says, semms to be collecting power from the stars! He said storms often brew in the room. He says the ogre that calls himself the star channeler wields lightening! Now, it won't be easy getting in to this chamber, but if you want, I know who has a [map] to the chamber!"

Arden says, "The ogre Malefact. He holds a map. I know this because Rory has tried to obtain this map. Normally, I would get Rory to sneak in, but Rory is missing, lost somewhere in the ogre fortress! Ah, but kill Malefact, and you will have your map. The map will guide you to the star channeler's chamber."
[Step #3] Kill Malefact in the Outerworld of Krondon, to obtain the map to the star channeler's chamber.
Malefact can be found near the entrance to Krondon. You will have a lot of goons to fight if you are KOS.
Malefact says, "Foul traitor to the land! You have failed us, and we fell to the drakoran. Now, you would destroy yourselves?"
[Step #4] Use the map to read it.

Place the map on your quickbar, press the "e" key or the key you have mapped to use an item and hold, then either press the number of the quickbar or click on the map icon to use it. Note: it seems at this time you cannot use the map if you are a necromancer in shade form.
You attempt to use Citadel Map.

My friend Malefact! Here is how you can enter my chamber without having to encounter the Queen or any of her foolish court. When you enter the citadel at first, veer left at the first opportunity. At each point you will receive a gem. They are peices of a final key. You could enter the chamber anyhow, but getting the pieces to the key is the quickest way. You will see, when you finally arrive Malefact, that the key is really a gift for you, my friend.
[Step #5] Veer left after first entering the citadel.
You receive the first key piece from Citadel Map!
Once inside you will get periodic messages as you reach your destination point. You will also receive a piece of the key.
My friend, here you must go straight and take the first left turn you find.
[Step #6] Go straight, then take the right turn, then the first left turn.
You receive a second key piece from Citadel Map!

Keep going straight. Veer right and turn the first right turn. These corridors and passages can be very confusing. After you take the first right, you will then need to take the first left. All this effort to avoid the Queen's chambers.
[Step #7] Go straight through the tunnel, then take the left turn.
You receive a third key piece from Citadel Map!
Go through this tunnel you're in, friend. Then turn left.
[Step #8] Follow this tunnel straight. Don't take any of the turns. Follow the tunnel until you see the beginnings of worked stone.
You receive a fourth key piece from Citadel Map!
Now, here's it's a bit tricky. Go straight through the tunnel. Don't take the left turn. Soon, you'll see the beginnings of worked tunnels.
[Step #9] Follow this tunnel straight to its end. Then, turn left and follow the tunnel until its end. Then, turn right.
You receive a fifth key piece from Citadel Map!

Ah, you can see the ogres here? They are indifferent to me, but I assure you, they have nothing to do with the Queen's bunch. Follow this tunnel straight until it ends. Then turn left until that tunnel ends. Then, turn right. You're almost there.
[Step #10] The chamber of the star tunneler should be directly ahead.
[Step #11] Try to defeat Scurceol Hyrde, the star channeler. Be careful, the room is very danerous.
Kill him! You will have to deal with the nodes first. Then onto him.
You receive a Puzzler's Globe!
You receive a Channeler's Orb!
You receive a Scurceol's Bracer!
[Step #12] Return the strange orb you received to Master Xavier in Caer Diogel.
You give the Channeler's Orb to Master Xavier.

Master Xavier says, "Ah! Well, to be honest, I have no idea what this is! But I will find out. I'm sure it is something that can be used to counter the magic of the Midgard shamans! Thank you my friend, thank you! Oh here, let me take that map as well. You don't need it!"
You are awarded 10 gold and some copper!
You are awarded 2,306,867,200 experience!
You have finished the Ogre's Might quest.

LONGBOW: +3

Slash: +8%

Bonus: 35%

Lines: This quest is a follow up to "Evening the Odds" You *MUST* have good lammia faction, and have completed that quest to do "Orcs and Spellbooks. Speak with Veena on the southeast cornet of Inishail Island, at loc 50000,49000

6) The first thing you need to kill is an orc soothsayer. These are blue-orange to 50. Travel north-west through (or around) the lake. Once you hit the opposite shore veer slightly left towards the buildings in the
distance (loc=12800,18800). This is the orc camp, remember it well. Kill enough soothsayers until you get the avalonian tome in your backpack.
7) Return to the Veena at 50k, 49k

8) Now you have to go kill a buzzing nuisance. They are just east of where you killed the orc soothsayer (Loc=25400, 14000) . Yellow-orange con to 50. Keep killing them until you get the stinger you need.
9) Return to the Veena at 50k, 49k

10) Now you have to kill the big bad boss, Chieftain Toca. He is in the large building near where you killed the orc soothsayer, surrounded by a number of helpers. You will need a good group to do this. Clear the adds first, but don't touch the soothsayers near the boss until you are ready to fight him. This is a casting boss, he has all sorts of terrible AE spells that will kill your group if you don't engage him in melee right away.

(another submitted note on the Chieftan: Chieftan is hard, may need a full group. He has a nasty ae poison DoT spell. He is in biggest central hut in village, and surrounded by bodyguards. Recommend pulling mobs around the hut entrance, then pulling the one just inside the entrance, then pull ones around him. When he begins to cast ae DoT, get a tank on him to interrupt him, while others kill adds, then get on chief. I am unsure if it is insta cast ae DoT, if it is, then just all kill adds first, then get back on chief. Need good healers to deal with DoT and healing tanks.)
After you kill him, return to Veena at 50k 49k and get your reward.

Lines: Sister Elaydith says, "Oh my friend, you have finally returned. I have been looking everywhere for you. So much has happened since I saw you last. Where do I [begin].

Sister Elaydith says, "Shortly after I saw you last, I was called to a meeting by the King's council to tell them all I knew about the plague you helped me stop. I learned about more weird reports of...well things that are hard to describe. It seems that strange creatures have been [scouting] around Albion.

Sister Elaydith says, "Just last week, in Campocorentin Station, one of the town guards reported that he slew a shadowy creature that he happened to surprise while it was writing notes on a map. The map showed where all the city guards stood throughout the day. It also showed the location of the town's healer, smith and enchanter. The map showed things that can only be seen by someone [studying] the town for a very long time.
Sister Elaydith says, "I overheard some of the council members whispering about a plot to attack the station. That could explain why the creature was making maps. There has been some other [reports].

Sister Elaydith says, "Villagers in Humberton became suddenly ill after drinking the water from a nearby well. When the guards checked the well, they found that someone had dropped a small bottle of [poison] into it.

Sister Elaydith says, "It was no accident either. The bottle was crafted with tiny holes in it to slowly leak the viscous (vicious?) poison into the water. That way more people would drink from the well before becoming ill. Who knows how many lives would have been lost if the guards had not acted so swiftly. There are also reports of hundreds of people suffering from a strange [haunting dream].

Sister Elaydith says, "They said the dream always starts the same. It starts with a strange woman wearing garments that look something like Cleric's clothes. She seems very upset about something and then she ventures into a very evil dungeon. She seems to be looking for someone and then she was suddenly slain and her spirit captured. The demons that capture her begin to taunt her and say that she is one of the first spirits they have captured intact. Then they mock her and say they have [special plans] for her.

Sister Elaydith says, "They give her spirit to the succubus so they can cast spells upon her and change her into one of them. Her spirit begins calling out for help and that is where the dream ends. The dream must be very haunting. Many of those having it, soon set off in search of the dungeon to see if they can somehow rescue the woman's spiritand are never seen or heard from again.
Sister Elaydith says, "Now you may be asking yourself why I called upon you again. It seems you were asked for [directly] (your name).

Sister Elaydith says, "One night a small imp scared a villager half witless by popping out of his fireplace and speaking to him. The imp told him his name was Mystemas and to seek you out and have you meet him in Darkness Falls. The imp said he had a secret to pass to the king and he would only speak it to those brave enough to go against the lecherous gress. The villager told the nearest guard and word made its way to the [Council].

Sister Elaydith says, "The King's Council and the Church debated back and forth about the wisdom of sending anyone into Darkness Falls to meet with a demon and we finally agreed to disagree. The Council asks that you journey into Darkness Falls and meet with this imp to see if he truly has any valuable information. I find this deplorable, but we are bound by the Council's decision. Will you do this for the council?
Do you accept this mission from the Council? [Level 45] Accept or Decline

Sister Elaydith says, "You are a brave soul, (your name). No one from the Church would ever consider stepping foot into that hellish place. Demons should be destroyed, not bargained with. I should hold my tongue, but I believe you are walking into some sort of twisted [trap].

Sister Elaydith says, "The imp may simply be trying to lure you back into Darkness Falls so the foul creatures may have their revenge against you. In any case, you should be very careful and not trust a thing the imp says. I wish you luck, my friend, and a safe journey.
[Step 2]Travel to the Albion entrance of Darkness Falls, and speak with an imp named Mystemas.
Mystemas says, "Eh? What do you think you are [looking] at, ugly (your characters race)?

Mystemas says, "What? Are you as stupid as you look? Maybe not, eh. You come down here with big ideas and try to do good deeds. I say the faster you go get yourself killed, the better. Wait a [second]!
Mystemas says, "You are that idiot who killed Malroch. Hehe, that was pretty foolish of you. Everyone in Darkness Falls has heard of you and is looking to cash in on the [bounty] for your head.

Mystemas says, "What? Do you think mortals are the only ones who use bounties? Any demon that slays you is supposed to be rewarded by the Master, but I have seen how he rewards his followers. I used to be one of the strongest demons in the Master's army and now look at me. The Master changed me into an imp as [punishment] for something I had nothing to do with.

Mystemas says, "How was I supposed to know the Master already had a plan? Anyway now I am really upset and I need your help to get some revenge on a few demons. If you help me I will tell you things that may just keep you alive a tad longer in the future. Let's say I know something about an ambassador that has been helping the lands of Albion to an early [demise].

Mystemas says, "I thought that might get your attention, but before I start telling what I know, I want some proof that you can handle yourself in battle. After all, you might have just been lucky when you beat the poor old Malroch. I want you to sneak into the area where the dragon of your land sleeps and return with something for me. You do this for me and I will tell you something of what I [know].

Mystemas says, "Let's see. What should I have you get, eh? I know! I want a granite gem from a granite giant stonebreaker living in southwestern [Dartmoor]. They dig up some very interesting gems in those mountains.

Mystemas says, "If you are wondering if you can trust me, don't worry your mind any longer. You can trust me, and I can't trust you. That keeps things simple in our future dealings. Now bring me what I want and stop wasting my time.
[Step 3] Journey to southwestern Dartmoor and retrieve Granite Gem from a granite giant stonebreaker.
Killed Granite Giant Stonebreaker at Dartmoor 10k,43k, got gem. Back to Mystemas in DF.
Mystemas says, "Oh, you are back. I suppose you have what I asked for?"

Mystemas says, "Well maybe you are not as weak as I thought, but certainly as smart as I thought. So lets talk shall we? I know a few things that would turn you pale with fear. What do I [know], you ask?"

Mystemas says, "Well I am glad that you asked. My Master has sent forth an ambassador to your lands to convince your king that the main threat to Albion from the other realms is far greater than the [threat] darkness falls presents."

Mystemas says, "This was done to increase the casualties on both sides of your stupid war. Each time a mortal falls in combat, we take a small portion of that creature's spirit and create one of the soultorn that roam deeper in Darkness Falls.
The soultorn are then trained to fight in my Master's armies. See the brilliance of this [plan]?"
Mystemas says' "The more you fight, the more you die. The more you die, the stronger we get. Hehe, very nice eh? Master also has a method to get the freshest and strongest of your [spirits]."

Mystemas says, "He watches which of your three realms is strongest on the field of battle and then allows only that realm to directly enter Darkness Falls. We can make far stronger soultorn from those that die here. In fact, once in a while we get very lucky and trap an entire creature's spirit here. There has been an especially strong [soultorn] captured recently."

Mystemas says, "She was a foolish healer named Caisha who came here looking for her lost friend. Now our Princess is torturing her spirit so we can make it into a succubi. Prince Ba'alorian wants to use her in his army as a high priestess or something. Wait, I have an [idea]."
Mystemas says, "You might be able to help both of us at the same time. The Ambassador normally stays at the Princess's side.
You will need proof to take to your king that he is being lied to and the Ambassador should be carrying plans from the
Prince that will help convince your king. You can help me by taking [Caisha's spirit]."

Mystemas says' "If the Prince has her for a high priestess, I doubt I will ever get a chance to gain my Master's favor again. I would surely like to see the Prince's plan fail miserably and you would provide me the means to do that. So let me make it clear what you [need to do]."

Mystemas says, "First, slay the ambassador and get his pouch of documents to take back to your king or whatever. Second, slay the Princess and her followers. You mst then slay Caisha's soultorn to release her spirit from its torment. Take this Soulstone. It will capture Caisha's spirit when she is slain so that no other demon captures her. Oh, one other [thing]."

Mystemas says, "If you get captured, I will do everything within my power to ensure the inquisitors shred every last piece of your spirit before you can tell anyone our little plan. Do you [Understand] me?"
Mystemas says, "Good. Now get going before someone sees us talking. Bring me Caisha like a good little (minstrel)
Reward:
Perfect Life Stone

hibernia|cad goddeau a.Name: Cad Goddeau A
hibernia|cad goddeau a.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This is the preliminary to the Reawakening Quest:

This quest starts in Tir na Nog with the Blademaster Trainer Luighseach. She will tell you to Seek out Torrance the Druid Trainer at an outpost near Innis Carthaig. The out post is just across the bridge before you reach Connla. The easiest way to get there is take a horse from Mag Mell to Howth, and another horse from Howth to Innis Carthaig.

Just after you cross the bridge you should see the tower. Jump off of your horse from here and talk to Torrance. He will ask you if you have heard the tale of Cad Goddeau. Just say yes and save yourself a ton of aggravation. He will tell you about learning from the past and eventually hand you a Druid Plant. Then he tells you to seek out Chief Neasan living in a tree just outside of Ardagh.

Behind the Tower you can see Connla, swim across the water to Connla and hop a horse to Druim Ligen. Jump off of the Horse at Ardagh, and head west, you will see a HUGE tree with a door, this is the home of Chief Neasan.

Give the Druid Plant to Chief Neasan and he will tell you that you must seek out the Old Hermit. And that you must complete a task before the Old Hermit will talk to you. You must defeat The Blademaster.

Hop a horse from Ardagh to Connla and another Horse from Connla to Innis Carthaig. Shortly before Innis Carthaig you will see another Tree like that of Chief Neasan's; this is the home of the Old Hermit. If you try to enter and talk to him he will ignore you until you have killed The Blademaster. The Blademaster wanders around here. I saw a few other creatures but nothing that wasn't neutral to me.

The Blademaster conned yellow to me at 16, and hits in the high 30's to mid 40's. I was able to defeat him barely (I got lucky and dodged a few of his attacks). He drops Coin, Boots of the Deft Strider, and a key.

Upon nearing the home of the Old Hermit he will tell you to give him the key, and then he will talk to you. He will tell you a story about a "dark thing" that a Druid once did and then will ask you if you have anything to give him. Hand him the Druid Plant.

You will gain EXP and obtain a new quest called the quest of the Reawakening, of which you cannot even start until you are Level 20. The new quest will take you to the Cliffs of Moher to rescue a Druid imprisoned by the Moherian Distorters.

Follow the road south to Innis Carthaig and hop another horse to Tie na Mbeo. Ardagh is the town just before there and again speak with Chief Neasan. If you are Level 16 like me he will ask you what you are doing back here. Get Lvl 20 and come back for more adventure.
Official hint (from Camelot Herald):
Don't lose Bas' Jewel! You will need it repeatedly for this quest.
Rewards:
Necklace of Energy -- Mentalist
Ring of Nature Affinity -- Druid
Boots of the Deft Strider -- Blademaster
Band of Woven Grass -- Animist
Necklace of Laughing Winds -- Valewalker
Rewards:
Necklace of Energy
Ring of Nature Affinity
Boots of the Deft Strider

Necklace of Laughing Winds

hibernia|cad goddeau b.Name: Cad Goddeau B
hibernia|cad goddeau b.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Go to Tir Uphorst in the Cliffs of Moher and run due east up the hill from the Guard Tower where u will find lots of siabras and a hut and some structures. You may need friends, if you are low level, to clear the siabra camp. Siabras are social and call for help when attacked. Or if you are high level and they con gray to you, they wont even aggro.

Look for the enclosed pointy-roof house and you will find the Druid Harkin and a siabra distorter sometimes spawns in the same room. Right clicking on Druid Harkin gives us nothing useful so /say [the old hermit has awakened] to him. Several things will happen. The Druid will give you an item (Transfixing Robes, looks very similar to a Siabra robe but a lighter hue), a parched scroll (to be delivered to a merchant), then runs out thanking you for freeing him.

Run back west to Tir Uphorst and look for Callough (the weapon merchant under the mushroom). Give him the scroll Harkin gave you and follow the conversation. He will ask you to seek Cathbad in Howth to obtain Bas' Jewel.
This you must do at level 25
Official hint (from Camelot Herald):
Players on step 4 that can't get the NPC to respond need to /say [old hermit has awakened] and also must be at least level 20 and have completed The Reawakening quest.
Rewards:
Transfixing Robes -- Mentalist
Hardened Short Bow -- Blademaster
Green Vine Necklace -- Druid
Light Gorse Robe -- Animist
Light Heather Robe -- Valewalker
Rewards:
Transfixing Robes
Hardened Short Bow
Green Vine Necklace
Light Gorse Robe

hibernia|cad goddeau c.Name: Cad Goddeau C
hibernia|cad goddeau c.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Go to Howth, Cathbad is in the main hut next to the firepot. Tell him, "I walk the path of cad goddeau", then "I need bas' jewel". He will give you a gem called Bas' Jewel and instruct you to hand it over to the Old Hermit.

Return to the Old hermit's hut and hand him the gem. He will give u a long paragraph to read about the 4 evils then suddenly disappear and a lvl 30 Druid Spirit will appear in his place. I've only done this part once and i tried to quickcast mez the druid spirit but she resisted and i died shortly after. Whether you kill this druid spirit or not is not important here, the quest goes on so dont worry if you die. Although with a bit of preparation it is possible to kill the spirit with some help. Ive heard that killing her may give you another interim reward, but again this isnt necessary. You will receive Bas' Jewel once again.

Step 8 requires you to travel to Bri Leth and kill a mob called a Druid to obtain the armband. The druid camp is located in the Valley of Bri Lieth at loc 20k, 18k. They are easy to kill but run fast and can be found west from the road between Caille and Drum Cain, off the path on the peak of the tallest brown hill very close to the siabra seekers camp. You may also find a named lvl 30 druid Riocard up here - con him and remember his level. Kill a Druid and he will yell "Mentalist, walking the path of Cad Goddeau? Did not the Old Hermit tell you it is the walk of death?" while he fights. You will automatically receive an armband. Now remember this camp because you will come back here.
Official hint (from Camelot Herald):
Players on step 8 that can't get the NPC's to drop the item need to be at least level 25, must have the jewel in their inventory, and need to approach the NPC's.
Rewards:
Staff of Mental Domination -- Mentalist
Scarred Vest -- Blademaster
Earthen Scale Gloves -- Druid
Master Valewalker's Necklace -- Valewalker
Staff of Natural Tendencies -- Animist
Rewards:
Staff of Mental Domination
Scarred Vest
Earthen Scale Gloves
Master Valewalker's Necklace
Staff of Natural Tendencies

hibernia|cad goddeau d.Name: Cad Goddeau D
hibernia|cad goddeau d.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Go back to Innis Carthaig and look for Chieftess Niamh in the straw hut. Tell her, "Riocard", and "I walk the path of cad goddeau". She will tell you to seek out Riocard now, same spot where you killed your druid so go back to Bri Leth. She will also give you a Staff of Mental Domination. Now if Riocard con'd purple/red/orange to you, you will need help killing him. If you're high level enough (30+) you could solo him.

Actually killing Riocard solo takes a bit of work since he has druid guard (the female guard aggroes if u attack Riocard and vice versa). The best approach would be to mez her, then nuke Riocard twice, sprint and run away. Riocard will chase you a good distance if you are close to him, but he will always walk back instead of running. Sit down, get some endurance and nuke him several more times while he is walking back to lure him again and eventually finish him off. If you succeed, you should move up to Step 11 of the quest in your journal. If you are having problems killing Riocard, I strongly suggest bringing friends.
Go back to the Old Hermit and give him Bas' Jewel for your final reward - Mindlord's Crested Cap. Congratulations on finishing such a long quest.

Resonant Gauntlets -- Blademaster
Jagged Shield -- Druid
Cap of Spring Awakenings -- Valewalker
Cap of Autumnal Splendor -- Animist

hibernia|connla's well.Name: Connla's Well
hibernia|connla's well.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to Labhras and he will tell you that a terrible beast has taken over Connla's Well in Shannon Estuary! Caora is her name, and she is one of the most feared of the Caoranachs! He asks you to Find Slevin. He usually frequents the guard tower on the road from Connla to Innis Carthaig.
Go to Slevin and he gives you a powder to take to Viola in Caille. Take it to her and she will give you a forumla to take to Maeve, the Crone. Take her the forumla and she will make you a charm.
**Ranger Version**

Your guildmaster tells you to journey to Connia, the town just just north of the river that connects Silvermine mountains and Shannon Estuary. There you are to talk to an armor merchant in the large wooden hut. He tells you to slay Caora, who is on the east side of the river. From the bridge, follow the east/south side of the river north until you come to a 3-way intersection. Turn right and follow the river. You should come to a small pond with stones circling it. Mermen and Caorathans should be in there. At night, Caora spawns. She cons level 11 and is very difficult to kill for a level 11. Bring a friend! (loc 50,26)
**Eldritch and Warden version**
Step 1.
Upon attaining level 11 speak to the Eldritch trainer in TNN. You will be
given the quest.
Step 2.
You have to travel South to Connla and speak to Edana.
Step 3.

Edana informs you that you must go and kill Caora, a large worm. She lives in a small lake NE of Connla. Go NE and the river will split, take the course to the right. Follow that until the end. There you will see stone pillars around a small lake. Hopefully your faction with Mermen is in good standing as they are all over this place.
Caora is in the lake as well as some of her children. Since you're an Eldritch use one of your long range bolt spells to pull her to you, no sense in getting your robe
wet.
At level 11 Caora is a bit hard to kill by yourself so if you can bring a friend.
**Hero Version** submitted by: Phorgon

1. Start out at trainer in TNN, he will tell you that you need to find Slevin on the path between Connla and Innis Carthaig. It's pretty far to run so I suggest riding a horse to Innis or Connla. If you get a horse to Connla, then jump at the bridge; if you get one to Innis Carthaig, then jump when you get to the SI gate. He is at around 23k 31k, right next to the tower.
2. He will give you some powder and ask you to take it to Viola in Caille which is past Mag Mell.

So swim accross to Connla and get on a horse to Druim Ligen. Jump before you get to Mag Mell and run East along the shoreline. Just follow the edge of the water all the way around, or if the curmudgeon scare you, just swim around. Keep going untill you see a dock. You are almost there when you see a second camp of Curmudgeons, but these are "Figters". When you get to the dock (52k 56k) turn east and run into the forest. It is just before Silvermine Mountains. There will be a pond in the middle of the forest and you will come out the other side in Bri Leith. You will see a rock with the Caille written on it, follow the path a few steps in front of it down into the valley between the trees. When I got to Brynach I was tired of running, so I got a horse to Druim Cain. Jump when you get to Caille (35k 32k). Viola is the translucent one in the gazebo. She will give you a formula and tell you to give it to Maeve by ardee.

3. Run back to Brynach and get on a horse to Druim Cain again and this time go all the way, then get a horse to Tir na Mbeo. It's a little out of the way but it will save a lot of time. Jump at Mag Mell again and run to the hut near the mudmen outside of ardee (57k 44k). Maeve is inside. She will give you your peice of jewelry. It's called the Hero Charm, it's level 13, and it gives strength +6, hits +16, constitution +6, and parry +1.
Rewards:
Warden -- Warden's Charm or Gloves of Agility
Hero -- Protector's Cloak or Hero Charm
Ranger -- Jewel of Speed or Ranger Charm
Eldritch -- Staff of Inner Power or Eldritch Charm
