hibernia|destructive forces.Name: Destructive Forces
hibernia|destructive forces.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This is the Traveler's Way quest for Path of Focus.

Given at level 7 to many classes. The quest begins in Tir na Nog. Your guild master tells you that you have trained hard and are ready to further the aims of your chosen path. He/she then asks you if you [agree on this]. He/she then tells you about an abandoned camp in a forgotten grove of trees.

It's [not safe to stay] there at night and she is not kidding. Anger sprites and worse prowl the area during the night. Make sure you go there during the day. To get there follow the road to Ardee and go to just before the bridge and head west. You should very quickly come to the camp on a hill (loc=33k, 23k).

The creature you must kill is a wind ghoul named Windaille (spawns around 6AM game time...reporterd to be 6:14). Once you kill him, a tree creature (Fearg) spawns and attacks a nearby NPC named Bas. Kill the tree creature, or simply let Bas do it. Then kill Bas and you receive "Bas' Gem". Talk to the Empyrean that then spawns and she tells you of the history of this place, and then tells you the next step in your quest.
Now go back to the road and head south to Howth. It's a long run so take a horse from Mag Mell.
Once in Howth, go to the lodge in the center of town and speak with Cathbad. He asks you if you've been visiting [ancient groves].
Then he asks if anything was odd and if something was [guarding the grove]. When he asks if you received anything, give him "Bas' Gem" to receive experience and a minor magic item.
Rewards:
Carved Wooden Bracer -- Wardens
Nature's Shroud -- Ranger
Medallion of the Warriors Spirit -- Hero
Twisted Silver Choker -- Eldritch
Next quest in this series:
Connla's Well
Rewards:
Carved Wooden Bracer
Natures Shroud
Medallion of Warriors Spirit
Twisted Silver Choker

hibernia|dying favor.Name: Dying Favor
hibernia|dying favor.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: You must complete the Enchanting Willow quest to begin this one. This one begins as Ciar is dying.
Lucan wants you to take the branch that Ciar drops to the Druid trainer, Torrance. Torrance is located out side the guard tower near Connla. He is outside.

hibernia|enchanting willow.Name: Enchanting Willow
hibernia|enchanting willow.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: - Locate NPC Ciar north of Connla and a fork in the road. Turn left at fork to find her in a group of dead trees.
- She explains she is held by magic and needs her "Guardian" to break the spell. "Guardian" is located across estuary from Connla. Name is Lucan.

- Lucan the ghost is directly across from the town near a large boulder (may be a night spawn only). He explains that she is evil and needs to be destroyed so he can rest in peace. He asks that a live willow branch then be brought to Torrance the Druid trainer at the Connla tower on the road to Innis Carthaig.
- Kill Ciar after she freaks out. Get branch and a magic item. A dialog box will open as she is dying, this is the Dying Favor quest.

hibernia|ilisa's trade.Name: Ilisa's Trade
hibernia|ilisa's trade.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This epic quest is received from your trainer at L40. You are sent to Ilisa, the weapon smith in Mag Mell. She offers to make you a special weapon but she needs spell components from various places and enchanted silver from Coruscating Mines. All items are placed in inventory, not looted. And your tasks may vary!
Enchanter tasks:

The first item she needs is the head of a boogie man which is found in Breifine. Or a Phaeghoul's Hand from a Phaeghoul- continue past Koalinth Mines in Moher and Phaeghoul's gather around a tree just past a Dweller encampment.

Next she needs enchanted silver from a silvermine knocker or Enthralled Silvier in Coruscating Mines. To determine whether she has sufficient silver, she offers to make one item from a choice of blades, blunts, large weapon, bow, Celtic spear, piercing, shield, or staff.
She had enough silver to make a staff but needs an ancient text from a creature not alive or dead that haunts the Bog by night. OR a scroll from Irewood Greenbarks or some such in Lough Gur.

This creature is a lesser banshee which drops a smithing stone globe. The song must be translated by an enchanter. After speaking to several enchanters in TNN, which may or may not be a part of this quest, I went to Connla and spoke to Eli who took the globe but said she needed a clarity stone for focus, and more time for study. She said she would call upon her fellow enchanters for assistance. Kern in Innis says moss monsters which are found in Breifine and Emain Macha have the clarity stone needed.

Take the moss monster stone to Caolan near the vault in TNN who provides a translation. Return to Ilisa with the translation and she asks for one additional item which is the essence of dead from a Bean Sidhe found in Cruachon Gorge, loc: LOC = 51300, 20500 (New Frontiers Cruachan Gorge loc 45027,27940,8152 dir=249 and loc=41k, 28k they con green to a 50.)
With this final piece returned to Ilisa, she again offers a choice of weapons. Enchanters receive a Silvered Spellbound Enchanter.
Nightshade tasks:
I had to kill a White Boar (MOB like a torc, I knew that when I saw one) for a TUSK . New Frontiers loc=58737, 15997, 7988 Mt. Collory, NE area of Collory in a penned in area with curmudgeons.

To find theses MOBs, go to Druim Ligen gate, enter Cruachan Gorge, go to the right, climb the cliff and keep running along the south border of the zone. After a moment you will hit the place where the White Boar are located (loc=45499, 56589.)
Take care there are always MOBs near the borders of zone.
These White Boar cons yellow to orange at level 40 which could be a problem for a level 40 Nightshade.
More of this, there is a real problem !

When you check the White Boar, they are neutral, so you pull one and fight it. I was very suprised when up to five came fightning one after the other (not all together). After the first kill, I have checked my inventory but found no TUSK. As I said I was obliged to fight other because they came asis. I think that they were now aggresive, but when I checked they were neutral.
So if you go there, have strong friends with you.
Champion tasks:
NOTE: all items appear in your inventory, so I didn't see a need to write them all down.
1. Speak with Lasairiona the Champion trainer in Tir Na Nog. She will send you to speak with Ilisa, the smith in Mag Mell.
2. Speak with Ilisa in Mag Mell. She will send you to kill a Phaeghoul. I found these in the Cliffs of Moher (approx. loc of 10k, 55k). They con yellow at level 40.

3. Back to Mag Mell. Give Ilisa the Phaeghoul item. She sends you to the Coruscating Mines to kill a Collared Gemgetter. Once you enter the mines, move forward to the end of the hall and turn right (the only way you can turn). Move forward again into the room with the wooden posts. Go up the ramp where the posts are and take a right. The Gemgetters are at the end of the hall. They con yellow and orange at level 40.

4. Back to Mag Mell. Give Ilisa the Gemgetter item. She sends you back to the Coruscating Mines to kill a Geasbound Hewer. These can be located at the same place as the Collared Gemgetters in step 3. They con yellow and orange at level 40.

5. Back to Mag Mell. Give Ilisa the Hewer item. She sends you to Treibh Caillte (the dungeon in Lough Gur) to kill a Rock Golem. I found one of these sitting at the entrance down the ramp. They con yellow at 40.

6. At this point, I had to take the Golem item to an enchanter. After visiting several, the one that worked was Sadhbh in Tir Na Nog (inside near the East Gate). Sadhbh sent me to kill a Moss Monster. I found these in Breifine at a small tower SW of Dun Bolg - if you stand at Dun Bolg and look SW, you can see the tower. The Moss Monster conned yellow and orange at 40.
7. Back to Tir Na Nog. Give the Moss Monster item to Sadabh. Sadabh sends you back to Ilisa in Mag Mell.
8. Talk to Ilisa in Mag Mell. She sends you to kill a Bananach in Briefine. These are found in the exact same place as the Moss Monsters in step 6. They con yellow and orange at level 40.
9. Back to Ilisa in Mag Mell. Collect your reward.
Bard tasks: send in by Bram
1. Speak with Bard trainer in Tir Na Nog. She will send you to speak with Ilisa, the smith in Mag Mell.
2. Speak with Ilisa in Mag Mell. She will send you to kill a Phaeghoul. I found these in the Cliffs of Moher (approx. loc of 10k, 55k). They con yellow at level 40.
3. Back to Mag Mell. Give Ilisa the Phaeghoul item. She sends you to the Coruscating Mines to kill an Enthralled Silvier. They con yellow and orange at level 40.
4. Back to Mag Mell. Give Ilisa the item. She sends you back to the Coruscating Mines to kill a Trammer. They con yellow and orange at level 40.

5. Back to Mag Mell. Give Ilisa the item. She sends you to Treibh Caillte (the dungeon in Lough Gur) to kill a Rock Golem. I found one of these sitting at the entrance down the ramp. They con yellow at 40.

6. At this point, I had to take the Golem item to an enchanter. You can visit up to 4 enchanters, 2 in Tir Na Nog, 1 in Connla and 1 in Innis Carthaig. I got lucky at the enchanter in Innis Carthaig. For the translation to work, i had to go kill a White Boar, which can be found in Cruachan Gorge, near the zonewall behind Dun Ailinne. Allthough these were neutral before and after the kill, the other boars will attack when one of them is killed, so be prepared to run or take some friends with you.
7. Bring the item to one of the 4 enchanters and get the translation to Ilisa in Mag Mell.
8. Talk to Ilisa in Mag Mell. She sends you to kill a Bananach in Briefine. These are found in a tower near Dun Bolg. They con yellow and orange at level 40.
9. Back to Ilisa in Mag Mell. Collect your reward.

Lines: I was sent to Cathbad in Howth, then Sholto in Innis Carthaig, and then retrieving a soul gem from a Gemclicker Horder in Coruscating Mines. The Gemclicker Horder is in Coruscating Mines. Follow the left wall down to the left smaller sentry room (not the one that leads to the pit). He looks like a Gemclicker, but name clearly shows Gemclicker Horder, so wait for him.

Next take the Soul Gem to the Enchantress. To find her, go to North Entrance of TNN, go directly NorthWest to hill. Up hill to center, then go due North past Clurikeens to thier little village. She is in the building at the north end (aprox loc=10k, 36k). She summons Lucan (sp?). you must says "Morven's Heirs" to him.
She summons Lucan, who asks you to kill heirs of Morven, all 3 are giants in the frontier, and they must be killed in order.

The first is East of Dun Lamfhota in Cruachan Gorge (56k, 17k): Ronat, a two headed Fomorian. Exit into the Frountier thru DL and go North by North-East to 56k,17k. This is just east of "Keep" Dun Lamfhota in Cruachan Gorge. (New Frontiers loc=38k 58k, right outside of DL, just down the hill)

The second in the camp just outside of Druim Ligen in Connacht: Uileog, a Fomorian Goberling (BAF). Head back towards DL entrance. There is a small camp North-East of the entrance with Uileog at it. *I found uileog at loc 32k,41k in Cruachan. (New Frontiers loc=60k 17.5k in Cruachan Gorge)

hibernia|roane skin.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Your steps and tasks may vary, these are only a couple...
You are asked to go to the village of Connla and speak with one of the people there in hopes of getting more information about this Roane named Resa.
From there you are sent across the first wood and stone bridge to the guard tower to speak with Slevin, loc: 22869,31225, about Resa's location. He sends you back to Connla and down the beach a bit.

Here she spawns during the early night till the early morning and is surrounded by Siabra Ghosts. Use caution but make your way to her. You learn that a named creature across the stone step bridge has her skin.

The named leprechaun is Hazard. Go past the stone and wood bridge and the next bridge is the stone step bridge. Cross this and turn left and in the trees near the shore you'll find the named lucridan. Kill him and you get the skin.
Go back to Resa for your reward. Don't kill Resa, you kill Hazard.

2) Ride horse from Mag Mell to Howth.
3) Get a horse ride from Howth to Innis Carthaig.

hibernia|seek the moonstone.Name: Seek the Moonstone
hibernia|seek the moonstone.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per patch 1.70:
- Seek the Moonstone - The area around Macnol's tower has been named the Ruined Tower of Tir na mBeo to help players locate the correct place.
1. Speak to your trainer in Tir na Nog. He/she will tell you to speak to
Fagan in Mag Mell.
2. Speak to Fagan in Mag Mell and get the quest. He gives you a ring and
tells you to talk to Macnol in the ruined tower of Tir na mBeo.
3. Go to Ardee and take the horse route to East Lough Derg. Head north
towards the grove of trees. There will be many Dergans. Macnol spawns inside

the tower, loc: 59280, 13895. The towers entrance is on the north side and he is surrounded by several guards. Do not kill any of the Dergans or you will take a faction hit and Macnol will not talk to you. Be sure to be wearing Fagans ring.

4. If the Dergan are already aggressive to you, head south to find Curmudgeons. The best place to hunt is the Curmudgeon campsite southeast of the Parthanan Farm. Keep hunting Curmudgeon until you are neutral to the Dergan. It may take many kills. I believe killing the Curm leader, Hughar, in the campsite will move your faction significantly. This is unproven but
the Dergan were neutral to me right after killing him.
5. Talk to Macnol. Hell ask you to go kill Nock, a named Sheevra.
6. From the parthanian farm, head further south. Eventually you will come to a single stone hut with a cart close by. In this camp you see normal Sheevra
Fighters and Archers. Nock spawns inside the hut (loc=54441,924). Kill him and get his head. Sheevra are also Siabra so dont kill any of them. Just pull out Nock and
kill him.
7. Back to Macnol. If the Dergan are aggressive to you again, go back and
kill Curms until they arent. Wear your ring.
8. Give the head to Macnol. He will thank you and then attack you so be
ready. His guards will defend him so either come with a group or be ready to
run.
9. Go back to Mag Mell and talk to Fagan, then give him the signet ring. You will get the ring back, and two more quest paths will open up.
Journal says you should talk to the Old or the Crone. Neither are named but
the Old is Merle the Old and the Crone is Maeve the Crone. Merle is behind
Howth on a hill and that quest is Merle's Informant. You must complete
Merles Informant before talking to Maeve. Maeve the Crone is between Ardee
and the mudman spot in a hut. Maeve will respond, but if youre less than
level 20 at this point, shell ask you to return when you are stronger.

Remember to wear Fagan's Signet!!

hibernia|stolen ore a.Name: Stolen Ore A
hibernia|stolen ore a.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: The ranger trainer in Tir Na Nog gives this quest when a newly leveled level 15 ranger comes to train.

1. You have to go to Howth and speak to Chieftain Proinnsias. Fortunately, you can grab a pony in Mag Mell and get there in a hurry if you have five silver to spare! Chieftain Proinnsias will tell you all about wanting to reclaim dominion over the silver mines for HIbernia. He will tell you about the Sheevra miners that are prospecting there now, and that they have discovered some special type of silver. The Chieftain says that the Sheevra leader, Cucugar, has some of this ore and he wants you to get it. He also warns that Cucugar is NOT alone and will be tough to take down.

2. Getting to the Sheevra mining camp: Chieftain Proinnsias gives you a set of astonishingly good directions to find Cucugar! This is unusual for DAoC quests! He tells you to go south along the western shore of the river, and swim cross just above the "stepping stone bridge" Be sure to heed his advice, because the wider lake area is infested with water badgers that con purple to a level 15 ranger. Once across the river, head in a northerly direction along the shoreline and you'll come to a "standing stone." If you miss the stone, you'll not miss all the Sheevra on the beach further north... needless to say if you meet up with them.. you've gone too far! From the standing stone, head due east. (A note here to those that do not have the compass displayed on their GUIs: Press Shift + C to activate it!) You'll go over a tall hill that is infested with several aggressive mobs (hill hounds for one) that conned purple to this level fifteen ranger. They are easily avoided. You'll go down into a valley and up another hill... continue eastward and on the other side of the hill there will be a camp. I passed through this area in daylight, and saw no inhabitants in the camp. From the camp, looking to the east-northeast you will see a tree filled blind valley. Cucugar is in this valley at the end of it (loc 59/39). If you go in high on the left hand wall, you will avoid all his troops, save the one that escorts him about.

3. Killing Cucugar: Cucugar and his escort both conned yellow to me. I used a bright oaken greater recurve bow and flight broadhead arrows to drop Cucugar before he and his escort could reach me. Then, in order to avoid melee with the fully healthy and, by then, rather hostile escort; I ran away! Upon his death, Cucugar kindly deposited the ore sample that Chieftain Proinnsias wants into my inventory.
4. The reward: Upon returning to Howth and giving Chieftain Proinnsias the ore, he will give the ore back to you, along with an "Ore Ring."

5. Last step: Chieftain Proinnsias tells you to take the ore sample to Dera, the enchanter in Mag Mell Conveniently enough, there is a return ticket to Mag Mell available with the local stablemaster in Howth! Upon doing so, you will receive the next portion of the quest that will be available to you at level 20. Return to
Dera when you reach level 20 to continue.

hibernia|strange matters indeed.Name: Strange Matters Indeed
hibernia|strange matters indeed.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to your trainer, in Tir na Nog. When you speak with your trainer she asks if you know about the dead oak by the tree northwest of Tir Na mBeo. If you accept the quest she tells you to go there and talk to the mad sprite. She tells you to find information on what a Mad Sprite is saying about the Veil. The Mad Sprite is next to a pond, northwest of Tir na mBeo. Loc 12k, 29k. When you arrive at the pond (it shows on the map that came with the game) you can find the mad sprite near a large dead tree along the north bank. When you talk to him he says something bad will happen to the Veil. You go through a dialog with him then he says 'lets go for a swim' and goes into the pond. I lost him at this point but found him again by the tree. Talking to him again he says a few things then attacks you. He then gives you a letter to give to Fagan who is in Mag Mell (who is found in the largest building in the town). Fagan reads the letter and makes reference to the same person involved in the stalker quests and says hopefully this information in the letter will never happen, and gives you a small amount of silver and about a bubble of exp (at level 7).

Blathnaid says, "I have not trained you long, but already you are my favored student. You are also one of my best. Are you familiar with the [dead oak among the trees] that circle the pond deep in the forest behind Tir na mBeo?"

Blathnaid says, "It has been the center of songs for years. It is dead, but still grows. Lately, a creature known as Mad Sprite has appeared around the tree. He circles it non-stop from mid-night to mid-day reciting [nonsensical phrases]."

Blathnaid says, "The elders of our class, and the others that follow our Path believe the Map Sprite is an oracle of sorts. An insane one, perhaps, but his message must be discovered. Speak with this Map Sprite, and see what you can glean from him."

Lines: Hiya, this is the description for the Path of Harmony epic quest, level 43
step.
1. See your trainer in TNN. Your trainer will tell you about rumors that although you killed Morven, a new danger is in the Bog of Cullen. He/She sends you to Chieftess Niamh to investigate.

2. Take a horse to Innis, talk to Chieftess Niamh. She will tell you more about these rumors, that she of course has no guards or harpers free to investigate the matter so she asks... you guessed right... she asks you to further investigate. Next one to interview is Kimba in Culraid.
3. Get a horse to Culraid from Innis and see the irbolg lady in the treehouse. She tells you about shrieking wraiths that cause trouble to
travellers and the unwary and that even the Siabra fear the wraiths. She sends you to a stranger who made his new home at the Innis Parthanan Farm, northeast of Innis.

4. Get a horse back to Innis and head northeast from the town. At the top of a small hill there is the farm and in the house there is the stranger, name is Donnchadh 57k, 26k. You two have a bit of chit chat and he tells you that you are cursed because you killed Morven's last heirs and that the only way to get rid of the curse that not only

affects you, it endangers all of Hibernia (Huzzah!), is with his help. Of course before he helps you, he wants you to do something for him. He needs a spirit sword and a spirit scabbard from 2 Dullahans.
5. Kill 2 Dullahans. Dullahans are a night spawn and can be found directly
south west of Innis. At Level 43, I did this with a 50 Bard and it was easy like stealing sweets from a baby.
6. Return the two items to the stranger at the farm and receive your reward and the next task that can't be done before level 45.

Ivory Beaded Sash -- Valewalker
String of Thoughts -- Mentalist

hibernia|unnatural powers.Name: Unnatural Powers
hibernia|unnatural powers.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: The Epic for these for classes starts at level 43 and is called Unnatural Powers, when you train with (Master Ranger Trainer in TnN was who I saw) your trainer.
He or she will tell you to talk to Lovernios, the Druid Prince in the garden behind the vault room in TnN.

He will tell you his story line & then tell you to go see & talk to Ide (loc 52k x 46k) a named Fruadan Draoi (not on beastiary list?) in the Bog of Cullen, go just a little north of Allian Bin to find her among others of her type (which are Dark Druids). She will tell you her story line.

Then you have find Saemus (loc 21k x 25k not on beastiary list either) he moves around some, but in the water all the time I was there) and kill him to get his Crystal. Seamus is around level 50 (red at 43) but not that hard to kill, bring a friend or 2 to be safe and watch out if Siabias have you on their kill on site list, lol which Im on.

Once you kill Saemus return to Lovernios & give him Seamuss Crystal, in return, after he tells his story line, he gives you 12 gold plus, almost 1.1 billion exp (about bubble and a quarter to me) along with a Emerald Threaded Forest Cloak usable by Ranger and then tells you to talk to Torrance when you are ready (for level 47, you get jewel when its completed) hes at the tower on the road to Innis Carthaig (across from Connla). For level 50 you get a full set of Epic armor, all 6 items at once so have room in storage.
Here is some more information on this quest, submitted by Diko 50 Battledruid Bedevere:
1. Speak to Lovernios in the castle, out back in the garden (head towards the vault the you'll see the opening same person you get the Seeking Glory quest.

2. Ask Ide about the [dark magic] that corrupted her friend. She can be found with the other Fruadan Draoi, in the Bog of Cullen. (just north of Allainn Binn at the rock on the road) just tell her "dark magic"
3. Find Saemus and retrieve the crystal, He roams the Bog of Cullen. (21k, 25k) neutral and we killed him orange con to 50.
4. Bring the crystal to Lovernios, so the Druid Court may study it. (Get a ridiculous cloak for rangers Emerald Threaded Forest Cloak, lvl 45, 100% quality, 20% bonus, +9 dex, 6% cold/crush, +18 HP)
5. Speak with Torrance, at the guard tower on the road to innis. When you are ready, he will set you upon the next course. Just after the bridge jump off at the guard tower.
6. Talk to Asthore in Innis Carthaig about the [crystal]. She knew the merchant that was killed. (merchant shack next to the stable guy)
7. Talk to the locals of Alainn Binn about [Ysberin]. (See Lirla and say "Ysberin")

8. Madawg, a siabra magi, killed Ysberin. Go kill Madawg just north along the lake, rangers have it easy since it'll try to cast run cast, usually kill it before it gets to you. Yellow to lvl 50. 47.5k, 12.3k Sometimes has blue con saibra as guard, instant spawn I think.
9. Bring the staff to Lovenios. (go back to TNN =p lotsa travel).
10. Speak to Brigit, in the palace in Tir na Nog, about ilisa.
11. Speak to Ilisa in Mag Mell. Deliver the letter to her. Don't lose it! It's from the Elven Court. Find out where she learned the enchantments.

12. Seek out Ainrebh in the Empyrean town of Caille. give him the gift from Ilisa, and find out more about the vile magic. Take horse towards Druim Cain and get off at Caille in the building is Ainrebh the enchanter.
13. Say Ilisa sent you. Just click on the hotlinks in the text dialog.

14. Find the hag Ainrebh spoke about. She roams the Bog of Cullen, and looks like one who is dead. Tell her you [need aid]. can be found at 42.2k, 17.1k near where you killed Madawg. Say "need aid" then "cronicorn" if needed. Kill cronicorn, Then return the Cronicorn horn to the Hag.
--Cronicorn can be found at 38k x 44k He often wanders out of the Siabra camp into the water.

--There are a couple cronicorn spawns. I found one at 40k, 33k in the bog. Purple to 50's with 2 purple siabra guards. The fight with cronicorn isn't so bad, but there is a TON of agro in the area. Very dangerous spot.
15. kinda skips over by itself (Get nice Ranger's Jewel lvl 47, 100% quality, 25% bonus, +9 dex, +3 recurve bow, 21 HP)
16. Pay heed to the rantings of these Leprechauns. (Head to Cursed Forest near Druim Cain, 33.5k, 11.5k) Talk to them to make the step change or kill the named.

17. Go to the cursed Forest, and seek out the dancing leprechauns. (steps are goofy 16 and 17 is same thing basically, but kill Luriquay orange con at 50 at that locaiton, seems only 1 per person :( so full group kill it 8 times, spawn is roughly 15-20mins per just stay away from spawn camp and rock)
Jumps to step 20

20. See if a wraith by the name Flame roams the cursed forest. A big draon looking mob will spawn on the rock SW of where Luriquay spawns after you kill it. You will have to wait for full group to finish step 17 first :( Flame is near location 46.9k, 42k spotted at 20h 19m game time.... rumors it's a night spawn. Flame is neutral but attacks :( Purple con to lvl 50. Flame hits fast and for about 152-223dmg on avg against RI, along with nukes that does 258-268dmg
21. skips over fast to 22.
22. Find Green Maw somewhere on a hill in the remnants of a tower. After you kill Green Maw 2 more lower con merman types will spawn so watch out.
Flame is not a night spawn, it is neutral to anyone not on that step of the quest but is aggro if you are on the quest even though it says neutral so be careful.
After Flame check your steps, some may still be on 21 and not advanced to 22.. steps tend to skip for some reason. If you're on 21 go kill the leprechaun again.

Green Maw is inside the ruins of the tower on top of the granny hill, to make it show itself you have to get close to the tower and it will just attack you so just go rushing near to the tower and just fight. Be careful after you kill it, it will spawn 3 red cons then 4 or 5 orange cons after that and so on til 1 green con Green Maw.

Take key to Ainrebh the enchanter in Caille, give it to her and get a token, she tells you to make room in your bag (very very important or you won't get all your stuff) give the token back and you will get your 6 pieces of armor
Approximate loc of base of the hill for the Green Maw is 42k, 35k

hibernia|magic for torrance.Name: Magic for Torrance
hibernia|magic for torrance.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Oriara says, "Blessings upon you this night, Sprig. Your progress has been not gone unobserved. Each day you walk the Path of Affinity brings you closer to being one with Nature. Yet there are many unnatural things that threaten both the world around and us. I have received word from one who strives beyond all others to remove the unnatural and restore the balance to this land. Her name is Ciarda and she is the trainer of Druids that walk the Path of Harmony. She desires that [all join together] and aid her in this fight."

Oriara says, "Ciarda has recruited a Druid by the name of Torrance to help her in this battle. Although he is in Hibernia, they share information about the magic that we use, and the magic that flows through Hy Brasil. Together they hope they can find a way to counteract some of the evil influence that Fomorian have had on our land. Yet they cannot do this work alone. They have asked all who walk the Path of Affinity to join with them and solve this problem. Will you [answer Ciarda's call] for help?"
You have been given the Magic for Torrance quest.
Oriara says, "The earth and the sky sing with happiness that you join in this endeavor. Go now to Ciarda, for she awaits you. She will tell you more of the work she and the Druid Torrance are doing."

Ciarda says, "I'm glad you answered my call, Sprig. My work with Torrance of Hibernia is vital to the protection of this fair land. If he and I can discover some way to protect the land from the influence of the Fomorian, it would help to turn the tide in our direction. As a Sylvan, I know many of the secrets of this land that now fail us with the coming of the Fomorian and I have shared these secrets with Torrance in hopes that he will be able to [tap into the same magic] that the Sylvan use."

Ciarda says, "He has had some success, although it is difficult to tell since he is not here to test it upon the plants and animals of this land. I have tested some of the spells he has developed, but since I possess the magic naturally, I am not a good judge. Torrance and I have come up with [a solution to this problem]."

Ciarda says, "The magic should work upon plants and animals of this land, but they have become far to wild to take to Hibernia safely. I believe that if we are able to get a root from a tendril weed, Torrance will be able to nurture it until it grows into a tendril weed he can use. As for the animals, Torrance said he doesn't actually need a live creature to work with, just [some part of it]."

Ciarda says, "I know it is not the most pleasant thought, but it will do the job. If it means that he will know if he is truly drawing upon the magic of Hy Brasil, it is worth it. Once you get the root from the tendril weed, seek out a callow forest grazer. You'll need to get a hoof from it. That will be enough for Torrance to work with. Now, go and seek out a tendril weed. When you have everything, return to me here."

[kill a tendril weed then a callow forest grazer for the two items - they can both be found just to the northwest of the first guard outpost down the main road out of Domnan (loc=22k 30k). Both are green to a Level 7 character.]
Ciarda says, "Were you able to obtain the root of the tendril weed? Please give it to me now."
Ciarda takes the root and packs it carefully in a box.
Ciarda says, "Thank you. Torrance will appreciate your hard work. Now, if you were able to obtain the grazer hoof, he will be very pleased."
Ciarda stores the grazer hoof in the box next to the root.

Ciarda says, "You have done well, Sprig. I know that the future of Hy Brasil is in better hands knowing there are people of the Paths of Harmony and Affinity out there protecting our precious lands. Take this with the thanks of both Torrance and myself. I hope that if we should need your services again, you will answer our call. Blessed be, Sprig!"
You are awarded 1,408 experience!
You are awarded 7 silver and some copper!
You have finished the Magic for Torrance quest.
You receive Forest Strider's belt from Ciarda!

hibernia|silver run.Name: Silver Run
hibernia|silver run.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: #Talk to the Warden Trainer (Yori) in the Grove of Domnann.#
Yori says, "Elline, You're familiar with Crace by now, right? He's got a scheme, and he wants help. He's found a trader in silver who claims to have some [special] silver."
Yori says, "Yes. He is looking for adventurers willing to help him out. He says this trader is reliable, and is offering enchanted silver!"
Yori says, "I'm sure Crace will reward you again. Talk to Crace, he'll tell you more."
Crace is standing outside the bind stone area, next to a tree. Talk to him.
Crace says, "Ah, you're here to help me, are you? Well, you know about the [enchanted silver] in the Silvermine Mountains, in Hibernia?"

Crace says, "Aye, Well, it's mainly controlled by those evil siabra local to the area, however, I've a friend who has managed to get a large amount of the silver. See, we've come up with a trade. The next boat leaves for Hibernia shortly, and I don't have the time to go and get everything to trade myself. See, there are many things here that may be valuable back in the mainland. I've arranged a trade. All I need right now, though, is two sporites."

At this point, you run straight down the road, until you pass the second guard tower. Sporites are all over the area, and you can easily kill two. "sporite remains" appear in your backpack. Return to Crace and talk with him.
Crace says, "Well, Elline, did you get the sporites? i understand that if you dry them out, they become quite useful. Well, that's what some of the Sylvan have told me!"
Give him the first "sporite remains".
Crace says, "Oh, this is a good one! I need just one more from you. Do you have it?"
Give him the second "sporite remains".

Crace says, "Great. Now, I just need one more thing. Now, have you seen the precocious cniogcrags? I would like one of them. I've a friend who wants it for display, why, I don't know. He wants to hang it on his wall. As an exotic type of beast."

Run back to the second tower... precocious cniogcrags are found across the road, or behind the tower. Pulling one with bow & arrow is recomended, as I've found they tend to come in groups if you get close to them. You recieve a "cniogcrag corpse". Return to speak with Crace.
Crace says, "Oh, did you get the creature? Hand it over!"
Give him the "cniogcrag corpse".
Crace says, "Ah, great! Thank you! Now, you certainly should receive a [reward] for your efforts!"
Crace says, "Here, you surely do. I hope you find it useful, Warden! Thanks again for your help! Hopefully, this enchanted silver my, ahh, friend, is sending will make a difference here!"
You are awarded 11 silver and some copper!
You are awarded 15, 928 exp!
You have finished the Silver Run quest.
You recieve Boots of Agility from Crace!

hibernia|criostoin's promise.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Find Kimba in Lough Gur, in the forest. Very easy, from Connla or Innis, take a horse to Culraid and enter the tree. Say 'Criostoin' to Kimba, she will tell you the story of Criostoin and send you to Siobhan in Innis.

Siobhan tells you to go to the pond where are Merush (sp) and Tritons and speak with Meriach. The easy way to go to the pond is to take the horse back to Culraid then go South. The exact location of the pound is 11k-31k.

When at the pound, I only see 3 Merush and 2 Tritons, all neutral and conned purple to my lvl20 Enchanteress. I ran all around the pond, seeking in the trees for Meriach. Nothing.... Then, suddenly, in the middle of the pond I saw Meriach, a very tall Merush. Right clic on mob, and immediately she gave me the Criostoin's Promise (a wand) and told me to bring it to Ainrebh in Caille.
After a long long long travel by horses, I gave the wand to Ainrebh and got the big reward: some xp and 7 slivers :(
This end the Criostoin's Promise quest and allow to continue the Seek the Moonstone quest.
From Innis Carthaig ( at the stable boy) I swam west to the (left) tip of the island and continued west beyond and across the hils and came right to the lake of Merman

hibernia|merle's informant.Name: Merle's Informant
hibernia|merle's informant.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This comes after doing the Seek the Moonstone Quest.
1. Outside Mag Mell there is a little lurikeen Tracker. Target him and say [Moonstone] and he will direct you to Merle, talking about a Creeper who stole a crown.

2. Horse to Howth. Behind Howth and up the hill is a hut. Merle the Old is always up. Target him and say [Creeper]. Now an NPC named Tracker wanders the area near Merle. Some people say you should wait for him and target him then say "Moonstone" but if you have done so with the Tracker outside Mag Mell, you can skip this.

3. From Ardagh, cross the lake to the Siabra Island with two houses and an upside down boat. Creeper is hiding at the boat (Lough Derg, Loc 42 58). Talk to him and get a crown for Maeve. Take the crown to Maeve. Now she will talk to you. This ends the Merle's Informant quest and enables you to continue the "Seek the Moonstone" quest, but if you are not lvl 20, Maeve will tell you you are not strong enough.

hibernia|miari's seed.Name: Miari's Seed
hibernia|miari's seed.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: this is the lv 1 quest for guardians starting in grove of domnann
Your trainer, Searlait tells you to speak with Miari in the Grove of Domnann.
[Step #1] Talk to Miari in the Grove of Domnann.
Miari says "Blessings of the Grove upon you, Guardian! You are the one Searlait sent, are you not? What be thy name?"
- tell her your name -
Miary says "A fine name, ***! I am called Miari, and I am one of the grove keepers of Domnann. I tend the seeds that shall one
day grow to be trees like these, or they would if my seeds did not [keep disapearing]."

Miari says "When the groves started to be destroyed by the unnatural Fomorian, we that tend the seeds rushed to the groves. We risked our own lives to gather as many seeds and seedlings as we could, for all feared that some rare trees would be lost

forever to the hate of the Fomorian. Thoug some of us were lost to the evil Fomorian, many of us were able to return here to the Grove. I have gathered all the seeds we saved and sorted them into pouches. I've stored all the different pouches in these chests. Lately, I found the chests open and [pouches missing]!"

Miari says "The other night I caught side of a lesser sylvanshade leaving here carrying something brown. I believe it had one of my seed pouches. The lesser sylvanshades never bothered us before the Fomorian came, but their evil presence has disturbed many creatures of the wood, including the sylvanshades. I fear the

Fomorian may have even coerced the sylvanshades into stealing the seeds to prevent we Sylvan from restoring the groves. I would go out and search for the thief myself, but i must guard the chests and tend to some delicate seedlings. You must go now and search for
the lesser sylvanshade that has the stole seed pouch. Return to me when you have retrieved it.
[Step #2] Find a lesser sylvanshade and get the pouch of seeds from it.
They can be found northwest of the entrance to the Grove of Domnann.
The lesser sylvanshades are everywhere round the Grove so go, kill one and retrieve the pouch.
[Step #3] Return to Miari in the Grove of Domnann.
Miari says "***! I am pleased to see you have returned. Were you able
to retrieve the pouch from the sylvanshade? Please, i must check the seeds."
[Step #4] Turn in the pouch of seeds to Miari.

Miari says "Ah, they are unharmed! These seeds were from some of the rarest trees we have grown. Alas, this handful of seeds is all that remains of the trees, for the Fomorian have destroyed all others. Please,
take this in thanks for rescuing these very precious seeds. Now i must go and encourage these seeds into strong, healthy trees. May the sun always warm your roots, ***!
You are awarded 6 silver and some copper!
You are awarded 11 experience!
You have finished the Miari's Seed quest.

hibernia|misdelivered letter.Name: Misdelivered Letter
hibernia|misdelivered letter.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Your trainer asks you to talk to one of the merchants in town (Erdola sp?). She's a firbolg standing outside the

building Keagan is in. She will give you a letter to take to another merchant two buildings over. She will tell you it should go to Eli the enchanter (who is standing right next to her in the same building). Give the letter to Eli and the quest is complete. I do not remember all the names, but since everything in Connla is clumped together this quest only takes a couple of minutes to complete. A little experience.
This is a good starter quest. You never leave your village takes maybe 5 min. and I, at least, got 4 bubbles experience before I even killed a single thing!

hibernia|slevin's powder.Name: Slevin's Powder
hibernia|slevin's powder.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Your trainer in Connla asks you to deliver some mist powder to the guard outside town. Across the bridge is a tower (visible from the town). The guard (whose name escapes me) is outside that tower. Just take the road or swim across the river (swimming is fastest) and hand the powder to the guard. You'll get a little copper and some experience.

Ennis says, "Have you time to do a favor for me? I've promised Slevin some mist powder. It's very hard to get, and he's paid me quite some money in advance, but I can't travel with this fever I've got. There's some money for you, if you do."
Dialog box: Will you deliver this powder to Slevin?
You have been given the Slevin's Powder quest.
Ennis says, "Here, take the powder to Slevin at the guard tower on the road past the bridge. You can keep the portion of the money he pays you, for your effort."
You receive a mist powder from Ennis!
[Step #1] Bring this powder to Slevin at the guard tower.
Slevin says, "Hi. Brave aren't you, coming out here? What can I do for you?"
You give the mist powder to Slevin.
Slevin says, "Ah, you've brought me the mist powder promised me! Thank you. This will bring me a nice fortune. Here, now, here's the portion I prmoised Bran. Now, have you heard of [Roane Maidens]?"
You are awarded 42 copper!
[Step #2] Speak with Slevin about [Roane Maidens].

Slevin says, Roane Maidens are enchanted creatures. They can take the form of both roanes and mortals. However, roanes can never be separated from their skin. Without their skin, roanes can't return to their true form. The problem is, once a land borne man gets sight of a roane maiden, he generally can't get her out of this head. They're beautiful. So, oftentimes, a lonely fisherman who comes across a maiden falls in love. Often they do marry. But then longing begins. After so long away from the sea, the roane maidens wish to return. But if their skin is hidden from them, they are trapped on land. Generally, the men hide them. But that never works. They always find their way to the sea."
You are awarded 160 experience!
You have finished the Slevin's Powder quest.
Also reported you receive 4 silver and some copper.

hibernia|tadhg's lost treasure.Name: Tadhg's Lost Treasure
hibernia|tadhg's lost treasure.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per patch 1.69:

- Tadhg's Lost Treasure - Players between levels 1 and 11 that have completed this quest may return to Tadhg in Connla to receive an addtional reward for the quest. Tadhg will now give this reward as part of the quest.
Tadhg, a firbolg NPC in Connla starts.
Tadhg says, "Greetings friend. I welcome you to Connla. I know this is somewhat abrupt, but I don't suppose you're looking for a little [adventure], are you?

Tadhg says, "Great! I have lost something that is important to me, an item my mother gave me when I was young. It was taken from me in the middle of the night. I noticed some [footprints] outside my window the next morning."
Tadhg says, "Aye, they matched those of the beach rats around here, but with all that's been happening lately I haven't had a chance to search for it.
Do you think you have the time to help me get it back?"
Dialog Box:

Tadhg says, "Great! This is wonderful. I'd truly appreciate your assistance in this matter. My mother gave me a special locket with her picture inside. I have always kept it with me, until it was taken. I know one of the beach rats has it. Please find it for me."
Kill a beach rat, and it drops a Golden Necklace.
Return the Necklace to Tadhg.
You are awarded 3 silver and some copper!
Tadhg says, "Ah, you've found the necklace, but... where is the locket? Hmmm... I wonder if one of the crabs got to it... Do you think you could [check] and see if the crabs have my locket?"
Tadhg says, "Thanks (player name). I know you will find the locket for me."
Kill a large number of crabs. (It doesn't drop on the first one.) Eventually, one will drop Tadhg's Locket. Return this to Tadhg.
Tadhg says, "Oh! My locket! How can I thank you, (player name). I know, here are a few silver pieces for all the trouble you've gone through."
You are awarded experience!
You have finished the Tadhg's Lost Treasure quest.
You are awarded 3 silver and some copper!
Rewards:
Faded Old Blue Vest
Faded Old Blue Robe

hibernia|way of arms -- learn the paths.Name: Way of Arms -- Learn the Paths
hibernia|way of arms -- learn the paths.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Given by your starting trainer. Gets you very good experience. This is particularly easy in Connla since all of the masters are centrally located right in town.
If you are unlucky enough to have started your career in one of the other towns you may have quite a bit of running to do for this quest. Just go and talk to each master and return to your trainer.

hibernia|way of magic - learn the paths.Name: Way of Magic - Learn the Paths
hibernia|way of magic - learn the paths.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Your Trainer will tell you to go and learn about the paths.
*Elf Version*

Anwar says, "Hail. You've come to learn about the Path of Essence. Those who follow the Path of Essence believe that magic is part of everything, and is all around us. Enchanters believe magic is a tool, and we use that tool in everything we do."
Etain says, "It is my duty to train you in the Way of Magic. Soon, you must [choose a path]. I am sending you out to learn about all the different paths now, so you may consider your choice wisely."
Dialog box: Do you intend to seek out the masters of paths you must one day choose from?
You have been given the Way of Magic - Learn the Paths quest.
[Step #1] Speak to Anwar, in Tir na Nog, about the Path of Essence.
Anwar says, "To learn about the Path of Harmony, speak with the Mentalist Aindreas in Ardagh, south of Mag Mell, or Ena, in Tir na Nog. They know more about that path than any other."
[Step #2]To learn about the Path of Harmony, speak with the Mentalist Aindreas in Ardagh, south of Mag Mell, or Ena, in Tir na Nog. The know more about that path than any other.

Ena says, "You've come to learn about the Path of Harmony. Mentalists follow this path because we draw strength from the understanding that everything works together, that the magical world and the non-magical world are really the same world. There is a balance between magic and non-magic, It's only when both are used together that there is harmony."
Ena says, "Seek out Coman, in Ardagh, or Aodh, in the city of Tir na Nog, to learn about the Path of Focus."
[Step #3]Seek out Coman, in Ardagh, or Aodh, in the city of Tir na Nog, to learn about the Path of Focus.

Aodh says, "So, you have come to learn about the Path of Focus? Those that follow this path believe in directing the energy that permeates us into perfecting their skills. As an eldritch, I concentrate this energy into the practice of magic."
Aodh says, "Now that you understand the different paths open to you, I hope when your time comes, you will choose wisely. Choose the one you believe in, and then you will choose correctly."
You have finished the Way of Magic - Learn the Paths quest.
You are awarded experience!
*Celt Version*
Adair says, "It is my duty to train you in the Way of Magic. Soon, you must [choose a path]. I am sending you out to learn about all the different paths now, so you may consider your choice wisely."

Adair says, "If you dread traveling far, please [tell me now], or you will find yourself running quite a bit. There are three Paths to choose from: The [Path of Essence], the [Path of Harmony], and the [Path of Focus]. Not all paths may be open to you."
Dialog box: Do you intend to seek out the masters of paths you must one day choose from?
You have been given the Way of Magic - Learn the Paths quest.
Adair says, "Very well then. No need tosend you all the way to Ardagh! Speak will Cadalind, at the Guard Tower on the road North, from outside Howth. She will explain the Path of Essence."
[Step #1] Seek out Cadalind at the guard tower on the road north from this town.
[Step #2]Return to Howth and speak with Keriann to learn the Path of Harmony.
Keriann says, "Hello traveler, what brings you to our small [hamlet]?"

Keriann says, "Oh! Another one wanting to know about the Path of Harmony, eh? Well, I'm not a Mentalist, but I've studied their ways. Mentalists draw strength from understanding that everything works together, that the magical world and the non-magical world are really the same world. There is a balance between magic and non-magic. It's only when both are used together that there is harmony. Now, go speak with Cadalind, at the guard tower, to learn of the Path of Focus. Yes, Yes, I know you already spoke with her, but I've not studied the path Eldritches follow."
[Step #3] Return to Cadalind to learn about the Path of Focus.

Cadalind says, "I presume you are back to learn about the Path of Focus? I forget Cadalind knows little of this Path. Eldritches follow this Path. They believe the energy that permeates all of Hibernia, including us, its people, can be directed into a talent or ability. They focus the energy into magic, and spend all their abilities learning to control and direct that power. That is the Path they follow. Now, think well, for one day you will need to choose a Path."
You have finished the Way of Magic - Learn the Paths quest.
You are awarded experience!

hibernia|way of stealth - learn the path.Name: Way of Stealth - Learn the Paths
hibernia|way of stealth - learn the path.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per Read File Fix Jan 02, 2002:
Learn the Paths - Stalkers: Lurikeen Stalkers should now be able to continue on this quest by speaking with Macawld in the Grove of Domnann.

Ula says, "I can teach you the Way of Stealth. Beyond the way lie two paths that you must choose from. I suggest you speak with a Ranger and a Nightshade now, to give you more time to consider your path."
Dialog box: Do you intend to seek out the masters of the paths you must one day choose from?
You have been given the Way of Stealth - Learn the Paths quest.
Ula says, "Well, there are two paths you may choose from: The [Path of Essence] and the [Path of Focus]."
[Step #1] Choose which path you wish to learn about, first.
I choose Path of Essence, it was first on the list, heh.
Ula says, "Speak with either Blathnaid in Tir na Nog, or Leachlainn, in Ardagh, south on the road outside of Ardee, North from Howth, to learn about the Path of Essence."
[Step #1] (again /sigh) Speak with either Blathnaid in Tir na Nog, or Leachlainn, in Ardagh, south on the road outside of Ardee, North from Howth, to learn about the Path of Essence.

Blathnaid says, "Yes, Nightshades do follow the Path of Essence. Is that so odd? Those who follow the Path of Essence believe that magic is a part of everything and everyone. We use that essence to achieve our own means. What else would we do?"
Blathnaid says, "Speak with a Ranger, either Mavelle in Tir na Nog, outside Magmell, or Teague, further south, in Ardagh. From Howth, head North to Ardagh, and Northwest past Tir na mBeo."
[Step #2] Speak with a Ranger, either Mavelle in Tir na Nog, outside Mag Mell, or Teague, further south, in Ardagh. From Howth, head North to Ardagh, and Northwest past Tir na mBeo.

Mavelle says, "Hail. It should come as no surprise to you that Rangers follow the Path of Focus. We believe in directing the energy that permeates us into perfection of our skills. In our field, concentration is essential, and distraction can be deadly."
Mavelle says, "Now that you understand the different paths open to you, I hope when your time comes, you will choose wisely. Choose the one you believe in, and then you will choose correctly."
You have finished the Way of Stealth - Learn the Paths quest.
You are awarded 20 experience!
You are awarded 2 silver and some copper!

hibernia|wild wilderness.Name: Wild Wilderness
hibernia|wild wilderness.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Miach says, "There was once a time when all of Hy Brasil was tame. There was once a time when nature's beasts were tame. Now, though, the creatures we once had no reason to fear, have become aggressive. They kill not just for food, but for pleasure. They no longer only kill their normal prey. Now, the [hunt] us."

Miach says, "Aye. It is not their normal way. I believe it is the evil touch of the Fomorians! They have ruined the homes of many of these creatures, they have destroyed their hunting grounds, and now, some of the creatures have become twisted and abhorrent! The beasts I speak of, close to our town, the lungers, we must get ird of them!
Dialog box: Will you help rid the area of young lungers?
You have been given the Wild Wilderness quest.
Miach says, "Great! While you are at it, bring one of the lunger tails to Resalg. He will pay you well for it. He is trying to create some potion. I told him I'd acquire a tail for him."
[Step #2] Kill a lunger for its tail. They can be found just outside the gates of Domnann.
You receive a lunger tail from the lunger!
You get 5 experience points!
[Step #3] Bring the tail to Resalg in Grove of Donmann
Resalg says, "What can I do for you, fine Forester?"
Give Resalg the lunger tail.
Resalg says, "Ah! You've brought me a lunger tail! Now, I'm not sure if this is going to work, but I think it just might, yes, it just might. You see, I'm working on a special [formula]."
[Step #3(again)] Talk to Resalg about the [formula].

Resalg says, "Aye. It will calm down the maddened animals, I think. I can't truly be sure, but I'm hoping so! Some of the animals have even been mutated, since the Fomorian's arrival, you know. I blame the foulness of that maleficent race! I would like to aid the Sylvan, I would like to see this ravaged land restored, and the peaceful balance that has taken generations upon generations to develop, once again restored. Aye, and I'll not lie, but I'm willing to bet I'd have a name, if I were to aid the process in some way! Maybe some prestige! Ah, but to work, yes, to work now. Here, I shall pay you for this tail! Good day, friend!"
You are awarded 6 silver and some copper!
You earn 2 outpost bonus experience~
You are awarded 20 experience!
You have finished the Wild Wilderness quest.

hibernia|balm hunt.Name: Balm Hunt
hibernia|balm hunt.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This quest is triggered by your trainer at level 2. Go talk to Fyrsil and he will ask you to collect the ingredients for him to make a balm:
From what I can tell, the ingredients seem to vary by class, so just follow his instructions.
Collect the ingredients and bring them back to Fyrsil for some decent money and experience.

hibernia|connla's fever.Name: Connla's Fever
hibernia|connla's fever.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Your trainer in Connla will ask you to talk to Keaghan about curing the fever in town. He will ask you to get two bits of mud from mudmen (which can be found by exiting the door beside Keagen and turning towards the hills on your left) and either a shinbone from a skeleton pawn or a sandcake from a sandman (both of which can be found in the fields just outside the door beside Keagan). The quest items will appear automatically in your inventory when you kill the relevant creatures. No need to pick anything up. Note that you CAN sell quest items, so do NOT sell these by accident.
Keagan says, "Have you come to collect the ingredients so that I may [cure the town] of this horrid fever going around?"

Keagan says, "It's truly a miracle you've not been affected. I think I can make a poultice or a brew that will break the fever, but I'm too weak with it myself to go and get the ingredients. It's nothing difficult really. Do you know [what is needed]?"
You have been given the Connla's Fever quest.

Kaegan says, "First, I need two bits of mud. You can collect t hem from the mudmen wandering just outside the village. Then, I'll need, oh, the fever has taken my mind, I can't remember if I need a dried sand cake from a sandman or the shinbones from a skeletal pawn. Oh, and I need to rest. I can't think of which one it is. It's one or the other. When you get the ingredients, bring them to me. I'm going to lie down and rest while you collect the ingredients."
[Step #2] Collect two bit of mud from two mudmen.
[Step #3] Kill one sandman for a dried sand cake, or a skeletal pawn for its shin bone.
Pawn is easier, quicker kill.
[Step #4] Bring the ingredients to Keagan.
Keagan says, "Rhodry, you're back. Oh wait, you're not Rhodry... this fever is making me lose my memory. I hope you have the ingredients. Here, give me a bit of mud first."
Keagan says, "Thank you Talelia. Now hand me that second bit of mud please."
Keagan says, "Good, good. Okay, hand me the shin bones. I'll take forever to grind these, but it must be done."
Keagan says, "Ah thank you, Ereex, ah, got you name right! Well, let me put this together for the towns people. This should surely cure the fever."
You have finished the Connla's Fever quest.
You are awarded experience!

hibernia|please deliver!.Name: Please Deliver!
hibernia|please deliver!.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Ula says, "Greetings. Do you [have time] to do me a favor?"
Ula says, "I realize you are recent to this area, and may not know the locals or the land, but I appreciate it. Could you deliver a letter to a merchant for me?
Dialog box: Will you deliver this letter for me?
You have been given the Please Deliver! quest.
Ula says, "I appreciate [the favor]. I would deliver it myself, but it would look a bit suspicious if it came from me. It involves some information I've acquired."

Ula says, "Deliver this letter to Dirmyg. He's usually found at the merchant shops across from the guard tower on the road south toward Tir na mBeo. If he's feeling talkative, he might even tell you about the Caoranoch."
You receive a letter from Ula!
[Step #1] Deliver this letter to Dirmyg. He is usually at the merchant shops across from the guard tower South on the road toward Tir na mBeo.
Dirmyg says, "Are you interested in purchasing something? Or do you have [other business] with me?"
Dirmyg says, "Ah you are here to deliver a letter? I am expecting one from Tir na mBeo. May I have the letter?"
You give the letter to Dirmyg.
Dirmyg says, "Thank you. Wait a moment please."
Dirmyg reads the letter.

Dirmyg says, "I hope you don't mind if I read this out loud: Cyana is training hard to be a Stalker. Please, if it's not too much trouble, help acquaint Cyana to the area by sharing some local tales."

Dirmyg says, "Well, I suppose no harm could come from telling you of the Lough Derg Lake monsters, eh? We call it Caoranoch. Not sure if there's more than one, but let me tell you, the creature is huge! A giant worm! The say they're all female. Say that the Caoranoch will devour a man whole! And keep it in its belly for weeks! Why, that fool Conan Mac Morna is now called Conan Muil! After being swallowed by that beast and suffering a lot of misfortune in her belly, he came out bald! Aye, I bet if you ever found him, he'd have a tale to tell, and a favor to ask, if that same demon still hunts the lake! Though I hear some tell the beast was throuwn in a lake in Lough Gur by an angry giant!"
You are awarded 40 experience!
You are awarded 4 silver and some copper!
You have finished the Please Deliver! quest.

hibernia|protecting the groves.Name: Protecting the Groves
hibernia|protecting the groves.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Searlait says "Welcome back. Mirari and I spoke recently. She complemented you on your skills in retrieving the lost pouch of seeds. She's taken those seeds and sprouted them. She showed me some of the seedlings and the ones [under her care] are doing well."

Searlait says " Some of the seedlings have gotten too big for her to keep inside, so she has planted them outside the walls of the Grove. Mirari told me that out there she will be able to keep an eye on the
seedlings until they are stronger. Once they are strong enough, she and
others will take them to their permanent homes in new groves. We shall help the Sylvans [protect thoses groves] from the evil of the Fomorian."

Searlait says "Mirari needs help now protecting the seedlings so they can grow into the great trees you see around us now. She has asked for your help again, for she fears there is some evil afoot in her newly planted groves. Will you [go to her] and help her again?"
You have been given the Protecting the Groves quest.
Searlait says "Mirari and I both had a feeling you would say yes. She asked that you come to her now, so that she may tell you more of what
she needs. Go to her now, and show the Fomorian they destroy the precious spirit of the Sylvan!"
[Step #1] Go speak with Mirari in the Grove of Domnann
Mirari says "Blessings of the Grove upon you. It is good to see you again. Since you retrieved the seed pouch for me I have not seen any

creatures prowling around the chests again. I offer the thanks of the Grove for that. Those seeds have begun to sprout and I have planted some of the seedlings outside the walls of the Grove. But I fear [for their safety]."
Mirari says "Shortly after I planted them, I noticed some tracks around the seedlings. Then yesterday morning, as the sun's rays touched the
leaves and filled the world with warmth, I went to the grove of seedlings. I was saddened by what I saw. Many of the seedlings had been
dug up! Their delicate roots had been ripped from the ground and their tender leaves eaten. Out of the corner of my eye, I [saw the creatures] I belieave are responsible for this horrible act!"

Mirari says "A pair of forest grazer calves slunk off into the trees. I am sure that they are the creatures that are tearing up my seedlings and feasting upon them. Before the Fomorian came, the calves never bothered the seedlings but ate the grass instead. I fear that the change in their
habits has been caused by the evil of the Fomorian. Some of these seedlings are the last of their kind. You must [protect them]!"

Mirari says "Go now and seek out the forest grazer calves. I know you cannot stop all of them, but stopping two of them would help a great deal. I do not like to deal with creatures in this manner, but I must
protect my trees at all costs! If they have any of my seedlings, bring them back to me and I shall try to save them. I wish you luck."
[Step #2] Stop two forest grazer calves from destroying Mirari's deedlings. They can be found northeast of the entrance to the Grove of Domnann.
kill one....
[Step #3] Kill one more forest grazer calf from tearing up the seedlings
in Mirari's grove. They can be found northeast of the entrance to the Grove of Domnann.
kill the second...
[Step #4] Return to Mirari in the Grove of Domnann.
Mirari says "Did the sun smile upon you? Were you able to rid the seedling grove of the horrible forest grazer calves? Did you retrieve any seedlings?"
[Step #5] Turn in one of the seedlings to Mirari
Mirari says "Ah, this one is in poor condition, but that is not your fault. I shall do what I can to help bring it back. With warm sun and
cool water it may grow yet. Did you find any more?"
[Step #6] Give Mirari the second seedling you recovered.
Mirari says "This one is in much better condition! I shall replant this one soon. Only a few of the leaves are torn and the roots are not
damaged. With a little care, this seedling will one day be a great tree that will withstand the evil of the Fomorian! I am in your debt!
Twice now you have helped me save the trees. Please, take this in thanks and know that the trees shall soon whisper your name in praise. May the
rain always be gentle upon your leaves!"
You are awarded 5 silver and some copper!
You are awarded 22 experience!
You have finished the Protecting the Groves quest.

hibernia|shade of a grove.Name: Shade of a Grove
hibernia|shade of a grove.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Miach says, "(your name), I've spoken with Liisu. Do you know, she wants us to go after the [sylvanshades]!"
Miach says, "The sylvanshades are strange creatures of darkness. They exist opposite the Sylvan, but where the Sylvan are nurturing, they are destructive. Liisu wants help protecting the groves."
Dialob box: Will you help protect the groves from the sylvanshades?
You have been given the Shade of a Grove quest.
Miach says, "Great! Talk with Liisu now."
[Step #2] Speak with Liisu. Tell her your name, if she asks.
Liisu says, "Ah, Forester, what would your name be?"
Tell Liisu your name.

Liisu says, "Ah. I did not expect anyone so soon. But I'm glad you are here. You are here to help me, right? I would like you to save a grove that the lesser sylvanshades are doing quite a destructive number on. These groves have been with us for so long, and we've lost so many already. Please, help us save this one! I need yo uto go find two of the lesser sylvanshades that are wrecking this grove! Rrturn them to me when you have them. Please find them before there is no chance for me to heal the grove! Bring me anything you find on them please! I've lost so many seeds!"
[Step #3] Help Liisu rid the area of lesser sylvanshades, and collect two seed pouches she lost.
Kill some lesser sylvanshades, these are located to the right and down the hill from the Grove gate.
[Step #4] Return the seed pouches to Liisu.

Liisu says, "Oh, (your name), have you found two of my seed pouches? I think there are more, but so many have offered to aid me that I've gottem most of them back, and haven't had time to count it! I'm going to plant these in the groves that were damages. Maybe the new growth will stimulate the groves! I am horrified that the sylvanshades even exist! It does make sense, though, with all the Fomorian evil corrupting the land. Well then, give it here!"
Give Liisu a seed pouch.
You are awarded 5 silver and some copper!
Liisu says, "Oh great! This one is still full, too! The horrid beasts didn't eat many of the seeds from this pouch! You should have seen some of the ones I've gotten returned to me!"
Give Liisu the second seed pouch.
Liisu says, "Thank you, (your name)!"
You earn 2 outpost bonus experience!
You are awarded 20 experience!
You have finished the Shade of a Grove quest.
You are awarded 5 silver and some copper!

hibernia|troya's research.Name: Troya's Research
hibernia|troya's research.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per patch 1.69:
- Troya's Research - Players between levels 2 and 12 that have completed this quest may return to Troya in Howth to receive an addtional reward. Troya will now give this reward as part of the quest.
Click on Troya, a lurikeen in Howth.
Troya says, "Welcome to Howth, (player name), it's always nice to see a (player race) about. Do you [have time] to help me with a little project?"

Troya says, "Excellent! I have been doing some research into the local wildlife here and have come up with some rather amazing results. I have but [two more items] I need to complete my research to present to Cathbad."
Troya says, "Yes, are you ready to get started?"
Dialog box:

Troya says, "Wonderful! Here is what you must do. Out in the small grove on your way towards Ardagh live some water beetle larva. I need for you to get me the skin of one of these creatures. When you have it, return to me."
Go out and kill a water beetle larva. It drops a Larva Skin. Return the skin to Troya.

Troya says, "Ah, the skin! Thank you so much. Here is a little something for your troubles. Now, for my second item. I need the [tibia] of a skeletal pawn. It is said the magical properties of the undead have yet to be fully understood."
You are awarded 4 silver and some copper!
You are awarded 20 experience!

Troya says, "Yes, friend. The tibia is one of the arm bones on a person. It is thought that anything relating to the arm means strength. I would like to discern the magical properties of an undead's bone. Return to me when you have it."
Go out and kill a skeletal pawn. It drops a Tibia. Return the tibia to Troya.
Troya says, "Oh, thank you, (player name.) I know these will come in handy for my research. I hope this coin will serve you well in your coming days. Thank you again for your bravery and honesty."
You are awarded 4 silver and some copper!
You are awarded 20 experience!
Reward:
Reed Bracer

hibernia|balance of nature.Name: Balance of Nature
hibernia|balance of nature.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This is given to Naturalists at level 3. Your trainer asks you to go help out a poor creature at the pond southwest of Tir Na mBeo. She gives you a fish to try to appease him. Sabha hangs out near the pond. When you give him the fish, he decides you would make a better meal and attacks. He killed me, and when I returned next level and killed him, I only got some experience, so I don't know if there is a reward if you kill him the first time.
Reward:
Band of Woven Twigs

hibernia|information is the key.Name: Information is the Key
hibernia|information is the key.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Your path on this quest depends on your race, talk you your trainer for details.
Adair says, "It is time you learned a bit about Hibernia. Speak with Merle. He is very old, and knows a lot about this land."
Dialog box: Will you collect and deliver these items to gain information from this old one?
You have been given the Information is the Key quest
[Step #1]Speak with Merle about the Moonstone.
Merle the Old says, "What brings one of Macigians out here? You don't think I [will speak] with you, do you?"
Merle the Old says, "Aye, more visitors than I've had in years! More than I've wanted in years, or still want."
Merle the Old says, "Well, I might. Perhaps. If you bring me back the mud from four mudmen. It has its uses, you know. Yes, that will do. Then perhaps I will speak with you."
[Step #2]Kill four mudmen and bring bit of mud to Merle. In exchange, he'll tell you about the Unnamed Rogue.
[Step #3]Kill three more mudmen and bring bit of mud to Merle.
[Step #4]Kill two more mudmen and bring bit of mud to Merle.
[Step #5]Kill one more mudman and bring bit of mud to Merle.
[Step #6]Return to Merle with all this mud so he'll tell you what he knows about the named Rogue.
Merle the Old says, "Did you get me the mud?"
[Step #7]Give Merle the mud.
You give Merle the Old a bit of mud.
Merle the Old says, "Ah this is good. I'll need three more. Yo udo know there's silver in these mountains? That's why all these siabra miners are crawling around here."
You give Merle the Old a bit of mud.
Merle the Old says, "Better. I'll want two more. Oh, you'll want to be careful in the mountains. I'd avoid them if I were you."
You give Merle the Old a bit of mud.
Merle the Old says, "Oooh, you've done well. I only need one more."
You give Merle the Old a bit of mud.
Merle the Old says, "Well then. You've kept your part. I'll speak of one thing with you. Which would you have me speak of, [the Unnamed One], [Lobais], or [Blaieseach]"?
According to the journal you want to click on the Unnamed One.

Merle the Old says, "Ah yes, He seeks the Moonstone, rumored to be in Lough Derg. It's a powerful item of enchantment. If ye seek it, be careful, for many seek it. If you do find it, then beware, for Blaieseach will then seek you with his trackers."
You have finished the Information is the Key quest.
You are awarded experience!

hibernia|magic in the grove.Name: Magic in the Grove
hibernia|magic in the grove.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: 1 - Got this from trainer at level 3, Mirari needs help again. So go speak with her and she tells you she thinks the problem is the formorian evil is causing her seeds to grow all wrong.

2 - Kill 3 bantam shrouders for their tentacles so Mirari can make an amulet to help protect the seeds. Some directions are given, which send you to some behind the first guard tower. Warning, they can be very strong if you try at level 3, you might need to wait for level 4 to do this.
3 - Return to Mirari.
4 - Give her the tenticles.

5 - Take your new amulet to Mirari's Grove and use the amulet there (if you dont know how she will tell you), go left out of the city and head south west until you see a willow tree (if you reach the river you have gone to far).
6 - Return to Mirari.
Got 6silver and 88xp.

hibernia|magical disturbances.Name: Magical Disturbances
hibernia|magical disturbances.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Miach says, "We could use your help again, with the young grove trees we are growing. We cultivate the grove trees, and grow them as our homes, naturally, without hurting them. It seems the growth is being [disturbed]."
Miach says, "I'm not sure what it is, but Liisu would like our help again."
Dialog box: Will you aid Liisu and find the source of this disturbance?
You have been given the Magical Disturbances quest.
Miach says, "Great! Speak to Liisu then. She's very disturbed about this whole thing!"
[Step #1] Talk with Liisu in the Grove of Domnann about the strange things going on in the grove.

Liisu says, "Have you decided to help me? I figured I could count on you. You see, there is a natural balance we maintain with nature. We use our magic to form the grove trees. We were trying to grow a grove of young trees into a new residence. It was working fine. Now, though, something is [disturbing] this magic!"

Liisu says, "Yes. The grove trees just aren't growing right! Some of them seem to be growing toward a malformed state! I'm not sure what it is! We don't think it's another form of magic interfering with it, since we can't detect any. We don't even know if it's intentional! But it's hurting the groves, and interfering with our magic! We've got to stop it! I've gone to [Aapo], for his help!"

Liisu says, "Yes, Aapo is the Druid envoy, sent to help us from the Druid Court. He's worked on a way to help us locate the source of all the disruption. He said I should send you to him. He will tell you how you can help."
[Step #2] Speak to Aapo, in the Grove of Domnann.
Aapo says, "Ah, has [Liisu] sent you to me?"
Aapo says, "Ah, is it wonderful to be here, Forester, amongst the [Sylvan]?"

Aapo says, "Right. The groves are being disturbed somehow, and nobody knows how. I've seen this sort of thing before, though, and may have an idea of what's going on. You see, a long time ago, nature in Hibernia got twisted. All things were affected; plantsm animals, and even us, the Celts! Sometimes, the land reacts to evil. It senses evil, and occasionally, the result is an [abomination] of what is normal."

Aapo says, "Nature became twisted. Creatures turned malevolent. The very trees turned horrific creatures of destruction. This was a very long time ago, and even still, some of these creatures remain! I believe the evil of the fomorian has done this to the creatures of Hy Brasil. I believe that one of these [twisted] creatures may be somehow disturbing the balance between the natural magic of the groves and the natural magic of the Sylvan."

Aapo says, "I've fashioned this item for you. Wear it, and seek out any of the creatures of the area. When the necklace starts glowing, you will know you are near. I would like to give you a greater idea of what you seek, but I can't. Wear the necklace. It will [guide] you."
You receive a necklace from Aapo!
Aapo says, "I do believe the tangleweeds may be disturbing the groves. Perhaps they are digging into the roots of the grove trees. If I am correct, I will need two of the tangle weeds, to study."
[Step #3] Wear the item the druid gave you, and find the tangleweed, generally found just outside the gates of Domnann, down the hill.
Tangleweeds are just outside the gate, no need to go down the hill.
[Step #4] Kill the two tangleweeds eating the grove roots.
You receive a tangleweed from the tangle weed!
You receive a tangleweed from the tangle weed!
[Step #5] Return the weeds to the druid.
Aapo says, "Ah. Good to see you! Did you get the tangleweeds? They are strangling the roots of the new grove trees. It's a sad state Hy Brasil is in. Well, then, give me the first tangleweed."
Give Aapo the first tangleweed.
Aaop says, "Ah. Hand me the second tangleweed."
[Step #5 (again)] Turn in the second tangleweed.

Aapo says, "Great. Now, here. I need you to go to the grove trees that these tangleweeds fed off of, and spread this mixture of leaves and seeds. It will help heal some of the roots, and also plant new grove trees. If you don't know how to use the seeds, speak to Mirari. Tell her you need [instructions]."
You receive magical seeds from Aapo!
[Step #6] Take the magical seeds and spread it in the grove. Talk to your trainer if you don't know how to [use the items].
Use the E key to spread your seeds around.
You attempt to use the magical seeds.
You use the magical seeds.
The seeds scatter through the air in a magical burst of golden leaves and magical lights.
[Step #7] Let Aapo know you spread the magical seeds.

Aapo says, " Ah. Well, I've learned that not only tangleweeds, but lost shrillers, have been affecting the groves! Well, others have helped me with the lost shrillers. Did you spread the [magical seeds]?"

Aapo says, "Great! I heartily thank you. It's been a rough time, what with the tangleweeds spreading! Here, take this coin, it should aid you. Again, I thank you. Now the grove trees will have a better chance of growing!"
