You are awarded 160 experience!
You have finished the Magical Disturbances quest.
You are awarded 12 silver and some copper!

hibernia|mild deception.Name: Mild Deception
hibernia|mild deception.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Ula mentions that the guards and sentinels are hunting down a certain

Stalker. She asks if you would be willing to assist in a mildly nefarious deed. Upon accepting, she instructs you to speak with a Lurikeen tracker, and attempt to trick him into giving you a note intended for someone else. She then tells you that, once you have the letter, you should deliver it to someone named Achaius, located either
in Tir na mbeo or Ardee.

The tracker is due West, directly across the road; he is wearing red armor, and is named simply "Tracker". Upon speaking with him, he tells you that you look like a Stalker; he asks if you are [here to aid] or if you are [a Stalker]. Choose [here to aid]; choosing [a Stalker] will fail the quest and requires starting over. He gives you a letter to deliver to a guard in green armor, located at the guard post near Tir na mbeo; DO NOT do this, as the quest will fail.

The quest info tells you to deliver it to someone in Howth or Ardagh. Achaius is, in fact, a wandering weapons merchant; he travels between Mag Mell (you'd think the tracker would notice... hard to find good help...) and Ardee. He never reaches Mag Mell, but stops short and heads back North. Deliver it to him for your reward.
Helpful hints:
You trick the tracker into giving you the letter, and then you give it to someone else.
If you got the quest in the south, you give it to Twm, who runs off because he is being hunted. He's the LARGE guy outside the round building with the two lovers in ARDAUGH.

If you got the quest in the north, you give it Achius, who can be found hiding (ok, standing, but he's a lurikeen) out on the outskirts of TNBeo near the horse seller. Achius is actually in one of the corners of the Tavern in Ardee, outside. As soon as I gave him the letter, he started sprinting towards Mag Mell.

hibernia|enchanted bandit hunt.Name: Enchanted Bandit Hunt
hibernia|enchanted bandit hunt.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Kaley, the Guardian Trainer of Howth, asks if she might [beg a favor].
She tells you that a certain bandit in the area is waylaying travelers.

The bandit is a [sabhail named Seireadan], who has stolen an [enchanted dagger] from a merchant; the sabhail has used the magic of the dagger to change its appearance to that of a lurikeen. The dagger was stolen from the father of Anra, a merchant in Howth; Anra has paid Kaley to retrieve
the dagger and do away with Seineadan. Arna asks that you do away with the bandit, and return the dagger to Anra.

Seireadan is in the valley due West of Howth. Cross the ridge directly West of Howth, then head a bit North. You should soon find a "lurikeen" named Seineadan. He is neutral, initially, and level three. Upon speaking with him, he will tell you to give him your weapon or die; he immediately attacked me, so there wasn't any debate involved.
Returning the dagger to Anra (lurikeen merchant, on the West side of Howth, with all the other weapons merchants) resulted in nearly two bubbles of experience, and a Ring.
Reward:
Ring of Swords

hibernia|learn the paths.Name: Learn the Paths
hibernia|learn the paths.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: 1 - At level 4 I was told I was nearing the time I would have to choose my Path. She sends you first to Serenda the hero trainer (first tree on right after entering grove).
2 - Then to Sean McCrean (the champion trainer), past the hero tree (the one with the vault keeper in).
3 - After that you are sent to speak with Aurnia (blademaster trainer), in the tree behind Searlait.
4 - Then return to Searlait for 3 silver and 88xp.

hibernia|summoner expulsion.Name: Summoner Expulsion
hibernia|summoner expulsion.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to the Magic trainer in Mag Mell. She gives the reason why there is so many skeletons to the NW of the town. It seems that the Stone obelisk is corrupted by a [summoner] (lvl 4) who keeps pulling the dead out of there graves. She want you to kill him and collect the power that drops. Then you have to give the power to the Eldritch trainer, Aodh, in Tir na Nog and he gives experience and a magical ring.
Reward:
Ring of Staves

hibernia|tale of cad goddeau.Name: Tale of Cad Goddeau
hibernia|tale of cad goddeau.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: At low level you can get some xp. The Nature Trainer in Connla will ask you if you know about Cad Goddeau and send you to the Druid trainer over the bridge at the tower to ask him about it. Target the druid trainer and say Cad Goddeau , he will tell the story of a ancient druid battle and at the end you receive exp.
Reward:
Ring of Twigs

hibernia|track and seek.Name: Track and Seek
hibernia|track and seek.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: You get this at level 4 from your trainer. You may have to do the mild deception quest first.

Speak to Ula, Stalker Trainer of Mag Mell, or perhaps directly to Damhnait, Stalker Trainer of Howth, and you will be instructed to locate a certain tracker, follow her, and determine from whom she is receiving information. Once you discover the person, you are to bribe them into telling you. You are given a jewel to use as a bribe.

The Tracker is an Elven woman in blue armor, who wanders across the hills due West of Howth. The easiest way to locate her, if you have patience, is to wait near Merle the Old, who resides on the ridge immediately West of Howth. I waited around fifteen minutes before she wandered up, but the wait could potentially be much longer. Before she reaches Merle (the culprit), right-click her. She will tell you that it is none of your business where she goes -- she doesn't seem to mind you following, though. Once she reaches Merle, right-click Merle and follow the prompt for more information. When he asks you for compensation, drop the jewel on him. He informs you that Blaiseach (previously referred to in the
Mild Deception quest) is worried that the Unnamed One is close to finding the Moonstone.

Return to Damhnait, who will tell you to pass the info on to Leachlainn, the Nightshade Trainer in Ardagh. Damhnait gives you the exact phrase to use. Travel to Ardagh, right-click Leachlainn, and follow the prompt to give him more info. Then, while he is selected, say something to the effect of "The unnamed one is close to finding the moonstone".
Leachlainn says that is interesting, and gives you the Ring of Masked Faces and mentions that, should you choose the path of Nightshade, he would be happy to have you.
Rewards:
Ring of Faces
Ring of Masked Faces

hibernia|way of the grove -- learning th.Name: Way of the Grove -- Learning the Paths
hibernia|way of the grove -- learning th.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Miach says, "Soon will come the time when you must choose between life as an animist, and life as a valwalker. It is already your destiny to walk the [Path of Affinity]."
Miach says, "Yes, it has always been our way, to start out as the Way of the Grove, and then follow the Path of Affinity, when we are ready. You do have a choice in your path, however."
Dialog box: Will you go and meet the trainers to learn of the different paths?
You have been given the Learning the Paths quest.
Miach says, "Ah, then talk with Faolan, first, to learn about life as an Animist."
[Step #2] Talk to Faolan about the Path of Affinity and life as an Animist.
Faolan says, "Ah, I imagine you're here to learn about the Path of Affinity and life as an [Animist]."

Faolan says, "Animists have an affinity with plants. We can animate plants, and use the magic of nature and the plant life nature produces when needed. There was a time when most of the magic we used was for simply shaping our homes and becoming closer to nature. Now, though, it seems we use our magic and our affinity with plants to defend. I know that the Druids and Wardens and Bards feel a desire to protect nature. As animists, we believe we should be nature. It is a hard thing to achieve, but it is what we believe. Now, speak to Oriara. She can tell you about life as a valewalker."
[Step #3] Speak to Oriara about life as a Valewalker.
Oriara says, "Ah, you are here to learn about life as a [Valewalker] are you not?"

Oriana says, "Valewalkers follow the Path of Affinity. The Path of Affinity is dear to Sylvan, though Firbolgs and Celts are more than welcome to follow it. The Path of Affinity believes that nature is perfection, and balance, and correct. The closer one is to nature, the closer one us to the way things should be. To become nature, that is our goal, for once we are a part of nature, then we have achieved true meaning. As Valewalkers, we use the magic of nature and our strength to fight for our land. Think of your choices, and choose wisely."
You are awarded 176 experience!
You are awarded 3 silver and some copper!
You have finished the Learning of the Paths quest.

hibernia|wolf infestation.Name: Wolf Infestation
hibernia|wolf infestation.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: While in the Firbolg starting city I spoke with the Naturalist Trainer about quests when I reached 5th level.
She told me to speak with Eluned in Mag Mell and to ask him about the wolves.
When I reached Mag Mell I right clicked on Caoimhe (Target Caoimhe and /say "can't feed them all" - this should give you
the quest you're looking for.) and he told me that he needed help feeding some wolves that were wandering near the town or some such thing.

He gave me 3 items all food for the wolves. I took the food and went out right beside of his house. I fed the first three tough "whatever" wolves that I ran across and I received a message to return to talk with Caoimhe.
When I returned he gave me a magic ring.

hibernia|youth gone wrong.Name: Youth Gone Wrong
hibernia|youth gone wrong.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per patch 1.69:
- Youth Gone Wrong - Players between levels 4 and 14 that have completed this quest may return to Mandra and receive an additional reward. Mandra will now give this reward as part of the quest.

Speak to Mandra in Mag Mell, she can be found on the East side of the town hiding in the back of the buildings. She'll tell you she's broken away from the local gang of villainous youths, and she's hiding in Mag Mell to avoid the hit gangs after her. After you accept the Quest, the villainous youths show up and after you kill a few, you are directed to speak to Mandra again by your Journal. You speak to her, she thanks you and you are given about 10 silver and a tiny bit of XP.
Reward:
Snake-tail Ring (Hib)

hibernia|kylirean's new armor.Name: Kylirean's New Armor
hibernia|kylirean's new armor.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per patch 1.69:

- Kylirean's New Armor - Players between levels 3 and 13 that have completed this quest may return to Kylirean and receive an additioanl reward. Kylirean will now give this reward as part of the quest.
Start by talking to Kyrilean, an armor merchant in Mag Mell.
Kyrilean says, "Hello, friend and welcome to my shop. You look the sturdy sort... I wonder... I don't suppose you'd be willing to help me with a little [experiment], would you?
Kyrilean says, "Aye, I think I have discovered a way to make comfortable and stylish armour, but I'm afraid people around here would look [down] on me if they knew what I needed to make it."

Kyrilean says, "You see those lough wolf cadgers? Their pelts make for excellent armor, if you can believe it. With this new tanning process I have been working on, it is lighter, more durable, and softer than any other [hide] I have ever worked with."

Kyrilean says, "Therein lies my problem, (player name). You see, there are folks here in Mag Mell that are trying to save the little beasts, if you can believe that. If they saw me kill one, they would go absolutely insane with fury. That's why I need you to [help me out]."
Kyrilean says, "I'd like for you to get me a lough wolf cadger pelt. You are anonymous enough that no one will care. Do you think you can do that for me?"
Dialog Box:
Kyrilean says, "Ah, my thanks to you friend. Now, hurry out there and get me that pelt."
Kill a Lough Wolf Cadger and it will drop the Lough Wolf Cadger Skin. Return this to Kyrilean, and you will see:
You are awarded 5 silver and some copper!
Kyrilean says: "Oh, this looks like a great pelt. You've done a good job... Now I need one other [item]."
Kyrilean says, "What I need now is a rock chert from a mudman. I can use the chert to smooth out the pelt and make the leather supple. Find a mudman and get the chert for me."
Kill a mudman, and it will drop the Rock Chert. Return it to Kyrilean.

Kyrilean says, "Excellent work, (player name). You've brought me the two components I need. Here, take this coin. I hope it serves you well. Thank you again. Perhaps, once I've perfected this armor technique, I'll be able to craft some armour for you."
You are awarded 80 experience!
You have finished the Kyrilean's New Armour quest.
You are awarded 5 silver and some copper!
Reward:
Choker of the Bear

hibernia|spicket, spackit and spykit.Name: Spicket, Spackit and Spykit
hibernia|spicket, spackit and spykit.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Mannix is an firbolg merchant in Mag Mell.

Mannix says, "Aye, friend. Have you traveled much yet? If so, you may have encountered those strange spraggon roaming around here as of late. They are very foul tempered, not to mention they have been destroying crops and fields all around the area. Typical spraggon behavior. Right alongside assaulting travelers and stealing their goods. These three, though, they've got some [magical stuff] on them, I'd bet anything on it."

Mannix says, "Well see, these three, they aren't like the others. One's super strong, the other is said to be as quick as anything and the third is said to be quick witted. So, it's got to be magic. I bet that one of your skill could overcome these creatures. I bet you could overcome one of them in their lair, if you're interested. So, I'm telling you, you kill one of these spraggon, there's bound to be praise, and a prize."

Mannix continues: "But I don't think you would want to take them all on just yet. Tell me, what would you rather have? You kill one of these three, and you can keep their little magical charm. Just bring proof of their death to Tethra, in Ardee. He's a great hatred of spraggon, you know. So which would you prefer? The spraggon with [strength], the [dexterous] one, or the one that seems a bit [smarter]?"
Select one of the three, and Mannix gives you directions to them.

Select strength, and you get directions to find Spicket. He appears at night in the woods to the west of the bridge on the road north from Ardee. Kill him and he drops Spicket's Head, and Spicket's Belt. Was right at the small hill behind MagMell at night. Had to kill 3 Spraggons before he spawned. Ran right toward me.
Select dexterous, and you get directions to find Spackit. He appears at night in the east-west valley to the northeast of Mag Mell. Kill him, and he drops Spacket's Head (sic) and Spackit's Bracer.

Select smarter and you get directions to find Spykit. He's the easiest to find, appearing at night on the other side of a small hill just northeast of Mag Mell. Kill him, and he drops Spykit's Head, and Spykit's Ring.
The three quests appear to be mutually exclusive. You can only get the magical item off the named spraggon you originally chose.
Tethra is in Ardee, loc =54780, 51655 inside the building on the first floor. Look for the little Lurikeen.

Bring any of the spraggons' heads to Tethra, a Lurikeen in Ardee. He says, "Ah! A spraggon head! I've not enough of these. It seems they multiply faster than we can rid the land of them. Tell me, I've heard strange things. I wonder, is there any truth to the [rumor] I've been hearing?"

Tethra says, "Yes then, there are some that seem to posess (sic) this strange ability to grow in size, though I'm told not many can. I suppose it matters not. You're a brave (character class), to have defeated this infamous spraggon. Have you defeated [many more]?"

Tethra says, "Have you their heads then? I will pay you for each head, friend, if you give them to me. Or have you [no more heads]? You have done a great thing in killing these spraggon. They are horrible. They run through the land, tearing up good fields, destroying."

Tethra says, "There is said to be an item of magical enchantment on the spraggon you killed, the large one. You didn't mention it. Perhaps you didn't find it? He may have hidden it somewhere. That's what they normally do. Could you please search for this enchanted item? I have a personal interest in it. I believe it would be hidden by the bridge on the road to Druim Ligen."

Go to the bridge north of Ardee and step on it. (OR-- It's UNDER the bridge. You have to swim under the bridge. Search awhile and you'll get a message that says some thing like "something catches your eye" and it will automatically be placed in your inventory.) You see the text, "You see a reflection from something shiny out of the corner of your eye. You find a partially opened bag hidden under the bridge. In the bag you see the cracked mirror that first caught your attention. You close the bag and place it in one of your larger packs. You have received a Spraggon Bag.
Go back to Tethra in Ardee, and hand him the bag.

Tethra says, "Thank you, Warden. The spraggon have been unusually villianous (sic), and I mean to find out why. This may help us. Good day to you, Warden, and please, consider spraggon hunting a sport. You're quite good at it."
You are awarded 10 silver and some copper!
You are awarded 640 experience!
Lvl 5 received 10 Silver and 176 Exp.
Rewards:
Spicket's Belt
Spackit's Bracer
Spykit's Ring

hibernia|the bug catcher's studies.Name: The Bug Catcher's Studies
hibernia|the bug catcher's studies.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Ignius is standing outside the east entrance to Tir na Nog, south along the wall.
Ignius says, "Greetings. I am Ignius, purveyor of magic and studier of magical creatures of Hibernia. I'm sure on your travels you have [seen] many of them, have you not?"
Ignius says, "Ah, yes. There are many, aren't there? Hibernia is a realm filled with the impossible! As you age, you will see even more fantastical creatures, ones you never thought were possible."
Ignius gets a far off look on his face. He shakes his head and returns his attention to you.

Then Ignius says, "Ah, sorry friend, I was just fondly remembering my days of youth. hehe - Anyhow, since you are here, I may have a [job] for you. Perhaps give you a chance to earn some coin. What do you think?"
Dialog box:
You have been given The Bug Catcher's Studies quest.

Ignius says, "Excellent! I knew you looked like the sort that could use a little coin. Here is what I need. I am currently working on a new magical item, but I am missing a few pieces. I need for you to [get the items] for me."

Ignius says, "Here is what I need... First you must get a set of eirebug eyes for me. The eirebugs are on that hill, to the southeast of here. Slay one to get its eyes. Next, I will nee the carapace of a [water beetle collector]."

Ignius says, "You can find the water beetle collectors near the shore by Mag Mell, to the east of here. Watch out for the water beetles, though. They may come to aid the collectors. When you have these items, return to me."
Go and kill an eirebug and a water beetle collector, and you receive the Set of Eirebug Eyes and the Collector Carapace.
Return and Ignius says, "Welcome back (player name). Since you're here, I'm sure you have the items I need. Please, hand the eyes to me first."
Hand the eyes over and Ignius says, "Ah, these look exquisite! Now, hand the carapace to me please."

Hand the carapace over and Ignius says, "Wonderful! You have done a fantastic job at getting these for me. Please take this coin as a thank you for all the effor tyou went through to get me this. Maybe, in the future, we can work together again!"
You are awarded 480 experience!
You are awarded 8 silver and some copper!
You have finished The Bug Catchers Studies quest.
This entire "quest" took me 9 minutes to get and finish :-) --BruceR

hibernia|evan's notes.Name: Evan's Notes
hibernia|evan's notes.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Evan, in Ardee, asks you to deliver a love letter for him to his girlfriend in Mag Mell. Deliver it and you will get a reward and another letter to return to Evan. Returning that letter gets you another reward. A nice easy way to make a little money at low levels, and only takes about 10-15 minutes. Total reward 8s and some copper.
Evan is a Firbolg armour merchant in Ardee.
Evan says, "Greetings, there, (player name). You look like you could use some cash. I'll tell you what. If you help me, I can help [you]."
Evan says, "Hehe, I can see it in your eyes that you're ready for some adventure! Excellent! Here's a note of grave importance that I must get you to take to Meara in [Mag Mell]."

Evan says, "Ah, you must indeed be young. Here are my directions. Follow the road out of town, make sure to head south. In the distance you'll see some towers, that is Mag Mell. Meara is a guard there, she's wearing green armour. Good luck!"
You receive a Letter to Meara.
Hand the letter to Meara, a Firbolg guard in Mag Mell.

Meara says, "Thank you so much for this letter. Oh, my beloved Evan, how I miss him. My parents have forbidden me from marrying him but I know he loves me so. Perhaps you can take a [letter] back to him for me?"
Meara says, "Here it is. Thank you so much. Please take this for your trouble. I do so appreciate your helping me with this."
You are awarded 320 experience!
You are awarded 5 silver and some copper!
You receive a Letter to Evan.
Return the letter to Evan and hand it to him.

Evan says, "Ah, my sweet Meara. Thank you (player name) for everything. I know her love for me is strong. One day, we will be united, no matter what her parents say. Please take this for your troubles."
You are awarded 160 experience!
You are awarded 3 silver and some copper!

hibernia|cristin's supplies.Name: Cristin's Supplies
hibernia|cristin's supplies.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Cristin can't collect the supplies she needs and asks you to help her out. Go out and get the following stuff (you need to get the quest first, since the items pop into your inventory):
- A Hill Toad Wart, dropped by any hill toad
- A Water Beetle Wing, dropped by any water beetle
- A Spraggonite hide, dropped by any spraggonite.

Cross the bridge back west from Basar. To the NW are hill toads, conned yellow to me. Then turn S and follow the river. Water Beetles conned yellow and orange, but were neutral. From there head SW to the spraggonites on the S side of the hill, NW of Ardee. Green and blue, but agressive, so be sure to pull one away from the group. Run back and get your $ (1s and some copper) and exp (total 2,560) from Cristin.

hibernia|straw's in town.Name: Straw's In Town
hibernia|straw's in town.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: I got this from Tethra as a lvl 9 Bard. Sequence of events:
1. Tethra says that there is a Spraggon named Straw who the guards have never been able to catch because he is so fast, for more information, talk to "Rolney" who is at the tower in
Mardagh.

2. After finding Rolney at the TOP of the tower in Mardagh, he tells me that Straw can be located on the peninsula that sticks out to the E of Tir na mBeo, and that Straw is usually there during the day. Of course, the
Ghostly Siabras are there at night, so... if you go there at night at level
9-10, you will probably be killed. Rolnoy also says that if you can't find
Straw, then "Odharnait" who is in Ardagh can probably help you find him.
3. I went to the peninsula, found Straw, and proceeded to try to take his
head. However, there is a major bug here. I was trying to hit Straw, but
he "Quickly Evades your Blow" or something like that, so you can never hit him, and any magic you throw at him is resisted. After hanging around (and
getting killed by the Siabras), I finally clicked on my journal, and it
told me that I had missed Straw, and that I should contact "Odharnait" in
Ardagh.
4. I finally found Odharnait in Ardagh, who wished me luck, and told me
that Straw frequently appeared at night with a band of Spraggon by the Dead
Tree and the Boulder at the top of the hill to the NW of town, but staying
to the "right" side of the road. She also said that "Sentinel Eimile" in
Ardagh would be willing to pay me well for Straw's head.
5. I went up to the top of the hill about 14 hrs, and killed the 5 or 6
spraggons there, then waited around until Straw appeared just to the West
of the Dead Tree. This time I killed Straw with no problem. I took the
head back to Tethra as noted in Step 1, however.... Tethra didn't want
it. I then checked my Journal, and had to take the head back to "Sentinel
Eimile" in Ardagh, where I got ~5000 xp, 6 sp, and the choice of
4 items: [Jewel of Health], [Belt of Nimbleness], [Charming Necklace], or [Choker of Empathetic Properties].
Jewel of Health -- Straw's Gem
Belt of Nimbleness -- Straw's Belt
Charming Necklace -- Straw's Bardic Beads
Choker of Empathetic Properties -- Straw's Beads
Rewards:
Straw's Belt
Straw's Gem
Straw's Beads
Straw's Bardic Beads

hibernia|clik's raids.Name: Clik's Raids
hibernia|clik's raids.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Caitriona, in Ardagh, has had her jewels snitched by a thieving water beetle named Clik and she needs help getting them back. Head up the coast and look for water beetles. First kill any that you see and you will soon be collecting stolen jewelry. AFTER you get three pieces (necklace, earring, ring) go search for Clik, he is usually found in the water. Warning he will call for help. Kill Clik and loot his carapace and return all four items to Caitriona for a reward. Clik spawns in the small bay just southeast of Mag Mell, approx loc is - 28785, 18463, 4587, usually on the southern end.
Reward:
Clik's Chitin

hibernia|gormghlaith's tea.Name: Gormghlaith's Tea
hibernia|gormghlaith's tea.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: In Ardee you are told by a Firbolg that he and his mother, Gormghlaith,
near Howth are big fans of yours and could use your help. Seems his mother
had a valuable teapot stolen from her by lucricaduanes in the Silver
Mountains. If you could get it back from them and give it to her (she's
right outside of Howth near the stable master) he'd much appreciate it. You

have to go kill a lucricaduane for it. I found some in a valley in the north edge of the Silver Mountains. You'll lose leprechaun faction when you do it (only two kills at this level will make you KOS). When you return the teapot to Gormghlaith she'll be greatful and then say what would be really nice was if she had some blackwood tea. She asks you to get a blackwood leaf from a lunatishee and some wolf whiskers from a lough wolf. Killing lunatishee will lower blackwood faction and once again killing two will make you KOS. Lunatishee and Lough Wolves can be found next to the road south from Mag Mell. When you return all this to her you get a quarter to half bubble experience and 2 silver and some copper.

hibernia|little wind.Name: Little Wind
hibernia|little wind.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Reidie in the tavern of Tir na mBeo sent me to make a bottle to capture the wind ghoul, Little Wind, so that more may be learned from it regarding the lost treasures of the Tower.
The cork was formed of a water beetle eye. They can be found all along the lake; just go east to the lake shore, and follow it north to water beetles.

The bottle was formed of a spraggonoll leg bone. Spraggonolls can be found throughout Lough Derg. If you want a guaranteed spawn (rather than running around all day long), head west to the cliffs, then follow them south. After a few minutes, you'll find a house halfway up the cliff. This ruined shack is home to a host of spraggon-kin, including many spraggonolls.
Return the water beetle eye to Reidie, then the spraggonoll leg bone. She'll give you a bottle which will capture Little Wind, once you defeat the ghoul in combat.
Head all the way north to Ardee, then go northwest until you find the ruins where wind ghouls roam. Little Wind only appears during the day. Once you
defeat him, he will automatically be sucked into the magic bottle.
The easiest way to find Little Wind is to head to Ardee, there are too many red things that are agressive to head from the N entrance of Tir Na Nog.

Once you get to Ardee, head W/NW to the bridge that is just up the road from Ardee once you hang a left on the road. From the bridge head SW/W. There is a dead tree on the left, some big rock parallel to each other and another dead tree on the left just behind the huge rocks.
Little Wind spawns at the top of the hill (loc:34431, 31819, 5640 dir=260). Keep killing wind ghouls till he shows up.

Head back south to Tir na mBeo, and talk to Reidie again. She'll ask for the bottle. After handing it over, she will give you a wind bracelet; 4% Wind and +2 Intelligence. At 13th level, I got 2 silver pieces and some odd copper, and 2/10ths of a bubble worth of
experience.
Reward:
Wind Formed Bracelet

hibernia|cyllane's cure.Name: Cyllane's Cure
hibernia|cyllane's cure.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: 1. Speak to Cyllane. She gives you a note. (This is another quest intended to teach you how to use items in inventory, so drag icon to hot bar, hit "Use" key and the number of the slot.)
2. Note directs you to kill three creatures - botonid leaf, sporite and precocious cniocrag. Kills can be done in any order.
3., 4., 5. Kill the three creatures. Sporite drop "sporite pod", botonid
leaf drops "botonid sap", and precocious cniocrag drops "cniocrag eye".
6. Take items to Niara, Priestess of the Grove in Grove of Domnann. The
note poofs either her or at step 5.
7. Niara prepares a "Niara's Potion". Take this back to Cyllane.
8. Give Cyllane the potion. She gives "Cyllane's Amulet" and "Cyllane's Cure". Drag and drop both of these on to the hotbar.
9. Directions are to exit the tree by the SW exit, and head W-SW until you reach the prepared circle. A dialog box pops up when you enter the area, requiring you to click a button.

10. Activate the amulet. This summons a "Controlled Writhing Weed", green at lvl10. Although killing it doesnt seem necessary, it does reward about 1,000xp and a few silver for killing it (even if its grey).
11. Activate the cure. You are directed to return to Cyllane with the caution that the summoned mob may be following. It did aggro after a bit.
12. Talk to Cyllane, and gives you a gift. Reward for a lvl 13 Hero was a
Leafblade Sword. I guess it may be class specific.
Total exp was approx. 65,000 (nearly full bubble for lvl 13) with some silver.
I have done this quest with several of my character's,
My Valewalker, Enchanter, and Elderitch got magic
torso armor, my Mentalist got a magic staff with
Mentalism focus. I have attempted to complete it with
my Warden but there is a bug where I get the message
saying You can't Use this Item, when I try to summon
the creature in the Circle of Protection.
Rewards:
Leafblade Sword -- Blademaster, Hero,and Champion
Leaf-Edged Jerkin -- Nightshade
Leaf Embroidered Robe -- Eldritch, Mentalist, and Enchanter
Leaf-Lined Vest -- Warden and Druid
Leafstring Bow -- Ranger
Leafsong Jerkin -- Bard
Vest of Woven Leaves -- Valewalker
Carved Leaf Staff -- Mentalist
Rewards:
Leaf-Edged Jerkin
Leaf-lined Vest
Leafsong Jerkin
Vest of Woven Leaves
Leafstring Bow
Leafblade Sword
Leaf Embroidered Robe
Braided Leaf Necklace
Carved Leaf Staff

hibernia|fagan's wand.Name: Fagan's Wand
hibernia|fagan's wand.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Nyderra in Ardee gives a quest to retrieve the 2 broken parts of the
Blackthorn Wand.
In the first part you may be asked to kill one of three Enchanted creatures: Spraggonoll, Ghoul, or Luricaduane. Not everyone receives the quest.

First go to Howth and head south to along river to the stone step bridge, cross this and straight across to the bottom of the hill and follow that around to the left. You'll come across a pass to the right, go through here and stay at the base of the hill to the right. You'll eventually see a tent camp in a clearing. In the trees just behind the camp spawns an Enchanted Spraggonoll (green con). Kill him to get the bottom half. Do not do this at night as really tough creatures run through the area.

Head back to the quest giver and give her the bottom half of the wand. Then she sends you out in search of Prunar near Tir Na mBeo (loc=23367, 37816). Just north west of the town in a wooded area spawns a lunantishee named Prunar. He is surrounded by others of his kind as well as Blackthorns. He can be pulled singly by a level 13. His con was blue, but he was relatively weak. Take this top half and go back to the quest giver. She'll then ask if you brought the magic cloth from Prunar so she can make you something. Give that to her and she sends you to get lough wolf fur...so go get some and head back to her. She will now make you a pair of magical boots.
Reward:
Boots of the Wicked

hibernia|lochlain's curse.Name: Lochlain's Curse
hibernia|lochlain's curse.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This is a Celt/Firbolg quest. The Elven/Lurikeen equivalent of this quest is Keara's Enchantment. The elven originator of this quest is found hidden behind crates on the second story of a building (between the forge and the horse) in Ardee. Some may not receive until level 12.

The quest starts in Ardagh and you speak to the Lurikeen that is on the North side of the main building. She is, in fact, not a Lurikeen and has had run-in previously with a Lurikeen in Tir Na mBeo. This caused her to be cursed to look like a Lurikeen.

She needs 3 items to remove the curse. The first is a Barca's Spirit. This is found in Bri Leith. I found one near Caille. To enter the valley, go to the dock on the east side of the Lake. Turn east. There are many Sheerie's that are dangerous nearby. Caille is along the road.
The second item is a Broken Mirror from a Siabra Enchanter in Lough Derg. I got mine on the Siabra Island East of Tir Na mBeo. Careful, these call for help.
The third item is a Siabra Knife from a Siabra in Silvermine. I found this at a house with Siabra's south of the Bri Leith Entrance on the East side of the lake. This is just across into Silvermine.
Take these items back to Ardagh and she will try to remove the curse and fail. You still get a small reward of cash and xp.

hibernia|rhian's dyes.Name: Rhian's Dyes
hibernia|rhian's dyes.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to Tyree in Howth. He is running low on dyes and needs some components for them. If you could help him he'd appreciate it. He needs a badger scent glance (badgers are along the road south from Mag Mell). He needs the hair from a Wild Lucradan (same area as badgers, two kills will make you KOS with Leprechauns). Finally he needs the eyes from a Large Eirebug. (some are a little south of Howth accross the stone step bridge along the shore). For the first two you get some experience, and 1 silver and some copper. For the third you get some experience and some orange dye worth 50 copper. ( Dye color is most likely random choice of blue, brown or orange.)

hibernia|keara's enchantment.Name: Keara's Enchantment
hibernia|keara's enchantment.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Celtics cannot do this quests, they do the Lochlain's Curse quest instead.

Keara can be found in Ardee, on the second floor of one of the buildings in the town tucked behind a few boxes. He relays a story about how "he" is actually a she, and a Celt came along and turned her into a male Celt. She is looking for a lurikeen or elf to assist her in gathering a few spell ingredients to turn back into her old self.
Item 1: Veil from a Veil Wisp in Bri Leigh -- these spawn northeast of the
guard tower that's on the way to Caille. They roam around the hill. Around level 12 and 13.
Item 2: Broken Mirror from a Siabra Enchanter -- these can be found on an island near Tir na mBeo that has roanes and siabras, or a few spawn in a
small forest right near the farm in east Lough Derg. They are around level
Item 3: Skin from a changeling -- the changeling can be found in an area northwest of Ardee (N of TnN), where there is a small camp of anger sprites in some
trees. He is around level 12.
Once you have all three items, return to Keara. You'll be rewarded with
a few silver and some experience.

hibernia|whatcha gonna do.Name: Whatcha Gonna Do
hibernia|whatcha gonna do.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per patch 1.69:

- Whatcha Gonna Do - Ailionora will now give Champions a more level appropriate reward. Champions who received the scale version of the Vine Entwined Hauberk can return to Ailionora to exchange it for the reinforced version of the reward.
start NPC is Ailionora in Grove of Domnann
step #2: tell Crace that Ailionora is being [stalked].
step #3: go back to Ailionora
step #4: kill a stalking sylvanshade (around loc: 6k, 36k. go West of the city across the water, then go north)
step #5: return the hand to Ailionora
step #6: kill another one (her friend was still killed, even with the stalker dead)
step #7: return to Crace
step #8: tell Ailionora that it was [after Tiaga]
lvl 14 belt is the reward for this
Rewards:
Shadow Scythe -- Valewalker
Constitutional Forebearance -- Bard, Druid, and Warden
Entwined Vine Vest -- Hero, Blademaster and Ranger
Entwined Pods -- Enchanter
Vined Entwined Hauberk -- Champion
Shadowblade -- Nightshade
Rewards:
Shadow Scythe
Constitutional Forebearance
Entwined Vined Vest
Entwined Pods
Vined Entwined Hauberk

hibernia|the hunt for bristle.Name: The Hunt for Bristle
hibernia|the hunt for bristle.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-11-01 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Do Little Wind and Fagan's Wand quests first.

Talk to Eruven in Basar in Connacht, Eruven can be found just over the bridge in Connacht - Follow the road N - NE out of Ardee - right after the bidge is a small town with merchants - he is outside the first building.

[Step #1] Talk to Reidie in Tir na mBeo about Bristle, Bristle is a named badger and he spawns right where Wug spawns. Bristle is called 'Pilou' on French servers. It is right behind Tir mBeo up on a hill.
[Step #2] Find Bristle west of Tir na mBeo and get his head (actually SW) Loc approxiamtely 18k, 54k
[Step #3] Return to Reidie
[Step #4] Give Bristle's Head to Reidie
[Step #5] Return to Eruven and give sealed bag.
Reward:
Bristle's Fang

hibernia|the status of information.Name: The Status of Information
hibernia|the status of information.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: I found this quest by talking to Lughaidh Mackiernan in Domnann. looks to be about a lvl 13-15 quest, but I was able to do it at 50. This is just one version, since you can 'roleplay' different options. :)
step #1: speak with Anola. she can be found outside town just near the
portal back to Daingean/Druim Ligen.
step #2: read the notes that Anola gave you. (requires putting them on
hotbar and knowing where your "use item" key is. default is E).
step #3: three options here, Oidhche, Ceana, or just go find the matted
vines. I chose the elf, Ceana (epic Enchanter robes). the matted vines I found at loc: 38k, 12k (approximately).
I spent ages looking around 38K12K and couldn;t find the matted vines, but
did die about 4 times from the nasties hiding around that area heh. I did
find the vines at aprox 24K11K
step #4: return the information to Anola OR the person you chose.
step #5: you are asked to kill 2 nibby cniogcrags (approx loc: 50k, 41k from
Domnann)
step #6: return the collars to Ceana.
step #7: she gives you a pouch to take to Niara, who is near the center of
town.
step #8: Niara gives you a note to give to Anraoi. You have an option of
leather or RF gloves, AF 30.
My bard received the gloves with Music 2pts; Charisma 3; Dexterity 3. (no name sent)
Rewards:
Woven Leaf Gloves -- Enchanter, Mentalist
Guardian Leaf Gloves -- Valewalker
Heart of Oak Gauntlets -- Hero, Champion and Blademaster
Arrowleaf Gauntlets -- Ranger
Lyrical Leaf Guantlets -- Bard
Shadowy Leaf Gloves -- Nightshade
Protecting Leaf Gauntlets -- Druid and Warden
Harmonious Leaf Gloves -- Bard
Valorous Leaf Gloves -- Reaver (co-op sevrer)
Rewards:
Arrowleaf Gauntlets
Woven Leaf Gloves
Guardian Leaf Gloves
Heart of Oak Gauntlets
Protecting Leaf Gauntlets
Shadowy Leaf Gloves
Lyrical Leaf Gauntlets
Harmonious Leaf Gloves
Valorous Leaf Gloves

hibernia|beautiful music.Name: Beautiful Music
hibernia|beautiful music.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Tavie tells you that her wonderful drum is missing! Her twin sister, Tira in Ardee, stole it, that thief! Go talk to Tira and she'll tell you that she's only borrowing it, and she'll give it back along with a gift lute for you if you can get her mystical Golden Flute back from an Anger Spite in Bri Leith. Being the lazy bard I am, I went to the anger sprite area north of Tir Na Nog and killed a sprite there - blue at 14 but they hit hard and were quite a challenge even with the damage buff I got from a friendly enchanter.

Tira is glad to have her flute back (rewarding you with half a bubble of xp at 14), but the lute she was going to give you was broken! So she asks you to get sinew from a curmudgeon trapper in Lough Derg. I found some to the west of Ardagh, took a bit of bardic trickery but ended up single pulling one from a valley there.

Returning the sinew to Tira, I was told that she could make the lute better than it ever was! I had to retrieve a piece of driftwood from a Roane Maiden and a seashell from Lelly, a named Roane Maiden who inhabits the shore just northwest of the Parth Farm in East Lough Derg (loc=55109,11602 in Lough Derg. ). Was yellow to 15, then blue to 15. She's not as near to the shoreline as other Roanes.

Return the Driftwood to Tira, and she'll give you the lute and Tavie's drum in return. She says she is too inexperienced to fashion the lute with the seashell, but says Tavie can do it! Return to Tavie in mBeo, and she requests her drum, then the lute, and finally the seashell. When she receives all three items, she fashions you a Lute of the Sea! Nice upgrade to Bard Initiate Lute.
Reward is Lute of the Sea, Blue to 15.
All in all, I got about 2 bubbles of xp from the quest between 14 and 15.
Reward:
Lute of the Sea

hibernia|lesser of two evils.Name: Lesser Of Two Evils
hibernia|lesser of two evils.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per Patch 1.60:
- The Lesser of Two Evils: Players should now find that the siabra and curmudgeons once again have their battle at high noon.
Depending on your faction will determine the path you are given.
Talked to Myfanwy and was sent to Aidaila in TnB.
She told me to see Fereinn on the island in Lough Derg.
I was sent to kill a curm Trapper as proof of my sincerity. Curm's name is Tharl.
Give Fereinn the ear.
Next kill a Courier and bring back the plans.
Assist the Siabra force to defeat the Curms and report back to Fereinn.
He gives you a book which you give to Aidaila.
Then you get your reward.
Rewards:
Vest of Enlightenment
Bracer of the Bold
Bracer of Understanding

hibernia|two ales, ailish!.Name: Two Ales, Ailish!
hibernia|two ales, ailish!.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to Iao in the Green Rose Pub (Loc=loc:15059,27271,1,6445 dir=265) who will start quizing you on if you notice something missing, which happens to be his glasses.
He wishes you to go find them for him as he has lost them somewhere but doesn't happen to know where but starts listing 3 places he has been recently.
So first stop is to see Vivienne the Scale armor merchant in Ceannai. She mentions she has not seen the glasses but would love to see Iao again and get some more of his lovely wine.

Next stop is to see Sentinel Casidhe in Tir Uphost, Casidhe says that Iao deffinately had the glasses before departing, mentioning he is surprised he could see straight with as much wine as he drinks.

Last stop is Brynn the Enchanter staff merchant in Caille. She mentions that Iao fell off his horse close to town and while searching the grass close by she found the glasses. She is impressed by the runes on the glasses. She gives you the Runed etched eyeglasses.
Back to Iao in Tir Na Nog who is happy for the return of his spectacles and to show you his appreciation he gives you one of his lovely wine glasses.
Reward:
Gold Etched Wine Glass

hibernia|fearan.Name: Fearan
hibernia|fearan.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: In my 16th season I was traveling and came upon a Filidh gossiping of the latest news. It seemed as though a prosperous merchant in Ardee named Fianait was taking up the hobby of gardening. The problem, much to our amusement, was that she was trying to create an otherworld garden, and the creatures of the otherworld were being none too cooperative.

Straight away I went to Fianait's aid. She told me of her problems in more detail, explaining that she was in need of the spores of a dew sherie. These spores she said needed to be taken to Cait in Howth.

Knowing where to find the reclusive dew sheeries, and already being in bad standing with their ilk, I quickly set off. For those unaware of where they can be found, the dew sheeries inhabit the eastern shore of the loch, almost directly east of Ardagh.

I found these sheeries to be, on consideration, slightly more powerful than I (red and orange at lvl 16), and was lucky enough to enlist the aid of a passing hero. Together we slew the Sheerie and I quickly went to Howth to find Cait.

Cait informed me that the otherworld garden would, of course, need otherworld soil. This soil was to be obtained from the earth demons. Some know these as Deamhan Craig's. I must confess as to having despaired, for I did not have any idea of where to find these creatures. After diligent search I found the Deamhan Craigs on the east shore of the lake. The route I traveled was across the stepping stones, and east by north east into the valleys there. You will know the area by the presence of an abandoned camp nearby.

Once found I hit the depths of my despair, for again these foul beasts would easily best me (red at lvl 16). But I took heart and set forth to increase my skills. Upon attaining the next season, I returned and found the deamhans to still be beyond my ability (red and orange to lvl 17). Luck would have it that a noble druid was located nearby and he agreed to assist me in gaining the other world soil.

Now my feet carried me back to Howth, where Cait informed me that my travels were far from over. I needed to seal the magic between the soil and the spores. Only Ainrebh of Callie the enchanter could perform this feat. So I went to the stablemaster and rode to Mag Mell, ran east and south around the loch to the barn (near the parths). The stableman there was able to transport me to Druim Cain. I knew that Caille was on this same route, and I jumped form the horse as I rode past.

Ainrebh, who was inside the main village building, told me that yet the quest continued, for I must find one final ingredient, the grass seeds from a, yes grass sheerie. I ran from town and began climbing the steeply sloped hills nearby, heading generally west by north west. As I was not familiar with the area, it was pure luck to stumble upon the grass sheerie named Fearan (blue at lvl 17) Loc: 24k,27.5k. Good luck for me bad luck for him. With grass seeds in hand, I returned to Ainrebh. He performed the enchantment upon the potted soil and the quest was all but over. I decided to run the final leg to Druim Cain and travel by horse from there to Druim Ligen. Setting my horse to run free at Ardee I returned to Fianait in triumph with her new otherworld potted soil. She was kind enough to reward me with (about 5 dashes of xp) a woven grass helmet she had made for me. Its wondrous abilities, were alas wasted on me, a champion. But what a quest it was!
*I also did this quest as Mentalist, but to get the soil it was a little bit different :
I go to Cait in Howth, and he told me to speak with Merlo and he´s somewhere around Howth. So I went to Merlo and said to him "soil from the otherworld"
and he told me that of course he had some and gave it to me.
And I found Fearan at Loc 22,34 he´s somewhere around there and yellow at 16 and has a companion (blue) (also seen at 18K/34K running along the crest of the hill).
Reward:
Woven Grass Helm

hibernia|lysagh's problem.Name: Lysagh's Problem
hibernia|lysagh's problem.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: 1) Talk to Gemma in the merchant area near warehouse 2 and she tells you she's worried about her brother Lysagh and could you go check on him and deliver an armor shipment to him in Caile. Lysagh's been being attacked by Fury sprites and needs help.
2) I ran there, but I think you can get a ticket to Druim Cain and Caile
is the little town before you get there.

3) Talking to Lysagh, he sends you to kill a grass sheerrie for a green crystal. You will find these back the way you came. Go past the lone guard tower into the area where the road disappears. Their green to you at this level and easy.

4) Give the crystal to Lysagh, he tells that every time he gets a crystal in payment the fury sprites show up and mug him for it, thinking he's grass sheerie who the sprites are at war with. Shortly after you give him the crystal 2 Fury sprites show up and start attacking you.
Glare was yellow to me at 17th and the other blue. I was able to kill
them both just barely.
5) Lysagh goes and hides in the stone building not far away (he's no
help during the fighting)
I'm not sure if this was a bug or not but I ended up fighting Glare twice, the first time he died all I got was a green crystal which I gave to Lysagh and Glare and his buddy showed up again
6) When Glare dies he gives you a body which you give to Lysagh, when Lysagh gets the body the quest is done. You also get some gold and the ring.
Reward:
Fury Sprite's Ring

hibernia|regional distinctions.Name: Regional Distinctions
hibernia|regional distinctions.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Be forewarned, if you are on dergan faction instead of curm faction, this will mess with your faction a bit. (Small faction hits though, so it's not a huge deal) Also, be sure to tell the npc's the bit in brackets when talking to them throughout the quest, or they won't say anything. Just be sure to check your quest journal as you go along.
Talk to Raine, the NPC behind the bar (she is not a barkeep) in Tir na mBeo. She will send you to Lavena in
TMB.

Raine says, "Hello. I imagine by now you've run into several dergans while exploring the area. They can be dangerous, so be careful with your dealings with them. They are of the unseelie court, you know. They are part of the siabra, and they are everywhere. why, I don't think there's one place not touched by these malevolent dark [elven beings]."

Raine says, "Aye. They are evil. Many in Hibernia have had unpleasant dealings with them. Even more have been killed by them. It would be worth your time to learn as much about them as you can. I know a bit about them, but the locals, they would know more. See, I am new to this area, and my knowledge of the unseelie court is more historical impartial observance than anything else. I am not an adventurer, though. You, however, are, and I think you'll discover how important it is to know as much as you can about the unseelie court. Beware though, the locals may demand you show your loyalty to Hibernia with the blood of these evil creatures."
Dialog box: Will you head Raine's advice and learn about the unseelie court?
You have been given the Regional Distinctions quest.

Raine says, "You've made a wise choice. No matter what your dealings with the siabra may be, they are as much of an enemy as the Midgard barbarians and Albion invaders. Talk to Lavena, in town, she has had some recent experience with the unseelie court."
[Step #1] Speak to Lavena, in Tir na mBeo, about the [dergans] in the area.
Lavena is on the left side of TMB looking at the town, in the first little hut.
You say, "What about Dergans in the area?"

Lavena says, "Dergans? You want to know about dergans? They are part of the unseelie court. They are defined by their region. Here, in Lough Derg, they go by the name dergans. They have a reason for being here. They all have a unified mission. I'm sure of that. Why, it's common knowledge that when the Lurikeens and Elves decided to come through the Veil to help the land of Hibernia, the [unseelie court] came rushing out as well. It seemed, to some, they had found their own way out, but I know little of that."

Lavena says, "Well, I may know why they occupy some of Lough Derg. But I won't be sharing that knowledge with those that aren't willing to take up the fight against the unseelie court. I know they're powerful, I know some feel it pays more to stay on their good side. But I'll not talk with those not willing to fight the evil of the unseelie court. If you wish this knowledge, you must return to me with some of the uncut stones the dergan furys occasionally pick up. You can find dergan furys in the woods northeast of the farm building by the parthanan field."
[Step #2] Kill a dergan fury and retrieve an uncut stone. Dergan furys can be found in the woods northeast of the parthanan farm in Lough Derg.
Dergan Fury can be found

on the island in the lake behind Ardagh; across from Tir na mBeo (green ones to a level 18), or in the forest beside the parth farm. The ones in the forest are higher level, but it doesn't matter where you go.
The dergan fury says, "The unseelie court will remember this deed. You will live to regret it!"
You recieve uncut stones from the dergan fury!
Return the stone to Lavena, and she then sends you to "locals" in Howth.
Lavena says, "You are back. Have you retrieved an uncut stone for me?"
Lavena says, "Ah. Yes, this is what I meant. You see, the dergans [occupy] our land for a reason."
[Step #4] Learn from Lavena why the dergans [occupy] Lough Derg.

Lavena says, "Most of Lough Derg was once Tir na mBeo. There are the ruins of a tower here in Lough Derg, they are the ruins of the Tower of Tir na mBeo. I won't tell the story of that tower, for it is common in Hibernia. When the unseelie court flooded Hibernia, some of them overran Lough Derg and began to occupy some areas. They have been here so long, that even though they are members of the unseelie court, the natives of Hibernia began to call them dergans. It's a way to [distinguish] the unseelie court."

Lavena says, "The dergans sole interest seems to bein retrieving the lost treasures of the Tower of Tir na mBeo. You could imagine the unseelie court's surprise when they reached the Tower of Tir na mBeo, to find that the once great Elven construct had fallen, and worse, that most of the treasures of the Tower were gone! So they stay here, to seek the treasures, and to search for clues that could lead them to the whereabouts of the treasures. Understand, now, that some of these treasures are items of magic more powerful than anything the unseelie court or the elves now have! As for the rest of the unseelie court, well, they spread our throughout the land. If you travel to Howth, I'm sure you can learn about the unseelie court that has settled in that area. Just talk to the locals."
[Step #5] Talk to the locals in Howth to learn about the [unseelie court] residing in Silvermine.

Talk to Bevin beside the dye merchants. Bevin asks you to kill a Sheevra Chieftain. Go across the stepping stone bridge south of Howth (or swim across) and go into the valley behind the mushroom ring. Hug the left wall, and take the first left, going past walking rocks. (I wouldn't recommend going directly over the mountains as there are many red-purple aggressives in this area.) Veer to the right when the valley opens up, and a large camp of sheevras will be in front of you. Chieftain spawns inside there. When I
saw him, he was behind the hut on the right, so he could be pulled easily to
the wall, bringing only one add. Chieftain was blue to me at 18.
Return to Bevin, and she sends you to Kylie on the dock in Connla. She asks

you to kill an Eiru Kedger. The directions she gives you are somewhat off, and take you through some high level aggressives, but generally: Take the road to Innis Carthaig. It'll go through the valley, turn right, turn left, and when it goes right again, go down into the valley. Loc is approx 49.5k, 42.5k. There is a whole camp of them, but the lowest level one I could find was yellow to an 18. Either bring friends, or go around the camp on the wall, and try to single from the outside.
Return to Kylie, and she will send you to Mosby in Tir Uphost. He asks you

to kill a Moheran Distorter. I wandered around the cliffs for a full day and didn't see one until nighttime, so they may be a night spawn only. Their camp is behind the gales just off of the road from TNN to Tir Uphost to your left, but I'd suggest killing any wandering ones you see, as the camp is guarded by large ants and many other higher level moherans. Lowest I could find here as well was yellow to an 18, and they are casters.
Return to Mosby, and he sends you back to Raine in TMB. She gave me some coin, xp, and a ring. Rings are based on class.
Rewards:
Skillful Ring -- Bard and Druid
Strength Ring -- Blademaster, Champion, Hero, and Warden
Intelligence Ring -- Eldrich, Enchanter, and Mentalist
Resistance Ring -- Ranger and Nightshade
Not a bad quest for the item you get, but it might as well be one of the
epics with as much as they have you running around Hibernia.
Rewards:
Skillful Ring
Strength Ring
Intelligent Ring
Resistance Ring

hibernia|alastriona's chest.Name: Alastriona's Chest
hibernia|alastriona's chest.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per Read File Fix Jan 03, 2002:

Animists and Valewalkers that received a reinforced pair of Skinner's Gloves when they completed Alastriona's Chest may return them to Alastriona outside of Tir na Nog in Lough Derg and receive a cloth pair of Skinner's Gloves. Players MUST have completed Alastriona's Chest to exchange the gloves. Players made only trade in their gloves once.
Talking with one of the Filidh's they tell you Alastriona just outside the Mag Mell (east gate) entrance to Tir na Nog, has broken her leg and needs some help.

1) Go talk to Alastriona outside Tir na Nog, she tells you a sob story about breaking her leg and how her chest with exotic furs was broken into and the furs stolen, but she tagged them magically and needs someone to help her get them back. So you agree and she sends you of after the first one.

2) White boar skin: This one is in the Cliffs of Moher, this is down the road south from the back enterance of Tir. You are after Bantam Spectre -- which I found one just within the borders of Moher and most spawn at night (which is the way you want it, everything in Moher is aggressive and most higher level than you). Once you get the skin, take it back to Alastriona.

3) Cave bear pelt: This one is found in Lough Derg, near the Parthaan Farm, around the lake behind Mag Mell, look in the woods before you get to the farm and there Sheevra all over, your looking for a Skirmisher. Once you have the skin back to Alastriona with it and off for the next.
4) This time Alastriona gives you 2 to go after.

Blood Otter skin: Found on Siabra Fiscere in Shannon Estuary. Cross over the bridge near Connla and head north along the river, they can be found there. The next is found on a Siabra Archer, these are also across the river in the Silvermine Mountains. Once you get the Fiscere continue along the river until you come to the stepping stones, go a little further to the toad stool ring and the and turn in towards the moutains, a little way in there will be a pass to the East, taking that you come out into a little valley with spraggon camp, continue East to the next pass and in there you will find Siabra Miners, Skirmishers, and the Archer you want. After getting the archer is back to Alastriona again for the last skin.

5) Cruiach Daemon Skin: This time Alastriona is sending you after a named crummie poacher in Lough Derg. South East of the Parthaan Farm is a camp of Crummie Fighters and Poachers with Hughar among them. Be careful at 17th these appeared yellow, orange and red to me. I died the first time and had a 23rd level Eldrich with me. The second time I had leveled to 18 and most con'd blue and Hughar was Yellow to me. I had a 22 druid with me and we had no problem getting revenge and the skin from him. Hughar's camp is DIRECTLY behind the singer-fighter camp by the water, near the parth farm. If you're looking at the farmhouse from Mag Mell, go SE around the woods, and follow that hill south, you'll run smack into it. You can see Hughar from the little clearing between the two camps. We pulled him to there, only got one add.
6) Take the last skin back to Alastriona and get you final reward.
She's been giving you some exp and money with each skin, but with the last she gives you a pair of reinforced gloves which con'd blue to me 19th.
Rewards:
Skinner's Gloves (Leather)
Skinner's Gloves (Reinforced)
Skinner's Gloves (Cloth)
Skinner's Gloves (Scale)

hibernia|rest in peace.Name: Rest in Peace
hibernia|rest in peace.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This quest is given by Gogarty Muire in Connacht, close to Muire Tomb entrance at a stone, at loc: 37k, 44k.
Talk to him and he will tell you the story of his family and ask you to get rid of the curse before he goes mad.

When you accept the quest you receive a Gogarty's Journal, which is the main tool you will be using for this quest as it has all the instructions to finish it, remember to check it often, it will update after each step is completed.
All family members are located inside Muire Tomb, so a good map is also very recommended, click link in menu box for multiple map/guide options
Now, the quest...
Step 1: Kill Beare. Very easy, no surprises here.
Step 2: Kill Alsandair. You receive a Dueling Sword, keep it!
Step 3: Kill Conaire. You HAVE to kill him using the Dueling Sword you recieved from Alsandair or quest will not advance.
Up to this point can be done by two persons (We did it as 24 Druid and 24 Nightshade), but from now on you will need more people.
Step 4: Kill Shyene. Be aware several of her Guards will spawn as soon as you attack Shyena and most of other mobs in the room are linked to her.

Step 5: Kill Kacey. This is a bit more complicated. First, you have to kill her to get Kacey's Charm. This is a magical charm that protects her from permanent harm. Second, you must destroy the charm by using it at the foot of the stairs, then you can kill Kacey again and quest will advance.

Apparently, Kacey's charm cannot be acquired by plainly killing her, it must be "stealthily" taken from her, according to Gogarty's log. We tried the quest - using the log above - with 18 champ, 18 champ, 22 warden, 18 druid - and did not get Kasey's charm.
Kill kacey Quest says you have to stelth up and take charm. Your entry says to kill her and you get charm . Then destroy and kill again. We tried this many times.
Finally I used Open command as we were fighting her I got the charm destroyed it and then killed again and quest proceeded.
So use the open command and you will get the charm.
Step 6: Kill Quillan. Nasty mob, be ready.
Step 7: Return to Gogarty Muire and give him the journal.
You receive nearly 1,000.000 xp and 2 gp.
Now you have several rewards to choose from. Note that after you pick one, you will be able to choose what material you want it made of (cloth, leather, reinforced or scale).

General remark to those who want to endeavour this challenging quest: the hardest part of the quest is between Conaire and Shyene: you have to not only kill the Conaire group, but you have to get past them to get to Shyene, and you have to kill the guards at the stairs behind Conaire before the Conaire group respawns, which sometimes happens pretty fast.
Beare's Seashell Belt - Empathy and Strength
Alsandair's Wading Boots - Constitution and Hitpoints
Conaire's Dueling Gloves - Dexterity and Quickness
Shyena's Gossamer Veil - Charisma and Dexterity
Kacey's Soft Sleeves - Intelligence and Dexterity
Quillan's Chest Armor - Constitution and Strength
Rewards:
Dueling Sword
Beare's Seashell Belt
Shyena's Gossamer Veil
Alsandair's Wading Boots
Kacey's Soft Down Sleeves
Quillan's Chest Armor

hibernia|riona's revenge.Name: Riona's Revenge
hibernia|riona's revenge.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Your tasks and targets may vary...
Talk to Riona, a guard at tower before Tir na mBeo (Mardagh), and she talks about the veil and how the sebria captured her. She wants revenge!.

The first task she gives you is to kill Dergal (loc: 58900,27975) at the siabra camp across the lake from Howth and retrieve the vest which has magical runes. Go across the river from Howth to the lucriduannes (sp) where Hazard and the enchanted guy are, that area. Do Not run over the hills, as there are many purple-red aggressive mobs there. Go into the valley behind the mushroom ring (slightly to the right of the standing stone), and hug the left wall. Take the first left, past the walking rocks (were neutral to us), and in the distance on the right is the camp with Dergal. He spawns directly in front of the hut on the right. Easiest place for us to pull him was up on the hill beside where he was standing. He was orange to us, and we ended up having two adds during the fight, but most of the camp was blue-green.
Step Two: (can be any target listed)

He had to kill an empyrian wisp, and I had to kill an eiru fiscere. For the empyrians, run to the parth farm, take a horse to Caille (sp), and they're all over the place in that valley, most were blue-green to us.

For the eiru fiscere, go across the stepping-stone bridge south of Howth, and follow the shoreline to your right (south more). When you start coming up on water badgers (purple-red and aggressive, so I wouldn't suggest swimming as we ended up doing). When the water splits off into a little channel, keep following the shore, and right around the corner inside the channel were tons of eiru guys, mostly green to us.

Then to fix the runes she needs a fire agate gem from a Spectre which wanders W of main city just past the guard tower, at night. Be carefull as soloing it at 18 is tough since most of the mobs are aggro.
Finally she asks you to kill a ghastly siabra for its essence. Do this and you get the Dergal's Runed Haubrek.
Rewards:
Dergal's Runed Hauberk (reinf)
Dergal's Runed Hauberk (scale)

hibernia|sad fomorie.Name: Sad Fomorie
hibernia|sad fomorie.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Reeni, in Ardagh, is worried about a Fomorie who is just sitting around the hills moping. She wants you to check on him. His name is Glom and he can be found on a hill south of the village. Seems that a badger named Stinky stole his toy. Track down Stinky (over the next hill) for him and teach him not to steal from giant babies and he drops Glom's toy. Take this back to Glom and he will no longer be depressed. He gives you a fruit basket to take back to Reeni, who rewards you with some decent coin (10s) and experience.
Stinky: 20k, 13.5k
Glom: 24.5k, 12k

hibernia|scuttle.Name: Scuttle
hibernia|scuttle.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: The Quest starts in Ardagh with a Merchant named Seana. She had a lucky rock stolen by a Fishing Bear Cub named Scuttle on an Island South of Ardagh.
She asks you to kill Scuttle bring back the Stone and Scuttle's Tooth (Note: it has been mention that Scuttle spawns at midnight game time.) She will then ask you later to get an additional item.

The Island is East of the Guard tower between Ardagh and Howth. I was unaware of this Island, but it is there. The Island is small so Scuttle is easy to find. He was trailed by another bear cub and was blue to me at 15 (the other cub was green). Kill them and return to Seana in Ardagh.

She then asked for a Glowing Worm from the belly of a Roane' Companion. These are some of the worm things near the Siabra Island across from Tir NamBeo. Kill it (there is some faction hit) and return the worm to her.
OR

Step 4# Bring back a tiny bit of silvered ore from a Sheevra miner. When I finally found a Sheevra miner (loc 58k, 44k Silver Mts.) I noticed that they are yellow and orange to me at level 13. I dont recommend to go there at level 13 without any company.
OR
Step #4: Obtain a silvered eye from a Roane Maiden.
Reward:
Scuttle's Glowing Tooth

hibernia|spinner's cloak.Name: Spinner's Cloak
hibernia|spinner's cloak.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Step 1: Retrieve 4 Spraggonal Cloaks by killing 4 Spraggonals. These can be found just South of Howth across the stepping stone bridge.
Step 2: Return the cloaks to Banba
Step 3: Take a note to Reedi in Aargagh.
Step 4: Choose a dye color and return to Howth with it.
Step 5: Give the dye to Banba and receive the reward - Spinner's Cloak in the color of the dye selected.
Reward:
Spinner's Cloak (level 9)

hibernia|eoghan's spell.Name: Eoghan's Spell
hibernia|eoghan's spell.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: You may or may not receive this quest.
Talked to Filidh Morven, one of the wandering people near Mag Mell, he said that I should talk to Eoghan in Ardee.
I found Eoghan standing by a tree in Ardee and in talking to him I found out that he is working on a spell and needed my help collecting components for it.
[Step #1] Is to get a Shaft of wheat from Satefe, the named parth, within the Parthanan farm.
[Step #2] is to get a red candle from a Empyrean Watcher in the hills SE of Caille.
[Step #3] is to get a Bowl of morning dew from a Dew Sheerie located near the tower that's on the road to Caille.
[Step #4] is to get a Sprig of vervain from a Gale in the Cliffs of Moher.
Upon getting all these things and returning to Eoghan he finishes his spell and gives you a Pumice Ring.
Reward:
Pumice Ring

hibernia|seeking glory.Name: Seeking Glory
hibernia|seeking glory.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Your class determines the path you are given.

Started from Lauralaye in Tir Na Nog (though post NF speak with Lovernios) you go into Bri Lieth to talk to a sentinel to learn of information about Glory (the bow), he sends you get an arrow from a siabran archer (nocks encampment is easiest... directly across river from Ardagh) then take it to the enchanter in Bri Lieth, She asks you to get her the hoof of a faeire horse, get that by going about South East from town (up a hill near a set of tents) then back to Bri Lieth. Now you are sent to an elf in Mardagh by the enchanter who tells you to find Tangua in Bri Lieth....

Tangua is a rare spawn in a set of huts behind the parthanan farm near Mag Mell, just follow the hill from Mag mell past the river towards the farm and you will eventually see it up on a hilly area (right behind a valley)... this area spawns 3 named Siogs! its main group is Siog footpad and Siog piller. He will spawn twice when he spawns for his cycle... you have a random chance of getting the item each time you kill him.
After that you take the bow back to Tir na Nog and get the bow for finishing the quest.
After getting the arrow. I was sent to find a Mountain Mephit to get a rock of some sort.
Note: Rangers are the only class to receive an item reward (Siabrian Recurve Bow), other classes that complete this quest will receive some silver.
Reward:
Siabrian Recurve Bow

hibernia|setting sail.Name: Setting Sail
hibernia|setting sail.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: 1. Speak with Evie, 8k,38k. She will send you to Keagan in Connla.
2. Speak with Keagan, Follow Journal there are about three different words or phrases to say here.

3. Kill Ualtar, Found in the woods With the Dergans, North of Parth Farm. He was yellow to my 14 Ranger I found Ualtar near loc=61963,7678,5361 in Lough Derg. He looks like a Ghastly Siabra and had a glowing teleport like effect behind him. Next time I saw him he casts 4 of those effects
4. Go to stepping stones near Howth swim around them till you find Rock Lichen.
5. Return to Keagan and give the Wood bowl from Ualtar and the Rock Lichen.
6. Speak with Evie.
7 Give Sailor potion.
8. Speak with Sailor until journal updates, between 7 and 9 times.
9. Speak with Evie, Quest complete
You get a necklace with 18 hp

the necklace you get called tiaga's charm can be turned into the merchant in the first hut to the right of SI's Grove Of Domnann The Merchant has a spelling error and is called taiga and way you get the neckless back but now its 27 hit points 2% crush 2% thrust 2% slash and has a 41 direct damage Ability useable at 17 with 5 charges
Rewards:
Tiaga's Charm
Tiaga's Blessed Charm

hibernia|the feud.Name: The Feud
hibernia|the feud.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Got it from a Filidh in Tir na Nog, I had to go talk to Lasrina in Howth.
After talking to Lasrina I had to kill a Faerie Beetle in Connacht to get a crystal eye. I found farie beetle in Connacht at loc 20K, 32K.
When I had done that I had to give it to Kean in Tir na mBeo and say it
came from Tadhg.
He then sends you out to kill a Large Luch which are in Lough Gur (just
outside Innis Carthaig, East). I found the large luch (looks like a rat) at Loug Gur 55K,41K.
After killing that you get a Luch ear. Go to Connla and give it to Tadhg.
He then sends you out to kill a named Deamhan Creig called Crag in the
Silvermine Mountain SW from the Spraggonole camp. I found Crag (had to kill 40 or so Deamhan Creig) to get him to spawn, his location is 48K, 58K. He was yellow to my 20 enchanter.
You get two items from him, you then go back to Lasrina and give her the
items.
You then get the staff : Aged Stone Staff, then you can exchange it later for a class specific staff.
(I did this quest as a level 20 Eldritch)
Rewards:
Aged Stone Staff -- everyone
Aged Stone Staff (Eldritch) -- Eldritch
Ancient Stone Staff -- Mentalist
Runed Stone Staff -- Enchanter
Rewards:
Aged Stone Staff
Aged Stone Staff (Eldritch)
Runed Stone Staff
Ancient Stone Staff

hibernia|treasure hunt.Name: Treasure Hunt
hibernia|treasure hunt.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Starting NPC is Gaenor the Pierce Merchant in Howth
1) You are asked to run to the bridge in Howth to speak to the named Sentinel concerning a missing supply courier.
2) Return to Gaenor and tell him what you learned.
3) You are sent to the Enchantress that resides at the Tower North of Howth. She send you to kill a Walking Rock.
4) Return to her and then speak to Glom the Fomorie.
5) Go and kill a Deamhan Creig and return to her.

6) Go and find the Gem hidden beneath the stones by the deamhan creigs.(The Gem of Power is obtained from the stones by the Deamhan Creigs while wearing the necklace which Cadalind the enchantress gives you.)
7) You get your choice of lovely 100% Quality weapons. I selected a piercer called Mayhem.
8) You are given a Gem. If you give it to Glom, he gives you a jewel: Glom's Tiny Brooch.
Rewards:
Glom's Tiny Brooch
Mayhem 1H Pierce
Chaos 1H Slash
Havoc 1H Crush
Destruction 2H Slash
Bracer of Obstruction -- Casters
Confusion 2H Thrust
Rewards:
Glom's Tiny Brooch
Mayhem
Chaos
Havoc
Destruction
Bracer of Obstruction
Confusion
Devistation

hibernia|sheerie mischief.Name: Sheerie Mischief
hibernia|sheerie mischief.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Originates with Anice in Mag Mell.

1. Anice sends you to talk to the Gurite Tempriar in Lough Gur. He can be found near Innis Carthaig at 60011x454257. I found him at night. He is surrounded by other gurites, was blue to level 28 (when I finally found him).
2. The Gurite Tempriar gives you a mist pearl and some experience and sends
you back to Anice.
3. Anice sends you to talk to Sentinel Giolladhe at the tower in Bri Leith
(between the MM parth farm and Caille).
4. The sentinel tells you that Driss is leading the sheerie mischief and
offers you the chance to go after him (and anger the sheeries) or not go
after him and keep your current standing with the sheerie. He also pays you 18 silver for the pearl.
5. Driss is at the pond west of the tower. He was not up when I got there,
but I killed off mist sheeries until he appeared in the pond. When you attack him, he will call all of the sheeries to attack you as well (I was attacked by both mist and dew sheeries).
6. Driss drops a scrap of mist cloth, which you are directed to return to
Anice.
7. Anice gives you the Mist Formed Bracer.
This quest is a replacement for the previous one-time drop of the
mist-formed bracer from Driss, the named mist sheerie.
Reward:
Mist Formed Bracer

hibernia|a piece of gormghlaith's mind.Name: A Piece of Gormghlaith's Mind
hibernia|a piece of gormghlaith's mind.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Speak with Gormghlaith, located to the south of the entrance to Howth, she is making tea, and needs a few ingredients.

The first thing you'll need to obtain for her is two water beetle carapaces. I found them to the north of Howth, at the waters edge near the guard tower. Return these to her and she will require you to tell one of the sentinels outside of Howth to do their [job].

Tell this to Sentinel Beacan, to the left of the Howth gate. He requires you to tell Chief Proinnsias about the [spraggons]. He is located in the central building in Howth. He will require you to go to the "spraggon den", to kill three spraggonolls. (Not the dungeon by the same name, but you will pass right by it. The direction you get in the quest journel are accurate enough to follow.) Return with the three Spraggonoll heads, and give them to the Chief.
