He then speak of a "barn" which is little more then a broken down house with no roof, right back where you just came from. Go there and kill the Boss, as Spraggonoll, named, well, Boss. He spawns right next to the 'barn" but there will be many more sprags around. Clear a path to him and kill him. (He was blue at 12th level).
After the Boss is dead, each person involved in the quest should enter and walk around inside the building until they collect four Blackthorn Leaves. These are required by Gormghlaith.

Return the Boss corpse to the Chief, and he will direct you to give the leaves to Gormghlaith. Return to her and give her the leaves. When you have no more to offer her, simply respond with [that's all there was]. The reward, beside a fair amount of silver, is your choice of one of four items.
[ring] for the musically inclined
[jewel] for poison: 4% body, +4 con, +3 hits
[gloves] of leather for speed
[choker] for strength
Rewards:
Badger Strength Choker
Gloves of Night
Musical Ring
Jewel of Absorption

hibernia|bria's savior.Name: Bria's Savior
hibernia|bria's savior.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Some may not get this quest, a prerequisite quest may be required.
Given by Kaenia, the robe merchant, in Tir na mBeo (inside the center building, direction is West).
Initially to test your trustworthiness, you are sent with a letter to
Kaenia's sister, Bria, to aid her with a troublesome curmudgeon. Bria is
located on a farm north of the bridge near Ardee. You reach the farm by
following the river (do not cross the bridge). At the farm, Bria will
request the demise of the "wandering curmudgeon", asking you to bring
its head to her. It is a single curmudgeon standing in a field with
nothing else. It con'd yellow to me at lvl 24. Once accomplished, you
return to Kaenia with a letter from Bria reporting your aid to her.
At this point, Kaenia sends you to the valley of Bri Leith with another
letter to Ailidh. She can be found southeast of Caille just off the road, west of the mushrooms,
standing in the shadow of a large stone circle. Ailidh tells you of a
nasty Faerie Drake named Tric (who has grown lethargic) that is holding
a magic shield. She gives you directions to reach Tric with instruction
to kill him to obtain the shield. You are warned not to hurt any of the
Empyreans at your own risk. To find Tric, travel west just outside
Caille to a log on the left side of the road. Turn North (right) and
head straight up the hill. Tric will be found at the top of the ridge
surround by about a dozen Empyrean Guardians. They were neutral to me,
so no problems were encountered with them. Tric is also neutral and I
was able to walk straight up to him and initiate combat. Tric con'd
yellow to me (again, at lvl 24). /loc is Valley of Bri Leith: loc=47009,21453
Were not offered quest:
24 Hero
25 Eldritch
26 Enchanter
27 Hero
24 Druid
Reward:
Faerie Drake Hide Shield

hibernia|essence of hostility.Name: Essence of Hostility
hibernia|essence of hostility.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to Guardian Adraste near the well in Tir na mBeo, he'll tell a story about a war between Firbolgs/Celts and the Elves a long time ago, in particular one person who was so evil and killed so many elves that after he was slain, all of his belongings were slain, except a few that were so imbued with evil that they could not be destroyed and only hidden away instead. Rumors have reached him that someone has found the location of one of the items, a cursed bracer that no elf will touch.

Andraste asks you to go retrieve the item, which is found on a Rolling Stone on the east side of the lake, in the spot where the stone & rock sheeries spawn (it also says you might need to kill stone sheeries for him to appear;

The Rolling stone spawns about half way between Scarnose and the south end of the lake. It is a daytime only spawn and looks like a stone sheerie. Comes in a group also with a rock sheerie so plan on fighting multiples. killing stone sheeries will help make it spawn.
I found the monster up at the time and killed it). This gets you a Cursed Stone Bracer, which you're told to take back to Andraste.

Andraste gives you three options: keep the bracer as is (it's supposedly cursed, I didn't try it on so I don't know what happens if you keep it), give it to him for a small reward, or cleanse it of the curse. I chose to cleanse it, whereupon he instructed me to travel to the northeast corner of the lake to a moss-covered standing stone where ghastly siabra spawn and find the Fallen One, who spawns only at night. Again, I'm told you might need to kill ghastly siabra to get him to spawn and only spawns once per 24 hours. Possible spawn locations: 53024, 39570 OR 44600, 33000 OR 52695, 40093 (these are all very close together)

Unfortunately there are two or three standing stones where ghastly siabra spawn in that area, and the one he turned out to be at wasn't even particularly moss-covered. It ended up being the large rock about midway between the parthanan farm and the small buildings south of it.

Give the Fallen One the cursed bracer, and hill hound(s) will spawn. I only got one spawn, but the Fallen One kept telling me to kill the hounds (plural), so perhaps it's possible to have multiple mobs appear, or maybe it's just a text error. After I killed the hound, the Fallen One attacked me.
Killing the Fallen One resulted in a Stone Bracer.
Reward:
Stone Bracer

hibernia|occupation of lough gur.Name: Occupation of Lough Gur
hibernia|occupation of lough gur.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: In this quest you are sent to discover why the Gurites are occupying Lough Gur, when there is nothing there that they should want. The quest begins with Aziliz, in the northern (higher) hut on the island in Lough Derg. You may need to speak with Filidh McFanawy in Tir na Nog in order to get the quest.
Speak with Aziliz. She provides the background information for the quest, and then sends you to talk to Chief Bran Llyr, in Culraid (he's standing outside the treehouse, with the stable keeper).

Aziliz says, Good day. Not many visit me out here. A pity, too! I've been hoping some grand adventurers would come my way. I've been interested in the Unseelie Court. I'm kind of curious about something. As you see, I stay here, on this island of dergans. I've made peace with them. I've been studying them. They think me a harmless researcher, and hope to somehow benefit from my [interest], which is why they let me stay."

Aziliz says, "Yes. My particular interest right now is the gurites. They are in Lough Gur, but to my knowledge, there's not really much value in that area. Why would they stay there? What keeps them? They don't attack Innis Carthaig, which is unlike them. I'm just curious as to why they stay there. Perhaps you could figure it out for me?"
Dialog box: Will you help Aziliz figure out why the gurites remain in Lough Gur?
You have been given the Occupation of Lough Gur quest.
Aziliz says, "Oh great! I appreciate your [willingness] to help me!"

Aziliz says, "Great. Go talk to Chief Bran Llyr. I think he knows quite a bit about the gurites and siabra. He lives in Culraid, in Lough Gur, with Kimba. He may know why the gurites stick around that area."
[Step #1] Talk to Chief Bran Llyr. He can be found in Culraid, in Lough Gur. He resides with Kimba. He may know why the Gurites remain in Lough Gur.
Chief Bran Llyr doesn't know anything, but tells you to see Kern, in Innis Carthaig. Kern is an enchanter, and is found in the last building on the left as you enter the city (near the vault-keeper).

Kern tells you that Barra, also in Innis Carthaig, maintains relations with the Gurites, but will need to provide them with a gift: two swords from Empyrean Keepers. The Empyrean Keepers are found in the northeast part of Bri Leith, at approximately 50000, 15000. The easiest way to get there is to take a horse to Druim Cain, then walk southeast over the hills; I didn't notice anything aggro on the way, although my faction with Empyreans is good. Empyrean Keepers are found in pairs, so you will have to fight both; they were generally yellow at level 26, although there were a few pairs that were blue/yellow.
Return to Barra, a weapon merchant who is located in the stall near the stable keeper. He tells you that he is putting in a good word for you with the Gurites
(after all the generic siabras that I've killed, this did nothing to help me), then tells you to speak with Sarena.
Sarena is also found in Innis Carthaig, and is the poison vendor in the first building on the right as you enter IC. She then tells you to seek out Smidget,

a Cluricaun who lives on the island in the middle of Lough Gur. He can be found on the north side of that island (37000,32000), and you better hope that faerie horses like you, as they're all over the place. There's also the occasional savage fishing bear, a 30+ mob who definitely will not like you. Once you kill Smidget, you receive a gem from him, which you take back to Aziliz (remember Aziliz? she's back in step 1).
Aziliz examines the gem, then sends you to talk with the curmudgeon Curmie.

Curmie can be found right outside of Innis Carthaig, near loc 49300, 29400; this is the last patch of trees on the way to IC. He was orange to me at 26. You have to fight him -- at least, I couldn't get him to respond to anything I said -- and when he dies he screams out "No one gets treasures of Tower of Tir na mBeo."
Return to Aziliz, say "tower of Tir na mBeo." She talks for a minute, concluding with "this requires some more thought," gives 2 g and 1.2MM xp, along with and item.
Mobs found during this quest (all below are in Lough Gur):
Trefor: Orange to level 24, 6.6k 53k
Iago: Red to level 24, 6.6k 53k
Smirky: Yellow to level 24, 31k 18k
Smidget: Yellow to level 24, 31k 18k (no special loot dropped)
Curmie: Orange to level 24, 49k 29k
Rewards:
Gramail Bann -- Nightshade and Ranger
Comas Bann -- Druid
Luth Bann -- Blademaster, Champion, Hero, and Warden
Brigh Bann -- Eldritch, Enchanter, and Mentalist
Rewards:
Gramail Bann
Comas Bann
Luth Bann
Bard's Bann
Brigh Bann

hibernia|the broken seal.Name: The Broken Seal
hibernia|the broken seal.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: The quest is called "The Broken Seal" And it was initialed in Tir Urphost by talking to the Druid Tobryn, who is standing next to a tree just SW of town.
He launches into a story about how he is too busy to talk due to his study of the kaolinth. He goes on to tell you the kaolinth are very
temperamental and that all of Hibernian would be better if they were locked away and it just so happens he's found the magical means to do
so... but he needs you help.
After accepting the quest he asks you to go deep into the Kaolinth caves and fetch a craved piece of Azurite from the Kaolinth Castellan. After acquiring that, you are asked to get a bit
of the glowing moss they grown down there. That can only be found with the Kaolinth elder.

After obtaining the items from the kaolinth castellan and elder, you are sent back to the druid in tir uphorst who than gives you a medallion that you are to use at the mouth of the cave, you will notice when getting close to cave entrance it will say you have entered the mouth of koalinth caverns this is actually in cliffs of moher and not inside.

This part took a while as well do to the fact that you use the medallion but something usually keeps it from working. Well finally was able to use the medallion at the entrance and a koalinth guardian spawned on top of me and begin mentioning that it wasn't possible to seal the cavern as the koalinths had already prepared for the attempt. He attacks you immediately and is level 27. After killing him return to the druid to say you were not able to seal the cave.
Rewards:
Waterspun Belt of Fortitude
Waterspun Belt of the Hidden
Waterspun Belt of Intellect
Waterspun Belt of the Thicket

hibernia|sea shell sleeves.Name: Sea Shell Sleeves
hibernia|sea shell sleeves.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Some folks have been required to do the Seeking Glory quest as a pre-requisite for this quest.
1) Talk to Kennocha in Tir na Nog.
2) Kill a Bird-eating Frog in the Cruachan Gorge (frontier).
3) Give the Bird-eating Frog's Hide to Greagoir in Mag Mell.
4) Get some bark from an Irewood Sapling in Lough Gur (or Gurite Waylayer), close to the outpost between Connla and Innis Carthaig.
5) Give unfinished sleeve and bark to Gavina in Connla.
6) Find Seary on spit of island across from Connla (directly SW of Connla).
7) Return to Gavina, she will finish the sleeves and ask you to take a note
to Kennocha in Tir na Nog.
Reward:
Sea Shell Sleeves

hibernia|sraoi's heart.Name: Sraoi's Heart
hibernia|sraoi's heart.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: We are not sure of pre-req's. Some get and some do not. Your steps and tasks may vary...
Labhaoise in Tir na Nog wants four things:
1. Get [essence of strength] from one of the following:
Walking Rock in Silvermine Mountains.
Gurite Assailer in Lough Gur 57k, 53k
Merman in Shannon Estuary
Return to Labhaoise before killing other monsters.
2. A [vial of cloudy liquid] from one of the following:
Lesser Zephyr in Shannon Estuary
Fog Phantom in Cliffs of Moher
Gray Spectre in Silvermine Mountaisn
3. A [vial of clear liquid] from one of the following:
Giant Ant in Lough Gur or Shannon Estuary
Rock Clipper in Silvermine Mountains (loc= 45500, 33200, it wanders around this area.)
Mountain Mephit in Silvermine Mountains

4. Find and kill Sraoi, a named Streaming Wisp in Connacht, at night and get his heart, he is north of the Basar bridge. (Another place to find him is SE of DF entrance on side of hill heading on direct line towards Basar bridge at loc= 42500,24500 (also found at 39370, 21391, 6108 ))
Return to Labhaoise for your reward.
Offered quest:
25 Druid
25 Nightshade
26 Druid
27 Enchanter
50 Eldritch
Not offered quest:
25 Druid
27 Eldritch
Level 30
30 Hero
Reward:
Sraoi's Luminescent Heart

hibernia|the piper's price.Name: The Piper's Price
hibernia|the piper's price.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Visit Amynda in Innis Carthaig , she will ask you to make some rat traps. You will need to get the wood of

an Irewood Sapling and the Mandibles from a Giant Ant. Return to Amynda with the parts you have collected. Received 2.6m experience and an Embellished Rat-Tooth Belt (Level 27 belt with +5% to each of Crush, Slash and Thrust as well as +4 Con). She will ask you to visit Glennard while she builds the traps.

Glennard wants you to find a staff he made for the chieftess but the rats stole. Look in their den to find it. The den in on the side of a hill. Leave town to the southwest and follow the path around the lake. Follow the path until it enters the woods, as opposed to getting really close to the woods, then turn west. Find the den around 16.4k, 24.7k. You will be attacked by several luches. Once you have defeated them, take the staff back to Glennard.

Once back at Glennard, he will reward you with your choice of several weapons. A staff, or something from your specialty: blades, large weapons, crushing, celtic spear, recurve or scythe (Glennards Short Sword: Blades weapon DPS: 9.3, SPD: 2.5 100% Quality. +3 to Blades, +3% Body, +3%spirit, +28 Hits). He will then ask you to take the staff to the chieftess.

Chieftess Naimh talks about how she hired a rat-catcher to help with the problem the town is having. She asks you to stick around and verify that he does the job he's been hired to do. He will appear around dusk, or 6pm. He will arrive slightly after 6pm with a trail of rats following him and gather more from the houses as he walks. He eventually walks into the lake drowning the rats. Return to the Chieftess to report the results.

The Chieftess gives you some bad news and asks you to go pay the Rat-catcher. Take the bag of money and take it to him. He can be found at 18k, 21.2k, near the rat lair you went to previously. The Rat-catcher responds to the bad news in a very negative fashion and you must return to the chieftess to get more money.

The chieftess asks you to visit the vaultkeeper near Connla, who can be found at the tower next to the portal to Hy Brasil. The vaultkeeper states that he can't help and you must return to the Chieftess.

You return to find that the Rat-catcher has taken the children from Innis and brought them to a cottage on a farm with a barn in the back and lots of black horses. You can find the place in question at 57.6k, 26.1k. You must rescue the children any way you can!
Once you return to the Chieftess, you are given a choice of chest armor Rescuer's Scale Hauberk: Scale AF54 100% Quality. +9 DEX, +9 STR, +5% Spirit, +24 Hits).
Rewards:
Embellished Rat-Tooth Belt
Rescuer's Scale Hauberk
Glennard's Short Sword
Glennard's Club
Glennard's Stiletto
Rescuer's Reinforced Vest
Glennard's Scythe
Rescuer's Silk Robe
Glennard's Staff of Mana
Glennard's Carved Bow
Glennard's Light Crafted Staff

hibernia|larylle's necklace.Name: Larylle's Necklace
hibernia|larylle's necklace.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: First talk to Larylle in Ardee upstairs in the main building. She tells you to get her 3 items to make a chain: a silver claw, a broze claw, and a golden claw.

Go to Connla and kill a Water Badger and get a bronze claw. Then swim across from Ardagh and find some Silvermine Badgers kill one get a silver claw. Then it says to find Scar Nose. I found him just a little South of that on the hill by the valley to go up to Dergal. Kill a few Silvermine Badgers and he will pop. Loc. 49670, 20810 or 46740, 24823 I killed him where he stood and got the loc. He was standing near a tree in some tall weeds not too far from a hill. I think it was between the 16th and 17 hour of the day. He con'd green to me at 36. Take the 3 claws back to Larylle and she will give you the necklace.
Another quest view, written by Semprini Nighthunter
1) First you can find Larylle in Ardee in main building upstairs.
2)She wants you to go get a golden chain off of Luch Catchers in Lough Gur, 19k, 20k. Sometimes the catchers wander out of the forest in front of Culraid by the Dampwood Mite log.
3)Now return to Larylle in Ardee and give her the golden chain(got 1.9mil exp for this part at 41). She sends you out to collect 3 claws.

4)First claw is off a Water Badger, so hop on a horse and go back to Connla where there are water badgers roaming in the river right next to it(in between Connla and the bridge is usually where they roam in the water).

5)Second claw is off a Silvermine Badger, which you can find by swimming across the lake at Ardagh at loc 50k, 23k, they wander around the shore in this area. Dont move this is where Scar-nose spawns.

6) Third claw is off Scar-nose. Here is the easiest way to get him to spawn, kill everything that wanders in this area, walking rocks, spraggonales and badgers, got him to spawn in 15 min by doing this, looks like all the rocks spraggons and badgers are on a random spawn(meaning when a mob is killed it randomly selects which mob will spawn, IE so if you kill a Spraggonale, a rock, spraggon or badger will spawn). So if you kill just the badgers you have a much lower chance of a spawn. Exact loc of where I got him was 48k, 24k right next to a hill by the shore.
7)Return to Larylle for her necklace.
Misc notes: Luch Catcher and Scar-nose were the highest lvl mobs I had to kill, they were both green con at 41. Turning in the claws gave me 1.6 mil exp per and 3.3mil exp on receiving the necklace.
Another path at the start of the quest is Larylle will send you to kill Mermen (Connla Well in Shannon Est) for the gold chain.
Reward:
Badger Claw Necklace

hibernia|search for nasco's spear.Name: Search for Nasco's Spear
hibernia|search for nasco's spear.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Aziliz is in the hut on the island near Ardagh, loc 40k, 54k.
Aziliz says, "Greetings, I am Aziliz, Prophetess to the people of Hibernia. I specialize in many things, but my main focus is the Siabra. For you see, they [threaten] our very way of life."

Aziliz says, "Yes, threaten. They are outspoken revolutionsists who desire to see the Elves and Lurikeen shoved from the Veil, to be forever lost from the world of Magic... We must [fight] against this. Are you with me?"
Dialog box: Will you help Hibernia and rid the land of Nasco?
You have been given the Search for Nasco's Spear quest.

Aziliz says, "Excellent. I am glad to know you are with me. Here is what we must do. There is a Siabra chief by the name of Nasco. He wanders around Shannon Estuary, and is guarded by his Ambushers and Waylayers. He is sneaky and crafty. You will need all the help you can get. Hurry to Howth and speak with my sister, Keriann. She will be able to assist you further in this endeavor for Hibernia."
[Step #1]Travel to Howth. Speak with Keriann and tell her Aziliz sent you.
Keriann is in the main hut in Howth. She told us to speak with Kyli in Connla.

Kyli is on the pontoon on the shore, near the boat on the beach. After telling us a story about the magical spear of Nasco, the quest log tells us to find and kill Nasco, he spawns at night only, in the curves of the road to Ceannai.

I found Nasco in the second curve from Ceannai, next to the entrance of the valley where are the Ophelists, at night at /loc 26650, 60468, 5101. Must kill some Eriu (maraudeur in French, may be marauder or prowler in english...) before. Beware: they are linked by two and conned yellow and orange to my warden lvl28. When you kill Nasco, he gives you a spear. You must bring the spear to Kyli.
Kyli tells us to bring the spear to Aziliz.
Aziliz makes something on the spear, and if you are not a Hero, you only receive some Xp and 3 gold. As a Hero you will receive Nasco's Spear.
Reward:
Nasco's Barbed Spear

hibernia|sile's sight.Name: Sile's Sight
hibernia|sile's sight.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This is a unique quest that I chanced on by tagging Oran as a 27 Ranger. Two important differences from other quests: you can't kill anything, and both your journal and most of the characters WILL NOT prompt you with the correct [key words]; you have to remember what you were told and then fake it. There is a LOT of running around, but a good reward.
Here's how it played out when I did it; your mileage may vary.

1. Oran O'Braonain is the Celt standing by the window inside the stone building in Connla. When tagged, he says something about a possible [treasure] project, but he isn't a good judge of character. He wants you to run up to Sile O'Dubhan in Ardagh to see if she thinks you're trustworthy.

2. As the note in your quest log says, Sile is standing in a little depression beside the water, about due E of the round wooden building. For a Celt she's hard to see. Sile is blind. Talk to her and she approves of your niceness and sends you back to Oran.

3. When you get back to Oran, tell him that Sile says you have a [pure heart]. Oran tells you that Sile might be cured if the Empyreans will intervene. He then sends you to take a note to Ardghal Corcoran in Tir na mBeo.

4. Ardghal is the Lurk dancing on the table in the stone inn. Give him the note, and he tells you a long and interesting history about how the Elves and Lurk's abandoned the Firbolgs and went behind the veil, only to be forced to return. When they returned, they found that, while they were out, not only had the Firbolgs become magic, but so had the Celts that had moved in, and also that some new creatures, the Empyreans, had appeared. The Empyreans seem to be made entirely of the unique natural magic that powers the Celts and Firbolgs. They have refused to have any dealings with Fagan or with any Hibernian, and will not intervene for or against any of them.

Eventually Ardghal gives you a package to take to the Empyrean Keeper Rasa in Bri Leith to see if you can bargain for a salve to heal Sile. He warns you to be nice, because Fagan is trying to win their trust.

5. Both Ardghal and your journal say that Keeper Rasa is near Caille. Yeah, like Seattle is near San Francisco. Fortunately, I knew about where to look. She's in a little village of Empyreans in a pocket valley far to the NE of Caille, at ( 51,220 , 14,410 ) . I don't know whether you can get bad faction with the Empyreans, but if you have this will be a long stealthy walk, since the hills are filled with them. The easiest way to get there is probably to take a horse to Drum Cain, hop off just when you see the fort, and strike out due East.

Keeper Rasa is in the stone hut with the light on. She is surprised that you would bother her and requires you to pass several tests to see if you're worthy. The first thing she wants is a perfect glass orb from an Empyrean Wisp.

6. As your journal suggests, you need to do this non-violently. I struck off SW toward Caille and right clicked the first wisp I found; when it faced me, I asked "May I have a perfect glass orb?" and one popped into my inventory.
7. Keeper Rasa, when given the orb, expressed further surprise and said she also needed a bag of moss from a moss sheerie and a bunch of poppies from a primrose.
8 Back to Caille. The moss sheerie gave me a dirty look but was gray and didn't attack; when I asked for a bag of moss it appeared in my inventory.

The primrose went off into a spiel about the joy of wandering the hills picking wildflowers and ends up asking what I wanted. Neither she nor your journal will remind you that you want [poppies], but again she gives them to you when asked.
9. Back to Keeper Rasa, who chats briefly and gives you the Salve of the Eagle Eye. The journal says to take it back to Ardghal.
10. Run to Drum Cain and take a horse to TnmB. Ardghal doesn't talk until you give him the Salve. He then gives the Salve back to you and tells you to give it to Sile and tell her about her [sight].

11. Back to Sile in Ardagh. This part of the quest may be buggy; I said something about [sight] to her before I gave her the Salve, and she was healed  she wouldn't take the Salve after that, but she thanked me and gave me a pot of enamel that some fool had given to a blind person. Not much of a payback for all that work, but she casually mentions that you might want to swing by Oran again.

12. Back to Oran in Connla, who basically ignores you until you say "Sile"s blindness has been cured." At this point he transforms into the Empyrean Keeper Oran, and relates how Rasa cursed him for intervening when he saw Sile wandering blindly through Bri Leith. He thanks you and gives you 3 gold and change and some exp.
Even better, however, is the fact that the Sword of the Keeper has appeared in your inventory.
Reward:
Sword of the Keeper

Lines: 1) Talk to Eira in Connla she tells you a story about a Siabra family that disagreed with the Siabra policies and moved near Connla and were friends of the Celts in the area. hibernia|returning for more.Name: Returning for More
hibernia|returning for more.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: I first heard about this Quest from a 33 Level Warden, who told me to talk to Banba to get it. Also, it seems that what my series of items to collect differs greatly from what my warden friend had to do. We both had to collect the spider's silk, but it veered off track after that. It may be based on your profession, or it may just be random. All I can do is give what I had to do to complete this Quest.
Talk to Banba, you will have had to complete the Spinner's Cloak Quest before this, and she will offer to make a new and improved cloak for you. But she'll need various items to complete it.
1) First thing she'll need is spider's silk from an arachnid found in Treibh Caillte.

2) Bring that back, and then she'll ask for some [Elven Gossimer]. She tells you to talk to someone named Tressa Gorrym'jiarg, /loc 41209, 7444, 5852. She's a fast mover and the hill is very steep, so losing sight of her is fairly easy. Just be patient, and quick. I asked Tressa if I could have some [Elven Gossimer] and was told that I had to do a task before she would give it to me. I was given a Quest called Traces of the Mad Changlings, so I had a Quest to complete within my current Quest.

3) Complete the Traces of the Mad Changlings, then bring the head back to Tressa who will grudgingly give you the Elven Gossimer. Take the cloth back to Banba, who is happy until she notices her sewing basket is missing. She tells you that the last time she saw it was when she was being chased by something scary up in the Cliffs of Moher, and that it was Guard Dooley (/loc 2394, 57547) who saved her life. She tells you to ask him if he's seen it.

4) Talk to Guard Dooley, who is the lurikeen guard hiding under the spiral staircase that surrounds the tower leading to the Cliffs of Moher. He moons over the memory of the beautiful giantess, and tells you that the basket might be found in the possession of a ghostly man near Tir Urphost. He directs you to "travel down that fork towards Tir Urphost, when you get to that town turn yourself right around till yer looking at the big hill. He's up there somewhere around the stones." It's a rather dangerous area surrounded by greater zephyrs (yellow to L34), cliff beetles (orange to L34), and cliff dweller hunters (red to L34). Of course, they are all aggro on me.

5) The ghostly man appears on the hills within the circle of standing stones. He's named Aengus Osrithe. He'll ask about Banba and wants to know what she is. I told him she was a [firbolg], and he gives me the basket. I camped the area from 20h... didn't see him until 23h. Location: 39/28.

6) Take the basket back to Banba, and give it to her. She'll happily cluck over her sewing basket, and asks you to get cloth dye from Reeni in Ardagh. Your choice of colors being blue, teal, light purple, royal green, red, dark grey, orange, earth brown, or royal purple.

7) When you get to Reeni, you'll click on her to talk, and she'll ask if you'll help her out. She needs you to talk to Sarena in Innis Carthaig and hands you a sealed scroll. You are offered the Returning to the Source Quest, another quest within your quest.
8) After you complete the Returning to the Source Quest, you talk to Reeni who will offer you a choice of colors from her cloth dyes. You pick one, then head back to Banba.
9) Give Banba your chosen cloth dye, and she will hand you a Spinner's Cloak dyed the color of your choice. And you're done.
Reward:
Spinner's Cloak (level 33)

hibernia|returning to the source.Name: Returning to the Source
hibernia|returning to the source.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: You are given this Quest as part of the Returning for More Quest.

1) Reeni in Ardagh gives you a sealed scroll and asks you to talk to Sarena in Innis Carthaig. Sarena can be found in the stone building to the right of the stable master in Innis. She's wearing red and black and is a Poison Merchant. She'll ask what does Reeni want? Give her the scroll, and she'll say that Reeni's lucky she's already written down the information and hands you a sealed scroll to give back to Reeni. Take the scroll back to Reeni in Ardagh.

2) Give the scroll to Reeni, and she'll mutter that that information wasn't quite what she had expected, and that she needs you to take another scroll to Jarlath in Tir na Nog. She hands you another sealed scroll, and tells you to look for him in bars.

3) Jarlath can be found in /loc 21922, 26412, 7807 which is best accessed through the North Gate to Tir na Nog in Connacht. Go straight through the double gate to the building directly across, the one containing the healer Waljan. Just up the stairs is Jarlath. Talk to him. He'll give you another sealed scroll and tell you to find Tethra in Ardee, and talk with her.

4) Tethra is in /loc 54819, 51598, 5216 in the main stone building (I think. I finished this very late at night and my memory is kinda foggy). Give her the scroll and I believe you are done. Head back to Reeni.

Loc: 15720 18448 also seen at 20607, 7759. Return his heart and he will give you half of it to turn into a merchant in the Bog of Cullen (SE of innis). hibernia|traces of the mad changlings.Name: Traces of the Mad Changlings
hibernia|traces of the mad changlings.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Given to you as part of the Returning for More Quest.
/loc for Tressa Gorrym'jiarg is approximately 41000, 7500
When you first click on Tressa, she'll say...
Tressa Gorrym'jiarg says, "Hmph, another noisy creature. And what is it you want?"

Tressa Gorrym'jiarg says, "Well, Champion, I see you are here. Unfortunately I cannot trade this necklace I have for you belt. The necklace would do nothing for a strong Champion like you. Run along now!"
I asked her for some [Elven Gossimer], and she replied.

Tressa Gorrym'jiarg says, "Oh really? Do you actually think you'll get it for nothing Celt? You must truly live in a fantasy land of your own makings. I'll tell you what, since I am a fair woman, I will let you have the cloth, for a [price]."

Tressa Gorrym'jiarg says, "There is a creature, one who annoys me greatly, of decent power and mind boggling insanity. He fancies himself a great paladin for Albion, and does much damage to the harmless creatures of Bri Leith. The Empyreans being ill-equiped to deal with such a monster, have done nothing to aid me in my efforts to finally rid Hibernia of this nuisance once and for all. If you [agree to help] me, I shall give the cloth to you willingly."
Dialog box:

Tressa Gorrym'jiarg says, "Excellent! I knew you'd be the sporting type. Here is what you must do. Near to where Watcher Rylie keeps his post at the standing stones in Moon Lake, is a mad changling called LUSMOREBANE (/loc 58K, 60K). As I said before, he thinks himself a paladin. He has slaughtered many harmless creatures within Bri Leith, and he needs to be dealt with. You may need to kill his fellow 'paladins' to coax him out of his 'stable'. When you are done, bring me his head that I may know the deed is done.

From Caille, head SE over a few hills then cross Moon Lake until you reach tall standing stones surrounded by Empyrean Watchers and Watcher Rylie at night and trackers by day. Just behind then, at the foot of the hills are the mad changlings. Start killing them, and soon Lusmorebane will pop. He conned yellow to my Level 34 Champion. After dispatching him, I had his head in my backpack, and returned to Tressa. I gave her the head, and received the Elven Gossimer after hearing this...

Tressa Gorrym'jiarg says, "Yes, this is it alright. Finally, now the gentle creatures can rest easier. And, as for you, well, since you did help me with that problem, I am honorable enough to hold up my end of the bargain."
Tressa Gorrym'jiarg says, "Make good use of this cloth Celt, I shall not be so generous in the future."
Rewards:
Lusmorebane's Jeweled Necklace
Belt of Spryness

hibernia|criofan's fish.Name: Criofan's Fish
hibernia|criofan's fish.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to Criofan the Fisherman (on the bridge north of Connla), and he will tell you his story of losing his pearl ring to his pet golden fish. It swam up the river, up a stream, and he thinks an Siabran Kedger named Kaen, has caught the fish. He requires you to first get him a Kedger scaling knife from an Eriu Kedger, and then get his golden fish from Kaen (you need not return to him between the tasks, just need to do the things in that order).

Kaen Kedger is hidden behind a building and you will not get him from the valley floor. Go up the east hillside and work your way between the 2 buildings. Look down and you will see him standing there. Remember to kill a Kedger first, which shouldn't be difficult as they are out in plain view and a lower lvl than the Henters and others running around. Also some of them wander very fast, very far and very aggressively, so you might want to watch them for a couple of minutes if you need to get close to the camp. Everything was no worse than yellow to me and were all easy kills. Nothing added, but I was careful to avoid any that were near others.
The requests are simple, and took me about 10 minutes to find the camp, and obtain the items. Once you return the things to Criofan, he is so overjoyed, he gives you Kedger's Gilded Boots.
FYI: Criofan required an additional step of fetching the stomach lining of a Fearie Beetle in Lough Gur to make the boots out of. Another needed a Curmudgeon Scout (loc=45k,30k near Innis)
If you can't wear leather armor and already completed this quest, you can turn your boots back in to Criofan, and he gives you Kedger's Quick Boots
Rewards:
Kedger's Gilded Boots
Kedger's Quick Boots

hibernia|freeing osier.Name: Freeing Osier
hibernia|freeing osier.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Odharnait looks up at you with tear-stained cheeks and red eyes.
Odharnait says, "Forgive me if my crying bothered you. It's hard to be anything but sad after what i saw the other day. Such [horrible thing] I've seen lately."

Odharnait says, "Have you ever seen the harvest rituals that are performed in some areas around here? Most of them are simple, thanking the earth and the goddess for this year's bounty and ensuring there will be a plentiful harvest next year. But in some places like Shannon Estuary, where I just came from, they have turned to the ancient ways. They have brought back [the wickerman] sacrifice!"

Odharnait says, "Oh, it is awful! They take people and put them into a large wicker cage shaped like a man. When everyone is inside, they light it on fire! Oh, those poor souls, trapped in there, sacrificed to next year's harvest. I recently witnessed one of these rituals and I fled here, since it brought back such [sad memories]."

Odharnait says, "About 10 years ago, my beloved Osier and I were visiting Shannon Estuary around the time of the harvest. The celebrations got out of hand, and the wickerman was raised. Osier was swept up in the masses and thrown into the wickerman. I watched in horror as he was burned with the others, a sacrifice to the mother earth and the harvest. I fled here to Silvermine Mountains and have stayed here. I haven't [left here] until recently."

Odharnait says, "I traveled down to Shannon Estuary to visit Osier's relatives. While i was there, I went for a short walk one night. I couldn't believe my eyes - a spectral presence wandered past me and stopped. It was shaped like a wickerman, and burning, but when it looked at me, its eyes were human. I realized then who it was - my beloved Osier. He lunged at me and I fled in horror, even though I could feel he [needed something] from me."

Odharnait says, "I think he recognized me too. I think he wanted me to free him from that ghastly existance he has been forced into. But, I am too full of sorrow and fear to do anything. I need [someone fearless] to help me."
Odharnait says, "I think you are brave indeed, Blademaster, to agree to help me with this. My whole way back up here I thought about how Osier could be freed and I think I [have a plan]."

Odharnait says, "I think if you were able to douse the flames that consume Osier, it would free him from this world. But ordinary water will not quench those spectral flames and no ordinary container can carry that water. You must make [an enchanted one]."

Odharnait says, "After some research, I have found that the bladder of a large red wolfhound, when enchanted, will hold the magical water you require. Seek out these creatures in Lough Gur or Lough Derg. When you have a bladder, take it to Uistean in Connla for more help."
[Step #1] Get a wolfhound bladder from a large red wolfhound. These can be found in Lough Derg and Lough Gur.
(Found a Large Red Wolfhound close to Ceannai, on the way to Innis Carthaig, before entering the forest, he dropped the bladder when killed - conned blue to me at 23)
*Your steps may be different and call for different animal.
also used:
Fishing Bear
Large Luch
Giant Otter
[Step #2] Go find Uisetan in Connla in Shannon Estuary and give him the bladder.

Uisetan says, "Hrmph, you expect me, a noble Lurikeen, to talk to the likes of you? I can't believe a Firbolg like you would even think of trying. If you're in such a desperate need for an enchanter, go see that Firbolg Kiana in Ardee in Connacht. Now, be off!"
[Step #3] Go find Kiana in Ardee in Connacht and give her the bladder.
Kiana says, "So, Uistean wouldn't help you? He's a terrible snob. I shall enchant it nicely for you. I will also tell you where to get the magical water you will need."
You are awarded experience!
Kiana casts a spell!
You receive a magically sealed bladder from Kiana!

Kiana says, "There is your enchanted bladder. Now to fill it and quench the fires that consume Osier, you must seek out the dew sheeries. The best place to find them is Lough Derg, although I have seen some in Lough Gur. When you kill the dew sheerie, the enchanted bladder will draw the water out of the sheerie and into itself. Once it is filled, wait until nightfall then seek out Osier in Shannon Estuary. Give him the bladder and it should quench the flames. Be warned, he will most likely attack you, for he has no knowledge of good any more. He may also call for the other spectral wickermen to help him in this mission. When you have freed him, return to Odharnait."
[Step #4] Kill a dew sheerie in Lough Derg or Lough Gur to get its water.
(Found a dew sheerie in Lough Derg, close to the Curmudgeon camp east of the Parthanan farm. It was green to me at 23)
As the dew sheerie dies, the magical bladder fills with water.
[Step #5] Seek out Osier at night in Shannon Estuary. Give him the magically sealed bladder.

(Found Osier in Shannon Estuary at loc=11531,52201,4534 - thats south of Connla over the river and over the first hill, four standing stones are there, he only spawns between midnight and morning, be careful as he might call for help when attacked. Don't fight him, just give him the bladder when he attacks you)
Osier says, "Free me...please...free me from the flames! Oh they burn! They burn...please..."
Osier takes the bladder and breaks it over his head, water pouring down his body.
Osier says, "Oh thank you...aahh...I shall be free now...thank you...take this to my sweet Odharnait...please..."
You receive Osier's Satchel from Osier!
[Step #6] Return to Odharnait in Ardagh in Silvermine Mountains.
Odharnait says, "It is good to see you have returned, Aila. I was worried that the task I asked of you was too great. Were you able to free my beloved Osier? I shall need some proof from you."
(Hand Odharnait the Osier's Satchel)
You are awarded experience!
Odharnait says, "Oh, this is his satchel. I made this for him shortly after we first met. Osier had this with him when they took him. I forget what he had inside it at the time. Let me look."
Odharnait opens the satchel and looks inside. She reaches in and removes two objects. She slips one of them on her finger.

Odharnait says, "This was the ring he was going to give me that night. I shall treasure it always, knowing he was going to ask me to marry him. I had forgotten about this necklace until just now. The silly man was so handsome, but he didn't think it. He bought this 'spectral' necklace, as he called it, to make himself more attractive to me. I'd like you to have it with my gratitude for freeing Osier from that torture. I hope it serves you well."
You receive a Osier's Spectral Necklace from Odharnait!
You are awarded 11 silver and some copper!
You are awarded experience!
You have finished the Freeing Osier quest.
Reward:
Osier's Spectral Necklace

hibernia|black plague.Name: Black Plague
hibernia|black plague.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: I did not capture the spam text, or even the journal entries before a certain point. (Approximate) journal entries are noted by #. Items are noted by[Item]. Otherwise it's my comments or notes.
Start the quest by going to the healer Waljan, upstairs inside the tavern opposite the Connacht entrance to TNN. Waljan is concerned about a plague affecting people in TNN.
1. Waljan directs you to go to Eavann, in Tir na Nog. Eavann is located downstairs in the building opposite the entrance to the Nightshade / Ranger guild.
2. Eavann directs you to speak to Tiarnan, in Tir na Nog. He has been ill.
Tiarnan is located upstairs in the same building as Eavann. Talk to Tiarnan and he gives you a [Sealed Letter for Keriann] for his sister Keriann.
>From this point on, journal entries are verbatim.
3. Take Tiarnan's letter to Keriann, in Howth. Keriann is located inside the Chief's hut. Give her the letter and get some quest spam.
4. Continue speaking to Keriann, in Howth, about her brother.

Keep talking to her and eventually she gives you back a [Note to Tiarnan]. She asks if you would like some cash for your troubles. I replied "No", and received 13,836,044 experience (a level 41 druid). I have no idea what the cash reward would be. (if you say "Yes" for some cash for your troubles you receive 2)
5. Return Keriann's Note to Tiarnan, in Tir na Nog. Take the horse back north, and run back into TNN to see Tiarnan. Give him the note.
6. Continue speaking with Tiarnan, in Tir na Nog.He likes chatting with you, and rewarded me with 6,918,022 experience. He directs you to Eavann.
7. Talk with Eavann to see if she has heard any more news from the Druids. Eavann chats for a bit, then directs you back to Waljan.
8. Return to Waljan, in Tir na Nog, and speak to him about Tiarnan's health.Run back over to Waljan, and speak to him.
9. Speak to Waljan to see if you are sick with the disease. To no one's surprise, you are sick so Waljan wants you to fetch an item that he can use to make a cure.
10. Travel to the Coruscating Mines and slay a Glow Worm. Bring the worm fungus back to Waljan for a cure.

Glow Worms are located just inside the entrance to CM. The [Worm Fungus] pops into your inventory like any other quest or one-time drop, but is marked as being stackable. It is capitalized like a post-20 kill task item.
11. Take the worm fungus back to Waljan in Tir na Nog. Run and take a horse back to Waljan. Hand the item to him, he mixes up the cure and you are healed.
12. Speak with Waljan to see if he has found out anything new. He has, of course, and send you out to kill the source (?) of the plague.
13. Journey to Darkness Falls and slay Archivist Borath. Return to Waljan, in Tir na Nog, with the Stoppered Wondrous Potion.

Archivist Borath can apparently be single-pulled if he is up, through the other mobs in his area. After killing him, you get two items, a [Stoppered Wondrous Potion] and an Unstoppered Wondrous Potion].
14. Return to Waljan, in Tir na Nog, with the Stoppered Wondrous Potion. You may keep the Unstoppered Wondrous Potion for yourself.
Run back to TNN, give the [Stoppered Wondrous Potion] to Waljan. The experience reward was 13,836,044 points. Waljan mentions coming back to talk to him again in case he has other work for you.
The Unstoppered Wondrous Potion is a 1 charge, 65% heal potion with a level 37 requirement.
I am told that this might be the prerequisite for a latter quest that requires killing Legion.
Rewards:
Unstoppered Wondrous Potion (Hib)
Stoppered Wondrous Potion

hibernia|fylara's armor.Name: Fylara's Armor
hibernia|fylara's armor.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-12-04 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per Patch 1.62:
- Fylara's Armor - In response to player concerns about the long wait for broodmothers, we have decreased the wait time between broodmother spawns.

Fylara MacKieran says, "Hail, Druid. I am Fylara MacKieran, armor-maker for Comor Mac Gwion and my father, Lughaidh MacKieran. I've been making armor since I was a child. My mother taught me how to sew and my uncle Monaghan taught me how to forge armor. When I was old enough, I learned old secrets to make armor that is better than what you can buy from the merchants. My father was most pleased with my skills and [intriduced me] to Conor Mac Gwion."

Fylara MacKieran says, "Conor was impressed with my skills and immediately put me to work making armor for his army. When Conor led his forces here to Hy Brasil to aid the Sylvan, I made sure I was one of the first here. I have always made my armor from natural things, and I knew I would [find new things] here to use in my armor."

Fylara MacKieran says, "The bars of the trees, the hides of animals, and various parts of the wild creatures that roam the land - all these things became potential parts of armor. I studied things and tried out different combinations until I was happy. I took my creations to my father and asked him to pass them on to Conor for his opinion. Conor was most pleased and charged me with [making enough] for the entire army!"

Fylara MacKieran says, "That wouldn't be such a problem except that Conor's army us huge! I have been trying my best to collect the items I need to make this armor, but I've been having trouble. They are fairly rare items and it takes a long time to make even one piece of armor. I could use someone to gather the items while I finish up the pieces I'm working on. Do you [know of anyone] that could help me?"
Dialog box: Will you help Fylara MacKieran make armor for Conor Mac Gwion's army?
You have been given the Fylara's Armor quest.

Fylara MacKieran says, "You want to help? That is wonderful! In exchange for helping me, I will give you this piece of armor I'm finishing up. But I need you to replace the items I'm using right nowso that Conor will not become angry at me for giving away a piece of his army's armor. [One of the pieces] is fairly easy to get, but the other is more difficult."
[Step #0] Talk with Fylara MacKieran to find out what is needed for the armor.

Fylara MacKieran says, "The first thing you need to get is the tongue of a gorge shriller. Their tongues are tough and hold well in battle. I have begun using them to reinforce the hinges of scale armor. You will find these creatures if you cross the wooden bridge near here and head north. I will not lie to you; getting the tongue will be the easy part. Have you heard of [the ixthiar]?"

Fylara MacKieran says, "They are vile creatures, bent on destroying anything that gets in their path. They hate all Sylvan and their allies but I've found that [a certain kind] of ixthiar has a carapace that makes very good reinforcements for armor."

Fylara MacKieran says, "I speak of the ixthiar broodmothers. They are elusive creatures, but I have discovered the secret to draw them out of their homes. Across the river and northwest of here there are five huge trees that were once in habited by Sylvan. But with the coming of the Fomorian, the Sylvan fled their homes, abandoning them to any and all creatures. The ixthiar broodmothers took up residence in these trees, producing their young to fill the land with evil. Most of the time the broodmothers live deep within the roots of the trees, but when their young are exterminated, they wil come to the surface to begin producing more. That is how you [will lure] a ixthiar broodmother out."

Fylara MacKieran says, "Heed my words, Druid! I would not try this alone! Ixthiar doomcallers and reapers guard the nests. Pick one nest and exterminate all the creatures close to it. When all are dead, the broodmother will sense this and will come to the surface. You must defeat her to obtain the carapace. It will not be easy, but with a few associates you should be able to win. Once you have the pelt and the carapace, come back to me and speak with me."
[Step #1] Kill a gorge shriller to get its tongue. They can be found by crossing the wooden bridge near the Grove of Aalid Feie and heading north.

the first thing she asks you to get can vary. a Nightshade was asked to get the pelt of a bugbear nuisance (just west of the town, between the two bridges) and a champion and bard were asked to get grove shriller tongues (follow the road north across the bridge and stay on it until you see them).

step #2: go to an Ixthiar nest (pick one, I used the one at 26k, 15k) and stay in that area killing all the Ixthiar. if you leave the area, I think the broodmother's timer resets, which will make it longer for you. After about 10 minutes or so, she popped for us and was orange to 50.
step #3: return the parts to Fylara
step #4: give her tongue
step #5: give her the eye
quest gives lvl 47 leggings (Ixthiar Eye Leggings for bard, Bugbear Pelt Leggings for NS, both af 94)
