hibernia|detrital crab meat -- kill task.Name: Detrital Crab Meat -- Kill Task
hibernia|detrital crab meat -- kill task.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to Marie in Connla and she wants some crab meat. The crabs are in the Bog of Cullen, kill some and return the meat to Marie for xp.

hibernia|cervideth antlers -- kill task.Name: Cervideth Antlers -- Kill Task
hibernia|cervideth antlers -- kill task.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Sarah in the Grove of Aalid Feie wants skeletal elk antlers. Return them to her for your reward.
Sarah says, "Oh, you scared me. What are you doing around these parts? You must be another [brave adventurer]."
Sarah says, "Please pardon my sarcasm, but I have seen more than a healthy handful of brave adventurers come around here, only to be killed by the [undead]."

Sarah says, "I don't know who's doing it, but I've seen dead men and women brought back here with gouges so large in their chests, you'd think a small tree has been shoved through them! I think I know [what creature] is doing this though."

Sarah says, "I think it's the skeletal elk. They have antlers large enough to gouge a man nearly in half! If you find one, bring its antlers to me so I may study them and compare them to the bodies that have just arrived."
You are awarded 18,256,769 experience!
A little more information Submitted by Cunla 50 Hero Igraine.
You need to hunt Cervideths (ghostly giant elks) outside town until you get
a drop - Cervideth Antlers
Bring these back to Sarah and she says:
"Oh my, these are large aren't they? Well let me get to work. If you
happen to get any other antlers please bring them to me. Thank you!"
Gave 18,256,769 at level 45

hibernia|spiteful sylvanshade head -- ki.Name: Spiteful Sylvanshade Head -- Kill Task
hibernia|spiteful sylvanshade head -- ki.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Jack in Grove of Domnann (found at second floor of a tree, loc 31766,52539) wants some heads to roll! Go and kill Spiteful Sylvanshades for their heads and return for your reward.
lvl 46 received 24 million exp.

midgard|traveler's way.Name: Traveler's Way
midgard|traveler's way.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: At level 7, your guild trainer will give you the traveler's way quest. There are two trainers for each class in Jordheim, the one who you spend your points with and the one that will give you your quest. The description and reward varies by class, but is pretty easy to follow. This results in a decent class-specific magic item.
Note: If you have Shrouded Isles expansion, you may start your epic quests in Aegirhamn and not do this one. See your class page for complete quest listings.
Trainer says, "(your name here), it is time to send you out into the lands beyond ours. Explore these other lands and tell them of our house's good will and [aid those we can]."
Dialog box: Do you wish to explore these lands and aid those in other lands as a sign of our house's good faith?
You have been given the Traveler's Way quest.
Trainer says, "Well then, if you wish to journey these lands, I shall send you to Val. He can be found in the guard tower on the road to East Svealand. Do explore!"
Val is located inside the guard tower in East Svealand at loc 15375, 53282.
Val says, "Aye there. You've come a ways, haven't you now? Spare me [some time], could you?"
Val says, "Just bring me a few of those ant parts; these little ant workers have been everywhere lately. You could rid us of a few, couldn't you now."

He wants you to only kill three army ant workers and return the legs to him. After you have done this he will reward you with coin and send you to Lalida in Fort Atla in Gotar. She is the Skald trainer in Fort Atla.
Lalida says, "You look a traveler from far off. What brings you to [Fort Atla]?"
Lalida says, "Oh. Val must have sent you. I had requested his aid, but it is no longer necessary...but since you've come this way, speak with Ruk. She owes me one, tell her Lalida says hello."
Ruk is a merchant in the building just to the left as you enter Fort Atla. You will have to /say Lalida says hello for her to respond.
Ruk says, "Hello traveler. Can I help you?"
You say, "Lalida says hello."
Ruk says, "Well! I am glad. Here, now don't be telling all your friends I've give you this now."
Rewards:
Cap of Mindbending -- Spiritmaster, Bonedancer, and Runemasters
Traveler's Cloak -- Hunters
Ring of Health -- Healers and Shamans
Ruby Studded Jerkin -- Berserkers, Thanes, Savages, Skalds, and Warriors
Ring of Stealthy -- Shadowblades
The next epics are listed to the left, please pick the appropriate one for your class.
Rewards:
Cap of Mindbending
Traveler's Cloak
Ring of Health
Ruby Studded Jerkin
Ring of the Stealthy

midgard|a war of old.Name: A War of Old
midgard|a war of old.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This is the Hunter epic quest, and you must complete the Traveler's Way quest first.
At 15th, the trainers in Jordheim will send you to talk to Morlin Caan. He can be found at the forge next to the temple (the one with Gris, not the tradeskill forge in the upper part of town).

He tells you about an Albion army that Arthur sent into Midgard before his death. The army was defeated, but parts of it still roam the land as undead. He will send you to talk to Masrim in Fort Atla for more information.
Masrim can be found in the building directly opposite the gate in Fort Atla, around in the back. She will tell you to go kill Scout Argyle.

The Scout and 2 undead scouts can be found on the hills near the entrance to Cursed Tomb - go over the bone bridge toward Myrkwood, then start looking around off to the left of the road. Approximate loc: 52129, 60447 and they do roam a bit.(also found at loc=50k/55k)
The undead scouts use bows and arrows to try and pick you off, but use swords up close. Kill him, and return to Masrim. She will say nice things about you and send you back to Morlin for your reward.
Morlin gives you the Beastfriend's Bracer or Boots of the Agile Evader for this part of the quest.
Rewards:
Beastfriend's Bracer
Boots of the Slinker

midgard|an end to the daggers.Name: An End to the Daggers
midgard|an end to the daggers.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Your trainer sends you to talk to Elizabeth in Mularn. She will give you a Dagger that you need to give to Lynnleigh.
Give the Dagger to Lynnleigh in East Svealand. She spawns on Strider Island(39200,21100) at night time. You know you remember the water strider? LOL
Lynnleigh will send you to kill Geyra in Yggdra Forest, spawns at 5k, 56k and BAF (New Frontiers loc=47,287 6,664).(Geyra is red to lvl 43 and 2 red mobs are protecting him)
Return to Lynnleigh and get approx 1,XXX,XXX,XXX xp.
Lynnleigh will then send you to kill Red Hagen in Raumarik. He can be found in a building right at the entrance(near the Wyverns). He will drop a map you need to give to Lynnleigh.
Return to Lynnleigh and give her the map for your reward.
Warrior gets about 603 mil xp when brings Geyra's necklace to Lynleigh
and about 642 mil xp when bringing Red Daggers map.
Rewards:
Modi's Belt of Bravery -- Berserker
Tyr's Hand Necklace -- Warrior
Voice of Bragi -- Skald
Belt of Thunder -- Thane
Kelgor's Belt of Battle -- Savage
Rewards:
Modi's Belt of Bravery
Tyr's Hand Necklace
Voice of Bragi
Belt of Thunder
Kelgor's Belt of Battle

midgard|bones of the dead.Name: Bones Of The Dead
midgard|bones of the dead.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This is a level 7 hunter and shadowblade epic quest given by the trainers in Aegirhamm.
Jolgeir will tell you to speak to Thara Stonehammer (loc 44k,44k).
Thara Stonehammer will tell a story about some research being done and she needs leg bones from two large skeletts.
Go kill two large skeletts (loc 27k, 50k) and return the bones to Thara Stonehammer.
In her gratitude you get Kappe av Jakten.
Rewards:
Ring of Shrouding
Kappe av Jakten

midgard|cape of the mother wolf.Name: Cape of the Mother Wolf
midgard|cape of the mother wolf.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: You must complete Traveler's Way quest first.
Sveck is upset that after fighting for years for his realm, he was driven
off the road by a wolf. He wants you to hunt down this wolf, Modervarg,

the mother wolf in West Svealand (55k, 14k), and return her heart. Upon its return, he gives you a note to take to Olgara in Huginfell where she will fashion something for you. When you hand her the note, she thanks you and then hands you back the Cape of the Mother Wolf.
Reward:
Cape of the Mother Wolf

midgard|clan business.Name: Clan Business
midgard|clan business.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: I recieved this quest from the Bonedancer trainer in Aegirhamn. I'm
assuming this is the pre-epic quest (i.e. traveler's way), because when I
returned afterward to Jordheim and went to the BD trainer there, he gave me
nothing. I'm also assuming that if you talk to the BD trainer in Jordheim
first, he'll redirect you to Aegir (though I could be wrong).
"Clan Business"
1) Talk to the Bonedancer (BD) trainer in Aegirhamn. He instructs you to talk to Karle Alfevson, whom is in the same area where the vault keeper is.
2) Karle tells you to get a "primitive talisman" from a musslakan youth", found SW of the tower (the two towers at the south exit of town).

3) Take the South exit out of town, and head accross the bridge, where 2 towers are, one at the base and top of the hill. Head in a SW direction, up the hill, and into the plains. You'll see a huge white boulder ahead of
you. (loc=25720 55527)There will be many groups of musslakan there. There is a purple named

that roams around, as well as higher con'd ones, so be careful. Any musslakan will do, even a grey one. They may add, but if you target a blue, a grey add won't break you. Once you kill one, you'll recieve a talisman.
4) Bring the talisman back to Karle and you'll recieve about a bubble of experience and 6 silver, and a piece of jewelry.
Rewards:
Totem Bones -- Bonedancer
Minding Beads -- Spiritmaster
Runed Ring -- Runemaster
Rewards:
Totem Bones
Minding Beads
Runed Ring

midgard|coplin's spirit.Name: Coplin's Spirit
midgard|coplin's spirit.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: After completing the first part of the Grenlock crest quest and reaching level 20, go back and speak to Anrid in Jordheim. She will instruct you to seek out the spirit of Coplin in Myrkwood to recover the second piece of the crest. Coplin spawns by the young envy drakeling nests in southwest Myrkwood at around 8490, 55854 (alt dircetions:go to askheim (the WW fort in myrkwood)(also found at loc=8563,55880,5028). Go behind it, all the way until there is no more water on both sides, and to the left. Follow the shoreline, until you see a ghosly looking guy (pretty bright at night). He will talk to you about the balance of nature and how all creatures must learn to live in harmony, and then tell you to find Tradande, a tree spirit in Skona Ravine. Tradande spawns around 48683, 31705 in Skona and will give you the second piece of the Grenlock crest when you speak to him. Be careful once you have the crest because a pack of werewolves will immediately come and try to kill him. Return the crest piece to Anrid in Jordheim to receive your reward.

Tradande says, "Hail. The human man Coplin has sent you to [collect] the piece of the family crest he bestowed upon me to protect. He was a good man. Coplin always protected those who needed it, even us."
Tradande says, "I give unto you the crest, but you must... NO! Run! Evil has descended upon us! I shall hold them off as long as I can!"
Run your butt off, for several werewolf types that conned purple to me attacked me. They cast root, so once you are rooted, you are a goner.
[Step #3] Return the Crest piece to Anrid within the walls of Jordheim.
Anrid says, "Did you meet with Coplin and get the second piece of the crest?"
You give the second crest piece to Anrid.
Anrid says, "Wonderful. You are doing well. Perhaps on this track we can once again restore the Grenlock Crest to its original glory! Be safe in your travels!"
You receive Spirit-dweller's Sleeves from Anrid!
You have finished the Coplins' Spirit quest
Rewards:
Runemaster -- Runed Mystical Pants
Spiritmaster -- Spirit-dweller's Sleeves
Bonemaster --
Rewards:
Spirit-dweller's Sleeves
Runed Mystical Pants
Boned Mystical Pants

midgard|darksong's dirge.Name: Darksong's Dirge
midgard|darksong's dirge.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Your trainer (Per or Dane) tells you that Darksong and her new husband were traveling when they were set upon and killed. Now her ghost roams the land looking for peace and he asks that you kill her to let her rest. Bring proof of the death to Lilib and you may keep her ring.

Darksong is a ghost that I found on the edge of the snowfield by Dvalin. If you take the road from Dvalin toward the nearby guard tower, you'll find Darksong to the left of the road just before you get to the tower. Darksong is alive from about 7pm to 5am each day, in the location near 10946, 49575. She was blue to me at 11 and I was able to solo her when fully buffed and carrying a good hammer. She dropped a lock of hair.
I gave the lock of hair to Lilib who is in the tower by Dvalin, loc 15325, 52775. I was given a ring and instructions to return to the trainer with the story of her being put to rest.
On speaking to the trainer I was given experience and told to keep the Pious Ring.
Reward:
Pious Ring

midgard|dark essence.Name: Dark Essence
midgard|dark essence.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Dalea Gronholm says, "Silica, it is good to see you again. I have recovered a bit from the last time we spoke. Remember the vessel you got for me? I was able to get it to Meregrota and she has enchanted it properly. It will be perfect for holding the essences that [Elizabeth so wants]."

Dalea Gronholm says, "Elizabeth has grown a little impatient with me, although she knows I've been sick and I'm still recovering. The situation over on the mainland grows worse, and she is desperate to learn some new enchantments to aid in the fight againsta Hibernia and Albion. Her one enchantment needs the essences of different undead spirits. she's asked a few others to help her over around Mularn, but [I am to gather] the essences here."

Dalea Gronholm says, "Since I am not well enough to handle this, it falls upon you. You must take this vessel with you and obtain the essences of three psylings. Elizabeth believes there is something in their essence that will help our brave forces defeat the armies of Albion and Hibernia. Go now and defeat three Pyslings. As you defeat each one its essence will fill the vessel. Do not lose the vessel for then all our hard work will be for naught! If it should become lost, return to me and we will work out a solution."
[Kill psyling x2]
The essence of the pysling flows into the enchanted vessel.
[Kill 3rd psyling]
As the spirit of the pysling enters the vessel, Pyserlian appears out of nowhere and steals the vessel from you!
[Return empty-handed to Dalea]

Dalea Gronholm says, "So, you have lost the vessel, after I warned you not to! Do not fret, Silica, I knew that Pyserlian might cause trouble. While he may not be the strongest pyslings, he is cunning and fearless, and the other pyslings fear him. I am afraid that [without a special charm] to weaken Pyserlian, you will not be able to get the vessel back and trap his essence."
Dalea Gronholm says, "When I went to Meregrota, she and I spoke of th

[ -- Missing quest text -- Dalea tells you to go kill a Morvalt Ungdom and collect a finger bone, then take it to Meregrota Solvor who can place an enchantment on it that will help defeat Pyserlian.]]
Meregrota Solvor says, "Dalea Gronholm said that you may be coming to me for a way to weaken Pyserlian. Give me the morvalt finger bone and I shall enchant it."

Meregrota Solvor says, "There, the bone is enchanted. Do not look surprised that it took so little time. The spell is quick and fairly simple, but it will cancel the spell that Pyserlian has cast around the vessel. You must wear the bone around your neck to cancel Pyserlian's spell. If you do not wear the bone, Pyserlian will not give you back the vessel and Dalea and Elizabeth will both be disappointed. Go now and seek out Pyserlian and obtain the vessel for Dalea! When you have defeated Pyserlian, the charm will disappear for its magic will be used up."
You receive morvalt finger bone charm from Meregrota Solvor!
[Wearing the necklace, find Pyserlian SW of the stone bridge, near the dangerous Tendrils. Yellow to me at level 11]
Pyserlian says, "No! How did you break my spell! I shall seek my revenge upon you one day! Just wait and see if I don't!"
You receive enchanted vessel from Pyserlian!
[Return with the vessel to Dalea]
Dalea Gronholm says, "Silica, I am glad to see you have returned. Time grows short. Do you have the vessel of essences?"

Dalea Gronholm says, "Elizabeth will be most pleased to finally receive this. There is a Berserker going over to Mularn soon and I shall send this with her. I sent word to Elizabeth that a Berserker was helping me and she sent this over in thanks. Please take it, knowing that you have helped to protect Midgard!"
You are awarded 15,928 experience!
You are awarded 11 silver and some copper!
You receive Necklace of Stoutness from Dalea Gronholm!
You have finished the Dark Essence quest.
Rewards:
Necklace of Stoutness -- Berserker
Blood Red Tooth -- Savage
Necklace of the Lyrical -- Skald
Strength of Thunder Amulet -- Thane
Gauntlets of Vitality -- Warrior
Rewards:
Necklace of Stoutness
Necklace of the Lyrical
Blood-red Tooth
Strength of Thunder Amulet
Gauntlets of Vitality

midgard|decoding the map.Name: Decoding the Map
midgard|decoding the map.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to Inaksha (Dwarf) in Haggerfel. She will tell you to go to Fort Atla with the map and talk to Salevia (Kobold) in the bar.
Say [Inaksha] to her and then give her the map. She will tell you to find Niswen, Fressen's brother, and talk to him. Say [Fressen's map] Loc is approximately 25946, 62480.

Niswen is the guy near the wall by the Shrieking Willows and Enchanting Dirges (from Gna Faste head on the road to the werewolf village. Head left and follow the waters edge.) Other mobs in the area include Soul Sinkers and Moras.
Talk to him three times. At the third time he challenges you. Kill him (green at 25) and his friend, Raslen (grey at 25), to get the map.
Return to Fort Atla and Salevia. She will give you the translation and send you back to Inaksha in Haggerfel. Give Inaksha the map and you will get your reward.
Rewards:
Rune Etched Hauberk -- Healer
Moonshone Gloves -- Shaman
Rewards:
Rune Etched Hauberk
Moonshone Gloves

midgard|fallen warrior.Name: Fallen Warrior
midgard|fallen warrior.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-08-23 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This is the 3rd part of the Runemaster Epic. You must be 25th level to
receive this quest and have completed the previous steps.

Anrid of Jordheim tells you the story of the warrior, Ove Alfevson. Ove fell in battle while fighting the werewolf leader and has been turned into a werewolf himself. He lives in Askheim. From the entrance to the werewolf city, his house is in the back, on the right. He is yellow to a 25th level Runemaster (can con blue as well), but he won't bring friends unless he shouts for help. He drops a crest piece, which you must return to Anrid for your reward.
[Step #2] Some say there is one who wears a crest piece and walks within the walls of Fort Askheim, Myrkwood. Do what you must to obtain this piece!
The Ove Alfevson calls for help!
You receive a Grenlock Crest piece!
[Step #3] Return to Anrid in Jordheim. Bring with you the crest piece.
Anrid says, "Have you obtained Ove's piece of the crest?"
Anrid says, "Ah! What a sight to behold! You have done well! In time I will call upon you. We shall not rest until the Grenlock crest is made whole once again!"
you receive Spirit-dweller's Pants from Anrid!
You are awarded 2,288,704 experience!
You have finished the Fallen Warrior quest.
Rewards:
Runed Mystical Gloves -- Runemaster
Spirit-dweller's Pants -- Spiritmaster and Bonedancer
Rewards:
Runed Mystical Gloves
Spirit-Dweller's Pants

midgard|feathers.Name: Feathers
midgard|feathers.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to your trainer who will send you to talk to Trealine, who will send you to kill some Boobrie Hatchlings for the feathers, then return for your reward. Boobrie Hatchlings can be found north of Aegirhamn near the stone bridge.
Rewards:
Clan Embossed Stone
Clan Ring

midgard|forgotten journey.Name: Forgotten Journey
midgard|forgotten journey.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This is the fourth part of the spiritmaster ongoing epic quest.
Return to Anrid in Jordheim once you reach level 30. She will tell you the story of Gunnar Alfevson and how he journeyed into Muspelheim with the last piece of the crest and never returned.

You can find the Shade of Gunnar at the skeleton camp in Muspelheim at 39500, 44400. Kill Gunnar and you will receive the fourth piece of the Grenlock Crest. Return the piece to Anrid to receive your reward and instructions for the next quest in the series.
Anrid says, "Welcome! Are prepared to [complete] the journey you started long ago?"
You have been given the Forgotten Journey quest.
Anrid says, "Very well the, let us proceed."

Anrid says, "The last of Svan's sons went by the name Gunnar, a mighty warrior and wise in the ways of worship. Gunnar outlived his brothers and like his father was a good man. Yet, the tradegy of his father's death struck Gunnar very hard. Even the birth of his own sons could not raise him from the pain. So it was that on a cold morning within the town of Vasudfheim, the ageing Viking took up his axe and headed towards Mularn. He paused only briefly to purchase supplies within Haggerfel. Then, according to the townsfolk, Gunnar set out into the fires of Muspelheim and [did not return]."
[Step #1] Learn of Gunnar from Anrid in Jordheim.

Anrid says, "In tribute of the great warrior, as baby born each generation within Vasudheim bears Gunnar's honored named. Gunnar carried with him, the fourth piece of the Grenlock crest. If you are to find this piece, you must start your journey within Musoelheim! When you have obtained it, return to me."
[Step #2] Follow Gunnar's trail into Muspelheim! Find where his journey took him, and you will find the crest piece.

Shade of Gunnar is located approximately 40k, 45k, and is surround by charred skeletal commanders, seared skeletons, and charred skeletal sentries. The agro range is wide and you will get at least three at one time. If you wait for Hroderk and the noxious hounds to come around on their patrol, they will kill some of the skeletons. All in all there are about a total of 12 skeletons in the whole area.
The Shade of Gunnar says, "You honor Gunnar's passing! Tread well the treasures that lay within!"
You receive a Grenlock Crest piece from the Shade of Gunnar!
You get 1,000,291 experience points.
[Step #3] Return to Anrid within Jordheim. Carry with you Gunnar's crest piece.
Anrid says, "Were you successful?"
Anrid's hands begins to shake.

Anrid says, "I cannot believe I hold all but the last piece of the crest! You have done wonders my friend! We have only to merge the five piece into one and [fulfill the wish] of a fallen king, now kept for hundreds of years."
You have finished the Forgotten Journey quest.
You are awarded 7,8XX,XXX experience!
Now go and finish the Grenlock Clan quest.

midgard|gashir.Name: Gashir
midgard|gashir.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: The level 25 section of this quest is: Decoding the Map
At level 30+, you're told to return to Inaksha.

Inaksha says, "I am pleased that you have returned to me. I have need of your services again. I have had more visions while studying this map. I believe [the visions] will help us learn about the elves Fressen spoke of, and this mysterious Gahsir."

Inaksha says, "In the first vision, I saw a young Norseman and woman, in a far away land. I know not what this means, although I do not think they live anymore. Another vision followed that one - a vision of a second young Norsewoman, surrounded by red, crowned in gold. I see her in a town, in the shadow of a city, and the sound of water fills my ears. Seek out this Norsewoman, and ask her of Gashir and the elves. Return to me when you have talked with her."
[Step #1] Seek out the Norsewoman surrounded by red and crowned in gold. She is in a town in the shadow of a city, within the sound of water.

The city is obviously Vasudheim, and the woman's name is Jana (she's wearing red and has blonde hair); she's in one of the buildings in Vasudheim. Jana will tell her tale about Gashir being a demon, the elves might try to summon him, he'll destroy the world, yadda yadda yadda.
[Step #2] Talk with Jana and learn about [Gashir].
Jana says, "Greetings. Please do not look surprised that I knew your name. I had a vision of you coming to me. Inaksha isn't the only one who has visions. You seek [knowledge], do you not?"
Jana says, "My visions did not reveal what you want to know, only that you would come seeking me. Tell me what you wish to learn about."
You say, "Gahsir."

Jana says, "Gashir? I have not heard that name since I was a child, and those that dared to speak it did so only in a whisper. If you seek knowledge of Gashir, you must also desire knowledge of the elves. You did well to come to me, for I know of both. Come closer and hear a story of my [childhood]."

Jana says, "My grandparents died when I was very young, but before they died, they told me of their raiding days. They were in a raiding party that ventured into Hibernia. One night after they had made a camp for the night, they told stories of the magic of the gods. My grandmother told the tale of the Rod of Mimir. A group of elves, which had gained the ability to understand our language, overheard the story as they prepared to [ambush the camp]."

Jana says, "During the ambush, they killed everyone except my grandparents. They took my grandmother captive as my grandfather escapted into the woods. The elves forced my grandmother to tell them all she knew of the Rod of Mimir. It was many days later that she managed to escape, and she and my grandfather fled back to the safety of Midgard. The [elves pursued] because they did not want anyone to know they sought the Rod."

Jana says, "Once here, they began their search, and captured passing travlers until they learned fro the proper ritual to summon Mimir. With the Rod, they can summon Mimir and force him to do their bidding. Unfortunately, their tongues are not well adapted to our language, and Mimir comes out as Gashir. After reading many ancient texts, I have discovered that there is another creature named Gashir, an evil demon who delights in destruction and chaos. If Gashir is released in this world, we will be doomed! That is all I can tell you of Gashir and the elves. I beg you, if you have the ability to stop the elves, please do so."
[Step #3] Return to Inaksha and speak to her about how the elves [must be stopped].
Return to Inaksha and tell her of these horrible events. Say the elves must
be stopped, and then when she prompts you, say Gashir is a demon. Your journal will tell you what you need to say, [enclosed in square-brackets] like this.
Inaksha says, "You have returned. Did you find the woman I saw in my visions? What did she tell you of the elves?"
You say, "The elves must be stopped."
[Step #4] Speak to Inaksha about the Rod of Mimir. Tell her Gashir is [a demon].
Inaksha says, "I figured she would say that. Any who have the Rod of Mimir must be stopped, and the dark one seemed to think that of the elves. And did she speak of Gashir? Who or what is he?"
You say, "Gashir is a demon."

Inaksha says, "A demon! We must stop them from summoning up Gashir and retrieve the Rod of Mimir from these evil creatures. These elves must be creatures of magic, for mortals such as you and I cannot hope to weild the Rod ourselves. If that foolish dark one had tried as he wished, he would have frozen to death, for the rod is filled with the snow and cold of the North. I shall help you to protect yourself from the Rod. I shall [weave a bag] to carry the rod in, so it will not harm you."

Inaksha says, "Travel into the fires of Muspelheim and bring me the fur of a firecat and a noxious hound. The warmth of their fur will protect you from the cold of the Rod. Return to me when you have both and I shall weave them into a bag for you."

Head to Muspelheim, get fur of a firecat and noxious hound. Beware - two types of hound - Noxious and Nocious (note that the hounds are social, and blue at level 30). You will get an item that says Noxious Fur - a pelt will not suffice. If in doubt, check your journal - as you get each type of fur, it will update itself and remove it from the list of things you need to do. Once you have both types of fur, return to Ishaka and hand the fur over.
She will make a nice bag from the fur to hold the staff of Mirmir (the bag protects you). She will then tell you to find Gashir.

She says that he is between Nalliten and Myrkwood. This is not that accurate. To find Gashir, head out from Gna Faste to the west, towards Askheim. Go past Askheim till you find the circle of stones (Stone Henge), in Skona Ravine. Turn north (past the shrieking willows) till you hit a cliff. Turn west and follow the cliff.

It's a fairly long run, but eventually you will come to a steep decline to the water. Head down, but watch out, you'll take damage if you aren't careful. Look for one of the small ravines down - you can get down without impact damage.

At the bottom of the hill, you'll see the elves in a circle, and the elves will start casting (surprise surprise), and Gashir will arrive. The elves that summons Gashir is on /loc 11793, 5572. And Gashir con blue at lvl 36, yellow at 30.

Now this part is important - let Gashir kill the elves. He'll attack them almost immediately, and wipe them out in seconds. He'll then turn on you, get ready to slow him, and then stun him so that you can get a few swings in. Also, be prepared to use an instant heal - he hits for about 45, which is more than I can hit for.

You may want to wait till level 31 or 32 to take him on, or bring a friend. He killed me at level 30, with mithril armor, using my Favor from Eir and all. Don't forget to bind in Galplen should the unthinkable happen.
Rewards:
Runed Etched Gloves -- Healer
Moonshone Helm -- Shaman
Rewards:
Glowing Rune Etched Gloves
Moonshone Helm

midgard|grenlock clan.Name: Grenlock Clan
midgard|grenlock clan.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This is a nested quest. There are four subquests involved in the completion of this epic.

The Runemaster trainer Signa,or Spiritmaster Dyre, in Jordheim, will give you a quest. They will send you to Anrid, who is located in a tavern near the north gate. Anrid will tell you the story of the Grenlock Crest and give you a quest to find Siv's Spirit in East Svealand.

Dyre says, "Hail Spiritmaster! Many great adventures await you, but you must first become aware of our past. [Anrid], a powerful Spiritmaster has decided to lead you along this path. Perhaps with her teaching and your adventurous spirit, the Grenlock clan can once again be united!"
You have been given the Grenlock Clan quest.
Dyre says, "I am glad to see you follow the path of the House of Hel! Anrid can be found at a tavern near the north gate of this city. Good hourney to you Spiritmaster!"
[Step #1] Speak to Anrid in Jordheim, inside a tavern next to the north gate. She will wishes to bind the spirits of the northland once more.
Anrid says, "Sit down my friend and let me tell you [a tale], a tale that you must understand to someday break the spirit bond in the northland."

Anrid says, "Many hundreds of years ago there was a great clan of Norsemen in the northland of Midgard. They were known as the Grenlock clan, and of them was a great chieftain who strove for peace and kinship among the people. the great man, chieftain Svan Alfevsin lived and worked among his people and was greatly respected. It seems that [history] is never kind to the good hearted, like Svan Alfevson.

Anrid says, "A great tragedy befell the northlands and their king. An unnatural winter befell the land of the north, known as Urfenlong, freezing the land and water tributaries solid. Being that the Grenlock clan had always lived in a harsh climate they prepared each year with grains and livestock for a harsh winter. However, nothing could have prepared them for the [Urfenlong]."

Anrid says, "In the third year of the Urfenlong, the land and the seasons were locked in a frozen icy grip. Svan Alfevson called upon his four sons and told them to begin gathering the northland armies and supplies still left. The old king wished for his sons to move the armies and peoples of the Grenlock southward to safety, away from the impending doom of the ice. Great ice sheets moved like living things in the far north, devouring everything in their path and the farthest points of civilization had already succumbed to [the ice]."

Anrid says, "As the ice moved closer and closer to Svergren Keep, the old king met with his sons one last time. Svan removed his own armor and divided it among his sons keeping only his helmet. Next the king took the Grenlock Crest, the family seal from upon the Keep's wall and with the blade of his battleaxe broke the seal into five pieces. Once again Svan divided the pieces of the crest, just as he did his own armor, and gave a piece to each of his four sons and [kept a piece] for himself."

Anrid says, "Svan's intention was that one-day, after the terrible unyielding winter that he and his sons would once again reunite and bring the Grenlock clan back together. Several says after Svan's sons left the northland, Svergird's Keep and its ancient stone walls were swept away by the white tide of ice and snow. The terrible storm took the old king with it, and all which remained of the northland. Svan's four sons, Coplin, Gunnar, Ove, and Div marched southward, tearing through [unknown territory]."

Anrid says, "They passed through Odin's Gate and into the untamed lands continuing to push southward, where they hoped the storm could not reach. The brothers hoped that the mountains of Odin's Gate would hold back the sheets of traveling ice, yet they knew it was not safe to stay that far north. The people of the northland continued to push forward for two years, never settling, always living in fear of what could come over the mountains and sweep them away. A year later due to starvation and exhaustion, the brothers stopped the clan and settled near the sea, [nestled safely] in the mountains near what is now Vasudheim."

Anrid says, "They hoped that the mountains would stop any invading force, including the elements. It just so happens that the brothers settled in the area that is known today as Jordheim. After several more years the clan had settled in their new home. The brothers once again gathered armies from the north. The intention was for the four of them to split up in the four directions, north, east, south, and west, and explore the new territory they would call home. [Siv was the first] of the brothers to push out of their new home and travel westward."

Anrid says, "Siv, the youngest of the brothers, put together a small following of an army and led them westward to that shore. Siv and his men settled in the area that is now known as East Svealand. It was here that his followers settled a small township and continued to explore the area in which they perceived to call home. Siv continued to live in East Svealand to the [end of his days] in peace."
Anrid says, "It is rumored that his [spirit still walks] the lands which he inhabited."
Anrid says, "You would be wise to seek Siv out and prove this rumor true!"
You have been given the Siv's Spirit quest.
Do the Siv's Spirit quest then return here for conclusion.
[Step #3] Return to Anrid when you have reached 20th level.
Anrid says, "Hail! Are you [ready to continue] along the path to unification?"

Anrid says, "As you know Siv had three more brothers. The second brother Coplin decided since Siv was making new settlements outside of their new home that he would patrol the land. Coplin's goal was to protect all those who survived the journey from the northland. Coplin made friends with many of the creatures that lived in the surrounding areas. It was his goal to make pacts with these creatures so that the land would stay [safe] for all those that lived there, both human and creature."

Anrid says, "Coplin was very successful in this attempt and many aggressions were worked through. Therefore many lived in peace during his lifetime. He lived a very long time, just as his brother Siv. His spirit resides on this plane in the forests of Myrkwood among his companions, the creatures of those forests. He may have information that will help you upon this journey. He can be found among the creatures of [Myrkwood]."
You have been given the Coplin's Spirit quest.
Anrid says, "Seek out Coplin's Spirit! Return to me when you have finished."
(Says [Step #3] (again, in your journal)
[Step #4] Perform the service required of you! Return the second piece of the Grenlock Crest!
[Step #4] Anrid of Jordheim will call upon you soon. Be ready!
[Step #4] (again) Locate Ove's missing crest piece within Myrkwood!
You will receive Fallen Warrior at level 25 for the third crest piece.
You have been given the Fallen Warrior quest.
Lastly you will receive the Forgotten Journey quest at level 30 for the fourth and final piece.
You have been given the Forgotten Journey quest.
[Step #5] Find the fourth piece of the Grenlock crest!
**Conclusion**
[Step #6] Learn from Anrid in Jordheim, how to make the crest whole.

Once you have turned in all four pieces of the Grenlock Crest to Anrid, she will return them to you and tell you to go visit the Dverge forge in Muspelheim. It is likely that you will have to kill seared skeletons or fire giants in order to raise your faction rating with the Dverge enough to approach their town without being slaughtered (If you are using a pet, you will not get a faction adjustment if your pet lands the final blow on an enemy). Give the four pieces of the crest to Sinyr, the Dverge smith. You will get XP for each piece handed over. Once you give him all four pieces youll witness an interesting ceremony and will inherit the finished Crest. Return it to Anrid for lofty praises, some XP, and your epic item.

Anrid says, "I cannot believe I hold all but the last piece of the crest! You have done wonders my friend! We have only to merge the five piece into one and [fulfill the wish] of a fallen king, now kept for hundreds of years."

Anrid says, "The crest pieces can only be merged in the fires of a [forge within Muspelheim]. It is our hopes that should be this accomplished, Svan Alfevson will hear our calling and deliver unto us the final piece."

Anrid says, "Take these four pieces and seek out the dverge fire-eaters within Muspelheim. They may distrust you at first, but I am told they hate the fire giants that also walk within the fire realm. If you are able to make into the forge of five anvils, deliver all four piece to one named Sinyr. He will do his best to fashion the Grenlock [crest pieces] into one."

Anrid says, "If the last of the five piece are delivered unto you, Sinyr will make the crest while once more. I look forward to your return! You champion our cause, and we are honored you have taken on this task. Fare thee well!"
You receive a Grenlock Crest piece from Anrid!
You receive a Grenlock Crest piece from Anrid!
You receive a Grenlock Crest piece from Anrid!
You receive a Grenlock Crest piece from Anrid!

[Step #7] Take all four Grenlock crest piece to the forge within Muspelheim. Pass them to one named Sinyr. The dwarves are wary of strangers. You may be forced to destroy charred skeletons or slay in order to gain their favor!
Sinyr says, "What have you Kobold? I have little time for games."
You give Sinyr a piece of the Grenlock Crest.
You are awarded 2,621,440 experience!
Sinyr says, "Oh! A piece of the Grenlock crest! Have you more?"
[Step #8] Hand to Sinyr the second piece of the Grenlock crest!
You give Sinyr a piece of the Grenlock Crest.
You are awarded 2,621,440 experience!
Sinyr says, "You are indeed a great Spiritmaster! You don't have another do you?"
[Step #8] Hand to Sinyr the third piece of the Grenlock crest!
You give Sinyr a piece of the Grenlock Crest.
You are awarded 2,621,440 experience!
Sinyr says, "My word! This is beyond belief!! You are lucky to have come by so many pieces. I may fall dead if you have a fourth!"
[Step #8] Hand to Sinyr the fourth piece of the Grenlock crest!
You give Sinyr a piece of the Grenlock Crest.
You are awarded 2,621,440 experience!
Sinyr says, "I now see what must be done! Stand aside! I must forge anew this ancient crest!"
Sinyr casts a spell and Svan Alfevson appears in giant ghostly form above the forge.

The Svan Alfevson says, "You have done well in returning that which is mine! For your tireless effort in fulfilling my ancient request, I bestow upon your smith the final piece of the Grenlock Crest! Use it wisely or you shall feel my wrath!"
[Step #8] Sinyr has forged the Grenlock crest anew! Ask and he shall deliver it unto you.
Sinyr says, "There! I still cannot believe that the crest is whole once more. This day shall forever be spoken by the Dverge!"
You receive the Grenlock Crest from Sinyr!
[Step #9] The Grenlock crest is complete once more! Return to Anrid in Jordheim and present the crest to her!
Anrid says, "We have heard of your deeds! Let us see the finished crest!"
You give Anrid the finished Grenlock Crest.

Anrid says, "The Grenlock clan us whole once more! you have performed a deed unlike any other within Midgard. Whenever anyone speaks of the Grenlock, may they utter your honored named as well! We bestow upon you this simple item, as nothing we could provide would be a just reward! Thank you!"
You receive a Spirit-dweller's Vest from Anrid!
You are awarded 15,728,640 epxerience!
You have finished the Grenlock Clan quest.
Rewards:
Runed Mystical Vest
Spirit-dweller's Vest
Boned Mystical Vest

midgard|helping dalea.Name: Helping Dalea
midgard|helping dalea.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Your trainer in Aegirhamn will ask you to help Dalea. Dalea Gronholm is located between the Thane and Savage trainers and needs you to kill a couple monsters for her. These monsters can be found by crossing the bridge from Aegirhamn.
Dialog for this quest (berserker version) submitted by: Airmodana of Nimue

Mielikka says, " Well met, ________. You look stronger than the last time I saw you! That is good! With Modi's courage flowing through you, you will continue to grow strong. But I wonder, will you use that courage to help [someone else]?"

Mielikka says, " I have received word from one of the merchants around here that she is looking for a courageous berserker to help her with something. Her name is Dalea and she is collecting things. She didn't say exactly what would be collected only that it might be difficult but the reward would be worth the work. S, [what do you say? Cound you help Dalea out?

Mielikka says, " Modi's courage does flow through you! Go now to Dalea Gronholm and she will give you more information about the task before you. All of the House of Modi will honor your name one day, _______!"

Dalea Gronholm says "Thank you for answering my summons, Berserker. I have been ill lately and am too weak to venture far. I have been working with my cousin Elizabeth in Mular. She is an enchantress and has been working on new enchantments for weapons ans armor. When she found out I was coming here, she asked me to gather potential enchantment components and send them to her. I agreed, but then I took ill. Since then I have been [unable to gather] anything."

Dalea Gronholm says "Apparently there have been some problems over on the mainland, for Elizabeth recently sent me a very urgent message begging for the new components. Since I cannot get them, I am asking you to get them for me. Elizabeth needs the essences of some of the creatures that roam the lands. But before you can gather those essences, I must make the vessel to hold them. You must [get me the parts] I need to make the vessel."

Dalea Gronholm says "There are two parts to the vessel. The first is a gilded fang from a scimitar kit. When it is cleaned out and enchanted properly, it will hold the essences Elizabeth needs. To enchant the fang I need some shimmery feathers from a boobrie hatchling. Once you have both things come back to me. May the House of Modi watch over you as you undertake this journey, Berserker."
Dalea Gronholm says "I am relieved to see you return, Berserker. Do you have the gilded fang for me? Please give it to me."
Dalea Gronholm says "Now give me the feathers please. The fang will do no good without the feathers."

Dalea Gronholm says "Wonderful. I am strong enough to take these to Meregrota Solvor and have her enchant them. It may take a while. I shall send word to your trainer when I need you again, Berserker. Until then, take this with my thanks."
You are awarded 1,408 experience!
You are awarded 7 silver and some copper!
You have finshed the Helping Dalea quest!
You receive the Emerald Flecked Jerkin from Dalea Gronholm!
Reward:
Emerald Flecked Jerkin

midgard|hill cat hunt.Name: Hill Cat Hunt
midgard|hill cat hunt.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: You must complete the Traveler's Way quest before getting this one. This is the level 11 epic for Warriors.

Thordia asks you to bring him back some hill cat teeth. Head out and hunt the cats until you get five of them and bring them back to Thordia. He will then send you to Hrrgyf in the Vale of Mularn to fashion them into some gauntlets.
The following is only a part of the dialog.
Thordia says, "I have given you a task! Prove yourself worthy or bother me
no more."
Thordia says, "I assume you have more?"
Thordia says, "This would prove sufficient, if you were a child!"
Thordia says, "Much better, yet I am still not pleased."
Thordia says, "Much better, yet I am still not pleased."
Thordia says, "I am well pleased. I do require more of you, if you feel
[worthy of the task]."
You are awarded XXXX experience!
Thordia says, "Seek Viking Karl at the tower in the hills. He will explain
what needs to be done."
[Step #3] Seek out Viking Karl at the guard tower in the mountains and aid
him in his plight.
Viking Karl is located at 17500, 49700 in front of the guard tower.
Viking Karl says, "Ah, are you the one Thordia has sent me? Are you [on the
hunt]?"
Viking Karl says, "?There is one vile beast that has feasted on many of my
men. Thordia has promised me a great warrior. Kill Hrrgyf, the hill cat that
roams the mountains here. Bring me her tooth, as proof of your deed."
[Step #4] Prove value as warrior by bringing Hrrgyf?s tooth back to Viking
Karl
Hrrgyf can be found at loc 12,26, it's on the hill next to Darkness Falls entrance on the way from Karl to Svasud Faste.
Viking Karl says, "My thanks. Take this small reward my men have collected
in hopes you would succeed. Thordia will be pleased. I am sure she will
reward you when she sees you again."
You are awarded 3 silver and some copper.
[Step #5] See Thordia, and tell of great deed!
Thordia says, "I have heard of your great deed! You have killed Hrrgyf! For
that, I shall honor you! Take this gift, granted only to the greatest
warriors! I shall speak your name to Tyr!"
You are awarded XXXX experience!
You receive Blessed Warrior Gauntlets from Thordia!
You have finished the Hill Cat Hunt quest.
Reward:
Blessed Warrior Gauntlets

midgard|hunt for dorga.Name: Hunt for Dorga
midgard|hunt for dorga.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: *Hunter Only*
This quest is given out by the Hunter Trainer at level 11. Hauk's exact location is: 27680, 26808, He asks you to talk to Trapper Jora and help her out with her problem.

Trapper Jora is in Audliten. She tells you about an envy drake named Dorga and asks you to seek him out and bring back his eye. Dorga is found up the river, surrounded by some envy drakelings. I found my Dorga at 32k, 43k pacing North with a drake glued to her tail. I did not do this quest until lvl 20--she conned grey, and took 3 hits. As someone mentioned above, she was located NorthWest of the crab bridge near Ft. Atla (by Nisse's Lair).
Be careful when you attack it, since the drakelings will help it out. Kill it and bring its eye back to Jora. She sends you back to Hauk and he rewards you with the Bowman's Gloves.
Reward:
Bowman's Gloves

midgard|jewel hunt.Name: Jewel Hunt
midgard|jewel hunt.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: You may be sent to Boidoc from your trainer elsewhere. Boidoc who is in second building on the right after you enter the gate. He tells you to seek out Lalida the Skald trainer, who is in the building directly across. You are given a necklace that has no bonuses, but you need to keep it and Lalida sends you to Vasudheim to see Kyba, a troll standing outside a building that is the third building on the left from the bridge (building #5 on DAAtlas). When you tell Kyba that [Lalida is well], she sends you to talk to an old skald that wanders between the vale of Mularn and Muspelheim. Go past Haggerfell, and start through the pass into Muspelheim, you will see a troll named Gokstad, approach and speak to Gokstad, he asks if you have anything for him. Give him the necklace. Gokstad then instructs you to seek out Denise in Mularn who is in first building as you enter Mularn, stable master outside. When you speak to Denise she will give you a Fine Norse Cloak.
Reward:
Fine Norse Cloak

midgard|masrim's spell.Name: Masrim's Spell
midgard|masrim's spell.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: You get the quest from your trainer Rusalka in Aegirhamn. She sends you to the smith, Thara Stonehammer, which in turn sends you out for some kills.
First off, you're to kill a morvalt ungdom, and as the Journal will tell you, they can be found N-NE from the large stone bridge near AH.
When you've killed one of these, you are to kill a mammoth calf, which can be found W or NW of the same stone bridge. After killing one, you're told to kill another, so do that.
Then head back to Thara Stonehammer, talk to her and turn in the items.

She'll then tell you to go kill a biting insect, and she is even as thoughtful as to tell you where they are. Head W across the wooden bridge, all the way to the coast, and they'll be there on the shore. Kill one, and head back to Thara, talk to her and turn in the legs and collect your reward.
At level 20 I got 57,960 experience, "11 silver and some copper" plus Evening's Call Cloak (see below).
Rewards:
Evening's Call Cloak
Huntmanship Gloves

midgard|mimir's protection.Name: Mimir's Protection
midgard|mimir's protection.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: The Healer trainer, Per in Jordheim, tells you to go to Inaskha in Haggerfell
to start the quest.
Step # 1 Inaksha tells you to speak with Miri in Jordheim (she stands
next to Per)

Step # 2 Miri tells you to get the eye of a nordic yeti. I found one in Yggdra Forest, Loc 54k, 50k, 7k )(New Frontiers33200 23200 )approximatly (cons blue to lvl 40) Another kill task may be to kill a Giant Snowcrab. I found many of
them on the mountain, immediately to the right of Svasud Faste. They conned
green/blue to me at lvl 43.
My task was to kill an alpine cockatrice. Found one at 63k 35k in upland.
Step # 3-5 Return to Miri, give her the eye and talk to her.

Step # 6 Seek out Leildolf in Skona, Loc 7k, 13, 1.6k we walks N-S at the beach. Talk to him and kill him, you receive Odins eye. cons blue to lvl 41 (Another option you may be given is to kill Snofrid in Yggdra Forest, seen around New Frontiers loc=20,39 along the river just East of Arvakr Tower 3)
Change or substitute step: step 6 you need to find Rognvald, he walks the shore beside Fort Atla, no need to talk to him, just kill and he drops the eye of Miri. cons blue to lvl 41.
Yet another change or substitute step: Had to kill Snofrid in Yggdra Forest. Found her at roaming from 32k,50k to... 19k,56k.
Step # 7,8 Return the eye to Miri and talk to her.
Step # 9 You get an eye back from Miri that you have to wear all the time during the following steps !!!
Go to Spindelhalla and kill an arachite tunnelhost (cons blue and yellow to lvl 41) Or step 9, go to varulvhamn and kill a Wolfavr Quixot, blue to lvl 46.
Step # 10 Kill a sidhe gaoite in Skona Ravine, 5549,31865,1764 dir=214(cons blue to lvl 41)
Step # 11 Kill a small black orm in Vanern Swamp, Loc 51k, 28k, 1.6k (blue to lvl 41)
Step # 12-16 Return to Miri and give her the eye and the three words.
Step # 17 Return to Inaskha and you will receive your reward
Rewards to chose for a healer : Staff, Hammer or Shield
Rewards:
Mimir's Hammer of Wisdom
Mimir's Staff of Wisdom
Gridelin Guard
Mimir's Large Hammer of Wisdom

midgard|new crest.Name: New Crest
midgard|new crest.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: by Arnah Vigrid, Bonedancer, Nimue
Talk to Teija the Bonedancer trainer in Aegirhamn. Teija says, "Ah, Bonedancer. You've aided Karle before, haven't you? Well, guess what! He's got a new idea. He wants to create a new clan crest!"
You have been given the New Crest quest.
Teija says, "I figured you would. His rewards aren't that bad, eh? Well, go talk to Karle. Tell him your curious about his new clan crest."
(Karle Alfevson is in the Vaultkeeper area of Aegir's Landing.)

Karle Alfevson says, "Ah, Arnah. So as it turns out, making a new Clan [Crest] won't solve the problems of my clan. However, I would still like to make one. I want a crest to represent our achievements here, in this new land!"
Karle Alfevson says, "Aye. I think that using the talisman and the primitive icons of this land would be appropriate. So, what do you [think]?"
Karle Alfevson says, "Morvalt ungdom often carry primitive tokens of luck. Find two morvalt ungdom and bring me their tokens!"

(Morvalt ungdom are north of Aeigerhamn. Head out the southwest exit across the bridge, then follow the shore north up to the large stone bridge. Cross it and head easterly where they roam, off the left side of the road. They look like undead Valkyn. After you kill two and receive two tokens, return to Karle Alfevson in the vault area of Aegirhamn.(loc=51k 27k))
Karle Alfevson says, "Great. Now, I also heard that morvalt fast-walkers carry magical stones that give them speed. I would like to place the stones somewhere in the cest. Could you get me two?"

( The Morvalt fast-walkers are in and around a camp almost directly east of the large stone bridge you went over before, and east of the morvaltar ungdoms you killed before. The location is approximately 51k,37k. After you kill two of the fast-walkers, return to Karle Alfevson in Aigerhamn)

Karle Alfevson says, "Oh. Well, this is great. I appreciate your helping Grenlock Clan. I don't know how the search for the crest pieces is going back in the old lands, but I'm sure this new clan crest will gain power of its own!"
You are awarded 11 silver and some copper!
You are awarded 57,960 experience!
You have finished the New Crest quest.
You receive a Runed Bone Collar from Karle Alfevson.
(lvl 11 received 15,928 exp)
Rewards:
Runed Bone Collar -- Bonedancer
Staff of the Spiritualist -- Spiritmaster
Runed Clan Staff -- Runemaster
Rewards:
Staff of the Spiritualist
Runed Bone Collar
Runed Clan Staff

midgard|prove kobold helen's innocence.Name: Prove Kobold Helen's Innocence
midgard|prove kobold helen's innocence.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This quest was given to my Spiritmaster at lvl 11 by the trainer in Jordheim.
You are sent to speak to Sarry in Ft. Atla. Sarry tells you that his niece has been accused of attacking travelers and to please prove her innocence.
Sarry says, "Hail! I have a small problem. A niece of mine, a pleasant child, is accused of [attacking travelers] on the road at night!"

Sarry says, "Aye! I haven't had time to talk to her; the guards took her away. Perhaps you could [speak with Sentry Litenberg], at the tower to Myrkwood, and see what needs to be done to free her. I'm not sure she's there yet; the escorts came for her."
You have been given the Prove Kobold Helen's Innocence quest.
Sarry says, "They won't let you speak to her for long, though, so speak with Sentry Litenberg."
[Step #1] Sentry Litenberg at guard tower knows more about what happened to Kobold Helen.
Speak with Sentry Litenberg, who is outside the tower to Myrkwood (He is located at 8928, 1737).
Sentry Litenberg says, "Sarry send you? Kobold Helen to die in morning. You [wish her to live]?"

Sentry Litenberg says, "Fine. You prove she not kill travelers at night, she go free. Have 'til morning, or she die here in tower. Speak with her, if you haven't already. If she not here, she on road to here."
[Step #2] Talk to Kobold Helen, either on road or at guard tower.
Kobold Helen will either be in the tower, on the road between Fort Atla and the Myrkwood tower, or in Fort Atla.

The Kobold Helen says, "Did my Uncle Sarry send you? Can you prove it wasn't me? They say she is a twin to me! Aye, she wanders between the two roads to the south, a little ways off at night. Find her, and bring something of her to my guards to free me."
The Kobold Helen says, "Please hurry! You haven't much time!"
[Step #3] Find Kobold Helen's twin south of the guard tower and prove her innocence somehow.
The Kobold Dirge roams the road from near the tower to just near the willows towards Gna Faste. From the tower south, from the road she will always be on the right side.
She cons neutral so you will have to attack her.
You receive a tattered flesh.
The Kobold Dirge drops a bag of coins.
You pick up 2 silver, and 28 copper pieces.
[Step #4] Return this odd bit of tattered flesh to Escort Sentry. Quickly.
You give Escort Sentry (there are two, doesn't matter which one) the tattered flesh.
You are awarded experience
You receive a Spirit Staff from the Escort Sentry!

The Escort Sentry says, "Ah. You do well. You prove Kobold Helen innocent. This cloth belong to old witch! I recognize it. You kill dirge that attack travelers. You take this. Now, go speak with Kobold Helen. She want to thank you. Then we escort her home."
[Step #5] Let Kobold Helen express her thanks.
The Kobold Helen says, "My thanks! Now I am free!"
You have finished the Prove Kobold Helen's Innocence quest.
Reward:
Spirit Staff (Spiritmaster)

midgard|runes of darkness.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: When you make level 11, go to the Runemaster trainer Signa, in Jordheim. She will offer you the quest titled Runes of Darkness. Once you accept, she tells you to obtain a branch from the 'Lone Weeping Willow.' She will send you to talk to Sentry Stonefist, who is on duty at the guard tower in Myrkwood. This guard tower is the first guard tower on the left hand side of the road once you enter Myrkwood Forest. Sentry Stonefist will tell you where to find this particular willow and what to do with it once you have it. He tells you that the willow can be found near the shore of Askheim, but that's not quite true. The willow actually spawns south of Gna Faste, on your left, between the lake and the road. it to Moona in Nalliten. Nalliten is SE of Fort Atla. She will craft a Weeping Runic Staff for you.

Weeping Runic Staff
Weeping Boned Staff

midgard|saving the clan.Name: Saving the Clan
midgard|saving the clan.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-11-03 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Anrid says, "What? You haven't heard? There is trouble in the Grenlock Clan. Shortly after you brought the sword back to me, a dark cloud settled around both the crest and the sword. I thought it was part of the protection spell but then Arnfinn started sending me messages that things were happening to people of the Clan. Harmless creatures attacking people, strange illnesses overtaking others. All signs point to [a problem] with the crest and the sword, but alas, I do not know what it may be.

Anrid says, "I know you have helped before, both with obtaining the crest and the sword. Now the very people of the Grenlock Clan call upon you to help solve the mystery of what is befalling them. Someone or something is trying to remove them from this world, and I can only beg that you will help them in these troubled times. Can I send word that you [are here for them]?"
Dialog box:
You have been given the Save the Clan quest.

Anrid says, "Thank you. I knew the Grenlock Clan could trust in your abilities and your dedication. Now, as I've said, I do not know exactly what has befallen the crest and sword, but I know of one who might. She is ancient, and has learned all the legends and tales of the Grenlock Clan for as far back as they go. You must go and [see her].
Anrid says, "Her name is Danica, and she lives in Mularn. Go to her now, and tell her that Anrid sent you. I wish you luck in your endeavor."
Danica is in the second hut on the left in Mularn, the building just to the west of Bolli. Loc approximately 51k, 51k. This building was previously empty, she was just added recently.

Danica says, "Well hello there, child. Oh, do not look at me so for calling you that. When you have lived as long as I have, everyone is a child. Now usually children don't come to me unless they were sent to me. Who sent you here to me?"
You say, "Anrid sent me."

Danica says, "So Anrid sent you? I am not surprised. She came to me recently to tell her the legends of the Grenlock Clan. Now, I know many stories and legends, and perhaps one day I will be able to share them with you and others, but for now we must focus on the task that Anrid has sent you on. She told me that trouble has befallen the Grenlock Clan, and she was going to send one who would [solve the mystery].

Danica says, "Since Anrid came to me, I have been going through all the stories I know related to the Clan but I've reference to visitors from a far off land that resulted in the death of a girl of the clan named Freyana. Freyana was the most beloved daughter of the clan at the time these visitors came to Midgard. It was said she was so beautiful when she was born that she was named after the goddess of beauty, Freya. But [something happened] to her while she was still young."

Danica says, "Unfortunately I do not know what caused it, but somehow Freyana died saving her childhood friend; a troll named Ljagnid. Healers of the Clan worked desperately to save Freyana's life, but their magics failed and her spirit was held here instead of travelling on to Valhalla. Legends say that Freyana's spirit grew bitter and ugly with her resentment towards the clan but especially to Ljagnid. She haunted him, sending horrible things [to torment him] day and night."

Danica says, "The torment became too much for him and he died from a mixture of fear and grief. Freyana watched this with joy, for she felt she was avenged. But her joy quickly turned to anger when she saw that Ljagnid was being taken to Valhalla, a place she had long been denied. She shrieked a curse at Ljagnid, and bound him to her, keeping him trapped here in the same tortured existance she suffers. It is rumored that Freyana and [Ljagnid] now roam around Vanern Swamp together, for that is where both their bodies where laid to rest, with the great kings and queens of Midgard."

Danica says, "In the stories I have found, it was speculated that Ljagnid wrote down his story and what brought about Freyana's death. If we only had that book! Some say it was lost forever while others say Ljagnid took the book with him when he died. Only you can [discover the truth] now, child."

Danica says, "You must travel to the sweltering depths of Vanern Swamp and seek out Freyana and Ljagnid at night and see if Ljagnid has this book. Freyana is evil, and cannot stand having Ljagnid around but she cannot let him go, they say. So she forces him into hiding most of the time, but when something tries to harm her, and try things do, for she is a most evil creature now, Ljagnid springs from hiding to help her. I fear you will not be able to face Freyana and Ljagnid alone, for they have both grown very strong. Gather your forces and take them with you for protection. Remember, Freyana only roams at night. If you are able to obtain the book, bring it back to me here."
Freyana spawns only at night in the SW corner of Vanern Swamp, 31K 51K. Kill her and get the book, then return to Mularn and give Danica the book she is wanting.

Danica Says, "Ah, this is wonderful! Ljagnid did writedown the story of what happened to Freyana. Apparently he felt horrible about it, and thought that writing it down would help ease his guilt. Here [listen to this story], for I believe it will shed some light on the problems with the Grenlock Clan."

Danica says "Visitors have come to the encampment today. They are from anotherland, I think, for they look different then the Grenlock Clan. Freyana was all excited about the visitors coming, but then she dreams of going to far off places. Me, I'm happier here with the Clan. Freyana was worried about me, because she thinks the visitors have never seen a troll before and would be scared of me. I went off into the woods for a while and talked with the other trolls in the area. Freyana came to me after sunset and told me about the visitors. They don't know our language, but drew pictures in the dirt to make themselves understood. Freyana says they are nice, but she wants me to stay away a while longer. He [continues] the story a week later."

Danica says, "The visitors have begun to learn the language of the clan, and we theirs. Freyana continues to hide me and the other trolls from Kelic, the leader of the magic users. She is too protective of me. I told her I wish to learn their language too, and she promised me she would teach me. I think tomorrow I will sneak close to their encampment and see them for myself. I am curious to see if they look like the Clan or like me. Freyana has come back to my hidings place to bring me food. I must go eat now and finish this later. Ljagnid stops writing there and did not finish on that day. [His next entry] is about Freyana's death. Perhaps this will help us."

Danica says, "'Ingvarr and his friends have been searching for a week now, but have not found the visitors. Everyone thought they had made it to their own lands until Runil showed up. He said that the deserters of the Clan had taken in the visitors and were making a deal with them. Runil feared the deal and left them, returning to the Clan. He begged to be accepted back into the Clan, but no one trusts him. The Alfevsons took him back in, but they secretly set someone to watch him at all times. I think Runil is [up to no good].'"

Danica says, "A few days later Ljagnid writes, 'I was right. Runil left us again today, but he said he wasn't returning to the deserters. He still feared the visitors. He told us he was going north, because he thought the visitors were going to do something bad to the Clan and to the deserters. Some people went with him, but we never saw any of them again. When he left, I saw him carrying a bunch of scrolls. I checked with everyone, but no one was missing any, so they must have belonged to Runil after all. Something strange is happening to me. I have started seeing strange creatures no one else sees. I am scared.' That is where the book ends. [Interesting], is it not?"

Danica says, "Now, before you start wondering, I know of these rengades Ljagnid wrote of in his journal. They were once Clansmen and women. When the Clan moved into the area, they had two choices - live in peace with the trolls, kobolds, and dwarves, or conquer them. The Alfvesons, chose to live in peace, and this made some of the Clan members [angry]."

Danica says, "These members did not like the non-human races. They felt that co-existing with them rather than ruling them showed weakness. Rather than live in that situation, they packed up and left, following the loudest of them, Jango. I guess you could say they are the forerunners to the Blodfelags that roam the lands now. He led them out into the wilderness, where they roamed for a short time until they mysteriously died out. They had no name for themselves, but in the Clan they were referred to as the deserters. I also know of this man, [Runil]."

Danica says, "I have a few notes about him in different books. He and his followers moved around quite a bit, but finally settled in Raumarik. It is said his spirit still haunts the land, although now he fears everyone, thinking they have been sent by either the deserters or the visitors. I believe the scrolls he took will contain the answer to what the visitors planned to do to the Clan. I need you to travel now to Raumarik and find Runil. His followers are always with him, hoping for his protection, so take many with you to defeat them. When you reach Raumarik, head to the river. Cross the river and head north until you find Runil. Return to me when you have the scrolls of Runil."
Go to Raumarik, find Runil and kill him to get the scrolls. He is located approximately 54k, 19k. Then go back to Danica and give her the scrolls.
Danica says, "So you have returned from Raumarik, child. What do you bring me from the deserter, Runil?"
You give Danica the scrolls of Runil.
Danica says, "Ah, I am glad you were able to get these. They will [solve the mystery] of the Clan's problems, I am sure."

Danica says, "I shall need a minute or two to scan over Runil's scrolls to see if I can learn anything [about the visitors]. While I do that, why don't you take a look at what Anrid sent over for you."
You receive a (your reward here) from Danica!
You are awarded 3 gold and some silver!
You are awarded 1,5XX,XXX,XXX experience!

When Taldos asks if you are there to release him or for his amulet say amulet. When he asks if you are there for [wealth] or [good name], for your own sake say good name... or receive this message: "greed in a thane Ill send you back to thor quickly"

After you get the amulet you need to go to talk to Taldos again. He spawns in the same place as above, but he spawns at around Midnight til 9 in the morn. Talk to him and give him the Amulet. He gives it back to you and gives you exp.

midgard|the red dagger.Name: The Red Dagger
midgard|the red dagger.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Given to you by your guild trainer in Jordheim. He tells you that there has been some bandit activity that has people concerned in the area. He tells you to seek out Gordin Tuhan in Mularn, for he has discovered a red dagger in his house after driving off one of the thieves. You speak to Gordin Tuhan and he tells you a small amount of the tale, and then asks that you seek out Karl Gat in Vasudheim. This guard, he says, is very concerned that this might be part of a larger plot.

You speak to Karl Gat and he tells you some more history about what's been going on, and asks that you seek out a rogue for him named Joseph Damr, who appears in Myrkwood near Gna Faste. This rogue had fled town when Karl Gat had gone to question him about the red daggers.

You can find Joseph Damr on a small mound just north of Gna Faste. Literally just steps away. Sometimes he is on top, sometimes near the back. He knows why you're there, and doesn't waste time talking. After you kill him, you receive a red dagger, which you then take back to Karl Gat. Karl Gat accepts the red dagger and gives you experience and an item. He then tells you to seek out Lynnleigh on an island near Vasudheim.

Lynnleigh tells a tale of her brother, Joseph, and how he ran off with the bad band of the Red Daggers. She mourns his death, and blames the Red Daggers for leading him down that path, and wants revenge. She has discovered what the Red Daggers are looking for, items forged by a specific smith who has learned how to empower his items with magic. She tells you to seek Genlu in Haggerfel and warn him of his danger.

Genlu is shocked to find that the Red Daggers seek the knowledge he carries, because they cannot use it without the knowledge of the Seithkona. However, he warns that if they were to obtain that knowledge there could be trouble. He asks that you gain strength, wisdom and experience and return to him when you have so that you can continue on the quest.

midgard|the three sisters.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to Anrid in Jordheim, she will instruct you to find the first sister.

Jodis Rindasdottir can be found at Loc 36k/33k roaming around on top of a hill south of the rope bridge from the werewolf town in Skona Ravine. She will want you to go and kill a Werewolf Shaman who is in the long building on the south side of the rope bridge, there are other werewolves in there and you will likely pull more then just the shaman which conned yellow to me at 40, once dead the shaman will give you a sword hilt, return this to Jodis Rindasdottir. She will give back the hilt and instruct you to find the second sister in Yggdra Forrest.

The second sister (Edonia Rindasdottir) can be found at loc 7k/59k next to the Fenrir fort halfway up a hill (New Frontiers loc 46720 6243 7959 in Yggdra Forrest). Be careful cause i saw a Fenrir scout in the area, he did not attack me but he does go by the sister in his pathing. The second sister will instruct you to find her drawings and a book. Kill a Wyvern for the drawings, which can be found on the hill on the opposite side of the Fenrir fort (You may be told to kill a frost giantinstead, their locin NF is 24 65). Her book can be found by killing a Bone-eater Spine Ripper, i found them at 57k/17k in Yggdra Forrest(New Frontiers loc 57679 22839 8098) also, once you have both return them to the Sister, she will then Instruct you to go find Coplin and to give him the book and drawings. (She has been know to give the task of killing an Ice Creature(aprox loc 24,17 in Yggdra, also seen at 16k 46 k)

Coplin Alverson is the guy from your 20th quest in Myrkwood Forest and his loc is 8k/55k which is on the shore of a lake west of Askheim the werewolf fort, after giving the book and drawings he gave the Sword Pommel and instructed me to find the third sister Norma in Vanern Swamp.

Norma can be found at loc 52k/43k. The easiest way to find here is when you zone into Vanern Swamp, find the fallen tree by the zone and follow a direction from that tree NW it will take you to a lake then head west and she'll be by a tree, (Caution, i have been told she would possibly attack you cause she does not want to let go of her blade, she did not for me but might for you, be prepared in case) If she does not attack you she will need a new water skin from a Bear bladder, what she is refering to is a bladder from a Battle Scarred Mauler. go back to Skona Ravine and head SE as soon as you zone in you should run into one, kill it and return to her with the bladder. After you give her the bladder she will give you the sword blade (Or if you killed her she will drop it)

Now return to Anrid in Jordheim, She will instruct you to go to the Smith in Vasudheim, the name should appear in the quest log, he will forge the sword into one, then return the sword to Anrid and you will get to chose a staff as your reward (Depending on your spec)

midgard|the war continues.Name: The War Continues
midgard|the war continues.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: The War Continues quest
Step #1
Morlin Caan says, "Ah my friend. You got word I needed you. I've received word from Masrim again. There have been more sightings of [the Albion undead] recently."

Morlin Caan says, "I fear that killing Pellinistra didn't end the reign of the undead here in our beloved land. I think someone has either taken her place or more likely [someone] was controlling Pellinistra and now has chosen someone else to lead the undead against us."

Morlin Caan says, "We will not be rid of the undead until we are sure we have found and dealt with the one from Albion that leads this fight. Will you aid Masrim and myself again in [purging our land] of this evil that plagues it?"

Morlin Caan says, "I knew we could count on one from the House of Loki. In the note Masrim sent to me, she spoke of messages she had received from across the land. The most pressing message came from Gunnolf in Vindsaul Faste on the edge of West Svealand, although he did not include many details. Travel to him now and find out what you can of these new undead invaders on our land."
Gunnolf is the Shadowblade Trainer in Vindsaul Faste.
Step #2

Gunnolf says, "Hail. I recognize you from Masrim's description. She was sure that once Morlin spoke to you of the evil invading our land, you would once again rise to the task. I was afraid to include too many details of what I've seen in my note. I did not want to spread panic across my beloved homeland. Let me tell you [what I've seen]."

Gunnolf says, "I was out on patrol recently in Yggdra Forest. As I was returning, I happened to catch a glimpse of a person dressed in black meeting with another in the same attire. I didn't think too much of it, for both seemed harmless enough. I saw something pass from one hand to another - something round and white, kind of like a bone or a skull. They both [headed off] in opposite directions after the item changed hands."
Gunnolf says, "It was a few days after that the reports started coming in from travelers about a group of undead roaming the Forest. They have been seen in [many places]."

Gunnolf says, "They seem to avoid the guards and patrols, but the travelers speak of them near the water at night. Since they avoid the patrols, I believe you will be able to find them, If you see them, do not hesitate to attack. Masrim has said she cannot solve the riddle of who controls the undead without knowing how they are controlled."
Kill a roaming undead patrol in the Forest and retrieve the Bone White Skull. They only spawn near midnight.
Step #3
Gunnolf says, "You have returned! I am most pleased to see you survived. Did those vile creatures have anything that might give us a clue as to who is controlling them?"
(New Frontiers Captain Rayburn found at loc=37k, 36k, short run SE from arvakr faste.)

Gunnolf says. "Why, this is the skull I saw the two cloaked figures exchanging! I should have known they were up to no good. I am a fool for thinking they were harmless.
