You must take this skull to Masrim immediatley. Hopefully her ancestors will be able to help her figure out who was using it. The safety of Midgard lies in your hands. May the House of Loki watch over you."
You receive a Bone White Skull from Gunnolf!
Step #4 Return to Masrim with the bone white skull.

Masrim says, "Welcome back. I wish we were meeting again under better circumstance, but these are bad times. It is up to us to make them better. Morlin sent word he was sending you to Gunnolf. Did you have any luck with him? Did you obtain anything that will help our cause?"
You give Masrim the bone white skull.
You are awarded experience!

Masrim says, "Hmmm. I have seen many bones in my day, but you don't need me to tell you this was the skull of some resident of Albion, dragged up from the grave to serve and evil purpose. Give me a minute to speak with my ancestors to see if we can identify those responsible for this deed."

Masrim says, "Ah, the one who is doing this is shielding herself from view. All I can tell is that she is female. If I had not broken my scrying crystal last week, I would be able to see more. They are hard to come by these days, but I know of [a few creatures] that use them."

Masrim says, "The sidhe draoi still use scrying crystals. Head to Skona Ravine. When you reach the circle of stones, head west down a deep ravine, When you come out of the ravine, head south to the water. The sidhe draoi live alond the water. When you have a scrying crystal, return to me." (or he will send you to the Isalf Scryers in Yggdra or Uppland
Go to Skona Ravine and kill a Sidhe Draoi
Step #5
Masrim says, "Welcome back. Give me the scrying crystal please."
You give Masrim the scrying crystal.
You are awarded experince!

Masrim says, Ah, my visions are much clearer now, although there is still some fog. The person you seek is still hiding her face from me, although now I can see where she is hiding herself. Go to Uppland and see out [Mjollner Faste]."

Masrim says, "She knows you have defeated her undead in Yggdra Forest, and has fled to Uppland. I fear she may be trying to return to Albion to protect herself. She hides now near Mjollner Faste. You must [find her]."

Masrin says, "Head west from there, up the mountain to a large lake, I believe an undead protector guards her so be careful as you approach. Learn her name if you can. Go now and remove her from our land. Our fate rests in your hands.
Find Eibhilin and kill her. (New Frontiers loc Uppland at 20k 27k, south of the relic keep, not far from the Snowshoe Bandit camp.)
Step #6
Masrim says, "Tell me, were you able to learn the name of the creature we seek? Tell it to me know."
You say, "Eibhilin"
Masrim says, "Ah, that is not an Albion name. That sounds almost Celtic. Did you get anything else from her?"
You hand Masrim a talisman.
You are awarded experience!
Masrim says, "This talisman bears a tree on it! That is not the symbol of Albion. Strange things are happening here. Was there anything else?"
You hand Masrim a book.
You are awarded experience!

Masrim says, "This book is not written in the language spoken by Albion. In fact, this looks rather like the druid texts I've seen before. I believe that the vile Hibernians have a hand in this plot. I shall have to investigate it more. For now, return to Morlin. He needs to know that there is a good pissibility that Hibernia is in league with Albion and that our realm is in mortal danger. Tell him the Hibernians are involved in this plague. Go now!"
Step #7
Morlin Caan says, "So you return. Gunnolf sent word he has you go to Masrim. That was good , for she knows more of this than anyone. What did you learn from her?"
You say, "Hibernians are involved."
You are awarded some experince!

Morlin Cann says, "The Hibernians are involved? This is worse that we thought! If they are in league with those in Albion, Midgard could be doomed. I must get in touch with Masrim immedialely and see what she has learned. For now though, I owe you [a reward]."
Morlin Caan says, "Aye, a reward. You've earned it for bringing me this knowledge. You must choose from the weapons I've been making. Would you prefer a [sword], or an [axe]?"
Morlin Caan says, "An axe, eh? Would you prefer [one handed] or [two handed]?"

Morlin Caan says, "Here is your axe, my friend. May the House of Loki keep watch over you until Masrim and I need you again, and we most certainly will need you if this pact between the realms is true!"
You receive Mischief Maker's Axe from Morlin Caan!
You are awarded 1 gold and some silver!
You are awarded experience!
You have finished the The War Continues quest.
Rewards:
Michief Maker's Axe (1H)
Mischief Maker's Great Axe (2H)
Winter's Spear (2H)
Winter's Blade (1H)
Sword of Ice (2H)
Bow of the North
Rewards:
Mischief Maker's Axe
Mischief Maker's Great Axe
Winter's Spear
Winter's Blade
Sword of Ice
Bow of the North

midgard|trealine's visions.Name: Trealine's Visions
midgard|trealine's visions.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Okay, I am sending this in to help prevent fellow Camelot'ers from going

through the pain & agony of trying to figure this quest out; especially for those of us that put off quests for long periods of time. First & foremost, it should be stated that this is a Shrouded Isles quest. Trust me in this, you can spend an eternity searching the classis DAoC Midgard realm to no avail-just the better part of 6 hours, in my case *sigh*. At any rate, here
is the skinny:
I was given this quest by the Healer Trainer in Aegirhamn (Fredi). He asked

me to seek out Trealine & ask her about her visions. Trealine can be found outside of the "bar" on the lower level of Aegirhamn just inside the city walls by the rope bridge leading west out of the city.

When you speak to Trealine, she will make up her mind to act on her visions; athough, she does not know what they mean. Her first request will be for the beak of a boobrie fledgling. The boobrie fledglings can be found just north of the stone bridge to the NW of Aegirhamn.

Upon returning the beak to Trealine, she will make her second request which is for the tusk, hide, and eye of a mammoth calf. I retrieved these three items by killing three mammoth calves just NW of the guard tower sitting on top of the hill to the NW of Aegirhamn.

Once these items have been returned to Trealine, she will give you a reward of some money & experience. In completing this quest with my 22nd level healer, she gave me 11 silver and some copper & 57,960 experience points.
Rewards:
Beaded Piety
Grenlock Blessed Choker

midgard|visions of darkness.Name: Visions of Darkness
midgard|visions of darkness.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Head to Inasksha in Haggerfel. Talk to her and she sends you to Corath in Huginfell. Corath an be found in the bar. You must actually say [Rod of Mimir] to him. He talks to you a while at which he ends with you needing to return to Inaksha. Upon talking to Inakasha you are given the task to kill Fressen, the dark kobold. Fressen can be found on the shipwreck near Nalliten. Careful. Fressen is green at 20 and looks alone but when you cast or hit him he summons instantly 4 or 5 drifiting spirits. After you kill Fressen the spirits will disapear and he will drop his journal. Return the journal to Inakasha for your reward.
Inaksha says, "Hail! It is good you have returned. I have meditated long on
what action we must take to secure the Rod of Mimir. Before we can journey
into the depths of the realm, we must [learn] more of the rod and what
obstacles may lay in our path."
Inaksha says, "I know of a young shaman. Corath, I believe is his name. He knows much of the thul. Perhaps he could enlighten us on what we should
expect. He was last seen adventuring within the western part of Svealand.
Seek him out and inquire about the rod and the Thul."
You have been given the Visions of Darkness quest.
Step 3 of Wisdom of Time (yes, it's step 3 again?)
-Learn what steps must be taken to secure the Rod of Mimir
Step 4 - kill Fressen a kobald by the boat near Nalliten - then return to Inaksha in Haggerfel
Experience gained: 540,672
Rewards:
Bracer of Pacification -- Healer
Necklace of Shamanic Magic -- Shaman
Rewards:
Bracer of Mending
Necklace of Shamanic Magic

midgard|war concluded.Name: War Concluded
midgard|war concluded.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: 1) Go speak to Masrim in Fort Atla. Masrim will send you to Yggdra Forest to speak to and deliver items to Fionnuala.

2) Find Fionnuala, the Hibernian Informer, in Yggdra Forest and hand her the items. She is a bit tricky to find since she will phase in and out, in the Old Frontiers she can be found at loc 12.7K/8.8K (New Frontiers loc=42856, 16923, 8324)
3) Fionnuala will send you to Vanern Swamp to kill Ajniollia. You can find her at loc 45800, 62830. Upon her death she will drop a scroll.

4) Travel back to Masrim in Fort Atla and give her the scrolls. When you do this Masrim will tell you that she is blind and that you will have to read the scrolls to her. To do this place the scroll on your hotbar hold down the use key you have bound (defalt is e) and click on the scroll on the hot bar.
5) Now open your quest journal and tell Masrim what it says.
Level 45 received 1,156,317,648 exp,
3 gold and some silver.
Level 47 received 608+ million xp
Rewards:
Dancing Flame -- Shadowblade
Crystalized Snowflake Pin -- Hunter
Rewards:
Crystalized Snowflake Pin
Dancing Flame

midgard|wisdom of time.Name: Wisdom of Time
midgard|wisdom of time.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Starts at your healer trainer in Jordheim she sends you to Inaksha in Haggerfel, She will send you to Gorne in Audilten, who sends you to Kjell in Vasudheim. He will tell you of a book of lore that only he can open, and that the Vendo Prugor has it.Prugor is found wondering between the 2 vendo camps west of Fort Veldon, between LOC=26475, 30170 and 26,500 by 11,400. He is not a stationary spawn, he does roam.
[Step 1] Seek out one called Inaksha. She can be found in the town of Haggerfel. She knows much regarding the Rod of Mimir, and often has visions.
Inaksha says, "I am so glad you have come to me. You see, I hve an [amazing story] for you."
Inaksha says, "There was once a time, long ago when this world was ruled by
the hands of the gods. Oh yes, the Aesir and Jotun were very prevalent in
this day in age. It was a time of myth and legend, young one. For I can see
it in my visions. My visions extend long into the past, during [ancient]
times, and I see into the murky future. For it is our past and our future
that make us who we are."
Inaksha says, "I see a man, wearing priestly garb, he is holding a great

staff and waving it. For which direction the staff points is uncertain. If waved at the field, that field grow. If waved at an opposition there is ending. However the direction the staff points now is uncertain. It is lost to me, even though there may be great suffering or great joy this staff must be found. I do not know what it mean, [my visions] of this time are so fuzzy."
Inaksha says, "Perhaps the scholar Gorne can make sense of these visions.
Please, [find him]. He may be the only person who can unravel this mystery for me."
You have been given the Rod and the Scholars quest.
Inaksha says, "Last I heard he was studying texts found in Audliten."
[Step 2] Seek out the Scholars, perhaps their studies into the ancient cultures of Midgard can shed some light on the Rod of Mimir.
(BEGIN THE ROD AND THE SCHOLARS QUEST HERE)
[Step 3] Return to Inaksha in Haggerfel when you have reached 20th level

midgard|blessed enchantments.Name: Blessed Enchantments
midgard|blessed enchantments.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Please note that your steps and tasks may vary.
Leif (in Jord) says, "Elizabeth the enchanter has need of your services. Attend to her in Mularn."

Elizabeth says, "Welcome. I see word has gotten to you that I need your help. As an enchanter, I am always seeking betters ways of enchanting the weapons and armor that are brought to me. I have studied long and searched hard to learn [the secrets] of the ancient people of this land. The people who lived in the dawn of our land knew the secrets of the gods, and used those secrets to create fantastic weapons.

Elizabeth says, "You recently had an encounter with the weapon, Thane's Blood, did you not? As you know, it was no ordinary axe but one enchanted in the old ways. It was said to be blessed by the gods themselves! The ones that crafted these enchanted weapons wrote down the secrets of their enchantments in books and tomes and kept them from the world. As invaders entered our realm, many were destroyed. We thought all were lost until recently. I have learned the location of one of these lost books. I wish to [acquire this tome] to help Midgard from the invaders who seek to destroy us. That is where you come in.

Elizabeth says, "I cannot get what is needed to acquire the tome, for I am not trained in the ways of battle. If you will help me obtain what I seek, I shall use the tome to create a special weapon just for you. Will you [aid me] in my quest?"
Dialog box: Will you help Elizabeth retrieve the ancient tome she seeks?
You have been given the Blessed Enchantments quest.

Elizabeth says, "You will not regret the decision to help me, although at times the way will be hard. The tome I spoke of is in two pieces. I only know the location of the first half of the tome. A shaman named Tyia holds the first half. She has sent word to me that she will give me the half she possesses if I will brind her something [she desires].

Elizabeth says, "She desires the heart of a battle-scarred mauler. It is the final component Tyria needs for a charm she wished to make. Travel to Skona Ravine and get the heart. Take it to Tyria in Vindsaul Faste. She will then give you what I seek, along with the location of the second half."
Travel to Skona, and right by entrance to Varulvhamn can find battle-scarred maulers. I found mine at 17K, 40K in Skona.

Alternate steps: May be asked to bring her the liver if a timberland badger found in Skona Ravine. These can be found at loc 20928, 42182. Or bring her the brain of a timber cat. Also may be asked to "Get a clump of Yeti Fur from a Nordic Yeti in Yggdra's Forest" for step #5 of Blessed Enchantments which can be found West of Arvakr Faste.
Tyria says, "So, you've come to me from Elizabeth, have you? I told her what I wanted in exchange for the tome. Do you have the mauler heart?"
You give Tyria the Mauler Heart.
You receive 104,857,600 experience!

Tyria says, "Ah, this is a wonderful mauler heart. I will finally be able to complete that charm I was asked to make. I've been asked to make another charm and I do not have all the things I need for it. Get me [the item] I need, and I will give you both halves of the tome Elizabeth wants.
Tyria says, "It is but a trifle really, a small token from [a creature] of the ice and snow."
Tyria says, "There are creatures in Yggdra's Forest known simply as blocks of ice. You must seek out one and retrieve its icy heart. Once you have it, return to me and I shall give you the tome."
Travel in Yggdra, West of the lake, by Fenrir's outpost to find the Blocks of Ice. Loc of 24400, 11230
Return to Tyria with the heart.
Tyria says. "Ah, you have returned. My patrons have been waiting for their protection charms to take with them into the frontier. Please, give me that icy heart.

Tyria says, "Here is your tome; although I do not know what good it will do Elizabeth. It is written in ancient Kobold and worth nothing to me anymore, since I cannot read that language. Perhaps she will be able to decipher it. I wish both of you luck."
Return to Elizabeth, and return Tome. You are awarded 62,914,560 experience!
Elizabeth says, "This is the entire tome! This is beyond my expectations! Now, let me see what is involved in enchanting weapons.

Elizabeth says, "Someone in Tyria's family must have been an enchanter in ancient times, or else they copied this book from another. It is written in ancient Kobold, which I happen to know. Part of my training to become an enchanter was to learn all the ancient languages, for many enchantments are in ancient tongues. I bet Tyia did not think I could do so much with this, for that very reason, or else she wouldn't have let it go for such a low price. With this tome, I can enchant many weapons for the brave inhabitants of this land, such as those of the House of Bragi. Now, in the tome, it says there are [three basic things] needed for the enchantment.

Elizabeth says, "It's almost humorous, to think that three simple things, when combined in the right amounts, will create such a powerful enchantment. The gods do have a sense of humor after all, it appears. When you hear what the three things are, you would never think to put them together. Well, let me send you out for [one thing] first. According to the book, it will take the longest to prepare. Then I shall have you get the other two.
Elizabeth says, "You must travel into Varulvhamn in Skona Ravine. Seek out a werewolf noble and acquire its pelt. Once you have it, return to me."

Travel to Varulvhamn and find noble in Lord room. Regardless of what people tell you, if you by yourself or with 1 other, you will just get singles from that room. Had no problem finding a noble in Lord room, and pulling it as a single pull.
Alternate task could be to get an arachite Vakt's pincers. These can be found in Spindelhalla, and are very easy to find.
Items can also include an Eye of an Ice Giant found in Yggdra or Upland, and a Nordic Yeti found in Yggrda or Upland.
Return to Elizabeth with the pelt.
Elizabeth says, "Good, you have returned. I must take the pelt and burn it. Give me the pelt please."
You give Elizabeth the pelt.
You are awarded 62,914,560 experience!

Elizabeth says, "The ashes contain the magical property that allows a werewolf to transform himself into a beast or a man. It is that property that will help transform everyday weapons into magical ones. Now, are you ready for the [other items]?"

Elizabeth says, "You must travel to Uppland. There hunt for the wyvern and the taiga cat. From the wyvern, get a scale. The scale contains many magical properties of the gods and is essential to the enchantment. From the taiga cat, bring me a claw. The claw will add sharpness to the weapons I enchant. Return to me when you have both."

Have to get Wyvern first. I got mine by Glenlock (forgot screenshot). Have to get a claw from Taiga Cat second. I saw many of these in Yggdra while looking for block of ice, and got mine there instead of Uppland (33778 31074 in Uppland).
Return to Elizabeth with both.
Elizabeth says; "Ah, the legendary scale of the wyvern. This is perfect. Now, the taiga claw please. I cannot use the new enchantments without it."

Elizabeth says, "Thank you for the claw. The enchantment is complete. Now you must pick your reward. Which do you desire - [one handed] or [two handed] or a [shield]. Choose carefully, for once your choice is made; you cannot change your mind.
After turning in both items to Elizabeth, gain 62,914,560 experience as well
Two Handed Conclusion:
Elizabeth then says; "Now chooose your weapon - [sword], [axe], or [hammer]. Again, choose carefully for you cannot change once you voice your selection."
Axe Conclusion:
Elizabeth says; "An axe, eh? Give me but a minute and I shall have it."
You are awarded 1 gold, and some silver!
You are awarded 83,886,080 experience!
You have finished the Blessed Enchantments Quest
Overall, I gained a bub and half of XP from this quest. I did it first thing when I turned 40, and didn't fight other creatures - just the quest.
Lvl 46 reports getting 158,934,400 xp for quest.
Rewards:
Blessed Northern Axe
Blessed Northern Great Hammer
Blessed Northern Hammer
Blessed Northern Great Sword
Blessed Northern Sword
Blessed Northern Great Axe
Midnight Defender
Beryl Bulwark
Barbed Claws
Blessed Bladed Claw Greave
Bedlam Bladestopper
Sword of the Ice

midgard|hill cat hunt -- savage version.Name: Hill Cat Hunt -- Savage Version
midgard|hill cat hunt -- savage version.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: You must complete the Traveler's Way quest before getting this one.
This is the level 11 epic for Savages. This quest is planned out and
played just the same as the Warriors but with different wording and dialogue.

Jaakko says, "Hail Mavador! Kelgor grants skill in battle to those who train as hard as you. Now it's time to put that skill to another use. Kelgor wishes you to go [on the hunt] for some exclusive creature."
Dialog box: Do you wish to participate in the Hill Cat Hunt?
Jaakko says, "Kelgor wishes you to go hunt for hill cats! Prove your skill in
battle. Get me five teeth from the hill cats to prove you are a member of the house of Kelgor!"
Go hunt down five hill cats and it can't be small hill cats but actual hill cats! You will receive a cat tooth for each hill cat you kill. The hill cats con yellow at 11th level.
Return to Jaakko and give him each hill cat tooth.
Jaakko says, "I have given you a task! Prove yourself worthy or be gone from
the house of Kelgor! Go get five hill cat teeth!"
Jaakko says, "I asked for five teeth to prove yourself to Kelgor. I hope you have more!"
Jaakko says, "This would be enough, if you were a puny child, but you are a
follower of Kelgor! Go now and get more!"
Jaakko says, "This is good, but Kelgor still wants more!"
Jaakko says, "This is good, but Kelgor still wants more!"
Jaakko says, "Kelgor is pleased, but he [wants more proof] that you have earned your place in the house of Kelgor."
You are awarded 7,964 experience!
Jaakko says, "The Viking Karl cannot deal with a problem he is having. Go
speak to him and show him that Savages are strong!"
Seek out Viking Karl at the guard tower in the mountains and aid him in his
problem.
Viking Karl is located at 17500, 49700 in front of the guard tower.
Viking Karl says, "You are from Jaakko, are you not? He said he would send
one to help me [with hunting] an evil creature."
Viking Karl says, "The vile beast Hrrgyf has feasted on many of my men.
Jaakko claims that this hill cat will not feast upon a Savage. Kill Hrrgyf
and bring me her tooth, as proof of your deed. She roams the mountains
near here."
Kill Hrrgyf and bring the tooth back to Viking Karl.
Viking Karl says, "Take this small reward with my thanks. I must now see
to training my men better and you must return to Jaakko. He wishes to speak
to you."
You are awarded 3 silver and some copper.
Return to Jaakko to show your loyalty.
Jaakko says, "Viking Karl sent word you have killed the mighty Hrrgyf.
Kelgor is pleased that you have proved yourself in battle. Be ready, for
Kelgor shall call upon you again!"
You are awarded 15,928 experience!
You receive a Necklace of Savage Strength from Jaakko!
You have finished the Hill Cat Hunt quest.
Reward:
Necklace of Savage Strength

midgard|siv's spirit.Name: Siv's Spirit
midgard|siv's spirit.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This is the second part in a nested quest. You must start the Grenlock Clan quest first.

Siv is located NE of Dvalin, usually on a long, narrow island in the small bay. He is a spirit named Siv Alfevson. The loc I found him at was 20000,44380,4600, although he appears to roam around the island. After a brief conversation, he will send you to find his wife, Ulga. Ulga is located in West Svealand, NW of Hugginfel. She will talk to you briefly, then attack you. She conned green to me at 17 and wasn't much trouble to kill, even though she started at close range. She drops a piece to the Grenlock Crest. Once you return the piece to Anrid, he will give you Runed Mystical Boots.
You have been given the Siv's Spirit quest.
[Step #1] Seek out spirit of Siv in East Svealand.

Siv is found on the same isle where Riv spawns, which is across from where Klippa is. Go to Dvalin and go past the guard tower to just past the ant camp, there to your left across the river is an isle, Siv is there or near it swimming in the water.
Siv Alfevson says, "Life is never to be taken for [granted] for one always reaps what they sow."

Siv Alfevson says, "I traveled many years, running in fear from the terrible consuming northern storm. After may years my brothers and I settled our armies and clan and built shelter and a new civilization after the terrible storm that wiped away our homeland. Our father stayed behind, leaving us with only pieces of his armor and pieces of our great clan crest of Grenlock. I too stay behind to watch over what is left of [our clan] here in these parts."

Siv Alfevson says, "There is little of the Grenlock Clan left, only our people and the shards of the crest my father entrusted me to us, both now scattered to the wind. You must make sure to gather the crest piece from my long dead wife, [Ulga}. This must be done at all costs!"

Siv Alfevson says, "Search for her soul and ask for the Grenlock Crest shard. Should you succeed, the House of Hel shall make us whole! I can assist you no more Spiritmaster. May the gods guard you on the rest of your journey, just as they have done with me."
[Step #3] Find Siv's wife Ulga within West Svealand. Acquire the Grenlock [crest] piece!

To find Ulga, from Aylarn (in front of lean-to) run west, then you'll see the tower and the camp of Bloodfellags. At the camp take the path and head a bit northwest (maybe a bit more north than west) then we saw her wandering around.
*Alternate directions:

Go to Audliten, go north across the bridge and take a left at the crossroad. Follow that trail a ways until you get to the top of the hill where there is another crossroad. Take a left (If you go right, you will end up at the West Gate). Follow the path until the next crossroad. There are 2 stumps, one on the south side of the path and one on the north side. If you stand next to the one on the south side and point yourself due South, go forward and you will run into a tree. Just past that tree is where i saw her each time. I hope this helps reduce some of your search time.
Be careful, there are also some wolfpacks running around there too. Ulga conned blue at lvl 15. And SOMETIMES a ghoul will spawn while you are killing her.
Approximate Loc sights (she does roam):
Ulga says, "How may I help you young one?"
You say, "crest"
Ulga says, "The only way you could know about the Grenlock Crest is if my husband [Siv] had spoken to you or you are an agent of evil!"
Ulga says, "It is doubtful that he has sent you! If you wish the crest, you must take it by force!"
She then proceeds to begin casting...kill her, get the crest.
Ulga says, "I have failed you my love!"
You receive a Grenlock Crest piece from Ulga!
Your standing with the spirits of Midgard has decreased.
[Step #4] Return to Anrid in Jordheim.
Anrid says, "You have returned. Did you obtain that which was required of you?"
You hand Anrid the Grenlock Crest piece.
Anrid says, "I see you have met Siv. He was very kind to his people, always wishing them the best and his family. Perhaps someday the Grenlock Clan name will be restored. Safe journey Spiritmaster.
You are awarded experience!"
You receive Spririt-dweller's Gloves from Anrid!
You have finished the Siv's Spirit quest.
Rewards:
Runed Mystical Boots -- Runemaster
Spirit-dweller's Gloves -- Spiritmaster
Boned Mystic Boots -- Bonedancer
Rewards:
Runed Mystical Boots
Spirit-dweller's Gloves
Boned Mystical Boots

midgard|the rod and the scholars.Name: The Rod and the Scholars
midgard|the rod and the scholars.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: *This is for Healers, the one for Shamans is The Rod and the Scholars (Shaman)

Starting with Per at level 15 he requests you to travel to Haggerfel and speak with a woman named Inaksha, she sits in a hut with the towns healer and enchanter. She tells you about visions she's been having and wants you to verify wether her visions of the past are true or not. She sends you to speak with Gorne in Audliten. This is the Wisdom of time part that send you to this part.
[Step 1] Seek out Gorne in Audliten. He has much to say!
He tells you a few tales of mythos and tells you that to better find information you should speak with a kobold in Vasudheim.
[Step 2] Seek out Scholar Kjell in Vasudheim.
This kobold tells of a book that archives items and artifacts of great lore but has been lost to him and requires you to get it back for him.
Kjell says, "Oh, I see, Gorne has send you to me looking for [information] I would guess?"
Kjell says, "Information on the Thul and a [great staff]?"
Kjell says, "I should think Gorne is speaking of the Rod of Mimir. It is
rumored to have once belonged to the ancient tribe of the Thul. I would not
put my beliefs in such things. I prefer to put my own beliefs into thtings I
can hold. Even these old books here. There may be one book, however, which
would turn rumor into fact! Are you [interested] Healer?"
Kjell says, "I once owned a book of item lore. One of the greatest lore
books I've ever seen! Written on its pages are the tales of many who have
laid their eyes upon [items of power]. The book is safe from prying eyes as the spells I?ve placed upon its lock can only be broken by me."
Kjell says, "I cannot be certain that your great staff can be found upon the
pages of this book. Yet, should you [retrieve] this book for me, I would not hesitate to open its secrets to you."
Kjell says, "The book was stolen in the dead of night from my abode. I have
heard rumors that it has since passed from hand to hand. The only [clues] I can possibly give you is a name and region where it was last seen."
Kjell says, "I know only of the name Prugor and that he dwells somewhere
within the region of Mularn. You should start your journey there my friend.
A warning Healer, this book is of great value and will be protected by many.
Should you find the book's current owner, you will require comrades to take it!"
[Step 3] Find Prugor and get the book of lore from him.
You must kill a Vendo in northwest Valley of Mularn near the Vendo camps by
the name of Prugor. Prugor can be found in the Vendo camp in the Vale of Mularn. Loc 25k, 12k. He was green to me at level 15 tho you have to watch out
for Rathes and his little war band as they both travel the same path. After
killing Prugor you will recieve a book.
You receive an book of lore from Prugor!
[Step 4] Return to Kjell in Vasudheim
Kjell says, "Welcome back Healer! Was your search for the book of lore
successful?"
You give book of lore to Kjell.
Kjell casts a spell!
Kjell says, "Ah! Let us see if we can yet find the secrets of your great
staff within the pages of my book."
Kjell says, "Here it is! The Rod of Mimir serves its maker, the god of

Wisdom in all things. The rod is rumored to bring ultimate knowledge to the Thul and the one who wields the rod! If this is the device you seek, then prepare yourself for disappointment. The rod has been lost to the Thul for many generations. All who may have known its location have been long since entered into Valhalla. You would be best to return to the one who has championed for the rod?s return and tell them of their misfortune."
Kjell says, "I can help you no more."
[Step 5] Return to Inaksha
Inaksha says, "Have you [found] truth in my visions?"

Inaksha says, "I knew you were the proper choice for this task. The Thul and the Rod of Mimir you say? Perhaps this is what I have seen in my visions! It is said in myth that the Thul were the great seekers of wisdom and the
purest of heart and spirit. I must meditate on this and decide on where next to direct your focus. I thank you for your service!"
You receive a Eir Blessed Pendant from Inaksha!
You are awarded 191,520 experience!
You have finished the The Rod and the Scholars quest.
Return to Wisdom of Time
Reward:
Eir Blessed Pendant

midgard|amora's aid.Name: Amora's Aid
midgard|amora's aid.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Your Trainer in Fort Atla asks you to speak to Amora. Her daughter, Magnild, has been bitten by a Water Snake and has not recovered enough for Amora to gather the components required to brew an antidote to the venom. Amora asks you to go out and gather 5 vials of Water Snake venom and take them to Kari the Healer who will brew an antidote.
Trainer says, "The lady Amora here in Fort Atla has been here for several weeks because she is [unable] to travel."
Trainer says, "Her daughter, Magnild has fallen [ill]."
Trainer says, "They have been staying in one of the homes here in town to keep the poor girl warm. Please help them, they are in great need."
Dialog box: The Lady Amora needs your help in curing her sick daughter.
You have been given the Amora's Aid quest
[Step #1] The Lady Amora and her daughter need your assistance, seek Amora out for details.
Amora can be found upstairs in the second building on the left when standing in the entrance to Fort Atla.
Amora says, "Be still Magnild, all will be alright soon and you will be well once again."
Amora says, "Hello stranger, may I ask your [name]?"
Amora says, "It is a pleasure to meet you. I am so glad you have come to aid me and [Magnild]."
Amora says, "Yes, my poor darling Magnild was bitten by a [water snake] while traveling into town. Unfortunately, the bite has not healed and she is not feeling very well at all."
Amora says, "Oh, it seems the venom of the snake was very powerful. I have sent word to t he healer and she has told me she needs five vials of [snake venom] to cure the child."
Amora says, "I do not feel right leaving Magnild [here alone] this ill, so I fear I can't hunt the snakes myself."
Amora says, "Please go outside the city and [collect] the five vials of venom and take them to Kari, the healer."
Amora says, "I am indebted to you always if you do the for me."
[Step #2] The Venom of the Water Snakes must be secured to cure Magnild, five vials are needed.
Water Snakes can be found along the sides of the road and towards the lake, not too far outside the entrance to Fort Atla. The vials are given to you automatically upon death of the snake.
[Step #3] Give the vials of snake venom to Kari so that she may brew a cure.
Kari can be found in the long house (the bar) directly ahead when standing in the entrance to Fort Atla. She is on the left side of the room when entering.
Kari says, "Ahh, you look as if you have been having a rough time. Have you brought me the vials of snake venom?"
Kari says, "I shall begin [work] at once in making the potion to cure the sick girl, hopefully all my training will not fail me."
Kari says, "You have aided in this situation beyond what is expected. I thnk you."
You are awarded 42 copper!
You are awarded 10 experience!
You have finished the Amora's Aid quest.

midgard|bad food.Name: Bad Food
midgard|bad food.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Pedra says, "Oh, I am not feeling very well at all. I don't think there's one member of this town that hasn't felt a little queasy at least (once?) from all the bad fish we've [eaten]."

Pedra says, "Aye, and now Kedra, the healer, is busy sorting out the worst! It turns out we are ate some bad fish. Now, Kedra says she is running our of her cure, and doesn't have time to get any more of the ingredients! Do you think you could help?"
Dialog box: Will you help the healer out?
You have been given the Bad Food quest
Pedra says, "Oh good! Talk to Kedra about [bad fish]. She'll tell you what needs to be done."
[Step #2] Talk to Kedra, the healer, about the illness in the town.

Kedra says, "Fish! The entire town has eaten bad fish! It is crazy! I told them not to! I told them the moon's position in the sky indicated a bad harvest of fish, but did anyone listen? And now, everyone is [sick]."
Kedra says, "Yes. Sick. Why are you here? Are you sick? You don't look sick to me. You can help me. I am running out of my cure! I don't have time to go get the [marine fungus] I need!"

Kedra says, "Aye. I mash it up and add herbs to it. It's a great cure! I need more though! Go get me a marine fungus. I will pay you for it! And the whole town will thank you, when they are through wretching up the illness, that is."
[Step #3] Kill a marine fungus for the healer, They can be found south, across the bridge.
You get 10 experience points!
[Step #4] Return to Kedra with the marine fungus.

Kedra says, "Oh thank you! The stench of the ill is getting to me! I can make a few more batches of my cure after this, and then be done with it all! This will teach everyone to ignore me! Let's see if they eat the fish the next time I say the moon isn't right! Here, I hope this is enough. Thank you for your aid!"
You are awarded 3 silver and some copper!
You are awarded 20 experience!
You have finished the Bad Food quest.

midgard|learn the hunt.Name: Learn the Hunt
midgard|learn the hunt.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This may be a level one only quest.
Aegan says "Greetings, are you [worthy of the hunt]?"

Aegan says, "Oh ho! Another bright young come to help Midgard fend off her enemies, eh? Wonderful, that's what I say! Wonderful! With the rise of the [Albion] and [Hibernia] armies,Midgard will need all the she can get!"
Aegan says "I have spent a great deal of my life hunting the [maulers] of this region"
Aegan says "Bring me the claws of a mauler cub and I shall reward you"
Step 1 - Hunt black mauler cubs for their claws
Steps 2 through 6 - Kill more mauler cubs (total of 5)
Step 7 - You have proven yourself a true hunter. Return to Aegan with all five bear claws.
Hand claws to Aegan, each time he says:
Aegan says, "You are doing well! Continue to pass me the bear claws!"
Aegan says "You have proven yourself well youngster! I hope the coin serves you well."
Received some copper and some (small at 7th level, probably quite a bit for a 1st level Char) experience.

midgard|rinda's lost keys.Name: Rinda's Lost Keys
midgard|rinda's lost keys.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per patch 1.69:

- Rinda's Lost Keys - Players between levels 1 and 11 may return to Dwarven Guard Rinda to receive an additional reward for this quest. Dwarven Guard Rinda will now give this reward as part of the quest.
Dwarven Guard Rinda says, "Greetings, and welcome to the dwarf town of Haggerfel. I wish I could stay and talk with you for a moment, but I am in a hurry to find my [lost keys]."

Dwarven Guard Rinda says, "Oh yes. It is dreadful that I was so careless as to lost them like this! You see, I am responsible for helping to lock the money the merchants bring in during the day into a large chest. I am the only one with the keys, and I have [misplaced them]."

Dwarven Guard Rinda says, "Oh, this makes me so angry! I have searched all around Haggerfel for them, but they are no where to be found. I don't suppose you would have a [little time] to help me out, would you?"
Dialog box: Will you help Rinda find her keys?
You have been given the Rinda's Lost Keys quest.

Dwarven Guard Rinda says, "Thank you! Thank you! I know there are some hobgoblins around that like to play jokes on people, viscious and mean ones. Why don't you check there while I check the merchant huts again?"
[Step #1] Search for a hobgoblin snake-finder around Haggerfel and see if it has Rinda's keys.
The hobgoblin snake-finder says, "Ha ha! Me no have keys! Feed to hungry bear! haha! You no help Rinda...Gold be ours!"
You receive a Iron Keychain from the hobgoblin snake-finder!
[Step #2] Look for the black mauler cub that ate Rinda's keys. Slay the beast and retrieve the keys for Rinda.
You receive a Rinda's Key from the black mauler cub!
[Step #3] Return the keys and keychain to Rinda in Haggerfel.
Dwarven Guard Rinda says, "I couldn't find them again in the village. Did you have better luck?"
Dwarven Guard Rinda says, "Oh my keychain. Well, this is a good start. But you didn't happen to find my key, did you?"
You are awarded 20 experience!
You are awarded 2 silver and some copper!

Dwarven Guard Rinda says, "Ah! This is great! My key! You have done a fabulous job in helping me. Please accept this coin in return for your time and effort. Thank you so much! Now, I can safely lock up the town's money. Thank you!"
You are awarded 20 experience!
You are awarded 2 silver and some copper!
You have finished the Rinda's Lost Keys quest.

midgard|sveabone hilt sword.Name: Sveabone Hilt Sword
midgard|sveabone hilt sword.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per patch 1.69:

- Sveabone Hilt Sword - Players between levels 1 and 11 that have completed this quest may now return to Gridash in East Svealand and receive money as part of the new reward for this quest. Gridash will now give money as part of the reward for this quest.

Talk to Gridash in Vasudheim he is located between buildings #1 and #7 via DAAtlas.com map. That is directly off the path leaving Vasudheim towards the road, and he will tell you about the sword. He will tell you to buy a bronze short sword and to get a sveabone tooth. The short sword can be bought from the local sword merchant named Gyda, who is located directly SW of the Jordheim bridge. And the tooth can come from any sveabone wolf, from baby cub to mother. Give him both and he gives you the sword.
Gridash says, "Hail young one! I have noticed that you do not carry one of my fine [bone hilt swords]."
Gridash says, "Aye! They are some of my finest works! I don't suppose you [would care for one] eh?"
Dialog box: Will you do what is asked so that Gridash can make a Sveabone hilt sword?
You have been given the Sveabone Hilt Sword quest.
Gridash says, "Oh great then! Run along and buy me a bronze short sword. I should be ready once you return."
[Step#1]Buy a bronze short sword and return it to Gridash
Gridash says, "Good work! I cannot seem to find anymore sveawolf teeth to fashion your weapon. Find one and return it to me."
[Step #2]Kill a sveawolf and return to Gridash with it's tooth.
Go kill any sveawolf, return with the tooth, should drop in your backpack with the first kill.
You receive a sveawolf tooth from the young sveawolf!
[Step #3]Return to Gridash in East Svealand with a sveawolf tooth.
You give Gridash the sveawolf tooth.
Gridash says, "Here is your completed work. I hope it serves you well!"
You receive a Sveabone Hilt Sword from Gridash!
You have finished the Sveabone Hilt Sword quest.
Reward:
Sveabone Hilt Sword

midgard|trapper's pride.Name: Trapper's Pride
midgard|trapper's pride.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Krek says, "Do you know that the famous trapper [Wariel] is here in town from Fort Atla?"
Krek says, "She is quite well known throughout the area and it would benefit you to [learn] the secrets of trapping."
Dialog box:
You have been given the Trapper's Pride quest.
Krek says, "Find Wariel and see if she would be willing to teach you a few secrets of trapping."
Wariel is located near the left bone crossing out of Galplen.
Wariel says, "Well hello young one. What is your [name]?"
Wariel says, "Well, it is a pleasure to meet you. I enjoy meeting all the young Vikings throughoout our [realm].
Wariel says, "Did you know that the [art] of trapping is very important here in Midgard, for everyone?"
Wariel says, "Yes, [trapping] is an art, the skinning of an animal, preserving the pelt and tanning it for use."
Wariel says, "Trapping and doing these things correctly can [fetch] you a good deal of popularity to traders and bring in a nice profit."
Wariel says, "Go in to woods and see if yo ucan capture fice tawny lynx cubs and bring their pelts to me so that I may prepare them."
Go kill 5 lynx bring back pelts...
Wariel says, "You have done a wonderful [job] and these pelts will work quite nicely."
Wariel says, "I shall begin preserving and tanning these skins shortly. Once they are finished tanning I may have another job for you."
You are awarded 42 copper!
You are awarded experience!
You have finished the Trapper's Pride quest.

midgard|trial of strength.Name: Trial of Strength
midgard|trial of strength.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Torold Sterkkriger says, "Hail. I am Torold, and I shall be your trainer in this wild land. King Goran Stonefist and his brother Stonelock have charged me with training all young Vikings to prepare them to join the ranks of King Goran's army to aid in the exploration of Aegir. Aegir is a wild, untamed place, and it's made even more dangerous for a your Viking like you by the presence of [Morvaltar]."

Torold Sterkkriger says, "As you may know, the Morvaltar are your wild cousins. We of Midgard do not fear Valkyn like you, for as a group you have more than proven your loyalty to King Goran. Many Valkyn have also proven that they are strong, intelligent, and brave. These are [the qualities] that all Vikings must possess before they can choose where their destiny lies."

Torold Sterkkriger says, "Now, young one, prepare yourself. You have three trials to face before I can allow you to make your destiny. These trials are designed to separate the true Vikings from the everyday Valkyn. So, prepare yourself now, for you trial is waiting for you. It is a test to [prove your strength]. Only the strongest will survive in this land."
Dialog box: Will you prove you have the strength to survive in the land of Aegir?
You have been given the Trial of Strength quest.
(I lost a screenie here...
[Step #1] Seek out Jorund Bruttstein in Aegirhamn. Tell him your name when he asks.
Turn around and you can't miss him, he's a big troll in green.
Jorund Bruttstein says, "Lo, I see a young Viking before me. What is your name? Speak up!"

Jorund Bruttstein says, "You are here to prove that you have the strength in you to endure in this land. The trial is simple in nature, but unless you are strong, may prove difficult to execute. You must venture out and face [one of the creatures] that roam this land."

Jorund Bruttstein says, "You must seek out a marine fungus. They may be found in the waters south and southwest of here. Find one and defeat it. Once you have, obtain proof that you have accomplished this test. Return to me here."
[Step #2] Obtain proof that you have defeated a marine fungus in combat. They can be found in the waters south of Aegirhamn as well as southwest of the city.
Cross the bridge, and these mushrooms with teeth and legs are located to your left from the bridge.
You receive a marine fungus root from marine fungus!
[Step #3] Return to Jorund Bruttstein in Aegirhamn.
Jorund Bruttstein says, "So, you managed to survive, but anyone can run away. Show me the proof you defeated the marine fungus."
[Step #4] Give Jorund the marine fungus root.

Jorund Bruttstein says, "Well done. I do not like to be so rough with young Vikings, but I must be. I do not want to see anyone die because I failed to do my job. But you have proven that you have the potential for great strength. I shall let your trainer know of your success."
You are awarded 2 silver and some copper!
You are awarded 20 experience!
You have finished the Trial of Strength quest.
Tell Jorund Bruttstein your name.

midgard|magnild's cure.Name: Magnild's Cure
midgard|magnild's cure.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Trainer says, "The girl Magnild is still very ill. Hopefully the healer [Kari] has had time to turn the snake venom onto a usable remedy."
Trainer says, "Go to Kari and see if she has completed the remedy to cure the girl."
Dialog box: Magnild is still ill. Hopefully Kari has prepared the potion
You have been given the Nagnild's Cure quest.
[Step #1] Speak to Kari and see if she has finished Magnild's remedy.
Kari says, "Hello again. You have come at exactly the [right time]."
Kari says, "I have been working with the snake venom now for several days, it was not easy to [brew] down."
Kari says, "However, I think I have finished the [remedy] for Magnild's bite."
Kari says, "Take it and deliver it to the girl quickly. The longer we wait the worse her condition becomes I'm afraid."
You receive a snake bite remedy from Kari!
[Step #2] Give the potion to Magnild before her illness gets worse.
You give the snake bite remedy to Magnild.
Magnild says, "Oh I have not been so [grateful] for a potion in all my days!"
Magnild says, "I have not felt myslef in so long time. Oh I hope this [asists me]."
Magnild says, "I must say that I am feeling a tad better already. I do not know how I can thank you, but I shall never forget your aid to me."
You are awarded 3 silver and some copper!
You are awarded 160 experience!
You have finished the Magnild's Cure quest

midgard|newfound group.Name: Newfound Group
midgard|newfound group.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Trainer says, "Have you met [Arni] yet?"
Dialog box: You have been offered the New Found Group quest.
You have been given the Newfound Group quest.
Trainer says, "Seek out Arni, for he is a good source of information in these parts, and a wonderful teacher."
[Step #1] Seek out Arni here in Fort Atla.
Arni says, "Good day my friend, can I help you?"
Arni says, "I see you have been sent here to [learn] my young friend."
Arni says, "Knowledge is the key that will unlock many doors for you. Understanding and knowing your surroundings is your ally and [teamwork] your backbone."
Arni says, "These are difficult times for our people and therefore you must understand that [camaraderie] between your fellows is very important."
Arni says, "Reach out to others. Form a grouping with one or more fellows and return to me once you have accomplished this."
[Step #2] Find another member of Midgard to assist in your quest, then return to Arni.
Arni says, "Welcome back, I see you have accomplished the [task] of forming a group."
Arni says, "Take your new found group into the countryside and look for the hobgoblin fish catchers and return to me with a token of the task set before you."
[Step #3] Seek out the Hobgoblin fish catchers in the surrounding area and bring back a token of the fight.
Hobgoblin fish-catchers are near the water just to the left outside of Fort Atla.
You receive a Fish bone from the hobgoblin fish-catcher!
[Step #4] Return to Arni with your battle party and token.
Arni says, "You and your partner have done well and hopefully learned an important lesson."
Arni says, "You must always remember that it is a party of like minds and goals that will accomplish much. Teamwork is our peoples best guarantee to a victory!"
You are awarded 40 experience!
You are awarded 1 silver and some copper!
You have finished the Newfound Group quest.

midgard|wealthy prospects.Name: Wealthy Prospects
midgard|wealthy prospects.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Pedra says, "(your name), good to see you. Are you looking for something to pass your time with? Perhaps you would be [interested] in aiding a friend of mine, then?"
Pedra says, "Aye. Bernt's his name, He's a bit of an explorer. He's got wind of some mineral deposits he would like to take a look at. He's always got a job for those looking to explore a bit."
Dialog box: Are you interested in exploring these lands for treasure?
You have been givem the Wealthy Prospects quest.
Pedra says, "Great! Go speak to Bernt. He'll set you up."
[Step #1] Talk to Bernt.
Bernt says, "Mystic, here to do some [exploring]?"

Bernt says, "Aye, I could use your aid, if you don't mind a bit of danger. You see, there's some minerals embedded in some rocks not too far from here. Now it's not a whole mine or anything, but I want to know what sort of mineral it is. There's one [problem]."

Bernt says, "Aye, there's some creatures about that make it hard to get to. Now, I'd go and fight off the creatures myself, but you know, I've got some work to do here, and really can't be bothered. That's why I'm [willing to pay] you."
[Step #2] Talk to Bernt.

Bernt says, "Ha! Of course I'm going to pay! I've been here long enough to know nobody's here for the pleasure of being here! Everyone wants something! Land! Treasure! Fame! Whatever it is. Well, are you [satisfied] I'll pay you?"
Bernt says, "There are some stray scimitar cubs near the mineral deposit. Remove the cubs to find the deposit. Many cuvs are found bsouthwest, just past the bridge."
[Step #3] There are some stray scimitar cubs near the mineral deposits. Remove the cubs to find the deposit. Many cubs are found southwest, just past the bridge.
Kill a cub and click to find the mineral.
You find a piece of mineralized rock and pick it up.
[Step #5] Bring the mineral deposit to Bernt.
Bernt says, "Ah, then did you find the thing I was looking for? Any of those rocks with those mineral bits on 'em?"
Give Bernt the mineralized rock.

Bernt says, "Great! I'm sure we can sort out what this is, and where we might find some more, if it proves to be any use! I've got a whole bunch of dwarven clans just eeking for a reason to come out here! If I can sell them on this area, I'll get a nice fee! Ah, but I promised you a fee as well, didn't I? Well then, I'll keep my word friend. Here you are! Good working with your Mystic."
You are awarded 7 silver and some copper!
You are awareded 22 experience!
You have finished the Wealthy Prospects quest.

midgard|aegan's letter to helen.Name: Aegan's Letter to Helen
midgard|aegan's letter to helen.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Your trainer tells you to go speak to Agean, who gives you the quest. Agean sends you to deliver a letter to his daughter, Helen, in Haggerfel.

midgard|bolli's leather supplies.Name: Bolli's Leather Supplies
midgard|bolli's leather supplies.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per patch 1.69:
- Bolli's Leather Supplies - Players between levels 3 and 13 may return to Bolli and receive an addiitonal reward for this quest. Bolli will now give out this reward as part of the quest.
Bolli says, "Greetings to you. I'm sure I've seen you before, but my memory isn't as great as it used to be, so you'll have to forgive me. Hehe [Mularn] sure is a nice place isn't it?"
Bolli says, "Ah, I've lived here nearly my entire life, well, most of it anyhow. Since my accident, though, I've had to take up another hobby besides adventuring. Did you know I do [leatherworking]?"
Bolli says, "Oh aye, I have become quite handy with a leather working tool. But alas, I seem to have [misplaced] it recently."

Bolli says, "I know...I know...I should have put it and my leather pieces away before heading to bed, but I just plain forgot! I don't suppose you could help a crippled old man [look] for it, can you?"
Dialog box: Will you fetch the items for Bolli?
You have been given the Bolli's Leather Supplies quest.
Bolli says, "Oh wonder of wonders! I shall indeed make it worth your time and effort. Now, the first item I am missing is my [skinning knife]."

Bolli says, "It is a wonderful knife, give to me as a present from a very old and sweet friend. I would be very appreciative if you could find it for me. I know there are creatures aroudn that like [shiny objects]."
Bolli says, "Hrm...Huldus come to mind. There are a bunch of them on a hill to the west, right outside of town. See if one of them has my knife."
[Step #1] Search the hills to the west of Mularn for a Huldu Lurker. See if the creature has Bolli's skinning knife.
Go and kill a Huldu Lurker.
You receive a Bolli's Skinning Knife from the huldu lurker!
[Step #2] Return Bolli's skinning knife to him in Mularn.
Bolli says, "My knife! Oh thank you! Now, I am in need of just one more thing, if you are [willing to get it]."
You are awarded 3 silver and some copper!
You are awarded 40 experience!

Bolli says, "I knew you would. I was using the shinbone of a rattling skeleton to smooth out my skins so I could start making my leather. THat is now gone also. I think the skeleton I took if from [took it back]."
Bolli says, "Honestly, I didn't know they would be so sensitive, but it was the perfect bone for the job. Please go out and get me another shinbone!"
[Step #3] Find a rattling skeleton outside of Mularn. Retrieve one of its shinbones for Bolli.
Kill any rattling skeleton.
[Step #4] Return the Shinbone to Bolli in Mularn.

Bolli says, "Ah! This will do nicely! I just hope its former owner doesn't come looking for it. hehe Anyhow, I thank you for your help in this matter, and maybe, in the future, I can show you some of my wares. Good luck in your travels!"
You are awarded 80 experience!
You are awarded 3 silver and some copper!
You have finished the Bolli's Leather Supplies quest.

midgard|mother dearest.Name: Mother Dearest
midgard|mother dearest.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Pedra says, "Have you met [Nibalk] yet>"
Pedra says, "Yes. He's a troll. He's also a bit of a spiritual leader in this area. He's working on the Valkyn [problem]."

Pedra says, "It seems the Mother, that old, vile diety that are worshipped by the more primitive of the Valkyn have begun to haunt them. The ones that have been here a while have been suffering terribly from lack of sleep. Perhaps you could help?"
Dialog box: Will you aid Nibalk, the town's spiritual leader in fighting the Mother?
You have been given the Mother Dearest quest.
Pedra says, "Ah a brave Mystic you are! Great! Go speak to Nibalk. He will tell you more."
[Step #1] Talk to Nibalk.

Nibalk says, "Oh. I have been greatly disturbed by the problems of the Valkyn. Now mind you, none of the recent explorers or adventures have suffered like the older Valkyn, but still. It has been rough. I have had to [meditate] for days."
Nibalk says, "Aye. It is not my nature to do so, but it had to be done. I finally had to beg for help from the [gods]."

Nibalk says, "Well, I certainly can't defeat a deity. Gazsi himself can't, though he is just as afflicted as the rest! He can't do the simplest tasks. The nightmares of the Mother has inflicted upon them all has made them [weak]."

Nibalk says, "Yes. Weak. But I have appealed to the gods, and as you are here, I can only think I have been answered. They have promised me their aid in defeating the Mother. But they have asked a small [price]."

Nibalk says, "They fell it is weakness that has allowed the Mother to enter the minds of the followers of the Norse gods, so we must prove our strength. If we prove our strength, than they will lend us theirs. So, I've a [challenge] for you."

Nibalk says, "This is not about brains, but strength. I need you defeat three naive sjoras. Bring me their ears, as proof. This will prove some strength, I think, to the gods that have answered me. Remember, return with three ears!"
[Step #3] Kill three naive sjoras. They can be found south, across the bridge.
Go and kill three naive sjoras.
[Step #4] Return all three sjora ears to Nibalk.
Nibalk says, "Well then, did you get the ears? Ah good deal then. Hand them in. One at a time."
Nibalk says, "Ah good. Two more then."
Nibalk says, "Well, one more, friend."

Nibalk says, "Great! The gods should be pleased! Now, if you'll excuse me, I must place these in an area blessed by the gods. Tonight, well, tonight all should get a good night's rest! Ah, but here, let me give you some coin for your troubles."
You are awarded 88 experience!
You are awarded 10 silver and some copper!
You have finished the Mother Dearest quest.

midgard|trial of bravery.Name: Trial of Bravery
midgard|trial of bravery.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Torold Sterkkriger says, "Well, you have done well. You passed the trial of strength without difficulty, and Idena spoke of your intelligence in dealing with those riddles. I myself have solved them, so I know what they are like. I'm glad you did well, for now it is time to face the [third and final trial]."

Torold Sterkkriger says, "The kast trial you will face will prove your bravery. If you pass this trial, you will have shown that you have the potential to survive in the wilds of Aegir. Are [you ready] to face this third trial?"
Dialog box: Will you face the trial of bravery?
You have been given the Trial of Bravery quest.
Torold Sterkkriger says, "Then you must go speak to Rania. She is one of the Valkyn that has been involved in training many young Vikings since she came to Aegirhamn. She is expecting you."
[Step #1] Go to Rania on Aegirhamn.

Rania says, "Hello. I have been expecting you. You have passed teh first two trials, but strength and brains mean nothing if you flee at the first sign of danger. The Morvaltar are not a group to run. They will fight to the death. I have seen a single Morvalt face [a hundred men] and not flee. Now, I'm not saying that Morvalt wasn't scared, but he was able to stand his ground."

Rania says, "Oh fear not, we shall not send you against a hundred men! You only need to face two. There are creatures called naive sjora. They can be fierce when engaged in combat. I want you to face two naive sjora. I will need proof that you defeated them and didn't run from combat. Naive sjora wear shell necklaces. I want you to get one of those. Also. when naive sjora die, they will often utter some words. You must listen to them and remember that word. Once you have both, return to me here. I wish you luck!"
[Step #2] Defeat a naive sjora and get the shell necklace it carries. They live along the coast south of the bridge on the west side of Aegirhamn.
You receive a sjora shell necklace from the naive sjora!
[Step #3] Defeat a naive sjora to learn the words Rania wants. They live along the coast south of the bridge on the west side of Aegirhamn.
Pop up box: Til sjoen!
[Step #4] Return to Rania in Aegirhamn.
Rania says, "Welcome back. Please give me the sjora shell necklace."
[Step #5] Give Rania the sjora shell necklace.
You give Rania the sjora shell necklace.
Rania says, "Now for the tricky part of the trial. You can obtain the necklace from others, but the words are for your ears alone. Tell me what they are."
[Step #6]Say the words [til sjoen] to Rania.
You say, "Til sjoen!"

Rania says, "Very good! You have passed all three trials! Here, take this to help you prepare to meet the trainers who will continue to guide you towards your destiny. I shall let Torold know you passed the final trial. Well done!"
You are awarded 2 silver and some copper!
You are awarded 44 experience!
You have finished the Trial of Bravery quest.

midgard|knowledge of the gods.Name: Knowledge of the Gods
midgard|knowledge of the gods.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Your trainer sends you to inquire to each of your respective future guildmasters about the gods. Once you reach level 5 you will choose which god you want to follow.

midgard|rogue trainer.Name: Rogue Trainer
midgard|rogue trainer.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Jucla says, "As a Rogue there are [two houses] from which you can choose on your path, the gods to choose from are Loki and Skadi."
Dialog box: You are tasked to learn about the gods!
You have been given the Rogue Trainer quest.
Jucla says, "The gods to [choose] from are Loki and Skadi and the Great House of the Jotun."
[Step #1] Speak to Jucla about your choice in houses.
Jucla says, "If you wish to learn of Loki seek out Boidoc here in Fort Atla."
[Step #2] Find Boidoc and learn of Loki and the Great House of the Jotun.
Boidoc says, "Greetings, I see Jucla has sent you to me to learn of [Loki]."

Boidoc says, "You can join the House of Loki. He is the giant of fire and the great trickster. If you choose to follow Loki you will become a shadowblade. You will follow his example and become a member of the [Great House of Jotun]."
Boidoc says, "The Great House of Jotun is made up of the gods living in Jotunheim, home of the Giants. If ever you wre to go to Jotunheim, you would find [Skadi] dwelling there."
Boidoc says, "To learn more about Skadi seek out Budo here in Fort Atla."
[Step #3] Find Budo and learn of Skadi and the Great House of the Jotun.
Budo says, "Greetings, I see Jucla has sent you to me to learn of [Skadi]."
Budo says, "Skadi is the giantess of the hunt. She was greatly beloved by both Aesir and Jotun. She is of the [Great House of the Jotun]."

Budo says, "The Great House of Jotun is made up of the gods living in Jotunheim, home of the Giants. Once you have grown stronger, and a bit wiser, return to your trainer. You must then choose which of the gods to follow."
You are awarded 8 silver and some copper!
You are awarded 400 experience!
You have finished the Rogue Trainer quest.

midgard|tric's lost list.Name: Tric's Lost List
midgard|tric's lost list.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per patch 1.69:
- Tric's Lost List - Players between levels 4 and 14 may return to Tric and receive an additional reward for this quest. Tric will now give out this reward as part of the quest.

Tric, (In building #1, on the daatlas.com map; loc= 54327, 15799) is a Kobold in Vasudheim and was attacked by a goblin called Gib. Gib stole his list of spells and would like them back. Gib is on the hill on the left when leaving Vasudheim and normally has a henchman or two. The reward for the return of the list is silver and experience. This is good for all classes, and levels higher than 4 will kill Gib in one hit.
You may have to talk to Barkeep Banak to start this quest. He is located at #3 on daatlas.com map for Jordheim.
Barkeep Banak says, "Tric is going on about his lost book! Something must be done!"
Tric says, "You look the friendly sort. Perhaps you [can help] me?"
Tric says, "I lost my [book of spells] in a battle. I am in no condition to recover it."

Tric says, "It was a battle against a great goblin called Gib and his followers. The rest of my party was slain in battle. I was wounded and forced to retreat to this town. If you could [recover it] I would be grateful."
Tric says, "Many thanks. To find the place we battled, follow the road out of this town until you reach the main road. Turn left and continue for a few paces. You should notice them."
Dialog box: Do you accept the Tric's Lost List quest?
You have been given the Tric's Lost List quest.
Tric says, "Keep your eyes west of the road to ensure reinforcements do not flank you."
[Step #1] Locate and slay Gib along with his followers. He was last seen around the left fork of the main road.
From Vasudheim, Gib is on the road past the Thrall Keeper, loc=36286, 9436 to the right on a hill.
You receive a Tric's Spellbook from Gib!
[Step #2]Return the book to Tric.
Tric says, "You are truly well trained! Fare-thee-well in your future travels."
You are awarded experience!
You are awarded 1 silver and some copper!
You have finished the Tric's Lost List quest.
Reward:
Dull Black Gem

midgard|venture to gotar.Name: Venture to Gotar
midgard|venture to gotar.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Krek (Viking trainer) will send you to Fort Atla in Gotar. You must speak with Hyndia (Seer trainer), she is in the first building on the left as you enter. To go from Galplen to Fort Atla, easiest way is to grab a horse in Galplen which stops in Fort Atla.

midgard|tomte jerkin.Name: Tomte Jerkin
midgard|tomte jerkin.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Gwaell, in Audliten, can make you a Tomte Jerkin if you bring her 3 tomte bracers, which are dropped by tomtes in the camp in East Svealand.
Gwaell says, "Do you have [a moment]?"
Gwaell says, I've notived you do not have one of my [tomte jerkins] on you."
Gwaell says, "I have learned how to craft them from a few [tomte bracers]."
Gwaell says, "Yes, the jerkin requires a total of three tomte bracers in order to have enough material to create. You show interest in this object. Would you like me to [craft one] for you?"
Gwaell says, "Very well then, find three of these bracers and return them to me."
Bracers only drop from Tomte thugs and you can still do this quest if the thugs are gray.
Your reward is a Tomte Jerkin
Rewards:
Tomte Jerkin
Tomte Tunic

midgard|hole of the dead.Name: Hole of the Dead
midgard|hole of the dead.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This is a Dwarven only quest.

Frimeth in Vasudheim is concerned about a hole that opened up in the earth, sucking in the lifeforce of fellow dwarves, leaving them mere animated skeletons. He can use the dust of their bones to fashion you an item.
Frimeth says, "Your assistance [is needed]!"
Frimeth says, "A [scourge] has presented itself at a location not far from here."
Frimeth says, "Aye! Tis a place where many of my kind have met their deaths... [A hole] in the bottom the earth that sucks the last bit of life from all dwarves who fall dead upon its barren ground."
Frimeth says, "Beware [the hole's power], for should you fall dead yourself you may rise up as one of it's minions."
Frimeth says, "I could tap this power for you and [fashion an item] of great use. That is if you are brave enough to meet this terror."
Frimeth says, "Aye! If you could bring me [dust] from one of the [dwarven skeletons] which walks there, I will create it for you."
Frimeth says, "This dust can only be taken while you wield the gift bestowed to you by your house."
Dialog box: Do you accept the Hold of the Dead quest?
You have been given the Hold of the Dead quest.

Frimeth says, "Aye, the evil lay not far from the main road. Look in the mountains to the west soon after day turns to night. Wield your house gift now and go seek the skeletons, or [tell me] if you need a new one."
Frimeth says, "Perhaps you should check your backpack. I think I see your house gift sticking out of the top of it."
And if you do not have your "house gift" Frimeth will give you a new one. =)
[Step #1] Slay a dwarf bone skeleton while wearing your House gift. The evil lay not far from the main road. Look in the mountains to the west soon after day turns to night.

The Dwarven Bone Skeletons spawn at night in a depression off the main road. When coming from Vasudheim, at the crossroad going to Mularn and Audliten, keep going straight west. The depression is very specific and contains fragile skeletons (which you can find all over the area at night) and Dwarven Bone. Not all bone skeletons drop the dust.

There's another camp near Fort Atla that has Dwarven Bone Skeletons at night, along Seikothna Initiates. Those skeletons also seem to have dust (when fighting them normally, you sometimes get a message that the bones turn into dust).
You receive a dwarven skeleton dust from the dwarf bone skeleton!
[Step #2] Return the dust to Frimeth in Vasudheim.
Frimeth says, "You have returned to us, and in good order! Have you brought with you the dust of a dwarven skeleton?"
You give Frimeth the dust of a dwarven skeleton.
Frimeth says, "You have done well. Here is the reward I have promised you! Fare-thee-well in the rest of your travels."
You receive Dwarven Boots of Air from Frimeth!
You have finished the Hole of the Dead quest.
Reward:
Dwarven Glima -- Berserker, Skald, Thane, Warrior
Gloves of the Eternal -- Healer and Runemaster
Dwarven Boots of Air -- Hunter
Rewards:
Dwarven Glima
Dwarven Boots of Air
Gloves of the Eternal

midgard|simple misgivings.Name: Simple Misgivings
midgard|simple misgivings.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Hilde, located in Haggerfel wants you to find Quirk, an ex-apprentice Huldu, because he stole her plans for a new forge. Directions: Quirk is located in a Huldu camp west of Mularn. Folloy the west path out of Mularn until you reach a fork. Turn right at that fork and you will be able to see the camp. Quirk is level six as far as I know. I fought him once and he was green to my level 8.
Hilde says, "Quirk was always getting himslef into trouble or causing trouble. They nearly [ran me out of town]!"
Hilde says, "You know, it used to be that people around here were pretty much open to anything and anyone until rumors came in about the Blodfelag."
Hilde says, "Then no one around here wanted to be seen with anyone other than [their own kind] which is absolutely silly if you ask me. But perhaps I'm just rambling now."
You have been given the Simple Misgivings quest.

Hilde says, "You see, Quirk was a huldu. He is smarter than most of those silly creatures outside the village, but still a huldu. He helped me in [quite a few tasks], but others didn't like him around because he like to cause a little trouble."
Hilde says, "He helped me in crafting armor and weapons as well as planning out the design I had for a [new forge]."
Hilde says, "The other towns people tried to run us out of town, but at the time I didn't want to [lose my job] so I told Quirk he should leave."
Hilde says, "The little bugger stole my plans and took off with them. Last I saw he was heading back towards the huldu camp. Haven't seen him since. Please find him and try to get my plans back."
[Step #2] Find Quirk and get the forge plans back.
Kill Quirk, who is located in a huldu camp West of Haggerfel. This is not just near Haggerfel, it is quite a walk.
You receive the forge plans from Quirk.
[Step #3] Bring the forge plans back to Hilde in Haggerfel.
You hand Hilde the forge plans.
Hilde says, "Wonderful! Now I can begin work on my newly designed forge. You have done a great job my friend."
You are awarded 5 silver and some copper!
You are awarded experience!
You have finished the Simple Misgivings quest.

midgard|svartmoln's appetite.Name: Svartmoln's Appetite
midgard|svartmoln's appetite.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Kyba, in Vasudheim next to the Healer, will give you a pair of boots if you bring her the hide of the bear Svartmoln. He spawns near the bridge. Kill him and bring back his fur and he will give you a reward, class specific of course.
Kyba says, "You help [Kyba and village]?"
Dialog box: Kill Svartmoln, bring back hide?
You have been given the Svartmoln's Appetite quest.
Kyba says, "You waste much time. Svartmoln eat many crabs, many more fishermen. Leave. No come back until have Svartmoln's hide."
[Step #1] Kill Svatmoln. Svartmoln roams near the bridge.
Svartmoln spawns in the water near the wall, he walks towards the bridge and past it and eventually goes to kill crabs on other side of beach. He conned yellow and orange at level 6.
Svartmoln growls in pain.
[Step #2] Bring hide back to Kyba.
Kyba says, "Where Svartmoln hide?"
Kyba says, "You kill Svartmoln. Village honor you. Kyba honor you. Here, take this gift that Kristen, the Norse woman, fashion for you."
You receive Light Bear-hide Boots from Kyba!
You are awarded 1 silver and some copper!
You have finished the Svartmoln's Appetite quest.

I found the bear at loc 59241,20752. He was heading NWN...to my surprise, I was expecting him to go the other way according the all the instructions. The second time he spawned he was heading a SES direction and was coming from a completely opposit direction(???) Somewhere I read that the bear only spawn during the daytime and I caught him just when the sky was darkening. It was 18h when I found him strolling towards me the first time and 23h the second time.
So in brief:
-he spawn on Jordheim side of the river.
-he can spawn at night
-he wasn't in the water but on land
-it appears that he might have 2 spawn points or he walks SES direction first then heads back. So basically he passes the bridge twice.

-first time I saw the bear, he walked right up to the guards at the Binding Stone and died, and the second time he was swimming on the Vaseudheim side of the bridge and was about to take the same route to the bind stone
Rewards:
Bear-hide Boots
Light Bear-hide Boots

midgard|troubled wild.Name: Troubled Wild
midgard|troubled wild.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Erekith in Vasudheim pays 60 copper for 3 wildling ears. The wildlings are located on the road west out of town, not far from town.

midgard|brutal chains.Name: Brutal Chains
midgard|brutal chains.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per patch 1.69:

- Brutal Chains - Players between levels 4 and 14 may return to the Thrall Keeper and receive an additional reward for this quest. The Thrall Keeper will now give out this reward as part of the quest.
You can only receive this quest at level 4.
Kill escaped thralls and bring the chains they drop to the slaver in Vasudheim. He rewards you for every 3 chains you bring him.
Make sure you are looking for "thrall keeper" loc=42300,7908,4548 for this quest
Barkeep Kanar says, "I hear that a thrall keeper just outside of Vasudheim has run into a bit of trouble. You might want to see what all the fuss is about."
The Thrall Keeper says, "Well met stranger, I am glad you have takedn the time to speak to me. I have need of your skills if you [have the time]."
The Thrall Keeper says, "My comrade, Jierec and I were on our way to Mularn when the thralls [revolted and escaped]."
The Thrall Keeper says, "Aye! I was feeling ill and three of them fell upon us while we were preoccupied. Jierec left me here with the remaining thrall and [went in search] of the rest."
The Thrall Keeper points to the hut just across the road.
The Thrall Keeper says, "He has yet to return from the hut over there. I fear he has [met his fate] and traveled beyond this life."
The Thrall Keeper says, "I would not ask you to return them alive, yet if you could assist and return to me [their chains] I would be most grateful."
Dialog box: Do you accept the Brutal Chains quest?
You have been given the Brutal Chains quest.
The Thrall Keeper says, "Three chains should be enough to show my master of their revolt."
[Step #1] Locate the escaped thralls and obtain their chains.
The escaped thralls are located across the road in a hut next to the water.
The escaped thrall says, "No prison can keep me!!!"
The escaped thrall says, "Let my actions in this life be forgotten!"
[Step #2] Return the chains to the Thrall Keeper.
The Thrall Keeper says, "Thank you, you have done well. I will tell my master of your assistance and how well you performed it."
You are awarded experience!
You are awarded 1 silver and some copper!
You have finished the Brutal Chains quest.
Reward:
Old Svarskodd Leggings

midgard|defeat the hobgoblin anklebiter.Name: Defeat the Hobgoblin Anklebiter
midgard|defeat the hobgoblin anklebiter.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: You can get the first part at level 8, and the second at level 10. The hobgoblin Carr (located at a tree stump at 46389, 50555) wants to help out his newly adopted people and fears foul play from his kind.
*Please note that all can do this quest, but not all can wear the reward item.
Carr says, "I leave hobgoblins. Me no like hobgoblins! Carr stay here in Mularn now!"
Carr says, "Smyga and Anklebiter [terrible mean] hobgoblin, always on raids. I don't like what they do anymore so I stay here."
Carr says, "Is a frightening time! Scared of the [Hobgoblin Anklebiter]!"
Carr says, "Anklebiter mean Lieutenant to Smyga. Smyga and Anklebiter [planning something awful] they are."
