Carr says, "No, am scared of plans Anklebiter may carry out [in Smyga's orders]."
Carr says, "Yes! Can find the Anklebiter in the Hobgoblin Camp. Anklebiter always carry out orders. Bring Smyga's Orders from Anklebiter."
Carr says, "Yes! Kill Anklebiter and bring the orders to me."

Ankelbiter is in the Hobgoblin camp between Mularn and Haggerfel, loc of 39575, 31328. You will need to kill off other hobgoblins to get Anklebiter to spawn. After you kill Anklebiter, you will get Smyga's orders. Take these back to Carr and he will tell you that you must kill Smyga in order to protect the village.
You receive a Smyga's orders from Anklebiter!
Your standing with Clan Smyg has decreased.
Your standing with the Vendo has decreased.
Your standing with the Hidden People has increased.

midgard|mucking through the ick.Name: Mucking Through the Ick
midgard|mucking through the ick.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per Patch 1.59:

- Mucking Through the Ick: Savages and Bonedancers have been receiving the wrong rewards for this quest. Savages who received the Silkstand Belt (+2 power) can take it to Belyria in Haggerfel and exchange it for the Hardened Silkstrand Belt. Bonedancers who received the Hardened Silkstrand Belt (+HPs) and would prefer the Silkstrand Belt (+power) can also speak to Belyria and exchange their belt. Players must have completed the Mucking Through the Ick quest and have the belt with them to exchange it. The exchange may only be done once.
Per Read File Feb. 24, 2003:

Got a read file note for you - a continuation of the earlier note about the Mucking Through the Ick quest: "Players stuck without the note to Garon can return to Yver in Haggerfel, target him, and /say "Garon" to get a new note."
Per Read File Feb. 26, 2003:
Players stuck on step 1 of the Midgard Quest "Mucking Through the Ick" need to speak to Yver about [Garon].
The following dialogue is just one scenario, see steps for more information. You have the possibility to get any version.
Barkeep Nognar says, Yver was recently hurt and needs someone to help him with some tasks. You should seek him out in Haggerfel and offer your services.
Then talk to an Npc called Yver Tiu, near the entrance of the city, turn right as soon as you enter, he is right there. He is studying spiders. Your quest will differ depending on your class.

Yver Tiu says, "Ah, you have never heard of us? We are rather small, I admit, but our work is very serious, I assure you! In fact, I am in the process of studying a specific spider as we speak! Have you ever heard of the [Ickerius] spider?"

Yver Tiu says, "The Ickerius arachnid, also known as the Ick spider, is a small tree spider, roughly three feet in length with a yellow tinge to it's body. Truly a marvelous creature, one we're lucky to have found. It's [silk] is used to make some of our fishing nets."

Yver Tiu says, "Some of the strongest silk comes from the Ick spider. Amazing, really, that such a small creature can produce something of such quality and strength. I was wondering, since you are here, would you care to run an errand for me?"
Dialog box...
You have been given the Mucking through the Ick quest.
You are awarded 5 silver and some copper!

Yver Tiu says, "Ah so kind of you. I was bitten the other day by a female juvenile red-back, and while I was able to treat myself with an antivenom I made, I'm not still feeling all that well. Could you run to Audliten and retrieve the silk for me from [Garon]?"
You receive a note to Garon from Yver Tiu!
[Step #1] Travel to Audliten in East Svealand and speak with Garon. He has the silk for Yver. Give him the note when he asks.
Garon says, "Greetings friend! Welcome to Audliten, though you seem to be a more seasoned traveler, I'm sure no introduction is needed for our fair town. What brings you to Audliten today?"
You hand Garon the note from Yver Tiu.
Garon reads the note carefully.

Garon says, "Ah, from Yver! Excellent. I see he's been bitten by a female red-back. Terrible lot that. It's good that's he's been able to treat the wound though, they can be deadly. One moment please."
You receive spider silk from Garon!
You are awarded experience!
You are awarded 5 silver and some copper!

Garon says, "Here you are friend. I've managed to pull the strands apart for easier inspection of the individual strands. I'm sure Yver will appreciate that. Make sure to keep it flat, or they will bunch. Here is some of my research. Please give it to Yver."
You receive a sealed scroll from Garon!
[Step #2]Give the silk to Yver
Yver Tiu says, "Ah, this silk looks very nice. Did he happen to have any notes on where he found it or anything?
[Step #3]Give the scroll to Yver.

Yver Tiu says, "Ah, his notes, excellent! Oh ho! What have we here? Possible magic properties within the silk? Excellent! But, that means that we have more [work] ahead of us to protect and scrye out why this silk is magical."
*Step 4 is different depending on class!
*For Spiritmasters and Thanes*

Yver Tiu says, "Aye friend, more work! While you were gone, I read more of Garon's letter. He said there was a small nest of baby spiders on the wooded isle near Audliten. There is something [preying] on them."

Yver Tiu says, "Aye friend. They upset the balance of nature. You should hurry to Audliten at once. There you will find a small wooded isle. On the isle are the plague rats. Kill them and return to me when you are finished."
[Step #4]Travel to Audliten. Find the wooded isle near there and slay the plague rats that prey upon the baby spiders.

Go towards Audliten and before you get there, there is a spot where the water comes close to the road. Turn 30 degrees to the left and there is a wooded isle. Baby spiders and Plague rats are at approximate location of 27666, 19873.
Upon you setting foot on the isle, the spiders and rats will spawn. There are about 4 rats and 8 spiders.
The plague rat hisses as it falls to the ground dead.
*For Beserkers*
Step 4: You receive an egg sack and a ticket to Vasudheim. Take the egg sack to Darrius in Ft Atla where you receive a note and a ticket to Mularn. Also get 15 silver, some copper and xp.
*For Thanes, Skalds, Warriors, Healers, and Shamans*

Step 4 -- You receive 3 beetles to feed the spiders, find 3 wolf spiderlings near Fort Veldon and feed them. To feed wolf spiderlings -- it says they are outside Ft Veldon but continues with info about south on the road from Haggerfel. Ignore everything except info about Ft. Veldon. The nest can be found just north of the fort, just behind the Stable Master. (They are not wolves but small spiders.)
*Conclusion*
[Step #5]Return to Yver in Haggerfel. Tell him you have [completed the task].
You say, "I have completed the task."
Yver Tiu says, "Welcome back friend! I'm glad to see you in one piece. I hope you don't mind, but I have one more task for you to do for me. I hope you're [up for it]!"

Yver Tiu says, "Excellent! Remember the ickerius spider I told you about earlier? Well, it seems there's one that roams about in Gotar! We need this specimen for study! The locals have called it [Ick], apparently, ickerius is too hard for them to pronounce."

Yver Tiu says, "Aye, the ickerius spider is a nasty spider. Be careful, it has a powerful bite. I can give you directions. Travel to Nalliten, from there, go south on the road. When you reach the fork, go southeast over the bridge. He is near the mountain."
[Step #6]Travel to Gotar and seek out the ickerius spider the locals call Ick. From Nalliten, go south, then southeast over the bridge. He is close to the mountain's base.
His loc is approxiamtely 47250, 59500. I had to kill 3 of the normal spiders before he spawned. He does roam a little so you may have to look around for him.
You receive an Ickerius spider body from Ick.
[Step 7] Return the Ickerious spider to Yver in Haggerfel.
Yver Tiu says, "Ah ha! You're back! Excellent! Do you have the specimen for me?
You hand Yver Tiu the Ickerius spider body.
Yver does a cursory exam of the ickerius body before putting it in a large bag he has at his side.
Yver Tiu says, "Excellent work my friend! Excellent work! Here, I think you'll appreciate this fine token of my [sincere gratitude] for all your hard work."

Yver Tiu says, "Here you are friend. I had my compatriot, Averrius, look over the silk. He said it had properties that would benefit someone like you. I hope you can use it for some time to come. Again, I think you for all your hard work!"
You receive a Silkstrand Belt from Yver Tiu!
You are awarded experience!
You are awarded 15 silver and some copper!
You have finished the Mucking through the Ick quest.
This is not a cross realm quest for Mordred and Gaharis. Midgard classes only.
Rewards:
Hardened Silkstrand Belt
Silkstrand Belt

midgard|sveawolf guardian.Name: Sveawolf Guardian
midgard|sveawolf guardian.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Barkeep Alaka says, "Hello, do you seek [adventure]?"
Barkeep Alaka says, "A strange Sveawolf has been seen in the hills above the town of Huginfell."
Talk to the Elder Sveawolf (Loc: 61312, 55636) which is located on the side of a hill directly SE from Huginfell. You must right click him.

Find the wounded Sveawolf (Loc: 42362, 51283) across the road from the Svartalf camp, and behind a tree. It is the SW road that runs out of Huginfell. I found the wounded sveawolf across the road from the camp hidding behind some bushes. It was named wounded Sveawolf. You have right click her twice, once to get her attention then sceond to let the wolf smell your scent. Then quickly give it the herbs. Then return to the Elder sveawolf. Unfortunately, you are only rewared with experience for this quest.
The elder sveawolf says, "Do not be afraid. I am speaking directly into your mind. Can you hear my [thoughts]?"
The Sveawolf gazes intently at you.

The elder sveawolf says, "Most two-leggers would have attacked me. You have shown great wisdom by not doing so, for I would have had to put you down. My clan feels all two-leggers are untrustworthy and ruthless slayers of all life. I feel that that if our kinds are to have peace between us, this must be changed. Would you be willing to help me [improve relations] between our kinds?"

The elder sveawolf says, "Perhaps the goddess has shined on us. One of my kind has sent message that she has been wounded and in need of aid. The nearby pointed ears have her cornered. Would you [give aid to her]?"
Dialog box: Find the wounded Sveawolf and feed her the herb, then return to the Elder Sveawolf.
You have been given the Sveawolf Guardian quest.
The elder sveawolf says, "First rub your hands through my fur to take up my scent and take these [herbs]."
The Elder Sveawolf opens his jaws and drops some herbs in your hand.
You receive a foul-smelling herbs from the elder sveawolf.

The elder sveawolf says, "These herbs will not work on your kind in case you are wondering. Take them and you will find her on the hard traveling path that leads from your haunted town. She is near the pointed ears den. Approach her slowly. She is wounded and will strike out at you if she doesn't know your scent. Allow her to smell my scent on you, then feed her the herbs. Make sure she leaves the area. Then return here so we may speak again. Go now and may the goddess light your path."
[Step #2] Find the wounded Sveawolf near the pointed ears den. See if she will interact with you.
The Sveawolf growls deeply at then lifts her nose to the air. She then looks at your hand.
The Sveawolf gingerly sniffs your hand as she watched your every move. She may attack at any second. Perhaps feeding her might relax her.
The Sveawolf gently eats the herbs out of your hand and is healed. She slowly stands and leaps off into the forest with a slight growl.
[Step #5] Return to the Elder Sveawolf
The elder sveawolf says, "Ah you have returned. Good work. Perhaps this will be a step forward between our two clans. May the goddess shine favorably on you."
You are awarded experience!
You have finished the Sveawolf Guardian quest.

midgard|bluebell's disappearance.Name: Bluebell's Disappearance
midgard|bluebell's disappearance.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per patch 1.69:
- Bluebell's Disappearance - Players between levels 4 and 14 may return to Guard Eske and receive an additional reward for this quest. Guard Eske will now give out this reward as part of the quest.
Dwarven Guard Eske says, "A good hardy welcome to you. I am Eske, one of the
local guards here in Audilten. It's good to see some sturdy fold come
through here. Hehe. I don't suppose you've come here for a little
[adventure], have you?"
Dialog box: Would you help Dwarven Guard Eske find information on Bluebell's disappearance? (sic)
You have been given the Bluebell's Disappearance quest.
Dwarven Guard Eske says, "Well! Just my luck, and yours too, then. I am
missing something very important to me. Perhaps you can [find her]."
Dwarven Guard Eske says, "Now, don't laugh at me when I tell you my story,
alright? You see, I am a tough and rough dwarven guard. I've seen my share
of trouble, made my share of trouble, and killed more Albions and Hibernians
than you can count to! But I have a [pet]."
Dwarven Guard Eske says, "This is no ordinary pet, as we hardly live in an
ordinary land! I have a bird, a special bird, one I rescued after a large
Hibernian raid on our fair land. We managed to chase off the invaders and
while I was helping to tend the wounded, I [saw her]."
Dwarven Guard Eske says, "She had been struck down by a filthy ranger's bow.
Her wing was torn in two, and she was hoping furiously on the ground. She
was so sad looking that it touched my stone heart. I scooped her up and made
a soft place for her in my [pack]."
Dwarven Guard Eske says, "When I returned to Jordheim and was awaiting my new orders, I nursed her back to health. She stayed with me everywhere I
went. She was a beautiful color blue, like the ocean! I called her
[Bluebell]."
Dwarven Guard Eske says, "I tried to release Bluebell into the wild many
times before my transfer was in order, but she would only look at me
confused. She was my favorite thing ever! But when I came to Audliten
[disaster] stuck!"

Dwarven Guard Eske says, "I had let Bluebell out for her morning flying, and she never came back. I fear something dreadful has happened to her, and I am very upset. But I can?t leave my post to search for her. Could you please help me find my [lost Bluebell]?"
Dwarven Guard Eske says, "Many thanks to you. To the east of here is where
she flew off to. I know there is a nasty smiera-gatto that lurks around
there. If she has indeed perished, please return her remains to me."
[Step #1] Look for the smiera-gatto that lurks near the trees Bluebell flew
to. Slay the beast and see if it killed Blue bell
Go east and kill the first Smiera-gatto you find. Any Smiera-gatto will do, they are all over the land.
You receive a Bluebird's Remains from the Smiera-gatto!
[Step #2] Return the remains of Bluebell to Guard Eske in Audliten.
You give Bluebird's Remains to Dwarven Guard Eske.
You are awarded 160 experience!
You are awarded 4 silver and some copper!
Dwarven Guard Eske says, "Oh, my beautiful Bluebell. How I will miss her! At least now I know what has happened to her. Thank you. Can you do me one last [favor]?"
Dwarven Guard Eske says, "Trapper Jora had been working on a special
ornamental box I could keep Bluebell in when I traveled. I think I will use
it now to bury her in. Could you please take this note to Jora and get the
box for me? I will be here when you return."
You receive a note for Trapper Jora from Dwarven Guard Eske!
[Step #3] Take Ekse's note to Trapper Jora in Audliten.
Trapper Jora says, "Greetings, what can I do for you?"
Trapper Jora says, "I see. This is terribly sad news. I know Eske was very
attached to the bird. Ah, such is the way of nature. Here, take this box
back to him so he may give Bluebell the burial she deserves."
You receive a Ornamental Blue box from Trapper Jora!
You give the Ornamental Blue Box to Dwarven Guard Eske.
Dwarven Guard Eske says, "My thanks to you, for helping me with this. I am
glad to know what has happened to my Bluebell. I will bury her behind
Audliten this eve. Please take this coin as a token of my gratitude to you.
Good luck in your future journeys."
You are awarded 160 experience!
You are awarded 4 silver and some copper!
You have finished the Bluebell's Disappearance quest.
Reward:
Snake-tail Ring (Mid)

midgard|a deed of old.Name: A Deed of Old
midgard|a deed of old.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Denise says, "A troll in Audliten who goes by the name of Aleaniver, is spreading tales of a great beast! Joining the hunt might prove your worth!"

The reward for this quest varies depending upon your class. Aleaniver, who is located in the town of Audliten in front of the building southwest of the bridge, asks you to kill the wolf Morra. He spawns up the coast near a shipwreck just past the tomte camp and is usually in a pack with several seawolf mothers, so you may want to bring friends. Kill him and bring back proof (dead Morra hide) to Aleaniver for your reward.
Rewards:
Studded Hide of Morra
Skullbone Brooch of Morra
Paw of Morra
Tail of Morra
Boneclaw Ring of Morra
Omni Hunting Gauntlets (Mid)

midgard|copious striders.Name: Copious Striders
midgard|copious striders.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to Alomali (listed between #5 and #6 on the daatlas.com map) in Vasudheim standing under a tree near the water. He will tell you to swim out to the island behind him (it is a barren sand island with a single runestone on it) and fetch him a water strider leg. Doing so gets you a some money and XP. Two further notes. First, be careful on the island, rock crabs are lethal at this level. Alomali's dialogue hints at further quests from him at later levels.
Alomali says, "Hail to thee. I seem to be in a [bit of a snitch]."
Alomali says, "My master has asked of me [a deed] I cannot complete."
Alomali says, "Aye! He asks the impossible! He wishes me to travel to [Striders' Isle] and return to him t he leg of one of [the beasts] there."
Alomali says, "It is the island behind me. A solitary rune stone stands there."
Alomali says, "There are these spider-like beasts that inhabit the island. Their legs are [of great use] to those in my practice."
Dialog box: Do you accept the Copius Striders quest?
You have been given the Copious Striders quest.
Alomali says, "If you could bring back to me on of these legs I would be forever in your debt!"
[Step #1]
Seek out and slay a water strider.
[Step #2] Return the strider leg to Alomali
Give Alomali the strider leg.

Alomali says, "Ah! Thank you so much! I hope this small amount of coin is enough to compensate you. I may have other tasks in which you could help. Return to me later when you have gained more experience and I will tell you of them."
You have finished the Copious Striders quest.
You are awarded 50 copper!
You have finished the Copious Striders quest.
You are awarded 50 copper!

midgard|letter to sveck.Name: Letter to Sveck
midgard|letter to sveck.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: I have placed starting point as Jordheim, but this quest starts in several different towns.
At level 3, your Trainer sends you to Audliten. You are to find Sveck,
who is in the fort defending the bridge crossing. Hand him the letter, and
Sveck grumbles and gives you XP and a few silvers.
[Step #1] Locate Sveck in the fort across from Audliten. Hand to him your trainers letter!
You give Sveck the letter from your trainer.
Sveck says, "Here is your coin, now leave me be!"
You are awarded experience!
You have finished the Letter to Sveck quest.
You are awarded 3 silver and some copper!

midgard|minx wiley.Name: Minx Wiley
midgard|minx wiley.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Hurg (located at 57426, 45286) in Huginfell is having troubles with a thief named Wiley. He wants you to track him down for you. Wiley is located just outside of town. *Wiley has several spawn locations. Kill him and you get Wiley's Boots.
Known spawn locales: (mostly at 5:30am)
In Huginfell behind Hurg, near the water next to a tree. 61300,44400
In Huginfell behind Healer building (West) at Loc: 51161, 42462 AND 50837, 46094
In Huginfell SSE from bind stone. 58760, 50170.
In Vasudheim on a snow covered hill near the wildlings.
Sometimes East of Huginfell almost to Dvalin
Hurg says, "Hey! I got [a problem]."
Hurg says, "Some nasty minx called Wiley keeps [pestering the town]."
Hurg says, "Yeah! He [won't go away]! He keeps [stealing stuff] from us.
Hurg says, "If you get rid of him I'll pay ya!"
Dialog box:
You have been given the Minx Wiley quest.
[Step #1] Find and kill Wiley
[Step #2] Return to Hurg for your reward!
Hurg says, "Thanks for your help! That little guy was getting on my nerves!"
You are rewarded 10 silver and some copper!
You have finished the Minx Wiley quest.
Reward:
Wiley's Boots

midgard|monstrous beast.Name: Monstrous Beast
midgard|monstrous beast.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Vik, the Kobold, next to the road with a broken down cart, in a field near Mularn gives you the quest to go find Hrrgyf the named hill cat and retrieve his book "The Yellow Canary." After killing Hrrgyf you get the book in your inventory and when you go back to Vik he gives you a letter to take to Dvalin and give to Brok. The reward is nice experience and cash.
Vik stomps his feet angrily, mumbling under his breath in utter frustration.
Vik says, "The blasted cart has broken, I knew something would go wrong on my [way to Fort Veldon]."
Vik says, "Ja! Fort Veldon! On my way from Vasudheim. Bu' me and my men were attacked by [marauding wild animals]!"
Vik says, "You'd never believe it if I told ya! Huge creatures they were. [Big jaws I tell ya]."
Vik says, "Never seen nothin' like it in my life. Was [the biggest cat] I've seen in my whole life, not to mention it scared off all my men."
Vik says, "Oh ya, made a funny sound it sure did, sounded like [hrrrrrgyyf] it did. Had a friend too, mean old Spat!"
Vik says, "What's that you say? Oh ya! The blasted beast ran off and took my favorite book, [The Yellow Canary]."
You have been given the Monstrous Beast quest.
Vik says, "Fetch it for me and I shall reward ye handsomely.
[Step #2]Find Hrrgyf and the book, The Yellow Canary.
Vik says, "Well well, lookie what you brought me! Ye done well and I thannk thee!"
Vik says, "I must tell ya I'm glad I lefy me money purse behind in Dvalin. Go see [my man Brok] there."
Vik says, "Take this note with ya so ya don't have to explain wha' happened here."
[Step #4] Seek out Brok in Dvalin and deliver Vik's troubling letter.
Brok says, "Well well, what is this?"
Brok says, Thank you for bringing this news from my friend. Seems Vik always runs into trouble when he travels to Mularn. Please, take this, I hope it suits you well."
You are awarded 9 silver and some copper!
You are awarded experience!
You have finished the Monstrous Beast quest.
Hrrgyf is known to wander about, look near Darkness Falls (12812,24648), Vendo caverns and Svadsad Faste.

midgard|smyga's raid.Name: Smyga's Raid
midgard|smyga's raid.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Part two, from Defeat the Hobgoblin Anklebiter quest.
Carr says, "Carr stay here in Mularn now!"
Carr says, "Carr has read Smyga's orders. Very bad news friend, very, very bad."
Carr says, "Smyga has grown upset, [very upset] at all the humans. Smyga doesn't like humans."
Carr says, "Smyga thinks humans stupid and [mean], attacking all hobgoblins home and camps humans are."
Carr says, "Smyga's Orders read that Anklebiter must gather all hobgoblin forces. [Gather forces] to attack the humans."
Carr says, "Carr doesn't like Smyga. Carr likes humans better so Carr will [tell you]."
Carr says, "Smyga plan a raid on human city of [Jordheim]. You must help."
Carr says, "Hurry! Hurry and find Smyga, so he can't take Jordheim. If he is defeated, hobgoblins have no leader and will not attack. Is only way to save city."
Kill Smyga and you will receive Smyg's helm. Smyga is in the same camp you found Anklebiter.
Reward:
Smyga's Helm

midgard|solving the argument.Name: Solving the Argument
midgard|solving the argument.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Skorri gives you 4 kill tasks then return for your reward. Tasks will vary.
::: Quest started by asking a bartender in Aegirhamn about adventure. Said that I should go see Skorri in Dyrfjell. I did :::
Skorri says, "I give up! These two are [driving me crazy]!"

Skorri says, "You don't know what's going on, do you? I believe you may be the only one in all of Aegir who hasn't heard the bickering that has been going on between these two. I would have had both of them dragged to Iarnvidur's Lair and left there if Stonelock Stonefist would have allowed it. Instead I have to listen to them [accuse one] another of horrible things!"
Skorri sighs unhappily, looking at Olvaerr and then at Ailsa. Olvaerr and Ailsa glare at each other.

Skorri says, "Olvaerr here is one of Ota Yrling's Kobolds, who came over with Longbeard and his dwarves. He claims that Ailsa stole something of his. And Ailsa, one of Catla's followers claims that Olvaerr stole a totem she was taking to Catla Gardasdottir, I've been trying to reason with them but they both so stubborn that neither will listen to me when I say that perhaps they simply [lost their belongings]."
Olvaerr says, I didn't lose my belongings, Skorri! Ailsa stole it! I know she did!"

Ailsa says, No, I didn't! Why would I want some smelly old cloak? But I know you stole the item I had for my mistress, Catla. You saw how special it was and you stole it for Ota and that grouchy old Longbeard! Give it back!"
Olvaerr says, How can I give back something I never had? you stole my cloak! Give it back right now and perhaps I won't tell Longbeard and Ota about the treachery of Catla Gardasdottir's people!"
Ailsa says, You thickheaded excuse for a Kobold! You probably lost that rotten old cloak in some drinking game with Longbeard's dwarves, I would never wear something that hideous!"

Olvaerr says, You pathetic excuse for a Norsewoman, you call ME thickheaded? Your head is so thick we could cut it off and put it on the border between Albion and us! It would take then years to get through it! only one as stupid as you would believe that a Kobold like myself would want your stupid totem!"
Ailsa says, You foolish little Kobold! You are playing with fore, insulting me like that! Perhaps a taste of a few Raven Bolts in the right place would teach you to respect those better than you!"

Skorri says. ENOUGH! Both of you be quiet this instant or I will have you dragged to Delling Crater and thrown in headfirst! Do you see what I have been dealing with? Stonelock, King Goran's brother, put me in charge of leading two groups up into Gripklosa Mountains and unfortunately these two are the leaders of those two groups. neither will budge until they [get back] their missing items and King Goran and Stonelock ill both string me up unless I get them there."
Skorri lowers his voice so only you can hear him.

Skorri says, "Niddogh, right? Well Niddogh, I was talking to Kaisa and she says she saw both objects before they were lost and knows how to recreate them. Kaisa can't go get the materials because she's been feeling sick lately and I can't leave these two alone for two seconds or they would tear each other apart. If there was someone to [go out and gather] the necessary items."
Will you help Skorri end the argument between Ailsa and Olvaerr by replacing their lost items?
You have been given the Solving the Argument quest.
Step #1: Go speak with Kaisa. She can be found in the small hut near Tjasse Vindrson in Dyrfjell.

Kaisa says, "Come in, come in, Hunter. If I'm not mistaken, Skorri sent you to me. I could hear Ailsa and Olvaerr all the way over here. They have been fighting for days and poor Skorri has been close to tears, which is saying something, him being a troll. They have surely tested his patience. I am just glad that I saw both objects before those two addle-brains [lost them]."

Kaisa says, Yes, they lost them. A few days ago Ailsa went out with the totem tied to her belt and didn't come back with it. I'm sure she lost it when she was out studying the Morvaltar for Catla. As for Olvaerr, Ailsa might be right in hat he lost it in a drinking game [with the dwarves]."

Kaisa says, He took a horse to Aegirhamn on the same say that Ailsa went out and he returned the next morning, reeking for ale and groaning about his head. I didn't see the cloak anywhere. It was the same day they both started accusing the other of stealing. I'm just glad I saw both items before they lost them Poor Skorri only has a certain amount of time [to meet Stonelock] up in Gripklosa mountains and if he can't get those two groups moving, Stonelock will be furious."

Kaisa says, Stonelock is going to be leading an expedition into the wilds of Gripklosa to track down the truth of yet another rumor about the Troll Fathers. I told Skorri to just go himself and leave both groups here and let Catla and Longbeard get in trouble for not being able to control their people, but Skorri said Stonelock wouldn't look at it that was. I'd hate for Skorri to [get in trouble] since he's been so kind to check on me while I've been sick."

Kaisa says, Well, if we want to keep Skorri out of trouble, we better get you going! Olvaerr's cloak is rather easy to reproduce. From what he was telling anyone who would listen, he killed a mammoth bull himself and sewed it with he sinew from a morvalt bagskytt. But I saw the cloak and know the pelt actually came from a mammoth calf. And I heard Alisa say she saw Olvaerr killing a morvalt ungdom shortly before he started wearing the cloak. I think you can handle getting the pelt and the sinew. Now for [Ailsa's totem].

Kaisa says, This will be a bit more difficult. She took the eye of a biting insect and imbued it with the essence of a pyslings. I believe I can reproduce the process she used if you bring me those two things. I know it is a lot to get, but I know that Skorri will reward you well for saving him from those two. Do you [need directions] to the creatures or do you [know the way]?"
Kaisa says, Which do you need directions to? the [mammoth] calves, the [morvalt] ungdom, the [pyslings], the biting [insects], or [all of them]?"

Kaisa says, The mammoth calves do have a tendency to roam, but you can almost always find some just west of here, in the open area by the rocks. Take care, for the calves usually travel in pairs. Watch out for the young mammoths, they are more than you can handle at this point!"

Kaisa says, For the morvalt ungdom, follow the road southwest as if you are going to Aegirhamn and cross the large stone bridge. Not far over the bridge you will find morvalt ungdom on both sides of the road."

Kaisa says, The pyslings and found in many places, but I like one particular spot. From the guard tower near the large stone bridge, head due south. You'll cross over the road and enter a small valley between the hills. You should find some in there. Some are only there at night, but others are there all the time."

Kaisa says, As for the biting insects, head south from the guard tower near the large stone bridge. Cross over the road and into a small valley between the hills. Once in the valley, follow it west until you reach the beach. The biting insects live along the coastline."
Step #2: Get a pelt from a mammoth calf. If you need directions to their location, speak with Kaisa in Dyrfjell. Be careful, the calves travel in pairs!
Step #3: Get a morvalt sinew from a morvalt ungdom. If you need directions to their location, speak with Kaisa in Dyrfjell.
Step #4: Get some essence from a pysling. If you need directions to their location, speak with Kaisa in Dyrfjell.
Step #5: Get an eye from a biting insect. If you need directions the location, speak with Kaisa in Dyrfjell.
Step #6: Return to Kaisa in Dyrfjell and speak with her.

Kaisa says, Oh, Hunter, you should be thankful you were not here recently! Ails and Olvaerr got into another yelling match and Skorri was ready to drag them back to Muspelheim and drop them into the lava! I managed to get over there and calm them down. Poor Skorri! He's looking so tired from all this. Let us get these things made quickly, shall we? I need the pelt from the mammoth calf first."
Kaisa says, Now give me the morvalt sinew an I shall quickly sew a cloak."
Kaisa takes out a bone needle and sews the morvalt sinew to the cloak.
Kaisa says, There, that is done and it looks exactly the same as the one he had before. Good job Hunter! Now give me the essence from the pyslings."
Kaisa takes the essence and pours it into a small wooden bowl
Kaisa says, Please give me the eye from the biting insect."
Kaisa places the eye in the bowl and then puts a few mysterious looking powders and liquids in. She then pulls the eye out of the gooey mess in the bowl.

Kaisa says, That is done too. I was a little unsure of this one, but from what I overheard Ailsa saying, this is the same process she used. We'll see if it's acceptable to her or not. Here, take the cloak and the totem and go speak with Skorri. Hopefully he hasn't hurt Ailsa and Olvaerr yet!"
You receive a Olvaerr's cloak from Kaisa!
You receive a Ailsa's totem from Kaisa!
Step #7: Go and see Skorri again.
::: No sshot for this one, just from memory :::
Skorri says, I hope for both my sanity and their health that you have found Alisa's and Olvaerr's missing items, Niddogh. Do I see [a cloak] in your pack there?"

Skorri says, Look Olvaerr, this fine Hunter has found your cloak! Please Niddogh, give Olvaerr his cloak so that he will no longer think that Ailsa stole it from him. Perhaps he will even apologize to Alisa."
Step #8: Give Olvaerr's cloak to him in Dyrfjell
Olvaerr takes the cloak and inspects it.

Olvaerr says, "Hrmph. It appears that you have found my cloak, Hunter. I didn't think that dwarf would give it...I mean I didn't think anyone would ever find it! Ailsa, I...I...am...sorry. There I said it! Hopefully you have Ailsa's totem so she realizes I didn't take it!"
You are awarded 11,264 experience!
You are awarded 6 silver and some copper!
Step #9: Give Ailsa's totem to her in Dyrfjell.

Ailsa says, Well would you look at that! The Kobold didn't steal it after all Perhaps I did drop it the other day when I was you watching the Morvaltar. I am sorry too, Olvaerr. And I am sorry, Skorri that we put you through this. I shall send word to my group to prepare for the trip to Gripklosa now. Niddogh, I think that Skorri has been stunned into silence. Perhaps you can break him out of it by speaking to him again."
You are awarded 11,264 experience!
You are awarded 6 silver and some copper!

Skorri says, Well Niddogh, I am speechless. You have done it! They have apologized to each other I thin the world may be ending after all. Now if I can just keep the two groups from killing each other on the away up to Gripklosa, Stonelock will be pleased with me. I cannot thank you enough for helping me. After the last expedition I led, Stonelock [gave me something] for my good service. I have never used it, but I think it is time it got some use."

Skorri says, According to Stonelock, this was made by the finest Troll craftspeople around. I hope you will use it as you explore this land. Perhaps one day we shall speak again and you can join in an expedition I am leading! May the house of Skadi watch over you, Niddogh!"
You receive a War-maker's Bow from Skorri!
You have finished the Solving the Argument quest.

::: This quest was done with my level 10 Hunter. Bow is an orange /con to level 10. Ive done this quest with my Savage (Gaaths), and the text/quests is/are identical, and the reward was an orange /con as well. All grammar errors are not mine. :) Nice quest, /good/ rewards, have fun! Fengr Skaifgrei, , Guinevere. :::
A lvl 15 Healer reports that the experience received from this quest was 40k per each part of the quest that grants experience.

midgard|spat the wild cat.Name: Spat the Wild Cat
midgard|spat the wild cat.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Vik in the Vale of Mularn gives out another quest. He wants you to go out and kill Spat the Cat.
Vik stomps his feet angrily, mumbling under his breath in utter frustration.
Vik says, "Spat! [Spat], that crazy mean old cat. You know he's given me troubles before comin' this way."
Vik says, "I've had some troubles with that nasty friend of Hrrrrgyf's. If you have a minute, I'll [tell you] about that cat Spat and maybe you can give me a hand with him."
Vik says, "Always getting into trouble that one is. You'd never believe the [audacity of that cat]."
Vik says, "He attacked the wagon with the others and got into a spat, which is why I call him Spat you see, [always been a fighter] that one."
Vik says, "Spat picked a fight with that grendalorm, and bit the end of [Vasas tail] right off, just liek that and took off into the hills."
Vik says, "Funniest thing I've ever seen I gotta tell ya, but you also gotta know I'd like to [have that tail]."
You have been given the Spat the Wild Cat quest.
Vik says, "If you bring me Vasa's tail from Spat it would make this whole shoddy trip worth it and I can make it worth your while too ya see."
Spat is a rare spawn in the Vale of Mularn hills. Rough location is 33700, 36700. He spawns at all times of the day. LOTS of cats there. (I killed cats for three days until he finally showed.)
I found Spat at 36.7k 38.4k and the time was around 20:00.. I got 164k expp (lvl 16 berserk)
Vik says, "Haha, you did it! I will not ask how you coaxed this prize from that crazy old cat but I thank you!"
Vik says, "At least my trip into Mularn is now worth it. I've been tryin' to get that cat for ages."
You are awarded experience!
You have finished the Spat the Wild Cat quest.

midgard|tomte problems.Name: Tomte Problems
midgard|tomte problems.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Macalena gives you a rumor that Throgil needs help. The quest starts with Thorgil, not Macalena. But in case you need to see her for the rumor, she is in Haggerfel.
Macalena says, "Thorgil seems to be having some problems with the tomtes. Go listen to his story in Audliten."
Thorgil says, "Tomtes, tomtes, tomtes! I'll be so glad if I never see another [tomte] in my life!"

Thorgil says, "I'm sorry for the outburst, but these tomtes continue to frustrate me. At one time, the tomtes were actually friendly but now all they do is cause trouble and heartache for the races of Midgard. But you don't want to hear an old man complain about some pests, do you? No one wants to hear about the problem I must now solve because of them. I'm sure you have better things to do. One day I will find someone [willing to listen] to my story and give me a had with my tomte problem."
Dialog box: Will you take the time to listen to Thorgil's tale and help him with his problem?
You have been giving the Tomte Problems quest.
[Step #1] Talk with Thorgil of Audliten about his problems with the tomtes.

Thorgil says, "What? You want to hear my story? I shall be in your debt for just that small favor you grant me now. I am a farmer, or at least I was. I once worked the land not far down the road from here. My house still stands there, but it is infested by those vile creature, the tomtes. But as I said, they weren't always that way. A very long time ago, they [became friendly] with the first settlers that moved into this region."

Thorgil says, "When the first settlers came to this land, the first creatures they encountered were the tomtes. No one had ever seen the strange little men before and were unsure of how they would react to the settlers. The settlers watched the tomtes from afar and observed that they were rather crafty when it came to building things. The settlers, new to the land, knew they would need the help of the tomtes if they were to survive. But the tomtes were unsure of these invaders and they [refused] to have anything to do with the settlers."

Thorgil says, "It was completely by accident that the tomtes ended up helping the settlers. One of the settlers had left a freshly baked loaf of bread cooling beside the camp fire while she went off into the woods to collect some more firewood. While she was gone, one of the tomtes crept into
the camp and tried the strange food. The bread was like nothing he had tasted before and he wanted more. He noticed the water skins of the woman were empty, and he took them and [refilled them]."

Thorgil says, "The woman was very surprised when she came back to find here bread gone but here water skins filled. That night, out of curiosity, she left more bread out, along with a broken cooking pan and went to sleep. In the morning she found the bread gone but the pan fixed. She told the other settlers about it, and they did the same thing, with the same results. Leaving bread would result in some chore being done, but no one was sure
[who was doing] the chores."
Thorgil says, "The settlers set up a watch and discovered that the tomtes

were the ones helping them. The settlers continued to leave bread and other things for the tomtes as they began to farm the land and the tomtes seemed to accept that these few people would be sharing the land with them. They even began to adopt certain farms, including my ancestor's farm. But then more people starting settling in the area, and soon it became [very crowded] for the tomtes."
Thorgil says, "As more people moved in and took up the land, the tomtes were

pushed to smaller and smaller areas and the original settlers over time forgot about their little tomte friends. The tomtes grew angry and began to do malicious things to the people living in and around here. Some of us were lucky enough to keep the good favor of the tomtes. My ancestor was one of those people, and up until recently I had tomtes helping myself and my family with our chores but one day that [all changed]."

Thorgil says, "The tomtes that we had been friendly with suddenly turned vicious, destroying things, hurting my family, tearing up my fields, and hurting the animals I kept. We tried to appease them with bread and other things, but they would take nothing we offered. We stayed as long as we could, but when they attacked my wife and daughter, it was enough. We gathered up everything we could and fled here to Audliten. My wife is currently in Jordheim visiting her sister, and my daughter is off playing somewhere. I remain here to keep an [eye on things]."

Thorgil says, "Don't tell my wife this, but when we fled, I left our chest of jewels and money there in the house. I didn't mean to, but we left in such a hurry. I'd go back and get it, but I will not leave my daughter and I cannot take her with me, because the tomtes have overrun the house. I need you to go into the house and get the chest I've hidden there. It's filled with all the treasured things I own. I also need you to do [one other thing] for me."

Thorgil says, "I seem to have lost the key to the chest. As we fled the house, I slipped it into my pocket for safe keeping, but I think it fell out when a tomte grabbed my leg and made me fall. I remember hearing something metal hit the wooden floor of the porch, but I didn't have time to look. The tomte scavengers were hurting me, so I just got up and ran for my life. Please, go to my old house and recover my chest of jewels. Once I have it and the key, I will open the box and give you something nice from it. My farm is not far from here. Go east down the road and over the stone bridge. The house lies on the south side of the road. Please, get the key and search the house for the chest. Thank you."
[Step #2] Get the key from the tomte scavengers that roam outside Thorgil's house. To get to his house, follow the road east out of town and over the bridge. His house lies to the south.
Go to the house to the east of the town and kill the 1 to 3 tomte scavengers in
front of the house. You may get it one the first kill, you may get it second or third.
The tomte scavenger says, "Ha-ha! You thought I had the key but I don't! I gave it to another when I saw you approach! Try again!"
The tomte scavenger says, "Oh no! You found the key! A (your class here) found the key! No no no!"
You receive a chest key from the tomte scavenger!
[Step #3] Search Thorgil's house to find the hidden chest of jewels.
Walk into the house and search for the chest of jewels. You may have to right click here and there. I did it over by the pot.
You search Thorgil's house for the chest of jewels.
You found Thorgil's chest of jewels!
You receive a chest of jewels from Thorgil's house!
[Step #4] Return to Thorgil in Audliten.

Thorgil says, "You seemed to have fared better with the tomtes than I have. Were you able to get the key from hem? My wife came by while you were gone and wanted to get something out of the chest, but I was able to distract her. Please, give me the key now."
[Step #5] Give Thorgil the chest key.
You give the chest key to Thorgil.
Thorgil says, "Thank you. Now, this key will do me no good unless you were able to locate the chest of jewels in my house. Please give me the chest now."
[Step #6] Give Thorgil the chest of jewels.
Give the chest of jewels to Thorgil.
Thorgil takes the chest and unlocks it with the key. He looks inside, sighs with relief, then closes it with a smile.

Thorgil says, "I am in your debt. You have saved me from hearing my wife rant and rave about having lost both the key and the box. I would like to know who provoked the tomtes to turn on me. I am going to try to find out more as to why they changed. I may have need of your services again soon.. Until then, I have the perfect reward for you. This chest is filled with many wonderful things I've collected over the years and I am more than willing to give you one of the trinkets I have in here. I just need to know [something from you]."
[Step #7] Choose a reward from Thorgil.

Thorgil says, "Would you like something that would add to you [magical power], your [strength], your [dexterity] or your skill with a [sword]? I can only give you one, so think carefully before you make your choice."
(obviously at this point the next part will change depending on the prize
chosen)
You receive a (see below for reward and end dialog)
You are awarded xxx experience!
You are awarded 80 copper!
You have finished the Tomte Problems quest.
Magical Power:
You receive a Woven Silver Bracelet from Thorgil!
Thorgil says, "Ah, that's a very good choice. I received this bracelet from a woman of great magical power. I know it you will make good use of it. Come
back to me soon!"
Strength:
You receive a Braided Hair Belt from Thorgil!
Thorgil says, "I received this belt from a warrior who had grown too old to use it. It's good for anyone who needs a little extra strength. Use it well, and come back and see me soon!"
Dexterity:
You receive a Twisted Copper Ring from Thorgil!

Thorgil says, "This is a nice ring I have for you. I received it from a shadowblade that grew too old to use it anymore. She traded for a crop of turnips! Anyway, use it well, and come back and see me soon!"
Sword:
You receive a Copper Chain Necklace from Thorgil!

Thorgil says, "This necklace came from a skilled swordsman who traded it to me for all my crops one year. He said he was too old to go out and fight. You don't look too old to use it! Take it and come back and see me soon!"
Rewards:
Braided Hair Belt
Woven Silver Bracelet
Twisted Copper Ring
Copper Chain Necklace

midgard|klippa's claw.Name: Klippa's Claw
midgard|klippa's claw.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: *You must have completed Copious Striders quest first.
Talk to Alomali (Vasudheim), Alomali will tell you to go see Lilib. Lilib is located inside the Fort right before you enter Dvalin.
Lilib asks you to kill Klippa, a named crab that spawns just East of the Ant camp (the Ant camp is just East
of the Fort you talked to Lilib in). There is a set of 2 crabs that spawn here just keep killing them until
Klippa spawns (Klippa seems to spawn at night). Lilib will tell you to go across the bridge to find Klippa

but this is wrong, just stick to the 2 spawn crabs near the ant camp. After you have killed Klippa you will have Klippa's Claw in your inventory. Return Klippa's Claw to Lilib and you will recieve a short sword named Klippor as your reward.
Alomali says, "Hail! I have [news] for you."
You have been given the Klippa's Claw quest.
Alomali says, "There is a smith to the west that I know well. I have asked him if he could make a special item for you. He says he is [willing]."
Alomali says, "Aye, he goes by the name of Lilib. Seek him out and tell him I sent you."
{Step #1]
Speak to Lilib. Tell him Alomali sent you.
You say, "Alomali sent me."
Lilib ponders for a moment.
[Step #2]
Locate Klippa and kill her. Return quickly so as to bring Lilib the still fresh claw.
You may be asked to kill Riv, Klippa's mate, who spawns across the water from Klippa on an island. The reward for this is the Riva, a chain tunic.
Found Klippa at 20.900 and 51.000 at 7.40 PM.
Found Riv at 20.500 and 46.000 at 10 PM.
Rewards:
Klippor
Riva

midgard|hunting party.Name: Hunting Party
midgard|hunting party.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: ***You need to do this quest three times. This is NOT a task, shows up in your journal, and is repeatable. Then the following quest is Silent Death. The Silent Death quest results in a great reward for your class. I was given the lynx variant twice, then the toad one.
Quest is one of several types, but in all of them Bork asks you to hunt
down a dangerous monster in the area. He has you hunt and kill one of a
number of various things, included grass vipers, ribbon toads, and savage
lynxes. Every time you do the quest you get a variable amount of silver
(around 10-50) and a small amount of experience, if you are low enough.
One variant:
Bork says, "Yes? Are you [looking for something]?"
Bork says, "Hmmm, I may have some work for you. Would you be [interested] in doing a little hunting for me?"
You have been given the Hunting Party quest.
Bork says, "Well let's see here. I think I may have something that you can do for me. Let me check my [scrolls]."
Bork nods and opens his bag of scrolls.
Bork searches quickly through his scrolls, studying them each for a few seconds before he nods and smiles.
Bork says, "Ok here is a tough one. A savage lynx stole a baby from her crib yesterday. Hunt one of these foul creatures down and slay it, then return.
Savage lynx are directly West of the Healer hut, go up and over the hill, to a clearing that is surrounded by trees, you should find plenty of them there.
[Step #1]
Hunt a savage lynx and slay it.
[Step #2]
Return to Bork
Another variant:
Bork says, "Hello again. Are you [interested] in more work already?"
You have been given the Hunting Party quest.
Bork says, "Well let's see here. I think I may have something that you can do for me. Let me check my [scrolls]."
Bork says, "The ribbon toads have been stealing food off the tables of villagers with their long tongues. Slay one of these beasts and return to me."
[Step #1] Hunt a ribbon toad and slay it.
[Step #2] Return to Bork
Ending:
Bork says, "Great job! Here are a few coins as a reward. Return a bit later and I may have more work for you. I have to update my scrolls now."
You are awarded 3 silver and some copper!
You have finished the Hunting Party quest.

midgard|ibicus.Name: Ibicus
midgard|ibicus.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: This is one of the multiple path quests...
Karle Alfevson says, "You are looking well. Have you been out [exploring]?"
Karle Alfevson says, "Have you seen the giant sea beast that has been [ravaging the town] when it can't feed off anything else?"

Karle Alfevson says, "Well, not the whole town. Just the people in it. The beast belongs out to sea, but somehow, it got stuck here, in the inlet of water and the harbor. Occasionally, when it runs out of fresh fish and can't finad any animals roaming the shores, it comes to town. We need to kill this beast."
Dialog box: Will you kill this sea beast?
You have been given the Ibicus quest.
Karle Alfevson says, "It's known as Ibicus. When you kill it, bring me it's carcass, and you will be well rewarded."
[Step #2] Kill Ibicus.
Nibalk says, "Hey! Hey! Come here!"
Nibalk says, "Are you hunting [Ibicus]?"

Nibalk says, "Yes, that large sea beast that's been devouring people everywhere. I understand that Ota, Karle, and Longbeard are all offering rewards for the carcass, to hang as trophies. I don't think that's what should be done! What a waste! No no no no listen to me. Take the carcass to the [Mussalkan]."

Nibalk says, "A creature like Ibicus is a gift to them! Althought they know him as Molvor. They can do so much with it! They will give you tokens, talismans, and trinkets of all sorts if you give them the carcass of a beast such as Ibicus! These trinkets and tokens, and the talismans, if you bring them to me, I will pay you not only for killing Ibicus, bu also for the trinkets they give you in exchange for the carcass! Think of it. It's worth more to ya!"
Gazsi says, "Come speak to me!"
Gazsi says, "Are you part of the [nonsense]?"
Gazsi says, "The sea beast, Ibicus. There are a few who have expressed

interest in having the beast killed and returned to the town, to be displayed as a trophy! Rewards were promised, but still the Ibicus it is more valuable to the Musslaklan than it is to the leaders. It would also please me, more, to see the beast everyone around here is calling Ibicus give to the Musslaklan. They will use the remains to feed themselves, create items from the bones, and will find some uses for the [carcass], I imagine. They generally do."
Gazsi says, "Yes. Kill Ibicus, I agree. But don't take the carcass to those
expeditionaries who want to display it on their walls or huts as trophies.
They will pay you some money, but the musslaklan will pay you in tokens and
trinkets. Turn the carcass of Ibicus in to a Musslaklan Trader and bring me
the trinkets and tokens. The musslaklan know Ibicus as Movlor. Remember
that. I will pay you a reward for the carcass, and I will pay you for the
trinkets. It's your choice."
Go kill Ibicus who can be found near the stone bridge, in the water, on the hill, or on the bridge.
[Step #3] Return the carcass of Ibicus.
I selected Ota Yrling to return the carcass to.
Ota Yrling says, "Ah. Do you have a carcass? The carcass of Ibicus? Did you defeat him? Tell me you did! I will pay you a handsome price for that carcass!"
Hand Ota Yrling the Ibicus carcass.

Ota Yrling says, "Yes! Ha! Longbeard can eat it! I've got Ibicus! I've got Ibicus! Longbeard is going to have to eat his words now! Telling me I haven't the sense of a huldu! Huh! Well! Here, I've promised you a reward, you shall have it!"
Ota Yrling gives you a Ibicus Soft Lined Cap.
You are awarded 8 silver and some copper!
You are awarded 81,930 experience!
You have finished the Ibicus quest.
If you talk to LongBeard, here is part of what he says:
Longbeard says, "Aye! Ibicus! Did you get me Ibicus? The beast? That vile,
ugly, malicious smelling stinking rotten beast that?s eaten my friend
Gworf?"
Longbeard says, ?Argh. Thank you! Here, as payment for your great deeds!
Gwarf, ahh, my friend Gworf, justice has been done in your name.?
You receive Ibicus Studded Sleeves from Longbeard!
You are awarded 6 silver and some copper
You are awarded 63,756 experience!
You have finished the Ibicus quest.
If you talk to Karle Alfevson, here is what he says:
Karle Alfevson says, "Ibicus? I see you have Ibicus! I recognize that foul
carcass anywhere! Did you know, he ate Gworf, a long time companion or
Longbeard's? He hasn?t taken that very well!"
Hand Karle Alfevson the Ibicus carcass
Karle Alfevson says, "Ah! I must tell you, Longbeard and Ota have been
crawling all over each other and everyone else in the town to get this
beast! They both want to claim it as their prize! Ha! Well, not that I want
to get involved in the in-fighting on the dwarven=kbold expedition, but
really, somebody had to end this Ibicus obsession once and for all. I
figured it'd be a better thing for me to have Ibicus. That way, Longbeard
and Ota can't spend precious time trying to outdo each other. Oh! But
imagine the looks they will have when they see Ibicus! Just a small benefit
from all this! Here, I promised you a reward, though. Thanks. You've be a
great help!"
You receive a Ibicus Soft Lined Cap from Karle Alfevson!
You are awarded 10 silver and some copper!
You are awarded 81,920 experience!
You have finished the Ibicus quest.
My level 18 SB completed ans gave Carcass to Karle Alfevson and got
6 silver and some copper & 81,930 experience & Blade of Ibicus
If you take your chance with factioning and talk to the trader:
Musslaklan Trader says, "I see you have Movlor. You give him to me, I will give you gifts! Gazsi likes our gifts. I'll give you gifts for Movlor, you take to trade with Gazsi."
I gave the Musslaklan Trader the Ibicus carcass.
Musslaklan Trader says, "Movlor is large. Has eaten many the musslaklan youth. But we could not hunt him!"
You receive musslakan gifts from Musslaklan Trader!
You are awarded 81,920 experience!
My journal then said, "Take the musslakan gift back to either Gaszi or Nibalk." I clicked on Gazsi and:

Gazsi says, "Miep, ah, I am thinking you are coming to me because you did the right thing and turned Movlor in to the Musslakam? Did they give you any gifts? I shall pay you for what they have given you."
I gave Gazsi the musslakam gift.

Gazsi says, "Ah! Talisman! I value these! They are often times objects of great power! I've always been interested in the primitive cultures of this land. They often can tap into magics we are unaware of! Well, but these are of no interest to you. Here, I promised you I'd pay you. I hope this is sufficient. Oh, and here, a reward, for ridding the town of one of its biggest threats, the sea beast known as Ibicus. I do hope there aren't many others!"
You receive a Ibicus Soft Lined Cap from Gazsi.
You are awarded 10 silver and some copper!
You are awarded 163,840 experience!
You have finished the Ibicus quest.
Rewards:
Ibicus Soft Lined Cap
Blade of Ibicus
Ibicus Studded Sleeves
Claw of Ibicus

midgard|tomte plot.Name: Tomte Plot
midgard|tomte plot.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: You must complete Tomte Problems quest first.
Return to Thorgil for his next fiasco with the Tomtes.

Thorgil says, "So, I walked over to Hulda the shield merchant and spoke with her. She didn't know much either, but she told me about her cousins. Ever since their sister was attacked as a child by the tomtes, they have watched them and learned everything about them. Hulda told me that they would help me learn more about why the tomtes had turned on me. But I [ran into a problem]."

Thorgil says, "Hulda's cousins don't live here in Audliten. They are out in the wilds of East Svealand, studying the tomtes. I can't just up and leave here to work with them especially since I just started working with Inga the arrow merchant. I needed a way to support my family, so I spoke with Inga and she agreed to teach me how to make arrows. That's why I'm glad [you've come back] to visit me."

Thorgil says, "I thought perhaps you could go and speak to the brothers and learn about the tomtes. Hulda told me she would let them what has happened to me and what I wanted to know. I was hoping I could [count on you] to give me help with this problem like you did with my lost chest of jewels. If you help me, I'm sure I can find something nice for you in the chest. Well, what do you say?"
Dialog box: Can Thorgil count on you to learn more about the tomtes and their plans?
You have been given the Tomte Plot quest.
[Step #1] Speak with Hulda the shield merchant in Audliten.
Hulda says, "Hail and well met! You look like a (your class here) with a purpose for coming here. I don't think you seek a shield, but perhaps [information]?"

Hulda says, "I thought so! I figured Thorgil would have to send someone in his place, since I've heard others say that Inga has begun teaching him the art of making and selling arrows. I was very sorry to hear that Thorgil has lost his farm to the tomtes. I was so busy selling shields that I hadn't had a chance to get over and speak with him about what happened. I was glad when he came in here the other day [to ask me] about the tomtes."

Hulda says, "I don't know much, but as Thorgil probably told you, my cousins do. When Thorgil came to me, I couldn't say no to his plea for help. I went and visited each of my brothers and told them of Thorgil's situation. They were both very intrigued by the whole thing, for they have been watching the tomtes around here for many years. Both said they recently observed some changes in [the tomtes' behaviour]."

Hulda says, "They both spent a few days watching the tomtes and then trying to make sense of what they saw. I recently received word from both of them, telling me who Thorgil should speak to. But since you are helping Thorgil, I shall tell you [which of my cousins] to speak to."

Hulda says, "Both sent me word that they think Edvard would be the best one to help Thorgil. He has noticed some happenings around the tomte camps he watches that his brother Emmerick hasn't noticed. Most people don't know where Edvard likes to hide so I shall tell you. Go across the stone bridge northeast of here to the guard tower. You will find him on the top most level. Take care in climbong the ladders, they can be tricky! Remember to tell him Thorgil sent you!"
[Step #2] Speak with Edvard Avarrson at the top of the guard tower. Go across the bridge northeast of Audliten to get to the guard tower."
Edvard Averrson says, "Yes? Is there something I can do for you? I am rather busy, and I am also waiting for someone."
[Step #3] Speak with Edvard Averrson. Tell him [Thorgil] sent you.
You say, "Thorgil sent me."

Edvard Averrson says, "Oh he did? Well then, you are the one I am waiting for. My cousin Hulda said that Thorgil was having problems with the tomtes. I wasn't surprised to hear it, because I have been watching them and I have noticed a change in their behavior lately. Most of the time they just pester people traveling along the road or thos that stray too close to the camps. But as I watched, I noticed that the tomtes were organizing [specific attacks]."

Edvard Averrson says, "I believe that the tomtes are trying to find a way to push the people of Audliten and its surrounding area off the lands that once belonged to the tomtes. As more people have moved into the area, the tomtes have been pushed to smaller and smaller areas. There are only a few camps left around here, and because of that ,the residents around here have grown to think the tomtes have moved on or disappeard from this world. But that is [far from the truth]!"

Edvard Averrson says, "The tomtes needed a place that wouldn't be taken over by the residents of the area. They searched and found a cave not far from where my brother watches them. They are crafty little men, and began to carve out a home for themselves under the earth. They worked quickly, and soon their new home was ready. Led by the strongest of the tomtes, Nisse, most of them left their lands and headed deep underground. Now, some people believe that the tomtes in the camps around here don't like dank surroundings of the cave, but that isn ot true. There is [another reason] they live above ground."

Edvard Averrson says, "All this time the tomtes have been planning ways to remove the inhabitants of Audliten and the surrounding areas and reclaim them for their own. The tomtes that live in the camps above ground are the eyes and ears for Nisse and report back everything they see. Recently I've noticed more messengers heading down from the north, yet my brother has not noticed and unusual activity around the entrance to the tomte caves. That has led us both to believe [someone else] is behind this plot to drive Thorgil and the others from this area off their land."

Edvard Averrson says, "I've noticed many messengers heading in and out of the camp of Edigo. It's my guess that something is going on and he knows about it. I've watched Edigo for some time now and I know he is plotting something. Most likely he's kept the messages that have been sent to him. You must get those messages so we can figure out what is going on and who is sending them. Edigo's camp is not far off from here. Head back through Audliten and take the road east out of town. Go over the stone bridge and keep going until you see the wooden tower. It's not far from Thorgil's old house. You will find Edigo there, but do not go alone! The other tomtes will anwer Edigo's call for help. Return to me when you have any messages.
[Step #4] Slay Edigo and obtain any tomte messages. Go through Audliten and head east out of town. Cross the stone bridge and continue to the wooden tower near Thorgil's farm house.
Edigo is at the tomte tower, loc approx 30k, 32k. He will have at least 3 other tomtes with him. When I went there was a Tomte Thug and Plunderer.
Edigo says, "You so mean! You hurt Edigo and tomtes! We get you!"
Edigo says, "Tomtes get you! You steal messages but you not stral our land!"
You receive a stack of messages from Edigo!
[Step #5] Return to Edvard Averrson at the top of the guard tower.

Edvard Averrson says, "I am impressed. I watched over your battle with the tomtes from here and I liked what I saw. Thorgil did well in selecting you to help him. Now, let's see the messages you obtained."
[Step #6] Give Edvard the tomte messages.
Edvard takes the messages and reads them carefully.

Edvard Averrson says, "It's good you brought these to me. They happen to be written in the ancient language of the tomtes, and my brother and I are experts at reading and writing it. It seems that Edigo has been following orders to drive the inhabitants of Audliten and the surrounding areas away and reclaim the land. I'm not surprised to see that the orders were issued by Smack. He has always been [eager to succeed]."

Edvard Averrson says, "A long time ago, Smack displeased Nisse and was forced to leave the tomte caves and live among the races of Midgard. Since then, he has been working to get back into Nisse's good graces. It seems that he thinks if he can clear the land of invaders, as he sees them, then Nisse will be pleased and restore him to the position he once held. It appears that SMack has recruited Edigo to help in his plot. But now that Edigo is dead, Smack will try to recruit another of the tomtes. You must [stop Smack]!"

Edvard Averrson says, "Gather your forces and lead t hem to Smack's stronghold. You must stop him from contacting any of the other camp leaders. Smack's stronghold isn't hard to find. Take the road east out of Audliten again, and cross the stone bridge. Continue down the road until you see a small stone fort to the southeast. That is where you will find Smack. While you are off dealing with Smack, I shall send word to Thorgil of what you are doing. Return to him when you are finished with Smack."
[Step #7] Seek out the tomte known as Smack and put an end to his evil plans against Thorgil. His fort lies southeast of the road that runs between Audliten and the rope bridge.

If you follow these directions you should not have a problem. The stronghold is near the drakelings. It is quite a trek, but if you end up at the rope bridge you went to far. Smack loc: 43k, 46k. Smack is surrounded by a lot of tomtes, including Tomte Skirmishers who will come to his aid, so BAF.
Smack says, "So you figure out Smack's plot! Smack will stop you from sharing with Audliten! Die (your race here)!"
Smack says, "You may stop Smack, but tomtes will have land back one day!"
You receive a Smack's leg bone from Smack!
[Step #8] Return to Thorgil in the town of Audliten.

Thorgil says, "So, Smack is behind all this mess, is he? I hope you were able to take care of him. If he's gone, perhaps I can move back to my farm and go back to the life I enjoyed. Please, give me proof that you were able to rid this world of Smack."
[Step #9] Give Thorgil the leg bone of Smack.
You give Thorgil the leg bone of Smack.
Thorgil takes the leg bone and smiles happily.

Thorgil says, "I will gather a few friends and we will go out and see if we can reclaim my farm now and hopefully soon my family can move back into our home. Speaking of friends, I have a few who would be able to turn this rather nice bone into a nice weapon for you. I just need to know who to send you to. Since there's only one bone, you can only pick one. Would you like a [sword], an [axe], a [hammer], a [bow], a [spear], or a [staff] for those that use magic?"
[Step #10] Choose which kind of weapon you wish to make.
Ok, I did this with a highlevel SM and Thorgil would ONLY let me choose the staff. So I will include his comments here, so you can see, heh.
Thorgil says, "You cannot use a bow, Spiritmaster. Perhaps a Spiritmaster like you would prefer a nice [staff]?"
Thorgil says, "A staff, eh? Then take this leg bone Eirik here in Audliten and he shall make it into a staff for you. Thank you, and keep an ear out for my call, I may have need of you again!"
You are awarded 20, XXX experience!
You are awarded 3 silver and some copper!
You receive a Smack's leg bone from Thorgil!
(ok another Mythic quest screw-up)
[Step #10] (actually 11) Give the bone to Eirik of Audliten to be made into a staff.
You give Eirik leg bone of Smack.
Sword:
Sword of Smack
Axe:
Smack-bone Axe
Hammer:
Hammer of Smack
Bow:
Smack-bone Bow
Spear:
Smack-bone Spear
Staff:
Eirik takes the leg bone and begins to shape it into a staff.
Eirik says, "Here is your staff, and a fine one it is for a Spiritmaster like you! Use it well, and smash any tomtes you may come across! Thank you!"
You receive a Smack-bone Staff from Eirik!
You have finished the Tomte Plot quest.
H2H:
Thorgil says, "I noticed you are a Savage! I have a special choice for you if you desire it. Would you prefer a [hand to hand pierce] or a [hand to hand slash]?"
I picked the Hand To Hand Slash and Thorgil told me to go see Peter down
the road where you give the Smack Bone to Peter and Peter makes you the "Hand Claws of Smack"
Rewards:
Smack-bone Staff
Hammer of Smack
Smack-bone Axe
Smack-bone Bow
Sword of Smack
Smack-bone Spear
Hand Claws of Smack

midgard|covet wiley.Name: Covet Wiley
midgard|covet wiley.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Aesirda asks you to hunt down a thief by the name of Olag and bring him proof of the deed. Olag only spawns at night and is not far from Aesirda. Kill him and bring back the proof and you will be rewarded with Fimx, a dex ring.
Aesirdia says, "Hail adventurer! I have a task you may be [able to assist] with."
Aesirdia says, "A thug by the name of [Olag] has been stealing our wares [every night]."
Aesirdia says, "He leaves us stupid notes requesting we deliver him someone by the name of [Wiley]."
Aesirdia says, "Yes, we know not exactly when he comes yet we would love to see him [leave for good]."
Aesirdia says, "Aye, it is said Wiley is a thief himself. I know nothing more if it."
Aesirdia says, "If you were to kill him once and for all, we will reward you for it."
You have been given the Covet Wiley quest.
Olag, a named Tomte, spawns only at night and in several (approx) locations:
6830, 53055 near water
3900, 55000 near shoreline
1700, 51500 behind Aerserdia
5600, 49300 stood next to a tree behind Aesirdia's tent.
[Step #1] Olag has been noticed around the camp at night. Find and slay him.
Olag says, "You smell like Wiley! Where is he! Boys... lets get em!"
Olag says, "I'll not let you leave without handing over your wares!"
[Step #2] Return to Aesirdia in Dvalin in East Svealand for your reward.
Aesirdia says, "Ah! Good work to thee. I have an item here that would suit you well. It is of some value alone, yet I have been told it has unlimited potential."
You receive a Fimx from Aesirdia!
You have finished the Covet Wiley quest.
Reward:
Fimx

midgard|thorgil's daughter.Name: Thorgil's Daughter
midgard|thorgil's daughter.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Notes from 1.63 Patch: - Thorgil's Daughter - The tomte Rygnol has been moved back to the Executioner's Room.
This is the third installment of Thorgil's quests. You must complete Tomte Problems and Tomte Plot quests first in that order.
Thorgil's daughter has been kidnapped.
Thorgil says, "My daughter is gone! I know I've spoken of her before.
Thorhalla is the sweetest little girl and her mother and I love her very

much. She went outside to visit the merchants yesterday like she always does, but when it began to grow dark, she didn't come home. I thought that perhaps she was staying with Hulda or Josli, so I went to visit both of them. Neither of them had seen Thorhalla since the middle of the day. That's when I [started to worry]

Thorgil says, "Hulda and Josli helped me ask all of the others in Audliten if they has seen Thorhalla, but no one had seen her since the middle of the day. With one last hope, I headed home, thinking she was hiding somewhere in the house, playing a trick on me. I searched all around but I couldn't find her. All I found was a note written in [a strange language] hidden under the bed."

Thorgil says, "No one around here could read it, but Hulda recognized it. She said that is was tomte writing and that her cousins could read it. I'd go take it to one of them, but I'm afraid to leave the house in case Thorhalla should come back. I would hate to have her find the house empty, since her mother is on her way back from Jordheim. Please, I need your help to [find my daughter]. I feel the tomtes are involved in her disappearance."
Dialog box: Will you help Thorgil find his missing daughter?
You have been given the Thorgil's Daughter quest.

Thorgil says, "Thank you. Here, take the note that was left. After talking with Hulda, she said that Emmerick would be best to help with this matter. He's in a guard tower down the road. Go east out of town and across both the stone bridge and the rope bridge. He's at the top of the tower, watching the tomtes. Be careful on those ladders! Hulda says they can be tricky. Please, get my daughter back!"
You receive a tomte note from Thorgil!
[Step #1] Go speak with Emmerick Averrson in the guard tower. Head east out of Audliten and follow the road across both the stone bridge and the rope one. Continue to the guard tower.
Emmerick Averrson is located in the Dvalin Guard Tower, loc 15k, 53k.

Emmerick Averrson says, "Hello there. My cousin Hulda said Thorgil was going to ask you for help again. I'm glad to see you agreed, for from what Hulda says, Thorgil and his daughter Thorhalla are both very nice people. Hulda sent word that Thorgil found a note written in the tomte language. Let me see it so I can read it."
[Step #2] Give Emmerick the tomte note from Thorgil.
You give Emmerick the tomte note from Thorgil.
Emmerick takes the note and reads it quickly.
ARGH! lost another one!

Emmerick Averrson says, "blah blah and they won't return her until Thorgil pays them for the loss of Smack or they may demand that the people of Audliten abandon the town in exchange for the girl. I don't want to think of the other possibility. you must find out what has become of Thorgil's daughter Thorhalla. To do that, you must be able to understand what the tomtes [are saying]."

Emmerick Averrson says, "Some of them speak the common tongue we all speak, but most of them speak their own language. My cousin Edvard and I have enchanted different pieces of jewelry that allow the wearer to understand the language of the tomtes. Wear this at all times when you enter the [lair of Nisse]. Once you enter the lair, seek out the handler Nioll. Hopefully he will have some clue that will lead you to Thorhalla."
You receive a tomte tooth earring from Emmerick Averrson!
[Step #3] Travel into Nisse's Lair and seek out the tomte handler named Nioll. Remember to wear the tomte tooth earring from Emmerick at all times.

Your best bet would be to put the earring on as soon as you get it. Once inside Nisse's Lair, go down the hall then to the first room on the right when you come to an area where you can go left, forward, or right. This room is filled with Tomte Handlers and a Tomte Warhounds, 3 of each. Nioll will spawn in this room so you will have to kill handlers for a bit to get him to spawn, doesn't take that long, a couple of spawn rounds.
Nioll says, "Invader! I know you are sent here to get the girl! You shall never get her!"
Nioll says, "Too bad I don't have to girl! Captor Rygnol has her now!"
[Step #4] See out the tomte captor, Rygnol. He knows something about Thorhalla's disappearance. Remember to wear the tomte tooth earring.

Rygnol is located in the south entrance to the Executioners room. Be prepared and bring an army, because when Rygnol dies he summons the Executioner and the whole room filled with Tomte Captors and Lair Guards comes at you. I got 9.
Rygnol says, "Executioner! Prepare the girl while I deal with this invader! We shall show all (race here) how we deal with them!"
Rygnol says, "Executioner! Do not let my death pass in vain! Do your duty to Nisse and execute this invader and the girl!"
[Step #5] Kill the Executioner to save Thorhalla. Remember to wear the tomte tooth earring!
You have saved the prisoners!!
The Executioner says, "No! How could you defeat me? May Nisse bring about your destruction! Flee now before he come for you!"
You receive the Executioner's Log from the Executioner!
[Step #6] Thoralla is on her way back to her father. Return to Emmerick in the guard tower.

Emmerick Averrson says, "So you have returned. I'm glad to see you made it out alive. I saw Thorhalla come running out of Nisse's Lair and head back toward Aedliten. Her father will be very pleased that you were able to save the young girl. Now, I wish I could allow you to keep the tomte tooth earring I gave you, but alas, I cannot. Please give it to me now."
[Step #7] Return the tomte tooth earring to Emmerick.
You give the tomte tooth earring.
You are awarded 58, XXX experience!

Emmerick Averrson says, "Thank you. Why, what's that you have? Is that a book you obtained in Nisse's Lair? Please, let me see it! I have been trying to obtain anything the tomtes have written. Hopefully it will be something I can use to aid in the fight against the tomtes."
[Step #8] Give Emmerick the Executioner's Log.
You give the Executioner's Log to Emmerick.

Emmerick Averrson says, "This is a treasure you have brought me! This is the Executioner's log and it contains a list of people he has executed and many orders from Misse himself, as well as future plans for the tomtes. Ny brother and I cannot thank you enough for bringing us this. Please, take this coin and use it to buy yourself something nice. I must go study this and you must go check on Thorhalla.
