Head back up to Audliten and speak with Thorgil."
You are awarded 115,850 experience!
You are awarded 10 silver and some copper!
[Step #9] Return to Thorgil in Audliten.

Thorgil says, "Thank you! I cannot say that enough! My daughter returned to me just as my wife arrived from Jordheim. After a brief reunion, she took Thorhalla off to Jordheim where she will be safe until the problem with the tomtes is resolved. I told my wife I would be giving you something from our [chest of jewels], and she supported the idea completely, for no price is too high for the safety of our child."
[Step #10] Speak with Thorgil and select your reward.

Thorgil says, "Let's see what I have in here. I have a [bracelet] that adds to your magical power, a [ring] that adds to your general well-being, a [necklace] that adds to your devotion, a [bracer] that will make you quite nimble, and a [mirror] that will show just how attractive you are. Choose carefully!"
Bracelet:

Thorgil says, "Here is your Tomte Skin Bracelet. I got this from old Dielf over there. He said he made it a long time ago from the skin of a tomte shaman. Try it on, I know it will look good on you! Thank you again. Let's hope I won't need your help again, but id I should ever call, I know you will answer!"
You receive a Tomte Skin Bracelet from Thorgil!
Ring:
You receive a Tomte Bone Ring from Thorgil!
Necklace:
You receive a Tomte Ear Necklace from Thorgil!
Bracer:
You receive a Tomte Skin Bracer from Thorgil!
Mirror:
*Guessed on name until someone confirms.
Tou have finished the Thorgil's Daughter quest.
Rewards:
Tomte Skin Bracelet
Tomte Ear Necklace
Tomte Crafted Mirror
Tomte Skin Bracer
Tomte Bone Ring

midgard|kyllikki's scrolls.Name: Kyllikki's Scrolls
midgard|kyllikki's scrolls.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per Patch 1.61b:

- Kyllikki's Scrolls - Catla was sometimes giving leather stealth leggings to Healers. For now, healers will need to appeal to have their incorrect reward exchanged for Ukjent Leger leggings. But Catla should now be giving the Ukjent Leger leggings consistently to healers.
There is more than one path to this quest. Scroll down for an optional path.
Catla Gardasdottir says, "Can you feel it? Can you feel the magic that flows
through this land from the great mother of Morvaltar? At time I think I can
fell it, but it still eludes me. If only I could touch that power for just
an instant, I know I could [harness it and use it]! Then my enemies, ah, the enemies of Midgard would cower in the fear before me, er, the armies of King Goran!"
Catla Gardasdottir says, "The Valkyn do not realize what a gift they have
been granted, by being able to call upon the power of the mother. Some of
the Valkyn have actually turned away from that power to worship the weak
gods of Midgard. I've tried to convince some of them to teach me their ways,
but they refuse, providing pathetic excuses? 'It's too dangerous, you'll
get hurt, Norse men and women were never meant to wield that power'! How
dare they lie to me like that? And [that Kyllikki] is the worst of them!?
Catla looks you up and down.

Catla Gardasdottir says, "Kyllikki promised to teach me how to tap into the power of the mother and use the magic granted to the Morvaltar, but she dose nothing but lecture me on the dangers of this spell or that one, and then scribble more things on those scrolls of hers! If I wanted lectures I would have stayed in Jordheim with Gothi of Hel. The time has come for me to do more than just listen! If only I [had her knowledge]."
Catla Gardasdottir says, "A thought just came to me. I know that Kyllikki
will only tell me selected things from the scrolls but never let me actually
read them. I really think she just doesn't like me! But she just might give them so someone else. I will reward you well if you were to [obtain the scrolls] for me."
Dialog box: Will you help Catla obtain Kyllikki's scrolls?
You have been given the Kyllikki's Scrolls quest.
Catla Gardasdottir says, "Kyllikki has the scrolls hidden in the house she
lives in. It is up to you to figure out a way to get them. I've asked her
for them before but she refused, but again, I think it is because she does
not like me. You could try that if you wanted, or you could try [getting
them out] of her house yourself."

Catla Gardasdottir says, "I know Kyllikki likes to take walks, so when she's out you could search the house. Just don?t let her catch you; get out of the house before she returns! She will be angry over someone trying to steal from her. I wouldn?t ask you to do this but I must have that magic if I am to defeat my enemies! Um, I mean, ah, if Midgard wishes to defeat it's
enemies! You will find Kyllikki?s house south of Aegirhamn."
[Step #1] You must get Kyllikki's scrolls. If you wish to ask for the
scrolls, talk with Kyllikki while she is in her house. If you wish to steal
the scrolls, you must wait for Kyllikki to take her walk. Her house is south
of Aegirhamn.
Ok, so I searched for her house South of Aegirhamn all the way to Knarr
in Munin Sound, and couldn't find it. I then realized it's because her house
is exactly west of Catla over the bridge in the newbie area.
Here is where the quest will be quite different depending on choices made.
Option 1
Here is the scenario I took my 34 Healer on: I chose to talk to Kyllikki for the scrolls.
Kyllikki says, "Hello there. Is there something I can do for you?"
[Step #2] Talk to Kyllikki. Tell her you seek the [scrolls of magic].
Kyllikki says, "You want my scrolls do you? Well, they are not for just
anyone! They contain information about powerful magic that has been used by
my people since the dawn of time. It is not for the weak or fearful! I'm
guessing someone told you I had these scrolls and sent you to get them. What
I wonder is who sent you. I have a guess, but I wonder, whom are you getting them for? Perhaps you should tell me before we go any farther."
[Step #3] You must make a choice: Will you be truthful and tell Kyllikki the
scrolls are really [for Catla] or will you lie and tell here the scrolls are
[for me to learn] from?
I chose for me to learn.
Kyllikki says, "Why don't I believe you? Foolish being, return to Catla! She will have to continue her study of Morvaltar magic on her own. I will not
help her anymore. Go back to her now and tell her I would not give you the
scrolls. If she wishes to have them, she should have come herself!"
[Step #4] You must return to Catla Gardasdottir and tell her you [failed to get the scrolls] from Kyllikki when she asks for them.
Catla Gardasdottir says, "It is about time you have returned. Time has grown
short while I have been awaiting the scrolls. Give them to me now."

Catla Gardasdottir says, "What? How could you fail! Argh, I should have gone myself. I have learned the lesson that I'm sure Kyllikki wanted me to learn. Ah well, I only needed the scrolls to confirm what I overheard Kyllikki [once telling someone]."
[Step #5] Talk to Catla about what she needs to tap into the power of the
mother.

Catla Gardasdottir says, "She said that each morvalt carries a totem that helps them draw upon the power of the mother. By gathering three of these totems I shall be able to draw upon that power myself. Since you failed to get the scrolls, you must now go and get these totems for me. Morvalt fast-walkers, morvalt spotters, and morvalt jakthasts carry the totems. You must get a totem from each one and return to me. Do not try to use the totems yourself, for you do not know the ritual!!"
[Step #6] Kill a morvalt fast-walker to get the totem it carries. They can be found in the camps east of the stone bridge near Aegirhamn.
Go kill the morvalt fast-walker. Approx loc 51,38. If you can't find one of these, just give up the quest now. There's no hope for you.
You receive a fast-walker totem from the morvalt fast-walker!
[Step #7] Kill a morvalt spotter to get the totem it carries.
Go kill the morvalt spotter. Approx loc 55,32. I found one up on top of a
near-by hill.
You receive a spotter totem from the morvalt spotter!
[Step #8] Kill a morvalt jakthast to get the totem it carries.
Go kill the morvalt jakthast. Approx loc 55,32. I found them on the same
hill as the spotter.
You receive a jakthast totem from the morvalt jakthast!
[Step #9] You must now decide: Will you return to Catla Gardisdottir now OR
will you experiment with the totems and try to use them yourself?
Oh, come on! What do you think I did?
You attempt to use the jakthast totem.
Nothing seems to happen when you use the totem
You attempt to use the fast-walker totem.
Nothing seems to happen when you use the totem
You attempt to use the spotter totem.
You use the spotter totem.
A searing pain rushes through your body and the totems all crumble into
dust!
[Step #10] You have failed to use the totem correctly. You have destroyed
all of them! You must return to Catla Gardasdottir now.
Catla Gardasdottir says, "Could you be any slower? Give me the totem from
the fast-walker. I have been practicing the spell and I know how to use
them. Quickly now!"
[Step #11] Tell Catla you accidentally [destroyed the totems].
Catla Gardasdottir says, "You destroyed them? How? The only way to destroy
them is to use them! By Hel and all the other gods of Midgard, I told you
not to use them! Do you not listen? And now I bet you expect me to give you
a reward? Hah! You?re lucky, because I have found a Valkyn who will tell me
more about the mother. Here take this; I don?t want it. Do not let it be
said that Catla doesn't fulfill her promises."
You are awarded 463,400 experience! (at level 34)
You are awarded 14 silver and some copper!
You have finished the Kyllikki's Scrolls Quest.
You receive Ukjent Leger leggings from Catla Gardasdottir!
Option 2
Here is the scenario I took my 15 Warrior on
I chose to steal the scrolls.
You have entered Kyllikki's house. Search the area for her hidden scrolls.
You search Kyllikki?s house for hidden scrolls.
You have found Kyllikki?s hidden scrolls!
You receive Kyllikki's scrolls from Kyllikki's house!
[Step #3] You have found the scrolls! You must get out of the house before
Kyllikki returns or she will catch you!
You have made it safely out of Kyllikki's house!
[Step #4] You have succeeded in getting out of Kyllikki's house without
being caught. Now you must choose: Do you return to Catla Gardasdottir OR
use them yourself?
Since I'm a big dumb warrior, I thought it best that I just give Catla
the scrolls.
Catla Gardasdottir says, "It is about time you have returned. Time has grown
short while I have been awaiting the scrolls. Give them to me now."
[Step #5] Give Catla Gardasdottir the scrolls you obtained from Kyllikki.
Catla Gardasdottir says, "Wonderful, wonderful! This confirms what I
suspected already. I had overhead Kyllikki talk about these totems before
but I could not remember exactly which ones she said to use. Now I know.
Since you were so successful in obtaining the scrolls, I know I can
trust you to [get the totems] I need."
Catla Gardasdottir says, "There are three of them that I need. The first
comes from a morvalt fast-walker. After you obtain that one, you must get
one from a morvalt spotter. The third totem comes from the morvalt jakthast.
I must have all three if I am to use them to draw upon the power of the
mother. Go now and obtain them, but I warn you, do not try to use them
yourself! They are powerful and could bring great harm down upon those that
use them incorrectly!"
[Step #6] Kill a morvalt fast-walker to get the totem it carries. They can
be found in the camps east of the stone bridge near Aegirhamn.
Go kill the morvalt fast-walker. Approx loc 51,38. If you can?t find one
of these, just give up the quest now. There?s no hope for you.
You receive a fast-walker totem from the morvalt fast-walker!
[Step #7] Kill a morvalt spotter to get the totem it carries.
Go kill the morvalt spotter. Approx loc 55,32. I found one up on top of a
near-by hill.
You receive a spotter totem from the morvalt spotter!
[Step #8] Kill a morvalt jakthast to get the totem it carries.
Go kill the morvalt jakthast. Approx loc 55,32. I found them on the same
hill as the spotter.
You receive a jakthast totem from the morvalt jakthast!
[Step #9] You must now decide: Will you return to Catla Gardisdottir now OR
will you experiment with the totems and try to use them yourself?
Catla Gardasdottir says, ?I have been awaiting your return. Please give me
the totem from the fast-walker.?
[Step #10] Give Catla Gardasdottir the fast-walker totem.
Catla Gardasdottir says, "Ah, this hums with power! Now please, give me the
totem from the morvalt spotter."
[Step #11] Give Catla Gardasdottir the spotter totem.
Catla Gardasdottir says, "This one whispers to me. I can almost feel the
magic flowing through me now. Now hand me the totem form the morvalt
jakthast."
[Step #12] Give Catla Gardasdottir the jakthast totem.
Catla attempts to use the totems!
[Step #13] Receive your reward from Catla Gardasdottir.
Catla Gardasdottir says, "By Hel and all the other gods of Midgard! I have

never felt such pain as what I just felt. The entry in the scrolls must have been wrong. I shall have to study it more and talk with Kyllikki again. But before I do that I must reward my loyal servant. Please, take this with my thanks. You tried, and it is not your fault the totems did not work as I hoped. One day I shall have control of the powers of the mother of the Morvalt and all shall cower before me! Er, um, I mean before Midgard!"
You are awarded 159,390 experience! (at level 15)
You are awarded 18 silver and some copper!
You have finished the Kyllikki's Scrolls quest.
You receive Ukjent Kjemper leggings from Catla Gardasdottir!
Another option:

When I talked to Kyllikki, I told her the scrolls were [for Catla]. She then told me how dangerous they were, but said she was tired of trying to reason with Catla, and gave me the scrolls. It then put me on Step #4 of Option 2.
Rewards:
Ukjent Vill Kriger Leggings -- Berserker
Ukjente Skygge Leggings -- Shadowblade
Ukjent Jeger Leggings -- Hunter
Rewards:
Ukjent Jeger Leggings
Ukjent Kjemper Leggings
Ukjent Leger Leggings
Ukjente Pants
Ukjent Musikk Leggings
Ukjent Vill Kriger Leggings
Ukjente Skygge Leggings

midgard|looking ahead.Name: Looking Ahead
midgard|looking ahead.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: I have information about a quest in Midgard called "Looking Ahead". I was a 26 Thane at the time I revcieved and completed it but the quest is much lower since the only person killed conned grey to me.

It starts in FT. Atla with a Dwarf in the Tavern named Greyfell. When you speak to him he complains about not knowing his ancestory and send you to his uncle in Mularn, even providing you with a ticket to go there and a pint of stout to gfet his uncle drunk (I do not know what it was for, I did not need it).
Step 1: Speak to Greyfell's uncle in Mularn

When you get to Mularn and speak to his uncle he talks about his proud ancestory and how he was attacked on the way to Mularn by a named Skogsfru (Guthr). Guthr stole a locked chest with a journal from some ancestor of his who talked about a strange other land. He also mentions he left the key in Audliten when he left for the Vale.
Step 2: Kill Guthr at the fork in the river in West Svealand
I found Guthr with the Skogsfu in West Svealand (49433, 20274) and he was grey to a 26 Thane.
Step 3: Search the cabinets in Audliten for the key
...Go straight into the Audliten house with two short, blond-bearded Armor Merchants standing outside (Gruth & Deilf), just North of the bind stone.
Search the cabinet on the left wall (near Olav) ~ search it several times.
Message 1: " " searches inside a cabinet!
You fail to find what you seek!
Keep searching until the message changes to:
Message 2: " " pulls something out of the cabinet! ... (noted by Nukluk)
The key can be retrieved in the hut N of the bind stone in the cabinet next to Olav (step in front of it and wait a few seconds, if it doesn't work at first, just try again) ;)
Step 4: Take the key and the chest to Greyfell
Go back to Ft. Atla and give Greyfell the stuff. His ancestor possess him and he says some cool stuff.
In the end I was awarded with a Runed Symbol of Shortbeard's Clan.
This is a lvl 14 magic necklace that adds +18 to hits.
Handing this item to Longbeard in Aegirhamn will change it to a Symbol of Longbeard's clan. This is not officially part of the quest.
Rewards:
Symbol of Longbeard's Clan
Runed Symbol of Shortbeard's Clan

midgard|evenings empty blessing.Name: Evenings Empty Blessing
midgard|evenings empty blessing.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: The quest begins in Mularn after level 15. You talk to the Aegan, the guy next to the wagon in Mularn. He asks you to take a Bear Mask to Kell in Fort Veldon. Kell is the weapon merchant in the building on the east side of the village. He tells you to talk to Sydney inside the guard tower near the fort. She asks you to bring anything to tell who the Vendo are. Go to the lake vendo camp and kill vendo there until you get a bear skin or bone. Best bet is to kill Vendo Scout Prugor. Return to the Sydney and she sends you to Huginfell to Virge if you got the bearskin, or to Daga in Vasudheim if you got the bone. Virge or Daga translates the item and sends you back to Fort Veldon. After talking to Sydney, find and destroy the vendo leader Rathis (he is in the hunter party that wanders the valley). Rathis coned green to an 18. He is hardly ever alone.
Aegan says, "You have learned much since I spoke to you last."
Aegan says, "It seems there is much amiss to the north around Fort Veldon. Kell sent word earlier that he required [information and assistance]."
Aegan says, "I have done what I can from here, would you care to further [help my friend]?"
Aegan says, "Take this with you and seek out Kell in Fort Veldon. You must hurry!"
You have been given the Evenings Empty Blessing quest.
You receive a bear mask from Aegan!
[Step #2] Speak to Kell; learn of what is happening at Fort Veldon.
You hand Kell the bear mask.
(In case Kell doesn't respond, /say Sydney)
Kell says, "I see you have spoken to Aegan. I'm glad you have come, we are having some [terrible upsets] here lately."
Kell says, "Each evening, as dark appraoches, you can see a clan of what seems to be walking bears [coming from the hills] and laying waste to the area."
Kell says, "They [scare and steal] any livestock our past dark as well as many of our goods. We can 't seem to get anyone to trade with us or to stay in the area for long."
Kell says, "Perhaps [Sydney] can tell you more."
Kell says, "Sydney can be found in guard tower up on the hill. You should hurry."
[Step #3] Speak to Sydney for more information on the situation here.
Sydney says, "There have been many rumors throughout my lifetime [about bears] threatening our homelands. I never thought I would see it with my own eyes."
Sydney says, "They are clans of bear-men, known as the vendo. They [come from the hills] with little else in mind but terrorizing innocents. Be wary, and keep a good lookout."

Sydney says, "I have watched as night falls how the hills to the west come alive with motion. Please make haste and be careful. There are many different ones out there, but thou must seek [a specific one]."
Sydney says, "Seek out the vendo stalkers in the surrounding hills. Bring back to me anything you may be able to obtain from them."
[Step #4] Search for those known as the vendo stalker in the surrounding hills. Bring back whatever you can.
Kill Vendos, get a ragged bear skin or bone.
[Step #5] Return the ragges bear skin to Sydney in Fort Veldon.
You hand Sydney the ragged bear skin.
Sydney says, "Hmm, it appears there is writing upon these skins. However I
cannot [translate what it says]."
Sydney says, "I only know of one person who could translate such runes. I,
however, don?t know where to [find Virge]."
Sydney says, "Please find Virge and have him translate. He is the only one
who can help solve this riddle now."
You receive a ragged bear skin from Sydney!
[Step #6] Find Virge and see if he can translate the runes upon the Bear Skin.
You give Virge the ragged bear skin.
Virge says, "Well hello stranger. What is this you give me?"
Virge says, "You have gotten this from a fabled vendo! I have nothing like this in my lifetime. Tis quite amazing I tell you. May I [keep this]?"
Virge says, "I shall try and translate these runes the best I can and send you back with it."
Virge scribbles down text quickly and give it to you.
You receive the vendo rune translations from Virge!
[Step #7] Return to Sydney with the translation.
Sydney says, "You have returned! I feel you are just in time, the evening comes quickly."
Sydney says, "All it says is [Rathis]..."
Sydney says, "Rathis must be important. Possible a leader. That should be our target."
[Step #8]It is time to seek out the Vendo captain known as Rathis!
Rathis says, "You have defeated me, but you shall never defeat the vendo!"
Rathis says, "Do not think you have won!"
You receive Berbenet Leggings from Rathis!
You are awarded experience!
You have finished the Evenings Empty Blessing quest.
Reward:
Berbenet Leggings

midgard|lover's circle.Name: Lover's Circle
midgard|lover's circle.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per patch 1.69:
- Lover's Circle - Quest Journalists will no longer remove this quest from players' completed quest list. Players over level 25 may once again obtain this quest.

Talk to Sugnhild in Huginfell. She speaks of a bad last winter and staying on in town because she lost her beloved husband because of it. Her husband was set upon by a creature named Swift who is found near the border gates. She asks you to return the ring Swift stole from her husband.
Sugnhild says, "Good day to you. I have heard stories of your travels being told at some of the tables at our local inn. I wish someone like you were around during [last winter]."
Sugnhild says, "Last winter was indeed a sad one for me. I lost my [loved one] and also the ring that he gave me in case something might befall him."

Sugn hild says, "Aye my friend, my husband was a wonderful man. His name was Fridgier and he was one of the most dashing men I have ever set eyes upon. He was sent on a mission by [Gudlor] and never returned. He said he could not tell me where he was going. I [searched many weeks] for him but to no avail."
Sugnhild says, "Gudlor is the town leader, Perhaps you should see him sometime."

***You go see Gudlor after you finished this and he gives you the Protect Huginfell quest. I went to him before completing the Lover's Circle and got the Protect Huginfell, he said to worry about Redhands later, which is another quest called Living Warning.

Sugnhild says, "While out one day, I was beset upon by this small sprite andhis followers. He laughed and called me names and then sapped me while I wasn't looking. When I awoke, I was in the bare and left in the woods to die. It was only by the hand of a Skadi that I was able to find furs and food enough to make it back to town. I have never gone out again for that creature stone the [ring] my husband gave me from my finger. All I have left to live for is my duty as a town guard."
Sugnhild says, "I wish I could have my ring again. Maybe you could go and get it for me."
You have been given the Lover's Circle quest.

Sugnhild says, "Oh thank you! I will tell you what I know. The creature that robbed me kept repeating the same words over and over. It said swift as swift may be, you can catch me. I believe I was near the boundary gates but I can't be for sure. I will reward you greatly for my ring if you manage to find it. Journey well and good luck."
[Step #1] Search for Swift near the boundary gates.
Swift should be around 53000,6400 in West Svealand. She conned yellow at level 17.
Swift says, "Get away from me!"
Swift says, "I don't have any stupid ring. Leave me alone."
Swift drops a ring as she screams in pain.
You receive a Ring of Illbane from Swift.
You receive XXX experience points!
[Step #3] Return the ring to Sugnhild in Huginfel
Sugnhild look at you with tears in her eyes, as if waiting for something.
Sugnhild says, "Oh, you have returned! Do you have my ring? I will pay you 40 silver for it. Just give it to me."
[Step #4] Give the ring to Sugnhild.
You give Sugnhild the Ring of Illbane.
Sugnhild dances around gleefully showing of her ring. Thank you!

Sugnhild says, "Oh thank you so much. I am so happy. Thank you! Thank you! Oh. Oh but wait. Here, you should keep it. You've gone through so much to get it. I've learned it's not the most important thing to me at all."
You receive a Ring of Illbane from Sugnhild.
You are awarded experience!
You have finished the Lover's Circle quest
You are awarded 40 silver and some copper!
Reward:
Ring of Illbane

midgard|paranoid guard.Name: Paranoid Guard
midgard|paranoid guard.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to Agnor Crusher, he is located just north of the buildings near the waters edge in Huginfell. He'll go into a spiel about little monsters spying on the town or something. Talk it through and you'll get the Paranoid Guard Quest.

Agnor Crusher says, "Hail. You look well. These are tense times for the guards. We have noticed more shadows in the surrounding area lately. We believe something or someone is [getting ready to attack]."
Agnor Crusher says, "Bork says I am seeing things but I think there is a small creature taking notes on us along the river. Maybe you could go and investigate for me."

Squirt is a water sprite and can be located along the shore, in front of the hut where all the Bloodfegs are. It's just N-NWish of Agnor Crusher. If you face the town from the blodfelag hut, you'll see him. Squirt is just south of the same hut in the water. You may have to kill a few place holders to get Squirt to spawn. Loc is 54750, 36610. Squirt conned yellow to me at lvl 15. I took her down and was awarded a ring as well as got Squirt's Hidden Notes.
[Step #1]
Search river and get proof of spying from Squirt.
Squirt drops some hidden notes.
You receive Squirt's notes from Squirt!
You receive a Watercast Ring from Squirt!
[Step #3]
Return and give Squirt's notes to Agnor Crusher
Agnor Crusher says, "This is just the proof I needed. Great job! I am going to go and give this to Bork so he can show it to the council. Thank you again for the excellent work."
You are awarded experience!
You have finished the Paranoid Guard quest.
Reward:
Watercast Ring

midgard|reach of the shadow.Name: Reach of the Shadow
midgard|reach of the shadow.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Aylarn says, "Is it true you are a [protector] of Midgard?"
Aylarn says, "I have heard rumors of an evil creature that wears a magical cloak. Perhaps you would like me to [share the tale] I heard."
You have been given the Reach of the Shadow quest.

Aylarn says, "One rainy night, a wild man came out of the lands directly behind our tent. He kept babbling about evil spectres and weird mages summoning creatures for the night. I thought he had lost his mind until the same thing happened a [few nights] later."
Aylarn says, "A young dwarf came stumbling out of the brush and cried for hours. He said he was the son of Arik of Haggerfel. He said he was only 14 winters old and had become [lost]."

Aylarn says, "He said a strange robed creature that called herself Ulga, had led him into the forest in promise of adventure and [cast some magic] on him. He said he wandered the forest for the last two nights."
Aylarn says, "I did not have the heart to explain to him what had happened. If there is a creature stealing life wandering about the forest, then someone should put an end to that. Don't you think?"

Aylarn says, "I would start by looking in the forest where the travelers came from. You might find something off in that direction. Be wary my friend. We wouldn't want to have to go hunting for you as well.
[Step #1] Travel deep into the forest and find Ulga.

To find Ulga, from Aylarn (in front of lean-to) run west, then you'll see the tower and the camp of Bloodfellags. At the camp take the path and head a bit northwest (maybe a bit more north than west) then we saw her wandering around.
*Alternate directions:

Go to Audliten, go north across the bridge and take a left at the crossroad. Follow that trail a ways until you get to the top of the hill where there is another crossroad. Take a left (If you go right, you will end up at the West Gate). Follow the path until the next crossroad. There are 2 stumps, one on the south side of the path and one on the north side. If you stand next to the one on the south side and point yourself due South, go forward and you will run into a tree. Just past that tree is where I saw her each time. I hope this helps reduce some of your search time.
Be careful, there are also some wolfpacks running around there too. Ulga conned blue at lvl 15
Approximate Loc sights (she does roam):
Kill Ulga, she conned blue to a level 15. She did attack, did not have to provoke her.
You receive a Driftspirit Cloak from Ulga!
You have finished the Reach of the Shadow quest.
You get 15094 experience points.
Reward:
Driftspirit Cloak

midgard|brack: rollo's story.Name: Brack: Rollo's Story
midgard|brack: rollo's story.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: You must complete the Simple Misgivings quest first. This is also DWARF only.

The Bartender in Jordheim and in Haggerfel tells you of spirit of smith in hills near Haggerfel. Hilde the smith in Haggerfel tells of Rollo, an apprentice who lost an object of power of his master's. Heading straight out the gates of Haggerfel into the hills in that direction is Rollo [Smith], a dwarven ghost (at night). He sends you to kill Ugnof Toestubber down in Huginfell (he is yellow at 16 and patrols around Huginfell with a blodfelag henchman/partisan (blue) and a wolfhound(gray)). He drops a Brack's {something}. You have to return to Haggerfel and talk to Hilde. She says keep the hammer, gives you 42 silver and exp and gives you Word of Dwarven deeds to take to your trainer. Giving the deed to the trainer finishes the quest and gives more xp.
Rollo says, "Unjust! Yes, I have been wronged! I shall not rest, nay, I
[can't rest]!"
Rollo says, "Surely, the smith told you? My story is one [passed down] the line of dwarven smiths. The story of how I, Rollo, failed my master, Brack."
Rollo says, "Aye, it is passed down. Brack left me to care for items he had
forged or helped create for use by all Dwarves. I failed! Ugnof and his men
heard of this changeable item and [stole it]."
Rollo says, "Aye, stole it. Killed me. For 300 years, the spawn of Ugnof
have been carrying the Brack item. For 300 years I have wandered these hills
cursing his name! I shall not rest until someone can [retrieve the Brack item]."
Dialog box: Will you seek out Ugnof and return the Barck item back to the Dwarven people?
You have been give the Brack -- Rollo's story quest.
Rollo says, "Aye, fare well, then, seek out Ugnof Toestubber in the lands

named Western Svealand (You will find Ugnof walking outside the perimeter of Hugginfel with a Blodfeleg Thralldriver and a Blodfeleg Warhound, both will join in the fight.) Return with Brack to Hilde, in Haggerfel, and my
soul shall rest!"
Rewards:
Brack Shield -- Thane
Brack Axe -- Berserker, Hunter, Skald
Brack Hammer -- Healer and Warrior
Brack Staff -- Runemaster
Rewards:
Brack Shield
Brack Axe
Brack Hammer
Brack Staff

midgard|protect huginfell.Name: Protect Huginfell
midgard|protect huginfell.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: *All classes can do this quest, but not all can wear the reward. The reward is a chain mail item.

Talk to Gudlor in Huginfell, who states that they have heard word that the town will be attacked by the Blodfelags. You are asked to protect Hugginfell by killing the leader of a band of blodfelag. His name is Thegn Aki.

Gudlor says, "Hail, the town needs your help. I have received word from our spies that the Blodfelag are planning to attack. We must stop them before they do. Do you think you have the strength of character to help us?"
You have been given the Protect Huginfell quest.

Gudlor says, "Ahh, good! Perhaps this may not be our darkest day afterall. The Blodfelag have a camp down the road past the Svartalf village where they plan to attack from. You must go to that camp and find their Captain, a man called [Thegn Aki]. He is an infamous killer who wil show no mercy to you or any that aid you. I suggest you gather as many men as you can before you attack his camp."
Gudlor says, "It is said he wears a special helm, crafted for his sire, the great [General Aki]. I am sure it is magical however I am not quite sure its purpose."

Gudlor says, "General Aki was said to be a great leader among men. Unfortunately, he only allowed men in his ranks. He was a friend of [Konung], Botolf's father. General Aki was reumored to be able to use magic as well, only his dead enemies knew just how much though."
Gudlor says, "Go gather your forces and quit wasting time! There will be time to worry about Redhands later. May the gods have mercy on us if you fail."
[Step #2] Find the Blodfelag camp and slay Thegn Aki.
You will need a group or a good mate to help if you are lower than 17 or so. Aki is orange to 16.
You have finished the Protect Huginfell quest.
You receive a Helm of the Aki from Thegn Aki.
Your standing with the Blodfelag has decreased.
You get XXXXX experience points.
Reward:
Helm of the Aki

midgard|tomte of doom.Name: Tomte of Doom
midgard|tomte of doom.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per live patch first week in Nov:
- Tomte of Doom - Yandu wouldn't respond to players trying to choose a circlet. This has been fixed, players can go back and talk to Yandu. The journals now have the trigger word: [inventory]
- Midgard Quests: Tomte of Doom - Players should no longer have difficulty selecting their reward.
Yandu thinks that the tomtes are building powerful artifact and asks for your assistance to keep this from happening.
1) Speak to Yandu in East Svealand. Yandu is located on the island east of the entrance to Nisse's Lair. This is the area you zone out to if you exit from the Warlord's room.

2) Kill the Haunt in Nisse's Lair. He can be found wandering around the Spider section of the dungeon. If coming from the entrance just hang a left in the first room and you will go up the stairs and find this area. The haunt patrols within sight of the ramp from the Shaman room. She will drop a piece of a map.

3) Kill Nisse in Nisse's Lair. He can be found in the large room that used to be the most difficult section of Nisse's Lair, but since the new addition, not that hard. He is usally surrounded by many other tomtes. He will drop a second piece of the map.
4) Use the map(drag on to your toolbar and click the use button, usually the "E" key) and then return to Yandu in East Svealand, she will tell you that the map is not complete.
5) Kill Hnaki in Nisse's Lair. He patrols not deep in to the new area of Nisse's Lair. He will drop a third piece. Use it (see above for how to use).
6) Kill Skirr in Nisse's Lair. He patrols around the Warlord's room. If you do this quest below level 25 you will need a group for this part. He drops the fourth piece to the map. Use it.

7) Kill Callilepis Nocturna in Nisse's Lair. She is the boss in the spider area. This is another tough fight that will require a group. But if you are a stealther there is no need to kill her, just stealth in and see next step.
8) Search the area behind Callilepis Nocturna and you will find an artifact. Just start clicking the area. If you have the quest advanced to this point it will eventually find it.
9) Give the artifact to Yandu in East Svealand for your choice of rewards.
Reward Choices:
Vest of Audumbla (PIE, STR)cloth, studded, and chain
Sleeves of Buril (PIE, POW)cloth, studded, and chain
Leggings of Borr (STR, DEX) leather, studded, and chain
Jewel of Bestla (Resists)
Gloves of Woden (DEX, QUI) leather, studded
Circlet of Willi (CHA, STR)
Boots of Weh (DEX, HP) cloth, leather, studded, chain
Rewards:
Gem of Bestla
Boots of Weh (chain)
Leggings of Borr
Jewel of Bestla
Boots of Weh (cloth)
Vest of Audhumbla
Circlet of Willi

midgard|waking of the fallen.Name: Waking of the Fallen
midgard|waking of the fallen.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to Saydyn, the Healer in Huginfell. He will ask you to slay the lich Broch. Broch looks like a ghoul, is level 16 and dwells in the following location : west of Huginfell there is a ridge that you shall come to. On the southwestern part of this ridge is a higher hill with a little village (tower and house) built on it with blodfelag guards and warhounds. You shall head to there but stop before coming to this upper hill. Broch wanders nightwhile just on the southestern edge of the lower ridge you are on.
Saydyn says, "Well met, Traveler. Our Lady Eir has giving me [visions] that you would come. The goddess has delivered you to us."

Saydyn says, "I have seen visions of a vile creature that has turned against the gods themselves. I could only watch, helpless, as it captured lone travelers and changed them into the [walking dead]."
Saydyn says, "If he is not stopped, he will gather an army of dead and begin launching attacks on the cities of our fair lands. Lady Eir has called upon you to help us. Will you [answer her call]?"
You have been given the Waking of the Fallen quest.

Saydyn says, "Oh thank you! We are truly blessed today. Perhaps you will find something of value that you can use to champion the lands of Midgard. Let me see if I can remember how to [find the creature] from my visions."

Saydyn says, "The foul stench of the creature is enough to almost guide you there but you may find it by heading down the road and walking on the ridge across from the Svartalf village. May Thor himself smile on your journey."
[Step #2] Kill Broch before he summons his minions. You may find him by heading down the road and walking on the ridge across from the Svartalf village.

But you shall not attack him when he wanders here or he would have dozens of ghouls and spirits to help him in battle - once you engage him he indeed calls all the undead in the nearby mile to help him. You have to slay him just when he spawns. He spawns more to the south, in the middle of the plain, shortly after the first drifting spirits begin to appear, and shortly before the other sanguinine ghouls appear. And he will head to the north. He will disappear at 5 AM just like all other undead.
You have finished the Waking of the Fallen quest.
You are awarded XXXXXX experience!
Broch drops a bag of coins.

Broch drops the usual Sanguinine Ghoul items, but if you have the quest when you kill him he will also give you a magical belt that adds 2 points to your Strength, Constitution and Quickness! You don't have to return to Saydyn and won't be granted supplementary experience.
*Official hint: Players stuck on step 1 of this quest need to return to Saydyn and /say [find the creature].
Reward:
Toe Bone Belt (Mid)

midgard|protecting the healer.Name: Protecting the Healer
midgard|protecting the healer.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to Samlauf Kolsson in Huginfell, who tells you to kill the Svartalf

assassin named Golga and his band of mercenaries before they attack and kill the town healer. Around evening time Golga (a kobold rogue of some sort) and 4 chanters will make their way to Healer Saydyn into town and attack him. Kill them and talk to Saydyn again to receive your reward.
Samlauf Kolsson says, "You are here just in time! I just have gotten a report that the svartalf have send assassins to slay Saydyn, our town healer. You must stop then before they can do that."
Dialog quest box:
Protect Saydyn from the assassin Golga.
You have been given the Protecting the Healer quest.
[Step #1] Hurry and protect the Healer Saydyn from harm.
Kill Golga and the rest is easy, we only had to kill Golga and the two that stayed with him.
[Step #3] Talk to Saydyn and make sure he is alright.
Saydyn says, "Thank the gods you were around to save me. I would shudder to think what may have happened if you were not there. Perhaps this gift may aid you in protecting other people as well."
You receive a The Healer's Defender from Saydyn!
You have finished the Protecting the Healer quest.
PRN Guide to this quest:
Step 1 Talk to Samlauf Kolsson in Huginfell.
Step 2 Talk to healer Saydyn in Huginfell.
Step 3 Talk to healer Saydyn again. This releases the kobold mob.
Step 4 Kill the kobold assassin Golga and his mob of kobolds.

Step 5 If you defend healer Saydyn, but do not get the kill on Golga, travel into forest toward blodfelags, and Golga is in the Kobold Camp to your right after you leave town. You may kill him there. Easy kills, FAST respawn, nice loot, good bonus XP. Players are timid about villages and camps in the area because they can be tough. This village is a pushover but beware the fast spawns. Level 20ish Warrior and Healer could not wipe out village before respawn consistantly. Respawn not that bad if you have good faction. These guys work off of svartalf faction I believe and do not aggro if you have fought your spiders by Gna Faste.

Step 6 If you fail to defend the Healer Saydyn, I do not know what happens regarding this quest. It is my assumption that Saydyn is more buff than yall are, and if you fail you will perish before him. Then go to the village and cap Golga and everything should be fine.
Step 7 After successful kill of Golga return to Saydyn for your reward.
Rewards:
Nightsworn
The Healer's Defender

midgard|morana's tunic.Name: Morana's Tunic
midgard|morana's tunic.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to Sentry Dwarn on top of the tower at Gna Faste. He tells you a
story about Morana and her God. He speaks of a Tunic that was bestowed upon her by the god and asks you to seek out Morana and return her to her god.
Sentry Dwarn says, "Greetings fellow adventurer. Would you care to hear a [tale]?"
Sentry Dwarn says, "Wonderful, let me tell you of [Morana], the pious Saracen."

Sentry Dwarn says, "Aye, Morana, never a more pious woman was to be had here in Midgard. She was a slave here, brought back from a raid on a settlement in northern Albion. She never complained about her plight, but she continuously [prayed]."
Sentry Dwarn says, "She prayed several times a day to her God. When the fever struck her, she prayed even harder, asking him to [preserve her piety]. He granted her wish."
Sentry Dwarn says, "It was said that her God took part of her soul and imbued it within a [tunic] she had been making.

Sentry Dwarn says, "This tunic, once given her spirit, danced away, out into the forest and was never seen again. I, for one, believe that no such thing happened, but if you're up for some [adventure], I can tell you where most think it is."
Dialog box: Do you accept the Morana's Tunic quest?
You have been given the Morana's Tunic quest.

Sentry Dwarn says, "I'm glad to hear you're up for a challenge, no matter how fantastical the story is. You can find Morana to the southwest of here, along with her kinsmen. What they are in search of, though, I do not know. Good luck adventurer!"
[Step #1] Seek out Morana to the southwest and return her spirit to her God.

Morana spawns with a Mora Dancer at 30752, 62327 and when Morana doesn't spawn, two Mora Dancers will. The spawn site is near a hill just off the base of the mountain, and somewhat near Niswen and the entrancing dirges. Morana is part of the Mora clan.
You receive a Dancing Silk from Morana!
You have finished the Morana's Tunic quest.
You get XXX experience points.
Reward:
Dancing Silk

midgard|the wanestone jewel.Name: The Wanestone Jewel
midgard|the wanestone jewel.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per Patch 1.60:
- Gokstad's Jewel - This level 18 Hunter only quest, given out by Singrid, has been renamed "The Wanestone Jewel" quest to avoid confusion with the level 11 Shadowblade trainer quest, "Jewel Hunt".

There are actually two Wanestone Jewel quests, one for Shadowblades and one for Hunters. This is the Hunter version. The one for Shadowblades is called Gokstad: Wolves in Myrkwood. You get the backstory to this at about 11th level, but you don't get the quest itself until around 18th. At 18th, Singrid the Hunter Trainer (is located in Jordheim, second building to the left of the entrance from East Svealand), will tell you to go find Gokstad. Gokstad is a Troll, usually found wandering around just outside the gates of Muspelheim (not to be confused with GokSTORM, who is a considerably higher-level named giant who drops a fire cloak!). When you talk to Gokstad, he will attack you. He's blue at 19th, and a fairly easy kill. As he dies, he will say something about a jewel eaten by Haglion's minions, and that "one is true and two are false".

Haglion's minions are found in Myrkwood after dark. If you go southwest from Gna Faste until you find yourself surrounded by mora dancers and riders, you're in the right area. Haglion himself is a named werewolf - you don't have to kill him for this quest. His minions are large wolves. You'll get either "fishbone necklace" or "Wanestone Jewel necklace" from them - the Wanestone Jewel is the one you want. The number of minions you have to kill seems to be variable - I got the Wanestone Jewel from my third minion, but one of my guildmates has killed nearly a dozen and seen nothing but fishbones. Once you get the Wanestone Jewel, go back to Singrid. She will give you xp and tell you to keep the necklace.
Reward:
Wanestone Jewel Necklace

midgard|fervent.Name: Fervent
midgard|fervent.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: You must complete the Sveawolf Guardian quest first.
The elder sveawolf says, "Greetings, it is nice to scent you again. Our kind depends heavily upon scent. Remember that for it may save your life one day. Our clan has a [problem]."
The elder sveawolf says, "We have had a recent problem arise in our clan. One of our senior elders has declared war of vengeance on all the creatures of Midgard. She has ruthlessly

gone about slaying any who cross her path. The other elders have suggested attempting to get the pack leader of the evil two-leggers to go out and slay her, but I am against this for I fear they would turn on us. Yet, she [must be removed] from hurting others."
Dialog box: Follow the elder sveawolf and slay Wildtooth.
You have been given the Fervent quest.

The elder sveawolf says, "Thank you. I am old and the way there is long, else I would guide you there myself. You must search out Wildtooth in West Svealand and stop her. You will find her near the fort of the blodfelags. I wish you well."
[Step #2] Find Wildtooth and her minions. Wildtooth can be found behind the blodfelag fort in West Svealand.
Locs:
Elder Sveawolf: 61312, 55636
Wildtooth: 5000, 13000 and cons org at 19, so BAF.
Reward:
Fervent Jewel

midgard|helping the arachites.Name: Helping the Arachites
midgard|helping the arachites.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Must do The Creatures of Myrkwood quest first.

As a 22 troll Thane I was tasked to kill a shrieking willow for an axe handle, followed by a dark hound for its tooth. Both are found in Myrkwood, along the SE shore of the lake, which is south of the werewolf fortress of Askheim. Stand in location 25k,57k and you will have both in sight (trees to you W, hounds to your E). Both conned blue.

Upon returning these items to Dunfjall, he tasked me with killing the svartalf sorceress Te'Delna. I found her in position 61k,60k-just south of the svartalf camp in the SE corner of Myrkwood. She conned yellow and brought along a green svartalf sorcerer.

I returned her blood to Dunfjall and was told to meet with the arachite Thraxia by the skull post just across the bone bridge near Nallitan. Thraxia appears from 8am-4pm (game time) every day, right next to the post. In return for the axe Dunfjall made for her, she gave me :
Silver Web Bracer, lvl 21 item, +1 Parry, +1 Axe, +3 Strength, 4% slash resist.
Rewards:
Silver Web Bracer -- Thane
Silver Spider Bracelet -- Shadowblade
Silver Silk Cuff -- Runemaster, Bonedancer and Spiritmaster
Silver Arachite Bracelet -- Healer and Shaman
Rewards:
Silver Silk Cuff
Silver Web Bracer
Silver Spider Bracelet
Silver Arachite Bracelet

midgard|helping the svartalfar.Name: Helping the Svartalfar
midgard|helping the svartalfar.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: After you talk to Atzar and he sends you to Dunfjall, you choose one faction to improve. This is the Svartalf version.

Dunfjall said he could create a bracer for me, and sent me to go kill a dark hound (found south of Gna Faste, in the area of the mora dancers), and a Great Tingler (found north of Gna Faste), and return to him Dark Hound fur and Tingler Silk. ***Your task targets could be different. Other known targets include: Fire Ant Scavenger and Rabid Sveawolf.

Upon returning the fur and silk, he said he needed one more thing to complete the bracer - blood of a werewolf. He sent me to kill Fasolt, at the tower outside of Askheim. After killing Fasolt, the Spirit of Fasolt will spawn in the spot, so be careful.

Killing Fasolt gave me Werewolf blood, which I took back to Dunfjall. He gave me a Svartalf bracer, and said to meet Terje at the skull-topped pole by the bridge south of Nalliten, between 4pm and midnight. It appears that the three factions rotate at that spot.
6. When you give Terje the bracer, he gives you:
Svartsolv Bracer -- Warrior, Berserker, Thane, and Skald
Svartalf Woven Bracelet -- Healer, Shaman
Svartsolv Bracelet -- Hunter, Shadowblade
Rewards:
Svartsolv Bracer
Svartalf Woven Bracelet
Svartsolv Bracelet

midgard|helping the werewolves.Name: Helping the Werewolves
midgard|helping the werewolves.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: You must complete the The Creatures of Myrkwood before you can be given this quest.
You have been given the Helping the Werewolves quest.
The Creatures of Myrkwood steps...
[Step #2] Work with Dunfjall to improve your werewolf status.
Helping the Werewolves steps...
[Step #1] Talk with Dunfjall about the werewolves.

Dunfjall tells this long story that seems to go on and on (dialog will come later). I have at least 6 screenshots of dialog just for the story. He tells you that you need to help him get some items so he can fashion a sword for the werewolves because they need weapons.
[Step #2] Learn what Dunfjall needs for the sword.

[Step #3] Seek out the dryad blossoms in Skona Ravine. Go southwest around Askheim to the cobwebbed log. Head west to the standing stone, then northwest to follow the base of the hill into Skona Ravine until you find the dryad blossoms. (to get dryad blossom skin for the hilt) I found one at 57514, 39384.
Add: In step 3, Go SE to wall, NOT NW. Then proceed south. Blossom Dryads abound near 60k, 40k.
*Standing stones = circle of stones
Next you will need to kill a phantom wolf in West Svealand for it's tooth for the blade. The place for the Phantom Wolves is 23k, 44k, they spawn at 10 PM.
I had to get a fur from a frothing wolf in W-Svealand and a death silk from a Death spider, after bringing it to him he sent me to kill Priestess Araxia (loc 3k 34k).

After killing blossom dryad and phantom wolf, I was told to find Svartalf Priestess Te'Delna near Svartalf camp in Myrkwood. I found Te'Delna in Myrkwood at about 62k, 60k. As reward I received a Silver Wolfhead Bracer.
Rewards:
Silver Full Moon Bracelet
Silver Wolfhead Bracer

midgard|the creatures of myrkwood.Name: The Creatures of Myrkwood
midgard|the creatures of myrkwood.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: 1. I received this quest as a 20th level Thane when I spoke to Atzar in Gna Faste. He told me to go talk to Dunfjall in Nalliten.

Atzar says, "Well, hello there. How are you enjoying Myrkwood? It's a nice place, if you can get along with the creatures that live here. Unfortunately, I can only get one group [to leave me alone] and that's the werewolves."

Atzar says, "I have a friend, Dunfjall, who is an expert at getting people to like him. He used to be a skald and he knows how to charm people. Well, he's spent some time studyingf the arachites, werewolves, and svartalfs and knows all their little secrets. He helped me with my werewolf problem. You know , he could probably [give you a hand] with one of those groups, if you're interested. The thing is, you can only improve your status with one group."
Atzar says, "It would take a little work on your part, but if you're [up to the challenge], I'm sure that Dunfjall would help you. What do you say?"
Dialog box: Would you like to improve your relations with a group of Myrkwood?
You have been given the The Creatures of Myrkwood quest.

Atzar says, "Excellent! I think it will really be worth your time to do what Dunfjall tell you. Now, I guess you need to know where to find him. He's been hiding out in Nalliten because he's kind of on the outs with the blodfelags right now. He's in Nalliten, hiding under the boats. When you see him, tell him that Atzar sent you and he'll be very helpful! Good luck!"
[Step #1] Seek out Dunfjall in Nalliten. He is hiding under the boats. When he asks, tell him [Atzar] sent you.

2. Dunfjall is under the boats. Loc 51k, 34k on the beach. Dunfjall talked about the three factions of Werewolves, Arachites, and Svartalfs, and how you could work them against each other. He asked which faction of those three I would like to improve.
Dunfjall says, "Yeah? What do you want?"
You say, "Atzar sent me."

Dunfjall says, "Oh, you know Atzar? He's a nice gu. He was having a problem with the werewolves and I helped him out. Is that why he sent you here? You have [a problem] with some of the creatures of the forest?"

Dunfjall says, "That happens a lot around here. People get into trouble with the svartalfs and they can't get out of it without some help. I'm that help. I know all their secrets, plus those of the arachites and werewolves. Unfortunately, if I'm popular with one group, the other two groups usually hate me until I do something for them. Then the first group hates me again. It's a never-ending cycle. One day I'll figure out how to get in good with all three groups, but until then, I'll take them one at a time. Now, it's [decision time] for you."

Dunfjall says, "Like I said, I don't know how to become friendly with all three groups. What you do may not make you friendly, but it will help you get close to that goal. I will also warn you now, sometimes you may need a partner to help you do the things I ask. So now, you must choose which group you want to improve your standings with. Will it be the [werewolves], the [svartalfs], or the [arachites]? Choose wisely for you may not change your mind, nor may you work with me again. I cannot reveal all my secrets to you or I would lose my place with all three groups! Now, choose."
After choosing, go to your respective quest link.
This is not a cross realm quest for Mordred and Gaharis servers. Midgard classes only.

midgard|living warning.Name: Living Warning
midgard|living warning.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to Gudlor and after he tells you the story Sugnhild will open up to you and ask for your service to put her husband's soul to rest. The hubby is Fridgeir Gestsson. He's walking around the blodfelag fort - west of Audliten, just follow the road, take a right at the "Y". And he usually has escorts of some kind.

Gudlor says, "You might not like what you hear. Fridgeir used to be a guard here in Huginfel, one of the best actually. I sent him on a secret mission to spy on the [Blodfelag] and he never returned."

Gudlor says, "I have been told that he was captured and his tongue removed. Redhands had one of his Runemasters cast a mind control rune on Fridgeir, turning him into nothing more than a [guard dog]. Now he serves as a warning to any who would dare cross Redhands."

Gudlor says, "I think naught can be done for this Frdgeir and have not told Sugnhild of his plight. Perhaps one day someone will tell her but that is not today. Someone should also [go to the Blodfelag keep] and put Fridgeir out of his misery."
Gudlor says, "What? You think you could? Well all I know about the location of the keep is that it is very far down the road. You will have to get past many dangers to acutally reach it."
Dialog box: Will you release Fridgeir from his fate?
You have been given the Living Warning quest.
Gudlor says, "Good luck my friend. Whatever you do, do not let Redhands capture you. Otherwise you may find out that there are things far worse than death."
[Step #1] Journey to the Blodfelag Keep and release Fridgeir from his fate.
He travels the path beyond the Fort, if you wait to catch him as we patrols you can get him easier. He is accompanied by a dog and a haxa.
Fridgeir Gestsson blinks his eyes as if a spell is broken.
Fridgeir Gestsson says, "Oh thank you great Tyr. Please tell my wife I love her."
You receive a Flame Helm from Fridgeir Gestsson!
You have finished the Living Warning quest.
You get XXXX experience points!
At level 22, go to Sugnhild and tell her that her husband said, "He loved you" and that will open the quest, Sugnhild's Revenge.
Reward:
Flame Helm

midgard|widower hunt.Name: Widower Hunt
midgard|widower hunt.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to an Npc called Yver Tiu, near the entrance of the city. He is studying spiders, and like to get some legs from the soot harvesters in Muspelheim.

Yver Tiu says, I see a wise person stands before me. Did you take heed of my warnings, friend, or do you come to mock me, as so many others do? Most folk find me odd because of my studies of [spiders].

Yver Tiu says, There are so many varieties in Midgard, it would take me days on end to list them all. Im sure a seasoned adventurer like yourself has seen many of them. Perhaps, though, youd be willing to assist an old man with a project?
Yver Tiu says, I have heard there are some oddities with the soot harvester spiders in Muspelheim. Please travel there and retrieve for me a bundle of legs so I may study them.
You have been given the Widower Hunt quest.
[Step #1] Go to Muspelheim and slay a soot harvester.
[Step #2] Return the bundle of harvester legs to Yver in Haggerfel.
Yver Tiu says, Oh ho! Youve returned! Glorious! Now, for the next task. You need to retrieve some more [parts] for me.

Yver Tiu says, My friend, Darrius, who lives in Fort Atla has recently made a strange discovery with some spinnerets. He wants me to look them over. Please take this note to him and bring the spinnerets back to me so I may further examine them.
You receive a note to Darrius from Yver Tiu!

Darius says, Ah, a note from Yver, my old friend. I see he wants you to deliver these spinnerets to him. I wish I had been able to make the delivery myself, but my wife is due any day now. Here are the spinnerets. Be careful, they are very delicate.
You receive silk spinnerets from Darrius.
You are awarded experience!
You are awarded 24 silver and some copper.
[Step #4] Take the spinnerets to Yver in Haggerfel.
Yver Tiu says, Darrius has truly outdone himself this time. I do now see the oddities of which he spoke about in his last letter. Now friend, there is [more to be done].

Yver Tiu says, You are truly a skilled and valuable asset to Midgard. For this, I salute you! Through your bravery and selflessness, you have demonstrated that you are more than [trustworthy] for my next task!

Yver Tiu says, While you were out and about for me, I sent others like you on similar quests. All have returned various spider parts to me, and I am most disturbed at what I see. I believe there are those that are deliberately tampering with the [forces of magic].
Yver Tiu says, I know of one way to cull it, but I require another favour from you. Deep within west Svealand live the Blodfelag clan. Within their ranks are shamantic priests known as the [haxa].

Yver Tiu says, Because the Blodfelag are purely Norse, they have defiled the laws of nature by attempting to subvert the Shamans magic to their own twisted ways. They have destroyed the land around them with their corruption, as well as the animals. These spider parts tell me that their magic is spreading to other parts of the land, not just remaining localised around their fortress. I must obtain a haxa charm necklace in order to perform a [rite] to banish their magic from corrupting any others.
Yver Tiu says, It would take far too long to explain right now, and we are quickly running out of time. Please retrieve this necklace for me so I might curb those that would harm Midgard.
[Step #5] Travel to W. Svealand and kill a blodfelag haxa.
[Step #6] Return the charm necklace to Yver in Haggerfel.

Yver Tiu says, You continue to amaze me brave Kayje. Now, before this rite can be performed, you must take this bundle to Averrius, in Myrkwood. He is an enchanter and can open the magic within these pieces so I may properly focus on the corruption.
You receive a bundle of spider parts from Yver Tiu!
[Step #7] Take Yvers bundle to Averrius in Gna Faste, near the guard tower in Myrkwood Forest.
Averrius says, Interesting, very interesting. Let me see what I can do with this. Please wait.
Averrius says, I am finished. You may return these to Yver. He will now be able to do his rite. I hope he discovers who is behind all this.
You receive enchanted spider parts from Averrius.
[Step #8] Return the enchanted spider parts to Yver in Haggerfel.
Yver Tiu says, The package, thank you friend, thank you. Please wait while I perform this rite and cease the corruption of the Blodfelag once and for all.

Yver Yiu says, It seems I was wrong about the Blodfelag. While there magic is corrupting the wilderness, it is not them that defiles the spiders. Nay, there twisted magic has not spread much farther than their fortress, as I originally said. There is another [force at work here].

Yver Tiu says, While I though it was merely a legend, something to scare children with at night, I see now that I have been a fool. There is a spider of immense power called the [Widower] who roams the woods of Myrkwood.

Yver Tiu says, He is thusly called for the men he has killed and widows he has made. While his power seems weak at the moment, I cannot help but think that it will grow strong soon. My brother has agreed to help up with this. He shall meet you in Myrkwood and together you shall find this creature and slay him. Should he regain his powers, theres no telling [what will happen].
Yver Tiu says, I fear Midgard is in peril friend. Quickly, travel to Myrkwood, he will meet you at the web covered tree near Spindelhalla. Quickly, you must hurry!
[Step #9] Go to Myrkwood and slay the Widower with Yric, Yvers brother.
Yric Tiu is just NW of spindelhalla entrance, loc 3581, 14407.
As soon as you right click on Yric, as if to speak with him, Widower (level 23-24) will appear right there with you and attack you, speaking the following 3 entries constantly until he is dead
Widower says, For so long I have been imprisoned within this fleshy body. You shall feel my pain and Midgard shall feel my wrath!!!
Widower says, You think you can defeat me you children of Valhalla? Try then, fools! I shall be the death of you both!
Yric Tiu says, So, Averrius, I should have known. You Arachite traitor! How dare you defile Midgard with your devious magic! We shall destroy you!
On dying he says
Widower says, The Arachites will slay your family and eat your children.
[Step #10] Speak with Yric again.

Yric Tiu says, You have done well young Kayje. I wish to reward you for your valiant attempts. I will make you a shield with the parts from his carapace. Let me imbue them with the power of Valhalla. This will only take a moment.
Yric Tiu says, Here you are. Use this shield well, and never forget the lessons we both learned here today.
You receive the Widower Shield from Yric Tiu.
You are awarded experience!
You are awarded 3 Gold and some silver.
You have finished the Widower Hunt quest.
Reward:
Widower Shield

midgard|silent death.Name: Silent Death
midgard|silent death.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per Patch 1.59:
- The quest "Silent Death" has been opened to Savages and Bonedancers. Also, ALL rewards for this quest have been changed to "No Sell".
This is the second in a series of quests. Hunting Party is required (3 times).

Speaking to Bork in Huginfell begins a quest involving a large lizard named Njessi in the lake between Gna Faste and Galplen. If you've never spoken to Bork before he may ask you to go kill some random thing approx. your level. After which he will tell you of a fearsome beast rumored to live in the lake at Gna Faste. He wants you to travel there and kill the beast and bring back its head as proof.

The best place I have found to camp this creature is straight towards the lake from the Gna Faste Hut in which the healer trainer stands outside of. Njessi will travel right past you staying in the water as she does. She conned blue, orange, and yellow to me at level 25 and is a very tough kill for her level. She has a searing heat blast which she uses frequently in the battle. Upon killing her you will rip her head off in a feat of strength. Return to Bork in Huginfel. Bork will ask to see the head but when you give it to him he hands it right back to you along with the 70sp reward. He then offers to buy the head from you. It is very important that if you want a good weapon you say NO to his offer. Saying yes will earn you a lousey 25sp more. If you say no he will then direct you to the Enchanter in town. Speaking to the enchanter she will tell you to head off to some other NPC in the game. Your class determines what NPC you will need to see.
Bork says, "You seem to be string enough to take on a real monster. A bounty issued for a [creature] that is terrorizing the lake near Galplen. Perhaps you have heard of it?"
Bork says, "Well here is all I know. It seems to many of the more adventurous sort of the land have called this creature, [Njessi]."

Bork says, "I agree that's a very strange name for a monster but I did not choose it. The [reward] for slaying thjis foul beast is quite large. That is good for [many have perished] trying to collect it."
Bork says, "Would you be interested in the [bounty]?"
Bork says, "I sent some after the creature just a few hours ago. Would you be interested in the [bounty]?"
Bork says, "The bounty is 70 silver for the head of the creature. What do you think?"
Dialog box: Find Njessi and end her reign of terror.
You have been given the Silent Death quest.
Bork says, "Well you are a brave soul. The creature can be found in the darkest depths of the Myrkwood lake. Good fortune on your jouirney and I really hope to see you again, my friend."
[Step #1] Travel to the lake in Myrkwood and slay Njessi.
You receive Njessi's head from Njessi!
You get 250,000 experience points.
You pull the creature's head from the corpse in a display of strength.
[Step #2] Return to Bork in Huginfell and speak with him.
Bork looks up with a very surprised look on his face.
Bork says, "You have returned. Amazing! Did you bring anything of Njessi back?"
You give Bork Njessi's head.
Bork says, "The god themselves must be watching you! You have brought back the creatures head. Here is your reward. I know of something you can do with [this head]."
You are awarded 70 silver and some copper!
You receive Njessi's head from Bork!
Bork says, "I have heard that Raker, the town enchanter, has been looking for one. Perhaps he can do something with it. You should do talk with him."
[Step #4] Find Raker in Huginfell and see if the head can be crafted into anything.
Raker says, "Greetings. Bork said you miught be coming by. I have heard tales of your travels as word spreads quickly around these parts. Please give me the skull so I can take a look at it."
You give Njessi's head to Raker.
Raker turns the skull over in his hands, looking closely at it, before returning it to you.
You receive Njessi's head from Raker!

Raker says, "I have an interesting idea. I believe that a magic staff can be crafted by driving slivers of skull bone deep into hardened wood. Only Gord in Galplen could make one of those. You must journey there and meet with him. He will be able to help you."
[Step #5] Journey to Galplen and speak with Gord the smith. He will be able to craft you the staff you desire.
Gord says, "I can make a staff that you will be able to use. The head is starting to rot though so I must start now. Would you like me to [make one] or [not]?"
Do not click not, you will only get some silver and will not get a weapon made for you.
[Step #6] Continue talking to the crafter to get your weapon.

Gord says, "Now these are very powerful staffs. You will be expected to uphold the traditions of all the Spiritmasters that have come before you. I will give you one of the staffs that I have already prepared. That way you din't have to wait."
You receive a Njessi Staff of Pure Thought from Gord!

Gord says, "Here is your staff. Now I expect you to spread the word and tell others that I can create these staffs. Just be sure and tell your friends to bring one of the Njessi heads so I can craft a new staff for the next person. May Hel guide your hand in battle."
You have finished the Silent Death quest.
Rewards:
Njessi Bone Hammer (1h)
Njessi Carved Fang (2H)
Njessie Staff of Pure Thought (Runemaster)
Njessie Staff of Pure Thought (Spiritmaster)
Njessi Short Tooth Axe (1h)
Njessi Crossed Short Tooth Axe (2h)
Njessi Skull Bone Hammer (2h)
Njessi Short Tooth Spear (2h)
Njessi Carved Short Fang (1h)
Njessi Carved Claw
Njessie Staff of Bones

midgard|sugnhild's revenge.Name: Sugnhild's Revenge
midgard|sugnhild's revenge.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: After you complete the Living Warning quest it will open up this one. Sugnhild will ask you to kill Redhands for messing with her husband. You will receive the Gauntlets of the Redhand. Redhands is located in the Blodfelag fort.
Sugnhild glances up.
Sugnhild says, "Well met. Do you have any news for me?"
Sugnhild says, "What did my husband say?"
You say, "He said he loves you."
Sugnhild says, "Please revenge my husband. Go and kill Redhands for me. I implore you. He can no longer be allowed to harm innocents. Please?"
Dialog box: Slay the Evil Kind Redhands
You have been given the Sugnhild's Revenge quest.
Sugnhild says, "Thank you. I shall pray to Tyr tonight in hopes he will watch over you. I shall be forever in debt to you my friend."
[Step #1] Journey to the Blodfelag camp and slay Redhands.

He is in the fort with the moat. Bring a friend unless you are a little higher in seasons. Redhands is in the center room towards the back, and is not alone. There are at least 8 others there as well and when you kill him, even some from outside come running in. Including Fridgeir Gestsson if he is near.
Konung Botolf Redhands says, "Thou shall kneel when thou comes before me, swine!"
You receive Gauntlets of the Redhand from Konung Boltolf Redhands!
[Step #2] Return to Sugnhild.
Sugnhild says, "My husband's spirit can now rest. I can never repay you enough but perhaps this may help you."
You are awarded 33 silver and some copper!
You are awarded 2,600,000 experience!
You have finished the Sugnhild's Revenge quest.
Reward:
Gauntlets of the Redhand

midgard|trustan's belongings.Name: Trustan's Belongings
midgard|trustan's belongings.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: The bartender sends you to Trustan, who is in the upper level of the healer hut in Huginfell. Trustan broke his leg when he fell off his horse while travelling up from Gna Faste. He needs someone to go get his luggage from his friend in Gna Faste. If you accept, he gives you a horse ticket to Gna Faste. This is the first quest in the Myrkwood zone which depends somewhat on your faction standing. Many later quests are affected by your standing with the three main factions in Myrkwood: the Werewolves, the Arachites, and the Svartalf. I think this quest is supposed to give you some ideas on how to modify your faction with these groups.

At Gna Faste, go see Atzar, who is on top of the stone tower. Careful going up, it is easy to fall down off the ramp. You can actually fall through it near the top. Atzar is glad to see you, but there is a slight problem (isn't there always). Some of the items were lost or loaned out, and he needs you to retrieve them.

Item #1: Trustan's sword was taken by some werewolf pups who robbed Atzar recently. Go kill a Werewolf Pup, who are located down the path behind (west) of the tower. They are just off to the north of the path a little way down from the tower. They were green to my lvl 14 Shaman, easy kill. Return to Aztar with Trustan's Sword (you get if automatically from the first pup you kill). Give Atzar the sword, and get the next step.

Item #2: You need to go to Galplen to see Curka (a merchant by the stable man in Galplen) for Trustan's Shield. Atzar gives you a horse ticket to get there. Talk to Curka, she tells you a sad tale of how some arachite younglings beat her up and took the shield. You need to go out the NE gate, follow the path to a fork, where you continue straight until you get to a guard tower. Then go SW into the woods to the cliff wall, where you will find a small valley with several arachite younglings. Kill one and get the shield. They were mostly green, a few blue to my lvl 14 Shaman. I also recommend you stay here and kill several of them, as you will need the svartalf faction for the next step. Take the shield back to Curka, who gives you a ticket to go see Atzar again. He takes the shield and sends you for the last item.

Item #3: You are sent to kill a svartalf who took Trustan's Helm from Atzar (funny how these wimpy creatures beat up these purple NPC's). Follow the trail south from Gna Faste (actually, the way you just came) until you get to the Direction Stone marked Galplen (near the undead area). Go East from there into the woods, past the various undeads, and you will see a few svartalf hanging out (loc=61536 46881). Kill one, and get the Helm. If you killed enough Arachites, you will still have neutral faction with the Svartalf, which is good as there is a big camp of them near here, and a ton of Svartalf Watchers nearby who will pretty much insta-kill you otherwise. Return to Atzar with the helm for the final step.

Atzar gives you a pack of the other items, and a horse ticket to Huginfell. Ride back, give the pack and helm to Trustan, and get the belt in return. A very nice item for Piety users, and the NPC's pay for most of the travel.

This took me about 1.5 hours real time, and it was pretty easy all the way, as long as you watch your faction. Interestingly enough, you can alternate killing werewolves and arachtites and the end result is a even balance between those two groups, and a big increase with several other groups, especially the svartalf.
Quest log:
Barkeep Alaka says, "I hear that Trustan thr troll needs some help with his belongings. Go speak with him in Huginfell."

Trustan says, "Greetings. My name is Trustan, and I have just moved here from near Gna Faste in Myrkwood Forest. Have you been there? It is quite a pleasant place, except for [all the fighting] that goes on there."

Trustan says, "You haven't heard about Myrkwood? Well then listen up, friend! You must be wary of the three big groups that live there. There are the svartalfs, the arachites, and the werewolves. Each group cannot stand the others, and they have made life miserable for the folks that live in Myrkwood. They fight with each other and sometimes with us! I had enought of it and just moved here to Huginfell. I hope life here in West Svealand will be better. I just wish I had remembered to bring all [my belongings]."

Trustan says, "I had to leave some of my things in Gna Faste. I paid for a horse to bring me here, and since I'm not a little person, the horse couldn't carry both me and all my things. I had some friends of mine in Gna Faste hold on to the rest of the things. I would go back there and get them myslef except while I was riding up here, I kind of [fell off the horse]."

Trustan says, "I had never ridden a horse before my trip up here, and I was unsure of myself, and the horse could sense my nrevousness. I guess I should have just walked but Atzar said I'd be okay. I was almost there when something spooked the horse and it threw me to the ground. I landed on my arm and it broke. I can't ride horses until it heals, but I'd like my things. Say, you seem kind. You've listened to me tale to this point. Do you think you would help me out and [get my things] from Atzar for me? I will repay you for your kindness."
Dialog box: Will you help Trustan retrieve his things?
You have been given the Trustan's Belongings quest.

Trustan says, "Thank you! I will be in your debt. When I came up here, I purchased this return ticket to Gna Faste to go back and get the rest of my things. I can't use it now, but you can. Please, take it and go give it to Prulgar the Stable Master and he will give you a horse to Gna Faste. When you get there you should find Atzar at the top of the guard tower. Speak with him and tell him I sent you. Thank you! I shall await your return."
[Step #1] Travel to Gna Faste and speak with Trustan's friend, Atzar. You will find him on top of the guard tower. Tell Atzar you were [sent by Trustan].
You say, "I was sent by Trustan."

Atzar says, "You were? That's wonderful! You have solved one of the problems I was dealing with. I did not know how I was going to get his belongings to him. I heard about his adventure with the horse and do not wish to repeat it. I am not skilled at riding, and I fear I would break something too. But if you are here to collect his things, then I will not have to ride a horse. Now, if only I [had his belongings] to give to you!"
[Step #2] Talk with Atzar about Trustan's belongings.
(Lost this paragraph...)But some of them left the area and traveled here, to [Myrkwood Forest]."

Atzar says, "There was a disagreement between the rwo werewolves, and the one left, taking some of the others with him. They came here to Myrkwood and settled into the forest, not far from here. At first, the residents if the town, Askheim, did not know of their presence. Understand that back then, the werewolves had a human form during the day. It has only been over time that they changed and assumed the form the have today. I do not know the entire story, but I know that something bad happened and it resulted in the werewolves taking over [Askheim]."

Atzar says, "The werewolves that live there now raise their young and let them tear up the land and terrorize the people. It was those pups that attacked me and stole Trustan's favorite sword.
