I know Trustan would want it back, and I'd go and get it from him, but have some other things of his to find. Trustan loaned a few of this things to another friend and I must get those things back before I can send everything up to him. Please, seek out the werewolf pups that scamper behind Gna Faste and get back Trustan's sword. Please!"
[Step #3] Find the werewolf pups that roam in the woods behind Gna Faste.
Go just behind the hut in Gna Faste, you can't miss the pups. Kill one.
The werewolf pup says, "Curse all Kobold's! One day you shall feel the bite of the werewolves!"
You receive Trustan's sword from the werewolf pup!
[Step #4] Return to Atzar at the top of the guard tower in Gna Faste.
Atzar says, "It is good to see you back. Please give me Trustan's sword so I can make sure it is undamaged."
[Step #5] Give Trustan's sword to Atzar for safe keeping.

Atzar says, "Good, the sword was not damaged by those little fiends. Trustan will be happy, but he would be happier if I was able to return all his things. I received a note from Curka in Galplen. She's the one that Trustan loaned his shield to before he went to Huginfell. I need to get that shield back, but apparently Curka ran into some trouble with [the arachites] on her way here."

Atzar says, "The arachites are another group that like to cause trouble around here, but Curka can tell you more about them. Here, take this and grab a horse to Galplen. It's not far, but it can be dangerous getting there. Seek out Curka and tell her Atzar sent you for the shield. Once you have it come back to me, and then we'll send you up to Trustan!"
You receive a ticket to Galplen from Atzar!
[Step #6] Take a horse to Galplen and seek out Curka. When she asks, tell her you are there [for the shield].
Curka says, "Hello there. Would you like to purchase something or is there something else I can do for you?"
You say, "I am here for the shield."
Curka says, "The shield? What shield? OH! You mean Trustan's shield. You must have been sent by Atzar. That shield is going to [be a problem]."

Curka says, "I don't have the shield, the arachites do. Atzar must have mentioned the arachites. They are these spidery type people that live in Myrkwood. Worst thing that ever happened to Myrkwood were those arachites. They didn't start off the way they are, you know. A very long time ago they were spiders. But Myrkwood is a dark forest, and sometimes strange things happen. The power of Myrkwood [affected those spiders]."

Curka says, "I had taken Trustan's shield over to Nalliten to show it to a friend of mine who wants to make his own shield. I went there and spent a few days helping my friend make his shield. It was on my way back that I ran into trouble. A group of arachite younglings ran out of the forest and attacked me. They screamed at me, saying those that helped the svartalfs would die. Apparently they could sense my friendship with them. I had to run or else I would have been killed. I threw Trustan's shield at them and ran for the guard tower. They picked up the shield and ran the other way. Now I fear the shield is [lost forever]

Curka says, "You know, you look strong enough to handle those arachite younglings. I am not brave or strong, which is why I ran for the guards at the first sight of trouble. Please, go find these younglings and kill them for me. It is the only way to retrieve Trustan's shield, and it will set you on the raod towards building a good relationship with the svartalfs. Head out through the northeast gate and follow the road. When you reach a split in the road, keep going straight to the guard tower. At the tower, head southwest into the woods. You will find the younglings there. Return to me when you have the shield."

[Step #7] Get Trustan's shield back from the arachite younglings. Head out the northeast gate. When you reach a split in the road, go straight to reach the guard tower. Them head southwest into the forest.
You receive Trustan's shield from the arachite youngling!
[Step #8] Return to Curka in Galplen.

Curka says, "Good job! I can see that you have Trustan's shield in your pack. It's hard to hide a shield, is it not? You do not appear to have to other things that Trustan left with Atzar, so I think I better send you back to [Atzar]."

Curka says, "Here take this ticket to Gna Faste. The horses are so much faster than walking! I shall send word to Trustan that you retrieved his shield so he can make you a nice present for your work. He's quite the craftsman! Now, hurry along to Gna Faste!"
You receive a ticket to Gna Faste from Curka!
[Step #9] Return to Atzar in Gna Faste.
Atzar says, "I see you have recovered the shield from Curka. Excellent. Hold on to it for now. I am almost ready to send Trustan's things to him, but there is one more thing [to recover]."

Atzar says, "I'm sure Curka talked about the svartlafs when you were with her. She always talks about them and how bad they get treated. Well, I can see why they get treated that way after what they did to me! While you were away, I wanted to get a peek at what the werewolves were up to. Living so close to Askheim, it's natural to want to know what's going on. While I was out in the forest I got attacked by the svartalfs! They seemed to think I [support the werewolves]."

Aztar says, "Of course I don't, since they seem to want to drive everyone out of Gna Faste, but the svartalfs didn't listen when I said I didn't like werewolves. They attacked me and stole Trustan's helm from me! I swear, I'm going to pack up ,y stuff and moce to Huginfell with Trustan. I think he had the right idea. Anyway, I've for to finish packing up this stuff. You're going to have to [get the helm back] for me."

Atzar says, "I know where these svartalfs who attacked me like to hide. Take the road south from here until you get to the rock that directs you to Galplen. Then you need to go east into the woods. They hide way back in the woods, so be careful! Just south of there you will find a full camp of the svartalfs! If they don't like you, and they may not after you get that helm back, they will attack. Oh, before you go, give me that shield so I can pack it up."
[Step #10] Give the Trustan's Shield to Atzar now.
You give Atzar Trustan's Shield.
Atzar says, "Excellent! Now, hurry to find those svartalfs and get the helm back."
[Step #11] Get Trustan's Helm from the svartalfs. Take the road south from the tower. When you reach the Galplen rock, turn east into the woods.
The loc of the Galplen rock is approx. 54k, 49k. And if you go directly East you will run into Svartalf Predators etc, go more Northeast to find the ordinary Svartalf camp.
The svartalf says, "Curse you and all those that support the arachites and the werewolves!"
You receive Trustan's Helm from the svartalf!
[Step #12] Return to Aztar in Gna Faste.
Atzar says, "I see you carry Trustan's helm. This is excellent. I have the rest of his things bundled up. Here, take them and a ticket to Huginfell and go take this stuff to him!"
You receive a pack for Trustan from Atzar!
You receive a ticket to Huginfel from Atzar!
[Step #13] Return to Trustan in Huginfell.

Trustan says, "I am so happy to see you. Curka sent word you were very helpful in gathering my belongings. she asked me to get a special reward for you, and I have it. But first, please, give me the pack with my belongings."
[Step #14] Give Trustan the bag containing his belongings.
You give Trustan Trustan's pack.
You are awarded experience!
Trustan says, "It looks like everything is here except for my helm. You don't happen to have that, do you?"
[Step #15] Give Trustan his helm.
You give Trustan Trustan's Helm.

Trustan says, "Ah, thank you very much! Here is a fine reward for you that I made all by myself! I'm quite a craftsman, you know. I thank you for your help with my belongings. And watch out for those svartalfs, werewolves, and arachites on your travels!"
you receive Trustan's Embroidered Belt from Trustan!
You are awarded 3 silver and some copper!
You have finished the Trustan's Belongings quest.
Reward:
Trustan's Embroidered Belt -- Spiritmaster and Runemaster
Trustan's Hand Embossed Belt -- Healer and Shaman
Trustan's Handmade Belt -- Thane, Savage and Warrior
Trustan's Handwoven Belt -- Hunter
Rewards:
Trustan's Embroidered Belt
Trustan's Hand Embossed Belt
Trustan's Handmade Belt
Trustan's Handwoven Belt

midgard|protecting myrkwood.Name: Protecting Myrkwood
midgard|protecting myrkwood.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Serilyna, the staff merchant in Galplen, tells you a tale about a stolen staff. She then sends you to the enchanter in the Gna Faste guard tower who finishes the tale and sends you off to kill the Tomb Priestess in the Cursed Tomb.
Just a note for people playing on a German server, instead of "die Svartalf",
which doesn't start the quest due to buggy translation, say "die Svartalfar" to Serilyna.

Cursed Tomb is located in Gotar, just near Nalliten. There is a pole with a skull on it just past the bone bridge. If you have done the helping the svartalf or werewolves you have been to that pole. Just East of the pole and up the hill some, there is the entrance to Cursed Tomb. Location is 60k, 54k, and the entrance looks like the other cave entrances.

Once inside there is a tunnel that leads downward. Don't let all the graves fool you! You will come to a room that is round. Go directly across and through that passage way, this is the priestess room. She is in the back left corner, and has several friends, and yes she BAF.

Kill her and and she drops for you the top half of the missing staff. Take the top half of the staff to the enchanter in Gna Faste. She spends more of the tale and offers you a horse ticket to Fort Veldon. You will be going to Vendo Caverns nearby to kill Grjotgard for the second half of the missing staff.

While you are on the horse, might as well go grab a coke heh. Take the horse to Veldon and go to the Vendo Caverns, loc: 25k, 7k. Once inside, look for Grjotgard. He is just inside the second room. When you just enter, there is a tunnel to the right to the second room surround by cave bears and maulers. He will drop the lower half.
Now return to the healer with the second half of the staff and she will give the two pieces back wrapped in a bag, horse tickets!

When you get to Haggerfel, go north along the wall until you get to Muspelheim. Once in Muspelheim, go to loc 18k, 12k, you will need to kill Haeng. After you kill Haeng, Bjame will spawn, of he hasn't already and kill Haeng for you. Either way you have to do it, you will get Haeng's Scroll. "Use" it to destroy the staff. To use the item, place the icon on the spell bar, press shift E to cast the spell that destroys the staff.
Return to Serilyna for your reward!
15 silver, xp, and a neck item.
Rewards:
Svartalf Hair Collar -- Mystics
Svartalf Bone Collar -- Rogues
Svartalf Finger Necklace-- Seers
Svartalf Eye Necklace -- Viking
Rewards:
Svartalf Hair Collar
Svartalf Bone Collar
Svartalf Finger Necklace
Svartalf Eye Necklace

midgard|sulphine's demise.Name: Sulphine's Demise
midgard|sulphine's demise.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Has changed to be melee types only and might have a prerequisite quest.
Talk to Macalena in Haggerfell
She will ask you to talk to Arnkatla, who is also in Haggerfell
Arnkatla will ask you to kill Sulphine, ..a named Sulphur Crab
Go to Muspelheim and find the lava lake up north, there you will see a lot of crabs and Lava Lizards. Sulphine spawns at loc 9660, 16560
If Macalena wont give you the quests and if you are level 23, you can try and /whisper Sulphine to Arnkatla.
Reward:
Flameforged Sword

midgard|bowyer's draw.Name: Bowyer's Draw
midgard|bowyer's draw.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: It starts with Hakon, the bow merchant in Huginfell, at 20th. He will tell you that he can make you a good bow, but he needs some materials to do it.
First, he needs spider silk and a perfect willow branch. The spider silk he wants comes from great tinglers, which can be found amongst the arachites in Myrkwood Forest.
The willow branch comes from a shrieking willow, which are just over the border into Skona Ravine.
Once you bring those back, he tells you to go get the digestive sac from the WOOD-EATER KING. Unless you're well over 20th, you will want to bring friends for this one.

The wood-eater king can be found just outside Mularn, usually to the left of the road that goes to Vasudheim, although he does sometimes wander across the road and up into the hills to the right. The king himself is green at 20th.
Reward:
Willow Wind Bow

midgard|foolish dancers.Name: Foolish Dancers
midgard|foolish dancers.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: There may be a prerequisite to this quest, and that quest may have changed to melee only. Please note this is like all other quests and your tasks and steps MAY vary.

Macalena points you to Cornelis the smith in Ft Veldon. Cornelis asks you to bring him 2 or 3 items easily obtainable in Muspelheim. He asks you to go to Muspelheim to kill a soot harvester and a fire flower. The first mob is at the entrance to Muspelheim, the second can be found if you go right and walk past the first pass. After you return to Cornelus he asks you to kill Olash. Olash can be found by hugging the north wall of Muspelheim, until you come to a very large lava pit. His loc is 6000,19300, and at the time all the regular mobs disappear and the undead spawn from 11pm to 6am, Olash appears, he is an Ashen Spirit. When you bring him the items he gives you an Unquenched Maul. When you kill Olash, the maul changes to the Ashen Maul. You do not have to use the unquenched maul to kill Olash. Simply having it in your pack is fine.
Other mob and items are:
flask of gas from a sulphuric ghoul (which can
be found at night only in the same area as the fire flowers and fire spouts)
Runemasters cannot do this quest.
Reward:
Ashen Maul

midgard|helping the weaponsmith.Name: Helping the Weaponsmith
midgard|helping the weaponsmith.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Quest release with Patch 1.60

Yrling, the armor merchant in Aegirhamn, will ask you to collect some items for him: A Chilly Skelett Bone (from Chilly Skeletts in the area immediately surrounding the town of Bjarken in Gripklosa Mountains), Skalklan Blood (which he claims are from Skalklan Shellsplitters, but mine dropped from a Skalklan Shellcrafter - there are several Skalklan camps with both mobs in the area straight out from Aegirhamn in Munin Sound), and Morvalt Landflyke Hair (from Morvalt Landflykes, also in the area around Bjarken).

Yrling wants you to take the note he gave you, and the 3 items, to Cadbg in Hagall. Cadbg will take the note and the first item, the Chilly Skelett bone, but then asks for the Morvalt Hair, not the Skalklan blood - he will not take the hair. If you give him the blood, he will step you to 'return the potion to Yrling in Aegirhamn' and will not accept the hair, as well as not giving you the potion. At this point I had to wait for a CSR to create the item, a 'Translucent Potion' - hopefully it will be fixed in one of these server downages.

Once you return to Yrling with the potion, he does a little dance, then turns around and notices his swords are missing. He thinks Styer, also in Aegirhamn, stole them, and asks you to speak with him. Styer is innocent, and when you return to Yrling with that information, a Shale Golem Emissary will spawn and you will have to speak with it. Getting the full text from the Shale Golem might be difficult, as it seems in this first spawn, an NPC in town attacks it with a spell, then all the other NPCs gang up on it and kill it.

However, it does tell you what you need to do next: Find Ghirni, a morvalt renegade, 'off the road, toward the water where the shale golems spawn.' This information isn't technically correct, the 'shale golems' are actually 'coral things' although they do have the same graphic as shale golems. Ghirni is in the morvalt camp right next to them. Loc 46k, 37k. You can get there by running straight out of Aegirhamn until you hit the water, then following the coast to your left (avoiding the aggro mobs, of course).

When you kill Ghirni, he will drop a head and a Pristine Obsidian Sword. Return to Aegirhamn, the Shale Golem Emissary will be respawned. Give him the head, and you will get a Ring of Shale. Give Yrling the sword, and he will offer you a choice of weapons. I chose Greatsword, but recieved a 1handed Bastard Sword.
Quest items may be class specific. I recieved 520k xp and 2 gold from the Emissary, and 1,040k and 2 more gold from Yrling.
Overall, it will be a great quest once the bugs are worked out.
Rewards:
Ring of Shale
Obsidian Warhammer
Obsidian Bastard Sword
Obsidian Long Spear
Obsidian Staff
Obsidian Great Spiked Hammer
Obsidian Great Sword

midgard|stripe.Name: Stripe
midgard|stripe.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per Patch 1.59:
- Bonedancers have been added to the available classes for the Stripe quest.
AND
- Bonedancers may now wear the Stripe Hide Helm.
BUT someone just sent in a message that they still can't get the quest as a Bonedancer.
May says, "Sometimes mortals have a way of bringing down the wrath of the Gods. Look for Halla in Huginfell for the details."
Halla looks you up and down sternly.
Halla says, "Yes, you look the [sturdy sort]."
Halla says, "Yes, sturdy sort. You look to Halla like a smart, strong, warrior! Maybe Halla has a [story] for you."
Halla says, "Halla's story is scary! Maybe you should close your ears? Ha ha! No, Halla's just joking. Have you ever heard of the bear the locals call [Stripe]?"
Halla says, "Good, then Halla will make sure you hear about nasty old Stripe. Long ago, there was a man named Varnarn who loved Hel and [served her] for most of his life."
Halla says, "Varnarn was a Spiritmaster for a long time, long long time, and Hel was going to reward him for his service, when he tried to [trick] Hel and take over the Underworld!"
Halla says, "Yes, But little did he know Hel turned his own trick on him, foiling his ploy and angering her at the same time. As his punishment, he was turned into a [bear]."
Halla says, "A bear the locals call Stripe. Halla doesn't know why he's called Stripe, but Halla hears tell of a [magical item] Stripe carries with him."
Dialog box: Do you accept the Stripe quest?
You have been given the Stripe quest.
Halla says, "Halla is new here in town, and not really sure what the item is, but you can find Stripe in the Skona Ravine. Good luck in your travels!"
[Step #1] Go to Skona Ravine and find Stripe!
Stripe is a woodland badger in Skona, the result of some curse, and
supposedly has a magic item on him.
Level: 26
Skona Ravine, near entrance to Malmohus
[Step #1] Go to Skona Ravine and find Stripe!
You receive a Stripe Hide Helm from Stripe!
You have finished the Stripe quest.
You get 360,XXX experience points. (for level 32)
Reward:
Stripe Hide Helm

midgard|family business.Name: Family Business
midgard|family business.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Thrand is no longer missing. He can be found where he normally was, outside of Mularn
The Jordheim bartender told me a story over a mug of ale about a boy named Thrand

Prugar told me to look for Thrand outside Mularn. He was worried about his brother. Thrand is located near a tree next to the guard tower just outside the town of Mularn. Loc: 42398, 48978. Seems Thrand has another possible loc in Gotar, loc 22,46 There is a guard tower manned by Svartalf just behind it to the south if a small farm and Thrand is stood by the haystack to the left as you approach.
Thrand says, "Hi there, have you ever heard of the Svartalfs? They're terrible! They are callous, cold-blooded killers, and I think my brother is [working for them]!"

Thrand says, "Yes, working for them. But my brother isn't anything like that. He's great at hiding in the shadows and maybe he's redistributed a little wealth, but I don't think that he'd work for the Svartalfs. He is a good person, not a killer! I just know something is wrong. He won't tell me anything though, he thinks he's protecting me. But he might talk to you. Do you think you could go [see him] for me?"
Dialog box: Will you help Thrand find out if his brother Piercer is mixed up in Svartalf business?
You have been given the Family Business quest.

Thrand says, "Thank you so much! You have no idea what this means to me. Piercer has been living in West Svealand, above and north of the main Svartalf camp. Be careful and stay far away from them, they don't [trust] anyone and will often attack."

Thrand says, "Ah you're right. Piercer won't trust you either. Hmmm, let's see, I know! Tell him you have a message for Halvor. That's his real name and if you use it he'll know I sent you. Good luck, I just hope it's not too late. He's the only family I have."
[Step #1] Tell Piercer that you have a message for [Halvor]. Piercer is on the ridge west of Huginfell, overlooking the Svartalf camp.
Piercer says, "What are you doing here, spying? Give me one good reason I shouldn't just kill you right now."
You say, "I have a message for Halvor."

Piercer says, "So! You know my real name, do you? Keep your voice down, there are unfriendly ears nearby. My brother Thrand must have told you. I don't blame him for worrying, I'm in real trouble this time. I got involved with these treacherous Svartalfar and now they want me to [kill someone]."

Piercer says, "Shhhh! Not so loud. Yes, murder. You're probably not familiar with the Svartalfar, so before I ask you to help me I'll explain a little about them. The Svartalfar, the Arachites and the Varulv are all involved in a long-standing dispute over the Myrkwood area. The Svartalfar think that they were there first and that the other two groups are invading their [territory]."

Piercer says, "The three factions are constantly fighting amongst themselves, sometimes in open combat, but more often they send agents to murder key personalities and sabotage plans. The Svartalfar have become adept at sneak attacks and assassinations and are pretty unscrupulous about what they'll agree to do to increase their holdings and resources. I didn't realize they were such a bad bunch when I first got involved and now they won't let me leave. They say they're going to kill my brother Thrand if I don't do this job for them! Can you [help] me?"

Piercer says, "Maybe Graesen will talk to you. I report to him, and if you tell him that I'd be a terrible assassin maybe he'll just let me leave. See the camp below? Graesen is just to the east of it."
[Step #2] Find Graesen in or around the Svartalf camp. See if he will release Piercer from his Svartalf obligations.

Graesen says, "What brings you skulking around here? Lookin' for work? I've got plenty hereabouts. Good money in it for you, too. 'Course we don't want none of them types that gets cold feet, like [Piercer]."
Graesen says, "He's a new guy, and a pitiful fool that don't have no guts. Promised he'd do a job, now says he's scared."
Graesen appears to think something over and then gets a treacherous gleam in his eye.

Graesen says, "I 'spose we could call it off, but someone would need to contact our arachite agent and tell him. That ain't gonna be easy. Those arachites are fighters and he'll probably attack before he hears the message. Want to [do it]?"
Graesen says, "The agent is in Myrkwood, disguised as an arachite priest (or weblasher or shadowslinker for another version). Just tell him Graesen sent you."
[Step #3] Find Graesen's agent in Myrkwood and tell him [Graesen sent me]. He's disguised as an arachite priest. Remember, he'll probably attack when he sees you.
Locate an arachite priest (or weblasher or shadowslinker or great tingler)and tell him that Graesen sent you, you will most likely have to do this while being attacked, even if gray con.
You say, "Graesen sent me."

The arachite priest says, "Then Graesen sent you to your death, fool! We know his plans, and every arachite will defend Priest Thaxtix to the death. Let me give you a taste of where my loyalties lie!"
The arachite priest says, "If the Svartalfs sent you, tell them we will all fight to the end.
[Step #4] Obviously Graesen tried to trick you by sending you into a trap. You can go back and tell Piercer of Graesen's trickery OR you can return and report to the treacherous Graesen.
**Return to Piercer version**
[Step #4] Talk to Piercer.

Piercer says, "You're okay! I was so worried! Graesen came and said that he'd tricked you into working for them, then sent you into a trap! You're a true friend for risking yourself for me. Did you bring anything back with you?"
You say, "The arachite priest dropped Priest Thaxtix Schedule."

Piercer says, "I've heard of Priest Thaxtix, he's the one the Svartalfar want me to assassinate. He and his priests have been performing ceremonies and sacrifices to gain enough power to launch a full attack on the Svartalfar. That's why Graesen wants him and his followers out of the picture so badly. You've got a lot more than that to worry about though. I overheard Graesen order someone to kill you if you [returned] from his trap!"

Piercer says, "A Svartalfar named Rip was told to do the job. He's big, mean, and won't stop until he's done it. I think the best thing would be for you to take the initiative and go after him first. He is Southwest of here, under a tree outside the main camp."
**Return to Graesen version**
After you kill the arachite weblasher, return to Graesen. Graeson is suprised to see you and tells you to see a friend of his, Rip, to the east of the camp. He will try and kill you.
**Conclusion**
Either way you are sent to Rip.
[Step #5] Find and kill Rip, to the Southwest of the main Svartalf camp in West Svealand.
Rip says, "What are you doing here? I should thank you for saving me the trouble of finding you. Prepare to die!"
Kill Rip and return to Piercer.
[Step #6] Talk to Piercer.

Piercer says, "Nice work, I'm glad Rip won't be bothering us anymore. I wish I had courage like yours. Then my little brother wouldn't be in danger. Will you please [help] me take care of Priest Thaxtix?"

Piercer says, "Please go and kill Priest Thaxtix for me. You might need to bring a few friends along to help because Thaxtix is usally surrounded by his lesser priests. Bring back proof that he's dead, so I can turn it in and then quit the Svatalfar. Here is some silver for you also, to reimburse some of what you've spent on travel. Taking a horse from Huginfell to Myrkwood and back can get expensive."
You receive 20 silver from Piercer

[Step #8] Find Priest Thaxtix in Myrkwood and kill him, so you can bring proof of his death to Piercer. You may need to bring some friends to help you, because Priest Thaxtix is often surrounded by his priests.

Locate and kill Priest Thaxtix and return to Piercer with proof. He is north from the werewolf fort, across the lake. Thaxtix spawns on the west shore of the lake north of the Werewolf fort. You can either go west from Gna, past the ww fort, and turning north, following the lake edge; or go north from Gna, then west around the the north shore of the lake. The location is approximately 10000,31000. BUT sometimes he pops as a regular priest, you may have to kill it a few times to get him to pop. Kill him and give his leg to Piercer.
Priest Thaxtix says, "You shall pay for this outrage against the Arachites! You shall pay..."
You receive Priest Thaxtix's leg from Priest Thaxtix!
[Step #9] Return Priest Thaxtix's leg to Piercer.
Piercer says, "You're back! Did you bring proof that you killed Priest Thaxtix?"

Piercer says, "I don't know how to thank you, you've done so much for me and my brother. Perhaps you can get some use out of these boots. I came by them honestly, and they have some useful properties. Thanks gain for your help."
You receive the Boots of Favor from Piercer!
You have finished the Family Business quest.
Rewards:
Boots of Favor -- Healer, Berserker, Savage, and Shaman
Slippers of Favor -- Bonedancer, Runemaster and Spiritmaster
Heavy Boots of Favor -- Thane and Warrior
Moccasins of Favor -- Hunter and Shadowblade
Thanks to Beguila Blutoz, Nydiric Inthgrad, and Sigmagnus
Rewards:
Boots of Favor
Slippers of Favor
Heavy Boots of Favor
Moccasins of Favor

midgard|nimh's secret.Name: Nimh's Secret
midgard|nimh's secret.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: You're asked by Finni to kill Nimh (rat). Upon entering Skona Ravine follow the north wall till you pass Werewolf Skulkers. Between there and the Witch (named NPC human) you will find some Wood Rats that spawn in the early night. If you're lucky one of them will be called Nimh. Plan on camping the spot for a few nights before you find Nimh though. On the plus side there are several yellows and oranges too keep you busy while you wait.
[Step #1] Search for Nimh in Skona Ravine. (loc 20169,5649 also spotted at loc 21749,7300)
I found him at 11am game time.
You receive a Nimh's Curse from Nimh!
You have finished the Nimh's Secret quest.
