Nimh's Curse

midgard|better off buried.Name: Better Off Buried
midgard|better off buried.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: *Formerly known as Strykel one time drop*
You must complete Lover's Circle (15), Living Warning (21) and Sugnhild's Revenge (22) before you will get this one.
Gudlor says, "You did a great job getting rid of that infamous Blodfelag camp. I hear they may be making other plans now, so be wary."
Gudlor says, "Welcome back. I have not seen you in a long time. I hope all has been [well] with you."

Gudlor says, "Sadly, we have had our share of problems here in Huginfell. The Svartalf raids continue daily but we have managed to survive. There has been something else that has been plaguing my mind, but before I tell you what it is, I must tell you another older story. Do you have some time to listen?"
Dialog box: Do you desire to help Gudlor in his quest to rid the town of evil?
You have been given the Better Off Buried quest.

Gudlor says, "Good! The story starts many years ago when Huginfell was first being settled. Back then, the Blodfelag had not yet banded together and Redhands was still just another misguided warrior with a [few followers]."
[Step #1] Learn the tale of the book av den dode from Gudlor in Huginfell.** (note: why there are two stars there I do not know)

Gudlor says, "Redhands began gathering more followers and set about his plans to take over the local ruffians. It is told that he sent his men into the far reaches of Raumarik seeking something to give him enough power to take complete control of the area. His men returned with an ancient [tome of runes]."

Gudlor says, "The tome was said to have some of the most powerful runes in existence. They were called the runes of creation, which were used in the formation of Midgard itself. Unfortunately, most of the runes in the book were beyond the understanding of mere [mortal] men."

Gudlor says, "Redhands called upon Lord Loki to aid him in his quest and a child came to him, bearing a dark ring. The child told Redhands the rind was cursed and somehow gave its bearer the power to read the tome. Redhands called upon his most trusted Runemaster and had her [wear the ring]."

Gudlor says, "She screamed and fell to the ground as a rotting corpse. Next, Redhands called on his second most trsuted Runemaster and ordered hiim to wear the ring. He slipped the ring on and began to decipher some of the tome, learning its [dark secrets]."

Gudlor says, "The first ones he learned about were the rune of power and the rune of damnation. The Runemaster attempted to craft a crown with the rune on it, but could not master the skills needed. He did, however, create a crown that made its bearer extremely strong and qucik but slowly drove them [insane]."
Gudlor says, "Redhands knew a good use for such a cursed item. He gave the crown to the leader of the Blodfelag as a gift. The Blodfelag Commander wore the crown and was slowly [driven mad]."

Gudlor says, "The Commander's men could no longer trust him to make good decisions and Redhands was more than willing to take control in his place. Redhands ordered the Commander to give up his crown or die. The Commander was not willing to give up his cherished crown and was last seen heading into Muspelheim, vowing to [never surrender] his crown to anyone."
Gudlor says, "He is probably still there with that cursed crown on his head. Next, Redhands turned [his attention] to us."

Gudlor says, "He had his Runemasters carve Runes of Damnation around the town to summon and control legions of dead to attack us. If not for Sugnhild's brave husband, Fridgier Gestsson, we would have been [surprised] and the town lost."

Gudlor says, "Fridgeir managed to alert his wife just as the last symbol was carved and we hunted the Runemasters, slaying them. The shadows rose from the mists and started slaying who stood against them. That was the longest [night]of my life."
Gudlor says, "The battle lasted until dawn when the shadows were driven away by the morning light. I went searching for survivors and only [found this]."
You receive the book av den dode from Gudlor!
You feel a bone-penetrating chill as your hand closes around the book.

Gudlor says, "I honestly do not know if this book can be destroyed. I pray to Odin every night, hoping that someone will be able to take [the book] from me without taking my life. Only time will tell though."

Gudlor says, "Now you need the rinf that came with the book. I gave it to Agnor Crusher so I would not be tempted to use the book. He hates protecting the ring but I can trust no other with it. You can find him guarding the northern part of the town from the Blodfelag. Thank you, my friend, for undertaking this dangerous quest."
[Step #2] Visit Agnor Crusher, the guard in the northwest corner of Huginfell, and learn more about the curse that plagues Huginfell. You must also get the ring av den dode from him.

Agnor Crusher says, "Hello again! I remember you. You gave me proof that the sprites were planning something. The other guards were beginning to think I had lost my mind. You look like you have done really well for yourself as well. What can I [do for you]?"
Agnor Crusher pales slightly and prays under his breath.

Agnor Crusher says, "I knew this day would come. You are taking the book to destroy it? I hope you are strong enough not to give into the temptation that has claimed the others. I have been wearing this cursed ring since Gudlor asked me to [protect it]."

Agnor Crusher says, "I swear, I think that some of the creatures around here know I have it. The way they look at me makes me very nervous and paranoid. The ring is not even quenched and it still bothers me. I will tell you what I have learned about [the ring]."

Agnor Crusher says, "To quench the ring you must travel into Uppland, place the ring on your finger and then slay a boreal cockatrice. The ring will only be fed if you are wearing it when the creature dies. Be very careful, the ring will make you feel much weaker while wearing it. Once you have quenched its thirst, return here and I will tell you how to destroy the book. May Odin smile upon you, my friend."
Agnor Crusher slips the ring from his finger and hands it to you.
You receive a Ring av den dode from Agnor Crusher!
The Ring av den dode, is -30 STR and -200 hits and you HAVE TO wear it when you kill your target. Not everyone will receive the same target in Uppland.
[Step #3] Journey to Uppland, wear the ring and slay a boreal cockatrice. They can be found on the road that leads from Svasud Faste.
Go through gates and follow the road til it Y's, go left a hop and a skip, BAM! A boreal cockatrice will find you, heh.
[Step #4] Return to Agnor Crusher, the guard in the northwest corner of Huginfell, and learn how the book av dev dode may be destroyed.

Agnor Crusher says, "Good, you have returned. I was getting worried that you may have fallen to the ring's evil powers. If you do not destroy the book soon, I fear it may destroy you. To find where the book was buried, you must first go to the ridge just west of here and follow that southwest until you are over the Blodfelag's camp. Look for [a boulder] near the top of the ridge."

Agnor Crusher says, "The book was actually found there and not in Raumarik. I think that is the best place to try destroying the book. I will know you have failed if the ring appears back on my finger. If the our plan fails, just return the book to Gudlor and we shall try again. I think he was planning on sending you after that cursed crown as well. The ring can only be used to read the book near nidnight. Just stand next to the boulder and wear the ring, then read the spell from the book. Anyway, you should be off. Time is short and you do not want to have both the ring and the book on you any longer than you have to. Trust me, bad things may happen to you if you delay too long."
[Step #5] Follow the ridge located west of Huginfell to the southwest. The small boulder is on top of the ridge north of the Blodfelag camp. You will receive a message when you find it.
Loc of the small boulder is 15k, 35k, it is just North of the Blodfelag camp, by the lake, that Thegn Aki is in.
You have found where the book was buried. You can only attempt to destroy the book near midnight.
[Step #6] Wait here until midnight. Then equip the ring av den dode and and [use] the book av den dode to cast a spell that may destroy the book.

Ok, here's how to use the book. Drag it from your inventory to a slot on your quickbar (for instance, 8). Wait 'til between 23:45 and 0:15. Have the ring equipped. Then, hit the 'E' key, then the quickslot number. The ring has to be equipped. So if I used slot 8, I hit e, then 8. That uses the book. Then, about six or seven dark summoners spawn. They despawn about 10 seconds later. My thinking is that if you try to attack one of them (I didn't have a chance), there might be a better alternate ending, but I didn't have that chance.
You begin to chant the words from the book.
Dark Summoner begins to cast a spell!
[Step #7] Return the book av den dode to Gudlor in Huginfell so he may once again protect it from the Blodfelag.
Gudlor says, "Greetings. I can tell by the look on your face that you were not able to destroy the book. Hand me the book and we shall see about sending you somewhere you can make a difference."
You hand the book av den dode to Gudlor.
Gudlor says, "Thank you. At least you tried and that is what truly counts. There is another thing that remains undone. The [evil crown] of the Blodfelag still exists."

Gudlor says, "Someone must go and get the crown back so innocents are not controlled by its twisted powers. I think that person is you. You should be able to get where the crown is with little danger because of your strong will. In any case, it will be safer with you. Legends say the Blodfelag king, Strykel, went deep into Muspelheim to hide. I do not believe he made it very far before he was completely [taken over] by the crown."

Gudlor says, "It changed him into a demonic monster and he is said to roam a fiery island just east of the Muspelheim gate. By Odin's will, you should be able to find Strykel and release his spirit to the gods. It shall be left to you how to guard the crown. Perhaps we shall try to destroy this book again another day. Until then, I shall guard it with [my life]."

Gudlor says, "Go now and one warning. If you are slain while wearing the crown, it may have the power to animate your corpse and slay your friends. Be forewarned, the crown is truly twisted evil. Safe journey to you, my friend."
[Step #8] To finish your quest, journey to the island of fire, in Muspelheim, and slay the twisted Blodfelg king, Strykel. The island of fire is located just east of the entrance to Muspelheim.
Kill Strykel, a named Plasmatasm (Giant), and get the Crown of Insanity. He spawns at night in the pit with Sulphine, Olash, and Bright Flame. Approx /locs:
Strykel says, "No! Please, I must protect my crown."
You receive a Crown of Insanity from Strykel!
You have finished the Better Off Buried quest.
You get 650,XXX experience points.
Reward:
Shining Crown of Insanity

midgard|lost maps.Name: Lost Maps
midgard|lost maps.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Sinna loc is 40806 43240 in Aegir's Landing.
Sinna looks up from the map she is drawing and glares at you.
Sinna Redtoes says, "What do you want? I've got [no more maps] to steal, so you can just keep on walking before I call the guards to come get you out of here!"
Sinna grabs your pack and searches through it quickly.
Sinna Redtoes says, "Hrmph, no more maps in there and that's lucky for you!

Someone crept in here while I was sleeping and stole two maps that belong to Longbeard. He put them in my care until he our forces came back from helping Stonelock fight the Morvltar. They are due back any day and the maps I had the Valkyn draw me are gone. I think I know [who did it] but I'm not completely sure."

Sinna Redtoes says, "I caught a glimpse of their clothes as they ran our with the maps. I believe they were members of the Grenlock Clan. I would go talk to the Grenlock Clan about it but I must try to recreate both those maps. The Valkyn who drew them went out with Stonelock and won't return until the rest of our group comes back. I need someone who will [track down these thieves] and retrieve my maps."
Dialog box: Will you help Sinna by tracking down the map thieves?
You have been given the Lost Maps quest.

Sinna Redtoes says, "Go then to Keirstyn Alfevson. She is much more reasonable person to deal with then that Karle. All he can think about is claiming land for his precious clan. Tell her Sinna Redtoes sent you and see what she has to say. I will reward you well if you can retrieve both maps."
[Step #1] Seek out Keirstyn Alfevson. When she asks, tell her [Sinna Redtoes] sent you.
Keirstyn Alfevson loc is 43542 42283 in Aegir's Landing.
Keirstyn Alfevson says, "Yes, what might I do for you?"
You say, "Sinna Redtoes sent me."

Keirstyn Alfevson says, "Oh dear, I feared it would come to this. I have heard that Sinna Redtoes had some maps stolen and that she thinks some of the Grenlock Clan was responsible. I'm not surprised that she sent someone here to speak with me. I'm sad to say I think [she is correct]."
Keirstyn Alfevson says, "A few days ago I awoke to find that four members of
the Clan had disappeared. At first I figured that my brother Karle had sent

them into the wild lands, since their packs were gone. When I heard later that day that Sinna Redtoes had seen Grenlock Clan members around her packs, I began to wonder. I went to Karle and he denied sending the four on any kind of mission. It was then that I [remembered something]."

Keirstyn Alfevson says, "That evening at dinner, before the four disappeared, I heard one of the men, Modolf, mention the town of Knarr in Munin Sound. I think I heard one of the missing women mention the word 'treasure' but I cannot be sure. Ever since I learned of the theft, I have been trying to track down the four without luck. I know Sinna sent you here to get the maps back. I cannot give you maps I do not have, but I can give you this. Use it to get to Knarr quickly and ask around the town to see if anyone has seen or heard of Modolf. I wish you luck."
You receive a ticket to Knarr from Keirstyn Alfevson!
[Step #2] Use the horse ticket to travel to Knarr in Munin Sound. Ask around town to see if anyone has heard or seen of [Modolf].
When you get to Knarr, talk to Heikki. He is right next to the stablemaster. Heikki loc is 7256 54337.
Heikki says, "Hail. Might I do something for you?"
[Step #3] Talk with Heikki about Modolf.
Heikki says, "Modolf? If you're looking for him, I'm sorry to say you won't

have much luck. He's gone. I was on watch the night he came through here so I remember him. A few nights ago he came into Knarr all in a big rush, demanding I give him a boat. Well, I told him I wouldn't give him one but that I would sell him one. He argued and stomped around telling me that no one said no to Modolf, but I stood my ground. I paid good gold for that boat and wasn't going to just give it away! He finally relented and handed over a pouch of gold. I took him to [my little boat]."

Heikki says, "As he got into the boat I wondered if I had done the right thing selling him the boat. He had no clue what he was doing. Can you believe a Norseman who doesn't know how to handle a boat? I showed him how to row it properly and then he headed out northeast across the water and followed the coastline until I lost sight of him. I figured that was the last I'd see of him or my little boat but [I was wrong]."
Heikki says, "I wasn't on watch the next night, so I decided to do a little
hunting before sunset. I went up the coast past the Shalklan camp and what
did I find on shore? Modolf's pack, soaked with water and my little boat,

upside down, with a big hole in it! I know I had sold the boat, but I was still upset. I began to drag the boat back to here when I realized that I hadn't seen Modolf anywhere, just his pack. I went back and search for him
but I couldn?t find him anywhere. But that time the sun had set and that is
[not a good time] to be far from home."
Heikki says, "Many people have drowned out in that part of the land. I think

the mist menaces that roam around there confuse people and they end up capsizing their boats. At night the spirits of those drowning victims come out and haunt the land. If Modolf did drown, that's where you'll find his spirit. That's all the help I can give you. I wish you luck in finding him."
[Step #4] Follow the east coast around past the Shalklan settlement until
you find the mist menaces. At night, the drowning victims roam the land
north of that part of the coast. Look for Modolf there and obtain the map
from him.

Go find Modolf at around 35k, 21k in Munin Sound. He spawns sometime around 10:00 PM. He cons blue/green to a 34 healer. You need to go inland from the shore just a bit, not right at the edge of the water.
As you start attacking him:
Modolf says, "You will not get my map! Never!"
You receive Modolf's map from Modolf!
As you tuck Modolf's map into your pack, you notice that there is some writing on the back of the map.
=== Note on Modolf: even if you aren't doing the quest, kill Modolf if you see him. I've killed him 2 times now and received 3 different axes from him. ===
[Step #5] The map has some writing on it. Perhaps you should use the map and
see what it says. To read the map, use it.
You attempt to use Modolf's map.
As you read the note written on the back of the map, you find a horse route
ticket tucked inside.
You receive a ticket to Bjarkan from Modolf's map!
The Modolf's map reads, "Bjarken. Meet Merja while L. and I. Search. Soon. Bring map. Use ticket. Do not get caught by Karle or Keirstyn!"
[Step #6] Use the horse ticket to travel from Knarr to Bjarken to meet Merja. Talk to her when you arrive.
Merja loc is 10388 54602 in Bjarkan(Gripklosa Mountains).
Merja says, "Yes, what might I? where did you get that map you carry? I know
that map! It is not yours and I know because I helped to steal it? I know where it came from. How did you come to have it? Did you steal it like a thief in the night? Tell me!"
[Step #7a] Tell Merja that [Modolf drowned and I got the map].
[Step #7b] Talk with Merja about why they stole the maps.
Merja says, "I knew something like this would happen. It was such a bad idea to steal those maps. Yes, we stole them! I knew it was wrong but Modolf,
Loden, and Idette convinced me to go along with them. I tried to talk Modolf

into letting me go with him to Knarr and helping with the boat, but he insisted he could handle it himself. He sent me here to wait while he, Idette, and Loden all went off in search of the treasure. I think we will all [pay the price] for stealing from the dwarves."

Merja says, "Then you must find Loden and Idette. I would go seek them myself, but I still have a shred of hope that they will return here. If they do I will get the maps from them and hold them until your return. The people here say they saw Loden and Idette heading kind of east from here, through a valley and then they turned north. How far they got, I don't know, but that's where you should start searching. I'm sure they won't give up the map halves easily, so be careful. You may even want to take some friends with you. Come back to me when you have both halves and I will reassemble the map for you."
[Step #8a] Retrieve both halves of the map. Loden has one half and Idette
has the other. You may get either one first. They were last seen heading
east through a valley near Bjarken, then north.
Go find both Idette and Loden at about 21k,47k during the night time.
Idette was a skeleton and conned blue to a 35 healer. Loden was an undead and conned green to a 35 healer.
Loden loc is 22646 48203 in Gripklosa mountains. Time was 9h 2m 17s, he was already spawned when I showed up. Con green to level 32. Respawn every 10 mins or so.
Idette loc is 20393 46501 in Gripklosa Mountains. time was 9h 2m 17s, he was already spawned when I showed up. Con blue/yellow to level 32. Respawn every 15 mins or so.
As Idette dies:
Idette says, "Loden! We are under attack! Flee if you can!"
===FYI: Loden doesn't listen ===
You receive Idette's map half form Idette!
[Step #8b] Get the other half of the map from Loden. He was last seen
heading east through a valley near Bjarken, then north.
You receive Loden's map half from Loden!
Loden says, "No! Now I shall never find the treasure before the dwarves!"
[Step #9} Return to Merja in Bjarken.
Merja says, "You have just confirmed my fears. Loden and Idette died in the
avalanche, didn't they? It saddens me to hear that. When I have the courage
I will return to the Clan and let them know of my wrongdoing and the deaths
of the other clan members. But for now, give me a piece of the map so that I
can put it back together and begin to make it up to the dwarves of Longbeard's group."
[Step #10] Give Merja one half of the map.
Merja says, "Now the other piece please."
[Step #11] Give Merja the other half of the map.
Merja says, "There it is done. Please return this map to Sinna Redtoes, for

we should have never stolen it from her. I will come in time to make my apologies to her and accept any punishment she may have for me. Please, take this to help you get back to her quickly. The quicker the maps are returned to her, the sooner I can begin to face what lies ahead of me. Go now and be well."
You receive a ticket to Aegirhamn from Merja!
You receive Merja's map from Mejra!
[Step #12] Use the horse ticket and return to Sinna in Aegirhamn.
Sinna Redtoes says, "You've been gone a while. What news do you have for me?
Any maps?"
[Step #13] Give Sinna Redtoes the map from Modolf.
Well, well, this is one of my lost maps. Were members of the Grenlock Clan to blame? Actually, if you have the other map, I don't really care who stole them. Do you have it?"
[Step #14] Give Sinna Redtoes the map from Merja.
Sinna Redtoes says, "It looks almost as if it was torn at some point, but I

can see it is whole, and that is all that matters. I am just thankful to have these maps back. I will keep them in a safer place this time. I know many seek the same lost treasures we do, and Longbeard would not be happy if someone else found them! Now since you served the dwarves so well, I shall
dig into my own store of treasures and [offer you a prize].?
[Step #15] Choose your reward from Sinna Redtoes.
Sinna Redtoes says, "I have a Fiery Garnet [belt], a Spirited Amber
[necklace], a Luminous Citrine [pin], a Terrence Adventureine [choker], a Chilly Sodalite [earring], and a Potent Amethyst [gem]. I can tell you about each one if you wish, of you may [choose now]."
Sinna Redtoes says, "The Firey Garnet belt was made by my grandfather and
will aid in resisting fire as well as add to you strength and dexterity.
Would you like the [Fiery Garnet] belt or would you like to hear [about the others]?"
Sinna Redtoes says, "The Spirited Amber necklace is very nice. Wearing it
will make you dexterous and quick, as well as help you resist those that attack your mind. Do you choose the [Spirited Amber] necklace or would you like to hear [about the others]?"

Sinna Redtoes says, "The Luminous Citrine pin is a rare creation of my own. When you are it, people will find you more charming and you will find yourself stronger. And it shall help you resist your enemies should they attack you with spells of light. Would you like the [Luminous Citrine] pin or would you like to hear [about the others]?"

Sinna Redtoes says, "The Terrene Aventurine choker was created by my mother before I came here to Aegir. It will protect you from those that try to attack you with earth spells, and will make you heartier as well as more pious. Do you wish to have the [Terrene Aventurine] choker or would you like to hear [about the others]?"

Sinna Redtoes says, "Ah, quite an earring it is! It is made from sodalite, a fine blue stone. While making you feel more pious, it will alsom make you feel dexterous. And it will definite come in handy if you should be ambushed by those Albions with their cold spells. Do you choose the [Chilly Sodalite] earring or would you like to hear [about the others]?"

Sinna Redtoes says, "The Potent Amethyst is a rare gem my grandmother found while she was a child and she has passed it down to my mother and now it has come to me. I hate to part with it, but I will if you desire it. While you wear it, it will make you strong and hearty, and help to defend you from the spells of those Hibernian casters. Would you like to have the [Potent
Amethyst] gem or would you like to hear [about the others]?"
Sinna Redtoes says, "Are you sure of your choice? Once you choose, you cannot change your mind. I can [tell you about them] again or you can choose the [Potent Amethyst] gem."
Sinna Redtoes says, "Here is your Potent Amethyst gem. I shall sing your praises tonight as I raise a horn of ale with Longbeard. May the House of Eir always watch over you."
You are awarded XX,XXX,XXX experience!
You are awarded 2 gold and some silver!
You have finished the Lost Maps quest.
You receive a Potent Amethyst gem from Sinna Redtoes!
Reward(s):
Fiery Garnet belt
Spirited Amber necklace
Luminous Citrine pin
Terrence Adventureine choker
Chilly Sodalite earring
Potent Amethyst gem
=== Side Note: Go talk to Longbeard after you finish the quest, and he says:
Longbeard says, "Ah, you are the one that Sinna Redtoes spoke of. You helped recover the maps that pesky Grenlock Clan stole. You are a friend of Longbeard now. I salute you!"
Rewards:
Potent Amethyst Gem
Fiery Garnet Belt
Sprited Amber Necklace
Luminous Citrine Pin
Terrene Adventurine Choker
Chilly Sodalite Earring

midgard|furf's reward.Name: Furf's Reward
midgard|furf's reward.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Dalla in Nalliten Guard Tower tells you about a cat in Skona Ravine...
Dalla glances over at you.
Dalla says, "Greetings friend. It's nice to see other adventurers roaming about these parts. I, too, used to [adventure]."
Dalla says, "I sought glory, treasure, and companionship, much like I'm sure you do. I found it, and a whole lot more. Adventuring had its ups and [downs] for me."
Dalla says, "Aye. My group and I were traveling through Skona Ravine, a most dangerous area, dodging the werewolves that live there, when we ran into a [large cat]."
Dalla says, "This cat hissed at us and lunged at one of my group mates. He slashed at him pretty good, all the while making a [furf noise]. With the help of our skald, we outran the thing."
Dalla says, "Yes, A strange noise indeed. Over the next few hours, we spoke of the cat often, but [didn't dare return]."
Dialog box: Do you accept the Furf quest?
You have been given the Furf's Reward quest.

Dalla says, "To this day I wish we had been able to get back to Skone to teach that cat a lesson. If you're up for some excitement, you should go to Skona and find Furf. I'm sure he'll prove quite a challenge."
[Step #1] Look for Furf in Skona Ravine near the werewolves main camp and slay him!

Kill Furf and get a fine sash. Loc: 50723, 36177 The spot where he spawns is like a little sand bar in the center of the ravine. It is a raised area, not a lot higher than the rest but a definite elevation.
You receive a Fine Sash from Furf!
You have finished the Furf's Reward quest.
You receive XXX amount experience.
Reward:
Fine Sash

midgard|ota's quest.Name: Ota's Quest
midgard|ota's quest.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per Patch 1.61b:
Ota's Quest, step 8 - Thanes can now turn in the pelt to Ota.

Ota Yrling in Aegirhamn wants a griffon pelt. You need to talk to a Bergklan Pelterer (loc is 4k 45k Gripklosa Mountains) and if you don't have neutral faction, you need to get it by killing morvalts.
After you talk to the Pelterer you will need to go back to Ota and she now wants something from a Griffon Loner. You can kill it or bargain with it.
Bargain:
If you bargain the loner will want a nose from a Hrimthursa Brute in Delling Crater. Return the nose and he will give you a kobold skin to give to Ota.
Ota will will reward you with xp.
Kill:
Kill the loner and get a claw and a pelt. Return them to Ota and get your reward. Most get a shield for this path.
As a Savage, in completing the quest by giving the Nose to the Griffon - I received a Hand to Hand weapon instead of a Cloak, or shield.
Received some exp and 15 gold.
Dialog:
[Step #2] Bring bag of trade items to a bergklan pelterer in the Gripklosa Mountains. Make sure you are on neutral terms with them.
Bergklan pelterer can be found at 4591,42781.
The bergklan pelterer says, "What?"
give bag of bartering goods to bergklan pelterer
The bergklan pelterer says, "Here, take this. Mammoth pelt. Should be good for you, kep you warm, well made."
[Step #3] Return the pelt to Ota.
Ota Yrling says, "Did you get the pelt Agrisi?"
give mammoth pelt to Ota.

Ota Yrling says, "Ah, well, let me take a look at it. Oh this will do. It is a simple, primitive styel. It will certainly stand out amongst the crowd. Oh! Especially when it's made of griffon fur! I can't wait! Alright, now, go find a griffon. You can find some griffon loners in the Gripklosa Mountains. That's the griffon pelt I want. When you kill the griffon, take the pelt to the pelterer. When the pelterer is finished, bring it to me, and I will reward you. Here, take part of the reward now, as a sign of good faith."
[Step #4] Hunt the Gripklosa Mountains for a griffon loner. If the griffon inquires, speak of [Ota].
(I found the griffon directly SSE of bjarken on the hill with the mylings to be the easiest to get close enough to talk to)
The griffon loner says, "What are you doing? Who sent you out here? Why do you hunt me?"
Say Ota.

The griffon loner say, "Ota. Ota. Ota. I know Ota. Ota is a hunter of what she calls exotic creatures. She is a fool Many have come for my pelt. Many have died. We can make a [bargain] Shaman, or shall you [die], as well?"
click [bargain]

The griffon loner says, "I hate hrimthusas. They bother me. I will forgive this act, if you kill a hrimthusa brute for me. Bring me the nose of a brute as proof, and I will reward you. You can find them in northwest part of the place you call Delling Crater."
[Step #5] Find a hrimthusa brute and kill it. They are found in the northwest portion of Delling Crater.
hrimthusa brutes can be found in delling crater at /loc 19000, 9000.
[Step #6] Take the giant nose back to the griffon loner.

The griffon loner says, "You killed a giant. Here. It is the skin of a kobold hunter. Take this to Ota. Tell her I've many like it, and do not need more. But if she sends me hunters, I will gladly oblige her. You may keep the trinket taken from this fool, as a reward."
give giant nose to griffon loner.
You recieve a kobold skin from the griffon loner!
You are awarded 15,728,640 experience!
You recieve a Cloak of Runes from the griffon loner!
[Step #6] Bring the kobold skin to Ota, and tell her the [griffon has many more].
tell Ota "griffon has many more" (I did this before giving her kobold skin. Not sure if you can give her skin first, but she won't take it after you speak to her).
Ota Yrling says, "You are insufferable! Reward? You wish a reward? For this betrayal? How dare you! I will have my griffon pelt! I will! As for you! Out of my sight!"
You are awarded 20,971,520 experience!
You have finished Ota's Quest quest.
Rewards:
Boned Fist - Savage
Griffin Claw -- Thane
Griffin Pelt Shield -- Warrior
Griffin's Impervious Pelt -- Skald
Pelted Fury -- Shaman and Runemaster
Rewards:
Cloak of Runes
Boned Fist
Griffin Claw
Griffin's Impervious Pelt
Pelted Fury
Griffin's Impervious Pelt Shield
Griffon Claw

midgard|tale of two trolls.Name: Tale of Two Trolls
midgard|tale of two trolls.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: You may or may not get this quest.

Darrius (kobold in the bar) in Fort Atla, mentions something about a book that he stole from the werewolves in Askheim. It details the history of the werewolves. Also mentions something about a magical crown. He no longer is able to continue the search. He needed cash so he sold the book to 2 trolls. The trolls began fighting over the book and ripped it into 2 pieces. The each parted with a half of the book. He directs you to the first troll in Galplen. He mentions a strange woman that is searching for the book as well.

Darrius says, "Greetings friend. Have you heard the news? My wife is due very soon. I am so happy. I am hoping for a wonderful baby girl but I will be happy with just a healthy baby. I have had to give up my studies and [stay home] to watch over my wife."

Darrius says, "I have even had to sell some of my most treasured objects to gather money so I will be able to support my family. I am almost saddened that I may never get to journey back to Galplen in search of the crown I [read] about."

Darrius says, "Aye, I had this old book and I had managed to translate some of it. It told a story about werewolves and how they came from a far away land to our shores and settled down in the fort of Askheim, in Myrkwood. It also mentioned the leader of the werewolves, a Baron Falwar, has a mystical crown. The crown has been passed down from werewolf leader to leader. At least I managed to earn a few coin from the sale of the book. I [sold it] to two trolls."
Darrius says, "It is an interesting story. Would you like to hear more about the tale of two trolls?"
Dialog box: Find the two trolls and learn what secrets the old book holds?
You have been given the Tale of Two Trolls quest.
[Step #1] Learn of the two trolls from Darrius, in Fort Atla.

Darrius says, "I guess they were friends until they bought my book. I saw them get angry and they started fighting. They almost crushed me by accident as they [rolled around] the floor. Finally, they tore my poor book in half."

Darrius says, "I told them to get out. I was amazed that they wanted their money back because the book was torn up. They are probably somewhere in Gaplen trying to sell someone what is left of the book. I am kind of [glad] I sold the book."

Darrius says, "A few days after the trolls bought the book, a strange woman came through town searching for it. She said that an old Runemaster had told her I had it. She seemed really upset when I told her I sold the book and wanted to know [who] bought it."

Darrius says, "I told her that the troll called himself Aki and had said he was returning to Galplen. The woman said she studied werewolves and wanted any knowledge the book contained. I told her I didn't know anything else."
Darrius says, "Wait! I have an idea."

Darrius says, "If you can get the book back from the trolls maybe you can seel her the book. I am sure she will pay quite a few coins for it. It seemed really important to her. I don't understand why anyone would want to study the [werewolves] anyway."

Darrius says, "They are cursed. Legend tells of people who could change into forest creatures but only because of their faith. The werewolves can change others into werewolves with but a single cite. That is why I did not mind trying to [steal from them]."

Darrius says, "The crown sounds like it could be a worthy prize for someone strong enough to go get it. If I were you, I would go to the stables and get a horse. You can reach Galplen much faster if you ride. Aki should be selling his wares somewhere around town. Talk to him about it."
[Step #2] Journey to Galplen and seek out Aki, the troll, for the first half of the book.

Aki a troll merchant in Galplen is the first troll. He talks about the book a little and explains that he cant read and will trade you the book for a perfect badger pelt from a woodland badger found in skona ravine. These mobs were blue and yellow to me at 25. These are found near the eastern start of the ravine in Skona.He also mentions that a woman came to him seeking the same book and she is looking for a pelt to get it as well. Bring him the pelt and he gives you the first half of the book. He mentions that the woman came back with a pelt but it was torn to shreds (may be a clue about her origins) and useless to him so he denied her the book. He then directs you to the 2nd troll located in Gna Faste. Some harsh words about his ex-friend end with a comment about hoping that Njesse eats him if he crosses the lake.
Kedin a troll merchant in Gna is your second troll. He talks a little about
the feud with Aki. He is willing to part with his half of the book if you
bring him some oil from a Giant Tree Frog from Skona Ravine. These mobs
conned blue to me at 25. They are found near the stonehedge type place. Bringing him the oil earns you his half of the book. He directs you to the

mysterious woman near the werewolf fort of Askheim. You may be sent to kill some drakes instead. I found the young drakelings at loc = 5.5k, 61k. Im a lvl 25 zerker and they coned btm. Was by 2 broken egg mounds over by skona.
Alina is found east of Askheim along the shore. Give her the books and she
details some history of the werewolf colony. She also regrets that you know
of the magical crown and challenges you to confront her after sunset eluding
that she is a werewolf. At about the 20th hour she will despawn. After a few
mins I began looking around to find her so am unsure of her spawn location.
She wanders around as Noble Werewolf Alina. She was blue to me at 25.
Kill her and her dying words are something about Baron Falwur having the
crown but you better bring an army if you wish to have the crown.
Baron Fulwar is located in the Werewolf fort of Askheim surrounded by about
5-6 werewolves and minor werewolf nobles. Kill him and you recieve the
crown. Baron is BAF so you may need a few people to help take down all the
werewolves.
The Baron Falwur calls for help!
You receive a Woven Crest Crown from Baron Falwur!
You have finished the Tale of Two Trolls quest.
Rewards:
Rigid Crescent Crown -- Shadowblade
Woven Crescent Crown -- Bonedancer, Rune and Spiritmasters
Barbed Crescent Crown -- Skald, Thane, and Warrior
Thick Crescent Crown -- Healer and Shaman
Spiked Crescent Crown -- Berserker and Hunter
Rewards:
Rigid Crescent Crown
Woven Crescent Crown
Barbed Crescent Crown
Thick Crescent Crown
Spiked Crescent Crown

midgard|young fire wyrm lord.Name: Young Fire Wyrm Lord
midgard|young fire wyrm lord.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Bolli says, "Ah greetings fellow Adventurer! I am Bolli, former Skald now retired. Have you time for a [tale] of love, adventure and loss?"
I lost this part...

Bolli says, "With my addition, her group was complete. We ran all over Midgard, slaying beasts, helping villagers... We had a splendid time. We had gained enough wisdom and insight that we went to Muspelheim in search of new adventure, [new opponents], and new riches."

Bolli says, "Aye, and new opponents were to be found everywhere in Muspelheim. At first, we were giddy and excited. We had found a nest of lava lizards and enjoyed ridding the world of them. Little did we know they had a [keeper]."
Bolli says, "Lava lizards are related to a family of drakes called Fire Drakes. These Fire Drakes have higher ranking members amongst them. One of these was a [Young Fire Wyrm Lord]."
Bolli says, "And a dreadful site he was too. Larger than other beast I've seen, he roams around Muspelheim, like the Lord of the manor! He didn't take too [kindly] to us beatin' on his kinfolk."
Dialog box: Do you accept the Fire Wyrm quest?
You have been given the Young Fire Wyrm Lord quest.
Bolli says, "Aye. I tried to use my traveling sone, but the rest of my group couldn't keep up. He [slaughtered] them, along with my beloved Gunnhildr."

Bolli says, "I don't know you too well, traveler, but if you're brave of heart and stout of spirit, then perhaps you'd like to visit the creature and slay him. I wish you luck on your journeys, friend. Be wary of the evils in Muspelheim."
[Step #1] Go to Muspelheim and destroy the Wyrm Lord.
Go to Muspelheim and follow the wall to the left around to the Wyrms. The Young Wyrm Lord us located approximately 54k, 13k
You receive a Wyrm sleeves from the Young Wyrm Lord!
You have finished the Young Fire Wyrm Lord quest.
You get 1,850,000 experience points.
Reward:
Wyrm Sleeves

midgard|krrrck's torment.Name: Krrrck's Torment
midgard|krrrck's torment.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: The quest starts in Vasudheim with Arnleif. She asks you to find and release the spirit of Krrrck, trapped in a frog's body.
Arnleif finishes examining several plant leaves.
Arnleif says, "Ah, you startled me! Are you here because of [Krrrck]?"

Arnleif says, "Ah such a sad tale. Originally, Krrrck was a priest of Skadi, helping oyung Hunters learn the ways of the woods, as well as tutoring villagers on how to survive the harsh winters. His name was [Erik]."
Arnleif says, "Erik was very improtant to Skadi, and she rewarded him well for his services. Loki, ever the mischief-maker, decided to trick Skadi and turned her friendly priest into a [frog]."
Arnleif says, "A large troll indeed! When the Goddess came to find Erik, all she found in his temple was this large frog. Not knowing what had happened to Erik, Skadi went in [search] of him."
Arnleif says, "She searched high and low for him, coming back to his temple twice a day to see if he had returned. The only one waiting for her was the [miserable], lonely frog."
Arnleif says, "Skadi, still unhappy with the disappearance of her priest, took the frog to [Skona Ravine] where he could be with other wildlife."

Arnleif says, "Skona Ravine and a wonderous place, filled with many creatures and various healing plants. It is said that Erik wishes to be released from his [imprisonment] and rejoined with his goddess, Skadi."
Dialog box: Do you accept the Krrrck's Torment quest?
You have been given the Krrrck's Torment quest.

Arnleif says, "You can find Krrrck living in Skona Ravine along with the other wild creatures. It is said the sadness that penetrates his heart will never be eased until he returns to his goddess and is avenged. Find him and release his soul. He has recently been seen to the west and south of the circle of stones in Skona Ravine."
[Step #1] Seek out Krrrck, slay him and release his soul. He has been spotted to the south and west of the circle of stones in Skona Ravine.
Krrrck spawns in several locations:
on the standing stone mound in Skona
depression in ground NW of mound
On second level in ravine
location 51, 8
After killing him, you receive the bulbous eye.
You receive a Bulbous Eye from Krrrck!
You have finished the Krrrck's Torment quest.
No word on whether Bonedancers can do this quest or not.
Reward:
Bulbous Eye

midgard|juuso's potion.Name: Juuso's Potion
midgard|juuso's potion.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Juuso can be found in Dyrfjall.
Juuso says, "Please tell me that you are here to help me! I have gotten
myself in a bind and I'm not sure how to get out of it alone. If only I
hadn't agreed to help [that crazy woman] I wouldn't be in this situation, but she scares me!"
Juuso says, "I think you know whom I speak on! None other than Catla! You

must have realized that she is very unstable. If she continues with her plan it won't be long for her to be completely insane. I'm sure she has told you she wants to tap into the power of the mother of the Morvaltar. She refused to accept the fact that humans cannot wield that power! You know she has been asking ever Valkyn in Aegir's Landing to help her out, right? There was [only one] who was brave enough to take on working with Catla."
Juuso says, "I'm sure Catla mentioned Kyllikki to you. Anyone who has talked
with Catla has heard of Kyllikki and how she has refused to teach Catla
anything else. You are not the only one who was asked to get those scrolls.
Catla wanted them more than anything and she asked everyone she ran into to
get them. I know you helped her because she came to me and [ordered me] to help her when the scrolls didn't give the information she wanted."

Juuso says, "Yes, she ordered me to help her! She said she heard that I knew of a potion that would let her use the power of the mother and I was to make it for her so that she could use that power. It is true that I have learned some ways to draw upon that power, but most of my strength come from Bogdar and the potion is very dangerous. I tried to tell her that but she would hear none of it! All she wants to hear is that she can use the power of the mother to [destroy her enemies]."

Juuso says, "She longs to destroy Albion and Hibernia for what happened to her family and I swear she'll destroy anyone who gets in her way of doing that. I've even heard her make remarks about taking control of Midgard! She scares me! She threatened to have my spirit sucked into the depths of Hel's domain if I didn?t do as she ordered. What was I to do? I must make the potion but I must also go to Catla and tell her everything I know about Morvaltar. She doesn't understand I can't do both at once and that I [need someone] to collect the ingredients for the potion."
Dialog box: Will you help Juuso make the potion to save him from Catla's wrath?
You have been give the Juuso's Potion quest.
Juuso says, "Thank you! You may have save both of our lives if you are able
to get the things that we need for the potion. It will not be an easy task,
but I have many friends that will help me reward you well for this. And it
is to [one of these friends] that you must go first."
Juuso says, "Before I came here to Aegir's Landing I spent some time with

the Skalklan in Munin Sound. An oyster-gathering Skalklan named Edrigu taught me many secrets of the Skalklan. One of those secrets was the potion Catla spoke of. Edrigu had enough purpose for it, but it had an interesting side effect on many. It allowed the drinker to speak directly to the spirit of the mother, who would then grant more of her power to use. One of the ingredients can [only be obtained] from Edrigu."
Juuso says, "That is a problem for you. The Skalklan are not very welcoming
to outsiders and will not talk to you if you approached them. But fear not!
Edrigu and the other Skalklan know me and will speak to one who carries a
sign from me. I have an amulet that Edrigu would recognize but it's missing [one piece]."
Juuso says, "The Skalklan do not like the creatures called ingesters that
live in Munin Sound. Getting a wiggly tentacle from one would help prove
that you want to be a friend to the Skalklan. Once you get a wiggly
tentacle, you will need to set it in the middle of this amulet. The Skalklan
will leave you alone as long as you wear it, but if you should harm a single Skalklan while you wear it, it will destroy the amulet and they could
possibly hate you! Seek out Edrigu and tell him Juuso sent you. He will know
what I seek. I wish you luck!"
You receive an unfinished Skalklan amulet from Juuso!
[Step #1] Obtain a wiggly tentacle from an ingester that lives in Munin Sound. They can be found on the northern end of the island that is east of Knarr.
== The ingesters are exactly where step #1 says they are. If you swim east
from Knarr, and go to the northside, you'll find the ingesters which are
blue/yellow to a 34 healer. Be careful of the flying griffons which are blue
and will drop down on you while swimming. ==
You receive a wiggly tentacle from the ingester!
[Step #2] Use the amulet Juuso gave you to complete it so that you may speak
with Edrigu, then put it on. Remember, do not attack any Skalklan while
wearing the amulet! Follow the road to Knarr. When the road nears the water,
turn west to find Edrigu.
== To use the amulet, drag it to the hot bar, and the while holding down the
use key (default to E) click on the amulet. ==
You attemt to use the unfinished Skalklan amulet.
You use the unfinished Skalklan amulet.
You receive a finished Skalklan amulet from the unfinished Skalklan amulet!
You complete the amulet give to you by Juuso!
[Step #3] Seek out the ancestral Skalklan member named Edrigu in Munin
Sound. Remember to wear the amulet or he will not talk to you! Follow the
road to Knarr. When the road gets close to water, turn west to find Edrigu.
== Edrigu can be found at about loc=15200,24400. He is a yellow in a camp of grays to a 34 Healer. ==
Edrigu says, "You wear an amulet I know. Who sent you to me?"
[Step #4] Tell Edrigu that [Juuso sent] you for the ingredient for the
potion.
Edrigu says, "Juuso. He wishes to make the potion again? I wish he would not
do that. It is not good for him. Too much power makes goo people bad. I see
it many times. I will give you what Juuso needs. I know I cannot change
Juuso?s mind, but I ask you not to drink the potoin he makes. It is bad and you seem good. Take it and go from here. No good will come from this potion. I know it!"
You receive a skin of fluid from Edrigu!
== At this point he starts attacking me. I still had the necklace on, but he
didn't like me anymore. ==
[Step #5] Return to Juuso in Dyrjfell.
Juuso says, "Do you have the fluid from Edrigu? Catla has been by three times asking for the potion! I fear if she has too wait to long Bogdar will
not be able to save me. I gave my promise that I would deliver the potion. Now please, give me the fluid."
[Step #6] Give Juuso the skin of fluid you obtained from Edrigu.
[Step #7] Finish talking to Juuso then go hunt a woolly mammoth for its fur.
Woolly mammoths can be found in the Gripsklosa Mountains. Make sure you have the two vials from Juuso! You may also be asked to get a fur from a Megaloceros Fawn instead.
Juuso says, "This helps a great deal, but we are not done yet! All will be
well when you get the rest of the ingredients! This fluid is only one part of the potion. You must now travel to Gripklosa Mountains and see out [three creatures] that dwell there."
Juuso says, "First you must find a woolly mammoth and obtain some of its
fur. The fur will tether Catla in this world so that she will not become
lost in the spirit world while she searches for the mother. After you have
the fur, you will need the blood of [two Morvaltar]."
You receive a empty vial from Juuso!
You receive a empty vial from Juuso!

Juuso says, "Take these vials and return them filled with the blood of the Morvalt vandarare and the Morvalt streber. Their blood, when mixed with the fluid from Edrigu and the fur, is what allows the communication with the
mother. It will not work for Catla but she must learn that for herself. She
will not listen to reason! Once you have filled both vials return to me so
that I may complete the potion and save us both from Catla's wrath!"
== The mammoths are found by going east from the city Bjarkan down a valley
that will eventually become snowy. It will come to an opening with mylings,
morvalt strebers, morvalt beskyddas, frost dusters, and Megaloceros Fawns.
They all range from blue to red at level 34. The mammoths spawn from there
to and then up to the north, they are usually yellow/orange con. ==
You receive a tuft of woolly mammoth fur from the woolly mammoth
[Step #8] Find a morvalt vandarare in Gripklosa Mountains and get some of
its blood.
== The morvalt vandarare, green con, can be found just outside of Bjarkan on
the hill just past where the bergklans walk, approx loc=15900,48600. ==
You receive vandarare blood from the morvalt vandarare!
[Step #9] Find a morvalt streber in Gripklosa Mountains. Get some of its
blood for Juuso.
== The morvalt strebers, con blue/yellow, can be found back in the same location at the woolly mammoths. Approx loc=31300,48500 ==
You receive streber blood from the morvalt streber!
[Step #10] Return to Juuso in Dyrjfell.
Juuso says, "Please, give me the fur so that I may finish this potion. I have appeased Catla for a while with some spells to try, but every hour that
passes without the potion being complete adds to my fear that she will send my spirit to Hel."
[Step #11] Give Juuso the fur you obtained.
Juuso drops the fur into skin of fluid from Edrigu.
Juuso says, "Now, give me the vandarare blood. I must add it now."
[Step #12] Give Juuso the vandarare blood.
Juuso slowly pours the vandarare blood into the skin of fluid.
Juuso says, "Carefully hand me the streber blood! I don't want to spill it
or the potion will be ruined!"
[Step #13] Give Juuso the streber blood.
Juuso pours the streber blood into the skin of fluid.
[Step #14] Talk to Juuso and choose your reward.
Juuso says, "There, it is done! I must deliver this to Catla. But before I
go, I must reward you. I owe you my life. I have many friends who make fine
weapons. If you tell me [what you want], I will give it to you."

Juuso says, "My friends have given me [swords], [hammers], [axes], [staves], a [spear], a [bow], and axe for your [left hand] and [hand to hand], weapons. Which would you prefer? Once you choose you cannot change your mind!"
== I picked the hammer. ==
Juuso says, "Would you like a [one-handed] or a [two-handed] hammer?"
== I picked the one-handed hammer ==
Juuso says, "Here is your Beinbrottsjo war hammer. I hope it will help to
defend you against Catla if she should ever completely lose her grip on
sanity. I must go to her now and deliver this potion that will not work for her. Wish me luck!"
You are awarded 63,438,848 experience!
You are awarded 2 gold and some copper!
You have finished the Juuso?s Potion quest.
You receive a Beinbrottsjo War Hammer from Juuso!
If you choose the staves, you are asked if you want a staff for [darkness], [suppression], [runecarving], [summoning] or [bone lore].
Rewards:
Beinbrottsjo War Hammer
Sjeltyv Sword
Skjaerer Two-handed Sword
Sann Flykt Bow
Bladdanser Axe
Krigvill
Innskrenk Staff
Sterkvill
Farlig Great Axe
Morkskygge Staff
Lynspyd Spear
Hode Knuse War Hammer
Skinned Hunter Shield

midgard|lord lauur's wife.Name: Lord Lauur's Wife
midgard|lord lauur's wife.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Talk to Dunfjall again after you have finished The Creatures of Myrkwood and Helping the Werewolves and he will give you a new quest called Lord Lauur's Wife. You will be sent to talk to Lord Lauur, who only spawns between 12a and 8a.
Lord Lauur is upset that his wife's spirit is being held by the two factions, svartalfar and arachite.

Next you talk to Hyua, the troll hiding behind a tree behind the merchants and stablemaster at Gna Faste. She will be happy that Lene's spirit was captured, then she will try to kill you. Kill her instead, and receive her diary.
You have to read the diary to find out what to do next, "use" the diary to read it.
When you read it, it will give you the location of Lene's spirit.
Te'Bui in Spindelhalla is the holder, kill him to get a white spirit crystal. Use this crystal to find out where next crystal is.
Kill an arachite tunnelhost to receive a black crystal, and take both to Lord Lauur so he can get his wife's spirit back.
After he puts the crystals together and restores his wife's spirit he is grateful and he gives you a reward for helping him.
Rewards:
Treskyggae Cloak -- Hunter and Shadowblade
Morktblad Cloak -- Runemaster and Spiritmaster
Mektigskog Cloak -- Berserker, Skald, Thane and Warrior
Viltdyr Cloak -- Healer and Shaman
Rewards:
Morktblad Cloak
Treskygge Cloak
Viltdyr Cloak
Mektigskog Cloak

midgard|thraxia's dilemma.Name: Thraxia's Dilemma
midgard|thraxia's dilemma.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Part II to Helping the Arachites, it's the continuation.

Talk to Fressen, the Kobold on the beach, on the shipwrecked boat -- next to Trolki. Fressen sends you off to talk to Thraxia. This is the same one from before. She spawns from 8a to 4p, then one of the other two will spawn. I don't remember which one was next. She tells you that the werewolves and svartalfs imprisoned the spirit of some arachite priest.

Find out where the priest is being held. You assume to WW are behind this so you go to Skona Ravine to the huts SE of the rope brige and you will find a parchment. You will have to click a few times to find it You have to "use" it.

***I was very frustrated with this Quest. I searched the huts immediately southeast of the rope bridge for the parchment. This is not easy with all the Werewolf aggro in the big hut. As it turns out, the huts you are
supposed to search are at 50K, 40K. I found the parchment in the easternmost of the huts by clicking a few times inside.
Once I figured this out (by searching every structure in Skona), the rest of
the quest was relatively easy and the cloak is nice.
It seems this parchment belongs to a svartalf in Spindehalla. His name is Te'Bui, and he possesses the spirit. Kill him and he gives you a totem. Then you gotta use the totem to get the spirit.
The spirit tells you to kill Thelod in Varulv, he's a pragmatic. When he dies the priest is totally free.
Rewards:
Treskyggae Cloak -- Hunter and Shadowblade
Morktblad Cloak -- Runemaster and Spiritmaster
Mektigskog Cloak -- Berserker, Skald, Thane and Warrior
Viltdyr Cloak -- Healer and Shaman
Rewards:
Mektigskog Cloak
Treskygge Cloak
Morktblad Cloak
Viltdyr Cloak

timberland badger in Skona Ravine and find the item of a devoured warrior.
[Step #1] Kill Zrit-zrit in Skona Ravine. He's in the area to the Northeast of the Sidhe Draoi camp.
I couldn't get an exact loc, because he wanders around, but after killing a
half-dozen badgers, I saw him along the bottom of the cliffs to the north of
the main Werewolf ravine. He was yellow to me at 35.(one location Zrit-Zrit has been found is 12032, 45580, and loc=14000, 43000)

Agile Defender

midgard|black plague.Name: Black Plague
midgard|black plague.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-30 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: 1)Visit Nanna Vinsdottir (healer) (26,22), she will send you to speak with Arve (Enchanter) round hut by Mularn entrance and Ottar (Merchant) next to Arve
2) Nanna tells you to go see Arve (Enchanter) round hut by Mularn entrance.
3)Arve tells you to go see Ottar (Merchant) who is next to Arve.
4)Talk to Ottar and he gives you a sealed letter to take to Thora in Huginfell - Building to the left of the Inn
5) Give the letter to Thora, listen to her story, she will give you a letter to take back to Ottar, she will also ask you if you need gold for your travels.
6) Return to Ottar and hand him Thora's letter.
7) Go speak with Arve again then go back to Nanna.
8) Nanna will send you to kill Lecherous Gress, located above the Rocot rooms in DF. (you may be told to go to Uppland and kill a gelid mass (approx loc=29k, 29k) before being sent to DF)
9)Take the Stoppered Wonderous Potion Lecherous Gress drops back to Nanna, you get to keep the Unstoppered Wonderous Potion for your reward.
Reward:
Unstoppered Wondrous Potion (Mid)

midgard|morvalt crystal.Name: Morvalt Crystal
midgard|morvalt crystal.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Per Patch 1.60:

- Morvalt Crystal: The material type was set incorrectly on two of the rewards for this quest. Because material type does not auto-update, players can take their Studded Mammoth Pants and their Fur Brushed Chain Legs back to Kekov and exchange them for a pair with the correct armor factor and material type. Players must have the Morvalt Crystal listed in their completed quests list. The exchange may only be performed once.

Speak to Kekov in Hagall. He will complain about Bergklan. He also wants to retrieve the Morvalt Crystal from the Morvalt. He will tell you to find Kreg, a Bergklan Concoctor in the Grip. Mountains, and retrieve a map from him and also find out what the secret words are that will allow you to get the crystal. We found Kreg to the East/Northeast of Bjarken. (loc=46300, 40950)

Kreg was friendly faction, so we did not have to kill him. He was green to 49. We said {map} and he freely gave us the map, complaining he can't read the words on the map anyway. We got about 150 million X.P. and the map. The map gives directions and has 3 charges of some sort of a AF buff. The words on the Map are "Rosa Er Kraft". The map tells you to look in the very NW of the Grip Mountains for the Morvalt camp, and that is where we found it.

The camp is mainly green and the occasional blue to 49 Morvalt. Upon entering, we also saw a large purple Crystal Holder. She is neutral and looks like an oversized female Kobold. You don't have to fight her.

Upon killing the morvalts in the vicinity, we got a little message in our text box that said: "The Words?" We spoke them, but nothing happened. Turns out you have to run right up to the fire, near the Crystal Holder and say the words {Rosa Er Kraft}, when there are no Morvalts in the vicinity. You are then teleported to a nearby tower, with crystal in hand.
Unfortunately, only the person who speaks the words advances in the quest. We had to wait for respawn (which was quick) for my other group member to advance in the quest.
We then returned to Kekov in Hagall, gave him the crystal and completed the quest. We received another 180 million X.P. and Fur Brushed Chain Legs
Rewards:
Fur Brushed Chain Legs
Mammoth Lined Leggings
Mammoth Hide Pants
Studded Mammoth Pants

midgard|gazsi's nightmares.Name: Gazsi's Nightmares
midgard|gazsi's nightmares.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: 1. Talk to Luikko in Hagall.
2. Kill a Mammoth Herdguard in Gripklosa Mountains or Delling Crater and it will drop a fur.
3. Kill a Yellowed Skeleton in Delling Crater and it will drop a bone.
4. Kill a Sulphurous Cloud in Delling Crater and it will drop sulphur.
5. Return to Luikko in Hagall and give him the three items.

6. Kill Urtzi in Munin Sound (loc= 59k, 43k). To find him head west-southwest from Hagall until you enter Munin Sound. From there head south and hug the zone wall until you reach the shore. On the opposite side of the camp here you will see a couple of large rocks. Urtzi spawns there. You are advised to not kill him until after he performs his ritual. This way you will know exactly where to drop the dust after he is dead.

7. Drop the four dusts of powder in the various ritual locations. For example the rock behind Urtzi(59k, 42.5k) will glow black when you walk near it. You should drop the black powder in this location. All four of the locations are right around Urtzi, basically at four corners near him so just keep walking in the area until you find them all.
Bag Location
8. Return to Luikko in Hagall for your reward.

midgard|cargila's blessing.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Geiri in Nalliten tells you about a secret that he wants to know more about. He sends you to discover [Cargila's 9000] lives. Cargila is a Timber Cat.
Go to Skona Ravine and look for Cargila. She is a rare spawn near the entrance to Varulvhamn dungeon. Loc is 15k, 20k.

Got 65 silver....no xp

Boots of Stealthy Evasion

midgard|werewolf bane.Name: Werewolf Bane
midgard|werewolf bane.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Basically this quest involves searching deep within the new areas of Varulvhamn and killing 3 WW lords and the King.
The quest runs briefly as follows:
To obtain the quest at Level 43 or above, head to Vindsaul Faste and speak
with the Gothi of the Juton. He will instruct you to head to Gna Faste and
speak with Averrius who is located on the top level inside the hut.

He will explain to you about the situation and request that you retrieve a werewolf direction sense charm off a Wolfaur Headsman. The headsmen can be found inside the first hut within the ravine inside Skona, just before the bridge.
They conned blue to me at 45 and have a friendly faction since I killed so
many werewolves during my leveling. Your Wolfaur faction is always the
opposite of your Werewolf faction - they are at opposition with each other. You can either kill the Wolfaur (if your faction is bad) or talk with it to
obtain the sense charm.
Head back to Averrius and give him the charm, and he will explain to you that you need to head into Varulvhamn to kill the 3 lords and retrieve their essences.
Varulvhamn is down the end of the ravine
in skona on the SW of the ravine. The lords are all situated within the new
area. Kill each lord in turn (they all conned yellow to me at 45) and take
each essense to the Altar (you will know you are in the correct place as the
zone area name will change) and hotkey it, hold your use button and click
it. This will convert it to a gem. Do this in turn for each lord.
The lords are not particularly difficult, however we did it in a group of 4 with 2 skalds, 49 and 45 (me), a 50 healer and 45 thane. The mobs mostly
con blue/yellow to me and are annoying at best. The lords con yellow and
are more difficult than their con would suggest, so best to take people with
you.
Once all 3 gems are collected, head back to Averrius and he will ask for some
belladonna, to complete the mix. Head outside to the arrow merchant and she
will tell you to kill a mud crab warrior in Vanern. These are found at the very first region of the Vanern Swamp very close to the W entrance. Conned blue to me at 45.
Head back to Averrius and he will ask you for your weapon choice. Once complete, he requests that you kill the Werewolf King, Hresveigr.
King Hresveigr is found in the new section of Varulvhamn as well within a very

nice regal region of the cave. Mobs to kill on the way all con yellow/blue - there was only one orange to 45. The king himself stands alone in a room. He appears as an orange con troll. Bring people with you for this one. Attack him first as a troll and he's relatively easy, standard orange con mob - however when you kill him he reappears as a large WW and attacks immediately. This time he's a very strong orange con mob that nukes and has a type of damage shield.

Once you kill him you are rewarded with a bundle of experience which equates to about half-3/4 of a bub (I got 750 million or so at level 45, my level 49 skald friend got 1.3 billion) - and the quest is complete! The weapon is a handy mid 40's 100% quality weapon with proc if you don't have one already.
A friend of mine chose the 1h and got
the same name, only it said sword not 2H sword.
You can select from a number of weapons: 1 handed sword, axe or hammer; 2
handed sword, axe or hammer; or a bow (w/ 20 arrows). You do not need to
kill the King to receive the reward; you can kill him at a later time. I
did this quest solo (for the most part) at lvl 47; the high lords (3 total)
all con'd yellow; however, each fought like a high orange. I could not solo
one high lord -- Moldolfr; I suggest you a bring a friend for him. An
excellent map of Varulvhamn can be found at the following website.
http://www24.big.or.jp/~ruci/daoc/DAoC_image/varulvhamn.jpg
Rewards:
Varulbane Two-handed Sword
Varulbane Sword
Varulbane Axe
Varulbane Two-Handed Axe
Varulbane Claws
Varulbane Spear

midgard|gem of the dwarven king.Name: Gem of the Dwarven King
midgard|gem of the dwarven king.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Notes from 1.63 Patch:

- Gem of the Dwarven King - Players may now only use Longbeard's Necklace in the area where they locate the box containing the Gem of the Dwarven King. Players trying to use the necklace outside of that area will receive a message that they cannot use the necklace.
See Abjorn Onefoot in Hagall, and you will be send to talk to Ornulf if you are not KOS, kill him if you are. You can raise your faction by killing golems and cats
Look for Ornulf in Delling Crater. He can be found near a rock just outside of Dellingstad -- town next to the Caldera at 28k, 60k. He will drop a Note and a Tablet.
Place the Note on your toolbar and use it by pressing the "e" key. This gives further directions for you.
Kill the golems: Smastein at 19k, 43; Klippe at 13k, 48k; and Kampestein at 17k, 51k to 21k, 53k (also spotted at 19700,47700).
Place the map on your toolbar and use it as you did the Note. This will give you more directions.

In the Caldera at location 21k, 46.5k you there is a spot where you locate the box and can't move. Look SE for a steam vent from the N stairway. When you see it, jump in and move about until you get a message that you are encumbered from the box.
Note for Hunters and Shadow Blades, you will not be able to find the box while in stealth mode!
Then you use the three keys you got from the golems. When you use the last key it will unlock the box and you will receive the Lost Gem of the Dwarven King.
Put on Longbeard's Necklace for port back to Hagall.
Go back to Abjorn and give him the Lost Gem of the Dwarven King and pick your reward.
A lvl 47, got 1,613,282,672 experience.
A lvl 49 received 2.1 billion exp.
Rewards:
Himmelbrann
Nattbrann
Gronnbrann
Hvitbrann
Glodende Brann
Solbrann

midgard|price of excellence.Name: Price of Excellence
midgard|price of excellence.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: The drunken dwarf (the drunken dwarf inside the tavern in Jordheim, not the wandering one in the city) asks you to seek out a Lady of Loki. She is Gythja of Loki located in the Temple. Speak with her until she prompts you to
"speak his name". Ask her about Ulfgar.

She will give you a bit of the story and request you bring her some leather and some metal so she can bless them. She tells you not to bring her cheap metals or it will anger Loki. Lines: "The Legend of Fenrir's Folly" is from the Herald's quest contest of 2002. The winning story by Lloyd Barron, a.k.a.Thunn Segundus, can be found on the Camelot Herald.
Re-write by Velodim:
Get quest from Silvertone in the bar at Vasudheim.

Step 1 - He sends you to Londar who is at the top of the tower across the road from Haggerfel (climb the ladders.) He tells you to seek the fire giants in Muspelheim and get what information you can from them.

Step 2 - Some of my party got the next step from the fire giant scout right at the entrance. It seemed to be random as to whether you got step 3 from whichever fire giant you kill. We got the quest from fire giant scouts, fire giant lookouts and fire giant guards (all gray to 49). The only indication that you are done with step two is to check your journal.
Step 3 - Then it's back to Londar. Tell him of the [dream]. He sends you to the blodfelag fort in W Svealand. They're in the small house at location 17440, 21880. (gray con)
Step 4 - Kill a svard or three and get a Worn Journal.
Step 5 - Put it on a quick bar and USE it several times (read it). You'll now be told to go to Skona Ravine and find werewolf guards outside Varulvhamn.
Step 6 - There are werewolf guards right near the west skona horse stables at location 22800, 29500. Kill some and get a Dwarf Skin Scroll.
Step 7 - Put the scroll in your quick bar and USE it twice.
Step 8 - Return to Londar and tell him that the fragment is in [Raumarik]. Londar sends you to Gris in Jordheim to ask him about making a container to carry the sun fragment in.

Step 9 - Gris is in the smithy behind the tavern near the north gate in Jordheim (loc 25100, 25600). Tell him [Londar] sent you. He sends you to get the scales of a great brown drake (in Pennine) and the teeth from a parthelonian wizard (in Breifine).
Step 10 - Go to Pennine and kill a great brown drake. We found one at 46600, 25800. He was red to me at 49 and had 3 gray adds with him. (Note: lower lvl great brown drake's will also the scales)

In Breifine the Parthenon Guards are at about 61000, 10500 behind Crimm. They are almost all purple and you will get adds if you have more than 3 ppl in your group. On top of that you may have to worry about hibs or albs. (Strangely enough we saw none of either in Albion...)
Step 11 - Return to Gris in Jordheim and give him the scales and the teeth. Then click him again and he'll give you the Cold Iron Casket. He also gives you 45 gp.
Step 12 - Go to Londar again and tell him you [have the casket]. At this point he gives you 867,238,236 experience and sends you to Drav in Galplen.
Step 13 - Talk to Drav. He's near the entrance to the tavern in Galplen. He assures you he can handle the sun fragment if you get it and sends you off to kill the revenant.

Step 14 - Go to Raumarik and kill the Raumarik Revenant. He's in the undead fortress at about 11000, 11000. You will need a good group!!! I suggest killing any adds first (frore liches). He is very spell resistant and hard to kill. On his death we got about 57 million exp, a couple gold worth of loot and a White Hot Iron Casket to take back to Drav in Galplen.
Step 15 - Drav gives you 867,238,236 exp points and an item.

Lines: Per Read File Jan. 23, 2003:

And just a friendly reminder - the quest "Catla's Downfall" has prerequisite quests that have to be done before you can start it. So if you go to the starter NPC and get no keyword, you need to discover and complete the prereq's.

However someone sent in that they didn't have to do either and still got the quest. I have heard a rumor that Medana will react differently to you depending on what quests you have done. Juuso's Potion and Kylikki's Scrolls are said to be pre-req's but Juuso's Potion has been determined to not be.
Now someone says opposite, take it for what you will. Be safe and do them both, heh.
"A woman named Medana has come to Aegir's Landing to help stop Catla Gardasdottir's mad plans. Anyone that is level 49 or 50 should speak to Medana in Dyrfjell if they wish to help."
Basically you talk to Medana, spend some time in Iarnvidiur's Lair killing. Location of the dungeon is 28k, 39k in Iarnwood Forest.
There is a large population of hatchling snakes found throughout the lair, and that they are extremely aggressive, and will bring friends.
Step 4
You have to find Redcap in Iarnvidiur's Lair
There is no map of this dungeon atm, but go on north all the way and turn West at T. At loc 20k,19.4k, you gonna find some (con orange to level 50).
Your reward is 2 out of 11 bracers. You cannot chose two of the same, and they are no drop/no trade/no sell. The info is still sketchy so send me some to update with!

As for the exit: As you enter the dungeon, and peer over the edge of the drop off into the lair itself, there is a red tendril that runs from the cliff to the floor of the lair below, ending in the pool of water that you see as you look over the edge. This 'tendril' is actually a ladder. We discovered this after we jumped down into the water, and then examined the tendril. We lost no hit points with the jump, thankfully.
Exp awarded at level 49 was 2.9 billion - looked to me like one full
bubble of exp. Yow!
Another look at the quest, sent in by Weezen Weatherwax - Gaheris:
I was able to receive this quest without doing any of the prerequisite quests. I received it from Medena in Dryfel. I then needed to travel to Aegirhamn to talk to Catla Gardasdottir.

Step 2: You receive a note from Catla. When you read it, you receive instructions to Iarnvidiur's Lair and what you need to kill. According to instructions in the note you receive from Catla, "you will need a large spore from a cadby, the hair of a redcap davin, and the saliva of a kolvarg. All of these creatures can be found in Iarnvidiur's Lair."
Step 4: Obtain some hairs from the head of a redcap davin in Iarnvidiur's Lair.
Step 5: Go to Juuso in Dyrfjell in Aegir's Landing. You need to give the three items to Jusso
Step 9: Seek out Catla's spirit. As you exit Dyrfjell, follow the town's wall until you see three large boulders. She will be on top of the western most one.
You give her the potion you received from Juuso and in return you receive Catla's Spirit Stone.
Step 10: Go to Medana in Dyrfjell. You need to give her the stone and then you receive your choice of bracers.

Lines: Long quest that takes you from Dyrfjell and a rejected dwarf, to the depths of Trollheim. Your reward, the ancient Stoneheart. A weapon of your choosing.

Step 2: The sabertooth cats can be found in singles, though it may be hard to locate one. If you just try and pull one out of the "pack" it will result in everything baffing, so unless you have a group or 2 with you, I recomend not doing it that way.
Damekia is at 9.0, 49.3k grip in the daytime.
The cats roam east of the town in delling crater. They are loners and wander alot. We got 2 singles out there. I dont know what this guy was talking about in terms of packs. Cats are yellow at 50.

Move across the bridge to the center and you will see a spiral ramp. This leads down to a landing where you will find Darac. Darac is red con and has 3 fast spawning orange con flunkies. He is a hard red, but you certainly do not need 2 groups to drop him. We had the orange cons jump us at the landing, then Darac noticed us and agged. There was no purple con snake.

Lines: Anakoll, who is located in the same building as the recharger in Knarr, wants some yellowed skeleton bones. Yellowed Skeletons are found in Delling Crater.
Anakoll says, "Good day to you Agrissi. I am in need of some [assistance] if you could help."
Anakoll says, "Yes. There have been some undead around here lately that are causing problems. Specifically, the [yellowed skeletons]."

Anakoll says, "I have been studying them for some time now, but I have yet to be able to get my hands on a sample of their bones. If you can, please get me some bones so I might be able to complete my research."
Anakoll says, "Ah, some bones, thank you friend. If you happen to get anymore, I would gladly take them from you."
Reward: 4,161,277 experience.
